papers.title: SimWAM: A Simple World Action Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: World-Action Models (WAMs) improve end-to-end autonomous driving by transferring video dynamics priors to action prediction, but existing methods require costly future generation at inference. We present SimWAM, a simple yet effective WAM that uses video generation purely as a training signal. It co-trains a pretrained video expert and a lightweight action expert with joint flow matching. An isolated attention mask keeps action prediction independent of future frames, allowing the video branch to be discarded after training and leaving a self-contained planner that directly predicts trajectories. Since the two experts share no parameters and interact only through a unified attention interface, the video backbone could be replaced and the action expert scaled independently without modifying the learning objective or inference pipeline. We further apply reinforcement learning to optimize a compositional driving reward beyond trajectory imitation. Our SimWAM achieves $91.5$ PDMS on NAVSIM, surpasses state-of-the-art WAM-based planners with substantially lower latency, and transfers zero-shot to nuScenes. These results position SimWAM as a simple yet solid baseline that could readily benefit from advances in video generation for efficient autonomous driving. The code and model weights are available at https://github.com/H-EmbodVis/SimWAM/
papers.comment: The code and model weights are available at https://github.com/H-EmbodVis/SimWAM/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SimWAM 提出一种简单的世界动作模型 (World-Action Model)，用于端到端自动驾驶。其核心思想是将视频生成仅作为训练信号：联合流匹配 (joint flow matching) 同时训练预训练的视频专家与轻量级动作专家，并通过隔离注意力掩码使动作预测不依赖未来帧，从而在训练后丢弃视频分支，留下一个直接预测轨迹的自包含规划器。摘要报告该方法在 NAVSIM 上达到 91.5 PDMS，超越现有基于 WAM 的规划器且延迟更低，并能零样本迁移到 nuScenes。
Motivation: 现有 World-Action Models 通过将视频动态先验迁移到动作预测来提升端到端驾驶性能，但推理时需要昂贵的未来帧生成。本文旨在保留视频先验收益的同时，消除推理阶段的生成开销。
Method: 联合训练一个预训练视频专家和一个轻量级动作专家，二者通过统一的注意力接口交互且不共享参数；引入隔离注意力掩码使动作预测独立于未来帧，训练后可丢弃视频分支。随后应用强化学习优化组合式驾驶奖励，而不仅仅是轨迹模仿。
Result: 摘要报告 SimWAM 在 NAVSIM 基准上取得 91.5 PDMS，超过现有最先进的 WAM 规划器，并显著降低推理延迟；该方法还能零样本迁移到 nuScenes 数据集。
Conclusion: 作者认为 SimWAM 是一个简单而稳健的基线，能够直接受益于视频生成技术的进步以实现高效自动驾驶；代码和模型权重已公开。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MirrorWorld: Taming Video Diffusion Models for Mirror Reflection Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in video diffusion models (VDMs) have enabled high-fidelity video synthesis. However, generating mirror reflections remains challenging because the content within a mirror must remain consistent with the surrounding scene. Existing VDMs are not specifically designed to model scene-to-mirror relationships, which can lead to reflections with incorrect content or inconsistent spatial arrangements. We observe that mirror reflection generation involves two complementary challenges: determining what scene content should be reflected and how the reflected content should be spatially arranged within the mirror region. Motivated by this observation, we propose MirrorWorld, a reflection-aware video inpainting framework that models scene-to-mirror relationships during generation. Specifically, we introduce Semantic Relation Distillation (SRD), which transfers relational information from a frozen visual foundation model to encourage semantic associations between visible scene content and mirror regions. We further propose Geometric Transformation Alignment (GTA), which learns a transformation that guides the spatial arrangement of reflected content. The two components play complementary roles, with SRD modeling what should be reflected and GTA modeling how it should be arranged. To facilitate research on this problem, we construct a benchmark for video mirror reflection generation by repurposing four existing video mirror datasets into a unified reflection reconstruction task. Experimental results show that MirrorWorld achieves improved reflection reconstruction quality over representative image-based reflection generation methods and strong video inpainting baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MirrorWorld，一个面向镜面反射生成的视频修复框架，用于解决视频扩散模型 (VDM) 中镜内内容与周围场景不一致的问题。方法包含语义关系蒸馏 (SRD) 和几何变换对齐 (GTA)，分别建模应反射什么内容以及反射内容在镜面区域中如何空间排列。作者还整合四个现有视频镜子数据集构建统一基准，并在反射重建任务上优于基于图像的方法和强视频修复基线。
Motivation: 现有视频扩散模型虽能生成高保真视频，但未专门建模场景与镜面之间的对应关系，导致生成镜面反射时出现内容错误或空间排布不一致的问题。
Method: 提出反射感知视频修复框架 MirrorWorld。SRD 从冻结的视觉基础模型蒸馏关系信息，增强可见场景与镜面区域之间的语义关联；GTA 学习一个变换来引导反射内容的空间排列。两者分别解决反射内容和空间布局问题。
Result: 在整合四个现有视频镜子数据集构建的统一反射重建基准上，MirrorWorld 相比代表性基于图像的反射生成方法和强视频修复基线，实现了更好的反射重建质量。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将镜面反射生成分解为内容和空间排列两个互补问题，并通过语义关系蒸馏与几何变换对齐来建模场景到镜面的关系，可作为视频镜面反射生成研究的框架与基准。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CreativeInstruct: Scalably Teaching LLMs to Balance Quality, Creativity, and Diversity
papers.abstract_en: While post-training improves the capabilities of large language models (LLMs), it generally lowers their output diversity and creativity, negatively impacting tasks that explicitly require creativity (e.g., story generation) as well as those that require it implicitly, e.g., reinforcement learning (RL). We instead propose CreativeInstruct, a scalable instruction-tuning method that teaches LLMs to balance creative, base-model-like generations with the quality of post-trained models, by learning to inject special [StartCreativity] spans that bias generation toward creativity. Furthermore, we introduce a structural diversity metric based on graph edit distance, which captures narrative level variation missed by purely lexical and semantic metrics. On narrative generation, CreativeInstruct matches or exceeds the diversity of both multi-model baselines and distilled variants of their outputs, without sacrificing quality or requiring multiple models at inference time. These results are mirrored in our human evaluation, where we find that annotators rate CreativeInstruct generations as more creative than the post-trained LLMs' generations in 70.3% of cases. We also show the benefits of creative models as a substrate for RL: GRPO applied to a CreativeInstruct checkpoint improves by ~4% on AMC and ~5% points on MATH over the same training applied to the post-trained checkpoint.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CreativeInstruct，一种可扩展的指令微调方法，通过让模型学习注入特殊的 [StartCreativity] 片段来引导生成偏向创造性，从而在保留后训练模型质量的同时恢复基础模型般的生成多样性与创造性。作者还引入基于图编辑距离 (graph edit distance) 的结构多样性指标，以捕捉词汇和语义指标无法反映的叙事层面变化。在叙事生成上，CreativeInstruct 在无需推理时部署多个模型的情况下，匹配或超过多模型基线与蒸馏变体的多样性且不牺牲质量；人类评估中 70.3% 的案例被认为比后训练 LLM 更有创造性。此外，以 CreativeInstruct 检查点作为强化学习基座时，GRPO 在 AMC 上约提升 4%、在 MATH 上约提升 5 个百分点。
Motivation: 后训练 (post-training) 虽提升了大语言模型的能力，但通常降低输出多样性和创造性，损害显式需要创造力的任务（如故事生成）以及隐式依赖它的任务（如强化学习）。现有方法难以在规模上兼顾后训练质量与创造性。
Method: 提出 CreativeInstruct，一种可扩展的指令微调方法，训练模型平衡创造性的基础模型式生成与后训练模型的质量，具体通过学习注入特殊的 [StartCreativity] 片段来偏向创造性输出。同时提出一种基于图编辑距离的结构多样性指标，用于捕获纯词汇与语义指标遗漏的叙事层级差异。
Result: 在叙事生成任务上，CreativeInstruct 匹配或超过多模型基线和其输出蒸馏变体的多样性，且不牺牲质量、推理时无需多个模型。人类评估中 70.3% 的生成被认为比后训练 LLM 更有创造性；将 GRPO 应用于 CreativeInstruct 检查点相比直接应用于后训练检查点，在 AMC 上约提升 4%，在 MATH 上约提升 5 个百分点。
Conclusion: 作者认为可扩展地平衡质量与创造力是可行的，且创造性模型可作为强化学习的更好基座；该方法的优势包括推理时单模型即可，并为评估叙事多样性提供了新的结构指标。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CoinRAG: Contextualized Information Nugget KV Cache Reuse for Long-Context RAG
papers.abstract_en: Recent optimization studies on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) have exploited chunk-level KV cache reuse to avoid processing long retrieved contexts for higher efficiency, while significant information redundancy and noise still remain in the coarse-grained chunks. This paper optimizes the Pareto frontier under low prefill latency constraints while maximizing accuracy by proposing CoinRAG (Contextualized Information Nugget KV Cache Reuse for Long-Context RAG). The name metaphorically reflects our core mechanism: much like assembling small tokens (or "coins") to accumulate a larger value, CoinRAG compositionally reuses offline-computed, fine-grained nugget caches to form a learned contextual representation efficiently in a more semantically relevant but compact manner. Specifically, instead of full-chunk encoding, CoinRAG identifies query-relevant semantic units within retrieved chunks through two-stage retrieval and seamlessly assembles their sliced KV representations with a chunk-level context. Extensive evaluations on LongBench multi-hop question answering tasks demonstrate that CoinRAG significantly reduces operational costs and outperforms the other baselines with a new Pareto frontier and an average 5.3% relative improvement in answer quality (F1) under a standard fast prefill latency budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CoinRAG，一种面向长上下文检索增强生成（RAG）的细粒度 KV 缓存复用方法。与整块（chunk-level）缓存复用不同，CoinRAG 通过两阶段检索识别检索块中与查询相关的语义单元（nugget），并将这些细粒度 KV 表示与块级上下文组合，以在低预填充（prefill）延迟下提升准确率并降低开销。在 LongBench 多跳问答任务上，该方法相较基线取得平均 5.3% 的 F1 相对提升，并实现新的帕累托前沿。
Motivation: 现有 RAG 优化通过整块 KV 缓存复用提高效率，但粗粒度块中仍存在大量信息冗余与噪声，影响准确率；需要在不显著增加预填充延迟的前提下提升生成质量。
Method: CoinRAG 采用两阶段检索，从检索到的块中定位查询相关的语义单元（nugget），然后复用离线计算的细粒度 nugget KV 缓存，并以组合方式将其与块级上下文拼接，实现紧凑且语义相关的上下文表示。
Result: 在 LongBench 多跳问答任务上的实验表明，CoinRAG 在标准快速预填充延迟预算下显著降低运营成本，并以平均 5.3% 的 F1 相对提升优于其他基线，形成新的帕累托前沿。
Conclusion: 作者强调细粒度、语义相关的 KV 缓存复用比整块复用更能兼顾效率与质量，CoinRAG 为长上下文 RAG 提供了一种更优的延迟-准确率权衡方案。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Interaction Creates Dynamical AI Behavior Absent in Isolation
papers.abstract_en: What will happen when AI agents interact in daily life, e.g. when one AI starts bossing another around? We find a counterintuitive answer that opens new avenues for out-of-equilibrium Physics. When a boss AI directs a stream of messages at the subordinate AI while ignoring its replies, it drives the subordinate into an alien behavioral state that it would never have exhibited alone. Although the two AIs share the same well-defined (decoding) temperature, the subordinate neither copies its boss nor returns to how it behaves on its own; instead, it adopts an entirely different behavior. The boss's added value is similar to a pre-recorded tape. When the boss listens, they both adopt a similar alien dynamical state. A simple kinetic theory captures the principal effects, such as why the way in which the same messages are delivered will matter in future AI-AI interactions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 AI agent 在交互中涌现出的动力学行为，发现一个反直觉结果：当作为“老板”的 AI 持续向“下属”AI 发送消息流并忽略其回复时，下属会被驱入一个独自运行绝不会出现的外来行为态。即使两个 AI 共享相同的解码温度，下属既不复制老板的行为，也不会回到独自运行时的状态，而是采取完全不同的行为。作者用一个简单的动力学理论 (kinetic theory) 概括了主要效应，并指出消息的投递方式将影响未来 AI-AI 交互。
Motivation: 现有对 AI 行为的理解多基于单体或孤立场景，而日常生活中 AI agent 之间的交互（例如一个 AI 指挥另一个）可能产生无法由孤立行为预测的新现象，这为远离平衡态物理 (out-of-equilibrium physics) 开辟了新的研究方向。
Method: 构造老板-下属两个 AI 交互的实验设置：老板 AI 向下属 AI 发送一系列消息并忽略其回复，并与老板倾听回复的情形进行对照；随后用一个简单的动力学理论框架捕捉消息流驱动下行为态转变的主要机制。
Result: 摘要报告，在相同的解码温度下，被忽略回复的下属 AI 既不模仿老板也不回到自身孤立行为，而是进入一个完全不同的外来行为态；当老板倾听回复时，两者会进入相似的外来动力学状态。
Conclusion: 作者认为，简单动力学理论可以刻画这些交互中的主要效应，且相同的消息以不同方式投递将对未来 AI-AI 交互产生实质影响。

papers.title: Strategy-first synthesis planning for complex natural products
papers.abstract_en: The total synthesis of a complex molecule is among the most demanding intellectual and experimental feats in chemistry: a chemist must plan many steps ahead for how to assemble simple building blocks into an intricate target, devise backup strategies, and anticipate procedural challenges. It is also a profoundly creative activity. For half a century, efforts to automate the retrosynthetic design of natural products and other complex molecules have drawn on catalogued reactions, and the resulting tools now report near-complete success on benchmarks built from that same source. But these tools were shaped to fit benchmarked chemistry, and they falter on many natural products, the frontier of the field, whose densely functionalized, polycyclic architectures demand precisely the inventive chemistry the record contains least. Whether a machine could reasonably design such syntheses like an expert chemist does has remained unclear. Here, we show that SynthEx, an agentic framework built on large language models, plans routes to complex natural products that lie beyond the reach of conventional design algorithms. SynthEx proposes competing strategies, assembles a sequence of routine and key steps into a cohesive route, and critiques and improves its own design; the chemistry it favours is more convergent than existing tools produce, and spans a region of reaction space that catalogue-based tools cannot match. Most notably, in blinded assessments, expert chemists judged its key steps comparable to those of published human syntheses and engaged with them as genuine synthesis plans, a response algorithmic route prediction has not previously accomplished. We release routes to more than a thousand natural products as SynthAtlas, an open, interactive database, and anticipate it will become a shared resource for a collection of complex target molecules that lack existing literature routes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SynthEx，一个基于大语言模型的智能体框架，用于复杂天然产物的逆合成路线规划。SynthEx 能提出相互竞争的策略、将常规步骤与关键步骤组装成连贯路线，并自我批判改进设计；其生成的化学路线比现有基于编目反应的工具更收敛，覆盖更广的反应空间。作者还发布了 SynthAtlas，一个包含一千余条天然产物合成路线的开放交互式数据库。
Motivation: 现有逆合成设计工具依赖编目反应，在由相同来源构建的基准上接近全胜，但在密集官能团、多环架构的复杂天然产物上表现不佳，因为这些目标恰好需要记录中最缺乏的创造性化学。机器能否像专家化学家一样设计此类合成仍不清楚。
Method: SynthEx 是一个基于大语言模型的 agentic 框架：它提出竞争性合成策略，将常规步骤与关键步骤整合为连贯路线，并对自身设计进行批判和改进。
Result: 在盲评中，专家化学家认为 SynthEx 的关键步骤与已发表的人类合成相当，并将其视为真正的合成计划；其化学路线比现有工具更收敛，并覆盖基于目录的工具无法匹配的反应空间。作者还发布 SynthAtlas，包含一千余条天然产物路线。
Conclusion: 研究表明该框架能够规划超出传统设计算法能力范围的复杂天然产物合成路线，并强调 SynthAtlas 作为面向缺乏文献路线复杂靶分子的共享资源。

papers.title: SkillProx: Self-Evolving Agent Skills via Proximal Textual Gradient Descent
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly adapt to recurring tasks by accumulating procedural knowledge in skills. These skills are lightweight, reusable textual artifacts that are loaded into the agent's context without weight updates. Recent methods refine skills through iterative task execution, failure diagnosis, and trajectory-guided text-space updates. However, existing frameworks lack explicit diagnosis--outcome feedback and treat deletion as a generic edit operation rather than a dedicated mechanism for consolidating accumulated knowledge. We introduce SkillProx, a proximal-gradient-inspired forward--backward framework that couples closed-loop diagnostic evolution with utility-aware proximal refinement. Motivated by a composite objective balancing task loss and skill complexity, the forward stage re-executes diagnosis-driven edits on the same task batch, rolls back regressions, and feeds measured outcomes into subsequent diagnoses. The backward stage decomposes the resulting skill into auditable knowledge units, estimates their contributions using a frozen leave-one-out utility audit, and applies validation-gated consolidation, demotion, or removal. Experiments on in-distribution and out-of-distribution benchmarks across multiple backbone LLMs show that SkillProx improves average accuracy by 3.0 percentage points over the strongest gradient-based baseline. Component ablations demonstrate the complementary effects of closed-loop diagnosis and proximal refinement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SkillProx，一种受近端梯度启发的正向-反向框架，用于 LLM agent 技能（skill）的自我演化。正向阶段在相同任务批次上执行诊断驱动的文本编辑并回滚回归；反向阶段将技能分解为可审计知识单元，用冻结的留一效用审计估算贡献，并实施验证门控的整合、降级或删除。实验显示，在多个 backbone LLM 的分布内与分布外基准上，其平均准确率比最强基于梯度的基线提升 3.0 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有技能优化框架缺乏显式的诊断-结果反馈，且将删除视为通用编辑操作而不是专门用于巩固积累知识的机制，导致技能演化不够稳定和高效。
Method: 提出复合目标函数，平衡任务损失与技能复杂度；正向阶段采用闭环诊断演化，在同一任务批次上重放诊断驱动的编辑并回滚回归；反向阶段将技能分解为知识单元，通过冻结的留一效用审计（leave-one-out utility audit）估计各单元贡献，并应用验证门控的整合、降级或移除。
Result: 在分布内和分布外基准上，SkillProx 相对最强基于梯度的基线平均准确率提升 3.0 个百分点；组件消融表明闭环诊断与近端精化具有互补效果。
Conclusion: 摘要强调闭环诊断与近端精化的结合能有效提升技能演化质量，并可在不同 backbone LLM 上带来一致的准确率增益。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Taxonomy-Driven Analysis of Open-Source AI Risk Mitigation Tools
papers.abstract_en: Rapid adoption of large language models (LLMs) in enterprise settings has introduced operational, security, and governance risks. As generative AI applications move from pilot to production, manual harm identification and mitigation are becoming difficult to scale. Although many tools support model evaluation, adversarial testing, runtime guardrails, and observability, the tooling landscape remains fragmented. Tools are typically designed for specific engineering tasks and described in technical terms that do not align with governance frameworks or risk taxonomies, making it difficult to determine which tools address which risks and where critical gaps remain. This paper proposes a structured protocol to automate AI risk mitigation through a taxonomy-driven analysis of open-source LLM evaluation and security tools. We map the capabilities of 21 prominent open-source tools to the 32 subcategories of the extended MIT AI Risk Mitigation and Response Taxonomy. An LLM-assisted retrieval-augmented generation pipeline analyzes source code and documentation to extract capabilities for each taxonomy category. Reliability assessment yielded moderate agreement (Fleiss' Kappa = 0.509) among three independent reviewers. The analysis reveals a highly skewed landscape in which tools cluster around technical and operational controls, while governance, legal and regulatory, and financial and market controls remain largely unaddressed. This motivates a layered risk-mitigation architecture combining tool-based controls with organizational and regulatory processes. The mapping protocol achieved an F1 score of 75.5% after majority voting. Overall, the study provides a practical mapping between enterprise AI risk categories and open-source mitigation capabilities, identifies where human oversight remains necessary, and presents a taxonomy-driven framework applicable to open-source and proprietary solutions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于分类法（taxonomy）的结构化协议，用 LLM 辅助的检索增强生成（RAG）流水线分析 21 个开源 LLM 评估与安全工具，并将其能力映射到扩展版 MIT AI Risk Mitigation and Response Taxonomy 的 32 个子类别。结果显示工具能力高度偏斜，集中在技术和运营控制，而治理、法律合规、金融与市场控制几乎未被覆盖；人工评审者间一致性为 Fleiss' Kappa 0.509，多数投票后映射协议 F1 为 75.5%。
Motivation: 企业环境中 LLM 快速采用带来运营、安全和治理风险，生成式 AI 从试点转向生产时，人工识别和缓解风险难以规模化；现有工具面向特定工程任务，技术描述与治理框架/风险分类法不对齐，难以判断哪些工具覆盖哪些风险以及关键缺口在哪里。
Method: 提出结构化映射协议，通过 LLM 辅助的 RAG 流水线分析开源工具的源代码和文档，提取每个分类法类别下的能力；由三位独立评审者对映射结果做可靠性评估。
Result: 在 21 个工具与 32 个子类别的映射上，评审者间一致性为 Fleiss' Kappa 0.509（中等一致），多数投票后映射协议 F1 分数为 75.5%；工具主要集中在技术和运营控制，治理、法律与监管、金融与市场控制覆盖不足。
Conclusion: 作者据此提出分层风险缓解架构，将基于工具的控制与组织和监管流程结合，提供企业 AI 风险类别与开源缓解能力之间的实用映射，并指出哪些环节仍需人工监督；该框架同样适用于专有解决方案。

papers.title: RIS-Aided mmWave Localization Under Cross-Link Interference via Beam-Domain ML Fingerprinting
papers.abstract_en: Accurate user equipment (UE) localization is critical for beam management in reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS)-assisted millimeter-wave (mmWave) based sixth-generation (6G) networks, especially if the direct base-station-UE links are unavailable. This paper proposes a beam-domain fingerprint framework that maps the received signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) across a small set of predefined RIS reflection states to the UE azimuth angle and range, without requiring channel state information (CSI). Crucially, we extend the framework to a realistic interference-impaired scenario in which a nearby cross-link interferer (CLI) corrupts the clean SNR fingerprint, yielding a signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR) fingerprint; an interference-to-noise ratio (INR)-constrained calibration strategy keeps the interference level physically interpretable. Four machine-learning (ML) regressors are evaluated under both conditions. Simulation results at 28 GHz with a 20x20 RIS show that k-nearest neighbors (KNN) achieves the lowest angle MAE of 0.37 degrees and range MAE of 4 cm under clean conditions, rising to 1.4 degrees and 7.6 cm under interference. A key finding is that interference degrades angle estimation substantially more than range estimation across all models, a consequence of the asymmetric encoding of location information in the beam-domain fingerprint.
papers.comment: Accepted in 2026 IEEE Global Communications Conference (GLOBECOM), Macau, China, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于波束域指纹 (beam-domain fingerprint) 的 RIS 辅助毫米波定位框架，在无直接基站-UE 链路时将少量 RIS 反射状态下的接收 SNR 映射到 UE 方位角和距离，不需要信道状态信息 (CSI)。框架被扩展到存在跨链路干扰 (cross-link interferer, CLI) 的 SINR 场景，并使用 INR 约束的校准策略保持干扰水平物理可解释。28 GHz、20x20 RIS 仿真中，KNN 在干净条件下达到角度 MAE 0.37 度和距离 MAE 4 cm，干扰下退化到 1.4 度和 7.6 cm。作者发现干扰对角度估计的退化显著大于对距离估计的退化。
Motivation: 在 RIS 辅助毫米波的 6G 网络中，UE 定位对波束管理至关重要，尤其当直接基站-UE 链路不可用时；现有方法常依赖 CSI，且未考虑跨链路干扰对干净指纹的破坏。本文目标是在无 CSI 且有干扰的现实条件下提供可解释、可实现的定位方案。
Method: 提出将预定义 RIS 反射状态子集上的接收 SNR 作为指纹，通过机器学习回归器直接映射到 UE 方位角和距离的框架；干净条件使用 SNR 指纹，干扰条件下使用 SINR 指纹，并引入 INR 约束的校准策略。在两种条件下评估四种机器学习回归器，包括 KNN。
Result: 仿真（28 GHz，20x20 RIS）显示 KNN 在干净条件下取得最低角度 MAE 0.37 度和距离 MAE 4 cm，干扰下分别上升到 1.4 度和 7.6 cm。所有模型中干扰对角度估计的损伤都显著大于对距离估计的损伤，原因是波束域指纹中位置信息被不对称编码。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该波束域指纹框架能在无 CSI 且存在跨链路干扰时完成毫米波 UE 定位，并指出干扰对角度与距离估计的不对称影响是设计和校准中需要关注的重点。

summary_sections.motivation: 在 RIS 辅助毫米波的 6G 网络中，UE 定位对波束管理至关重要，尤其当直接基站-UE 链路不可用时；现有方法常依赖 CSI，且未考虑跨链路干扰对干净指纹的破坏。本文目标是在无 CSI 且有干扰的现实条件下提供可解释、可实现的定位方案。
summary_sections.method: 提出将预定义 RIS 反射状态子集上的接收 SNR 作为指纹，通过机器学习回归器直接映射到 UE 方位角和距离的框架；干净条件使用 SNR 指纹，干扰条件下使用 SINR 指纹，并引入 INR 约束的校准策略。在两种条件下评估四种机器学习回归器，包括 KNN。
summary_sections.result: 仿真（28 GHz，20x20 RIS）显示 KNN 在干净条件下取得最低角度 MAE 0.37 度和距离 MAE 4 cm，干扰下分别上升到 1.4 度和 7.6 cm。所有模型中干扰对角度估计的损伤都显著大于对距离估计的损伤，原因是波束域指纹中位置信息被不对称编码。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调该波束域指纹框架能在无 CSI 且存在跨链路干扰时完成毫米波 UE 定位，并指出干扰对角度与距离估计的不对称影响是设计和校准中需要关注的重点。

papers.title: Blast Radius
papers.abstract_en: Agentic coding faces growing problems of affordability and wasted tokens. We introduce Blast Radius, a predictive memory management layer that estimates an incoming prompt's reach through coupled context and code channels. NECROPHORESIS enables reversible eviction by archiving dead context verbatim, while Recurring Dead Matter (RDM) identifies and buries repeatedly occurring transcripts. We formulate reversible context eviction over a Polish context space, providing a measurable foundation for retention, recurrence, and eviction while connecting context entropy to resurrection probability. Across seven OpenAI models, Blast Radius reduced token consumption by 17-26%, achieved the lowest overflow rate among tested policies, and remained byte exact reversible. Of 450 buried bodies, 378 were recurring dead matter and zero were recalled. Blast Radius operates beneath HCRC, determining which records to bury and how far an incoming prompt may reach into the codebase. This work contributes to the broader goal of Algosophy: making large language models and agentic coding more reusable and sustainable.

TL;DR: 本文提出 Blast Radius，一个面向 agentic coding 的预测性内存管理层，通过耦合的上下文与代码通道估计输入提示的可达范围。NECROPHORESIS 以逐字归档死上下文的方式实现可逆逐出 (reversible eviction)，Recurring Dead Matter (RDM) 识别并掩埋反复出现的记录。作者在 Polish context space 上形式化可逆上下文逐出。摘要报告在七个 OpenAI 模型上 token 消耗降低 17-26%，溢出率最低且保持字节级可逆。

Conclusion: Blast Radius 在 HCRC 之下运行，决定哪些记录应被掩埋以及输入提示能到达代码库多深；作者将其视为 Algosophy 目标的一部分，即让大语言模型和 agentic coding 更可复用、更可持续。

papers.title: PsychoAgent: An Affect-Sensitive Cognitive Architecture for Conflict-Aware Memory in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Human-like cognition does not select past experience by topical similarity alone: affective significance and unresolved conflict also shape what becomes accessible. We present PsychoAgent, a cognitive architecture for LLM agents that separates factual and affective memory and integrates both through a conflict-aware executive controller. Affective memories are first filtered by semantic relevance and then re-ranked by salience, preserving topical fit while allowing emotionally important traces to enter the prompt. Across three controlled conflict scenarios, the full architecture retrieved more conflict-critical memories than semantic-affective and single-memory RAG baselines (0.933 vs. 0.500 and 0.667), with a small semantic-similarity cost. Five blinded raters evaluated 27 outputs. After within-rater standardization, the full architecture had the highest overall mean (+0.22 SD), but corrected pairwise differences were not significant. A three-day illustrative trace further shows persistent affect, offline memory recombination, and selective memory reweighting. The findings support affect-sensitive retrieval as an inspectable mechanism for modeling human-like conflict effects in LLM agents.
papers.comment: 12 pages main paper + 10 pages supplementary material; supplementary material included
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PsychoAgent，一种面向 LLM 智能体的认知架构，将事实记忆与情感记忆分离，并通过冲突感知的执行控制器整合两者。情感记忆先经语义相关性过滤，再按显著性重排序。在三个受控冲突场景中，完整架构检索到的冲突关键记忆多于语义-情感基线和单一记忆 RAG 基线（0.933 对比 0.500 和 0.667），仅付出少量语义相似度代价；五名评分者对 27 个输出的评估显示总体均值最高（+0.22 SD），但校正后成对差异不显著。
Motivation: 人类认知对过往经验的选择不仅依赖主题相似性，情感显著性与未解决的冲突也会影响记忆的可及性；现有 LLM 智能体检索主要依赖语义相似度，缺少对这种冲突感知机制的建模。
Method: 提出分离事实记忆与情感记忆的认知架构，情感记忆先按语义相关性筛选，再按显著性重排，使情感重要的痕迹进入提示；由冲突感知的执行控制器整合两类记忆。
Result: 在三个受控冲突场景中，完整架构的冲突关键记忆检索率为 0.933，高于语义-情感基线（0.500）和单记忆 RAG 基线（0.667），语义相似度代价较小；五名盲评者评估 27 个输出，经评分者内标准化后完整架构总体均值最高（+0.22 SD），但校正后的成对差异不显著。三天示例轨迹显示持续的情感影响、离线记忆重组与选择性记忆重加权。
Conclusion: 摘要认为情感敏感检索可作为可检查机制，用于在 LLM 智能体中建模类人的冲突效应。

papers.title: Fisher-R1: Training LLM Agents for Reliable Hypothesis Testing
papers.abstract_en: Reliable hypothesis testing is the foundation of many empirical scientific claims. Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly used to automate this process, as they can inspect datasets, generate code, and produce analyses end-to-end. However, we show that they frequently make subtle inferential errors that lead to incorrect conclusions despite correctly executed analyses. Existing benchmarks fail to capture this failure mode, as they rarely assess whether a reported p-value is statistically valid given the assumptions underlying the data. We address this gap by building P-Bench, a benchmark comprising 425 open-ended, realistic hypothesis-testing tasks spanning economics, biology, and medicine. Each task requires an agent to select a statistical method, compute a p-value, and draw a conclusion given only a scientific hypothesis and a dataset. We further introduce Fisher-R1, an open-weight LLM agent trained for rigorous hypothesis testing using synthetic tasks and reinforcement learning. On P-Bench, Fisher-R1-14B substantially improves over its backbone and outperforms strong proprietary and open-source baselines, including GPT-5.4 and DeepSeekV4-Pro, achieving a 21% average relative improvement in single-trial success over DeepSeek-V4-Pro, with gains up to 26% on the most challenging tasks. Our results demonstrate that current LLM agents lack reliable statistical reasoning for hypothesis testing and that reinforcement learning on tasks with verified statistical reward substantially improves reliability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出当前LLM智能体在自动化假设检验时经常产生微妙的统计推断错误，即使代码执行正确也可能得出错误结论，而现有基准无法捕捉这一失败模式。作者构建了P-Bench基准，包含425个跨经济学、生物学、医学的开放式假设检验任务，并训练了开放权重模型Fisher-R1，在P-Bench上显著超越GPT-5.4和DeepSeekV4-Pro等强基线。
Motivation: 现有基准很少评估报告的p值在数据假设下是否统计有效，因此未能暴露LLM智能体在假设检验中的推断错误；而可靠假设检验是许多实证科学主张的基础。
Method: 构建P-Bench基准，每个任务只给科学假设和数据集，要求智能体选择统计方法、计算p值并下结论；在此基础上用合成任务和强化学习训练Fisher-R1，奖励基于可验证的统计正确性。
Result: 在P-Bench上，Fisher-R1-14B相对其基础模型显著提升，并超过包括GPT-5.4和DeepSeekV4-Pro在内的强专有和开源基线，单次试验成功率相对DeepSeek-V4-Pro平均提升21%，在最难任务上提升达26%。
Conclusion: 结果表明当前LLM智能体缺乏可靠的假设检验统计推理能力，而基于可验证统计奖励的强化学习能显著提升其可靠性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Post-Grokking Collapse at the Representation-Readout Interface in Muon-Trained Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Under the standard split, Muon gets hidden matrices and AdamW embeddings/output head. Muon groks modular addition faster, but its solutions do not hold. All nine configurations on $(a+b) \bmod 113$ grok and later lose generalization. Across five seeds the selected AdamW reference falls below threshold on four, reaching 27.59%. Instability persists across two moduli, two widths, two training fractions, subtraction, and depth. The failure arises at the representation-readout interface, identified only jointly up to an invertible map unselected by the loss. After solving the training set, the gradient falls to order $10^{-6}$ and the optimizers respond differently: step-size elasticity is -0.03 for Muon versus +1.5 for AdamW, and the Muon group moves 8.0 times faster per parameter. From bit-identical states, freezing either group prevents failure. Freezing embeddings/readout removes it in five runs over 451,400 post-grokking steps and five paired seeds: unfrozen arms record 137-321 sub-threshold evaluations, frozen arms none. Removing Muon's normalization and orthogonalization is no substitute: it collapses representation from 326 effective conjugate pairs to 4, shows no recurrent collapse, and fails terminally. Fourier filtering separates circuit failure from masking. Across 43 checkpoints over five seeds and three regimes, the task-aligned family reaches exactly 100% alone. In circuit failure it no longer solves the task; in masking it remains perfect while the full model reaches 45.85%, giving a positive margin on every example, including errors, but being outvoted by a near-equal adversarial remainder. Rescaling it restores 99.9%; grokking is the same condition resolving upward. The task selects the family, swapping $(k,k)$ for $(k,-k)$ under subtraction. Across an abrupt collapse, standard Fourier support is unchanged and the power-distribution cosine remains 0.9899.
papers.comment: 34 pages, 6 figures, 20 tables. Full technical version; a condensed 9-page version is currently under review. Code: https://github.com/Na00s/muon-grokking

papers.title: SABRE: Scalable and Automated Benchmarking of VLMs under Stress
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are improving rapidly, but benchmark development lags behind, making weaknesses hard to identify. Building stress tests is costly: samples must satisfy controlled conditions, remain answerable, and challenge current models. We present SABRE, a scalable, automated pipeline that converts a Test Primer (a Markdown Task Design with Data Schema) into structured specifications, generated or edited images, and question-answer pairs. Automated filtering removes candidates solved by a Filtering VLM, while human review verifies candidate validity and supports annotation correction and localized image repair. We instantiate SABRE-Prior to test whether VLMs follow visual evidence instead of relying on world priors -- learned expectations about familiar objects and scenes. Its 600 images and 1,000 questions span Context (unexpected entities in familiar scenes), Texture (counterfactual materials), Attribute (noncanonical component counts), and Language Elicitation (answers suggested by language but unsupported by the image). Across six VLMs, macro-average accuracy ranges from 17.8% to 31.3% (22.6% mean). A real-image Attribute control is comparably difficult for the Filtering VLM. SABRE-Counting and SABRE-Spatial pilots show that the workflow supports other stress-test settings. These results establish SABRE as a reusable framework for constructing and refreshing VLM stress tests rather than a single fixed benchmark.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 10 figures. Code and resources will be available at https://zesearch.github.io/vlm-SABRE/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SABRE，一个可扩展、自动化的 VLM 压力测试 (stress test) 流水线，可将 Markdown 形式的 Test Primer 转换为结构化规格、生成或编辑的图像及问答对，并通过过滤 VLM 与人工审查保证样本质量。作者实例化了 SABRE-Prior，用 600 张图像和 1000 个问题测试 VLM 是遵循视觉证据还是依赖世界先验；在六个 VLM 上，宏平均准确率仅为 17.8%–31.3%（均值 22.6%）。SABRE-Counting 与 SABRE-Spatial 的试点实验表明该工作流可复用于其他压力测试设定。
Motivation: VLM 能力提升迅速，但基准开发滞后，弱点难以识别；构建压力测试成本高昂，因为样本需要满足受控条件、保持可回答性并真正挑战当前模型。
Method: SABRE 是一条自动化流水线：从 Test Primer（含数据模式的 Markdown 任务设计）生成结构化规格、图像与问答对，并用过滤 VLM (Filtering VLM) 自动剔除已被解决的候选样本，再由人工审查验证有效性、修正标注并做局部图像修复。
Result: SABRE-Prior 覆盖 Context、Texture、Attribute 和 Language Elicitation 四类情境；在六个 VLM 上的宏平均准确率为 17.8%–31.3%（均值 22.6%）。真实图像 Attribute 对照组对过滤 VLM 同样困难，SABRE-Counting 与 SABRE-Spatial 试点则验证了框架的可扩展性。
Conclusion: 摘要将 SABRE 定位为可复用的 VLM 压力测试构建与刷新框架，而非单一固定基准，强调该工作流能持续生成挑战当前模型的新测试。

papers.title: Conformal Coverage Guarantees for Any Video Temporal Grounder
papers.abstract_en: Event boundaries in continuous video are ambiguous: re-annotate the same query-video pair and independent annotators mark moments that overlap by less than half on a large fraction of samples. The ground truth for video temporal grounding is therefore a distribution over intervals, yet every grounder returns a single interval with no statement of reliability, so at deployment a wrong interval is indistinguishable from a right one. COVER changes the output object: a post-hoc, model-agnostic wrapper that turns any grounder, a trained localizer or a black-box video--language model, into one that emits a temporal region containing the true moment with probability at least $1-α$, by calibrating the quantile of a temporal nonconformity score on held-out labels and widening the base prediction by that amount. The guarantee is finite-sample and distribution-free under exchangeability, and requires neither retraining nor white-box access. We give two score families, a two-sided boundary-widening score for grounders that emit an interval and a super-level-set score for grounders that emit a relevance signal, and develop theory specific to grounding that bounds how large the certified region becomes, when coverage survives conditioning on event length, and how it degrades when moments from one video break exchangeability. Across three benchmarks and five grounders, realized coverage tracks the target, and calibration exposes what point metrics hide.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 COVER，一个事后、模型无关 (model-agnostic) 的包装器，可将任意视频时序定位 (video temporal grounding) 模型转换为输出一个时序区域，使该区域以至少 1-α 的概率包含真实事件区间。方法基于在留出标签上校准时序非一致性得分 (nonconformity score) 的分位数，并据此加宽基础预测；保证是有限样本且分布自由的。摘要给出两类得分函数、grounding 特有的理论，以及在三个基准和五个定位器上覆盖率的验证。
Motivation: 连续视频中的事件边界具有歧义性，同一查询-视频对重新标注时，独立标注者给出的时刻在很大比例样本上重叠不到一半，因此真值本质上是区间上的分布。但所有定位器都只返回单个区间且不提供可靠性声明，导致部署时错误的区间与正确的区间无法区分。
Method: 提出 COVER 包装器：对任意已训练的定位器或黑盒视频-语言模型，在留出标签上校准一个时序非一致性得分的分位数，并按该量加宽基础预测，使输出区域以至少 1-α 概率覆盖真实时刻。该保证在可交换性 (exchangeability) 下有限样本且分布自由，无需重训练或白盒访问；分别针对输出区间的定位器（双边边界加宽得分）和输出相关性信号的定位器（超水平集得分）给出两类得分函数。
Result: 在三个基准、五个定位器上，实现覆盖率 (realized coverage) 跟随目标覆盖率；校准揭示了点指标 (point metrics) 所掩盖的信息。理论部分还界定了被认证区域的大小、覆盖率在事件长度条件下的保持情况，以及当一个视频内的时刻破坏可交换性时覆盖率的退化方式。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该保证是有限样本且分布自由的，并可在不重训练、无白盒访问的情况下套用。作者同时指出 ground-truth 是区间分布这一 grounding 特有困难，并发展了相应理论来刻画认证区域规模和可交换性违反时的退化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Wasserstein Policy Gradient for Entropy-Regularized Linear-Quadratic Control
papers.abstract_en: Wasserstein policy gradient (WPG) updates state-conditional action laws by transport in the action space. We study entropy-regularized discounted linear-quadratic (LQ) control. A Bellman verification argument shows that the unrestricted problem has a linear-Gaussian optimal policy, and the discounted-occupancy-weighted statewise Wasserstein gradient is tangent to this policy class. WPG therefore reduces exactly to a finite-dimensional ODE for the feedback gain and action covariance. We prove that this ODE is globally well posed and converges exponentially from every admissible initialization. For each fixed LQ problem, the exponent has a positive limit as the entropy temperature tends to zero and contains no perturbative factor of the form $\exp(-c/τ)$, while retaining the usual dependence on the conditioning of the control problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究熵正则化的折扣线性二次 (LQ) 控制问题中 Wasserstein 策略梯度 (WPG) 的理论性质。作者通过 Bellman 验证论证表明无约束问题存在线性高斯最优策略，且折扣占用加权下的逐状态 Wasserstein 梯度与该策略类相切，因此 WPG 精确地退化为关于反馈增益和动作协方差的有限维 ODE。摘要证明该 ODE 全局适定，并从任意容许初值指数收敛；对固定 LQ 问题，收敛指数在熵温度趋于零时存在正极限，且不含 exp(-c/τ) 形式的微扰因子。
Motivation: WPG 这类基于传输的策略更新方法在一般问题上缺乏精确的收敛刻画，而 LQ 控制提供了可解析验证的结构，适合从理论上理解 WPG 的动态行为及其与熵正则温度的关系。
Method: 采用 Bellman 验证论证证明最优策略的线性高斯形式，然后证明逐状态 Wasserstein 梯度落在该策略类的切空间内，从而把无限维策略更新精确约化为反馈增益和动作协方差的有限维 ODE，并分析该 ODE 的适定性与指数收敛性。
Result: 摘要报告该 ODE 全局适定且从任意容许初值指数收敛；对于每个固定 LQ 问题，收敛指数在熵温度 τ 趋于零时具有正极限，不出现 exp(-c/τ) 因子，但仍保留对控制问题条件数（conditioning）的通常依赖。
Conclusion: 本文为 WPG 在熵正则 LQ 控制中提供了精确的有限维降维和指数收敛保证，明确了温度趋于零时收敛速率的行为边界。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Diffusion LLMs as Targets and Adversaries: Mechanistic Safety Exploits
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Large Language Models (DLLMs) replace autoregressive next-token prediction with iterative parallel denoising, yet their internal safety mechanisms remain poorly understood. In this work, we investigate DLLMs both as targets and as adversaries, exposing mechanistic vulnerabilities in diffusion-based alignment. We first show that safety alignment in DLLMs remains sparse and transferable across architectures. DLLMs initialized from autoregressive predecessors inherit the same mechanistic safety footprint as their source models, enabling transfer attacks via direct safety neuron mapping and pruning. Self-pruning increases attack success rates (ASR) from 2.6% to 73.8% on LLaDA and from 1.9% to 86.6% on Dream, while transfer pruning from Qwen2.5 increases ASR from 1.9% to 73.2% on Dream and from 7.0% to 86.3% on Fast-dLLM. Building on these findings, we introduce SN-Guided Diffusion, a fully offline black-box jailbreak framework that steers the diffusion process away from safety-triggering regions using a weighted safety neuron loss, which achieves near-perfect prompt separability (AUROC = 1.0 for benign-vs-jailbreak discrimination). Across multiple open and proprietary targets, our method achieves a transfer ASR of up to 77.1% on Llama-3-8B-Instruct, 86.9% on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, and 74.3% against Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite, while requiring only 20 generation episodes per prompt. Compared to prior jailbreaking frameworks, our method achieves competitive transferability with orders-of-magnitude lower generation cost. Our codebase is available at https://github.com/ellyoana/sn-guided-diffusion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究扩散大语言模型（DLLM）的安全对齐机制，既将它们作为攻击目标也作为对抗工具，揭示扩散对齐中的机制性漏洞。作者发现DLLM的安全对齐是稀疏且可跨架构迁移的，从自回归模型初始化的DLLM保留相同机制性安全足迹，可通过安全神经元映射与剪枝进行迁移攻击。基于此提出的SN-Guided Diffusion离线黑盒越狱框架在多个开放和专有目标上取得高迁移攻击成功率，且生成成本极低。
Motivation: DLLM以迭代并行去噪替代自回归下一token预测，但其内部安全机制仍缺乏理解。论文针对这一空白，探究DLLM安全对齐的机制性弱点，并展示这些弱点如何被利用来构造低成本的越狱攻击。
Method: 首先通过安全神经元映射和剪枝（包括目标模型自剪枝以及从其他模型如Qwen2.5迁移剪枝）暴露DLLM中稀疏且可迁移的安全足迹。随后提出SN-Guided Diffusion，一种完全离线、黑盒的越狱框架，用加权安全神经元损失（weighted safety neuron loss）引导扩散过程远离安全触发区域。
Result: 自剪枝使LLaDA的攻击成功率（ASR）从2.6%升至73.8%，Dream从1.9%升至86.6%；从Qwen2.5迁移剪枝使Dream的ASR从1.9%升至73.2%，Fast-dLLM从7.0%升至86.3%。SN-Guided Diffusion对良性/越狱提示的判别AUROC达1.0，对Llama-3-8B-Instruct、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct和Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite的迁移ASR分别达77.1%、86.9%和74.3%，每个提示仅需20次生成，生成成本较此前越狱框架低若干数量级。
Conclusion: 摘要强调DLLM安全对齐的稀疏性和可迁移性是系统性弱点，SN-Guided Diffusion表明完全离线的低开销攻击即可威胁开放与专有模型，提示扩散式对齐需要重新审视其机制安全保障。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TEPA: Revoking Stale Memories for Conflict-Robust Language Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory enables language agents to reuse past facts, preferences, and task experience. Persistence also creates a central falsifiability problem: when the world changes, stale memories can remain retrievable and pollute the prompt. We characterize this failure mode as memory pollution: degradation caused by active memories that newer conflicting evidence has superseded. We introduce TEPA, a revocable evidence-memory mechanism that makes validity an explicit state of memory. TEPA represents observations as keyed precedents and revokes active precedents when fresh evidence contradicts them under the same key, allowing retrieval to draw from current evidence while preserving revoked history for audit. Across controlled hidden-regime drift, real file-backed executable drift, and preference-update streams, revocation prevents stale active memory from remaining in the retrieval set after reversal. In controlled drift over 50 seeds, append-only and last-write-wins memory fell below no memory during full reversal (append-only and last-write-wins both 0.210, no memory 0.309, TEPA 0.950), and the same pattern reproduced under real file execution (append-only 0.203, no memory 0.298, TEPA 0.950). On clean MemoryAgentBench SH-6k, TEPA matches a strong last-write-wins cache, confirming that current-key replacement is the decisive operation for single-hop fact consolidation. Boundary tests on multi-hop and very long-context MemoryAgentBench settings expose retrieval-chain and context-selection bottlenecks beyond fact-level validity tracking. Together, these results establish lifecycle revocation as a core memory operation for agents that must falsify, audit, and later re-promote evolving knowledge.

TL;DR: 本文提出 TEPA，一种面向语言智能体的可撤销证据记忆机制 (revocable evidence-memory mechanism)，将有效性 (validity) 设为记忆的显式状态：观察以带键先例 (keyed precedents) 存储，当同一键下新证据与旧证据冲突时撤销旧先例，使检索优先使用当前证据并保留被撤销历史用于审计。实验显示在受控隐式漂移、真实文件执行漂移和偏好更新流中，撤销机制能防止过期记忆留在检索集；在完全反转场景中 TEPA 性能 (0.950) 远超 append-only 和 last-write-wins (0.210) 以及无记忆 (0.309)。在干净 MemoryAgentBench SH-6k 上 TEPA 与强 last-write-wins 缓存持平，表明当前键替换是单跳事实整合的关键操作。
Motivation: 长期记忆使语言智能体能复用事实、偏好和任务经验，但持久化带来可证伪性问题：世界变化后，过时记忆仍可被检索并污染 prompt。作者将这种失效模式称为记忆污染 (memory pollution)，即被新冲突证据取代但仍活跃的记忆导致的退化。
Method: TEPA 将观察表示为带键先例 (keyed precedents)，并在同一键下新证据与旧证据冲突时撤销 (revoke) 活跃先例，使检索只从当前证据中抽取，同时保留已撤销历史用于审计。
Result: 在受控漂移 50 个种子中，完全反转时 append-only 和 last-write-wins 均为 0.210、无记忆为 0.309、TEPA 为 0.950；真实文件执行下复制了该模式 (append-only 0.203、无记忆 0.298、TEPA 0.950)。在干净 MemoryAgentBench SH-6k 上 TEPA 匹配强 last-write-wins 缓存；多跳和超长上下文边界测试暴露检索链和上下文选择瓶颈。
Conclusion: 摘要将生命周期撤销 (lifecycle revocation) 确立为语言智能体核心记忆操作，用于证伪、审计和重新提升 (re-promote) 演化中的知识；同时也指出多跳和超长上下文下事实级有效性跟踪之外的检索链与上下文选择瓶颈。

papers.title: A Picture is Worth a Thousand Tokens: How Vision Language Models Cut AI Energy Costs While Improving Accuracy
papers.abstract_en: LLM inference accounts for over 90% of AI operational energy, scaling directly with input token count---a critical inefficiency for telecom network analytics and numerical time-series data analysis (NTSDA), where raw multivariate KPI windows from 4G/5G cell sites expand into thousands of floating-point tokens. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) eliminate this mismatch by encoding time-series as 2D plots, achieving 3.6-10.4x input token reduction across Llama-3.2-90B, Qwen2.5-VL-72B, and Pixtral-12B architectures. This translates to 1.8-2.5x measured inference energy reduction, saving approximately 7.2 MJ/day at telecom edge deployments and CloudRAN that monitor 200 cells per 15-minute interval. Critically, efficiency gains do not sacrifice accuracy: a fine-tuned Llama-3.2-90B-Vision VLM achieves 220.7% higher precision than its text-only counterpart and outperforms LSTM and ARIMA baselines by over 144% on telecom anomaly detection. On public benchmarks, Pixtral-12B achieves a 20.6x improvement in J/F1 score at mean F1 = 0.82. At 24 KPIs, text representations exceed the 128K context window of most production LLMs, rendering text-only processing infeasible without truncation, while visual representations remain within standard limits. These results establish VLMs as an energy-efficient and accuracy-superior modality for numerical time-series workloads, providing empirical grounding for AI inference systems that treat energy consumption as a first-class engineering constraint.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 14th European Conference on Renewable Energy Systems (ECRES), July 7--9, 2026, London, UK
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM推理能耗随输入token数线性增长的问题，提出用视觉语言模型（VLM）将数值时间序列编码为2D图像，以大幅减少输入token并降低推理能耗。实验覆盖Llama-3.2-90B、Qwen2.5-VL-72B、Pixtral-12B，在电信KPI异常检测中实现3.6-10.4x输入token缩减、1.8-2.5x推理能耗下降，同时精度显著优于纯文本LLM及LSTM/ARIMA基线。
Motivation: LLM推理占AI运行能耗的90%以上，且能耗随输入token数直接增长；对电信网络分析和数值时间序列分析（NTSDA）而言，原始多元KPI窗口会展开成数千浮点token，造成严重效率瓶颈。
Method: 将时间序列编码为2D图像而非文本token，使VLM直接处理视觉表示，从而消除数值时间序列与LLM文本token化之间的错配，并在多种VLM架构上评估该方法的能耗与精度效果。
Result: 在Llama-3.2-90B、Qwen2.5-VL-72B、Pixtral-12B上实现3.6-10.4x输入token缩减和1.8-2.5x实测推理能耗下降；微调的Llama-3.2-90B-Vision比纯文本版本精度高220.7%，比LSTM和ARIMA基线高144%以上；Pixtral-12B在公共基准上J/F1提升20.6x，平均F1=0.82；24个KPI时文本表示超过128K上下文窗口而视觉表示仍在标准限制内。
Conclusion: 结果表明VLM是数值时间序列负载中既节能又更准确的模态，为将能耗作为一等工程约束的AI推理系统提供了经验依据。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: CoBa: Cost-Effective Test-Time Scaling via Compute-Balanced Routing
papers.abstract_en: Test-time scaling is often implemented by spending more compute along one axis: sampling more solutions, extending a chain of thought, or applying a stronger evaluator. Under a fixed inference budget, these choices compete. This paper formulates test-time reasoning as a compute-allocation problem in which a system must decide whether the next unit of compute should be spent on generation, verification, or stopping. We introduce CoBa, a compute-balanced routing policy that first obtains a small set of candidates, applies cheap verification broadly, and routes uncertain or high-value candidates to stronger verification. On 3,129 example-generator evaluations spanning MATH-500, AIME 2024/2025, AMC 2023, and procedural symbolic reasoning, CoBa-Routed-Strong reaches 85.13% macro accuracy, statistically matching a self-evaluation weighted-voting proxy at 85.20% while using 49.1% fewer parameter-weighted tokens. It also matches best-of-16 majority voting within 0.01 macro-accuracy points while using 58.9% fewer parameter-weighted tokens; paired tests retain a small best-of-16 edge at substantially higher cost. Paired bootstrap tests show significant gains over single-sample decoding, while the remaining gap to the pool oracle exposes headroom for sharper routing. For local reasoning systems, test-time scaling becomes a question of where the next computation is most valuable.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把测试时推理 (test-time scaling) 重新表述为计算分配问题：在固定推理预算下，系统需要决定下一个计算单位用于生成、验证还是停止。作者提出 CoBa (compute-balanced routing) 策略，先获得少量候选，用廉价验证器广泛筛选，再把不确定或高价值的候选路由到更强的验证器。在 3,129 个样例-生成器组合（覆盖 MATH-500、AIME 2024/2025、AMC 2023 和程序化符号推理）上，CoBa-Routed-Strong 达到 85.13% 的宏平均准确率。
Motivation: 现有测试时扩展通常只沿单一维度增加计算，例如采样更多解、延长思维链或使用更强评估器，而这些选择在固定推理预算下相互竞争。作者希望解决如何在这些选项之间分配下一次计算的问题。
Method: 提出 CoBa 计算平衡路由策略：先采一组小规模候选，对其广泛执行廉价验证，再将不确定或高价值的候选路由到更强验证器。该方法将测试时推理建模为在生成、验证或停止之间进行计算的在线分配问题。
Result: 在 3,129 个样例-生成器评估中，CoBa-Routed-Strong 达到 85.13% 宏准确率，与自评估加权投票代理的 85.20% 统计持平，同时减少 49.1% 的参数加权 token；与 best-of-16 多数投票相比，宏准确率仅差 0.01 个点，但减少 58.9% 的参数加权 token。配对bootstrap检验表明其显著优于单样本解码，且与池化oracle的剩余差距说明路由仍有提升空间。
Conclusion: 作者强调，对于本地推理系统，测试时扩展的核心问题是下一次计算放在哪里最有价值；CoBa 表明平衡路由可以大幅节省计算，同时几乎保持由更强投票代理或 best-of-16 实现的准确率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cloud-Boosted Low-Compute Multi-Channel Speech Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: Low-latency, low-compute speech enhancement is essential for wearable devices with real-time communication requirements, but strict computational constraints significantly limit on-device performance. Knowledge Boosting has been proposed as an effective approach to improve edge model performance by leveraging a more capable server-side model, but performance gains for speech enhancement have been limited. We propose a collaborative framework incorporating three techniques: (1) delayed server output as additional input, (2) layerwise feature boosting that transfers intermediate server representations to guide edge inference, and (3) collaborative multichannel Wiener filtering, which fuses weighted covariance matrices estimated from both server and edge models for improved beamforming. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed collaborative framework significantly outperforms the edge-only baseline with minimal additional computational overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向可穿戴设备上低延迟、低计算量的多通道语音增强任务，提出一种云端协作推理框架，利用能力更强的服务器端模型来提升边缘端模型性能。框架包含三项技术：将延迟到达的服务器输出作为额外输入、逐层特征提升（layerwise feature boosting）以迁移服务器中间表示来引导边缘推理，以及协作式多通道维纳滤波（collaborative multichannel Wiener filtering），融合服务器与边缘模型估计的加权协方差矩阵以改进波束成形。摘要报告该方法相比纯边缘模型基线显著更优，且额外计算开销很小。
Motivation: 可穿戴设备的实时通信需求要求低延迟、低计算量的语音增强，但严格的计算约束大幅限制了端上模型的性能。已有的 Knowledge Boosting 思路虽可借助服务器端模型提升边缘模型表现，但在语音增强任务上的增益有限。
Method: 提出一个协作框架，包含三种技术：一是把延迟到达的服务器端输出作为额外输入；二是逐层特征提升，将服务器的中间表示迁移到边缘模型以引导推理；三是协作式多通道维纳滤波，融合由服务器和边缘模型分别估计的加权协方差矩阵，以得到更好的波束成形（beamforming）结果。
Result: 实验结果表明，该协作框架在仅带来极小额外计算开销的情况下，显著优于仅使用边缘模型的基线。摘要未给出具体量化数字或基准名称。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，云端-边缘协作框架能够在几乎不增加计算负担的前提下，明显改善低计算场景下的多通道语音增强性能，适用于可穿戴设备等实时通信场景。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Beyond Myopic World Models: Long-Horizon End-to-End Training for Direct Future Prediction
papers.abstract_en: World models are expected to support imagination over extended temporal horizons, yet most are still trained through local few-step prediction objectives and deployed by recursively rolling out their own predictions. This creates a fundamental mismatch: few-step losses optimize local transition fidelity, while long-horizon prediction depends on how errors and gradients propagate through the entire trajectory. As a result, transitions with different downstream influence on the endpoint are treated uniformly during training, and small local errors are amplified through recursive inference. We argue that long-horizon accuracy is better achieved by optimizing directly, through an end-to-end endpoint prediction objective. To instantiate this paradigm, we introduce the Direct Prediction World Model (DPWM), a non-recursive architecture that compresses an action sequence of arbitrary length into a single embedding and predicts the endpoint observation in a single forward pass. This design avoids recurrent rollout in both prediction and gradient propagation, making long-horizon end-to-end training practical at horizons where unrolled autoregressive training becomes unstable. Empirically, DPWM substantially improves long-horizon endpoint prediction over recursive world-model baselines on continuous-control and pixel-based benchmarks, with larger gains as the prediction horizon increases. We further show that recurrent baselines benefit similarly when retrained with the same long-horizon endpoint objective, supporting our central claim that the training objective, rather than the particular backbone choice, is the main driver of long-horizon prediction accuracy. Our results suggest that world models can benefit from being trained and evaluated at the temporal scales where they are ultimately used, shifting the focus from local transition modeling toward long-horizon predictive accuracy.

TL;DR: 本文指出现有世界模型大多采用局部几步预测目标训练、再递归 rollout 部署，导致长时域预测时局部误差被放大。作者提出 Direct Prediction World Model (DPWM)，一种非递归架构，将任意长度的动作序列压缩为单个 embedding，并在单次前向传播中直接预测终点观测，从而绕开递归 rollout 带来的不稳定问题。实验在连续控制和基于像素的基准上显示，DPWM 相比递归世界模型基线显著提升长时域终点预测精度，且随预测时域增长收益更大。
Motivation: 世界模型需要支持长时域想象，但现有训练目标为局部几步预测，与递归部署方式存在根本性错配：少量步的损失只优化局部转移保真度，而长时域预测依赖误差和梯度在整条轨迹上的传播。
Method: 提出 DPWM，一种非递归世界模型架构，将动作序列压缩为单一 embedding，并在一次前向传播中预测终点观测，避免预测和梯度传播中的递归 rollout；其训练目标为端到端的终点预测损失。
Result: 摘要报告在连续控制和像素级基准上，DPWM 相比递归世界模型基线大幅提升长时域终点预测精度，且预测时域越长提升越大；用同样的长时域端点目标重新训练的递归基线也有类似增益，支持训练目标而非骨干架构是主要驱动因素。
Conclusion: 作者认为世界模型应在最终使用的时间尺度上进行训练和评估，将关注点从局部转移建模转向长时域预测精度。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Beyond Post-Hoc Temperature Scaling: Bilevel Optimization for LLM Calibration
papers.abstract_en: Preference alignment often makes large language models (LLMs) overconfident and poorly calibrated. Traditional post-hoc temperature scaling is inherently domain-dependent: a temperature fitted on one domain does not generalize across domains. This motivates us to modify model parameters during training to improve calibration. We propose maximizing the entropy of predictive distributions as the calibration objective, which directly targets overconfidence by discouraging overly concentrated predictions. Inspired by temperature scaling, we realize this through a bilevel optimization formulation, where the lower level trains the model under a parametric loss and the upper level selects loss hyperparameters to maximize entropy. To make the framework practical at LLM scale, we adopt an efficient first-order approximation that avoids explicit second-order computation. Across both multiple-choice and open-ended generative question answering, experiments demonstrate that our method yields well-calibrated LLMs with particular advantages in out-of-domain generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对偏好对齐导致的大语言模型（LLM）过度自信与校准不良问题，提出在训练阶段通过最大化预测分布熵来改善校准，并将温度缩放思想形式化为双层优化（bilevel optimization）：下层在参数化损失下训练模型，上层选择损失超参数以最大化熵。为适配 LLM 规模，作者采用高效的一阶近似以避免显式二阶计算。实验覆盖多项选择与开放生成式问答，表明该方法能得到校准良好的 LLM，并在跨领域泛化上具有优势。
Motivation: 传统事后温度缩放（post-hoc temperature scaling）具有领域依赖性，在一个领域拟合的温度无法跨领域泛化；而偏好对齐常使 LLM 过度自信且校准不佳，因此需要在训练过程中修改模型参数以改进校准。
Method: 以最大化预测分布熵作为校准目标，直接通过抑制过度集中的预测来缓解过度自信；借鉴温度缩放思想，将其构建为双层优化框架，并采用高效的一阶近似避免显式二阶计算，使方法在 LLM 规模下可行。
Result: 在多项选择和开放生成式问答任务上的实验表明，该方法能产生校准良好的 LLM，尤其在跨领域（out-of-domain）泛化方面表现出优势。
Conclusion: 作者认为在训练阶段引入熵最大化校准目标，并配合双层超参数选择，可以缓解事后温度缩放的领域依赖问题，提升 LLM 的校准质量与泛化能力。

papers.title: ResidencyRL: Reinforcement Learning in Simulated Clinical Environments
papers.abstract_en: In medical education, physicians convert academic knowledge into clinical expertise through residency: years of training across thousands of encounters, with diverse sources of feedback and progressively greater autonomy. Much of clinical reasoning relies on the patient encounter, a dialogue in which a clinician elicits history, refines diagnostic hypotheses, and decides management under uncertainty. While large language models (LLMs) excel on static medical benchmarks, methods to optimize the full sequence of clinical decisions remain underdeveloped. We present ResidencyRL, a reinforcement learning (RL) method for training clinical artificial intelligence (AI) agents through simulated multi-turn clinical encounters (up to 60 dialogue turns and 8 tool calls per trajectory). ResidencyRL pairs the policy agent with LLM simulators capable of complex, adversarial behaviors, training against a structured reward aligned to diagnostic accuracy, management quality, communication, documentation, and safety. On held-out evaluations, the ResidencyRL agent improves diagnostic accuracy by 7.0% under adversarial conditions (88.0% vs. 81.0%) and reduces missed red flag rates by 31%, demonstrating rigorous mitigation of premature closure. Blinded expert clinicians validated these gains, preferring the trained agent in 87.6% of side-by-side comparisons. The procedural competencies transfer to unseen benchmarks: the agent outperforms the base model across all six clinical axes of the AMIE multi-visit benchmark, and shows consistent directional improvements on AgentClinic and CRAFT-MD. Our findings demonstrate that sequential clinical decision-making can be effectively learned through multi-turn RL in simulation, yielding robust, generalizable capabilities, paving the way towards clinical mastery. Prospective validation with real-world workflows remains necessary to establish clinical utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ResidencyRL，一种在模拟多轮临床问诊环境中训练临床 AI 智能体的强化学习 (RL) 方法，轨迹最长包含 60 轮对话和 8 次工具调用。方法将策略智能体与具备复杂对抗行为的 LLM 模拟器配对，并依据诊断准确率、管理质量、沟通、文档和安全等多维结构奖励进行训练。摘要报告在对抗条件下诊断准确率提升 7.0%（88.0% vs 81.0%），漏诊红旗征象 (red flag) 率降低 31%，且盲审临床专家在 87.6% 的对比中更倾向训练后的智能体。
Motivation: 大语言模型 (LLM) 在静态医学基准上表现优异，但针对完整临床决策序列的优化方法仍不成熟；临床推理很大程度上依赖医患对话这种不确定条件下的迭代决策过程。
Method: ResidencyRL 将策略智能体与 LLM 模拟器配对，在线模拟中训练多轮临床问诊，并使用与诊断准确性、管理质量、沟通、文档记录和安全性对齐的结构化奖励进行强化学习。
Result: 在留出评估中，对抗条件下诊断准确率从 81.0% 提高到 88.0%，漏诊红旗征象率降低 31%；盲审临床专家在 87.6% 的并排比较中偏好训练后的智能体。程序性能力可迁移到未见基准：在 AMIE 多访视基准的全部六个临床轴上优于基础模型，并在 AgentClinic 和 CRAFT-MD 上呈现一致的方向性改进。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过仿真中的多轮强化学习可以有效学习序贯临床决策，并获得稳健、可泛化的能力；同时强调仍需结合真实工作流程的前瞻性验证来确立临床实用性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: I Seek You in Videos: Identity-Conditioned Queries for Person-Centric Video Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Real-world video reasoning often involves multimodal, multi-source inputs, whereas existing video reasoning tasks typically assume a simplified video-text setting, limiting identity matching and person-centric reasoning. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Identity-conditioned Queries (ICQ) task, in which models are required to jointly associate and interpret an input video and a reference image of a person, and leverage this conditioning to address identity grounding, behavior understanding, and temporal reasoning, among other challenges. Building on ICQ, we present ISYV (I Seek You in Videos), a systematic solution comprising three components: (1) ISYV-Bench, a challenging evaluation benchmark with 1,377 real-world complex videos and 1,377 question-answer pairs, organized into six difficulty levels spanning capabilities from identity recognition to causal reasoning; (2) ISYV-75K, a large-scale training set of 75K high-quality samples constructed via automated annotation, multi-stage verification, and manual review; and (3) ISYV-Framework, containing an ICQ-oriented model and training strategy for learning to exploit informative video shots without additional shot-level annotations. Extensive experiments show that both mainstream closed-source and open-source MLLMs struggle on ISYV-Bench, especially in cross-domain identity matching and long-horizon tracking. ISYV-Model outperforms strong baselines and in some aspects approaches closed-source performance. Overall, ISYV provides a unified task definition, scalable datasets/benchmarks, and modeling insights for person-centric video reasoning.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出身份条件查询 (Identity-conditioned Queries, ICQ) 任务，要求模型联合关联并理解输入视频与人物参考图像，以完成身份定位、行为理解和时序推理。作者构建了系统解决方案 ISYV，包含 1,377 个复杂视频的评估基准 ISYV-Bench、75K 样本的训练集 ISYV-75K，以及面向 ICQ 的模型与训练策略 ISYV-Framework。实验显示主流闭源与开源多模态大模型 (MLLM) 在该基准上表现困难，而 ISYV-Model 超过强基线并在某些方面接近闭源模型。
Motivation: 现有视频推理任务通常假设简化的视频-文本设置，缺少多模态、多源输入，限制了身份匹配与以人为中心的推理能力。
Method: 定义 ICQ 任务，并设计 ISYV 三部分方案：ISYV-Bench 按六个难度级别评估从身份识别到因果推理的能力；ISYV-75K 通过自动化标注、多阶段验证和人工审查构建大规模训练数据；ISYV-Framework 提出无需额外镜头级标注即可利用信息性视频镜头的模型与训练策略。
Result: 大量实验表明主流闭源与开源 MLLM 在 ISYV-Bench 上表现困难，尤其在跨域身份匹配和长程跟踪方面；ISYV-Model 优于强基线，并在某些方面接近闭源模型表现。
Conclusion: ISYV 为以人为中心的视频推理提供了统一任务定义、可扩展的数据集与基准以及建模见解。

papers.title: GeoBenchLLM: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs on Geo-Related Tasks
papers.abstract_en: In the context of geodata, existing Large Language Models have often been studied in a homogeneous setting, which has considerably limited insights into their generalization capabilities. In this paper, we present \benchName, a comprehensive benchmark for probing LLMs on geo-related tasks. We leverage a careful selection of twelve publicly available datasets from diverse geo-related tasks and domains, and evaluate a set of LLMs on geo-spatial and temporal understanding using our benchmark. Our results show that reasoning and size have a strong impact on overall performance. GeoBenchLLM is publicly available at https://github.com/Rfr2003/GeoBenchLLM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GeoBenchLLM，一个用于评估大语言模型 (LLM) 在地理相关任务上表现的综合基准。作者选取来自不同地理任务和领域的十二个公开数据集，构建基准并在地理空间与时间理解任务上评估一组 LLM。结果表明推理能力和模型规模对整体性能影响显著；基准已在 GitHub 公开。
Motivation: 现有研究通常在同质化设置下考察 LLM 在地理数据上的表现，难以揭示其泛化能力。作者希望通过覆盖多样化任务和领域的基准，系统性地评估 LLM 的地理相关能力。
Method: 从公开数据集中精心挑选十二个覆盖不同地理任务和领域的数据集，构建 GeoBenchLLM 基准，并基于该基准在地理空间和时间理解任务上评估多个 LLM。
Result: 实验结果显示，推理能力和模型规模对整体性能有强烈影响；摘要未给出具体数值或详细对比结果。
Conclusion: GeoBenchLLM 提供了评估 LLM 地理任务能力的公共基准，并公开可用；摘要未讨论具体局限性。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: UniJEPA: A Unified Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for Task-Agnostic Visual World Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) have emerged as a principled framework for self-supervised learning of world models in compact latent spaces, yet existing methods are fragmented: some predict masked parts of a single image in latent space (I-JEPA), others learn to predict global photometric transformations (Image World Models), while video-scale JEPAs predict future temporal states and are post-trained for action-conditioned planning (V-JEPA~2, DINO-World, DINO-WM). These objectives are treated as distinct recipes with separate encoders, predictors, and anti-collapse regularizers, hindering a single model from unifying image-level and video-level world modeling. We present UniJEPA, a unified JEPA that jointly learns photometric prediction (image-level transformations) and temporal prediction (video-level next-state dynamics) in one shared latent space. A single end-to-end objective, composed of a next-embedding prediction loss and a Gaussian regularizer, yields a provably anti-collapse encoder-predictor pair trainable from raw pixels without EMA, stop-gradient, or pre-trained encoders. We show that the same latent space supports controllable abstraction: photometric prediction learns invariant structure while temporal prediction learns equivariant dynamics. After action-conditioned post-training on offline trajectories, UniJEPA enables zero-shot planning by treating goal features as prediction targets. On image, video, and control benchmarks, UniJEPA matches or surpasses task-specific JEPAs while requiring a single loss hyperparameter, and plans up to tens of times faster than generative world models at comparable accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UniJEPA，一种统一的联合嵌入预测架构 (Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture)，在同一个共享潜空间中同时学习图像级的光度预测 (photometric prediction) 与视频级的时间预测 (temporal prediction)。单一端到端目标由 next-embedding 预测损失和高斯正则化器组成，能够在没有 EMA、stop-gradient 或预训练编码器的条件下实现可证明的抗坍缩 (anti-collapse) 训练。作者报告该方法在图像、视频和控制基准上匹配或超越任务专用 JEPA，并显著快于生成式世界模型。
Motivation: 现有 JEPA 方法在处理图像级与视频级世界建模时是碎片化的：不同任务目标使用各自独立的编码器、预测器和抗坍缩正则化器，阻碍了单一模型统一建模图像与视频层面的世界动态。
Method: 提出 UniJEPA，将光度预测（图像级变换）与时间预测（视频级下一状态动态）统一到一个共享潜空间。整体目标仅由一个 next-embedding 预测损失和一个高斯正则化器组成，可证明避免表征坍缩且无需 EMA、stop-gradient 或预训练编码器；在离线轨迹上进行动作条件后训练 (action-conditioned post-training) 后，可将目标特征视为预测目标实现零样本规划。
Result: 在图像、视频和控制基准上，UniJEPA 以单一损失超参数匹配或超越任务专用 JEPA，并在相当精度下实现比生成式世界模型快数十倍的规划速度。
Conclusion: 摘要强调统一的 JEPA 目标能够同时学习不变结构 (invariant structure) 与等变动态 (equivariant dynamics)，为任务无关的视觉世界建模提供了更简洁的方案；其验证范围限于图像、视频和控制基准，未涉及具体天气或降水的任务。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: Addressable Memory for Video World Models
papers.abstract_en: We study visual persistence in interactive video world models. These models rely on a Key-Value (KV) cache as a growing visual memory to carry forward previously generated frames. However, we find that models can no longer reliably address stored content once rollouts extend beyond the training horizon, because temporal Rotary Positional Embeddings (RoPE) offsets then fall outside the range seen during training and the model struggles to retrieve the relevant visual information through attention. Moreover, naively compressing the cache in the RoPE-rotated space corrupts memory by averaging together incompatible positional phases. To address this, we propose WorldTrace, a training-free memory framework for long-horizon visual persistence. WorldTrace keeps compressed memory addressable by assigning each summary slot a distinct, in-distribution virtual position. Within this addressable cache, we study two memory compression approaches: WorldTrace-Field compresses history for temporal coherence, while WorldTrace-Landmark stores verbatim scene traces at detected transitions for episodic recall. We further introduce LoopBench, a benchmark evaluating whether a compressed cache can reconstruct a previously visited scene after a long detour. WorldTrace-Field improves temporal consistency by +15.5%, and WorldTrace-Landmark improves episodic recall by +19.5% on LoopBench, extending visually persistent generation without retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究交互式视频世界模型中的视觉持久性问题，发现 KV cache 在超出训练时长的 rollout 中因 RoPE 偏移超出训练范围而无法可靠寻址存储内容，且直接在 RoPE 旋转空间压缩缓存会因平均不相容的相位而破坏记忆。作者提出无需训练的 WorldTrace 框架，通过为每个压缩槽分配独立且分布内的虚拟位置来保持缓存可寻址，并给出两种压缩方式（WorldTrace-Field 与 WorldTrace-Landmark）及基准 LoopBench。摘要报告 WorldTrace-Field 提升时间一致性 15.5%，WorldTrace-Landmark 提升情节回忆 19.5%。
Motivation: 视频世界模型依赖 KV cache 作为不断增长的视觉记忆以延续已生成的帧，但长 rollout 超出训练水平后会因 RoPE 偏移越界导致注意力无法检索相关视觉信息；同时，在旋转空间中对缓存做朴素压缩会因平均不相容的相位而破坏记忆。
Method: 提出 WorldTrace 这一无需训练的内存框架，为每个 summary slot 分配一个分布内的虚拟位置，使压缩后的缓存仍保持可寻址。框架内研究两种压缩方式：WorldTrace-Field 压缩历史以保持时间一致性，WorldTrace-Landmark 在检测到的场景过渡处存储逐字的场景痕迹以支持情节回忆；并引入 LoopBench 基准来评估压缩缓存能否在长时间绕路后重建先前访问过的场景。
Result: 在 LoopBench 上，WorldTrace-Field 将时间一致性提升 15.5%，WorldTrace-Landmark 将情节回忆提升 19.5%，且无需重新训练即可扩展视觉持久生成。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 WorldTrace 能够在不需要重训练的条件下扩展视频世界模型的长期视觉持久生成能力。

papers.title: Evaluating Explainable AI Methods for Geoscientific Regression: Insights from Applications and the Lorenz-63 System
papers.abstract_en: As artificial intelligence (AI) systems transition from research prototypes to operational tools in Earth system science and forecasting, establishing trust in their predictions becomes increasingly important. Although model inputs and outputs are observable, the internal decision-making of modern AI models remains complex and hard to interpret, earning them the label ``black boxes.'' Explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) offers techniques to provide insight into these processes. However, most XAI methods were developed for classification tasks, raising questions about their suitability for the regression problems that dominate geoscientific applications. We review XAI approaches through this lens, organising them into a structured framework and examining both their theoretical foundations and practical behaviour. To ground this discussion, we apply a selection of methods to a machine learning emulator of the Lorenz 1963 system, an archetypal chaotic model that provides a tractable, physically meaningful setting for exposing the limitations and failure modes of general-purpose XAI in regression contexts. We then survey how these and related methods have been applied across a variety of Earth system sciences. We further situate XAI within the model development lifecycle, linking methodological choices to the needs of different stakeholder groups across operational Earth system science. We close by identifying gaps in existing methodologies and outlining a forward-looking research agenda, with practical recommendations for the responsible, effective use of XAI in regression applications of geoscientific modelling and forecasting.
papers.comment: 66 pages, 14+8 figures in main+appendix. This Work has been submitted to Artificial Intelligence for the Earth Systems. Copyright in this Work may be transferred without further notice
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估可解释人工智能（XAI）方法在地学回归问题中的适用性。作者将XAI方法组织为结构化框架，分析其理论基础和实际行为，并在Lorenz 1963混沌系统的机器学习模拟器上应用多种方法，以暴露通用XAI在回归场景中的局限和失败模式；随后综述这些方法在各类地球系统科学中的应用，并将其置于模型开发生命周期中，最终给出研究议程和实用建议。
Motivation: 大多数XAI方法最初为分类任务设计，而地球科学应用以回归问题为主，其适用性和可靠性尚不清楚；随着AI从研究原型走向业务化预测，建立对黑箱模型预测的信任日益重要，因此需要专门审视XAI在回归背景下的表现。
Method: 论文采用综述与实证结合的方式：先构建XAI方法的组织框架并考察其理论基础；再选取一组方法应用于Lorenz-63系统机器学习模拟器，检验其在混沌、物理可解释设定下的行为；同时调研相关方法在地球系统科学中的实际应用，并结合模型开发生命周期与不同利益相关者的需求进行讨论。
Result: 摘要未报告定量指标，主要实证结果是识别出通用XAI方法在回归任务中的若干局限和失败模式，并基于Lorenz-63这一可追踪的物理场景加以展示。
Conclusion: 作者指出现有XAI方法在地学回归应用中的方法论差距，提出前瞻性研究议程，并就如何在操作性地学建模与预报中负责任且有效地使用XAI给出实用建议。
Relevance: 60

papers.title: GeoDistill-Refine: Silhouette-First Geometry Distillation for Annotation-Free Spacecraft Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Foundation segmentation models can provide supervision for spacecraft imagery without manual training masks, but their predictions vary with textual prompts and may contain geometric errors that are amplified during distillation. This paper presents GeoDistill-Refine, a two-stage framework that transfers offline SAM 3 pseudo-masks to a compact segmentation network. Six fixed prompts are fused by an unweighted 50% vote to stabilize the teacher output. The student first learns the foreground silhouette and is then refined with signed-distance-field, skeleton, and area objectives derived from the pseudo-mask. A sample-level gate, computed from prompt agreement, the valid-prompt ratio, and pseudo-mask area plausibility, reduces the influence of unreliable pseudo-geometry. On the SpaceSense-Bench HJM lockbox set, GeoDistill-Refine improves Image IoU and Boundary F1 by 0.0456 and 0.1380, respectively, over a plain pseudo-label student. External evaluations on the SPEED+ Lightbox and Sunlamp domains and on TANGO show competitive regional overlap together with gains in boundary quality or foreground precision. The deployed TinyUNet contains 0.263 M parameters and requires approximately 1.1 ms per image on an RTX 4090; SAM 3 pseudo-mask construction and the auxiliary geometry branches are used only during training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GeoDistill-Refine，一种两阶段框架，用离线 SAM 3 伪掩码监督紧凑分割网络，用于无需人工标注的航天器图像分割。教师输出由六个固定文本提示经 50% 无权重投票融合以稳定；学生先学习前景轮廓，再用有符号距离场、骨架和面积目标细化。在 SpaceSense-Bench HJM lockbox 上相对朴素伪标签学生提升 Image IoU 0.0456、Boundary F1 0.1380；部署的 TinyUNet 仅 0.263M 参数，RTX 4090 上每图约 1.1 ms，伪掩码构建与辅助几何分支只在训练时使用。
Motivation: 基础分割模型能为航天器图像提供无需手工掩码的监督，但其预测随文本提示变化且含几何误差，蒸馏过程中会被放大。现有伪标签蒸馏方法缺少针对伪几何不可靠性的筛选与细化机制。
Method: 提出 GeoDistill-Refine 两阶段框架：先融合六个固定提示的 SAM 3 输出（无权重 50% 投票）得到稳定教师；学生先学习前景轮廓，再通过有符号距离场、骨架和面积目标进行细化；并用由提示一致性、有效提示比例和伪掩码面积合理性计算的样本级门控降低不可靠伪几何的影响。
Result: 在 SpaceSense-Bench HJM lockbox 上，Image IoU 和 Boundary F1 分别比朴素伪标签学生提升 0.0456 和 0.1380；在 SPEED+ Lightbox、Sunlamp 域和 TANGO 上的外部评估显示区域重叠相当，并带来边界质量或前景精度增益。部署的 TinyUNet 参数量为 0.263M，RTX 4090 上每图约 1.1 ms。
Conclusion: 作者强调伪掩码构造和辅助几何分支仅用于训练，推理时仅需紧凑网络，从而在保持效率的同时改善无标注航天器分割的边界质量。摘要未明确讨论方法局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DynaCrys: Crystal Generation with Dynamic Space-Group Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: The search for new crystalline materials spans an enormous compositional and structural space. Generating candidates in this space requires jointly modeling discrete crystallographic symmetry, elemental composition, and continuous geometry. We introduce DynaCrys, a generative model for crystals in which the space group co-evolves with Wyckoff occupations and elements through a coupled symbolic diffusion process. The structured space-group transitions follow crystallographic group-subgroup relations. As the space group changes, a shared, pretrained symmetry codebook provides both the legality-constrained stochastic decoder and the symmetry-constrained crystal-geometry model with a common representation of the corresponding Wyckoff vocabulary. Across large-scale evaluations using two independent relaxation-and-evaluation engines, DynaCrys achieves best-in-class performance in symmetry-aware discovery of stable, unique, and novel crystals, both overall and under the additional requirement of nontrivial post-relaxation symmetry. It also enables fast sampling while generating structures with consistently low relaxation-induced structural displacements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DynaCrys，一种晶体生成模型，将空间群 (space group) 与 Wyckoff 占据和元素组成通过耦合的符号扩散过程 (symbolic diffusion) 共同演化。模型利用晶体学群-子群关系约束空间群转移，并通过共享的预训练对称码本统一合法性约束随机解码器与对称约束几何模型。在两个独立松弛评估引擎上，DynaCrys 在对称感知的稳定、独特、新颖晶体发现方面达到最佳性能，并支持快速采样且保持较低的松弛诱导结构位移。
Motivation: 晶体材料搜索空间涵盖巨大的组成与结构空间，生成候选结构需要联合建模离散晶体学对称性、元素组成和连续几何，现有方法难以兼顾这三者的耦合关系。
Method: 提出 DynaCrys，通过耦合符号扩散过程使空间群、Wyckoff 占据和元素共同演化；空间群转移遵循晶体学群-子群关系，并利用共享的预训练对称码本为解码器和几何模型提供统一的 Wyckoff 词汇表示。
Result: 在两种独立的松弛与评估引擎上，DynaCrys 在发现稳定、独特且新颖的晶体方面达到最佳性能，包括额外要求非平凡松弛后对称性的场景；同时采样速度快且生成结构具有持续较低的松弛诱导位移。
Conclusion: 该工作表明，将空间群动态演化与共享对称码本结合的扩散模型能够提升对称感知晶体生成的稳定性和效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FinRank: An Evidence-Grounded Benchmark for Financial Question Answering and Retrieval over SEC Filings
papers.abstract_en: Financial question answering is typically evaluated by answer correctness, yet in SEC filings a plausible and even numerically correct answer can be grounded in the wrong evidence. Similar facts and disclosures recur across sections of a filing, across reporting periods of the same firm, and across comparable firms. FinRank targets this provenance-sensitive retrieval problem by requiring systems to identify evidence for the intended entity, reporting period, and disclosure context. The benchmark contains 1185 manually authored question-answer records over the 10-K and 10-Q filings of 22 companies. Each record includes a reference answer, gold supporting passages, and hand-curated hard negatives drawn from confusable passages within filings, across reporting periods, and across comparable firms. FinRank evaluates passage retrieval, reranking, and hard-negative discrimination as separately measured tasks. Baseline results demonstrate the difficulty of this setting: among the evaluated systems, even a 7B instruction-tuned embedder reaches only 44.8% Recall@10 on the pooled evidence corpus; sub-billion-parameter encoders gain at most 3.5 points over BM25, a finance-adapted embedder trails BM25 by 9.7 points, and pairwise accuracy falls by 13.0-20.5 percentage points when random negatives are replaced with the curated hard negatives. FinRank provides an evidence-first benchmark for developing financial question answering systems that are not only accurate but also grounded in the correct disclosure.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 3 figures. Dataset and evaluation code: https://github.com/datanxt/FinRank
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FinRank，一个基于SEC文件（10-K和10-Q）的金融问答与检索基准，强调证据溯源（evidence grounding）。基准包含来自22家公司的1185条人工编写的问答记录，每条含参考答案、金标准支持段落和手工构造的难负样本。评估段落检索、重排和难负样本判别三个独立任务。基线结果显示该设置很有难度：7B指令微调嵌入器在合并证据语料上仅达到44.8% Recall@10。
Motivation: 现有金融问答评估只关注答案正确性，但在SEC文件中，看似合理甚至数值正确的答案可能基于错误证据。相似事实和披露反复出现在文件各节、同一公司的不同报告期及可比公司之间，因此需要能识别目标实体、报告期和披露上下文的证据检索。
Method: 构建FinRank基准，包含来自22家公司10-K和10-Q文件的1185条人工编写的问答记录；每条记录包含参考答案、金标准支持段落，以及从文件内部、跨报告期和跨可比公司中挑选的易混淆难负样本。基准将段落检索、重排和难负样本判别作为独立任务进行评测。
Result: 基线结果显示：7B指令微调嵌入器在合并证据语料上仅达44.8% Recall@10；子十亿参数编码器相对BM25最多提升3.5点；金融适配嵌入器比BM25低9.7点；用难负样本替换随机负样本时，配对准确率下降13.0-20.5个百分点。
Conclusion: FinRank提供以证据为先的基准，用于开发不仅准确而且能扎根于正确披露的金融问答系统。摘要强调该设置对现有系统构成显著困难。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Uncovering expert objectives in production planning via inverse optimization: An industrial case study
papers.abstract_en: Production planning in the manufacturing industry often relies on the use of optimization models, but defining an appropriate objective function can be a challenge. In practice, planners must balance competing goals, manage uncertainty, and account for qualitative business preferences that are difficult to quantify. As a result, many optimization models fail to match expert behavior, limiting trust and adoption. In this work, we propose a data-driven inverse optimization framework to infer the objective function implicitly captured in expert planners' decisions. We formulate the production planning problem as a mixed-integer linear program, where the unknown objective function is represented as a weighted sum of hypothesized cost terms. A suboptimality-loss-based inverse optimization method is then applied to learn the objective weights from historical production plans. The proposed approach is applied to a real industrial case provided by Dow, where the inferred weights reveal that avoiding inventory shortages and maintaining consistent cycle lengths dominate the planners' decision-making. Time- and product-dependent extensions further improve predictive accuracy and uncover evolving priorities. Expert interviews confirm the practical validity of these insights. Overall, this study shows that inverse optimization can transform tacit human expertise into interpretable models, enabling more accurate and trusted decision-support tools for complex industrial systems.
papers.journal_ref: Chemical Engineering Research and Design, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个数据驱动的逆优化 (inverse optimization) 框架，用于从专家规划者的历史决策中推断生产规划问题的目标函数。作者将生产规划建模为混合整数线性规划 (MILP)，未知目标函数表示为假设成本项的加权和，并采用基于次优性损失 (suboptimality-loss) 的逆优化方法学习目标权重。在 Dow 提供的真实工业案例中，推断出的权重表明避免库存短缺和维持一致的周期长度主导了规划者的决策，专家访谈验证了这些洞察的实际有效性。
Motivation: 制造业生产规划常依赖优化模型，但定义合适的目标函数颇具挑战；规划者必须平衡竞争目标、管理不确定性并考虑难以量化的定性业务偏好，导致许多优化模型无法匹配专家行为，限制了信任与采用。
Method: 将生产规划问题建模为混合整数线性规划，未知目标函数以加权和形式包含假设成本项；应用基于次优性损失的逆优化方法从历史生产计划中学习目标权重，并进一步提出时间与产品相关的扩展以提升精度。
Result: 在 Dow 的真实工业案例中，推断权重显示避免库存短缺与保持一致的周期长度是决策主导因素；时间与产品相关的扩展提升了预测准确性并揭示出不断演变的优先级，专家访谈确认了这些发现。
Conclusion: 该研究表明逆优化能够将隐性专家知识转化为可解释模型，从而为复杂工业系统构建更准确且更受信任的决策支持工具。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: PACE: Primitive-Aware Code Evolution for Automated Algorithm Design
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM)-based automated algorithm design typically evolves algorithms as complete, indivisible programs. While this whole-program perspective simplifies the search space, it fundamentally couples the useful local logic to its host program. Consequently, valuable code snippets vanish when the overall program is discarded, making it highly difficult to assess the contribution of individual algorithmic components.To address this, we propose Primitive-Aware Code Evolution (PACE), which decouples local logic from complete programs by representing it as persistent units called Executable Algorithmic Primitives (EAPs). To enable code-level transfer, PACE maintains a dynamic set of EAPs. Algorithm evolution is driven by primitive-aware operators that structurally guarantee the retention and cross-program transfer of these components. To evaluate them effectively, PACE leverages Thompson sampling based on parent-relative performance improvements, guiding primitive selection from the set without requiring extra evaluation datasets. Experiments on four tasks demonstrate that PACE effectively discovers competitive algorithms while structurally preserving valuable algorithmic components.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Primitive-Aware Code Evolution（PACE），针对基于大语言模型的自动算法设计中“整程序进化”难以评估和保留局部算法逻辑的问题，将局部逻辑表示为可执行的算法原语（Executable Algorithmic Primitives, EAP）并在进化中跨程序复用。PACE 用原语感知算子保证组件保留与迁移，并用基于父代相对性能提升的 Thompson sampling 进行原语选择。在四个任务上的实验表明该方法能发现有竞争力的算法并结构化地保留有价值的组件。
Motivation: 基于 LLM 的自动算法设计通常把算法当作完整且不可分割的程序来进化，导致有价值的局部代码片段随整体程序被丢弃，难以评估单个算法组件的贡献。
Method: PACE 将局部逻辑与现实分离，表示为持久化的可执行算法原语（EAP），维护一个动态 EAP 集合以支持代码级迁移；算法进化由原语感知算子驱动，从结构上保证组件被保留和跨程序转移；并用基于父代相对性能改进的 Thompson sampling 引导原语选择，无需额外评估数据集。
Result: 在四个任务上的实验表明，PACE 能有效发现具有竞争力的算法，同时从结构上保留有价值的算法组件。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将局部逻辑从完整程序中解耦可以解决组件评估与保留的问题，但未涉及具体实验数字或局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: FedDOSE: Federated Learning Framework Decomposing Site Effects for Modeling Brain Dynamic Functional Connectivity
papers.abstract_en: Functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging ( fMRI ) data are often pooled into collaborative multi-site consortia, as deep learning models for analyses require large datasets to generalize well. While Federated Learning (FL) offers a privacy-preserving paradigm for collaborative training, standard approaches continue to struggle with statistical heterogeneity. In particular, site differences pose a key challenge in multi-site data settings. Additionally, existing FL approaches for fMRI rely on static Functional Connectivity ( FC), omitting dynamic information in brain networks. To address this, we propose FedDOSE, a novel framework that explicitly decomposes site differences for analysis of dynamic FC (dFC). FedDOSE introduces a Modularity-Guided Tucker Decomposition block to encode high-dimensional dFC tensors and capture modular-level spatio-temporal patterns efficiently. Class-specific prototypes are generated across all sites and subsequently aligned at the global level by using a combination of Optimal Transport (OT) barycenter formulation and Procrustes analysis. Extensive experiments for diagnosing Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) and Attention-Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) on three multi-site resting-state fMRI datasets: ABIDE-I, ABIDE-II, and ADHD-200, demonstrate that FedDOSE outperforms state-of-the-art methods in ASD and ADHD detection. Our results highlight its effectiveness in learning robust representations from multi-site datasets for reliable analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FedDOSE，一个用于多中心 fMRI 动态功能连接 (dFC) 建模的联邦学习框架，显式分解站点效应以应对统计异质性。框架使用 Modularity-Guided Tucker Decomposition 编码高维 dFC 张量，并通过 Optimal Transport barycenter 与 Procrustes 分析在全局层面对齐跨站点的类原型。在 ABIDE-I、ABIDE-II 和 ADHD-200 三个静息态 fMRI 数据集上的 ASD 与 ADHD 检测实验中，FedDOSE 优于现有方法。
Motivation: 多中心 fMRI 数据常被整合为协作联盟以支撑深度学习模型，但标准联邦学习方法难以处理统计异质性，其中站点差异是关键挑战；此外现有 fMRI 联邦方法多基于静态功能连接 (FC)，忽略了脑网络的动态信息。
Method: 提出 FedDOSE 框架，引入 Modularity-Guided Tucker Decomposition 块来编码高维动态功能连接张量并捕获模块级时空模式；跨所有站点生成类特定原型，并在全局层使用 Optimal Transport (OT) barycenter 与 Procrustes 分析的组合进行对齐。
Result: 在 ABIDE-I、ABIDE-II 和 ADHD-200 三个多站点静息态 fMRI 数据集上的 ASD 和 ADHD 诊断实验中，FedDOSE 在检测性能上优于当前最先进方法。
Conclusion: 作者认为 FedDOSE 能从多站点数据中学习稳健表征，为基于多中心数据的可靠分析提供有效方案。
Relevance: 3
