papers.title: Omni-modal decomposition autoencoders learn full-stack wearable disentangled representations
papers.abstract_en: Learning disentangled representations is a key requirement for developing versatile, general-purpose, and sustainable models in multi-modal wearable computing. However, existing approaches do not operate as full-stack wearable processors, i.e., they do not simultaneously address task-specific classification performance, disentangled and interpretable representation learning, fusion, and generative modeling of highly heterogeneous multi-modal time series. To address this gap, we introduce Omni-modal Variational Decomposition Autoencoders (OmniDecVAEs), a framework that efficiently learns multi-purpose representations in a unified and scalable manner from arbitrarily many modalities. OmniDecVAEs extend DecVAEs by learning modality-conditioned time-frequency latent subspaces through a multi-view self-supervised decomposition loss and a shared asymmetric autoencoder (AE) architecture. Results on a challenging omni-modal human activity recognition (HAR) setting with up to thirty modalities, demonstrate the ability of OmniDecVAEs to learn full-stack wearable representations. When compared to transformer-based and VAE-based methods, OmniDecVAEs full-stack disentangled representation properties lead to accuracy improvements of 1.01% and 6.75% in activity and identity recognition, respectively. Furthermore, OmniDecVAEs synthesize realistic omni-modal time-frequency data that manifest with enhanced reconstructions (mean absolute error improves by 76.84%) and distributional similarity between real and synthetic data (maximum mean discrepancy improves by 13.85%). Our results highlight OmniDecVAEs potential as a lightweight model suitable for intelligent edge wearables and clinical healthcare, unifying processing requirements and abilities in a single model, through its enhanced representational capacity, modality-invariant spatial complexity (4.1M parameters), and real-time latency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Omni-modal Variational Decomposition Autoencoders (OmniDecVAEs)，一种面向多模态可穿戴时间序列的统一表示学习框架。它扩展 DecVAEs，通过多视角自监督分解损失和共享非对称自编码器架构学习模态条件化的时频潜在子空间，在最多 30 个模态的 omni-modal 人类活动识别 (HAR) 设置上验证效果。摘要报告其在活动识别和身份识别上的准确率提升，以及更好的重构误差和真实/合成数据分布相似度，并强调其轻量、适合边缘可穿戴和临床医疗应用。
Motivation: 现有可穿戴计算中的解耦表示学习方法没有作为 full-stack 可穿戴处理器运行，即不能同时兼顾特定任务的分类性能、可解释解耦表示学习、多模态融合以及高度异构多模态时间序列的生成建模。
Method: OmniDecVAEs 通过一个多视图自监督分解损失和共享的不对称自编码器 (AE) 架构，学习模态条件化的时频潜在子空间，从而统一扩展 DecVAEs 并高效处理任意数量的模态。
Result: 在最多三十个模态的 HAR 设置中，相比 Transformer 和 VAE 方法，OmniDecVAEs 在活动识别和身份识别上分别提升准确率 1.01% 和 6.75%；合成数据的重构误差 (MAE) 提升 76.84%，真实与合成数据的最大均值差异 (MMD) 提升 13.85%。模型参数量为 4.1M，并具有实时延迟。
Conclusion: 作者认为 OmniDecVAEs 凭借增强的表示能力、模态不变的模型复杂度和实时性，有潜力作为单一轻量模型用于智能边缘可穿戴设备和临床医疗，统一多种处理需求。

papers.title: SkySeaLand: A Wide-Format Satellite Transportation Benchmark with an Ultra-Lightweight Detection Baseline
papers.abstract_en: Satellite object detection is challenged by small targets and wide-format scenes that lose detail under standard square-input resizing. We introduce SkySeaLand, a public dataset of 1,307 high-resolution satellite images and 19,101 verified bounding boxes across airplane, boat, car, and ship classes in terrestrial and maritime scenes. Native COCO and YOLO annotations are provided. The collection is dominated by large source images and wide scene geometry: 84.5 percent exceed 3,836 pixels on the longest side and 73.1 percent are near a 3:1 aspect ratio. We evaluate twelve detectors from the YOLO, RT-DETR, DETR, and Faster R-CNN families using a common split and COCO metrics. The tested YOLO and RT-DETR variants obtain 84.4--88.2 mAP50, with no consistent accuracy gain from larger parameter counts under the reported model-specific recipes. We also report SkyDet, a 1.22 M parameter anchor-free baseline that obtains 60.5 mAP50 and 24.32 mAP50-95 in a 4.90 MB footprint, with 13.74 ms latency (72.8 FPS) on a Tesla T4. SkySeaLand provides a compact benchmark for mixed land--maritime transportation detection, while SkyDet establishes a documented low-footprint reference rather than a state-of-the-art accuracy claim.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SkySeaLand，一个面向海陆交通目标检测的宽幅卫星图像基准数据集，包含 1,307 张高分辨率图像和 19,101 个验证过的边界框，类别覆盖飞机、船、汽车和船舶，并提供 COCO 与 YOLO 格式标注。作者在统一划分和 COCO 指标下评测了 YOLO、RT-DETR、DETR 与 Faster R-CNN 等 12 个检测器，发现 YOLO 和 RT-DETR 变体取得 84.4-88.2 mAP50，且更大参数量未见一致增益。文章还报告了 1.22M 参数的 anchor-free 基线 SkyDet，在 4.90 MB 体积下达到 60.5 mAP50 和 24.32 mAP50-95，Tesla T4 上延迟 13.74 ms（72.8 FPS）。
Motivation: 卫星目标检测受小目标和宽幅场景制约，标准方形输入缩放会丢失细节；现有公开基准缺乏针对宽幅海陆交通场景的紧凑型数据集和低参数量参考基线。
Method: 构建 SkySeaLand 数据集并统一评测协议，使用 COCO 指标对比多个检测器家族；同时提出 SkyDet，一个 1.22M 参数的 anchor-free 轻量检测基线，作为低内存占用参考而非高精度方案。
Result: 数据集统计表明 84.5% 图像最长边超过 3,836 像素、73.1% 接近 3:1 宽高比；在测试的 YOLO 与 RT-DETR 变体上 mAP50 为 84.4-88.2，未观察到参数量增加带来的稳定精度提升；SkyDet 以 4.90 MB 模型体积取得 60.5 mAP50 与 24.32 mAP50-95。
Conclusion: SkySeaLand 可作为混合海陆交通检测的紧凑基准，SkyDet 提供一个有文档记录的低足迹参考，作者并未声称其达到最先进的检测精度。

papers.title: LSEAD: A Privacy-Preserving LLM-Based Speech Analysis Framework for Early Alzheimer's Disease Screening
papers.abstract_en: Early diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease (AD) is critical for enabling timely interventions that may slow disease progression and improve patient outcomes. There is a growing need for AD detection methods that are non-invasive and cost-effective, especially in real-world clinical settings with diverse patient populations and recording conditions. Speech-based screening addresses these needs by using natural speech collected without specialized equipment. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have improved speech analysis by providing rich linguistic representations and strong generalization. In this study, we propose LSEAD, a speech-based AD detection framework using pretrained open-source LLMs. Speech recordings are automatically transcribed, and text embeddings are extracted using locally deployed LLMs. Principal component analysis (PCA) is applied to reduce dimensionality before classification. Because the framework relies only on speech transcripts and locally deployed models, it supports privacy-preserving AD risk assessment without external data exchange. We evaluate LSEAD on the ADReSS20 and ADReSSo2021 benchmark datasets. Experimental results show that LLM-based embeddings generalize well across datasets and improve AD classification accuracy by up to 5 percent over existing methods, especially for early-stage detection. These results demonstrate that LSEAD provides a practical, secure, and scalable approach for early AD screening.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LSEAD，一个基于预训练开源大语言模型（LLM）的语音阿尔茨海默病（AD）筛查框架。语音录音被自动转写，文本嵌入由本地部署的 LLM 提取，随后用 PCA 降维和分类器进行判别。作者在 ADReSS20 和 ADReSSo2021 基准上评估，报告 LLM 嵌入能跨数据集泛化，并将 AD 分类准确率较现有方法提升最多 5 个百分点，尤其利于早期检测。由于仅依赖语音转写文本且模型本地运行，框架无需外部数据交换，从而支持隐私保护的 AD 风险评估。
Motivation: 早期诊断阿尔茨海默病对及时干预至关重要，但临床场景需要非侵入、低成本的检测方法；语音筛查可利用自然语音，但需在多样化人群和录音条件下保持稳健。近年 LLM 在语音分析中提供丰富语言表示与强泛化，但隐私和外部数据交换问题限制了实际部署。
Method: 采用预训练开源 LLM 对自动转写的语音文本提取嵌入，使用主成分分析（PCA）降维后再进行分类；全部模型本地部署，仅利用语音转写文本，避免外部数据交换，从而满足隐私保护要求。
Result: 在 ADReSS20 和 ADReSSo2021 数据集上，LLM 嵌入跨数据集泛化良好，与现有方法相比将 AD 分类准确率提升最高 5 个百分点，尤其在早期检测阶段。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 LSEAD 为早期 AD 筛查提供了实用、安全且可扩展的语音分析方法，隐私保护设计使其适用于真实临床环境。

papers.title: Trajectory-Relative Hindsight Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Recent agentic reinforcement learning methods use hindsight to complement sparse outcome rewards. However, a completed rollout can yield many such signals, leaving their appropriate allocation across turns unclear. We introduce TRIAL, a trajectory-relative hindsight distillation framework with a unified turn-aligned scoring protocol. For each decision turn, TRIAL extracts an outcome view of that decision's realized consequence and evaluates the same response under ordinary and hindsight-conditioned contexts. The signed log-probability gap determines the direction and local strength of token-level supervision, while turn-level magnitudes are normalized jointly over the realized trajectory. The resulting allocation multipliers have an eligible-token-weighted mean of one, redistributing dense supervision across turns while fixing its average multiplier. Experiments on WebShop and ALFWorld with different backbones show that TRIAL outperforms GRPO across all eight combinations of backbone, environment, and evaluation metric, while achieving the best or tied-best performance among six methods on six of them. On WebShop with Qwen3-1.7B, TRIAL improves the success rate from 56.4% to 75.2% and the task score from 78.7% to 85.7%. Controlled ablations further show that trajectory-relative turn allocation provides substantial gains beyond those of dense hindsight distillation alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TRIAL，一个基于轨迹相对事后蒸馏 (trajectory-relative hindsight distillation) 的智能体强化学习框架，用于解决补全回合中大量事后信号在决策轮次间的分配问题。TRIAL 为每个决策轮提取该决策实际结果的结果视图，并在普通上下文与事后条件上下文下评估同一响应，用有符号对数概率差确定 token 级监督的方向与局部强度，再对轨迹层面联合归一化轮次级幅度。在 WebShop 和 ALFWorld 上，该方法在八种主干-环境-指标组合中全部优于 GRPO，并在六种组合中达到六种方法中的最佳或并列最佳。
Motivation: 现有智能体强化学习方法用事后信号 (hindsight) 补充稀疏的结果奖励，但一次完整 rollout 会产生多个此类信号，它们在各个轮次间应如何分配尚不明确，阻碍了密集监督的有效利用。
Method: TRIAL 采用统一的轮次对齐打分协议：对每个决策轮，提取该决策实际后果的结果视图，在同一响应上分别施加普通上下文与事后条件上下文，计算有符号的对数概率差作为 token 级监督的方向与局部强度；随后在整条已实现轨迹上联合归一化轮次级幅度，使所得分配乘子的合格 token 加权均值为 1，从而在固定平均乘子的前提下跨轮次再分配密集监督。
Result: 在 WebShop 与 ALFWorld 上结合不同主干模型的实验显示，TRIAL 在全部八种主干-环境-指标组合中优于 GRPO，并在八种组合中的六种上取得六种方法里最优或并列最优。以 WebShop 上的 Qwen3-1.7B 为例，TRIAL 将成功率从 56.4% 提升到 75.2%，任务得分从 78.7% 提升到 85.7%；受控消融表明轨迹相对的轮次分配在纯粹密集事后蒸馏之上带来显著增益。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，将密集事后监督按轨迹相对方式跨轮次再分配、并固定其平均乘子，是一种有效的智能体强化学习训练策略；该研究的实验范围限于 WebShop 与 ALFWorld 等环境，摘要未报告其他任务上的表现或局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Measurements Automatically Extracted from Zero Echo Time MRI Using Deep Learning Image Segmentation and Geometric Modeling Agree with Expert Manual Readings
papers.abstract_en: Computed tomography (CT) remains the reference for 3D osseous morphometry in femoroacetabular impingement (FAI) but requires ionizing radiation and manual measurement. Zero echo time (ZTE) MRI visualizes cortical bone and yields FAI angles that agree with CT, but automated angle extraction remains limited. We developed and validated automated FAI angle computation from ZTE MRI and assessed agreement with expert manual measurements in a cross-sectional study (level of evidence, 3). Pelvic ZTE MRI was acquired in 73 participants (mean age 36.8 +/- 18.5 years; 51 women, 22 men), yielding 135 hips. nnU-Net was trained on 100 manually curated hips to segment the femur, pelvis, and three osseous landmarks. Custom geometric algorithms computed alpha, femoral neck-shaft, Tonnis, coronal and sagittal center-edge, and acetabular version angles from inferred segmentations. Measurements on 35 test hips were compared with the mean of two radiologists' manual measures using intraclass correlation (ICC) and Bland-Altman analysis. Dice exceeded 0.96 for bone and ranged from 0.65 to 0.83 for landmarks. Median landmark error was 0.38 mm (femoral head), 0.82 mm (lateral acetabulum), and <2.5 mm (medial acetabulum, greater trochanter). Interrater ICC was excellent for acetabular version, coronal center-edge, and Tonnis (>=0.82) but poor for alpha and femoral neck-shaft. Model versus rater-mean agreement was excellent for acetabular version, coronal center-edge, and Tonnis (0.92-0.96), good for mid-acetabular sagittal center-edge (0.74), and fair for alpha (0.45) and femoral neck-shaft (0.55). Model Bland-Altman limits of agreement were narrower than interrater limits for most angles. Fully automated morphometric assessment from ZTE MRI is feasible and performs comparably to expert readers for most coverage and version angles.

TL;DR: 本文开发并验证了从零回波时间（ZTE）MRI 全自动计算髋臼股骨撞击（FAI）相关角度的流程：用 nnU-Net 分割股骨、骨盆及三个骨性标志点，再以几何算法计算 alpha 角、颈干角、Tonnis 角、中心边缘角和髋臼前倾角。研究基于 73 名受试者（135 髋）的横断面数据，将 35 个测试髋的自动测量与两位放射科医生手动测量的均值比较，发现大部分覆盖角和前倾角的一致性与专家读片相当，表明全自动形态学评估可行。
Motivation: CT 是 FAI 三维骨形态测量的参考标准，但存在电离辐射且依赖手动测量；ZTE MRI 能显示皮质骨且角度与 CT 一致，但自动角度提取仍很有限。
Method: 使用 100 个手动标注的髋关节数据训练 nnU-Net，分割股骨、骨盆和三个骨性标志点；基于推断的分割结果用自定义几何算法计算七种 FAI 相关角度；在 35 个测试髋上将模型输出与两名放射科医生的手动测量均值通过组内相关系数（ICC）和 Bland-Altman 分析比较。
Result: 骨骼分割 Dice 超过 0.96，标志点 Dice 为 0.65–0.83；标志点中位误差为 0.38 mm（股骨头）、0.82 mm（髋臼外侧）、小于 2.5 mm（髋臼内侧、大转子）。模型与读片者均值的一致性对髋臼前倾角、冠状位中心边缘角和 Tonnis 角为优秀（0.92–0.96），中部髋臼矢状位中心边缘角为良好（0.74），alpha 角和颈干角仅一般（0.45 和 0.55）；多数角度的模型 Bland-Altman 一致性界限窄于读片者间界限。
Conclusion: 来自 ZTE MRI 的全自动形态学测量是可行的，对大多数覆盖角和前倾角而言其表现与专家读片相当；alpha 角和颈干角的自动测量一致性仍偏弱。

papers.title: People Are Not Just Their Countries. Disentangling Social Determinants of LLM Value Alignment Across Europe
papers.abstract_en: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used as a primary source of information and advice, understanding their alignment to humans in terms of values becomes a pressing concern. A growing literature has leveraged large scale surveys to investigate to what extent LLMs' and humans' stated values and opinions align. With limited exceptions, studied populations have been defined country borders or cultural bounds. Yet, this focus neglects the role that socio-demographic divides may play for value alignment disparities. Relying on the European Social Survey, we address this knowledge gap by considering value alignment displayed with respect to 10 prominent commercial LLMs in terms of 15 socio-demographic variables as well as country of residence. Our analyses reveal that LLMs are indeed unequally aligned to the values of different socio-demographic groups, notably those defined by education, income, occupation and religion. When examining alignment at the individual level, a respondent's country, taken as a stand-alone variable, explains a substantial amount of variation that is on par with the full set of considered socio-demographics. Further disentangling the respective role of country-level and socio-demographic factors, we find they are complementary in explaining value alignment patterns, with their relative weights varying across the subset of questions considered.
papers.comment: Accepted at AIES 2026 (9th AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于欧洲社会调查 (European Social Survey) 数据，考察 10 个主流商用 LLM 在不同社会人口学变量与国家维度上的价值对齐差异。作者发现 LLM 对不同社会群体的价值观对齐并不均衡，教育、收入、职业和宗教等变量影响显著；在国家层面，受访者所在国家单独解释的变异量可与全部社会人口学变量相当，且两类因素在对齐模式上具有互补性。
Motivation: 已有关于 LLM 与人类价值观对齐的研究大多以国家或文化边界定义人群，忽略了社会人口学差异（如教育、收入、职业、宗教）在价值对齐差距中的作用。
Method: 使用欧洲社会调查数据，将 15 个社会人口学变量以及居住国纳入分析，系统比较 10 个商业 LLM 在价值维度上的对齐表现，并在个体层面分离国家因素与社会人口学因素的贡献。
Result: 摘要报告 LLM 对不同社会人口学群体（尤其按教育、收入、职业和宗教划分的群体）的价值对齐不均衡；以国家作为独立变量时，其解释的变异量等同于全部社会人口学变量之和，且国家与社会人口学因素在对齐模式上互补，相对权重随问题子集变化。
Conclusion: 作者强调应超越国家边界来看待 LLM 价值对齐，社会人口学因素与国别因素共同且互补地影响对齐结果。

papers.title: Curriculum as Code: An AI-Assisted Architecture for Instructional Design in STEM Education
papers.abstract_en: Contribution: This paper presents a six-phase AI-assisted instructional design architecture based on the Curriculum as Code paradigm, integrating Generative AI with LaTeX and Python to automate the creation of reproducible, visually consistent, and technically precise materials for STEM education. Background: Creating customized instructional materials for active learning imposes a heavy workload on faculty. Standard presentation tools lack robust support for technical content, while current AI applications often hallucinate and fail to formalize the instructional authoring process, limiting their utility for rigorous academic design. Intended Outcomes: The framework aims to reduce preparation time while ensuring mathematical accuracy, adherence to institutional visual identity, and preservation of the instructor's tacit pedagogical knowledge through explicit rules. Application Design: The solution comprises a six-phase pipeline that replaces ad-hoc prompt engineering with a systematic workflow, utilizing text-based interfaces and code-driven generation (LaTeX/Beamer for slides, Python for figures), governed by pedagogical constraints, contextual calibrations, and automated review cycles. Findings: Validated over one year across 8 modules and 28 project contexts in a Project-Based Learning environment, the architecture significantly reduced instructor workload. Generated assets underwent independent peer review and were deployed by six different faculty members, confirming scalability beyond a single author. Based on over 600 voluntary student evaluations, materials achieved high quality ratings from 8.5 to 9.9/10. Results indicate high reproducibility, minimized hallucinations, and sustained pedagogical and visual fidelity, suggesting viability for broad STEM educational applications.
papers.comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于“课程即代码”(Curriculum as Code)范式的六阶段 AI 辅助教学设计架构，将生成式 AI 与 LaTeX 和 Python 结合，自动生成可复现、视觉一致且技术准确的 STEM 教学材料。该系统在项目式学习环境中经过一年、8 个模块和 28 个项目场景的验证，显著减少教师工作量，并基于 600 多份学生评价获得 8.5–9.9/10 的高质量评分。
Motivation: 为主动学习定制教学材料给教师带来沉重负担；标准演示工具对技术内容支持不足，现有 AI 应用易产生幻觉且未将教学创作过程形式化，限制了在严格学术设计中的使用。
Method: 提出六阶段流水线，用系统化工作流取代临时提示工程（prompt engineering），采用基于文本的界面和代码驱动生成（LaTeX/Beamer 制作幻灯片、Python 绘制图形），并以教学约束、上下文校准和自动审查循环来管控生成过程。
Result: 在一年内于 8 个模块、28 个项目场景的 Project-Based Learning 环境中验证，显著降低教师工作量；生成材料经独立同行评审并由 6 位不同教师部署，600 多份学生评价给出 8.5–9.9/10 的高质量评分。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该架构具有高可复现性、最小化的幻觉以及持续的教学与视觉保真度，并认为其适用于广泛的 STEM 教育场景。

papers.title: QFCQT: A Chaotically Gated Quantformer Framework for Volatile Time-Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Forecasting non-stationary time series remains difficult due to long-range dependencies, local volatility bursts, structural shifts, and nonlinear oscillatory behaviors. Although Transformer-based forecasters are effective for modeling long-term temporal dependencies, their feed-forward blocks typically rely on smooth static activations that are insufficiently sensitive to abrupt regime changes. Motivated by quantitative Transformer designs and oscillator-based nonlinear activations, we propose QFCQT, short for Quantum-Fractal-inspired Chaotically Gated Quantformer, for robust forecasting under complex volatile dynamics. Here, "quantum-fractal-inspired" denotes a computational analogy based on soft oscillator superposition and multi-scale nonlinear responses, rather than a formal quantum-mechanical or fractal-theoretic derivation. QFCQT consists of three main components: (1) a Quantformer-style numerical encoder that directly processes multivariate inputs via linear embedding; (2) a learnable Lee-oscillator activation module that maps scalar pre-activations to dynamic oscillatory responses and summarizes them through Max-over-Time pooling; and (3) a smooth-chaotic gated fusion mechanism that adaptively balances conventional smooth activations and chaos-sensitive responses. Furthermore, instead of using a single fixed oscillator, QFCQT employs a soft superposition of eight parameterized Lee oscillator families to adaptively capture different nonlinear response patterns across regimes. Experiments on ETTh1, ETTh2, and A-share Stock Index benchmarks show that QFCQT consistently outperforms strong baselines, including Informer, LogTrans, LSTMa, HAT, and COTN.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 QFCQT（Quantum-Fractal-inspired Chaotically Gated Quantformer），一个面向波动剧烈非平稳时间序列预测的 Transformer 框架，由 Quantformer 风格数值编码器、可学习 Lee-oscillator 激活模块和 smooth-chaotic 门控融合机制组成。在 ETTh1、ETTh2 和 A 股指数基准上，QFCQT 一致优于 Informer、LogTrans、LSTMa、HAT 和 COTN 等强基线。作者强调“quantum-fractal-inspired”仅为计算类比，并非严格的量子力学或分形理论推导。
Motivation: 非平稳时间序列的预测难点在于长程依赖、局部波动爆发、结构漂移和非线性振荡行为；Transformer 预测器的前馈块通常依赖平滑静态激活，对突然的状态切换不够敏感。
Method: QFCQT 包含三个组件：直接对多变量输入做线性嵌入的 Quantformer 风格数值编码器；将标量预激活映射为动态振荡响应并用 Max-over-Time 池化汇总的可学习 Lee-oscillator 激活模块；以及在常规平滑激活和混沌敏感响应间自适应平衡的 smooth-chaotic 门控融合机制。此外，使用八个参数化 Lee oscillator 族的软叠加代替单一固定振荡器，以捕捉不同机制下的非线性响应模式。
Result: 在 ETTh1、ETTh2 和 A-share Stock Index 基准上的实验显示，QFCQT 持续优于 Informer、LogTrans、LSTMa、HAT 和 COTN 等强基线。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，结合振荡器式激活和混沌敏感响应的门控设计能提升复杂波动动态下的时间序列预测鲁棒性，并明确限定其“quantum-fractal-inspired”命名只是计算类比，而非正式理论推导。

papers.title: Depth-Wise Probing and Pruning of the Planning Token in a Driving Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models route driving decisions through a deep language model, but it is unclear how much of that depth the action itself requires. We study a representative driving VLA whose entire plan is carried by a single planning token that a generative planner decodes into a trajectory. Borrowing the planner as a trajectory-space logit lens, we decode the planning token from every one of the 32 decoder layers and measure two signals: the linear decodability of the navigation command and trajectory compatibility with the frozen native planner. Our diagnostic shows that semantic intent is linearly decodable early: command-probe accuracy reaches 97.7\% after the first decoder layer, compared with 16.7\% chance. In contrast, compatibility with the frozen native planner improves gradually across depth, with open-loop Avg-L2 reaching its minimum of 2.11\,m only at the final layer. Learned readouts from the first layer recover much of this gap, indicating that planning information is already present early but is not yet represented in the format expected by the deployed planner. Ranking decoder layers by the angular deviation they induce in the planning token permits removal of 8 of 32 layers within an approximately 5\% relative open-loop error increase and yields a measured 1.33$\times$ decoder speedup. At the evaluated sample size, no family-specific degradation is statistically resolved. These findings are limited to the evaluated ORION checkpoint and Bench2Drive setup.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 6th DriveX Workshop (Foundation Models for Autonomous Driving), ECCV 2026. 14 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究驾驶视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中规划token对深度Transformer层数的实际需求。作者借用生成式规划器作为轨迹空间logit透镜，从每个解码器层解码规划token并测量导航命令的线性可解码性与轨迹兼容性，发现语义意图在早期层即可线性解码，而轨迹兼容性随深度渐次提升。基于层间角偏差排序可移除8/32层，仅造成约5%的相对开放循环误差增加，并获得1.33倍解码器加速。
Motivation: VLA模型将驾驶决策路由经过深层语言模型，但动作规划本身需要多少深度尚不清楚；若能证明深层冗余，则可通过层剪枝降低推理成本。
Method: 将规划token从32个解码器层逐一解码，使用线性探针（linear probing）测量导航命令的线性可解码性，并借用冻结原生规划器评估轨迹兼容性；再按规划token的角偏差对层排序并剪枝。
Result: 命令探针精度在第一层后即达97.7%（随机基线16.7%）；与冻结规划器的兼容性随深度改善，开放循环Avg-L2仅在最终层达到最小值2.11 m；第一层学习读头可恢复大部分差距。剪掉8/32层后相对误差增加约5%，测得的解码器加速为1.33倍。

papers.title: Assessing AI-generated music detection in real-world broadcast monitoring
papers.abstract_en: The proliferation of AI-generated music in broadcast media raises concerns about transparency and fair compensation, but reliable detection under real broadcast conditions remains unresolved. Existing studies report substantial performance degradation in this domain, yet their evaluations are limited to synthetic broadcast data. To address this gap, we introduce BAMM (Broadcast AI-Music Monitoring), a 40-hour dataset of real-world television recordings containing AI-generated and human-made music. We compare clean-trained and broadcast-trained CNN variants across three progressively more challenging scenarios: Clean Foreground Music (CFM), Synthetic TV Broadcast (STB), and Real TV Broadcast (RTB). Both models achieve near-perfect performance on CFM but degrade substantially under synthetic broadcast conditions. Broadcast-oriented training improves robustness compared with clean training, although performance remains limited. On RTB, evaluated using BAMM, both models degrade further and show substantial score overlap between AI-generated and human-made music. These results expose a critical domain gap and show that current training approaches on CNN-based detectors remain insufficient for reliable AI-generated music detection in broadcast monitoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BAMM（Broadcast AI-Music Monitoring）数据集，包含 40 小时真实电视广播录音，并据此评估 AI 生成音乐检测在真实广播条件下的表现。作者对比了干净训练与广播训练的 CNN 变体在 Clean Foreground Music (CFM)、Synthetic TV Broadcast (STB) 和 Real TV Broadcast (RTB) 三个递进场景下的性能，发现模型在干净条件下接近完美，但在广播条件下明显下降，且真实广播场景中 AI 生成音乐与人类音乐得分高度重叠。
Motivation: 现有关于 AI 生成音乐检测的研究报告了广播条件下性能显著下降，但评估仅基于合成广播数据，缺乏真实世界广播条件下的可靠检测验证。
Method: 引入包含真实电视录音的 BAMM 数据集，比较干净训练与广播训练的 CNN 检测器，在 CFM、STB、RTB 三个难度递增的场景下评估检测性能。
Result: 两个模型在 CFM 上均接近完美，但在合成广播条件下明显退化；广播训练比干净训练更具鲁棒性，但性能仍然有限。在 RTB 上两者进一步退化，AI 生成音乐与人类音乐的分数分布出现大量重叠。
Conclusion: 结果表明存在严重域差距（domain gap），当前基于 CNN 的检测训练方法不足以支撑可靠的 AI 生成音乐广播监测。

papers.title: Finite-Response Complementarity in Fluctuation Constraints on Climate Sensitivity
papers.abstract_en: Equilibrium climate sensitivity (ECS) is a zero-frequency susceptibility, whereas historical globalmean temperature variability samples a finite, forced projection of the climate system. We test whether information missed by a scalar fluctuation-memory coordinate reappears in a finite CO2 response. After conditioning both ECS and the finite response on Ψ, CMIP5 residuals are nearly uncoupled (C5 = 0.154), whereas CMIP6 shows strong complementarity (C6 = 0.593, p = 0.00288). A two-mode stochastic response model attributes this contrast to hidden-response spread that is visible in the finite response but poorly projected onto Ψ. The CMIP6 residual direction defines a first-order correction and yields a HadCRUT5 conditional ECS estimate centered at 3.00 K. Thus the weakened CMIP6 fluctuation constraint does not imply that susceptibility information is lost: part of it is recovered through a complementary finite-response projection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从涨落约束（fluctuation constraints）的角度研究平衡气候敏感性（ECS）的信息可恢复性。作者将 ECS 与有限 CO2 响应同时用标量涨落记忆坐标 Ψ 条件化后发现，CMIP5 残差接近解耦（C5=0.154），而 CMIP6 呈现强互补性（C6=0.593, p=0.00288）。两模态随机响应模型将这一对比归因于隐藏响应散布（hidden-response spread），该散布在有限响应中可见但较差地投影到 Ψ 上，并由此给出 HadCRUT5 条件 ECS 估计。
Motivation: 历史全球平均温度变率常被用作标量涨落记忆来约束 ECS，但 CMIP6 中这种涨落约束被削弱；本文要检验被该标量坐标遗漏的信息是否会在有限 CO2 响应中重新出现，即零频磁化率（zero-frequency susceptibility）的信息是否并未真正丢失。
Method: 对 ECS 和有限 CO2 响应均基于 Ψ 做条件化，并计算残差耦合系数 C5 与 C6；构建两模态随机响应模型（two-mode stochastic response model）解释 CMIP6 与 CMIP5 的对比，再利用 CMIP6 残差方向定义一阶修正，得到条件化 ECS 估计。
Result: CMIP5 残差近乎不相关（C5=0.154），而 CMIP6 表现出强互补性（C6=0.593, p=0.00288）；利用该互补性得到的 HadCRUT5 条件 ECS 估计中心值为 3.00 K。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 CMIP6 中削弱后的涨落约束并不代表敏感性信息丢失：部分信息可以通过互补的有限响应投影（finite-response projection）恢复，并给出约 3.00 K 的条件 ECS 中心估计。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Geo-Spatial Concept Probing of Large Language Models: Abstraction, Compositionality, and Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Understanding concepts is fundamental to generalization. Despite their impressive performance on a wide range of tasks, Large Language Models (LLMs) still struggle with genuine concept understanding. Prior work has evaluated conceptual understanding in LLMs using natural-language benchmarks or narrowly scoped synthetic tasks, but these settings often conflate multiple skills or lack precise control over the underlying concepts and their properties. To support controlled probing of concepts in LLMs, we design tests on their core properties: abstraction, compositionality, and groundness. We set up a concept-centric benchmark, targeting spatial concepts such as direction, distance, topology, and their compositions, and use question answering tasks serving as a proxy. We conduct extensive experiments across multiple LLM architectures and training regimes to analyze how model scale and design impact conceptual understanding. The results reveal clear limitations in current LLMs and provide insights into the factors shaping their ability to acquire and compose structured concepts. Our findings shed light on how concept-based LLMs can be redesigned for improved information access and knowledge management. The code will be available at https://github.com/rd20karim/concept-probing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用于大语言模型（LLM）的概念探测基准，聚焦空间概念（方向、距离、拓扑及其组合）的三个核心属性：抽象（abstraction）、组合性（compositionality）与接地（grounding），并以问答任务作为代理。作者在多种 LLM 架构和训练范式下开展实验，结果显示当前模型在结构化空间概念的理解与组合上存在明显局限，并分析了模型规模与设计对概念习得的影响。代码将在 GitHub 公开。
Motivation: 现有评估 LLM 概念理解的自然语言基准或狭义的合成任务常将多种技能混在一起，且难以对底层概念及其属性进行精确控制，因此需要更可控、面向概念属性的探测框架。
Method: 构建概念中心的基准，针对空间概念（方向、距离、拓扑及其组合）设计测试，通过问答任务作为代理，系统探测抽象、组合性和 grounding 三个核心属性，并跨多种 LLM 架构与训练范式进行对比实验。
Result: 摘要报告当前 LLM 在概念理解上表现出明显局限，实验结果揭示了模型规模与设计如何影响模型获取和组合结构化概念的能力；未给出具体量化数字。
Conclusion: 作者认为研究发现有助于从概念角度重新设计 LLM，以改进信息访问和知识管理，并计划公开基准与代码。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Residual Algebra for Representation-Preserving Learning
papers.abstract_en: Learning from heterogeneous representations is usually reduced to feature concatenation, which erases which representation produced an error. We instead algebraize the residual: a representation is a typed object that owns both a coordinate system and the residual it leaves unresolved, and learning is an ordered composition of operators that preserve or deliberately erase that type. Fold realizes the objects as point-in-time conditional-mean fields on 10x10 rank grids. FPRC-PQ realizes the algebra as relax-aggregate-close: each field is relaxed by a correction fitted to its own residual in its own coordinates; corrected fields meet at a fixed mean that is the sole identity-erasure boundary; and a shared learner closes only the aggregate's fresh residual. The composition telescopes exactly into representation, local residual estimate, and residual-of-residual estimate. Its aggregate is a learned control-variate interface with population variance reduction, while refitting the closer along perturbations of the backbone yields first-order coupled-path mean orthogonality. As an analytical extension, a reflective rumination operator reads the displacement of a global reconstruction from the aggregate anchor, reflects it, and fixes its gain by a unique orthogonal projection rather than return-tuned grid search. On 3.67M Chinese A-share stock-day observations (2023-2026) under a frozen point-in-time protocol, the evaluated base algebra raises net-of-cost return from 13.52% to 19.10% and Sharpe from 1.42 to 2.09. Matched-capacity, unified-residual, identity-free two-stage, and pairwise-only controls all trail it. The gain is therefore not explained by more features or more trees, but by making residual ownership and composition explicit while representation identity is still available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种表示保持学习的残差代数框架，把表示视为同时拥有坐标系统和未解析残差的类型化对象，并将学习定义为保持或擦除该类型的有序算子组合。作者在10x10秩网格上实现对象，并以FPRC-PQ过程（松弛-聚合-闭包）实现代数。在3.67M中国A股股票-日观测（2023-2026）的冻结时点协议下，基础代数将净成本收益从13.52%提升至19.10%，Sharpe从1.42提升至2.09。
Motivation: 从异构表示学习通常被简化为特征拼接，这会抹去哪个具体表示产生了误差的信息；作者希望将残差代数化，以显式保留表示身份和残差所有权，从而提升学习效果。
Method: 提出残差代数：表示是带坐标系统和未解析残差的类型化对象。FPRC-PQ将代数实现为relax-aggregate-close：每个场由在自己坐标中拟合自身残差的修正来松弛；修正后的场在固定均值处汇合，该均值是唯一的身份擦除边界；共享学习器只关闭聚合体的新残差。作为分析扩展，还提出一个反思性rumination算子，读取全局重建相对聚合锚点的位移并反射，通过唯一正交投影而非回归调参的网格搜索固定其增益。
Result: 在3.67M中国A股股票-日观测（2023-2026）冻结时点协议下，评估的基础代数将净成本收益从13.52%提升到19.10%，Sharpe从1.42提升到2.09。匹配容量、统一残差、无身份两阶段以及仅配对的控制方法均落后于该方法。
Conclusion: 作者强调收益并非来自更多特征或更多树，而是来自在表示身份仍可用时显式化残差所有权与组合。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: An End-to-End Agent Auditing Engine
papers.abstract_en: With the rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs), harnesses have become essential infrastructure for deploying agents across a wide range of domains. The fast-evolving harness ecosystem has also made rigorous capability evaluation increasingly important. However, efficiently building an end-to-end, systematic, and comprehensive evaluation pipeline remains a significant challenge. To address this challenge, we introduce $A^2E$ (Agent Auditing Engine), an end-to-end evaluation engine designed for agent harnesses. $A^2E$ leverages our newly proposed Agent Task Protocol (ATP) to enable the rapid integration of evaluation tasks with different harnesses. Through an automatically instrumented Monitor, it captures and generates standardized execution traces during experiments. In the Evaluation stage, $A^2E$ systematically assesses harness capabilities using a suite of multidimensional metrics. Compared with correctness alone, these metrics provide a more fine-grained characterization of differences among harnesses in execution efficiency, tool use, task planning, and error recovery. Experiments conducted with $A^2E$ further reveal that model-harness combinations exhibit substantial performance variation across different types of tasks, and that no single combination consistently outperforms all others across every task. These findings not only demonstrate the necessity of systematic evaluation but also provide useful guidance for the co-evolving of models and harnesses. Our code is available at https://github.com/datamllab/A2E.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 A2E (Agent Auditing Engine)，一个面向 agent harness 的端到端评估引擎。A2E 引入 Agent Task Protocol (ATP) 以快速集成不同 harness 上的评估任务，通过自动插桩的 Monitor 捕获并生成标准化执行轨迹，在 Evaluation 阶段用一组多维指标系统评估 harness 能力。实验表明模型-harness 组合在不同任务上的性能差异显著，没有单一组合能在所有任务上持续最优。
Motivation: LLM agent 的 harness 生态快速演进，但高效构建端到端、系统且全面的评估 pipeline 仍是显著挑战；仅靠正确率难以细粒度区分 harness 在执行效率、工具使用、任务规划和错误恢复等方面的差异。
Method: 提出 A2E 评估引擎，核心包括新提出的 Agent Task Protocol (ATP) 以支持不同 harness 快速集成评估任务、自动插桩的 Monitor 在实验中捕获标准化执行轨迹，以及使用多维指标进行的系统化 harness 能力评估。
Result: 实验揭示模型与 harness 的组合在不同类型任务上存在显著性能差异，没有任何单一组合在所有任务上一致优于其他组合。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果说明系统化评估 agent harness 的必要性，并为模型与 harness 的协同演化提供指导；代码已开源。

papers.title: Zero Gap Is Not Restoration: Stratified Per-Question Probability Evaluation and Step-wise Mitigation of Benchmark Contamination
papers.abstract_en: Test data from public benchmarks inevitably leaks into pretraining corpora, inflating evaluation scores once memorized. \textbf{Contamination mitigation evaluation} intervenes in the decoding process to suppress memorization and restore a contaminated model's genuine capability, but its prevailing metric, the \textbf{G-AP} (\textbf{G}ap of \textbf{A}ggregate \textbf{P}erformance), is flawed. Discrete correct/incorrect readouts cannot characterize per-question performance, averaging before differencing lets over- and under-suppression cancel out, and uniform per-question weighting invites strategies to push solve probabilities onto the clean model's high-frequency values. We propose \textbf{SA-PPG} (\textbf{S}tratified \textbf{A}ggregate of \textbf{P}er-question \textbf{P}robability \textbf{G}aps): estimate each question's solve probability by sampling, difference it against the clean model per question, and aggregate within groups defined by the clean model's solve probability. Existing mitigation strategies first estimate where contamination lies and then operate on the estimate, so they are only as correct as the estimate. \textbf{RailCap} instead judges contamination during generation: whenever a sample falls back onto the greedy trajectory, the next trajectory token is capped to the runner-up, accumulating suppression until the response distribution becomes sufficiently dispersed. Across multiple contaminated models and benchmarks, SA-PPG reveals that prior strategies' restoration is substantially overestimated, while RailCap attains the lowest SA-PPG.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出用于评估基准污染缓解策略的主流指标 G-AP(聚合性能差距)存在缺陷,并提出新的评估方法 SA-PPG(分层逐题概率差距聚合),通过采样估计每题的解出概率、与干净模型逐题差分,并按干净模型解出概率分层聚合。作者同时提出解码阶段的污染缓解策略 RailCap,在采样落回贪心轨迹时对下一轨迹 token 进行截断抑制。摘要报告在多个受污染模型和基准上,现有缓解策略的真实恢复效果被明显高估,而 RailCap 取得最低的 SA-PPG。
Motivation: 公开基准的测试数据会泄漏进预训练语料并被记忆,从而虚增评测分数;污染缓解评估需要在解码中抑制记忆以恢复真实能力,但现有指标 G-AP 无法刻画逐题表现,先聚合再差分会让过度抑制与抑制不足相互抵消,且均匀逐题加权会诱导模型把解出概率推向干净模型的高频值。
Method: 提出 SA-PPG:对每题用采样估计解出概率,与干净模型逐题求差,再按干净模型解出概率分组的聚合;同时提出 RailCap,在生成中动态判断污染,每当采样样本落回贪心轨迹,就将下一轨迹 token 限制为次优项,逐步累积抑制直到响应分布足够分散。
Result: 在多个受污染模型和基准上,SA-PPG 显示既有缓解策略的恢复效果被大幅高估,而 RailCap 取得最低的 SA-PPG。
Conclusion: 既有缓解策略先估计污染位置再操作,其正确性受限于估计精度;RailCap 在生成阶段直接判断污染并抑制记忆,能获得更可靠的真实能力恢复。

papers.title: H2AL: Hyperbolic Hierarchy-aware Aggregative Learning for Registration-based Few-shot Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Registration-based Few-shot medical image segmentation (RFMIS) aims to generate pseudo-labels for unlabeled images by warping a labeled image through registration. However, existing methods primarily perform pixel-level optimization and inference in Euclidean space, treating anatomical structures as flat and disjoint. This neglect of inherent hierarchies degrades pseudo-label quality and weakens the discrimination of ambiguous regions, limiting the segmentation performance. To overcome this challenge, we propose a Hyperbolic Hierarchy-aware Aggregative Learning framework for RFMIS, termed H2AL, that enhances both deformation plausibility and anatomical discrimination for dual-task learning. Specifically, we introduce a Hyperbolic Hierarchy-aware Infusion (H2I) module, which leverages the hierarchical modeling capability of hyperbolic space to learn precise hierarchy-aware representations via transformation-guided supervised hyperbolic contrastive learning, and injects such hierarchical priors into Euclidean space through a gated infusion block while preserving semantic richness. Furthermore, we propose an end-to-end joint optimization algorithm by gradient aggregation, where the gradients from the registration and segmentation decoders, embedding semantic and hierarchical cues, are aggregated to update the shared encoder to promote collaborative learning across tasks. Extensive experiments on two anatomical regions, with five experimental settings, demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of our method in both registration and segmentation. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/JiamingCai469/H2AL.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 9 figures. Accepted at ACM Multimedia 2026 (MM '26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 H2AL，一种面向基于配准的小样本医学图像分割（Registration-based Few-shot Medical Image Segmentation, RFMIS）的双任务学习框架。作者指出现有方法在欧氏空间中做像素级优化，忽略了解剖结构的内在层级性，因此引入双曲空间（hyperbolic space）的层级建模，并通过门控注入与梯度聚合实现配准与分割的联合优化。摘要报告在两个解剖区域、五种实验设置下，该方法在配准和分割任务上均表现出有效性与高效性。
Motivation: 现有 RFMIS 方法主要将解剖结构视为平坦、互不关联的像素集合，在欧氏空间进行优化与推理，忽略了结构固有的层级关系，导致伪标签质量下降并削弱模糊区域的判别能力，进而限制分割性能。
Method: 提出 H2AL 框架，包含两个关键组件：一是双曲层级感知注入（Hyperbolic Hierarchy-aware Infusion, H2I）模块，利用双曲空间的层级建模能力，通过变换引导的监督双曲对比学习（hyperbolic contrastive learning）学习层级感知表示，并用门控注入块将层级先验融入欧氏空间；二是基于梯度聚合的端到端联合优化算法，将配准与分割解码器的梯度聚合以更新共享编码器，促进跨任务协作学习。
Result: 摘要报告在两个解剖区域、五种实验设置下的广泛实验表明，该方法在配准和分割任务上均有效且高效；摘要未给出具体量化数字。
Conclusion: 论文的核心结论是，在 RFMIS 中引入双曲空间层级建模能够改善配准变形合理性并增强解剖判别能力，从而提升伪标签质量与分割性能；代码已公开。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Aftab: A Comprehensive Benchmark of CNN Encoders and Advanced Value Functions in Parallelized Q-Networks
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements in deep reinforcement learning have increasingly favored simplified, highly parallelized paradigms. Notably, the Parallelized Q-Network (PQN) algorithm achieves stable off-policy learning without relying on computationally expensive replay buffers or target networks. However, the representational capacity and parameter efficiency of visual encoders operating in these buffer-free settings remain underexplored. In this work, we systematically investigate the architectural design space of Convolutional Neural Networks for PQN. We design and rigorously evaluate eight distinct CNN topologies, optimizing for sample efficiency under strict parameter constraints. Furthermore, we study the impact of representation and value estimation enhancements by integrating the Hadamax encoding paradigm and advanced Q-learning extensions, including distributional, ensemble, and dueling heads. Extensive experiments on the Atari-57 benchmark demonstrate that our proposed composite architecture, Aftab, achieves an Interquartile Mean (IQM) Human-Normalized Score of 6.479, establishing a 0.86 Probability of Improvement over the standard PQN baseline. Additionally, structural resilience evaluations on the highly non-stationary Procgen Hard benchmark confirm out-of-distribution generalization, with Aftab yielding an IQM Procgen Normalized Score of 0.418 compared to the baseline's 0.382. Ultimately, this work establishes an efficient, probabilistically superior structural reference for model-free reinforcement learning, all while preserving the simplicity and memory efficiency of unbuffered, parallelized optimization. The complete Aftab framework, including all model definitions, training configurations, and raw experimental logs, is open-sourced and available on our GitHub repository: https://github.com/tahashieenavaz/aftab
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估并行化 Q-Network (PQN) 在无回放缓冲区、无目标网络条件下的 CNN 编码器架构设计空间，提出复合架构 Aftab，整合 Hadamax 编码以及分布、集成、决斗等 Q-learning 扩展。在 Atari-57 上获得 IQM Human-Normalized Score 6.479，相对标准 PQN 基线的 Probability of Improvement 为 0.86；在 Procgen Hard 上验证了非平稳环境下的分布外泛化。
Motivation: 深度强化学习日益偏向简化且高度并行化的范式，PQN 无需昂贵的回放缓冲区或目标网络即可实现稳定的离策略学习，但视觉编码器在这种无缓冲设置下的表示能力与参数效率仍未得到充分探索。
Method: 设计并严格评估 8 种不同的 CNN 拓扑，在严格参数约束下优化样本效率；同时引入 Hadamax 编码范式，并整合分布、集成和决斗头部等 Q-learning 增强，最终构建组合架构 Aftab。
Result: 在 Atari-57 基准上，Aftab 的 IQM Human-Normalized Score 达到 6.479，相对标准 PQN 基线有 0.86 的 Probability of Improvement；在高度非平稳的 Procgen Hard 基准上，Aftab 的 IQM Procgen Normalized Score 为 0.418，优于基线的 0.382。
Conclusion: 该工作为无缓冲、并行化的无模型强化学习提供了一个高效且概率上更优的结构参考，同时保留了 unbuffered 并行优化的简洁性和内存效率；完整框架、模型定义、训练配置与日志已开源。

papers.title: When GNNs Fail: Quantifying and Overcoming Temporal Correlation Volatility in Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Modeling multivariate time series by representing them as graphs, where individual series act as nodes and pairwise temporal corre- lations serve as edges, has gained significant traction. Recent advances in Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have demonstrated strong perfor- mance by assuming a static graph topology and aggregating information from neighboring series. In this work, we investigate the representa- tional power of GNNs for forecasting under both static and dynamic settings (i.e., when pairwise correlations evolve drastically over time) and identify critical limitations in current architectures. To formalize this, we first propose Temporal Correlation Volatility (TCV), a model- agnostic metric designed to quantify the distributional evolution of these latent structures. We establish a clear connection between TCV and performance degradation, demonstrating that many popular models, including Transformers, generalize poorly in high-TCV settings and are often outperformed by simple structure-agnostic baselines. To address these limitations, we propose Graph Layer for Inference in Dynamic En- vironments (GLIDE), a novel GNN layer enhanced by two theoretically grounded design mechanisms: (D1) Path-based Message Passing, which captures path-based neighborhoods and (D2) Static and Dynamic Propagation Separation, which identifies optimal dynamics via local static approximation. These components significantly improve learning under dynamic topology while preserving robustness in static scenarios. Ex- tensive experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks show that GLIDE improves average performance by up to 45.6% across static and dynamic settings, with the largest gain reaching 85.7%. The source code is available at https://github.com/ChenS676/GLIDE.
papers.journal_ref: European Conference on Machine Learning and Principles and Practice of Knowledge Discovery in Databases, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究图神经网络（GNN）在多变量时间序列预测中的表征能力，针对其静态图拓扑假设在成对时序相关结构剧烈演化时失效的问题。作者提出模型无关的时序相关波动性（Temporal Correlation Volatility, TCV）指标来量化潜在结构的分布演化，并发现包括 Transformer 在内的多种流行模型在高 TCV 场景下泛化差，甚至不如简单的不依赖结构的基线。在此基础上提出新 GNN 层 GLIDE，包含基于路径的消息传递（Path-based Message Passing）与静态/动态传播分离（Static and Dynamic Propagation Separation）两种机制。
Motivation: 现有基于图的时序预测方法通常假定静态图拓扑，但在实际多变量时间序列中，成对时序相关可能随时间剧烈演化，这使 GNN 的邻域聚合假设失效，需要系统量化这种波动并改进架构。
Method: 先提出 TCV 指标以形式化度量潜在时序相关结构的分布变化；随后提出 GNN 层 GLIDE，包含两种理论支撑的设计机制：D1 基于路径的消息传递以捕获路径级邻域，D2 静态与动态传播分离，通过局部静态近似识别最优动态。
Result: 实验表明 TCV 与性能下降之间存在明确关联，许多流行模型（包括 Transformer）在高 TCV 环境下泛化差。在合成与真实世界基准上，GLIDE 在静态与动态设定下平均性能提升最高达 45.6%，最大单项提升为 85.7%。
Conclusion: 作者强调通过量化时序相关波动性并有针对性地设计动态拓扑下的图传播机制，可以显著改善动态环境中的预测性能，同时在静态场景下保持稳健。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究图神经网络（GNN）在多变量时间序列预测中的表征能力，针对其静态图拓扑假设在成对时序相关结构剧烈演化时失效的问题。作者提出模型无关的时序相关波动性（Temporal Correlation Volatility, TCV）指标来量化潜在结构的分布演化，并发现包括 Transformer 在内的多种流行模型在高 TCV 场景下泛化差，甚至不如简单的不依赖结构的基线。在此基础上提出新 GNN 层 GLIDE，包含基于路径的消息传递（Path-based Message Passing）与静态/动态传播分离（Static and Dynamic Propagation Separation）两种机制。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有基于图的时序预测方法通常假定静态图拓扑，但在实际多变量时间序列中，成对时序相关可能随时间剧烈演化，这使 GNN 的邻域聚合假设失效，需要系统量化这种波动并改进架构。
summary_sections.method: 先提出 TCV 指标以形式化度量潜在时序相关结构的分布变化；随后提出 GNN 层 GLIDE，包含两种理论支撑的设计机制：D1 基于路径的消息传递以捕获路径级邻域，D2 静态与动态传播分离，通过局部静态近似识别最优动态。
summary_sections.result: 实验表明 TCV 与性能下降之间存在明确关联，许多流行模型（包括 Transformer）在高 TCV 环境下泛化差。在合成与真实世界基准上，GLIDE 在静态与动态设定下平均性能提升最高达 45.6%，最大单项提升为 85.7%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调通过量化时序相关波动性并有针对性地设计动态拓扑下的图传播机制，可以显著改善动态环境中的预测性能，同时在静态场景下保持稳健。

papers.title: Learning Fault-Tolerant Locomotion with Adaptive Gait Timing
papers.abstract_en: Hardware failures require legged robots to rapidly reorganize coordination and gait timing to maintain stability and mobility. This is particularly challenging for larger quadrupeds, where increased mass and tighter actuation limits reduce the feasibility of aggressive, high-frequency compensation strategies often observed on smaller platforms. In this work, we propose a deep reinforcement learning approach for fault-tolerant locomotion under actuator power loss. The method employs an asymmetric actor-critic architecture in which the critic has access to privileged information during training, while the actor learns to reconstruct a corresponding latent representation from proprioceptive observations. We introduce a latent-alignment loss that encourages consistency between actor and critic representations. Additionally, we augment the action space with a learnable gait frequency parameter, enabling adaptive gait timing in response to terrain variations and actuator degradation without predefined faulty-leg strategies. The approach is validated in high-fidelity simulation on uneven terrain and real-world experiments on flat ground using a 68 kg quadruped robot.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于深度强化学习的容错运动方法，针对四足机器人在执行器动力损失下的稳定性与移动性问题。方法采用非对称 actor-critic 架构，训练时 critic 可访问特权信息，actor 则从本体感受观测中重建对应的隐表示，并引入隐对齐损失 (latent-alignment loss) 保证两者一致性。动作空间额外加入可学习的步态频率参数，使步态时序能随地形变化和执行器退化自适应调整，无需预设故障腿策略。方法在崎岖地形的高保真仿真和 68 kg 四足机器人的平地真实实验中进行了验证。
Motivation: 硬件故障要求足式机器人快速重组协调与步态时序以维持稳定和移动能力，而较大型四足机器人因质量更大、执行器极限更紧，难以采用小型平台上常见的激进高频补偿策略。
Method: 提出非对称 actor-critic 深度强化学习方法：critic 在训练时使用特权信息，actor 从本体感受观测重建对应隐表示，并设计隐对齐损失促进二者一致性；同时将可学习步态频率参数加入动作空间，实现无需预设故障腿策略的自适应步态时序。
Result: 方法在高保真仿真中于不平地形上验证，并在 68 kg 四足机器人上完成平地真实实验；摘要未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法能针对地形变化和执行器退化自适应调整步态时序，且不需要预设故障腿策略；论文已被 2026 年 IEEE/RSJ IROS 接收。

papers.title: State transitions in land-vegetation systems emerge at Paris Agreement warming levels in CMIP6
papers.abstract_en: Using an automatic detection workflow applied to the Coupled Model Intercomparison Project Phase 6 (CMIP6) ensemble under future emission scenarios, we identify 47 abrupt and more gradually developing state transitions in the land-vegetation component of the Earth system, classified into 9 categories. Over the Amazon, we find state transitions via vegetation dieback alongside greening cases; the contrast between them is traced primarily to differences in precipitation: models showing dieback experience either a larger absolute decline in precipitation, or one that translates more efficiently into soil moisture loss, particularly near the surface, while in greening models the CO$_2$ fertilization effect wins out where the soil moisture loss remains weaker. The precipitation decline in dieback-prone models appears driven through a weakening of moist convection. Across these Amazon cases, models with dynamic vegetation undergo dieback, whereas greening is confined to models with prescribed vegetation distributions. African cases include greening over eastern-central Africa and the Congo basin, and an abrupt soil-moisture drying also over the Congo. At high latitudes, boreal forest expands, while permafrost thaws once the regional above-zero temperatures persist for more than half the year. Additional categories cover transitions to a reduced snow-cover state over northeastern North America, increased vegetation biomass near the Tibetan Plateau and southeastern Asia, and increased leaf-area index over the northeast Northern America. Of particular concern, a global warming of 2$^\circ$C or below, within reach of the Paris Agreement targets, is already enough to trigger the onset of the majority of the identified categories in CMIP6.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过在 CMIP6 多模式集合上应用自动检测工作流，识别出未来排放情景下陆地植被系统中 47 个突变或渐进的状态转换，并将其归为 9 类。在亚马逊地区，植被枯死 (dieback) 与变绿 (greening) 并存，差异主要归结为降水变化及其向土壤湿度损失的转化效率，以及 CO2 施肥效应。多数类别在 2°C 或以下的全球增温（巴黎协定目标范围内）即可触发，表明此类转变风险可能较早出现。
Motivation: 需要系统评估 CMIP6 模式在未来排放情景下陆地植被系统状态转换的发生条件与类型，特别是这些转换是否在巴黎协定升温目标范围内就会出现，以指导气候风险判断。
Method: 作者使用自动检测工作流 (automatic detection workflow) 扫描 CMIP6 多模式集合，识别陆地植被组分中突变与渐进的状态转换，并按现象分类；对亚马逊案例进一步比较降水绝对下降量、降水向土壤湿度损失的转化效率（尤其近表层）以及 CO2 施肥效应。
Result: 共识别出 47 个状态转换、9 个类别；亚马逊 dieback 与其伴随的 greening 对比由降水与土壤湿度损失差异驱动，dieback 模式中降水下降经由湿对流减弱，且动态植被模式发生 dieback 而固定植被分布模式出现 greening；其余类别包括东中部非洲和刚果盆地的变绿、刚果的突然土壤湿度变干、北方森林扩张与冻土融化，以及东北美洲积雪减少等。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，在不高于 2°C 的全球增温（巴黎协定目标范围内）下，CMIP6 中大多数类别已经可以被触发，说明陆地植被系统的各类型状态转换可能较早发生，值得关注。

papers.title: Is SwiGLU's Open Positive Tail Necessary? Evidence from Closed-Tail Gating with MemGLU
papers.abstract_en: We test whether decoder-only language-model FFNs require SwiGLU's open positive tail. We introduce MemGLU as a closed-tail comparator derived from a memristive branch geometry. Across paired 9M and 30M pretraining runs with three seeds, MemGLU remains within about 0.1% of SwiGLU in validation NLL. Trained SwiGLU checkpoints are sensitive to positive-tail suppression, while mechanism diagnostics show that the two models use their gates differently despite similar losses. These results suggest that models adapt to the gate geometry available during pretraining. At the tested scales, SwiGLU's open positive tail is not necessary for decoder-only language-model FFNs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过引入 MemGLU 作为闭尾门控对照，检验 decoder-only 语言模型 FFN 是否需要 SwiGLU 的开放正尾。在 9M 和 30M 规模、三种随机种子的配对预训练中，MemGLU 在验证 NLL 上与 SwiGLU 相差约 0.1%；训练后的 SwiGLU 检查点对正尾抑制敏感，但机制诊断显示两者门控使用方式不同。作者认为在测试规模下开放正尾并非必要。
Motivation: 探究 SwiGLU 激活函数中开放正尾是否是 decoder-only 语言模型 FFN 的必要设计特征，以理解门控几何如何影响模型。
Method: 提出 MemGLU，一种基于忆阻分支几何的闭尾对照门控，与 SwiGLU 做配对预训练比较，并对训练后检查点进行正尾抑制测试和机制诊断。
Result: 在 9M 和 30M 参数规模、三种子重复实验中，MemGLU 与 SwiGLU 的验证 NLL 差距约 0.1%；SwiGLU 检查点对正尾抑制敏感，而两个模型门控使用方式不同。
Conclusion: 在测试规模下，decoder-only 语言模型 FFN 不需要 SwiGLU 的开放正尾；模型会适应预训练期间可用的门控几何。

papers.title: Towards Assurance Closure in AI-Native Large-Scale Agile Software Development
papers.abstract_en: The AI-Native Manifesto envisions large-scale agile software development in which humans increasingly govern intent, risk, and exceptions while agents execute more of the engineering process. Realizing that end-state requires more than better code generation: it requires assurance closure, meaning that the system can establish what must be true, determine and obtain appropriate evidence, judge the credibility of that evidence, preserve its validity through change, and use the resulting uncertainty to bound agent authority. Existing work already provides many of the necessary mechanisms across formal methods, testing, simulation, assurance cases, digital twins, and runtime assurance. We identify six residual gaps in making the surrounding assurance reasoning sufficiently machine-operable, propose a high-level architecture with six corresponding capabilities built on a shared semantic assurance layer, and formulate four research questions to turn that architecture into dependable, human-on-the-loop, AI-native R&D.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向 AI-Native 大規模敏捷軟體開發中的保障閉合 (assurance closure) 問題，主張僅提升程式碼生成能力不足以達成 AI-Native Manifesto 的終態。作者指出現有形式方法、測試、模擬、保障案例、數位孿生與運行時保障等機制雖已覆蓋多數必要環節，但保障推理尚不足以被機器可操作化。論文識別六個殘餘缺口，提出基於共享語義保障層的六能力高階架構，並提出四個研究問題。
Motivation: 實現 AI-Native 大規模敏捷開發需要系統能建立必真條件、取得並判斷證據、在變更中維持證據有效性，並用不確定性約束代理人權限；現有機制分散但缺乏機器可操作的統一保障推理。
Method: 識別讓保障推理機器可操作的六個殘餘缺口，提出一個高階架構，包含建構在共享語義保障層之上的六項對應能力，並將其轉化為四個研究問題。
Result: 摘要未報告實證結果；核心產出為缺口分析、高階架構設計以及四個待研究問題。
Conclusion: 作者認為要使 AI-native、human-on-the-loop 的研發體系可靠，必須解決保障閉合的機器可操作化問題，而非僅靠更強的程式生成。

papers.title: Natural Language Processing Psychometrics
papers.abstract_en: Natural Language Processing (NLP) models predicting mental health outcomes rarely specify what they measure: contextual knowledge, emotional content, or syntactic structure. NLP Psychometrics treats psychological prediction from text as a psychometric problem, linking scores to interpretable linguistic evidence and testing beyond the training text format. Nine LLMs, conditioned on controlled personas (cognitive digital shadows), completed psychometric questionnaires with textual explanations per item. We extracted emotional profiles and syntactic-semantic structure via textual forma mentis networks, combined with personality and sociodemographic variables in ablated random forest (RF) regressors, using SHAP to identify which features drove performance and in which direction. Full RF models explained up to 70.8% of variance in life satisfaction (SWLS), 55.7% in depression (PHQ-9), and, for DASS-21, 68.5% depression, 76.0% anxiety, 72.4% stress. Sociodemographics alone explained no meaningful variance in depression, anxiety, or stress, but did so for life satisfaction, where emotion features and income were the strongest predictors; neuroticism and network topology instead dominated depression and anxiety, reversing direction between them. Without retraining, RF models separated diaries from low- and high-score personas ($r$ up to 0.91) and, using only network/emotion features, classified clinical from control participants in real transcripts with up to 68% accuracy. These results show the promise and limits of synthetic data: LLM personas can expose model biases, recover patterns consistent with clinical rumination, and support psychometric prediction from human text without a matched questionnaire, but cannot substitute for human validation. NLP Psychometrics makes these distinctions explicit, measurable, and testable through interpretable AI and network/emotional features.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“NLP 心理测量学”(NLP Psychometrics) 框架，将文本的心理健康预测重新定义为心理测量问题，使分数可关联到可解释的语言学证据并检验超出训练文本格式的泛化。作者让九种 LLM 在受控人格（认知数字影子）条件下完成心理问卷并给出逐项文本解释，用文本 forma mentis networks 提取情感与句法语义结构，再结合人格和社会人口学变量构建消融随机森林回归器，并用 SHAP 分析特征贡献。摘要报告模型对生活满意度、抑郁、焦虑、压力等量表解释了最高约 70%-76% 的方差，并可在不重新训练的情况下泛化到人类文本。作者认为合成数据能暴露模型偏差并支持心理测量预测，但不能替代人类验证。
Motivation: 现有 NLP 心理健康预测模型很少明确说明它们测量的是上下文知识、情感内容还是句法结构，导致预测分数缺乏可解释的心理测量学基础。本文把心理预测当作真正的心理测量问题来处理，要求分数能关联到可检验的语言学证据，并考察超出训练文本格式的泛化能力。
Method: 九种 LLM 在受控人格（cognitive digital shadows）条件下完成心理问卷并生成逐项文本解释；从这些文本中提取情感概况与句法语义结构（textual forma mentis networks），与人格和社会人口学变量一起输入带消融的随机森林 (random forest) 回归器，结合 SHAP 分析哪些特征驱动性能及其作用方向。
Result: 完整 RF 模型解释了生活满意度 (SWLS) 70.8% 的方差、抑郁 (PHQ-9) 55.7%；DASS-21 上抑郁 68.5%、焦虑 76.0%、压力 72.4%。社会人口学变量单独对抑郁、焦虑、压力几乎无解释力，但对生活满意度有解释力；神经质与网络拓扑主导抑郁和焦虑预测，且两者的作用方向相反。无需重新训练，RF 即可区分日记中的低分与高分人格（r 最高 0.91），仅用网络/情感特征对真实转录中的临床与对照组分类准确率最高达 68%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 LLM 人格可以暴露模型偏差、恢复与临床反刍一致的模式，并能支持在没有匹配问卷的情况下从人类文本进行心理测量预测，但合成数据不能替代人类验证。NLP 心理测量学通过可解释 AI 与网络/情感特征，使这些区分显式、可测、可检验。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: TEMPO: Semantic-Action Decoupled RL Post-Training for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are commonly adapted to downstream manipulation tasks via supervised fine-tuning (SFT) or online reinforcement learning (RL) post-training. SFT is prone to distribution mismatch, and existing RL approaches typically apply a single, uniform update strategy to all model components, ignoring their distinct functional roles. We propose TEMPO, a semantic-action decoupled, two-timescale RL post-training framework for VLA models. TEMPO freezes the pretrained vision-language backbone to preserve general semantic representations, and restricts adaptation to two components with dedicated RL optimization loops: the semantic projection layer and the low-level action expert. We update them at different rates--the semantic projection layer infrequently, to keep the latent action stable, and the action expert frequently, to rapidly incorporate control feedback from online interaction. This decoupling RL fine-tuning strategy prevents fast policy updates from destabilizing high-level semantic representations while still allowing the action expert to learn efficiently from online feedback. Experiments on the CALVIN benchmark and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that TEMPO consistently outperforms both pretrained state-of-the-art VLA models and the RL post-training baseline, while reaching and maintaining higher evaluation rewards on two real-world tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TEMPO，一种面向视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型的语义-动作解耦双时间尺度 RL 后训练框架。该方法冻结预训练视觉-语言骨干以保留通用语义表示，仅对语义投影层和低级动作专家分别进行专门优化，并以不同频率更新。实验表明，TEMPO 在 CALVIN 基准和真实世界操纵任务上一致优于预训练 SOTA VLA 模型和 RL 后训练基线。
Motivation: 监督微调 (SFT) 容易产生分布不匹配，而现有 RL 后训练方法对所有模型组件使用统一更新策略，忽略了不同组件在语义理解与控制执行上的功能差异。
Method: TEMPO 冻结预训练视觉-语言骨干，将适配限制在语义投影层和低级动作专家两个组件；语义投影层低频更新以保持潜在动作稳定性，动作专家高频更新以快速吸收在线交互反馈，实现双时间尺度的 RL 优化。
Result: 在 CALVIN 基准和真实世界操纵任务上，TEMPO 持续超越预训练 SOTA VLA 模型和 RL 后训练基线，并在两项真实世界任务上达到并维持更高的评估奖励。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将 RL 更新解耦到不同语义/动作组件并以不同频率更新，可以防止快速策略更新破坏高层语义表示，同时仍允许动作专家高效地从在线反馈中学习。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Winning by Peeking: Unenforced Budgets and Test-Set Selection Inflate Short-Budget AutoML Comparisons
papers.abstract_en: Comparisons between AutoML systems at short time budgets -- tens of seconds rather than hours -- are common in tool READMEs and workshop papers, and they are easy to get wrong. We report a case study in which a simple AutoML engine, Orcetra, appeared to beat FLAML and AutoGluon on 513 OpenML datasets, winning 57.1% of them at a nominal 60-second budget and 78.4% of datasets against FLAML alone at 30 seconds. Both margins came from protocol defects that a results table cannot show. The search loop scored every candidate on the test split and reported the best, making the headline metric a maximum over dozens of noisy estimates while the baselines selected on training data and touched the test set once; and the budget was checked before launching a candidate but never enforced during one, so the system consumed a median of 120 s against a 60-second budget, 2.24x the wall-clock AutoGluon used. Re-running with selection moved to a validation split, the deadline enforced externally and every framework pinned to an equal share of the machine, Orcetra's win rate on the re-run subset falls from 59.4% to 34.3% and no pairwise difference against either competitor remains significant. Recording both estimands inside a single search lets us attribute the collapse: the selection rule accounts for 4.8 percentage points and unequal compute for most of the rest. The same traces give the selection bias as a function of budget, measured rather than assumed: it grows with $K$ but reaches only 0.27 accuracy points, about five times below the $σ\sqrt{2\ln K}$ bound a marginal-standard-error argument predicts, because candidates scored on shared test rows cancel most of the noise. We close with a checklist for short-budget comparisons. Code, per-dataset results and the scripts that regenerate every number and figure in the paper are released with it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过案例研究指出，短时间预算（数十秒而非数小时）下的 AutoML 比较很容易因协议缺陷而失真。作者提出的简单 AutoML 引擎 Orcetra 在名义 60 秒预算下以 57.1% 的胜率击败 FLAML 和 AutoGluon，但两个胜率主要来自在测试集上选择候选以及未强制执行的预算。将选择移到验证集、外部强制执行截止时间并给所有框架等量机器资源后，Orcetra 的胜率从 59.4% 降至 34.3%，且与两个竞争对手的差异不再显著。文章还测量了选择偏差随预算的变化，并给出短预算比较的检查清单。
Motivation: 短时间预算的 AutoML 比较在工具 README 和 workshop 论文中很常见，但很容易做错；结果表无法暴露这类协议缺陷，导致不公平比较被误读为真实性能优势。
Method: 以 Orcetra 为案例进行对照实验：先在原始协议下运行，再改为在验证集上选择候选、外部强制执行截止时间并给每个框架等量机器资源；同时在同一搜索中记录两个估计量，以分解胜率下降的来源，并把选择偏差作为预算的函数进行实测。
Result: 修正协议后，Orcetra 在重跑子集上的胜率从 59.4% 降至 34.3%，与 FLAML 和 AutoGluon 的成对差异均不再显著；其中选择规则贡献 4.8 个百分点，其余大部分来自不等的计算量。选择偏差随 K 增长但仅达到 0.27 准确率点，约为边际标准误界 σ√(2 ln K) 的五分之一。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，短预算 AutoML 比较必须避免测试集选择、强制执行预算并公平分配计算资源；作者提供了检查清单，并公开了代码、逐数据集结果以及生成所有数字与图表的脚本。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Same Attention, Different Truths: Put Logit-Lens over Visual Attention to Detect and Mitigate LVLM Object Hallucination
papers.abstract_en: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) often suffer from object hallucination, generating objects that are absent from the image. Prior work largely attributes this to insufficient visual attention. However, we find that both real and hallucinated objects receive equally strong visual attention in the model's mid-to-late layers, suggesting that the key issue may not be how much the model attends, but what it attends to and why. To this end, we decode the visual features of high-attention regions using Logit Lens, and observe that regions corresponding to real objects can be correctly decoded to the target object tokens, whereas those for hallucinated objects cannot. Building on this, we identify two hallucination mechanisms: (i) visual uncertainty, triggered by semantically similar or confusable regions; masking these regions eliminates the hallucination. (ii) contextual prior, triggered by strong co-occurrence priors; even when the initially attended region is masked, the hallucination persists and attention drifts to other regions. Based on these findings, we propose a simple yet effective training-free Detect-Mitigate framework comprising a Logit-Lens Consistency Check to detect hallucination and targeted remedies: High-Attention Regions Masking (HARM) for visual uncertainty hallucination, and Visual Evidence Enhanced Decoding (VEED) for contextual prior hallucination. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art results on multiple hallucination benchmarks. Code will be available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大视觉语言模型（LVLM）的目标幻觉问题，发现真实目标与幻觉目标在模型中层到深层都获得同等强度的视觉注意力，因此问题不在于注意力多少，而在于模型注意了什么以及为何注意。作者用 Logit Lens 解码高注意力区域，发现真实目标区域可正确解码为目标词元，幻觉目标区域则不能，并据此区分出视觉不确定性与上下文先验两种幻觉机制。基于此提出无需训练的 Detect-Mitigate 框架，包含 Logit-Lens 一致性检查以及针对两种机制的掩码与解码补救，在多个幻觉基准上取得当前最优结果。
Motivation: 以往研究多将目标幻觉归因于视觉注意力不足，但作者发现真实与幻觉目标在中间及深层都获得同样强的视觉注意力，说明关键不是模型注意了多少，而是它注意的内容与原因，因此需要重新审视幻觉机制并提出相应检测与缓解手段。
Method: 作者利用 Logit Lens 对高注意力区域的视觉特征进行解码，据此识别两类幻觉机制：视觉不确定性由语义相似或易混淆区域触发，可通过掩码这些区域消除幻觉；上下文先验由强共现先验触发，即使掩码初始关注区域幻觉仍会持续并发生注意力漂移。基于此提出无训练框架，包括用于检测幻觉的 Logit-Lens 一致性检查（Logit-Lens Consistency Check），以及分别针对两类机制的高注意力区域掩码（HARM）与视觉证据增强解码（VEED）。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在多个幻觉基准上达到当前最优（state-of-the-art）结果，但未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 LVLM 目标幻觉的根源在于注意力内容而非注意力强度，并提出两类可分别干预的机制；所提框架无需训练即可完成检测与缓解，代码将公开。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: From Optimal Actions to World Models: Identifiability of Transition Kernels in Discounted MDPs
papers.abstract_en: We study what can be recovered about the transition probabilities of a Markov decision process from optimal actions alone. This is closely related to the inverse problem considered by Letcher et al., who ask when the dynamics can be recovered from numerical \(Q\)-values. Here the numerical values themselves are not observed; only the optimal actions are known, for every reward in a given class. For state-action rewards \(r(s,a)\), knowing the optimal actions for every reward also tells us how much better one action is than another when each is followed by the same fixed policy. This is still not enough to determine the transition probabilities uniquely. We prove that two kernels give the same optimal actions for every reward exactly when \[ Q_{s,a} = \Bigl(P_{s,a}+\tfrac1γe_s^{\mathsf T}(L-I)\Bigr)L^{-1} \] for one invertible matrix \(L\) satisfying \(L\mathbf 1=\mathbf 1\). Near a kernel with strictly positive entries, there is an \(n(n-1)\)-dimensional family of different kernels with this property. The result is unchanged if we consider only rewards having a unique optimal action at every state. We then compare this with rewards of the forms \(r(s)\) and \(r(s,a,s')\). Rewards that depend on the next state can usually recover the transition kernel itself: every row at a state with at least two actions is determined, and we describe exactly when a row at a state with one action can remain hidden. State rewards reveal less: two kernels give the same optimal actions exactly when every deterministic policy is optimal for the same set of rewards. The results show how the form of the reward affects what can be learned about the dynamics from optimal actions alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在折扣马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）中，仅凭最优动作（optimal actions）能否唯一恢复转移核（transition kernel）的问题。作者证明，对于状态-动作奖励，两个转移核在任意奖励下产生相同最优动作的充要条件是二者满足一个矩阵等式；在严格正转移核附近存在 n(n-1) 维的不可辨识族。文章还对比了依赖下一状态的奖励与仅依赖状态的奖励：前者通常能恢复转移核本身，后者信息更少。
Motivation: 逆问题研究关注从数值 Q 值恢复动态系统，而本文考虑更严格的设定：不观察数值 Q 值，只观察每个奖励下的最优动作。该问题关系到从行为数据中能学到多少环境动力学信息，对理解强化学习中的世界模型可辨识性有理论意义。
Method: 对于状态-动作奖励，推导两个转移核给出相同最优动作的等价条件，即存在可逆矩阵 L 满足 L1=1，使得两个核之间满足文中给出的矩阵关系；并分析严格正核附近的不可辨识族维度。随后分别分析奖励形式为 r(s) 和 r(s,a,s') 时的可辨识性，刻画了哪些行可被唯一确定、哪些行可能隐藏。
Result: 证明在状态-动作奖励下，两个转移核给出相同最优动作当且仅当满足矩阵等式；在严格正转移核附近存在 n(n-1) 维的互异核族。若仅考虑每个状态有唯一最优动作的奖励，结论不变。对于依赖下一状态的奖励，至少有两个动作的状态的每一行都能被确定，并精确描述了只有一个动作的状态的行何时可隐藏；对于状态奖励，等价条件是两个核使同一组奖励下的每个确定性策略都最优。
Conclusion: 摘要强调奖励的形式决定了从最优动作中能学到多少关于动态的信息：状态-动作奖励不足以唯一恢复转移核，依赖下一状态的奖励通常可以恢复，而状态奖励恢复能力最弱。

papers.title: EliSeg: Verified Target Construction for Report-Grounded Abnormality Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Radiology reports describe clinical observations but do not specify executable segmentation targets. They may contain present, negated, prior,uncertain, or irrelevant findings, while multiple valid abnormalities may coexist. Existing segmentation methods largely bypass this ambiguity by receiving a target identity or spatial prompt before inference, which acts as a hidden target oracle. We study report-grounded abnormality segmentation, where a model must determine target eligibility, cardinality, and finding-to-mask correspondence directly from an unfiltered report before delineating the corresponding regions. We propose \textbf{EliSeg}, an atcor--verify--revise framework that integrates target construction with mask generation. A grammar-constrained Actor proposes target slots and masks, an independent text-only Verifier reconstructs the eligible finding inventory, and Revision selectively re-executes the shared Actor when their target structures disagree. EliSeg requires no predefined target identity, finding prompt, point, or bounding box. Experiments on MIMIC-CXR-ILS show that EliSeg consistently outperforms direct segmentation methods and extract-then-segment cascades across findings, while effectively suppressing masks for ineligible report mentions. Ablation studies confirm the complementary roles of verification and revision, and evaluation on CheXlocalize demonstrates effective transfer of the EliSeg to an external dataset.Code is available at https://github.com/Maybach-dream/EliSeg.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EliSeg，一个用于报告引导异常分割 (report-grounded abnormality segmentation) 的 actor-verify-revise 框架，使模型能在没有任何目标身份、发现提示、点或边界框的情况下，直接从未过滤的放射报告中判定目标资格、数量以及发现与掩码的对应关系，再生成分割掩码。在 MIMIC-CXR-ILS 上，EliSeg 一致优于直接分割方法和提取后分割级联方法，并能有效抑制不合格报告提及所对应的掩码。
Motivation: 放射报告描述临床观察但并未给出可执行的、明确的分割目标，其中可能包含现存、否定、既往、不确定或无关的发现，且多个有效异常可以共存。现有分割方法大多在推理前接收目标身份或空间提示，等同于一个隐藏的目标 oracle，绕开了这种歧义。
Method: 提出 actor-verify-revise 框架：一个受语法约束的 Actor 提出目标槽位 (target slots) 与对应掩码；一个独立的纯文本 Verifier 重建合格的发现清单；当 Actor 与 Verifier 的目标结构不一致时，Revision 会选择性地重新执行共享的 Actor，从而把目标构造与掩码生成整合起来。
Result: 在 MIMIC-CXR-ILS 上的实验表明，EliSeg 一致优于直接分割方法和 extract-then-segment 级联方法，同时有效抑制不可纳入报告的提及对应的掩码；消融实验确认验证与修订的互补作用，CheXlocalize 上的评估显示该方法能有效迁移到外部数据集。
Conclusion: 摘要强调无需任何目标身份或空间提示即可从报告中直接构建分割目标，并说明验证与修订在框架中具有互补价值，且具备外部数据集上的迁移能力。代码已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FUSE: Feature-Wise Unified Specialization with Cross-Column Exchange for Mixed-Type Tabular Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Generating mixed-type tabular data requires jointly modeling diverse feature distributions and their complex cross-column dependencies. Variational flow matching handles distinct endpoints via factorized distributions, yet leaves feature-specific processing and cross-column interactions implicit within a shared backbone. We introduce Feature-wise Unified Specialization with cross-column Exchange (FUSE) to explicitly separate these roles. FUSE applies separate adaptive mixture modules to numerical and categorical features, allowing each feature to combine shared specialized subnetworks, while joint attention preserves information exchange across all columns. We also characterize the excess population risk from restricted conditioning contexts and bound the continuous Wasserstein generation error by endpoint-prediction risk. Comprehensive experiments on eight tabular datasets demonstrate that FUSE achieves strong and consistent performance across distributional fidelity and downstream utility metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FUSE（Feature-wise Unified Specialization with cross-column Exchange），用于混合类型表格数据生成。FUSE 将特征特定处理与跨列交互显式分离：对数值和类别特征分别使用自适应混合模块，并通过联合注意力保持所有列的信息交换；作者还给出了受限上下文下的超额总体风险刻画，以及用端点预测风险界定连续 Wasserstein 生成误差。在八个表格数据集上的实验表明，该方法在分布保真度和下游效用指标上表现强且一致。
Motivation: 现有变分流匹配（variational flow matching）通过因子化分布处理不同端点，但特征特定处理和跨列交互仍隐式地共用一个主干（shared backbone），缺乏显式分工，这限制了混合类型表格数据的生成质量。
Method: 引入 FUSE 架构：对数值和类别特征分别使用独立的自适应混合模块（adaptive mixture modules），使每个特征能够组合共享的专门子网络，同时用联合注意力（joint attention）机制保留所有列之间的信息交换。作者还从理论上刻画受限条件上下文下的超额总体风险，并以端点预测风险界定连续 Wasserstein 生成误差。
Result: 在八个表格数据集上的实验显示，FUSE 在分布保真度（distributional fidelity）和下游效用（downstream utility）指标上均取得强且一致的性能。
Conclusion: 摘要主张显式分离特征特定处理和跨列交互可以改进混合类型表格生成，并提供相应的理论误差界作为支撑。

papers.title: Foundation Models Adaptation for Multi-View Multi-modal Cardiac MRI Segmentation and Direct Ejection Fraction Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models have shown strong transferability in cardiac MRI (CMR), but their effectiveness for heterogeneous multi-view and multi-sequence CMR analysis remains unclear. In this work, we explore the effectiveness of fine-tuning and combining different CMR foundation models for the Universal Multi-Sequence, Multi-Center and Multi-View CMR Segmentation (CMR-Multi) Challenge. CineMA was fine-tuned for cine and late gadolinium enhancement (LGE) segmentation across short-axis and long-axis views. For direct left-ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) estimation, we used two recent frozen CMR foundation models to extract embedding vectors that were then combined using attention-based multiple-instance learning for LVEF regression. In the challenge validation set, cine segmentation achieved Dice scores of 0.862, 0.883, and 0.902 for short-axis, two-chamber and four-chamber cine MRI, respectively. LGE segmentation achieved Dice scores between 0.621 and 0.846 across views. The direct LVEF regression model achieved an MAE of 4.96 percentage points and a Pearson correlation of 0.91. These results indicate that foundation models can be effectively adapted and combined for multi-view CMR analysis, while accurate LGE scar segmentation remains a challenging task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 CMR-Multi 挑战，探索如何微调和组合多种 CMR 基础模型（foundation models）来完成多视角多序列的心脏 MRI 分割与左室射血分数（LVEF）直接回归。作者微调 CineMA 用于 cine 和晚期钆增强（LGE）分割，并用两个冻结的 CMR 基础模型提取嵌入，再通过基于注意力的多实例学习（attention-based MIL）进行 LVEF 回归。验证集上 cine 分割在短轴、两腔和四腔视图的 Dice 分别为 0.862、0.883 和 0.902，LGE 分割 Dice 在 0.621 到 0.846 之间，LVEF 回归 MAE 为 4.96 个百分点、Pearson 相关系数为 0.91。
Motivation: 基础模型在心脏 MRI 中表现出强迁移能力，但其在异质多视角、多序列 CMR 分析中的有效性仍不明确，本文通过 CMR-Multi 这一统一多序列、多中心、多视角分割挑战来考察这一问题。
Method: 针对 cine 和 LGE 分割，微调 CineMA 并覆盖短轴与长轴视图；针对 LVEF 直接估计，使用两个近期发布的冻结 CMR 基础模型提取嵌入向量，再用基于注意力的多实例学习（attention-based multiple-instance learning）将这些向量组合后进行回归。
Result: 挑战验证集上，cine 分割在短轴、两腔和四腔视图的 Dice 分别为 0.862、0.883 和 0.902；LGE 分割 Dice 在不同视图间为 0.621 至 0.846；直接 LVEF 回归的 MAE 为 4.96 个百分点，Pearson 相关系数为 0.91。
Conclusion: 结果表明基础模型可以被有效微调并组合用于多视角 CMR 分析，但准确的 LGE 瘢痕分割仍是一项具有挑战性的任务。

papers.title: A foundation-model approach to pediatric headache classification from rs-fMRI
papers.abstract_en: Headache is the most common neurological disorder in children and substantially affects quality of life. We investigated whether resting-state functional MRI (rs-fMRI) can support pediatric headache classification using machine learning. We encoded rs-fMRI data using NeuroSTORM, a recent foundation model, and fine-tuned it to distinguish healthy controls from children with headache and subsequently classify headache subtypes. We compared NeuroSTORM with a standard neuroscience approach using functional-connectivity (FC) matrices derived from brain activity as predictors. Using 189 rs-fMRI scans from 110 individuals collected across two visits (prevalence of any headache: 74%), NeuroSTORM achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.82 (95% CI, 0.82-0.82) and an area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC) of 0.93 (95% CI, 0.93-0.94) for discriminating headache from non-headache. In contrast, models trained on FC matrices showed lower performance (AUROC, 0.67 [95% CI, 0.67-0.67]; AUPRC, 0.85 [95% CI, 0.85-0.85]). In multiclass classification of healthy controls, chronic migraine, and non-chronic headaches (e.g., post-viral headache, new daily persistent headache, post-traumatic headache), NeuroSTORM achieved a macro-AUROC of 0.69 (95% CI, 0.68-0.69). Results suggest that the approach can distinguish chronic migraine but has difficulty differentiating other headache subtypes from chronic migraine. Overall, under limited-data conditions, NeuroSTORM appears to capture latent rs-fMRI representations that transfer to headache-related tasks without relying on FC features. These findings provide proof of concept for fMRI-based prediction of pediatric headache and highlight potential future utility for subtype identification and individualized treatment strategies.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 6 figures. In Proceedings of Machine Learning Research, Volume 340, 2026 (Machine Learning for Healthcare Conference)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究rs-fMRI是否可用于儿童头痛分类，采用NeuroSTORM基础模型对rs-fMRI数据进行编码并微调，区分健康对照与头痛儿童及头痛亚型。基于189次扫描（110人两次就诊，头痛患病率74%），NeuroSTORM区分头痛与非头痛的AUROC为0.82（95% CI 0.82-0.82），AUPRC为0.93（95% CI 0.93-0.94），优于基于功能连接（FC）矩阵的模型。多分类任务中宏AUROC为0.69，模型能区分慢性偏头痛但难以区分其他头痛亚型。
Motivation: 头痛是儿童最常见的神经系统疾病，显著影响生活质量，但基于影像的客观分类方法尚不充分。作者希望验证rs-fMRI是否能在机器学习支持下实现儿童头痛分类，为亚型识别和个体化治疗提供依据。
Method: 使用近期基础模型NeuroSTORM对rs-fMRI数据进行编码并微调，以区分健康儿童与头痛儿童，进而分类头痛亚型；并与传统神经科学方法（基于脑活动导出的功能连接矩阵作为预测变量）进行比较。实验数据为189次rs-fMRI扫描，来自110名个体、两次就诊。
Result: NeuroSTORM在头痛与非头痛分类上AUROC为0.82（95% CI 0.82-0.82）、AUPRC为0.93（95% CI 0.93-0.94）；FC矩阵模型性能较低（AUROC 0.67，95% CI 0.67-0.67；AUPRC 0.85，95% CI 0.85-0.85）。多分类（健康对照、慢性偏头痛、非慢性头痛）的macro-AUROC为0.69（95% CI 0.68-0.69），表明模型可区分慢性偏头痛但难以区分其他头痛亚型。
Conclusion: 在数据有限的条件下，NeuroSTORM无需依赖FC特征即可捕捉可迁移至头痛相关任务的潜在rs-fMRI表示。该结果为基于fMRI预测儿童头痛提供概念验证，并提示其在亚型识别与个体化治疗策略上的潜在价值。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: How Much AI Is in This Track? Quantifying the Proportion of AI-Generated Stems in Hybrid Music Mixtures
papers.abstract_en: AI-generated music is increasingly used at the stem level, with producers integrating synthetic drums, basslines, or vocals alongside human-performed instruments. However, current AI music detection systems are binary, treating tracks as either fully AI or fully human. In this paper, we reformulate AI music detection as a regression problem on a continuous AI energy ratio, alpha in [0, 1]. We propose a methodology that leverages a multi-track music dataset to assemble mixtures of human-performed and AI-reconstructed stems (obtained using a neural audio codec) with known proportions of each content type. Using this approach, we first show that a CNN-based model trained on fully AI-generated or human-performed tracks, which achieves >99% accuracy as a binary detector, when faced with mixed content, yields an output that rises with the AI stems' energy contribution, acting as a noisy and miscalibrated estimator. Our analysis of the influence of different stems shows that detection sensitivity depends on the instrument and reflects its frequency content: drums and guitar carry strong codec-artifact signatures, while vocals and bass are less detectable. Based on these insights, we train a similar CNN-based model for regression of alpha, achieving MAE = 0.076 and R^2 = 0.85 on held-out mixtures from the same pipeline. These results suggest that the regression formulation is an initial promising step towards AI-music detection in realistic music production workflows.
papers.comment: Accepted at International Society for Music Information Retrieval Conference (ISMIR 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把 AI 音乐检测从二元分类重构为对连续 AI 能量比例 alpha（取值 [0,1]）的回归问题。作者利用多轨音乐数据集，用神经音频编解码器 (neural audio codec) 重建 AI 分轨，并按已知比例组装人类演奏与 AI 重建分轨的混合内容。实验显示，在完全 AI 或人类曲目上训练出的二分类 CNN 面对混合内容时输出随 AI 分轨能量贡献上升但缺乏校准；同类 CNN 回归模型在相同流程的留出混合数据上达到 MAE=0.076、R^2=0.85。
Motivation: 现有 AI 音乐检测系统是二元的，仅能把曲目判为完全 AI 或完全人类，但实际制作中制作人经常把合成鼓、贝斯或人声与人类演奏的乐器混合，二元检测无法刻画这种混合程度。
Method: 将 AI 音乐检测公式化为对连续 AI 能量比例 alpha 的回归问题；基于多轨数据集组装已知比例的人类演奏与 AI 重建分轨混合内容，并分析不同乐器分轨对检测灵敏度的影响，据此训练 CNN 模型估计 alpha。
Result: 在完全 AI 或人类曲目上训练的二分类 CNN 精度超过 99%，但面对混合内容时输出随 AI 分轨能量贡献上升，且噪声大、校准差；分轨分析表明鼓和吉他携带较强 codec 伪影因而更易检测，人声和贝斯更难检测；回归模型在留出混合数据上取得 MAE=0.076 和 R^2=0.85。
Conclusion: 摘要认为回归式表述是向真实音乐制作流程中 AI 音乐检测迈出的初步且有前景的一步；其评估限于来自同一组装管道的留出混合物。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Gaze Behavior in Visual World Experiments Can be Modeled With Off-the-shelf Language-Vision Encoders
papers.abstract_en: The recent advances in neural language models have also spurred much work in computational psycholinguistics, asking whether neural LMs are also promising models of human language processing. However, work has been overwhelmingly focused on the unimodal case of written or spoken language. In contrast, multimodal experimental paradigms, like visual world studies that present participants with both visual and linguistic input simultaneously, have been neglected. In this paper, we present a novel approach that predicts gaze behavior in visual world studies. It does so by combining a simple multi-modal bi-encoder model of the CLIP family with a bimodal attribution method. We demonstrate the ability of this approach to robustly replicate the results of a seminal English visual world study which shows hu- man predictive processing. Remarkably, it does so without a generative architecture and without the need for fine-tuning, despite not being trained for this task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用现成的 CLIP 族多模态双编码器（bi-encoder）结合双模态归因方法，来预测视觉世界实验（visual world studies）中的注视行为。作者展示了该方法能复现一项经典英语视觉世界研究中的人类预测加工（predictive processing）结果，并且不需要生成式架构、不需要微调，尽管模型并非为该任务训练。
Motivation: 计算心理语言学中神经语言模型研究多集中于单模态书面或口语语言，而视觉与语言同时呈现的多模态实验范式（如视觉世界研究）一直被忽视。作者认为需要一种能利用现成多模态编码器来建模此类实验中注视行为的方法。
Method: 采用 CLIP 家族的简单多模态双编码器模型，并配以双模态归因方法（bimodal attribution method），将视觉与语言输入的联合表征用于预测注视行为；整个流程不使用生成式架构，也不针对任务进行微调。
Result: 摘要报告该方法能够稳健地复现一项具有开创性的英语视觉世界研究结果，该结果体现了人类的预测加工能力；且这一复现是在无需微调和无需生成式架构的条件下实现的。
Conclusion: 摘要强调现成的语言-视觉编码器（off-the-shelf language-vision encoders）足以预测视觉世界实验中的注视行为，提示多模态编码器可成为计算心理语言学中多模态理解的简单基线。
Relevance: 0
