papers.title: High-dimensional ridgeless least squares interpolation under spiked covariance structures
papers.abstract_en: This paper investigates the asymptotic behavior of the out-of-sample prediction risk of the high-dimensional ridgeless least-squares estimator when the feature dimension $p$ and the sample size $n$ grow proportionally. We consider a generalized spiked population covariance model with multiple latent factors, where the number of spiked eigenvalues may remain finite or increase with $n$, and the spiked eigenvalues may be bounded or diverge at arbitrary rates. Beyond characterizing the impact of covariance spectra, we reveal a new mechanism underlying benign overfitting: the prediction behavior of ridgeless interpolation is fundamentally governed by the alignment between the regression coefficient $\boldsymbolβ$ and the spiked eigenspaces of the population covariance matrix. In particular, we show that the signal energy distributed along latent spike directions determines whether interpolation leads to benign, tempered, or catastrophic overfitting. Our theoretical framework establishes sharp prediction risk limits under minimal moment conditions, requiring only finite fourth moments rather than Gaussianity. We characterize how the number, strength, and geometric structure of the spikes jointly influence the double-descent phenomenon. These results provide a unified understanding of when latent covariance structures facilitate or hinder generalization in overparameterized regression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究特征维数 p 与样本量 n 同阶增长时，无岭正则最小二乘插值 (ridgeless least squares interpolation) 的样本外预测风险渐近行为。作者在广义 spike 协方差模型下证明，插值是否产生良性、温和或灾难性过拟合，根本上由回归系数 β 与 spike 特征空间的对齐程度决定。理论结果在仅需四阶矩等最小矩条件下给出预测风险的精确极限，并刻画 spike 的数量、强度与几何结构如何共同影响 double-descent 现象。
Motivation: 现有对高维过参数化回归中良性过拟合 (benign overfitting) 的理解大多依赖简单的协方差结构假设，而现实中潜在因子结构可能复杂得多，如 spike 特征值数量随 n 增长或特征值以任意速率发散。本文试图在广义 spike 协方差模型下统一刻画这些因素对泛化性能的影响，填补对回归系数方向与协方差特征空间对齐这一机制的缺失理解。
Method: 作者采用渐近理论分析框架，构建广义 spike 总体协方差模型，允许潜在因子数量有限或随 n 增长、spike 特征值有界或任意速率发散，并在此设定下推导 ridgeless 最小二乘估计器样本外预测风险的极限表达式。理论分析仅假设有限四阶矩而非高斯性，属于最小矩条件下的精确渐近研究。
Result: 摘要报告得到预测风险的精确极限，并揭示预测行为由信号能量沿 spike 方向（即 β 与 spike 特征空间的对齐程度）决定，据此区分良性、温和与灾难性过拟合。此外，结果刻画了 spike 的数量、强度和几何结构对 double-descent 现象的影响，给出一个统一的理论框架。
Conclusion: 作者强调这些结果提供了关于潜在协方差结构何时促进或阻碍过参数化回归泛化的统一理解，适用于高维统计学习中对 latent covariance 结构影响的理论分析。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Finite E-Group of Nilpotency Class Three
papers.abstract_en: A group is an E-group if every element commutes with each of its endomorphic images. Caranti asked whether a finite E-group can have nilpotency class three. We prove that the $3$-group of order $3^{84}$ introduced by Abdollahi, Faghihi, and Mohammadi Hassanabadi, and later shown by Abdollahi, Faghihi, Linton, and O'Brien to have the corresponding automorphism property, is an E-group. Let $P$ denote this group and put $V=P/Φ(P)\cong \mathbb{F}_3^9$. The nine power relations of $P$ determine a linear map $q:V\longrightarrowΛ^2 V$. We prove that $q$ has no nonzero proper subspace $U$ satisfying $q(U)\subseteqΛ^2 U$. Since the image induced by any endomorphism of $P$ on $V$ has precisely this closure property, every endomorphism acts on $V$ either invertibly or trivially. The invertible case is the known A-group case. In the trivial case the image first lies in $Φ(P)=P'$, and the power relations then force it into $Ω_1(P')=Z(P)$. Thus every element commutes with every endomorphic image. The tensor rigidity is reduced to an exact finite calculation on the $9841$ points of $\mathrm{PG}(8,3)$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明了 Abdollahi、Faghihi 和 Mohammadi Hassanabadi 引入的 3^84 阶 3-群是一个 E-group（每个元素与其所有自同态像交换的群），从而肯定地回答了 Caranti 关于有限 E-group 是否可以达到幂零类三的问题。证明把该群的九个幂关系表示为线性映射 q:V→Λ^2V（其中 V=P/Φ(P)≅F_3^9），并验证 q 不存非零真子空间 U 满足 q(U)⊆Λ^2U。该张量刚性条件最终化为对 PG(8,3) 上 9841 个点的精确有限计算。
Motivation: Caranti 提出公开问题：有限 E-group 的幂零类能否为三。此前已知该 3^84 阶群具有对应的自同构性质（A-group 情形），但需要证明它也是 E-group，以回答该问题。
Method: 设 P 为该 3-群，V=P/Φ(P)≅F_3^9，九个幂关系定义线性映射 q:V→Λ^2V。作者证明 q 没有非零真子空间 U 满足 q(U)⊆Λ^2U；由于任何自同态在 V 上的像都具有该闭包性质，自同态在 V 上要么可逆要么平凡。可逆情形是已知的 A-group 情形；平凡情形下像先落入 Φ(P)=P'，再被幂关系迫使进入 Ω_1(P')=Z(P)。张量刚性的验证归结为对 PG(8,3) 上 9841 个点的有限计算。
Result: 摘要报告证明该 3^84 阶 3-群是 E-group，即每个元素与其每个自同态像交换，从而给出有限 E-group 幂零类为三的实例。核心结果是 q 缺乏满足 q(U)⊆Λ^2U 的非零真子空间，并通过 9841 个点的计算完成验证。
Conclusion: 该结果表明有限 E-group 的幂零类可以达到三，回答了 Caranti 的问题。证明依赖对 PG(8,3) 上有限点集的精确计算，属于构造性验证。

papers.title: TOFD: Target-Oriented Feature Decoupling against Poisoning Attacks in Split Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Split Federated Learning (SFL) facilitates privacy-preserving collaborative training with reduced client-side overhead. However, its split architecture introduces unique attack surfaces, rendering it vulnerable to diverse poisoning attacks. Most existing defenses fail to exploit the split paradigm, limiting their ability to detect and contain malicious behaviors at an early stage. To bridge this gap, we propose Target-Oriented Feature Decoupling (TOFD), a unified framework that jointly enables proactive detection and robust optimization against a wide range of poisoning attacks. TOFD operates in three stages: (1) Target Inference, which identifies potential attack targets by refining class-wise safe zones via class-specific Margin Perturbation (MP); (2) Sample Purification, which adaptively filters poisoned smashed data using thresholds calibrated through cross-class min-max normalization of MP; and (3) Decoupling Optimization, which leverages an adversarial guidance model to capture attack-induced patterns and decouple their influence during optimization, thereby suppressing residual adversarial effects. We provide theoretical guarantees for the convergence of TOFD. Extensive experiments on five datasets demonstrate that TOFD consistently outperforms state-of-the-art defenses under diverse attack scenarios, achieving superior robustness with low computational overhead suitable for practical deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Target-Oriented Feature Decoupling (TOFD)，一种针对分割联邦学习 (Split Federated Learning, SFL) 中多种投毒攻击的统一防御框架。TOFD 通过目标推断、样本净化解耦优化三个阶段，在利用分割架构特性的同时实现主动检测与鲁棒优化，并给出收敛性理论保证。在五个数据集上的实验表明，TOFD 在多种攻击场景下优于现有最先进防御，且计算开销较低。
Motivation: SFL 的分割架构引入了独特的攻击面，使其容易受到多种投毒攻击；而现有防御大多没有利用分割范式本身的特点，难以在早期阶段检测和遏制恶意行为。
Method: TOFD 包含三阶段流水线：目标推断阶段通过类特定的 Margin Perturbation (MP) 细化类级安全区域以识别潜在攻击目标；样本净化阶段利用 MP 的跨类 min-max 归一化校准阈值，自适应过滤被投毒的 smashed data；解耦优化阶段引入对抗引导模型捕获攻击诱导模式，并在优化过程中解耦其影响以抑制残余对抗效应。
Result: 在五个数据集上的大量实验表明，TOFD 在多样攻击场景下持续优于现有最先进的防御方法，兼具强鲁棒性和低计算开销，适合实际部署。
Conclusion: 作者为 TOFD 提供了收敛性理论保证，并强调其统一框架能够同时实现主动检测与鲁棒优化，且计算开销低。

papers.title: WNM-3D: A World Navigation Model with 3D Scene Conditioning for Closed-Loop VLN
papers.abstract_en: Recent vision-language navigation (VLN) systems increasingly adapt pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) into vision-language-action (VLA) policies that map egocentric observations and language instructions directly to navigation actions. Although semantically capable, such action-centric training does not explicitly model how the agent's visual observations should evolve under its predicted motion. Generative world-action models (WAMs) jointly predict future observations and actions, yet existing WAMs for continuous VLN do not condition joint future-view and action generation on geometry-aware representations inferred from the observed history. We present WNM-3D, a generative World Navigation Model with 3D scene conditioning for continuous VLN. To consolidate past observations into persistent scene context, a frozen feed-forward geometry encoder extracts geometry-aware representations from the monocular egocentric RGB history, and a trainable 3D Scene-to-Token Adapter converts them into a fixed-length prefix in the token space of the world-action Diffusion Transformer. Through block-causal attention, this prefix conditions every future video-action block, providing a shared geometric context for both future-view and action generation. We train WNM-3D through supervised world-action fine-tuning on A*-generated demonstrations, DAgger-style adaptation on policy-visited states, and DanceGRPO-based closed-loop policy optimization. Experiments on GN-Bench show that WNM-3D outperforms strong VLM-based navigation policies and its 2D-conditioned counterpart in closed-loop navigation. On a fixed near-goal evaluation set, WNM-3D also achieves higher flow-action consistency and lower visual-motion error.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WNM-3D，一个用于连续视觉语言导航（VLN）的生成式世界导航模型。它利用冻结的前馈几何编码器从单目 RGB 历史中提取几何感知表示，并通过可训练的 3D Scene-to-Token Adapter 将其转换为世界动作 Diffusion Transformer token 空间中的固定长度前缀，借助块因果注意力同时条件化未来视角与动作生成。模型经 A* 演示监督微调、DAgger 式适应和 DanceGRPO 闭环策略优化训练，在 GN-Bench 上超越强 VLM 导航策略及其 2D 条件版本。
Motivation: 现有 VLN 系统把预训练 VLM 适配为 VLA 策略，直接将观感和指令映射为动作，缺少对预测运动下视觉观察应如何演化的显式建模；而用于连续 VLN 的现有 WAM 也没有基于历史观测推断的几何感知表示来条件化未来视角和动作的联合生成。
Method: 冻结的前馈几何编码器从单目 egocentric RGB 历史提取几何感知表示，可训练的 3D Scene-to-Token Adapter 将其压缩为 token 空间中的固定长度前缀；通过块因果注意力，该前缀为每个未来视频-动作块提供共享几何上下文。训练采用 A* 演示上的监督世界-动作微调、策略访问状态上的 DAgger 式适应，以及 DanceGRPO 闭环策略优化。
Result: 在 GN-Bench 的闭环导航评测中，WNM-3D 优于强 VLM 导航策略及其 2D 条件化对应版本；在固定近目标评测集上，取得更高的 flow-action consistency 和更低的视觉-运动误差（visual-motion error）。
Conclusion: 作者认为，将几何感知的 3D 场景信息显式条件化到未来视角与动作的联合生成中，可以提升连续 VLN 的闭环导航表现。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: CANIS: Generation-Assisted 3D Canonicalization via an Image-Semantic Bridge
papers.abstract_en: Canonicalizing 3D object orientation is fundamental to 3D understanding and analysis. Existing approaches often rely on geometric cues, although 3D canonicalization ultimately requires a semantically meaningful orientation. To address this gap, we propose CANIS, a category-agnostic, generation-assisted framework that introduces the semantic orientation prior of a frozen image-to-3D generative model into 3D canonicalization, without canonicalization-specific training or category-specific templates. Specifically, CANIS first renders the input object from candidate viewpoints, selects an informative view, and generates a proxy in a canonical orientation. During generation, a sparse structural latent encoded from the input guides the proxy to preserve the geometry of an object. CANIS then uses the selected image as a semantic bridge between the input and the proxy. Image patches identify semantic regions on the proxy, and depth back-projection locates the corresponding regions on the input. The resulting semantic anchors constrain geometric matching, from which we estimate the rigid transformation that canonicalizes the input. Experiments on synthetic benchmarks validate CANIS and its key components, while qualitative results on partial observations and OmniObject3D suggest its applicability to incomplete and real-world scans. CANIS also improves downstream 3D classification, part segmentation, and dense correspondence under arbitrary rotations. Project page: https://kenkenzaii.github.io/Canis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CANIS，一个类别无关、生成辅助的 3D 规范化 (canonicalization) 框架，利用冻结的图像到 3D 生成模型的语义朝向先验，无需专门训练或类别模板。方法通过渲染候选视角、生成规范朝向的代理物体，并以图像补丁与深度反投影作为语义桥梁来估计刚体变换。实验在合成基准上验证有效性，并在部分观测与 OmniObject3D 上展示对不完整及真实扫描的适用性，同时改善下游分类、部件分割与稠密对应任务。
Motivation: 现有 3D 规范化方法主要依赖几何线索，但 3D 规范化最终需要语义上有意义的方向，这一语义线索缺口尚未被已有方法解决。
Method: CANIS 先将输入物体从候选视角渲染并选取信息量高的视图，再利用冻结的图像到 3D 生成模型生成规范朝向的代理物体；生成过程中，从输入编码的稀疏结构潜在码 (sparse structural latent) 引导代理保持几何。随后用所选图像作为输入与代理之间的语义桥：图像补丁定位代理上的语义区域，深度反投影 (depth back-projection) 定位输入上的对应区域，所得语义锚点约束几何匹配，从而估计使输入规范化的刚体变换。
Result: 合成基准上的实验验证了 CANIS 及其关键组件；部分观测和 OmniObject3D 上的定性结果说明其对不完整和真实扫描的适用性；在任意旋转下，CANIS 还提升了下游 3D 分类、部件分割和稠密对应 (dense correspondence) 的性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 CANIS 是类别无关且无需 canonicalization 特定训练或类别模板的框架，能够借助生成模型的语义先验处理不完整与真实世界扫描。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: SCALE: Scientific Concept Aggregation via LLMs and Embeddings for Fine-Grained Taxonomy Extension
papers.abstract_en: The increasing specialization of scientific research challenges existing classification systems, which provide effective representations of broad disciplines and research topics but often fail to capture the fine-grained conceptual structure of contemporary science. Author keywords offer greater specificity, but their fragmentation, redundancy, and terminological variability limit their use as stable units of knowledge organization. We introduce SCALE (Scientific Concept Aggregation via LLMs and Embeddings), a framework that extends the OpenAlex taxonomy with a new level of scientific Concepts below Topics. Rather than treating keywords as isolated descriptors, SCALE organizes semantically related terms into coherent and interpretable conceptual units and integrates them within the existing disciplinary hierarchy. The framework combines scientific text embeddings, large language models, and graph-based community detection to construct this additional layer at scale. The resulting taxonomy enables scientific literature to be read through an intermediate conceptual level between broad research topics and individual documents. This perspective provides a more detailed representation of how scientific knowledge is structured, specialized, and connected across disciplines. By transforming heterogeneous author terminology into reusable hierarchical units, SCALE offers a foundation for fine-grained scholarly classification, scientometric analysis, research monitoring, and future ontology development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SCALE（Scientific Concept Aggregation via LLMs and Embeddings）框架，用于扩展 OpenAlex 分类法，在 Topics 之下新增一层细粒度的 Scientific Concepts。该方法结合科学文本嵌入、大语言模型和图社区检测，将作者关键词聚合成连贯可解释的概念单元，并融入现有学科层级，使文献能在研究主题与单篇文档之间通过中间概念层级被解读。
Motivation: 现有科学分类系统能有效表示宽泛学科和研究主题，但难以捕捉当代科学中细粒度的概念结构；作者关键词虽更具特异性，却存在碎片化、冗余和术语变异问题，不适合作为稳定的知识组织单元。
Method: SCALE 结合科学文本嵌入、大语言模型（LLM）与基于图的社区检测，将语义相关的关键词组织为可解释的概念单元，并把这些单元整合进 OpenAlex 现有的学科层级中，从而在 Topics 之下构建一个新的 scalable 概念层。
Result: 摘要未报告量化实验数据，主要声称该框架能大规模构建这一附加分类层级，使科学文献可以通过介于宽泛研究主题与单篇文档之间的概念级视角被阅读，并更细致地表示知识的跨学科结构。
Conclusion: 通过把异构的作者术语转化为可复用的层级化概念单元，SCALE 为细粒度学术分类、科学计量分析、研究监测和未来本体开发提供了基础。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有科学分类系统能有效表示宽泛学科和研究主题，但难以捕捉当代科学中细粒度的概念结构；作者关键词虽更具特异性，却存在碎片化、冗余和术语变异问题，不适合作为稳定的知识组织单元。
summary_sections.method: SCALE 结合科学文本嵌入、大语言模型（LLM）与基于图的社区检测，将语义相关的关键词组织为可解释的概念单元，并把这些单元整合进 OpenAlex 现有的学科层级中，从而在 Topics 之下构建一个新的 scalable 概念层。
summary_sections.result: 摘要未报告量化实验数据，主要声称该框架能大规模构建这一附加分类层级，使科学文献可以通过介于宽泛研究主题与单篇文档之间的概念级视角被阅读，并更细致地表示知识的跨学科结构。
summary_sections.conclusion: 通过把异构的作者术语转化为可复用的层级化概念单元，SCALE 为细粒度学术分类、科学计量分析、研究监测和未来本体开发提供了基础。

papers.title: Reading Copom's Tone: A Weighted LLM Framework for Hawkish-Dovish Sentiment, Forward Guidance, and Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: This paper documents an applied natural-language-processing framework for measuring the tone of Brazilian Monetary Policy Committee (Copom) statements. The project is explicitly inspired by iSent, Itaú's Central Bank sentiment classifier, particularly its sentence-level division of official communication into hawkish, dovish, neutral, and out-of-context classes. The implementation extends that idea in three directions. First, an LLM identifies short hawkish and dovish expressions and assigns each a 0-to-1 intensity weight. Second, the document index combines sentence counts with document-specific average signal intensities, producing a bounded score from -1 to 1. Third, a separate full-document layer measures forward-guidance direction, guidance explicitness, uncertainty level, and change in uncertainty. The empirical sample is restricted to communications dated August 2016 or later and contains 80 statements and 1,498 classified sentences from August 31, 2016 through August 5, 2026. Across this sample, 33.3% of sentences are hawkish, 18.0% dovish, 42.1% neutral, and 6.5% out of context. The average document score is +0.107, while the most hawkish reading is +0.570 in August 2021. The latest statement, dated August 5, 2026, scores +0.232, with eight hawkish, two dovish, and nine neutral sentences. Its structural overlay is more nuanced: guidance is directionally ambiguous but partly explicit, while uncertainty is classified as central and higher than at the prior meeting. Tone and the guidance-direction score have a contemporaneous Pearson correlation of 0.719. These are descriptive outputs, not a validated forecast of Selic decisions or DI returns. The main contribution is therefore methodological: a transparent, incremental, auditable system that separates rhetorical tone from policy guidance and uncertainty.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于加权 LLM 的框架，用来量化巴西货币政策委员会 (Copom) 声明的鹰派-鸽派情绪，并受 Itaú 的 iSent 中央银行情绪分类器启发。框架在句子层面把官方沟通分为 hawkish、dovish、neutral 和 out-of-context 四类，并对每条鹰鸽表达赋予 0 到 1 的强度权重；文档指数综合句子计数与信号强度，得到 -1 到 1 的有界分数。样本包含 2016 年 8 月 31 日至 2026 年 8 月 5 日的 80 份声明和 1,498 个分类句子，其中 33.3% 为鹰派、18.0% 为鸽派、42.1% 为中性、6.5% 为无关句子。作者强调这是描述性输出，而非对 Selic 决策或 DI 收益的经过验证的预测。
Motivation: 现有中央银行沟通情绪衡量方法（如 iSent）提供句子级分类，但缺少对单个鹰鸽表达强度、前瞻指引方向和不确定性层面的系统度量。本文旨在构建一个透明、递增、可审计的框架，将修辞语气与政策指引及不确定性分开刻画。
Method: 在 iSent 思路基础上，框架在三个方向上扩展：第一，用 LLM 识别短小的鹰派和鸽派表述，并为每条赋予 0 到 1 的强度权重；第二，文档指数将句子计数与文档平均信号强度结合，形成 -1 到 1 的分数；第三，增加一个全文层，衡量前瞻指引方向、指引明确程度、不确定性水平及其变化。
Result: 样本中平均文档分数为 +0.107，最鹰派的读数出现在 2021 年 8 月（+0.570）。最近一份 2026 年 8 月 5 日声明的分数为 +0.232，包含 8 个鹰派、2 个鸽派和 9 个中性句子；其结构性信息显示指引方向模糊但部分明确，不确定性被归类为中央且高于上次会议。语气与指引方向分数的同期 Pearson 相关系数为 0.719。
Conclusion: 摘要明确说明这些是描述性输出，不是对 Selic 决策或 DI 收益的验证性预测；主要贡献是方法层面，即提供一个把修辞语气与政策指引和不确定性分离的透明、可审计系统。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence Can Match Domain Experts in Evidence Extraction and Critical Appraisal of Microbial Oncogenesis Research Publications
papers.abstract_en: Confirmed oncogenic microbes contribute significantly to cancer burden. Identifying novel microbial oncogenicity could yield strategies that will reduce disease burdens. However, relevant evidence is dispersed and infeasible for humans to comprehensively synthesize. LLMs may enable scalable, expert-level systematic evidence synthesis to identify microbe-cancer pairs; however, such capabilities have not yet been demonstrated. Domain experts were recruited to create a dataset to benchmark LLM performance (Gemini 2.5 Pro, Gemini 2.5 Flash, GPT-5, GPT-5 Nano) on 24 research papers using MMTV-LV and breast cancer as a case study. We devised a structured template for evidence extraction and appraisal, consisting of MCQ, Likert-scale, multi-select, and free-text question types (77 items across 24 papers). Agreement between (1) experts and (2) experts and each LLM was determined per question instance using novel metrics. LLMs were assessed by comparing inter-expert and expert-LLM agreement distributions to determine whether LLMs behaved as additional experts by increasing or maintaining inter-expert agreement. Free-text responses were further evaluated qualitatively. Across all question types, LLM responses aligned closely with experts, with GPT-5 and GPT-5 Nano achieving score distributions indistinguishable from experts. Gemini models behaved similarly but were significantly more lenient in applying microbial oncogenesis criteria. Hallucinations were rare. Methodological appraisal and identification of contradictions within full-texts were the most persistent LLM vulnerabilities. GPT-5 and GPT-5 Nano were indistinguishable from experts on structured domain research paper evaluation tasks. This supports use of LLMs for automated systematic evidence synthesis. However, methodological appraisal tasks and contradiction identification in full-texts remain weaknesses requiring strengthening.
papers.comment: Published in Frontiers in Cellular and Infection Microbiology, 45 pages, 14 figures
papers.journal_ref: Kokkas K, Wang H, Klein R, et al. (2026) Artificial intelligence can match domain experts in evidence extraction and critical appraisal of microbial oncogenesis research publications. Front. Cell. Infect. Microbiol. 16:1876326
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估大型语言模型（LLM）在微生物致癌研究文献中进行证据提取与批判性评价时能否达到领域专家水平。研究以MMTV-LV与乳腺癌为案例，基于24篇论文、77个问题项构建基准，比较Gemini 2.5 Pro/Flash、GPT-5、GPT-5 Nano与专家的回答一致性。结果显示GPT-5与GPT-5 Nano的得分分布与专家不可区分，Gemini模型表现类似但更宽松，幻觉罕见；方法学评价与全文矛盾识别是最持久的弱点。
Motivation: 确认的致癌微生物对癌症负担有显著贡献，但相关证据高度分散，人类难以全面综合。作者希望探索LLM能否实现可扩展的、专家级的系统证据综合，以识别微生物-癌症对，此前这类能力尚未被验证。
Method: 作者招募领域专家创建基准数据集，以MMTV-LV和乳腺癌为案例研究，对24篇研究论文设计结构化抽取与评价模板，包含单选题（MCQ）、Likert量表、多选和自由文本题型共77项。采用新提出的指标按问题实例计算专家间及专家-LLM一致性，并比较一致性分布以判断LLM是否表现得像额外专家；自由文本回答还进行了定性评估。
Result: 在所有题型上LLM回答与专家高度一致，其中GPT-5和GPT-5 Nano的得分分布与专家不可区分；Gemini模型表现相似，但在应用微生物致癌标准时明显更宽松。幻觉出现罕见；方法论评价和识别全文中的矛盾是LLM最持续的薄弱环节。
Conclusion: 在结构化领域研究论文评价任务上，GPT-5和GPT-5 Nano的表现与专家无法区分，支持将LLM用于自动化系统证据综合。但方法学评价任务和全文矛盾识别仍是需要加强的弱点。

papers.title: Establishing Boundary KKT Convergence of Mirror Descent through Reparameterization
papers.abstract_en: We prove that mirror descent converges to a KKT point for the nonconvex problem without excluding boundary limits. The result holds under verifiable conditions that jointly couple the objective, the Legendre kernel, and the feasible geometry. The key ingredient to establish the convergence is a metric-flattening reparameterization \(S\) that admits a definable boundary extension. Applying the KL argument to the reparameterized objective yields convergence of \(S(x_k)\). Continuity of \(S^{-1}\) then recovers convergence to the KKT point of the original sequence. We further apply our general framework to some concrete examples: Shannon entropy, Fermi--Dirac entropy, and power kernels. Future work may consider more general constraint geometries and genuinely nonseparable kernels, and extend mirror descent to broader Bregman-type methods, e.g. Bregman proximal point algorithms and Bregman ADMM, and their inexact variants.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明镜像下降 (mirror descent) 在非凸问题中无需排除边界极限即可收敛到 KKT 点。收敛性依赖于目标函数、Legendre 核与可行集几何之间可验证的联合条件，核心工具是一个具有可定义边界延拓的度量展平重参数化 S。作者将该一般框架应用于 Shannon 熵、Fermi–Dirac 熵和幂核等具体例子。
Motivation: 现有镜像下降在非凸约束问题中的收敛性分析通常需要排除边界极限，而边界现象在实际问题中无法回避；作者希望建立无需此类排除的 KKT 收敛定理。
Method: 引入度量展平重参数化 S，它允许可定义的 (definable) 边界延拓；对重参数化后的目标应用 Kurdyka–Łojasiewicz (KL) 论证得到 S(x_k) 的收敛，再利用 S^{-1} 的连续性恢复原序列到 KKT 点的收敛。
Result: 摘要未给出数值实验，主要结果是理论性质：在可验证条件下镜像下降收敛到非凸问题的 KKT 点，且不排除边界极限；并对 Shannon 熵、Fermi–Dirac 熵和幂核给出具体应用。
Conclusion: 作者指出未来工作可考虑更一般的约束几何与不可分离核，并将镜像下降推广到 Bregman 近端点算法、Bregman ADMM 及其非精确变体等更广泛的 Bregman 类方法。

papers.title: Recipes for Creativity: Iterative Generation and Evaluation in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Generative models are often evaluated through singular artifacts, whereas human creativity typically emerges through iterative generation, appraisal, and refinement. This pilot study examines whether iterative search improves LLM creativity by adapting FunSearch to recipe generation for the 2024 Pillsbury Bake-Off and evaluating outputs against human benchmarks using TTCT-based LLM evaluation. Across two experiments, we test iteration count, generator temperature, and in-loop selection-scorer model size. Results show that iterative generation-selection can produce recipes with creativity scores comparable to human benchmarks, but additional iterations alone do not improve creativity. The in-loop evaluator matters most: a smaller selection scorer yields significantly higher scores across most TTCT dimensions, while temperature has limited effects except for originality. These findings suggest that evaluator design is a first-order design variable in subjective creative search.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Short paper accepted at ICCC'26
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 17th International Conference on Computational Creativity (ICCC'26), Coimbra, Portugal, June 29-July 3, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一项关于大语言模型 (LLM) 创造性搜索的试点研究，将 FunSearch 的迭代生成-评估范式改造为食谱生成任务，用于 2024 Pillsbury Bake-Off，并采用基于 TTCT 的 LLM 评估与人类基准比较。两个实验考察了迭代次数、生成器温度以及循环内选择评分模型大小的影响，发现迭代生成-选择能产生与人类基准相当的创造力分数，但单纯增加迭代次数不会提升创造力；循环内评估器的设计才是影响最大的因素。
Motivation: 生成模型通常只通过单一产物被评估，而人类的创造力往往来自迭代生成、评价与改进的循环过程。论文针对这一差距，研究迭代搜索能否提升 LLM 的创造力表现。
Method: 将 FunSearch 的迭代搜索思路适用于食谱生成任务，在循环内使用选择评分器 (selection scorer) 对候选进行筛选，并用基于 TTCT 的 LLM 评估方法对照人类基准打分。两个实验分别改变迭代次数、生成器温度以及循环内评分模型的规模。
Result: 摘要报告迭代生成-选择可达到与人类基准相当的创造力分数；但额外迭代本身不提升创造力。较小的选择评分器在大多数 TTCT 维度上显著提高分数，温度仅在原创性 (originality) 维度有有限影响。
Conclusion: 作者认为在主观创造性搜索中，评估器设计是第一阶设计变量 (first-order design variable)，比迭代次数或生成温度更关键；同时本工作仅为食谱生成领域的试点研究。

summary_sections.method: 将 FunSearch 的迭代搜索思路适用于食谱生成任务，在循环内使用选择评分器 (selection scorer) 对候选进行筛选，并用基于 TTCT 的 LLM 评估方法对照人类基准打分。两个实验分别改变迭代次数、生成器温度以及循环内评分模型的规模。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告迭代生成-选择可达到与人类基准相当的创造力分数；但额外迭代本身不提升创造力。较小的选择评分器在大多数 TTCT 维度上显著提高分数，温度仅在原创性 (originality) 维度有有限影响。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为在主观创造性搜索中，评估器设计是第一阶设计变量 (first-order design variable)，比迭代次数或生成温度更关键；同时本工作仅为食谱生成领域的试点研究。

papers.title: From probability to causality in probabilistic logic programming
papers.abstract_en: Probabilistic logic programming is a formalism of statistical relational artificial intelligence that supports causal queries, including interventions from outside the system. When the structure of a probabilistic logic program is learned from data, however, only probabilistic information is used, and a single probability distribution may be compatible with several causal orders. This leads to ambiguity in interventional reasoning, raising the question of when the causal order is uniquely determined by the distribution. Exploiting the relationship between acyclic probabilistic logic programs and Bayesian networks, we derive conditions under which the probabilistic information encoded in a program determines a unique causal order. We also incorporate constraints arising from relational structure by taking into account prescribed sets of causal symmetries induced by the underlying relational vocabulary. The result is a method for verifying when a learned probabilistic logic program supports well-defined intervention semantics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究概率逻辑编程 (probabilistic logic programming) 中从概率信息到因果推断的过渡问题。作者指出，当从数据学习无环概率逻辑程序时，仅使用概率信息可能导致一个分布对应多个因果顺序，从而使干预推理产生歧义。利用无环概率逻辑程序与贝叶斯网络 (Bayesian networks) 的关系，论文推导了概率信息唯一确定因果顺序的条件，并结合由底层关系词汇引起的因果对称约束，给出一种验证所学程序是否支持良定义干预语义的方法。
Motivation: 学习的概率逻辑程序只利用概率信息，而单一概率分布可能兼容多种因果顺序，导致干预性因果查询出现歧义，因此需要刻画因果顺序何时能被分布唯一确定。
Method: 基于无环概率逻辑程序与贝叶斯网络的等价关系，推导概率信息确定唯一因果顺序的条件，并通过纳入由底层关系词汇诱导的预设因果对称集来处理关系结构约束，最终形成验证干预语义良定义性的方法。
Result: 摘要未报告数值实验，主要贡献是理论性的：给出概率信息决定唯一因果顺序的条件，并组合因果对称约束得到可用于验证的判据。
Conclusion: 作者认为该结果可用于验证从数据学到的概率逻辑程序是否具有良定义的干预语义，从而为统计关系 AI 中的因果推理提供基础。

papers.title: Learning Suffers More Than the Policy Class Under Partial Observability: A Closed-Form Analysis
papers.abstract_en: When a reinforcement learning agent cannot observe the full state, we usually blame its policies: it cannot see enough to represent a good one. We show that in a solvable case the bigger problem lies elsewhere. Even when a good policy is available and the agent's value function is expressive enough to describe it exactly, learning still ends up somewhere far worse. We study a partially observed linear-quadratic problem in which a standard actor-critic learner can be solved in closed form. At our default setting the best policy the agent can represent is already close to optimal, costing 10.4% more than the ideal controller that observes everything. Learning does not find it. The algorithm instead comes to rest at a policy that is 35% worse than the best one available to it, and we can say exactly where and why. The cause is a bias in what the critic learns rather than a limit on what the actor can express. Because the agent cannot attribute what it sees to the part of the state it cannot observe, the critic misreads that unexplained variation as sharp curvature in its own value estimates, and the actor follows that error away from the optimum. We derive closed-form expressions for the resulting policy, for its cost, and for the one design choice that removes the problem, which is how far the learner looks ahead before trusting its own value estimates. Deep reinforcement learning experiments follow these predictions closely. Notably, giving the agent memory of past observations does not help, while changing how far it looks ahead does.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究部分可观测条件下的强化学习问题，指出学习过程的偏差比策略类的表达能力限制更严重。作者在一个可闭式求解的部分可观测线性二次 (linear-quadratic) 问题中分析标准 actor-critic 学习器，发现即使存在可表达且接近最优的策略，学习仍会收敛到远差于该策略的结果。文章给出了最终策略、其代价以及一个关键设计选择（学习器在信任自身价值估计前的回看距离）的闭式表达式，并用深度强化学习实验验证了这些预测。
Motivation: 在部分可观测的强化学习中，人们通常把性能不佳归咎于策略类无法表达足够好的策略；本文试图说明，在可解情形下更大的问题在于学习过程本身，而不是策略的表达能力。
Method: 作者研究一个可闭式求解的部分可观测线性二次控制问题，在该设定下标准 actor-critic 学习器可以解析求解；他们推导出学习所得策略、其代价，以及能够消除该问题的唯一设计选择（即学习器在信任自身价值估计前回看多远）的闭式表达式，并用深度强化学习实验对照这些预测。
Result: 在默认设置下，智能体可表达的最佳策略已接近最优，代价仅比全观测理想控制器高 10.4%；但算法最终收敛到的策略比其可得最佳策略还差 35%。摘要还报告，给予智能体对过去观测的记忆并无帮助，而改变回看距离则有效；深度强化学习实验与这些理论预测高度吻合。
Conclusion: 作者认为性能损失的根源在于 critic 的学习偏差而非 actor 的表达限制：智能体无法把观测归因于不可观测的状态部分，导致 critic 将无法解释的变异误读为自身价值估计中的陡峭曲率，actor 随之偏离最优。改变回看距离这一设计选择可以消除问题，而记忆过去观测不能。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: Dual-Node NVIDIA DGX Spark over Tailscale: A Remote-Access Testbed for Distributed LLM Training and Cyber-Threat-Intelligence Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Compact AI systems make local language-model experimentation increasingly accessible, yet practical evidence for multi-node training on desktop-class accelerators remains limited. This report presents a proof-of-concept deployment of distributed NanoChat pretraining across two NVIDIA DGX Spark systems, each with a GB10 Grace Blackwell system-on-chip and 128 GB of unified memory, administered remotely over a Tailscale mesh VPN and connected for training by a dedicated 200 Gb/s QSFP56 direct fiber link. PyTorch torchrun, DDP, and NCCL were configured with one process per node, a depth-20 NanoChat model, a local batch size of 32 per node, and a 2,048-token context, giving a global batch of 131,072 tokens per step. The run sustained a step time of about 69.4 s (about 1,890 tokens/s), processing about 653 million tokens over four days. We document link configuration, container setup, interface binding, a step-zero evaluation bug that triggered NCCL timeouts, checkpointing, and troubleshooting lessons, as a reproducibility reference for small labs. We also built a cybersecurity fine-tuning dataset from 77 CISA advisories (338 training, 37 validation conversations) and ran a 17-question held-out evaluation comparing a baseline SFT checkpoint against a CTI-augmented checkpoint with an Ollama-hosted LLM judge. CTI-specific categories improved while general-knowledge categories regressed, for a small overall change from 2.06 to 2.29 on a 0-10 scale. The same cluster supports a 400-level AI course (CS 426) and a query engine for CompTIA Security+ POGIL activities in CBS 255, showing modest local infrastructure can serve both research and teaching. The study establishes feasibility rather than a scaling-efficiency claim, since single-node throughput used for comparison was estimated, not measured under matched conditions. Runbook and scripts are available (see Code Availability).
papers.comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Deployment runbook and code: https://github.com/viyer-research/dual-dgx-spark-tailscale-testbed
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告了一个在两台 NVIDIA DGX Spark（各含 GB10 Grace Blackwell SoC 与 128 GB 统一内存）上通过 Tailscale mesh VPN 远程管理、并以 200 Gb/s QSFP56 直连光纤互联的分布式 NanoChat 预训练概念验证。作者详细记录了链路配置、容器设置、接口绑定、一个触发 NCCL 超时的 step-zero 评估 bug、checkpointing 与排障经验，并构建了由 77 条 CISA 公告派生的网络安全微调数据集进行对比评估。研究明确将自身定位为可行性验证，而非扩展效率声明。
Motivation: 紧凑型 AI 系统让本地语言模型实验越来越容易，但桌面级加速器上的多节点训练仍然缺乏实际证据；小型实验室需要可复现的部署参考，以评估这类基础设施能否支撑分布式训练。
Method: 采用 PyTorch torchrun、DDP 与 NCCL 配置，每节点一个进程，使用 depth-20 NanoChat 模型、每节点局部 batch size 32、2,048 token 上下文，得到每步全局 131,072 tokens。此外从 77 条 CISA 公告构建了网络安全威胁情报（CTI）微调数据集（338 条训练、37 条验证对话），并用 Ollama 托管的 LLM 裁判对 17 个留出问题评估基线 SFT checkpoint 与 CTI 增强 checkpoint。
Result: 训练持续约四天，处理约 6.53 亿 tokens，稳定步时约 69.4 秒（约 1,890 tokens/s）。CTI 相关类别评分提升而通用知识类别出现回退，整体从 2.06 变为 2.29（0-10 分制）。作者指出用于对比的单节点吞吐是估算值，而非匹配条件下的实测值。
Conclusion: 该研究证明两节点 DGX Spark 集群可为分布式训练、课程教学（CS 426）和教学查询引擎提供可行的本地基础设施，但作者明确表示这是可行性验证而非扩展效率声明，单节点基线未经同等条件实测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Stochastic Autoregressive Learning
papers.abstract_en: Motivated by LLMs, which generate outputs by iteratively sampling from next-token distributions, we introduce a PAC-learning model for binary stochastic autoregressive learning. This generalizes the deterministic autoregressive learning framework of Joshi et al., COLT 2025. In our model, one fixed generator assigns a Bernoulli next-token distribution to every prompt string. Starting from an input prompt, a token is sampled and appended to the prompt; the same generator is then applied again to this expanded prompt; this procedure is repeated for $M$ steps. Three forms of supervision are considered: base one-step samples, chain-of-thought (CoT) samples that reveal full random trajectories of length $M$, and end-to-end (e2e) samples that reveal only the final token of length $M$ trajectories. For a generator class, we study the minimum number of samples $m_{base}(\varepsilon),m_{CoT}(\varepsilon), m_{e2e}(\varepsilon)$, resp., required to learn the one-step probabilities in the base model, and the final-token probability in the CoT and e2e models, under squared loss error~$\varepsilon$. We show that stochastic autoregressive learning fundamentally differs from the deterministic theory. At scale $\varepsilon$, there is no universal comparison between the three learning tasks: both $m_{CoT}/m_{base}$ and $m_{e2e}/m_{CoT}$ can be made simultaneously arbitrarily larger than $M/\varepsilon$, the natural analogue for the existing deterministic results. Nevertheless, after altering scales, for every class, CoT learning at scale $\varepsilon$ is upper-bounded by base learning at scale $\varepsilon/M^2$, whereas e2e learning at scale $\varepsilon$ is upper-bounded, up to logarithmic factors, by $(M/\varepsilon) m_{CoT}(Θ(\varepsilon))$. These dependencies and scales are essentially tight. We complement these bounds by studying dimension $d$ logistic functions in our model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对二元随机自回归学习的 PAC 学习模型，将 Joshi 等人 COLT 2025 的确定性自回归学习框架推广到生成器为每个提示字符串分配伯努利 next-token 分布的情形。作者研究了三种监督形式——base 一步样本、chain-of-thought (CoT) 完整轨迹样本和 end-to-end (e2e) 仅最终 token 样本——下的样本复杂度，并证明随机情形与确定性理论有本质差异，各学习任务之间的样本复杂度不存在普遍的简单比较关系。
Motivation: 大语言模型通过迭代地从 next-token 分布中采样来生成输出，但已有的自回归学习理论主要针对确定性生成器。该工作旨在建立随机自回归生成场景下的 PAC 学习样本复杂度理论，弥补这一空白。
Method: 在生成器类上定义三种监督模型：base 模型用一步样本学习 one-step 概率，CoT 和 e2e 模型用长度为 M 的轨迹样本学习最终 token 概率，误差均用平方损失衡量。作者给出所需最少样本数 m_base(ε)、m_CoT(ε)、m_e2e(ε) 的上下界，并分析了 M 与 ε 的尺度关系，还补充了维度为 d 的逻辑函数 (logistic functions) 在该模型下的分析。
Result: 摘要表明随机自回归学习与确定性理论根本不同：在尺度 ε 下，m_CoT/m_base 和 m_e2e/m_CoT 可以同时任意大于 M/ε，即不存在三类任务的普适比较；但改变尺度后，对任意类别，CoT 学习在 ε 尺度下可由 base 学习在 ε/M^2 尺度下上界控制，e2e 学习在 ε 尺度下至多差对数因子地被 (M/ε)·m_CoT(Θ(ε)) 上界控制，且这些依赖关系与尺度本质上是紧的。
Conclusion: 论文强调随机自回归学习中监督形式间的样本复杂度关系与确定性情形截然不同，并给出基本紧的上下界；其结论以理论保证为主，未涉及实验验证。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一种针对二元随机自回归学习的 PAC 学习模型，将 Joshi 等人 COLT 2025 的确定性自回归学习框架推广到生成器为每个提示字符串分配伯努利 next-token 分布的情形。作者研究了三种监督形式——base 一步样本、chain-of-thought (CoT) 完整轨迹样本和 end-to-end (e2e) 仅最终 token 样本——下的样本复杂度，并证明随机情形与确定性理论有本质差异，各学习任务之间的样本复杂度不存在普遍的简单比较关系。
summary_sections.motivation: 大语言模型通过迭代地从 next-token 分布中采样来生成输出，但已有的自回归学习理论主要针对确定性生成器。该工作旨在建立随机自回归生成场景下的 PAC 学习样本复杂度理论，弥补这一空白。
summary_sections.method: 在生成器类上定义三种监督模型：base 模型用一步样本学习 one-step 概率，CoT 和 e2e 模型用长度为 M 的轨迹样本学习最终 token 概率，误差均用平方损失衡量。作者给出所需最少样本数 m_base(ε)、m_CoT(ε)、m_e2e(ε) 的上下界，并分析了 M 与 ε 的尺度关系，还补充了维度为 d 的逻辑函数 (logistic functions) 在该模型下的分析。

papers.title: Beyond the Black Box: Interpretable Models of Human Randomisation Failures
papers.abstract_en: Mixed strategy equilibrium predicts i.i.d play: past actions should not help predict future decisions. Human players, however, systematically depart from this benchmark, and in O'Neill's zero sum card game, these departures can be predicted by black box sequence models such as LSTMs. This paper asks whether that predictive power can be achieved by transparent alternatives that also reveal the behavioural structure behind it. Using 84,060 decisions from 2,802 pairs, the analysis first benchmarks naive and behavioral models against interpretable machine learning and deep learning models, then evaluates the modified EWA specifications of prior work against these benchmarks and uses the LASSO diagnostics to motivate a further nested frequency tracking extension. The results show that repeat or avoid behavior, especially players' management of their own recent action histories, accounts for most of the interpretable and strategically exploitable signal, while frequency tracking adds little out of sample.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究人类随机化决策中偏离混合策略均衡的系统性模式，利用 O'Neill 零和纸牌游戏中 2,802 对玩家的 84,060 个决策，对比黑盒序列模型（如 LSTM）与可解释机器学习/深度学习模型，并评估先前工作的 modified EWA 规格及一个嵌套频率跟踪扩展。结果显示重复或回避行为，尤其是玩家对自身近期动作历史的管理，贡献了大部分可解释且可被策略利用的信号，而频率跟踪在样本外几乎没有增加预测力。
Motivation: 混合策略均衡预测 i.i.d. 行为，但人类玩家系统性偏离这一基准；此前 LSTM 等黑盒序列模型能预测 O'Neill 游戏中的这类偏离，却无法揭示背后的行为结构。作者希望检验透明可解释模型是否也能获得相当的预测能力，从而同时提供策略可利用信号和行为学洞察。
Method: 基于 84,060 个来自 2,802 对的决策，先对朴素模型和行为模型与可解释机器学习及深度学习模型进行基准比较，再评估先前工作中的 modified EWA（经验加权吸引力）规格，并利用 LASSO 诊断来推动提出嵌套的频率跟踪扩展。
Result: 摘要报告重复或回避行为，特别是玩家对自身近期动作历史的处理，解释了大部分可解释且策略可利用的信号；频率跟踪在样本外几乎没有增加预测力。
Conclusion: 作者认为可解释模型能够获得黑盒序列模型的主要预测能力，行为结构高度集中于玩家自身近期行动历史，而频率跟踪扩展的样本外增益很小，提示该方向的边际价值有限。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Toward a Causal Data Management Ecosystem for Decision Making and Agentic AI
papers.abstract_en: Modern AI is no longer a single model but an ecosystem: classical ML predictors, deep and multimodal models, large language models, and agents, each trained and tuned over different data sources and each producing outputs at scale that become inputs to the others. Operating such an ecosystem is fundamentally a data integration problem - the knowledge it depends on is fragmented across dozens of heterogeneous, independently governed sources that must be reconciled and continually maintained. Yet integration alone is not enough. The predictions these systems make are shaped by many interacting factors, and the events, decisions, and variables that drive an outcome are routinely entangled with the ones that merely accompany it; treated as a basis for action, such correlational signals invite confounded decisions. This becomes acute once agents act autonomously: to be trustworthy and reliable, an agent must anticipate the consequences of its actions, not merely extrapolate from what has co-occurred before. Causal reasoning is what closes this gap, distinguishing the drivers of an outcome from its correlates, and enabling prescriptive and counterfactual analysis over the ecosystem's data. We therefore argue that the integrated ecosystem needs an explicit causal layer, and we propose to build it as a shared, persistent, queryable Causal World System (CWS).
papers.comment: Accepted at ACM AI Leadership Summit 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场/架构论文，主张现代 AI 已从单一模型演变为多源数据、多模型与智能体共同构成的生态系统，其运作本质上是数据集成问题。作者认为仅靠关联信号会带来混杂决策风险，因此提出在生态系统之上构建一个显式、持久、可查询的因果层，即 Causal World System (CWS)，以支持行动后果预测与反事实分析。
Motivation: 现有 AI 生态系统的知识分散在数十个异构、独立治理的数据源中，需要持续对账与维护；同时模型输出中的关联信号常与真正的因果关系纠缠，若被直接用于决策会产生混杂偏差，在智能体自主行动时尤为危险。
Method: 提出为集成生态系统增加一个显式因果层，并将其构建为共享、持久、可查询的 Causal World System (CWS)，用于区分结果驱动因素与伴随因素，支持规定性分析与反事实分析。
Conclusion: 作者认为可信赖的自主智能体必须预估行动后果而非仅从历史共现外推，因此集成生态系统需要一个显式因果层，并以此论证 CWS 的愿景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Measuring Concept Content in Text from LLM Activations: ESG Evidence from Concept Vectors and Linear Probes
papers.abstract_en: Existing measures of how much a text is about a concept read the surface of the text: dictionary word shares, topic proportions, embedding similarities. They score the words a text uses, not the judgment a reader forms about it. Recent work has shown that a gap exists in what Large Language Models (LLMs) know internally versus what they express in their response. This paper asks whether that internal knowledge, read by monitoring the activations of frozen, out-of-the-box LLMs, can stand in for task-specific fine-tuning when measuring concept content, and which extraction method reads it best. We extract such measures via the Recursive Feature Machine (RFM) algorithm and via linear probing, and compare these against an embedding baseline, surface baselines, and the same model's own answer to the question. We demonstrate the approach on financial text, a domain studied extensively and served by established annotated resources, using a human-annotated Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) dataset. The best linear probe comes within 0.6 percentage points of a fine-tuned domain classifier's accuracy without any task-specific fine-tuning, and outscores the same model's own answer to the question in eleven of twelve comparisons, so the activations carry concept content the response does not report. The simple probe consistently beats the RFM concept vectors, which in turn provide what classification alone does not: a continuous score intended to reflect how strongly a concept is present in a text, whose validation awaits graded labels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨能否用冻结、开箱即用的 LLM 内部激活来度量文本对某个概念的内容含量，而不做任务特定微调，并以金融 ESG 文本上的概念向量与线性探针为实验场景。作者用 Recursive Feature Machine (RFM) 和线性探针提取度量，与嵌入基线、表层基线和同一模型对问题的直接回答比较，发现最佳线性探针可比微调分类器准确率只差 0.6 个百分点，并在十二组比较中十一次胜过模型自身的回答。
Motivation: 现有概念含量度量只读取文本表面，如词典词频、主题比例和嵌入相似度，无法反映读者形成的判断；而 LLM 内部知识与其表达之间存在差距，作者希望用冻结模型的激活填补这一差距并替代任务特定微调。
Method: 在冻结的现成 LLM 上，通过 Recursive Feature Machine 算法和线性探针从激活中提取概念含量度量，并与嵌入基线和多种表层基线对比，同时对比同一模型对问题给出的直接回答。实验使用人类标注的 ESG 金融文本数据集。
Result: 最佳线性探针在没有任务特定微调的情况下，准确率比微调领域分类器仅低 0.6 个百分点；在十二次比较中有十一次超过同一模型对问题的直接回答。RFM 概念向量虽不如简单探针，但提供分类无法给出的连续分数，用于反映概念在文本中的强度。
Conclusion: LLM 激活确实携带响应未报告的概念内容，线性探针是当前读取该内容的最有效方式；RFM 连续分数的有效性仍待有分级标签的数据来验证。

papers.title: Authoring and Management of Transparent Research Integrity Assessments of Randomised Clinical Trial Publications Using LLM-assisted Tools and Provenance Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Systematic reviews of Randomised Controlled Trials (RCTs) are routinely used as evidence for clinical care guidelines. Such evidence has to meet high research integrity standards to prevent low quality or false research outputs influencing the clinical care. However, assessing research integrity of published RCTs is a complex process requiring manual effort, and potentially resulting in diverse opinions of the human assessors. This paper describes INSPECT-AI, an LLM-based interactive tool that assists human reviewers with research integrity assessments of published RCTs based on the community approved INSPECT-SR framework, and the Research Integrity Provenance and Evidence ontology (RIPE-O) for documenting the provenance of the assessment process. In addition, we present the Research Integrity Provenance and Evidence knowledge graph (RIPE-KG), an initial set of 140 expert research integrity assessments of 95 RCT publications generated by INSPECT-AI and described using RIPE-O.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 INSPECT-AI，一个基于 LLM 的交互式工具，用于辅助人工审稿人对已发表的随机对照试验（RCT）论文进行研究诚信评估，评估依据社区认可的 INSPECT-SR 框架，并使用 Research Integrity Provenance and Evidence ontology (RIPE-O) 记录评估过程来源。作者还构建了对应的知识图谱 RIPE-KG，包含由 INSPECT-AI 生成并用 RIPE-O 描述的 140 项专家研究诚信评估，覆盖 95 篇 RCT 出版物。
Motivation: 系统评价中的 RCT 证据需要满足较高的研究诚信标准，以避免低质量或虚假研究影响临床指南；但对已发表 RCT 进行诚信评估耗时且依赖人工，不同评估者可能产生分歧。
Method: 提出 INSPECT-AI 工具，结合 LLM 辅助人工评审；评估过程依据 INSPECT-SR 框架，并通过 RIPE-O 本体对评估流程的来源（provenance）进行结构化记录，进而形成 RIPE-KG 知识图谱。
Result: 摘要报告初步构建了包含 140 项专家研究诚信评估、覆盖 95 篇 RCT 出版物的知识图谱数据集，这些评估由 INSPECT-AI 生成并使用 RIPE-O 描述。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了用 LLM 辅助工具配合 provenance 知识图谱来编写和管理透明、可追溯的研究诚信评估的可行性，当前内容属于初步数据集阶段。

papers.title: Flow-Corrected Shape Optimization: Taming Manifold Drift in High-Dimensional 3D Models
papers.abstract_en: Optimizing 3D shapes within the latent spaces of deep generative models is fundamental to computer assisted engineering, yet remains prone to a critical failure mode we term manifold drift: the tendency of gradient-based optimization to move latent vectors away from the manifold of valid shapes. This problem is exacerbated in state-of-the-art 3D shape generative models that operate in increasingly high-dimensional latent spaces where valid shapes occupy a vanishingly small fraction of the full space. Existing mitigation strategies, including latent regularization and flow-matching approaches, either sacrifice expressiveness, demand a difficult trade-off between objective guidance and generative fidelity that remains prone to manifold drift, or are computationally infeasible to scale to modern, large-capacity 3D shape models. We introduce a novel optimizer-corrector framework that alternates between gradient steps for objective minimization and guided flow matching to drive the latent state back to the valid shape manifold. By decoupling objective minimization from flow-based correction, optimizing freely and correcting strictly, this alternating design avoids inherent trade-offs, preserving geometric validity without sacrificing expressiveness while remaining computationally feasible on modern 3D shape models. We demonstrate its effectiveness across generative priors of varying complexity, from simple vector latent spaces to large-scale architectures across a variety of downstream optimization tasks, including aerodynamic drag reduction and object compliance optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对深度生成模型潜在空间中三维形状优化时出现的流形漂移 (manifold drift) 问题，提出一种优化器-校正器 (optimizer-corrector) 交替框架：先做目标最小化的梯度步，再用引导式流匹配 (guided flow matching) 将潜在状态拉回有效形状流形。作者称该方法解耦了目标最小化与流形校正，在不牺牲表达力且计算可行的前提下保持几何有效性，并在从简单向量潜空间到大规模架构的多种生成先验及气动减阻、物体柔度优化等下游任务上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 在深度生成模型的高维潜在空间中优化三维形状时，基于梯度的优化容易使潜在向量偏离有效形状流形，即流形漂移；现代大容量三维生成模型的潜空间维度越高，有效形状所占比例越小，问题越严重。现有缓解手段如潜在正则化和流匹配方法要么牺牲表达力，要么需要在目标引导与生成保真度之间做困难权衡，要么难以扩展到大规模模型。
Method: 提出一个交替的优化器-校正器框架：在目标最小化的梯度步与引导式流匹配步骤之间交替执行，由流匹配负责把潜在状态拉回有效形状流形。该设计将目标优化与流形校正解耦，即“自由优化、严格校正”，以避免两者的固有权衡并保持计算可行性。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在复杂度不同的生成先验上均有效，适用范围从简单向量潜空间到大规模架构，并在多种下游优化任务（包括气动减阻和物体柔度优化）上展示出效果。摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 作者强调这种交替设计避免了对目标引导与生成保真度的妥协，在不牺牲表达力的前提下保持几何有效性，且可扩展到现代大规模三维形状模型。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: EMAS: Stabilizing Multi-Agent System Evolution through Evidence-Guided Revision
papers.abstract_en: Many methods for automated multi-agent system design optimize prompts and topologies during an initial design stage and then deploy the resulting system unchanged on subsequent samples. Experience from these samples is rarely consolidated into reusable system updates, while accuracy-oriented designs may incur high token costs. We introduce EMAS (Evolving Multi-Agent System), which uses this experience to revise MAS topology and prompts without updating LLM parameters, either to improve accuracy or to reduce cost. EMAS converts traces into structured diagnoses that specify a revision operation and target. It generates a candidate revision only when the same diagnosis recurs across samples and applies it only if paired validation against the current MAS meets the corresponding acceptance criterion. Across four benchmarks and two LLMs, EMAS attains the highest task-weighted overall accuracy for both backbones and is best or tied in six of eight model--benchmark settings. Within two evolution epochs, EMAS achieves relative gains of 6.30% and 20.10% in task-weighted accuracy on Kimi-K2-6 and Qwen3.6-27B, respectively. On MBPP with Qwen3.6-27B, EMAS raises accuracy from 55.09% to 89.12% while reducing token use per task by 62.2%. These results show that EMAS can turn experience from new samples into reusable updates to MAS topology and prompts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EMAS（Evolving Multi-Agent System），一种不更新 LLM 参数、利用运行经验来修订多智能体系统（MAS）拓扑与提示的方法。EMAS 将轨迹转换为结构化诊断，仅在相同诊断跨样本重复出现时生成候选修订，并通过配对验证决定是否应用。在四个基准和两个 LLM 上，EMAS 取得最高任务加权整体准确率，并显著降低 token 成本。
Motivation: 现有自动化多智能体系统设计方法通常在初始设计阶段优化提示和拓扑后即固定部署，很少把后续样本的经验整合为可复用的系统更新；同时只追求准确率的设计可能带来高昂 token 开销。
Method: EMAS 将交互轨迹转换为结构化诊断，指明所需的修订操作与目标；只有当相同诊断在多个样本中重复出现时才生成候选修订，并且仅在配对验证（paired validation）相对当前 MAS 满足对应接受标准时才应用修订，从而稳定地演进 MAS 的拓扑和提示。
Result: 在四个基准与两个 LLM 上，EMAS 在两个骨干模型上都取得最高任务加权整体准确率，并在八个模型-基准设置中最佳或持平六项。在两个演化 epoch 内，EMAS 在 Kimi-K2-6 和 Qwen3.6-27B 上分别带来 6.30% 和 20.10% 的任务加权准确率相对提升；在 Qwen3.6-27B 的 MBPP 上准确率从 55.09% 提升到 89.12%，同时每任务 token 使用减少 62.2%。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 EMAS 证明可以将新样本带来的经验转化为 MAS 拓扑和提示的可复用更新，实现在控制 token 成本的同时提升准确率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: An AI4AI Framework for Visual Token Pruning
papers.abstract_en: Visual-token pruning can substantially reduce the inference cost of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), yet existing methods largely rely on fixed, handcrafted heuristics and costly expert trial and error. As pruning objectives, budgets, and model architectures diversify, manually navigating the expanding design space becomes increasingly difficult. This paper aims to build an AI4AI framework for visual-token pruning by addressing a natural question: Can large language models automatically design effective visual-token reduction algorithms? Although LLMs possess broad algorithmic knowledge and strong reasoning capabilities, translating such general knowledge into effective solutions for a specialized task remains nontrivial. We argue that the key lies in designing an appropriate search-state representation that connects the internal knowledge of LLMs with the structural requirements and constraints of visual-token pruning. Based on this insight, we propose AutoPrune, a training-free framework for LLM-driven visual-token pruning policy design. At its core, AutoPrune introduces a Token Pruning Domain-Specific Language (TPDSL) comprising 131 reusable atoms for budget control, token scoring, selection constraints, and token reassembly. A key property of TPDSL is that it represents each search state as a residual modification of a strong base policy. This residual formulation narrows the search space and directs the LLM's attention toward the policy components that are most consequential for performance. Experiments on 14 multimodal benchmarks and three MLLM backbones demonstrate the effectiveness, efficiency, and transferability of AutoPrune. Even when removing 94.4% of visual tokens, AutoPrune preserves more than 99% of full-token performance while reducing FLOPs by 9.9x and prefill latency by 6.4x.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AutoPrune，一个由大语言模型驱动、无需训练的视觉 token 剪枝策略设计框架。其核心是 Token Pruning Domain-Specific Language (TPDSL)，包含 131 个可复用原子，并将每个搜索状态表示为对强基础策略的残差修改。实验在 14 个多模态基准和 3 个 MLLM 骨干上验证了有效性、效率和可迁移性。
Motivation: 现有视觉 token 剪枝方法多依赖固定手工启发式和昂贵的人工试错；随着剪枝目标、预算和模型架构的多样化，人工搜索设计空间越来越困难。作者提出让 LLM 自动设计剪枝算法的问题，并认为关键在于设计合适的搜索状态表示，以连接 LLM 内部知识与视觉 token 剪枝的结构要求和约束。
Method: AutoPrune 是一个训练免费框架，通过 TPDSL（131 个原子，涵盖预算控制、token 评分、选择约束和 token 重组）来描述策略；每个搜索状态被表示为对强基础策略的残差修改，从而缩小搜索空间并引导 LLM 关注对性能最关键的策略组件。
Result: 在 14 个多模态基准和 3 个 MLLM 骨干上的实验表明，即使移除 94.4% 的视觉 token，AutoPrune 仍保留超过 99% 的完整 token 性能，同时将 FLOPs 降低 9.9 倍、prefill 延迟降低 6.4 倍。
Conclusion: 作者认为恰当的搜索状态表示（如残差式 TPDSL）能让 LLM 利用通用算法知识自动设计有效的视觉 token 剪枝策略；该框架无需训练，且展示了跨骨干和基准的可迁移性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MAUPITI: On-Device Prototype-Based Learning on a Smart Infrared Sensor
papers.abstract_en: Low-resolution infrared (IR) array sensors represent an interesting solution for privacy-preserving human sensing in embedded systems. In this letter, we describe a smart multi-pixel IR sensor integrating a 16$\times$16 thermal MOSFET (TMOS) array and a RISC-V microcontroller extended with low-precision SIMD instructions, capable of on-device learning and continual adaptation for pose and gesture recognition tasks under tight memory and power constraints ($<$32kB on-chip memory, $\approx$1.5mW). To avoid the memory overheads of backpropagation and replay buffers, we adopt a prototype-based Nearest Class Mean (NCM) classifier in which a simple Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) encoder is trained and quantized offline, while class prototypes are stored and updated on the device in streaming mode. With experiments on two datasets, we show that this approach yields accuracy on par with a conventional classifier, with negligible latency overheads in both the classification and the prototype update ($<$0.29% considering both phases), effectively enabling online adaptation of the perception framework.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Embedded Systems Letters
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向隐私保护人体感知的智能多像素红外传感器方案，集成16×16热MOSFET (TMOS) 阵列与带低精度SIMD指令的RISC-V微控制器，可在低于32kB片上内存、约1.5mW功耗的严格约束下进行端上学习与持续适应，用于姿态和手势识别。为避免反向传播与重放缓冲区的内存开销，作者采用基于原型的最近类均值 (NCM) 分类器，CNN编码器离线训练并量化，类别原型在设备上以流式方式存储和更新。
Motivation: 低分辨率红外阵列传感器是嵌入式系统中隐私保护人体感知的有前景方案，但设备上学习和持续适应受限于极小的内存与功耗预算，传统反向传播和重放缓冲区开销过大。
Method: 设计智能传感器系统，采用原型式NCM分类器：CNN编码器离线训练并量化，设备端仅以流式方式存储和更新类原型，从而绕开反向传播和重放缓冲的内存需求；微控制器扩展低精度SIMD指令以支持端上计算。
Result: 在两个数据集上的实验表明，该方法精度与传统分类器相当，且分类和原型更新两阶段的延迟开销合计小于0.29%。
Conclusion: 该方案在低于32kB内存和约1.5mW功耗的约束下有效实现了感知框架的在线自适应，为资源受限嵌入式设备的持续学习提供了可行路径。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SetEasy: A Multi-Modal Classroom Engagement Assessment and Seating Optimization Framework
papers.abstract_en: SetEasy optimizes classroom engagement in fixed seating grids. It fuses multimodal sensing (wristband physiology, 4K video, environmental data) and trains a v-Gage model grounded in a revised ISEQ. Each week, two-week engagement forecasts are mapped to a student-seat utility matrix, and CP-SAT generates seating plans under visual-access and social-dynamics constraints. In a four-week deployment (23 students, 331 classes), v-Gage converged across affective, behavioral, cognitive, and overall dimensions, cutting RMSE from 0.75 to 0.53. Optimization raised mean engagement from 0.30 to 0.70, with over two-thirds of seats reaching high engagement and back-row low-activity patterns markedly reduced. These results show that, without hardware changes, interpretable, data-driven seating strategies can substantially enhance engagement. The multimodal "assessment + optimization" paradigm offers a transferable, sustainable path to culturally responsive, differentiated spatial design amid global homogenization.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Published in the Proceedings of ASCAAD 2025
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 13th International Conference of the Arab Society for Computation in Architecture, Art and Design (ASCAAD 2025), Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SetEasy，一个用于固定座位教室的多模态课堂参与度评估与座位优化框架。它融合腕带生理信号、4K 视频和环境数据，训练基于修订版 ISEQ 的 v-Gage 模型，并利用 CP-SAT 在视觉可达与社会动态约束下生成座位安排。在 23 名学生、331 节课的四周部署中，v-Gage 的 RMSE 从 0.75 降至 0.53，平均参与度从 0.30 提升至 0.70，超过三分之二的座位达到高参与度，后排低活动模式明显减少。
Motivation: 课堂参与度在固定座位布局中难以系统提升，现有方法缺乏可解释的数据驱动座位策略，且多模态感知与优化结合的方案尚不成熟。
Method: 融合腕带生理、4K 视频和环境数据等多模态感知，训练基于修订版 ISEQ 的 v-Gage 模型；每周将两周参与度预测映射为学生-座位效用矩阵，再由 CP-SAT 在视觉可达和社会动态约束下生成座位计划。
Result: 四周部署中 v-Gage 在情感、行为、认知和整体维度上收敛，RMSE 从 0.75 降至 0.53；座位优化将平均参与度从 0.30 提升至 0.70，超过三分之二的座位达到高参与度，后排低活动模式显著减少。
Conclusion: 作者认为无需硬件改动，可解释、数据驱动的座位策略即可显著增强课堂参与度，所提出的多模态“评估 + 优化”范式为应对全球课堂同质化提供了可迁移、可持续的差异化空间设计路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Conformal Fusion Under Missing Modalities
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal fusion architectures typically assume all modalities are available at inference, yet sensor failures, acquisition variability, and cost constraints routinely produce incomplete observations. Existing work treats modality absence as a prediction-accuracy problem, leaving a more basic question unanswered: whether a model's confidence estimates remain calibrated when an entire input stream is removed. We argue that missing-modality robustness and calibrated uncertainty are a single coupled property, and introduce Modality-Conditioned Conformal Fusion (MCCF), an architecture that addresses both at once. MCCF combines a multimodal bottleneck fusion backbone trained with modality dropout, per-modality evidential heads producing modality-decomposed Dirichlet distributions, and a Dempster-Shafer combination rule that fuses the per-modality evidence into a joint predictive distribution; an absent modality contributes vacuous evidence that is structurally ignored, so the fused uncertainty automatically reflects the reduced information without test-time imputation. A Mondrian conformal calibration module keyed on the modality-presence mask then provides finite-sample group-conditional coverage for every non-empty modality subset. MCCF is, to our knowledge, the first method with formal coverage guarantees under arbitrary modality availability through architectural integration rather than post-hoc recalibration, and the evidential decomposition yields per-modality vacuity scores that localise uncertainty to the absent modality responsible. Across a synthetic problem and three real multimodal benchmarks, MCCF holds its target coverage on every modality-presence subset, substantially narrows the coverage gap between full and partial modalities relative to a marginal split-conformal baseline, and imposes no measurable accuracy cost relative to temperature-scaled and evidential baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态融合在推理时模态缺失的问题，提出 Modality-Conditioned Conformal Fusion (MCCF)，将缺失模态鲁棒性与校准不确定性作为同一性质处理。MCCF 结合了训练时模态丢弃 (modality dropout) 的多模态瓶颈融合主干、逐模态证据头生成的 Dirichlet 分布、Dempster-Shafer 证据组合规则，以及以模态存在掩码为条件的 Mondrian 共形校准模块。作者声称这是首个通过架构集成而非事后重校准，在任意模态可用性下提供形式化覆盖保证的方法。
Motivation: 现有多模态融合通常假设推理时所有模态可用，而传感器故障和成本约束会造成观测不完整；已有工作把模态缺失仅当作预测精度问题，忽视了缺失整个输入流时模型置信度估计是否仍保持校准。作者认为缺失模态鲁棒性与校准不确定性是耦合的单一属性。
Method: MCCF 使用带模态丢弃训练的多模态瓶颈融合主干，配以逐模态证据头产生模态分解的 Dirichlet 分布，再通过 Dempster-Shafer 组合规则融合为联合预测分布；缺失模态贡献空证据 (vacuous evidence) 并被结构性忽略，无需测试时插补。一个以模态存在掩码为键的 Mondrian 共形校准模块为每个非空模态子集提供有限样本的组条件覆盖保证，且证据分解给出逐模态空泛分数 (vacuity scores) 以定位不确定性的来源。
Result: 在一个合成问题与三个真实多模态基准上，MCCF 在每个模态存在子集上维持目标覆盖率，与边际 split-conformal 基线相比大幅缩小了完整模态与部分模态之间的覆盖差距，并且相对于温度缩放和证据基线没有引入可测的精度损失。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法是通过架构集成而非事后重校准，首个在任意模态可用性下提供正式覆盖保证的方法；其逐模态证据分解可将不确定性定位到缺失的模态上。

papers.title: Momba: Network Modernization Improves Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in deep reinforcement learning (RL) have shown that improving neural network architectures can yield substantial gains in sample efficiency and asymptotic performance without altering the underlying algorithms. In contrast, work on multi-objective reinforcement learning (MORL), which aims to discover a set of policies that balance trade-offs among conflicting objectives, has predominantly focused on algorithmic innovations, leaving the area of architectures underexplored. While the optimal policies and value functions can differ significantly depending on the trade-offs, MORL algorithms commonly represent them with simple feedforward networks conditioned on the trade-off. This raises the question of whether the performance of the algorithms could be improved with more expressive function approximators. In this paper, we integrate recent advances in neural network design: (i) observation and feature normalization, (ii) weight normalization, and (iii) modeling of distributional returns with an entropy-regularized MORL algorithm. The empirical results across standard continuous control benchmarks demonstrate that these changes substantially improve the quality of the produced solution sets without requiring major changes to the underlying algorithm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多目标强化学习（MORL）中的网络架构改进，指出该领域此前主要关注算法创新而忽视了函数逼近器的表达能力。作者将观测/特征归一化、权重归一化以及分布回报建模（distributional returns）整合进一个熵正则化的 MORL 算法，并在标准连续控制基准上验证这些改动能在不改变底层算法的情况下显著提升所生成解集（solution sets）的质量。
Motivation: MORL 算法通常用简单的、以 trade-off 为条件的前馈网络来表示最优策略和价值函数，但不同权衡下最优策略与价值函数差异可能很大；更富有表达力的函数逼近器能否提升算法性能这一问题尚未被充分探索。
Method: 集成近年神经网络设计中的三项进展：观测与特征归一化（observation and feature normalization）、权重归一化（weight normalization）、以及用分布回报建模（distributional returns）替换点估计，并将其结合进一个熵正则化的 MORL 算法。
Result: 在标准连续控制基准上的实验显示，这些改动可以实质性地提高生成解集的质量，且无需对底层 MORL 算法做重大修改。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过现代化网络组件即可显著改善 MORL 解集质量，说明架构改进是 MORL 中一条有前景的、被低估的研究方向；该结论目前仅在连续控制基准上得到经验支持。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Representation-driven Endoscopic Visual Embedding Alignment for Latent Generation
authors: Rixta A.H. van Eijck van Heslinga
papers.abstract_en: Developing foundation generative models for endoscopy is limited by the gap between natural and clinical images and the computational cost of training large Diffusion Transformers. Although representation alignment has improved efficiency in general computer vision, its role within the highly specialized endoscopic image space remains unclear. We introduce REVEAL (Representation-driven Endoscopic Visual Embedding Alignment), the largest generative foundation model for endoscopy to date, trained on GastroNet-5M (GN-5M), a multicenter dataset of 5 million endoscopic frames. Instead of depending on out-of-domain priors, REVEAL employs encoders pretrained directly on the endoscopic distribution to align diffusion latents with domain-specific visual features, preserving fine textures and intricate anatomical structures. Beyond image generation, REVEAL also serves as a powerful feature extractor; in multiple benchmarks, it delivers performance that is competitive with, and in several cases exceeds, endoscopic foundation models such as EndoViT and Endo-FM, specifically tuned for classification tasks, while demonstrating strong representation robustness under realistic imaging corruptions. REVEAL produces high-fidelity images and maintains robust structural coherence in latent-space edits such as inpainting and outpainting. This high-capacity backbone lowers the computational threshold for building specialized clinical tools, offering an open, versatile foundation for conditional synthesis, segmentation, and out-of-distribution detection in future intelligent gastroenterology systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 REVEAL (Representation-driven Endoscopic Visual Embedding Alignment)，一个针对内窥镜图像的生成式基础模型，在包含 500 万帧的多中心数据集 GastroNet-5M (GN-5M) 上训练。与依赖域外先验不同，REVEAL 使用直接在内窥镜分布上预训练的编码器将扩散潜变量与领域特定视觉特征对齐，以保留精细纹理与解剖结构。除图像生成外，它还可作为特征提取器，在多个基准上与 EndoViT、Endo-FM 等内窥镜基础模型相当或更优，并在潜空间编辑（inpainting/outpainting）中保持结构一致性。
Motivation: 内窥镜基础生成模型的发展受限于自然图像与临床图像之间的分布差距，以及训练大规模 Diffusion Transformer 的高计算成本。表示对齐在通用计算机视觉中已提升效率，但其在高度专业化的内窥镜图像空间中的作用尚不明确。
Method: 提出 REVEAL，使用直接在内窥镜数据分布上预训练的编码器，将扩散潜变量与领域特定的视觉嵌入对齐，而不依赖域外先验，从而在生成过程中保留领域细节。
Result: 在 GastroNet-5M 上训练，声称是迄今为止最大的内窥镜生成基础模型；在多个分类基准上取得与 EndoViT 和 Endo-FM 相当甚至更高的性能，并在现实图像损坏下表现出较强的表示鲁棒性；生成高保真图像，且在 inpainting 与 outpainting 等潜空间编辑中保持结构连贯性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该高容量骨干降低了构建专用临床工具的计算门槛，为条件生成、分割和分布外检测提供了一个开放且通用的基础，面向未来智能消化内镜系统。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Agent Memory Distillation: Empowering Small LLM Agents with Hierarchical Teacher Memory
papers.abstract_en: Memory systems have shown promise for improving agent performance, but their potential remains largely unexplored for small language models, which struggle to generate sufficient successful trajectories on their own. We propose Agent Memory Distillation (AMD), a training-free framework that transfers structured knowledge from a large teacher agent to a small student agent through hierarchical memory. AMD constructs three complementary memory types from successful teacher trajectories: Workflow memory encodes task-level strategies, Subtask memory provides concrete behavioral examples at an intermediate granularity, and Function memory captures per-function calling conventions and common pitfalls. Workflow and Subtask memories are injected proactively at the start of each task, while Function memory is retrieved reactively upon tool-calling errors. We evaluate AMD on three tool-use benchmarks using four student models (4B-8B parameters) with GPT-5-mini as the teacher, achieving average accuracy gains of 27.2%p, 11.2%p, and 3.4%p on AppWorld, BFCL V3, and ToolSandbox, while consistently outperforming existing memory-based baselines. Further analysis shows that Subtask memory contributes the largest gains, teacher effectiveness depends on both teacher capability and student compatibility, and 4B-sized students benefit most from AMD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Agent Memory Distillation (AMD)，一种无需训练 (training-free) 的框架，用于将大型教师智能体的结构化知识通过层次化记忆迁移给小型 LLM 智能体。AMD 从教师成功轨迹构建三种互补记忆：工作流记忆 (Workflow memory)、子任务记忆 (Subtask memory) 与函数记忆 (Function memory)。在三个工具使用基准上，以 GPT-5-mini 为教师、四个 4B-8B 学生模型进行评估，平均准确率提升显著，并持续优于现有基于记忆的基线。
Motivation: 记忆系统已被证明能提升智能体性能，但其潜力在小语言模型上尚未充分探索，因为小模型难以自行生成足够数量的成功轨迹。本文旨在通过从教师智能体迁移结构化记忆，弥补小模型在工具使用任务中的经验不足。
Method: AMD 构建三种层次化记忆：Workflow memory 编码任务级策略，Subtask memory 提供中间粒度的具体行为示例，Function memory 捕获函数调用约定与常见陷阱。Workflow 与 Subtask 记忆在任务开始时主动注入，Function 记忆则在工具调用出错时被被动检索 (retrieved reactively)，整体为无需训练的迁移框架。
Result: 在 AppWorld、BFCL V3 和 ToolSandbox 三个工具使用基准上，AMD 平均准确率分别提升 27.2、11.2 和 3.4 个百分点，并一致优于现有基于记忆的基线。进一步分析显示 Subtask memory 贡献最大，教师有效性取决于教师能力与学生兼容性，4B 规模学生受益最多。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 AMD 能通过层次化教师记忆有效增强小模型智能体的工具使用能力，且收益与学生规模相关；该框架无需训练即可部署。

summary_sections.result: 在 AppWorld、BFCL V3 和 ToolSandbox 三个工具使用基准上，AMD 平均准确率分别提升 27.2、11.2 和 3.4 个百分点，并一致优于现有基于记忆的基线。进一步分析显示 Subtask memory 贡献最大，教师有效性取决于教师能力与学生兼容性，4B 规模学生受益最多。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要表明 AMD 能通过层次化教师记忆有效增强小模型智能体的工具使用能力，且收益与学生规模相关；该框架无需训练即可部署。

papers.title: NiyamAI - An Intent-Bound AI Agent with Cryptographically Verifiable Guardrails using Zero-Knowledge Proofs
papers.abstract_en: Giving an AI agent the ability to send emails, query databases, or execute commands is useful--until the agent is tricked into doing something it shouldn't. Prompt injection, hallucinated reasoning, and unsafe tool calls form the primary attack surface for autonomous LLM agents. Existing defenses rely on software checks like system prompts or policy filters running on the same machine the attacker targets, offering no verifiable proof of execution. We introduce Niyam-AI, a framework that makes safety enforcement provable. At session start, permitted tools and constraints are locked into an Intent Contract committed via SHA-256. Every tool call is intercepted and validated by an isolated Judge model; upon passing, a zk-SNARK proof is generated via EZKL. The tool executes only after proof verification, allowing third parties to confirm enforcement without accessing Judge model weights. Evaluating Niyam-AI on 2,000 real-world scenarios from Agent-SafetyBench against NeMo Guardrails, Meta's Llama Prompt Guard 2, and OpenAI's GPT-OSS-Safeguard using 5-fold stratified cross-validation yields an F1 score of 88.5% with a 1.1% false-positive rate (bootstrap 95% CI: [85.19%, 91.88%], N=1000). McNemar's exact paired test confirms significant improvement: Niyam-AI wins 390 discordant scenarios against NeMo (vs 20 losses), 115 against Prompt Guard 2 (vs 13), and 384 against GPT-OSS-Safeguard (vs 19) with p < 0.0001 in all cases. Proof generation adds 2260.6 +/- 218.4 ms per approved action, while verification takes 53.1 +/- 11.8 ms. Niyam-AI provides a guardrail that is both highly accurate and mathematically verifiable--though this reflects a classifier adapted to Agent-SafetyBench evaluated against zero-shot baselines, a distinction discussed in Section IV.C.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Niyam-AI，一个用零知识证明让 AI agent 的安全执行具备可验证性的框架。会话开始时将允许的工具和约束锁定为 Intent Contract 并用 SHA-256 提交；每次工具调用由隔离的 Judge 模型拦截验证，通过后经 EZKL 生成 zk-SNARK 证明，工具仅在证明验证后执行。在 Agent-SafetyBench 的 2000 个真实场景上取得 F1 88.5%、假阳性率 1.1%，并显著优于多个现有守卫基线。
Motivation: 自主 LLM agent 面临提示注入、幻觉推理和不安全工具调用等主要攻击面，而现有防御依赖系统提示或策略过滤器等运行在被攻击同一台机器上的软件检查，无法提供可验证的执行证明。
Method: 框架在会话开始将允许的工具和约束固化为 Intent Contract 并经 SHA-256 提交；每个工具调用被隔离的 Judge 模型拦截和验证，通过后由 EZKL 生成 zk-SNARK 证明，工具只在证明验证后执行，使第三方无需访问 Judge 模型权重即可确认安全约束确实被施加。
Result: 在 Agent-SafetyBench 的 2000 个真实场景上，采用 5 折分层交叉验证得到 F1 88.5%、假阳性率 1.1%（bootstrap 95% CI: [85.19%, 91.88%], N=1000）。McNemar 精确配对检验显示相较 NeMo Guardrails、Llama Prompt Guard 2 和 GPT-OSS-Safeguard 均显著更优（p<0.0001）。证明生成每个批准动作增加 2260.6±218.4 ms，验证耗时 53.1±11.8 ms。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 Niyam-AI 提供了一种既高准确又数学上可验证的 guardrail；同时明确这是针对 Agent-SafetyBench 适配的分类器，与零样本基线比较，该区别在 Section IV.C 中讨论。

papers.title: Estimating and Testing Kinks in Panel Data Models
papers.abstract_en: Many economic and financial relationships may change gradually rather than abruptly. We study panel data models in which the coefficient vector is continuous and piecewise linear in calendar time, with a finite number of unknown kink dates at which its slope changes. We propose a penalised least squares estimator that applies adaptive weighted group penalties to the second differences of the coefficient path, and develop asymptotic theory showing that it recovers both the number and the locations of the kinks with probability approaching one. To our knowledge, this is the first panel framework to estimate an unknown number of common kink dates in a time-varying coefficient path under fixed effects. We establish that endpoint slopes converge at the usual cubic regime-length rate and interior slopes at rates determined by their own and adjacent regime lengths. We also develop a coefficient-by-coefficient extension allowing individual regressors to kink at different dates. Monte Carlo evidence supports the good finite sample properties, and we illustrate the method through an application in macro-finance, specifically the relationship between debt and growth.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究面板数据模型中系数向量随时间连续分段线性的情形，即存在有限个未知的断裂点（kink dates），斜率在这些时点发生变化。作者提出一种对系数路径二阶差分施加自适应加权组惩罚的惩罚最小二乘估计量，并证明其能以趋近于1的概率恢复断裂点的数量和位置。据作者所述，这是首个在固定效应下估计时变系数路径中未知数量共同断裂点的面板框架。
Motivation: 许多经济与金融关系是逐渐变化而非突然变化，现有面板模型通常假设系数突变或平滑变化，缺乏对未知数量、共同断裂点的估计框架。作者希望填补这一空白，在固定效应面板中同时估计断裂点数量、位置及斜率。
Method: 提出惩罚最小二乘估计量，对系数路径的二阶差分施加自适应加权组惩罚（adaptive weighted group penalties），通过惩罚稀疏性来识别未知数量的断裂点；并给出端点斜率与内部斜率收敛率的渐近理论，还扩展了允许不同回归元在不同日期断裂的逐系数（coefficient-by-coefficient）版本。
Result: 渐近理论表明断裂点数量和位置能以概率趋近1被恢复；端点斜率以通常的三次方区间长度速率收敛，内部斜率收敛率由自身及相邻区间长度决定。蒙特卡洛证据支持良好的有限样本性质，并以债务与增长的宏观金融关系作为应用示例。
Conclusion: 摘要强调这是首个在固定效应下估计时变系数路径中未知数量共同断裂点的面板框架，并指出方法在估计断裂点与斜率方面具备理论保证和良好有限样本表现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fluid-DiT: Graph-Free Diffusion Transformers for Fluid Flow Simulations Learning
papers.abstract_en: Simulating complex fluid flows requires capturing full equilibrium distributions rather than just mean trajectories, yet high-fidelity solvers remain computationally prohibitive. Recent advances, such as Diffusion Graph Networks (DGNs), have combined diffusion models with graph neural networks to sample equilibrium states directly from unstructured meshes, enabling distributional accuracy even from short simulations. However, graph-based diffusion approaches suffer from hand-crafted architectural constraints, limited receptive fields in message passing, and costly multi-scale designs, which restrict scalability to larger and more complex domains. We propose Fluid-DiT, a Graph-Free Diffusion Transformer that replaces graph message passing with attention-based denoising, eliminating explicit graph design while preserving the ability to model distributions of chaotic flows. Our framework introduces a latent-space formulation that disentangles geometric fidelity from distributional learning, reducing high-frequency artifacts and accelerating sampling. By leveraging the transformer's global receptive field, Fluid-DiT naturally captures both local flow structures and long-range correlations without requiring hierarchical graph coarsening. On canonical benchmarks including laminar cylinder wakes, ellipse-flow systems, and turbulent 3D wing experiments, Fluid-DiT consistently outperforms graph-based diffusion baselines in both sample quality and distributional accuracy, achieving higher $R^2$ correlations and lower Wasserstein distances. Moreover, it generalizes robustly from short, incomplete trajectories to unseen Reynolds numbers and geometries, demonstrating strong scalability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Fluid-DiT，一种无图扩散 Transformer（Graph-Free Diffusion Transformer），用于流体流动模拟。它用基于注意力的去噪替代图消息传递，并引入隐空间公式把几何保真与分布学习解耦。在层流圆柱尾流、椭圆流系统和湍流三维机翼等基准上，Fluid-DiT 在样本质量和分布精度上均优于基于图的扩散基线，并可从短轨迹泛化到未见 Reynolds 数和几何。
Motivation: 基于图的扩散方法（如 Diffusion Graph Networks）能从非结构网格直接采样平衡态，但受限于手工设计的图结构、消息传递感受野有限以及昂贵的多尺度设计，难以扩展到更大更复杂的流体域。作者希望去掉显式图设计，同时保持对混沌流分布建模的能力。
Method: Fluid-DiT 用注意力机制去噪替代图消息传递，避免显式图构造；在隐空间中分离几何保真与分布学习，以减少高频伪影并加速采样；利用 Transformer 的全局感受野同时建模局部流动结构和长程相关，无需分层图粗化。
Result: 在层流圆柱尾流、椭圆流系统和湍流三维机翼等基准上，Fluid-DiT 一致优于基于图的扩散基线，取得更高的 R^2 相关性和更低的 Wasserstein 距离；摘要还报告其对短的不完整轨迹、未见 Reynolds 数和几何具有鲁棒泛化。
Conclusion: 摘要认为去除显式图设计并采用注意力与隐空间公式，能够在保持分布精度的同时提升流体模拟的可扩展性与泛化能力；摘要未提及具体局限性。

papers.title: Edge Sparsification via Temporal Forman-Ricci Curvature for Dynamic Graph Learning
papers.abstract_en: Temporal graph learning has become essential for analyzing real-world systems whose interactions continuously evolve over time, including financial transaction networks, communication systems, and online social platforms. However, learning from large-scale temporal graphs remains computationally challenging when networks are dense and rapidly changing. To address this limitation, we propose a network-curvature-inspired edge sparsification framework for dynamic graph learning. Our proposed method, TRicci, extends classical Forman-Ricci curvature to directed weighted temporal graphs by capturing structural support, temporal recency, and local interaction competition. Experiments on 9 transaction networks and 3 temporal graph benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed framework preserves predictive performance across multiple graph-level prediction tasks. The results show that TRicci sparsifies temporal graphs by approximately 80% while reducing end-to-end downstream training and inference time by an average of 55.94%, without substantial degradation in predictive performance. Our findings suggest that temporal curvature can serve as a principled basis for scalable temporal graph learning by preserving predictive temporal-structural information under substantial sparsification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于网络曲率的边稀疏化框架 TRicci，用于动态图学习。该方法将经典 Forman-Ricci 曲率扩展到有向加权时序图，利用结构支撑、时间近因和局部交互竞争来刻画边的重要性。实验在 9 个交易网络和 3 个时序图基准数据集上表明，该框架可将图稀疏化约 80%，同时将端到端下游训练与推理时间平均降低 55.94%，且预测性能无明显下降。
Motivation: 大规模时序图在稠密且快速变化时学习成本很高，现有方法难以在保持预测能力的同时降低计算负担，这是本文要解决的问题。
Method: 提出 TRicci 框架，将 Forman-Ricci 曲率推广到有向加权时序图，融合结构支撑、时间近因和局部交互竞争三类信息，据此对动态图的边进行稀疏化。
Result: 在 9 个交易网络和 3 个时序图基准数据集上进行图级预测任务，TRicci 可将图稀疏化约 80%，端到端训练与推理时间平均减少 55.94%，预测性能没有显著退化。
Conclusion: 作者认为时序曲率能够在大幅稀疏化的情况下保留有预测价值的时序结构信息，可作为可扩展时序图学习的原则性依据。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Capacity Confounds and Coverage Guarantees in Adaptive Sub-model Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Sub-model federated learning lets resource-constrained clients train width-reduced versions of a global model, but existing methods allocate capacity by device resources alone. A natural next step, allocating capacity by each client's data heterogeneity as estimated from the updates the server already observes, has been repeatedly suggested. We ask whether that step is possible, using HAS-FL, an adaptive capacity-allocation framework, as a test case. Our findings are threefold. First, validated against ground-truth label-distribution divergence on reproducible partitions, update-divergence estimates of client heterogeneity are dominated by capacity rather than data: across two corrected estimators, multiple datasets, and all seeds, the estimates correlate strongly and negatively with device capacity, and no data signal remains once capacity is controlled for. This previously undocumented confound affects any method estimating client statistics from sub-model updates. Second, adaptive allocation has a hidden failure mode: when every client is capped below full width, the uncovered parameters stay at random initialization and progressively corrupt the global model. A simple coverage guarantee removes the failure and explains why uniform allocation collapses. Third, a matched-budget control settles what adaptivity contributes: random allocation to the same average budget performs no differently on both image benchmarks, and on the naturally partitioned text benchmark the adaptive policy is the weakest of the three strategies while consuming the most capacity. Sub-model training remains valuable because it admits constrained clients at quadratically reduced cost, but what protects accuracy is parameter coverage rather than allocation intelligence. Its apparent benefits come from capacity budgeting and coverage, and future designs need heterogeneity signals separable from capacity effects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文以 HAS-FL 自适应容量分配框架为测试案例，检验子模型联邦学习（sub-model federated learning）中按客户端数据异质性分配模型宽度是否可行。作者报告三个发现：从子模型更新估计的异质性信号被设备容量混淆（与容量强负相关，控制容量后数据信号消失）；当所有客户端被限制在低于全宽时，自适应分配存在未覆盖参数停留在随机初始化并逐步腐蚀全局模型的失败模式，而简单覆盖保证（coverage guarantee）可消除该失败并解释均匀分配崩溃的原因；在匹配预算（matched-budget control）下，随机分配与自适应分配在图像基准上无差异，在自然划分的文本基准上自适应策略最弱且消耗最多容量。结论是保护精度的是参数覆盖而非分配智能。
Motivation: 子模型联邦学习让资源受限客户端训练全局模型的宽度缩减版本，现有方法仅按设备资源分配容量；按客户端数据异质性分配容量是自然且被反复提出的下一步，本文追问这一步是否可行。
Method: 以自适应容量分配框架 HAS-FL 为测试案例，在可复现划分上以真值标签分布散度为基准，用两个修正估计器、多数据集和多随机种子验证基于更新散度（update-divergence）的异质性估计；并设计匹配预算控制，比较自适应、随机与均匀三种分配策略，同时引入覆盖保证来消除未覆盖参数问题。
Result: 异质性估计被容量而非数据主导，与设备容量强负相关，控制容量后无残留数据信号；自适应分配在客户端全部低于全宽时失败，未覆盖参数从随机初始化逐步腐蚀全局模型，覆盖保证消除该失败并解释均匀分配为何崩溃；匹配预算下随机分配与自适应在两个图像基准上表现无差异，在自然划分的文本基准上自适应策略是三者中最弱且消耗容量最多的。
Conclusion: 子模型训练仍有价值，能以二次方降低的成本接纳受限客户端，但保护精度的是参数覆盖而非分配智能；其表面收益来自容量预算与覆盖保证，未来设计需要能与容量效应分离的异质性信号。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Machine Learning-Based Inter-Crystal Scatter Recovery for Ultra-High Resolution PET Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Inter-crystal scatter (ICS) events pose a significant challenge in ultrahigh- resolution positron emission tomography (UHR-PET), especially as detector crystals become smaller and their readouts increasingly segmented. Current approaches either reject these events, reducing sensitivity, or accept them with suboptimal positioning algorithms, degrading image resolution. We present a feed forward neural network to optimize ICS event recovery by inferring the line-of-response belonging to the first Compton interaction. Our approach was validated using both Monte Carlo simulations and experimental data from the fully pixelated LabPET-IIbased preclinical and brain UHR-PET scanners.Results demonstrate a 70% to 106% increase in sensitivity while preserving sub-millimeter spatial resolvability (down to 1.6 mm) compared to conventional methods. This ICS recovery approach is an effective solution that compensates for the lower detection efficiency of small, pixelated detectors in UHR-PET, enabling reduced scan times and lower radiation doses while largely preserving image quality.
papers.comment: 19 pages, to b published in Physic in Medecine and Biology
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对超高分辨率正电子发射断层成像 (UHR-PET) 中的晶体间散射 (ICS) 事件，提出一个前馈神经网络来推断首次康普顿相互作用所属的响应线 (line-of-response)，从而优化 ICS 事件恢复。方法在基于 LabPET-II 的临床前及脑部 UHR-PET 扫描仪的蒙特卡洛模拟和实验数据上验证，结果显示与传统方法相比灵敏度提升 70% 至 106%，同时保持亚毫米级空间分辨能力（可达 1.6 mm）。作者认为该 ICS 恢复方案能有效补偿小尺寸像素化探测器在 UHR-PET 中的较低探测效率，从而缩短扫描时间并降低辐射剂量。
Motivation: 在 UHR-PET 中，随着探测器晶体变小且读出越来越分段化，ICS 事件成为显著挑战：现有方法要么拒绝这些事件从而降低灵敏度，要么以次优的定位算法接受它们从而降低图像分辨率。
Method: 提出一种前馈神经网络 (feed forward neural network) 方法，用于推断首次康普顿相互作用所属的响应线，从而实现对 ICS 事件的恢复与优化定位。
Result: 基于蒙特卡洛模拟和 LabPET-II 相关 UHR-PET 扫描仪的实验数据验证，与传统方法相比灵敏度增加 70% 至 106%，同时保持低至 1.6 mm 的亚毫米空间分辨率。
Conclusion: 该 ICS 恢复方法被证明是有效方案，可补偿小尺寸像素化探测器在 UHR-PET 中较低的探测效率，在基本保持图像质量的前提下实现更短的扫描时间和更低的辐射剂量。
