papers.title: Representation Handoffs for OpenArm-Based Laboratory Mobile Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Open-source robotics and foundation models have lowered the barrier to embodied AI, yet language-guided laboratory automation still requires reliable alignment from instructions and observations to safe actions. This field report presents an OpenArm-based mobile manipulation prototype for laboratory-style tasks, built by integrating dual OpenArm manipulators with a mobile base, vertical slide, RGB-D sensing, lidar-based mapping, ROS2/MoveIt execution, and profile-defined skill interfaces. The system is organized around representation handoffs: natural language requests are constrained into registered skill calls, sensor observations are grounded into maps and object poses, object priors provide role and skill constraints, and runtime bindings compile validated skills into executable motion goals. We use dry-run traces and startup checks to evaluate this integration path, showing how the prototype exposes missing calibration, incomplete object assets, and unfinished real-scene visual grounding as explicit deployment blockers. These intermediate representations serve as practical debugging interfaces for integrating language, perception, planning, and robot safety in embodied systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇领域报告 (field report)，介绍了一个基于 OpenArm 的移动操作原型，用于实验室风格的自动化任务。系统集成了双臂 OpenArm、移动底座、垂直滑轨、RGB-D 感知、激光雷达建图、ROS2/MoveIt 执行以及基于配置文件定义的技能接口，并以“表示交接” (representation handoffs) 为主线，将自然语言请求约束为技能调用、将传感器观测落地为地图和物体位姿、用物体先验提供角色与技能约束、再通过运行时绑定将已验证技能编译为可执行的运动目标。作者用干跑轨迹 (dry-run traces) 和启动检查评估了这一集成路径，指出未完成的视觉接地等问题会作为明确的部署阻塞项暴露出来。
Motivation: 开源机器人和基础模型降低了具身 AI 的门槛，但语言引导的实验室自动化仍然需要从指令和观测到安全动作的可靠对齐，这一对齐问题是系统集成的主要难点。
Method: 提出并搭建 OpenArm 移动操作原型，集成双臂、移动底座、RGB-D、激光雷达建图与 ROS2/MoveIt 执行；系统围绕表示交接组织流程：语言请求被约束为注册技能调用，观测被接地到地图与物体位姿，物体先验提供角色和技能约束，运行时绑定把验证过的技能编译为可执行运动目标，并用干跑轨迹和启动检查评估集成。
Result: 通过干跑轨迹和启动检查发现，原型会暴露缺失的标定、不完整的物体资产以及未完成的真实场景视觉接地，这些都被明确视为部署阻塞项。
Conclusion: 中间表示可以作为实用的调试接口，帮助在具身系统中整合语言、感知、规划与机器人安全。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Interpretable reinforcement learning with decision-tree pruning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning policies are difficult to inspect, but interpreting them is a prerequisite for trustworthiness. Converting a trained policy into explicit decision-tree rules improves transparency and the resulting artifacts often remain too complex for human understanding. We present a pruning process that simplifies such rule-based policies while preserving task performance and making edits to the policy auditable. The process defines a small set of structural and usage-aware operators and evaluates candidate edits by re-executing the policy to measure return and interpretability proxies. This exposes an transformation process from complex to compact policy structures. We investigate this approach on classic control and MuJoCo benchmarks, where pruning traces reveal consistent interpretability improvements while maintaining high performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对强化学习策略难以检查的问题，提出一种对决策树形式的规则化策略进行剪枝（pruning）的流程，在保持任务性能的同时简化策略，并使策略编辑可审计。作者在经典控制（classic control）和 MuJoCo 基准上验证，剪枝轨迹在保持高性能的同时带来一致的 interpretability 改进。
Motivation: 强化学习策略难以检查，而可解释性是可信赖的前提；将训练好的策略转换为显式决策树规则可以提高透明度，但得到的规则往往仍然过于复杂，难以被人类理解。
Method: 提出一个剪枝过程：定义一小套结构性和使用感知（usage-aware）的编辑算子，并通过重新执行策略来评估候选编辑，以衡量回报（return）和可解释性代理指标（interpretability proxies）。
Result: 在经典控制与 MuJoCo 基准上，剪枝轨迹显示出一致的可解释性提升，同时保持了较高的任务性能。
Conclusion: 该流程展示了从复杂策略结构到紧凑策略结构的转换过程，能够在简化基于规则的策略的同时保留任务表现并支持可审计的策略编辑。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A MARL Centered Reference Architecture for Large Language Model Augmentation in Smart Manufacturing
papers.abstract_en: Modern manufacturing imposes six coupled demands on adaptive control: local decisions with global consequences, partial observability, nonstationarity, reflex speed response with long horizon effects, delayed and diffuse outcomes, and dynamics that resist explicit modeling. Cooperative multiagent reinforcement learning (MARL), posed as a Dec-POMDP under centralized training with decentralized execution, is a particularly natural formalism for these demands. This paper adopts a MARL centered scope and asks where large language models (LLMs) should augment, interface with, train, or, in the strongest competitive case, replace that coordination core. A taxonomy organizes the literature through four LLM attachment points: policy, reward design, communication between agents, and hierarchical planning. A conditional capability profile separates native mechanism, reported performance, formal guarantee, and engineering maturity, and a deployment readiness analysis identifies the evidence behind each role. These stages yield the principal contribution: a three layer MARL centered reference architecture, grounded in evidence, for semantic reasoning, adaptive cooperative control, and independently assured execution. The LLM-Augmented Dec-POMDP is a descriptive comparative notation for that architecture, recording four attachment choices without introducing a new decision process class or algorithm. Under the reviewed evidence, conventional MARL is better suited to frequent, structured, decentralized coordination after task specific training, whereas LLM components are promising for semantic interpretation, reward drafting, human interaction, and slower supervisory planning. Current LLM only manufacturing controllers do not yet establish equivalence for strict real time, decentralized, safety critical control; this conclusion is bounded by the available evidence and does not assert impossibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文围绕智能制造的适应性控制需求，提出以多智能体强化学习 (MARL) 为核心、LLM 作为增强组件的参考架构。作者通过四个 LLM 接入点（策略、奖励设计、智能体间通信、分层规划）的文献分类、条件能力画像和部署就绪度分析，得到三层参考架构，并用 LLM-Augmented Dec-POMDP 作为描述性比较记号。基于证据的结论是：常规 MARL 更适合频繁、结构化、去中心化的协调，LLM 更适合语义理解、奖励起草、人机交互与慢速监督规划，纯 LLM 制造控制器尚不能等同严格实时、去中心化、安全关键的控制。
Motivation: 现代制造的自适应控制同时面临局部决策与全局后果、部分可观测性、非平稳性、反射式快速响应与长期效应、延迟且分散的反馈以及难以显式建模的动态等六项相互耦合的需求。这些需求与协作式 MARL（以集中训练、分散执行的 Dec-POMDP 形式化）高度契合，但 LLM 在其中应承担何种角色尚不清晰，因此需要一个以 MARL 为中心、基于证据的架构来明确 LLM 应在何处增强、接口、训练或替换协调核心。
Method: 提出以 MARL 为中心的参考架构构建方法：先用四类 LLM 接入点（策略、奖励设计、智能体间通信、分层规划）组织文献分类，再用条件能力画像区分原生机制、报告性能、形式化保证与工程成熟度，并进行部署就绪度分析；最终给出三层参考架构（语义推理、自适应协作控制、独立保障执行），并以 LLM-Augmented Dec-POMDP 作为记录四种接入选择的描述性比较记号，不引入新的决策过程类别或算法。
Result: 摘要报告，在该证据基础上，经过任务特定训练的常规 MARL 更适合频繁、结构化、去中心化的协调；LLM 组件在语义解释、奖励起草、人机交互和较慢速的监督式规划方面有前景；现有纯 LLM 制造控制器尚未在严格实时、去中心化、安全关键的控制上建立等价性，且该结论受现有证据限制，并不断言不可能。
Conclusion: 核心结论是 LLM 应作为 MARL 协调核心的增强而非替代：LLM 适合语义理解与慢速监督规划，而实时安全关键的分散协调仍应交给 MARL。作者强调结论受可用证据边界约束，不构成对纯 LLM 控制器的绝对否定。

papers.title: DiDPO: Diff-in-Diff Policy Optimization for Coding Agent Training
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with Verifiable Reward (RLVR) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for training coding agents, where the execution feedback from compilation and tests provides objective verification. However, unlike agent tasks, coding agents face a unique and finer-grained credit assignment challenge: at each step, coding actions simultaneously pack varying changes into different regions of a code version, which makes the contribution of independent change indistinguishable. Existing RLVR methods mostly leverage the outcome reward or step-level reward, which fails to dive into a code diff and makes unique properties of coding actions invisible to training. In this paper, we propose Diff-in-Diff Policy Optimization (DiDPO), a critic-free RL method that constructs fine-grained credit units directly from the structure of code diffs. DiDPO organizes multi-turn coding interactions into multiple thought--action steps and discovers code diffs across sampled trajectories. It then selects anchors by aggregating highly similar sub-diffs split from each whole diff by our ``groupability score'', which provides the splitting schema that optimally balances the semantic scope of anchors and the group mass they may form. Finally these anchors form advantage groups and project the diff-level advantage back to individual response tokens. Experiments on long-horizon coding and reasoning benchmarks show that DiDPO significantly outperforms strong agentic RL baselines. On Qwen2.5-7B-Coder, DiDPO exceeds comparable methods by over 10\% and narrows the gap with far larger models, offering a principled framework for fine-grained credit assignment in coding agent training. We also open-source verl-code, an agentic rl codebase that supports various RL methods and coding benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DiDPO（Diff-in-Diff Policy Optimization），一种用于编码智能体训练的免评论家（critic-free）强化学习方法，直接从代码 diff 的结构构建细粒度信用单元。方法将多轮编码交互组织为 thought-action 步骤，在采样轨迹间发现代码 diff，并用 groupability score 划分高度相似的子 diff 作为锚点（anchors），进而形成优势组（advantage groups）并把 diff 级优势投影到各响应 token 上。实验显示在长程编码与推理基准上显著超过强 agentic RL 基线，在 Qwen2.5-7B-Coder 上比同类方法高 10% 以上，并缩小了与更大模型的差距；同时开源了 verl-code 代码库。
Motivation: RLVR 用编译与测试的执行反馈作为可验证奖励，但编码智能体在每一步会同时把不同变更打包进代码版本的多个区域，导致独立变更的贡献难以区分；现有方法主要利用结果奖励或步骤级奖励，无法深入代码 diff，使编码动作的独特性质对训练不可见。
Method: DiDPO 是免评论家的 RL 方法，先把多轮编码交互拆分为多个 thought-action 步骤，再跨采样轨迹发现代码 diff；通过提出的 groupability score 从每个完整 diff 中聚合高度相似的子 diff 并选择锚点，使锚点的语义范围与它们形成的组规模达到最优平衡。这些锚点构成优势组，并把 diff 级优势回投影到单个响应 token 上。此外作者开源了支持多种 RL 方法与编码基准的 agentic RL 代码库 verl-code。
Result: 在长程编码与推理基准上，DiDPO 显著优于强 agentic RL 基线；在 Qwen2.5-7B-Coder 上超过可比方法 10% 以上，并缩进了与远更大模型之间的差距。
Conclusion: 作者认为 DiDPO 提供了编码智能体训练中细粒度信用分配（fine-grained credit assignment）的原则性框架，并指出该工作仍在进行中（work in progress），同时开源了相关代码库。

papers.title: InstanceSplat: Instance-Aware Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting for Scene Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables efficient and generalizable 3D reconstruction, but current feed-forward 3DGS methods for scene understanding remain largely category-oriented. In contrast, instance-aware 3DGS methods typically rely on per-scene optimization and often decouple reconstruction from instance and semantic learning, limiting reciprocal interactions among them. We present InstanceSplat, a unified feed-forward 3DGS framework for generalizable 3D reconstruction and instance-aware scene understanding from pose-free multi-view images. In a single forward pass, InstanceSplat constructs an instance-aware Gaussian representation that jointly encodes appearance, geometry, instance identity, and language-aligned semantics. Shared 3D Gaussians ground instance identities across views, producing renderable and cross-view-consistent instance features. To allow reconstruction and scene understanding to benefit from each other, we further design an instance-centric learning strategy that connects reconstruction, instance learning, and semantic learning through shared instance structure. Specifically, instance cues guide reconstruction, language-aligned semantics strengthen the discrimination of confusing same-category instances, and instance regions aggregate semantic evidence into coherent object-level predictions. Experiments on novel-view synthesis, instance segmentation, and open-vocabulary semantic understanding under varying input-view settings and on an unseen dataset demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, practical efficiency, and strong generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 InstanceSplat，一个前馈式 3D 高斯溅射 (feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting) 统一框架，用于从无位姿多视图图像中同时进行可泛化的三维重建与实例感知场景理解。单次前向传播中，该方法构建实例感知的高斯表示，联合编码外观、几何、实例身份和语言对齐语义；共享的 3D 高斯跨视图锚定实例身份，从而产生可渲染且跨视图一致的实例特征。文中还设计了实例中心学习策略，通过共享的实例结构把重建、实例学习和语义学习连接起来，并在多个任务上报告了最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有前馈 3DGS 场景理解方法大多是类别导向的，而实例感知 3DGS 方法通常依赖逐场景优化，且常把重建与实例、语义学习解耦，限制了重建与理解之间的相互促进。
Method: 构建实例感知的 3D 高斯表示，在单次前向中联合编码外观、几何、实例身份和语言对齐语义；所有视图共享同一组 3D 高斯来锚定实例身份。进一步提出实例中心学习策略：实例线索引导重建，语言对齐语义增强对易混淆同类别实例的判别，实例区域聚合语义证据形成一致的对象级预测。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在新视图合成、实例分割和开放词汇语义理解等任务上，在不同输入视角设置以及未见数据集上均取得最先进性能，并展现实际效率与强泛化能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调重建、实例学习和语义学习可以通过共享的实例结构相互受益，实例感知的前馈 3DGS 能够在一次前向中同时完成可泛化重建与实例感知场景理解；摘要未给出具体数值或明确限制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Human-AI Perceptual Alignment by Playing Hues and Cues
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating the perceptual alignment between Contrastive Vision-Language Models (CVLMs) and humans is typically constrained by traditional benchmarks that overlook fine-grained semantic and cultural nuances. In this work, we propose a novel evaluation framework that leverages the gamified, discrete color space of the board game Hues and Cues. By mapping the board's 480 color cells to the CIE xy chromaticity diagram, we calculate empirical perceptual distances across a carefully curated 100-word vocabulary spanning seven semantic categories. To properly contextualize model performance, we establish an empirical lower bound of expected error-the Human Consistency baseline-calculated via Leave-One-Out (LOO) cross-validation on a dense dataset of color associations collected from 325 human observers through a custom digital interface. We evaluate 162 models across multiple architectural families and pre-training datasets to assess their semantic color grounding. Our results demonstrate that while CVLMs successfully replicate human cognitive biases, such as idealized memory colors for concrete physical referents (e.g., food and plants), they systematically diverge from the human baseline in abstract, subjective, and pop-culture domains. We identify two distinct failure modes in severely misaligned concepts: semantic misclassification and a systematic uncertainty collapse into a default blue coordinate. Furthermore, we reveal that highly curated pre-training datasets are significantly more effective than massive, uncurated corpora in mitigating these severe misalignments. Ultimately, this work highlights that despite their broad categorization capabilities, current CVLMs still fail to capture the nuanced, localized consensus of human color memory, emphasizing the value of gamified tasks in exposing underlying model biases. The data and code are publicly available to test other metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种评估对比视觉语言模型（CVLM）与人类感知对齐程度的新框架，利用桌游 Hues and Cues 的离散色彩空间，将棋盘 480 个色块映射到 CIE xy 色度图，并基于 100 个词汇、七个语义类别计算经验感知距离。作者用 325 名受试者的颜色联想数据通过 Leave-One-Out 交叉验证建立 Human Consistency 下界，并评估了 162 个模型。结果显示 CVLM 能复现针对具体物理指称（如食物和植物）的理想化记忆颜色偏差，但在抽象、主观和流行文化领域系统性偏离人类基线，并暴露出语义误分类与不确定性坍缩为默认蓝色两种严重错位模式。
Motivation: 传统基准在评估 CVLM 与人类感知对齐时忽略了细粒度的语义与文化差异，难以揭示颜色记忆等微妙的人类认知偏差。
Method: 利用游戏化、离散的色彩空间设计评估框架：将 Hues and Cues 的 480 个色块映射到 CIE xy 色度图，构建 100 词七类语义词汇表，并通过 325 名观察者的密集颜色联想数据计算 Human Consistency 基线，再对 162 个跨架构与预训练数据集的模型进行语义颜色接地评估。
Result: CVLM 在食物、植物等具体指称上成功复现人类认知偏差，但在抽象、主观和流行文化领域系统性偏离人类基线；严重错位概念存在语义误分类与不确定性坍缩为默认蓝色坐标两种失败模式，且高度精选的预训练数据比大规模未精选语料更能缓解这些严重错位。
Conclusion: 当前 CVLM 尽管具备广泛分类能力，仍无法捕捉人类颜色记忆中细微、局部化的共识；游戏化任务有助于暴露模型潜在偏差，且数据与代码已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Online Conformal Prediction Beyond Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Uncertainty quantification is essential when deploying machine learning models in safety-critical applications. Online conformal prediction (OCP) provides theoretically principled uncertainty quantification for arbitrary black-box classifiers and non-i.i.d. data streams by constructing prediction sets that are guaranteed to contain the true label at a user-specified frequency. OCP usually updates prediction sets using feedback from previously deployed predictions. We instead study an OCP setting beyond feedback: on each round, the learner can either output a prediction set or query the correct label, but not both. Thus, no deployed prediction is ever evaluated directly. We reduce this problem to a partial monitoring game in which prediction actions return no observation and a separate query action reveals the label. The reward function is constructed in a way that encourages the learner to output small prediction sets while ensuring that the correct label is covered with a sufficiently high probability. To solve this game, we develop OCP with queries (OCPQ) by adapting the label efficient forecaster of Cesa-Bianchi, Lugosi, and Stoltz (2004) to our setting. For any black box classifier and any (non-i.i.d.) oblivious data stream of length $T$, OCPQ has $O(T^{2/3})$ expected regret and expected coverage at least $β-O(T^{-1/3})$ for a user-defined $β$, while querying only an expected $T^{-1/3}$ fraction of rounds. This provides coverage comparable to bandit-based OCP methods while requiring no feedback from deployed prediction sets. Experiments on real-world datasets further demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

TL;DR: 本文研究无反馈场景下的在线共形预测（OCP）：每一轮学习器要么输出预测集，要么查询真实标签，二者不能同时进行，因此已部署的预测集永远不会被直接评估。作者将问题归结为部分监控博弈（partial monitoring game），并基于 Cesa-Bianchi、Lugosi 和 Stoltz (2004) 的 label efficient forecaster 提出 OCP with queries (OCPQ)。摘要给出长度 T 的任意非 i.i.d. 数据流上的期望遗憾、覆盖率和查询次数理论界，并在真实数据集上验证了方法。
Motivation: 标准在线共形预测依赖先前部署预测的反馈来更新预测集，但很多实际场景下反馈不可得。作者希望在没有这种反馈的情况下，仍能以用户指定频率覆盖真实标签，同时保持较小的预测集。
Method: 将无反馈 OCP 建模为部分监控博弈，预测动作不返回观测，单独的查询动作揭示标签；通过构造奖励函数鼓励输出小预测集并保证高覆盖概率。求解该博弈时，将 label efficient forecaster 适配到该设置，得到 OCPQ 算法。
Result: 对任意黑盒分类器和任意非 i.i.d. 的 oblivious 数据流，OCPQ 的期望遗憾为 O(T^{2/3})，期望覆盖至少为 β−O(T^{-1/3})，且只需在期望 T^{-1/3} 比例轮次中查询标签。实验显示该方法有效，覆盖水平可与基于 bandit 的 OCP 方法相比。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法能在不依赖已部署预测集反馈的情况下获得与 bandit 类 OCP 方法相当的覆盖保证。摘要未讨论的具体局限包括真实应用中的实现开销等问题。

papers.title: Autonomous discovery of accelerator commissioning algorithms
papers.abstract_en: Simulated commissioning has become essential for de-risking modern light-source design and commissioning, but the procedures being simulated are still designed entirely by human experts. Their labor-intensive redevelopment after lattice changes makes such studies hard to repeat and limits their use during early design iteration. This Letter demonstrates a closed research loop in which a language-model agent writes commissioning code, tests it in simulation, and improves the algorithm from the results. Applied to RF beam capture in the ALS-U accumulator-ring model, the loop substantially improves a working expert procedure and can construct a working one from a minimal starting point, with more capable models succeeding from less initial code. Extending the same framework to multiple objectives produces 16 non-dominated algorithms spanning physically distinct trade-offs between rapid beam capture and correction of seeded machine errors. This reframes commissioning studies from evaluating human-designed procedures toward a mode in which agents participate directly in discovering accelerator algorithms.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to Physical Review Accelerators and Beams (ZVR1001)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文演示了一个由语言模型智能体 (language-model agent) 构成的闭环研究流程：智能体编写加速器调试 (commissioning) 代码、在仿真中测试并根据结果改进算法。以 ALS-U 累积环模型中的射频束流俘获 (RF beam capture) 为例，该闭环显著改进了已有的专家流程，并能从极简初始代码出发构造可用流程；扩展到多目标后得到 16 个非支配算法，覆盖快速束流俘获与修正种子机器误差之间的不同物理权衡。
Motivation: 现有的加速器调试仿真流程仍完全由人类专家设计，格点 (lattice) 变更后需要大量人工重开发，导致研究难以复现并限制了早期设计迭代中的使用。
Method: 提出一个闭合研究回路：语言模型智能体生成调试代码，在仿真环境中测试，并依据仿真结果迭代改进算法；将该框架应用于 ALS-U 累积环模型的射频束流俘获，并扩展到多目标优化以生成权衡算法集合。
Result: 摘要报告该闭环能显著改进一个可用的专家调试流程，也能从极简初始代码出发构建出可用流程，且能力更强的模型能从更少的初始代码成功起步；多目标扩展产生了 16 个非支配算法，展现快速束流俘获与修正种子机器误差之间的物理权衡。
Conclusion: 本文将调试研究从评估人类设计的流程转向智能体直接参与发现加速器算法的模式，强调该方法对早期设计迭代和流程自动化的意义。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: PHOENIX: Fine-Tuned SLM-Powered Autonomous Satellite Lifetime Extension via Predictive Self-Healing and Multi-Agent AI Recovery
papers.abstract_en: Most CubeSats, small and low-cost satellites roughly the size of a shoebox, do not survive as long as they were designed to: a study of 178 missions found that only 48-65% remain operational after two years, against a designed lifetime of 2-5 years. The deeper issue is that a CubeSat in low Earth orbit (LEO) is physically unreachable from the ground for roughly 85 minutes out of every 96-minute orbit, so faults that start during that window go unnoticed until the next contact pass, by which point recovery may no longer be possible. We propose PHOENIX (Predictive Health On-orbit Edge Neural Intelligence eXtension) to give the satellite its own fault reasoning capability. A fine-tuned Small Language Model (SLM) compact enough to run on embedded hardware is deployed onboard the CubeSat, running on the flight-proven Aethero NxN-ECM computer, monitoring all sensor readings continuously, and resolving recurring faults using a memory system that stores past repairs so the same inference does not need to run twice. Once per orbit it sends a short structured health report to the ground instead of a raw data dump; six specialized AI agents on the ground read that report and generate validated satellite commands within the 5-10 minute contact window. A generative diffusion model (DDPM) creates synthetic training data because real fault examples make up only 0.57-1.80% of the dataset. We report preliminary results on the ESA Anomaly Detection Benchmark (14 years, 76 channels, 118 labeled faults).
papers.comment: 6 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at IEEE IRAI 2026 (International Conference on Responsible Artificial Intelligence)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PHOENIX，一个面向 CubeSat 在轨寿命延长的自主故障推理系统。其核心是在星载嵌入式计算机 Aethero NxN-ECM 上部署经过微调的小型语言模型 (SLM)，持续监控传感器数据，并用记忆系统复用历史修复经验；每个轨道周期向地面发送压缩健康报告，由六个地面 AI 智能体在 5-10 分钟联系窗口内生成验证过的卫星指令。由于真实故障样本仅占数据集的 0.57-1.80%，作者用生成式扩散模型 (DDPM) 合成训练数据，并在 ESA Anomaly Detection Benchmark（14 年、76 通道、118 个标注故障）上报告了初步结果。
Motivation: 多数 CubeSat 的实际寿命低于设计寿命，一项针对 178 个任务的研究显示仅 48-65% 在两年后仍可运行；且 LEO 卫星每个 96 分钟轨道约有 85 分钟无法与地面通信，故障在联系窗口外发生时会延误恢复时机。
Method: 提出 PHOENIX 架构：在轨端部署紧凑 SLM 持续监测传感器，通过存储历史修复的记忆系统避免重复推理；地面侧用六个专用 AI 智能体解析简短结构化健康报告并在联系窗口内生成命令；并用 DDPM 合成故障数据以弥补真实故障样本稀缺。
Result: 摘要仅报告在 ESA Anomaly Detection Benchmark 上的初步结果，未给出具体性能数字；真实故障样本占比 0.57-1.80% 的数据不平衡问题由合成数据缓解。
Conclusion: 作者认为给卫星配置自身故障推理能力可提升 CubeSat 在轨寿命，当前结果仍属初步阶段，基于 ESA 异常检测基准。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Multiple Hypothesis Flow Estimation for Video Frame Interpolation under Matching Ambiguity
papers.abstract_en: Many flow-based video frame interpolation (VFI) methods synthesize an intermediate frame by estimating optical flow fields, warping the two input frames, and blending the warped observations. These latent flow fields are typically learned through image-level reconstruction supervision without direct flow annotations. In ambiguous regions containing repetitive or stochastic textures, rotating symmetric structures, or fast motion with blur, the matching evidence for a single query may contain multiple comparable and spatially separated peaks. Although the ground-truth intermediate frame provides indirect supervision, it may not uniquely identify the latent correspondence in ambiguous regions.When several locations provide multiple plausible matches, a single-flow estimator can retain only one displacement and discard the remaining candidates. If the selected match is incorrect or inconsistent with those of neighboring pixels, warping samples content from mismatched locations, producing ghosting, structural distortion, or blur.To address this limitation, we propose a multiple hypothesis flow estimation framework that preserves top-K candidate correspondences and selects one per location through a reliability-guided router. Each hypothesis is initialized from a coarse matching anchor and refined separately through anchor-centered local attention. Frame synthesis is thus conditioned on one selected flow-appearance hypothesis rather than a soft combination of candidate motions.Experiments on the proposed MA-HD benchmark and public VFI benchmarks show that our method achieves the best LPIPS and DISTS among the compared methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视频帧插值 (video frame interpolation, VFI) 中由匹配歧义引起的伪影问题，提出一种多假设光流估计框架。该方法保留 top-K 候选对应关系，并通过可靠性引导的路由器 (reliability-guided router) 为每个位置选择一条假设；每条假设从粗匹配锚点初始化，并经锚点中心局部注意力 (anchor-centered local attention) 独立细化。帧合成基于选中的单一 flow-appearance 假设而非候选运动的软组合，在提出的 MA-HD 基准和公开 VFI 基准上取得最优的 LPIPS 和 DISTS。
Motivation: 现有基于光流的 VFI 方法在重复或随机纹理、旋转对称结构、快速运动模糊等歧义区域中，单个查询可能对应多个强度相当且空间分离的匹配峰值；单光流估计器只能保留一个位移并丢弃其余候选，一旦选错就会导致重影、结构畸变或模糊。仅靠图像级重建监督和中间帧的间接监督无法唯一确定潜在对应关系。
Method: 提出多假设光流估计框架：保留 top-K 候选对应关系，利用可靠性引导的路由器在每个位置选择一条假设，每条假设从粗匹配锚点初始化并分别通过锚点中心局部注意力细化；最终帧合成条件化于选中的单一 flow-appearance 假设，而非候选运动的软组合。
Result: 在作者提出的 MA-HD 基准以及公开 VFI 基准上，该方法在 LPIPS 和 DISTS 两个感知指标上均优于所比较的方法。
Conclusion: 作者认为显式保留并选择多个候选匹配关系而非软混合，能够改善匹配歧义下的帧合成质量，这一思路由感知指标上的领先表现所支持。

papers.title: How Much, Then Where: Credit-Conserving Action-to-Token Allocation for Multi-Turn Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Credit assignment in multi-turn agent reinforcement learning operates at two levels: assigning trajectory-level credit to actions and distributing each action's credit across its tokens. In this paper, we introduce FACTOR, which separates these decisions. FACTOR uses checkpoint-calibrated TD residuals to assign per-action credits that telescope to the trajectory advantage, and feedback-conditioned teacher-student likelihood gaps to allocate each credit across the realized action tokens. Per-action normalization preserves the action-average coefficient and prevents token-level sign flips. We pair this construction with an action-mean reduction, removing the implicit dependence of an action's scalar surrogate weight on its token length. At the behavior policy and before clipping, each action's inner action-mean surrogate equals its TD credit. FACTOR consistently improves over competitive baselines across ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld, with every environment-seed comparison favoring FACTOR and the largest gains emerging on the longest-horizon environment. The same hyperparameters transfer without retuning to a larger backbone and to a different model family. Ablations identify TD action credit as the dominant driver of the improvement, with hindsight token allocation contributing complementary gains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FACTOR，用于多轮智能体强化学习中的两级信用分配（credit assignment）：先为动作分配轨迹级信用，再把每个动作的信用分摊到其各 token。FACTOR 用 checkpoint 校准的 TD 残差生成可 telescoping 到轨迹优势的动作级信用，并用反馈条件下的师生似然差（teacher-student likelihood gap）将信用分配到实际动作 token，同时通过动作均值归约去掉标量代理权重对 token 长度的隐含依赖。摘要报告其在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 ScienceWorld 上一致优于竞争基线。
Motivation: 多轮智能体强化学习的信用分配同时涉及轨迹级动作信用与动作内 token 级信用分配，现有方法容易把两者混在一起，导致 token 长度影响动作代理权重并可能产生 token 级符号翻转。
Method: FACTOR 将这两类决策解耦：使用 checkpoint 校准的 TD 残差为每个动作赋予可 telescoping 到轨迹优势的信用，并使用反馈条件下的师生似然差把信用分配给实际动作 token；动作级归一化保持动作平均系数并防止 token 级符号翻转，再配合动作均值归约（action-mean reduction）消除动作标量代理权重对其 token 长度的依赖。
Result: 摘要称 FACTOR 在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 ScienceWorld 上一致优于竞争基线，每个环境-随机种子对比都更优，且最大提升出现在最长 horizon 的环境中；相同超参数无需重调即可迁移到更大 backbone 和不同模型家族。消融显示 TD 动作信用是主要增益来源，hindsight token 分配提供互补提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将轨迹级动作信用与 token 级信用分配分开、并采用动作均值归约，是提升多轮智能体强化学习信用分配质量的关键设计。

papers.title: Beyond Fluency: A Clinical Benchmark and Anomaly-Enhanced Baseline for Spine MRI Report Generation
papers.abstract_en: Radiology reporting is time-consuming and subject to inter-rater variability, making automated report generation an attractive clinical application for Vision-Language Models (VLMs). We benchmark state-of-the-art VLMs on lumbar spine MRI with a focus on diagnostic accuracy and demonstrate that standard lexical and semantic metrics poorly reflect clinical correctness: fluent, well-structured reports can score highly while containing clinically meaningful diagnostic errors. To address this failure mode, we propose an architecture-agnostic framework that augments VLM inputs with spatially localized, disc-level anomaly heatmaps generated by a semi-supervised U-Net++ model. These heatmaps both improve anatomical sensitivity through explicit visual grounding and provide an independent interpretability output for clinical oversight, moving us closer to diagnostically reliable, visually grounded VLMs for lumbar spine MRI interpretation.
papers.comment: Maria Monzon and Catherine R. Jutzeler contributed equally as shared last authors. Accepted at the CV4Clinic Workshop, CVPR 2026
papers.journal_ref: Proc. IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) Workshops, 2026, pp. 6759-6770
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对腰椎 MRI 报告生成，系统评估了多种 SOTA 视觉语言模型 (VLM)，发现标准词汇和语义指标并不能反映临床诊断正确性：流畅且结构良好的报告可能含有临床意义的诊断错误。为此，作者提出一个与架构无关的框架，用半监督 U-Net++ 生成空间局部化的椎间盘级异常热图来增强 VLM 输入，既提供显式视觉定位 (visual grounding)，又给出独立的可解释性输出，以便临床监督。
Motivation: 放射科报告撰写耗时且存在观察者间差异，自动报告生成因此是有吸引力的临床应用；但现有 VLM 在腰椎 MRI 上的诊断准确性欠缺验证，且常用评测指标与临床正确性严重脱节，流畅文本可能掩盖实质性诊断错误。
Method: 作者先对 SOTA VLM 在腰椎 MRI 报告生成上进行基准测试，然后提出一个与架构无关的增强框架：由半监督 U-Net++ 模型生成椎间盘级异常热图，将热图作为额外输入注入 VLM，同时将热图作为独立的可解释性输出提供给临床审查。
Result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，但指出标准词法和语义指标无法反映临床正确性，热图增强通过显式视觉定位提升了报告的解剖敏感性，并提供了供临床监督的独立输出。
Conclusion: 摘要将这一框架定位为迈向诊断可靠、视觉 grounded 的腰椎 MRI 解释 VLM 的一步，强调临床监督和可解释性对于实际应用的必要性。

papers.title: Geometry-Aware Camera Localization for Bronchoscopy
papers.abstract_en: Camera localization in bronchoscopy remains a challenging problem due to stringent accuracy requirements, real-time constraints, and limited training data. Compared to natural scenes, the confined anatomical structures demand millimeter-level precision, while intraoperative guidance necessitates low-latency inference. However, existing methods often fail to effectively exploit preoperative geometric priors, limiting their robustness and accuracy. To address these limitations, we propose a unified geometry-aware bronchoscope localization framework (GABL) that effectively fuses preoperative structural priors with paired intraoperative video to estimate 6-DoF camera poses. Specifically, to address visual ambiguity in complex airways, we propose a graph-guided coarse-to-fine localization scheme that effectively leverages structural priors for precise pose estimation. Furthermore, to mitigate pose jitter and bridge the visual-structural gap, we integrate a Transformer-based tracking model with a novel RGB-depth matching objective, jointly enforcing spatio-temporal and geometric consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method yields remarkable reductions of 8.37% and 31.76% in translation and rotation errors over the prior state-of-the-art, alongside 4 times inference speedup (33.6 FPS) for robust real-time bronchoscope localization. Project website: https://paulili08.github.io/GABL/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的几何感知支气管镜定位框架（GABL），融合术前结构先验与术中视频估计 6-DoF 相机位姿。方法包含图引导的由粗到细定位方案，以及结合 Transformer 跟踪模型与新颖的 RGB-深度匹配目标，以缓解位姿抖动并弥合视觉-结构差异。实验显示相比先前最优方法，平移和旋转误差分别降低 8.37% 和 31.76%，推理速度提升 4 倍（33.6 FPS）。
Motivation: 支气管镜相机定位面临毫米级精度、实时推理和有限训练数据的挑战，现有方法未能有效利用术前几何先验，导致鲁棒性和准确性受限。
Method: 提出 GABL 框架：采用图引导的粗到细定位方案利用结构先验进行精确位姿估计；集成基于 Transformer 的跟踪模型与新颖的 RGB-深度匹配目标，共同约束时空一致性和几何一致性。
Result: 在实验中对先前最优方法实现平移误差降低 8.37%、旋转误差降低 31.76%，并获得 4 倍推理加速（33.6 FPS），支持鲁棒的实时支气管镜定位。
Conclusion: 摘要强调融合术前结构先验与术中视频、并联合约束时空与几何一致性，可显著提升支气管镜相机定位的精度与实时性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Optimized Certainty Equivalent Risk Minimization Using Samples: Algorithms, Convergence Rates, and Applications
papers.abstract_en: We consider the optimization of the Optimized Certainty Equivalent (OCE) risk, with applications including portfolio optimization in finance, and uncertainty quantification, classification, and regression in machine learning. Our contributions cover popular special cases of OCE, such as entropic risk, mean-variance risk, and smooth variants of Conditional Value-at-Risk. Our treatment sets out the conditions that facilitate the extension of OCE to unbounded r.v.s.. We provide a useful characterization of OCE that links OCE to utility-based shortfall risk (UBSR). Our characterization enables us to form an OCE estimator from the classic sample-average approximation (SAA) of UBSR. We derive mean-squared error (MSE) bounds for our proposed OCE estimator. For OCE optimization, we first derive an expression for the OCE gradient using the characterization linking OCE to UBSR. This expression serves as the basis for a gradient estimator for the OCE. We derive non-asymptotic bounds on the MSE for the proposed OCE gradient estimator. We incorporate the aforementioned gradient estimator into a stochastic gradient (SG) algorithm to optimize OCE and quantify its convergence rate using non-asymptotic bounds that we derive. Finally, we present three experiments that use our OCE optimization algorithm to solve portfolio optimization and uncertainty quantification problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于样本的优化确定等价 (Optimized Certainty Equivalent, OCE) 风险最小化问题，覆盖熵风险、均值-方差风险和条件风险价值 (CVaR) 的光滑变体等特例。作者建立了 OCE 与基于效用的短缺风险 (UBSR) 之间的联系，并据此构造 OCE 估计器及其梯度估计器，推导了非渐近的均方误差界，并给出随机梯度 (SG) 算法的收敛率。实验部分将该算法用于组合优化与不确定性量化问题。
Motivation: OCE 风险是金融组合优化和机器学习中不确定性量化、分类与回归的重要工具，但现有基于样本的优化方法缺乏统一的估计器设计、梯度估计及非渐近收敛保证，且需要将 OCE 推广到无界随机变量情形。
Method: 给出将 OCE 推广到无界随机变量的条件，建立 OCE 与 UBSR 之间的刻画关系，基于 UBSR 的样本平均近似 (SAA) 构造 OCE 估计器；利用该刻画推导 OCE 梯度表达式，进而设计梯度估计器，并整合到随机梯度 (SG) 算法中进行 OCE 优化。
Result: 摘要报告为 OCE 估计器和梯度估计器推导了均方误差 (MSE) 的非渐近界，并为 SG 算法量化了非渐近收敛率；在三个实验中用该算法求解组合优化和不确定性量化问题。
Conclusion: 该工作为 OCE 风险的样本优化提供了统一的算法框架与理论保证，主要面向金融和机器学习应用。

papers.title: Modular TTT: Rethinking Test-Time Training as Composable Modules
papers.abstract_en: Test-time training (TTT) views sequence modeling as an online learning problem in which fast weights are updated by an internal learning rule. Despite the growing number of TTT variants, existing approaches typically hard-code each variant separately, which makes it difficult to design new TTT methods and to isolate the role of each component. To address this, we propose Modular TTT, a framework that represents the inner learner as a directed acyclic graph and exposes the fast-weight network, loss function, learning rate, weight decay, and normalization as explicit design dimensions. Modular TTT automatically composes primitive-level train-view forward, train-view backward, and causal query-view rules into the full graph-level TTT computation, including the fast-weight state transition. Using Modular TTT, we systematically ablate the components of TTT and find that small learning-rate initialization, weight decay, and a single-layer nonlinearity improve performance, while MSE and inner-product losses perform similarly. Deeper fast-weight networks and normalization tend to hurt performance because they induce excessively large activations, while residual connections and gating provide little measurable benefit. Guided by these findings, we train the best resulting variant as 410M- and 1.45B-parameter models on 100B tokens, and observe training loss and benchmark performance comparable to Gated DeltaNet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Modular TTT，将测试时训练（Test-Time Training, TTT）的内部学习器表示为有向无环图，并把快速权重网络、损失函数、学习率、权重衰减和归一化等显式暴露为可组合的设计维度。框架自动组合 primitive 级的 train-view forward、train-view backward 和因果 query-view 规则，生成完整的图级 TTT 计算（含快速权重状态转移）。基于该框架，作者系统消融了 TTT 各组件，并用 410M 和 1.45B 参数的模型在 100B tokens 上训练最佳变体，得到与 Gated DeltaNet 相当的训练损失和基准性能。
Motivation: 现有 TTT 变体众多但每个变体通常被单独硬编码，导致难以设计新方法，也难以隔离每个组件（如损失函数、学习率、归一化等）的具体作用。缺少一个统一、可组合的框架来系统研究 TTT 的内部学习规则。
Method: 提出 Modular TTT 框架：将内部学习器建模为有向无环图，显式区分快速权重网络、损失函数、学习率、权重衰减和归一化等设计维度，并自动组合 primitive 级规则（train-view forward、train-view backward、因果 query-view）为完整的图级 TTT 计算，包括快速权重状态转移。
Result: 系统消融发现：小的学习率初始化、权重衰减和单层非线性可提升性能；MSE 与内积损失表现相近。更深的快速权重网络和归一化因诱导过大的激活值而损害性能；残差连接和门控几乎没有可测量的收益。据此训练的最佳变体（410M 和 1.45B 参数，100B tokens）在训练损失和基准性能上与 Gated DeltaNet 相当。
Conclusion: 作者认为 Modular TTT 提供了一个可组合的框架来理解和设计新的 TTT 方法，并指出简单配置（浅层快速权重网络、适当的正则化）已能取得与强基线相当的效果。

summary_sections.result: 系统消融发现：小的学习率初始化、权重衰减和单层非线性可提升性能；MSE 与内积损失表现相近。更深的快速权重网络和归一化因诱导过大的激活值而损害性能；残差连接和门控几乎没有可测量的收益。据此训练的最佳变体（410M 和 1.45B 参数，100B tokens）在训练损失和基准性能上与 Gated DeltaNet 相当。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为 Modular TTT 提供了一个可组合的框架来理解和设计新的 TTT 方法，并指出简单配置（浅层快速权重网络、适当的正则化）已能取得与强基线相当的效果。

papers.title: MemWM: Memory-Augmented Text-Based World Model
papers.abstract_en: World models are increasingly used to support planning in agents by predicting how environment states evolve in response to agent actions. Yet fluent next-state predictions can still omit task-critical facts, corrupt product attributes, or apply incorrect transition rules. To address such systematic prediction errors, we introduce MemWM, a memory-augmented text-based world model. MemWM uses world memory, a curated memory bank of transition rules, state caches, and hard-to-predict facts, to condition next-state imagination. We evaluate factual state preservation with Structured State Fidelity (SSF), which scores predicted states through benchmark-specific facts and fields. Compared with SFT, memory-augmented training improves SSF by up to 206.3%. In the full planning setting, we keep the policy model frozen and provide policy-side world skill: retrieved task-level skills and step-wise corrective guidance for action selection. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld, memory-augmented agents improve downstream success over an SFT-trained world-model agent, with up to a 65.4% relative gain. Sensitivity analyses further show that retrieved memory improves task success and efficiency under different memory and action-budget settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MemWM，一种基于记忆增强的文本世界模型（text-based world model），用于改善智能体对下一状态的预测和规划。MemWM 使用世界记忆（world memory）——包含转移规则、状态缓存和难预测事实的精选记忆库——来条件化下一状态想象，并提出结构化状态保真度（SSF）指标评估事实状态保持。在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 ScienceWorld 等环境中，记忆增强的智能体相比 SFT 训练的 world-model 智能体在规划成功率上有提升。
Motivation: 现有的文本世界模型虽然能生成流畅的下一状态预测，但可能遗漏任务关键事实、破坏产品属性或应用错误的转移规则，导致系统性预测错误，进而影响智能体的规划性能。
Method: MemWM 引入世界记忆（world memory）作为记忆增强模块，对下一状态想象进行条件化；同时提出结构化状态保真度（SSF）来按基准特有的事实和字段对预测状态打分。在规划设置中，保持策略模型冻结，并通过检索到的任务级技能和逐步纠正性指导提供策略侧的世界技能。
Result: 相比 SFT，记忆增强训练将 SSF 最高提升 206.3%；在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 ScienceWorld 的完整规划设置中，记忆增强智能体相比 SFT 训练的 world-model 智能体在下游成功率上最高获得 65.4% 的相对提升。敏感性分析显示，在不同记忆和动作预算设置下，检索到的记忆改善了任务成功率与效率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过外置记忆库对预测和规划进行条件化，可以有效缓解文本世界模型中的系统性预测错误，并在多个文本环境中带来可观的规划性能提升。

papers.title: Synthetic LiDAR Data Generation and Deterministic Downsampling for Point Cloud Classification on the Edge
papers.abstract_en: Deploying three-dimensional deep learning frameworks to low-power embedded processors is bottlenecked by the unstructured nature of spatial data and the resource-intensive distance sorting algorithms often used before neural network inference. To address this gap, this paper presents a hardware-constrained workflow optimized for native execution on the Raspberry Pi 5. To account for the reality gap between noiseless, clean computer-aided design (CAD) datasets and real-world sensor data, we use physics-based simulation to construct a synthetic LiDAR dataset. Cross-dataset evaluations demonstrate a substantial drop in classification accuracy when networks trained on clean CAD data are evaluated on synthetic LiDAR sensor data, highlighting the critical need for sensor-aware training. To address the latency bottleneck of traditional geometric preprocessing on edge CPUs, we integrate an isolated, feature-driven Critical Points Layer (CPL) as a frontend filter. Our results show that the pretrained CPL deterministically compresses raw 1024-point clouds to a subset of 40 to 60 unique coordinates. When profiled on the ARM Cortex-A76 processor, the complete pipeline achieves an inference throughput of approximately 50 FPS while maintaining an instance classification accuracy of 88.36%, demonstrating the viability of deterministic real-time 3D perception at the edge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对在低功耗嵌入式处理器上部署三维点云分类模型的问题，提出一套面向 Raspberry Pi 5 原生执行的硬件约束工作流。作者利用基于物理的仿真构建合成 LiDAR 数据集，并设计了一个作为前端滤波器的 Critical Points Layer (CPL)，对原始 1024 点云进行确定性压缩。在 ARM Cortex-A76 上，完整流程达到约 50 FPS 的推理吞吐，实例分类准确率为 88.36%，验证了边缘端确定性实时 3D 感知的可行性。
Motivation: 将三维深度学习框架部署到低功耗嵌入式处理器时，空间数据的非结构化特性以及推理前常用的距离排序算法构成资源瓶颈；同时，干净 CAD 数据与真实传感器数据之间存在现实差距 (reality gap)。
Method: 提出一个硬件约束的端侧工作流：用物理仿真生成合成 LiDAR 数据以模拟传感器噪声，并集成一个独立的、基于特征的 Critical Points Layer (CPL) 作为前端滤波器，在神经网络推理前对点云进行确定性降采样。
Result: 跨数据集评估显示，在干净 CAD 数据上训练的模型迁移到合成 LiDAR 数据时分类准确率显著下降，说明传感器感知训练的必要性；预训练的 CPL 可将 1024 点云确定性压缩到 40 至 60 个唯一坐标，完整流程在 ARM Cortex-A76 上达到约 50 FPS，并保持 88.36% 的实例分类准确率。
Conclusion: 作者认为，确定性实时 3D 感知可在边缘端实现，且传感器感知的训练数据对于缩小仿真与真实数据之间的差距至关重要。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: International Transfer of Stochastic Cortical Self-Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Stochastic cortical self-reconstruction (SCSR) enables personalized mapping of gray matter atrophy, a hallmark of neurodegenerative disorders such as Alzheimer's disease (AD), onto high-resolution cortical surfaces. Unlike conventional normative modeling approaches, which typically operate at a coarse regional level and remain inherently constrained by the covariates included during training, SCSR estimates an individualized healthy reference directly from the observed cortical thickness at the vertex level. This allows the detection of subtle, subject-specific deviations from healthy cortical shape. In this work, we investigate the generalization and transferability of SCSR, originally trained on UK Biobank (UKB) data, to an independent Chinese population dataset. Specifically, we evaluate the ability of SCSR-derived Z-scores to discriminate between healthy scans, individuals with mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and patients with AD, while also assessing model robustness across the lifespan. We compare four training strategies: direct application of the UKB-trained model, fine-tuning on Chinese data, training from scratch, and joint training on UKB and Chinese cohorts. As reconstruction backbones, we consider both a multilayer perceptron (MLP) and a Spherical UNet (SUNet). Our results demonstrate that SCSR provides robust detection of cortical atrophy in the Chinese population across all evaluated models. The highest discriminative performance was achieved by the fine-tuned SUNet model (average pairwise AUC = 0.848), followed closely by the UKB-trained SUNet. Moreover, reconstruction errors remained low across the lifespan, even when the training population exhibited a substantially narrower age distribution, indicating strong cross-population transferability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究随机皮层自重建（Stochastic Cortical Self-Reconstruction, SCSR）从 UK Biobank 训练模型向独立中国人群数据集的跨群体迁移能力，SCSR 在顶点级从观测皮层厚度估计个体化健康参考，并计算 Z-score 以检测细微信号。作者比较四种训练策略（直接应用、微调、从零训练、联合训练）与两种重建骨干（MLP 与 Spherical UNet），发现所有模型均能稳健检测中国人群的皮层萎缩，其中微调 SUNet 取得最高判别表现，平均成对 AUC 为 0.848。
Motivation: 传统规范建模通常在粗区域水平运行，且受训练时纳入的协变量约束，难以检测细微的个体特异性偏离；SCSR 能从顶点级皮层厚度估计个体化健康参考，但需要验证其跨人群泛化性，尤其是从 UKB 数据集迁移到独立中国人群。
Method: 使用 SCSR 在顶点级重建健康皮层参考并生成 Z-score，用于区分健康、轻度认知障碍（MCI）与阿尔茨海默病（AD）；比较直接应用 UKB 训练模型、在中国数据上微调、从零训练以及 UKB 与中国人群联合训练四种策略，并以多层感知机（MLP）和 Spherical UNet（SUNet）作为重建骨干。
Result: 摘要报告所有评估模型均能在中国人群中稳健检测皮层萎缩；微调后的 SUNet 取得最高判别性能（平均 pairwise AUC = 0.848），UKB 训练的 SUNet 紧随其后；即使在训练人群年龄分布明显更窄的情况下，重建误差在整个生命周期内仍保持较低水平。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 SCSR 具有较强的跨人群可迁移性，可将 UKB 上训练的模型有效应用于中国人群的皮层萎缩检测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Human-Centered Explainable AI for TinyML Edge Devices: A Pareto-Based Selection Framework with LLM-Guided Design
papers.abstract_en: Edge Artificial Intelligence (Edge AI) enables the deployment of AI models directly on local edge devices, while such deployments are subject to strict resource constraints, particularly in clinical applications requiring local and timely inference. In such contexts, explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) can serve as a human-AI interface intended to support healthcare professionals' and patients' understanding of model predictions and informed decision-making. To fulfill this role, XAI method selection for TinyML deployments can be formulated as a human-centered multi-objective design problem that jointly considers qualitative stakeholder preferences, explanation quality, and proxy-based deployment cost. We propose a framework that integrates a large language model (LLM)-guided design interface that maps qualitative stakeholder preferences to candidate XAI methods, followed by deterministic feasibility filtering and Pareto-based optimization. The framework exposes trade-offs among explanation fidelity, stability, and proxy-based deployment cost while characterizing their implications for explanation quality and estimated deployment feasibility. A proof-of-concept evaluation on a skin lesion classification task illustrates how the framework systematically compares candidate XAI methods and identifies Pareto-efficient trade-offs. The present evaluation covers the computational selection stages, while physical MCU deployment and empirical human-expert validation remain outside the scope of this study.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出面向 TinyML 边缘设备的人类中心可解释 AI (XAI) 方法选择框架，将 XAI 方法选择建模为多目标设计问题，集成 LLM 引导的设计接口、确定性可行性过滤和基于帕累托的优化，在皮肤病变分类任务上进行概念验证。摘要强调该方法暴露解释保真度、稳定性和代理部署成本之间的权衡，但物理 MCU 部署和人工专家验证不在研究范围内。
Motivation: 边缘设备上的 AI 部署受严格资源约束，尤其在临床应用中需要本地和及时推理，而 XAI 作为人机接口需要同时考虑利益相关者偏好、解释质量和部署成本，现有方法难以系统处理这种多目标权衡。
Method: 框架首先用大语言模型 (LLM) 将定性利益相关者偏好映射到候选 XAI 方法，然后进行确定性可行性过滤，最后基于帕累托优化比较候选方法并识别帕累托有效权衡。
Result: 在皮肤病变分类任务上的概念验证表明，该框架能系统比较候选 XAI 方法并识别帕累托有效的权衡；当前评估仅覆盖计算选择阶段。
Conclusion: 该研究验证了人类中心多目标框架在 TinyML 场景下选择 XAI 方法的可行性，但物理 MCU 部署和人类专家经验验证留待未来工作。

papers.title: RoRA: Role-Oriented Regional Allocation for Visual Token Pruning in MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) encode images as long visual token sequences, making prefilling and KV-cache storage expensive. Existing training-free pruning methods select tokens by importance, diversity, or spatial coverage, but treat retained tokens as interchangeable and do not explicitly track which object-related regions are already covered. We present RoRA, a training-free framework that casts visual token pruning as role-oriented regional evidence allocation. Given a fixed budget, RoRA partitions tokens into a protected semantic core, complementary context, and fine-grained detail. It first calibrates text-conditioned attention with a positional prior and a prompt-calibrated object prior, then builds Attention-Anchored Regions (AARs) from high-confidence anchors as lightweight proxies for covered object support. Context is explored mainly outside AARs, while a small AAR-guided budget restores local detail; pairwise similarity is used only for context-stage redundancy filtering. Under matched budgets, RoRA consistently outperforms strong training-free baselines across LLaVA and Qwen-VL families, retaining most of the unpruned accuracy even at aggressive pruning ratios, e.g., 96.5% of full performance at 88.9% pruning on LLaVA-1.5, and improving over D2Pruner by about 5% on Qwen3-VL at 75-90% pruning. At a 66.7% pruning ratio, RoRA requires only 0.7 ms for token selection and reduces end-to-end inference time by 24.6%, corresponding to a 1.33x speedup over unpruned inference on an NVIDIA H800.

papers.title: Beyond Isolation: Unlocking Reinforcement Learning Component Synergy for Sample-Efficient Continuous Control
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning systems are significantly more complex than other machine learning paradigms due to inherent properties, causing RL system design to jointly account for many tightly coupled factors. Despite advances in individual algorithmic components, their functional interdependencies remain underexplored: do they exhibit mutual synergy or counterproductive interference? To bridge this gap, we conduct a systematic investigation and find that the efficacy of different components exhibits significant task-dependency, and naively stacking state-of-the-art techniques does not necessarily yield performance gains; instead, it often triggers emergent challenges, such as compounded non-stationarity. Building upon these findings, we distill a suite of actionable insights into the principled coordination of these components. Guided by these insights, we propose ROSER, an RL framework that coordinates three critical dimensions: Model-based Representation, Optimization Stability, and Experience Replay. Across diverse continuous-control benchmarks, ROSER consistently outperforms vanilla baselines and achieves 17.60% gains over naive stack. Our findings underscore the necessity of a holistic perspective in RL system design and paves the way for developing sample-efficient agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统考察强化学习（RL）系统中各算法组件之间的功能依赖关系，发现组件有效性存在显著的任务依赖性，简单堆叠当前最优技术并不总能带来增益，反而常引发复合非平稳性（compounded non-stationarity）等新问题。作者据此提出 ROSER 框架，协调基于模型的表示（Model-based Representation）、优化稳定性（Optimization Stability）与经验回放（Experience Replay）三个关键维度，并在多种连续控制基准上稳定超越朴素堆叠基线。
Motivation: RL 系统因内在特性远比其它机器学习范式复杂，其设计需要联合考虑大量紧密耦合的因素；尽管单个算法组件不断进步，组件间的功能互依性仍未被充分探索，即组件之间究竟相互增益还是相互干扰尚不清楚。
Method: 通过系统性实验揭示组件效果的任务依赖性和盲目堆叠带来的挑战，并据此提炼组件协调的原则性洞见；进而提出 ROSER 框架，统一协调基于模型的表示、优化稳定性和经验回放这三个关键维度。
Result: 在多样化的连续控制基准上，ROSER 一致优于 vanilla 基线，并且相对朴素堆叠（naive stack）实现 17.60% 的性能提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 RL 系统设计需要整体性视角（holistic perspective），组件协调而非孤立优化是提升样本效率的关键，并为开发样本高效的智能体铺路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LifelongCrossNav: Persistent 3D Semantic Memory for Cross-Floor Multi-Object Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Object-goal navigation has made substantial progress in semantic perception and exploration, yet persistent memory for multi-object navigation and cross-floor navigation are still commonly addressed separately. We present LifelongCrossNav, a framework for sequential multi-object ObjectNav in unknown multi-floor indoor environments. Within each episode, the agent receives an ordered sequence of object-goal queries while continuously maintaining a shared sparse 3D semantic voxel memory. This memory incrementally accumulates geometric structure, traversability states, and vision-language features, allowing subsequent object-goal queries to retrieve previously acquired scene information without rebuilding the map. To support persistent search across floors, LifelongCrossNav combines support-aware 3D traversability mapping, stair-specific perception, and direction-aware stair traversal. A unified navigation policy coordinates same-floor frontier exploration, live and historical point-of-interest retrieval, stair navigation, and target-object search and approach. We further introduce HM3D-MFMON, a benchmark for sequential Multi-Floor Multi-Object Navigation built on HM3D scenes, including a dedicated subset in which completing the full sequence of object-goal subtasks requires at least one floor transition. Experimental results show that LifelongCrossNav consistently outperforms a representative planar persistent semantic-map baseline on HM3D-MFMON, demonstrating that persistent 3D semantic memory and cross-floor traversability modeling effectively support sequential multi-object navigation in multi-floor environments. Project page: https://flageval-baai.github.io/LifelongCrossNavPage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LifelongCrossNav，一个用于未知多楼层室内环境中顺序多目标导航 (sequential multi-object ObjectNav) 的框架。智能体在每个 episode 内接收有序的目标查询序列，并持续维护共享的稀疏 3D 语义体素记忆，增量累积几何结构、可通行状态和视觉-语言特征，使后续查询无需重建地图即可检索场景信息。作者还引入基于 HM3D 场景的基准 HM3D-MFMON，其中包含需要至少一次楼层切换才能完成全部子任务的子集。实验显示 LifelongCrossNav 在该基准上持续优于一个代表性的平面持久语义地图基线。
Motivation: 多目标导航所需的持久记忆与跨楼层导航通常被分开处理，现有方法难以在未知多楼层环境中支持顺序多目标查询并重用先前获取的场景信息。
Method: 框架包含共享稀疏 3D 语义体素记忆、支持感知的 3D 可通行性建图、楼梯特定感知、方向感知的楼梯穿越，以及统一导航策略来协调同层前沿探索、实时与历史兴趣点检索、楼梯导航和目标搜索与逼近；同时构建了 HM3D-MFMON 基准评测顺序多楼层多目标导航。
Result: 在 HM3D-MFMON 上，LifelongCrossNav 一致优于代表性平面持久语义地图基线，表明持久 3D 语义记忆和跨楼层可通行性建模能有效支持多楼层环境中的顺序多目标导航。
Conclusion: 摘要强调持久 3D 语义记忆与跨楼层可通行性建模相结合可支撑顺序多目标导航；未提及明确局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Scalable High-Fidelity Macromolecular Docking for GPU-Accelerated Supercomputers
papers.abstract_en: Flexible macromolecular docking offers high-fidelity predictions of biomolecular interactions, but remains prohibitively expensive at scale. Among existing approaches, LightDock leverages Glowworm Swarm Optimization (GSO) for accuracy, yet suffers from limited parallelism, irregular computation, and severe load imbalance, preventing efficient execution on GPU supercomputers. We present SparkleDock, a scalable GSO-based docking framework enabling near-real-time flexible docking. We redesign GSO to expose massive fine-grained parallelism at the glowworm-agent level, and restructure the dominant energy scoring computation into a Tensor Core-compatible formulation, enabling efficient execution of irregular pairwise interactions through structured matrix operations. We further introduce a performance-model-driven scheduling for load balancing and out-of-core scaling across GPUs. SparkleDock achieves 9.7 $\times$ and 18.9 $\times$ speedups over LightDock on single A100 and H100 GPU, and delivers over two orders of magnitude acceleration at scale. On 512 GPUs, it reduces docking time from hours to seconds, enabling large-scale, high-fidelity virtual screening previously impractical with flexible docking.
papers.comment: To be published in the International Conference for High Performance Computing, Networking, Storage, and Analysis(SC) 26
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SparkleDock，一个基于 Glowworm Swarm Optimization (GSO) 的可扩展柔性大分子对接框架，目标是在 GPU 超级计算机上实现近实时的柔性对接。作者将 GSO 重设计为以萤火虫智能体为单位的细粒度并行，并把能量打分计算重构为兼容 Tensor Core 的矩阵形式，同时引入基于性能模型的调度来均衡负载和实现跨 GPU 的 out-of-core 扩展。摘要报告在单块 A100 和 H100 上分别取得对 LightDock 的 9.7 倍和 18.9 倍加速，在 512 块 GPU 上获得超过两个数量级的加速，使原先需要数小时的对接缩短至秒级。
Motivation: 柔性大分子对接虽能提供高保真的生物分子相互作用预测，但计算成本过高，难以大规模应用。现有高精度方法 LightDock 依赖 GSO，却受限于并行度低、计算不规则和严重的负载不均衡，无法在 GPU 超级计算机上高效执行。
Method: SparkleDock 从三个层面重构 GSO 管线的并行性：在 glowworm-agent 级别暴露大规模细粒度并行；将占主导的能量打分计算重构为 Tensor Core 兼容的矩阵运算，以结构化矩阵操作处理不规则成对相互作用；并引入性能模型驱动的调度，实现负载均衡与跨 GPU 的 out-of-core 扩展。
Result: 摘要报告 SparkleDock 在单块 A100 与 H100 GPU 上分别比 LightDock 快 9.7 倍和 18.9 倍，在集群规模下加速超过两个数量级；在 512 块 GPU 上可将对接时间从数小时降至数秒，使此前不切实际的大规模高保真虚拟筛选成为可能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过重设计 GSO 的并行粒度并利用 Tensor Core 与性能模型调度，柔性对接可以在 GPU 超级计算机上获得近实时性能。论文将发表于 SC'26，其声称的效果主要面向大规模虚拟筛选场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Transformers Struggle to Use Their Emergent World Models: Revisiting the Tower of Hanoi, and the Illusion of Thinking
papers.abstract_en: The Tower of Hanoi is a simple planning puzzle that in prior work has proven challenging for large reasoning models (LRMs). Current models solve the standard formulation of the puzzle, but still struggle with the flat-to-flat variant (where initial and goal states are not restricted to have all rings on a single peg). This paper presents an in-depth study of how both small, in-house Transformers and large, third-party LRMs solve this task. To understand the failures mechanistically, we first train small Transformers from scratch on precomputed solution traces. Using a variety of interpretability techniques, we show that these Transformers develop an emergent world model: a linearly decodable, geometrically faithful representation of the puzzle's state space (the Sierpinski triangle), that is causally involved in solving the puzzles. Second, we return to the large LLMs and apply our techniques to two frontier reasoning models, Qwen3.6-27B and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B, that attempt to solve the task through extended chain-of-thought. Surprisingly, we find that both models encode the Sierpinski world model near-perfectly at the end of the prompt, and yet fail at the majority of tasks when there are more than 3 rings. We locate the source of this failure in the decaying representation of the world model. We probe for the representation at different stages during planning, and establish causality by showing that performance can be improved by injecting the prompt-time representation at inference. The failure of the models is thus one of maintenance of the required representations, not their absence, and performance is at least partially recoverable. These results thus reframe the reported collapse in performance from prior work: current Large Reasoning Models build a world model, and then lose it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统地研究小型 Transformer 与大型推理模型（LRM）在解决汉诺塔（Tower of Hanoi）任务时的内部机制。作者先用预计算轨迹从头训练小型 Transformer，借助可解释性技术发现其形成了可线性解码、几何上忠实于谜题状态空间（谢尔宾斯基三角形）的涌现世界模型，并且该表示因果地参与了解题。随后对 Qwen3.6-27B 和 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B 两个前沿推理模型进行相同分析，发现它们在提示词末尾近乎完美地编码了同样的世界模型，但在超过 3 个圆环的大部分任务上仍然失败，原因在于规划过程中表示发生衰减；在推理时注入提示阶段的表示可以部分恢复性能。
Motivation: 已有工作表明大型推理模型能解决标准汉诺塔任务，却在 flat-to-flat 变体（初始和目标状态不限于所有环在单个柱上）上表现不佳。本文旨在从机制上解释这一性能塌陷究竟源于世界模型的缺失还是其维持失败。
Method: 首先在预计算解轨迹上从头训练小型 Transformer，并综合运用多种可解释性技术验证涌现世界模型的存在及其因果作用；随后将同样的探针技术应用于两个通过长思维链（chain-of-thought）解题的前沿推理模型，在不同规划阶段探测表示质量，并通过在推理时注入提示阶段的表示来建立因果性。
Result: 小型 Transformer 中出现了线性可解码、几何上忠实于谢尔宾斯基三角形状态空间的表示。两个大型推理模型在提示末尾对世界模型的编码近乎完美，但在超过 3 个圆环时仍无法完成大多数任务；失败源于规划过程中表示的衰减，而非表示缺失，且注入表示可部分提升性能。
Conclusion: 模型失败的本质是对所需表示的维持（maintenance）问题，而不是表示不存在；性能至少可以部分恢复。这一结果将先前报道的性能塌陷重新框定为：当前大型推理模型先构建了世界模型，然后在推理过程中丢失了它。

papers.title: MemOPD: On-Policy Distillation through Memory State Alignment for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon agents accumulate growing contexts during interaction, impairing performance and stability. Compact memory mitigates this problem by compressing and rewriting the history retained between model invocations. Learning what to retain typically relies on proximal policy optimization (PPO) with final task rewards, but sparse rewards provide little guidance for individual memory updates. This limitation motivates on-policy distillation (OPD), which supplies dense teacher supervision on student rollouts. For such supervision to be valid, the teacher must evaluate each sampled action under the same state in which it was generated. However, the context rewriting performed during memory compression can break this alignment. When sampled responses are retained and re-encoded for later invocations, flattening the interaction into a persistent history may cause the teacher to score the action under a state that the student never visited during rollout. The action therefore remains on-policy by provenance, but not necessarily by state. We therefore propose Memory-Aligned On-Policy Distillation (MemOPD). MemOPD records the inputs and sampled outputs of each model invocation, restores its original token positions and causal visibility, and packs the reconstructed invocations for efficient teacher scoring. The teacher provides full-vocabulary supervision at the sampled action positions, while PPO preserves the final task objective. Experiments verify state alignment across several context updates and show that it improves F1 by 7.0% over persistent-history teacher scoring in a matched control. Overall, MemOPD-3B improves F1 over PPO by up to 416.2%, while packing yields up to a 1.63x speedup in actor computation during training. The code for this work is publicly available at: https://github.com/TPssp/MemOPD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Memory-Aligned On-Policy Distillation (MemOPD)，解决长程 agent 中记忆压缩导致的状态不对齐问题。作者指出，在上下文重写后，teacher 可能在与学生实际访问状态不一致的条件下打分，因此 MemOPD 记录每次模型调用的输入与采样输出、恢复原始 token 位置与因果可见性，并打包重建调用以进行高效的 teacher 评分。实验显示状态对齐在多次上下文更新中保持有效，且相比持久历史 teacher 评分将 F1 提升 7.0%；MemOPD-3B 相比 PPO 将 F1 提升最多 416.2%，打包机制带来最多 1.63 倍的 actor 计算加速。
Motivation: 长程 agent 在与环境交互中积累不断增长的上下文，损害性能与稳定性；紧凑记忆通过压缩和重写历史来缓解问题，但基于 PPO 的稀疏最终任务奖励难以指导单次记忆更新，因此需要稠密监督的 on-policy distillation；而记忆压缩时的上下文重写会破坏 teacher 与学生状态的对齐，导致 teacher 在错误状态下评分。
Method: MemOPD 记录每次模型调用的输入和采样输出，恢复其原始 token 位置和因果可见性，并将重建的调用打包，使 teacher 在采样动作位置提供全词表监督；PPO 保留最终任务目标。
Result: 实验验证了多次上下文更新下的状态对齐，并在匹配对照中相比持久历史 teacher 评分将 F1 提升 7.0%；MemOPD-3B 相比 PPO 将 F1 提升最多 416.2%，打包机制在训练中带来最多 1.63 倍的 actor 计算加速。
Conclusion: 摘要强调记忆状态对齐对 on-policy distillation 有效性至关重要，MemOPD 兼得稠密教师监督与最终任务目标，同时提升长程 agent 性能与训练效率。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: DocMemo: Dynamic Evidence Discovery via Probabilistic Memory-Guided Retrieval for Multi-Modal Document Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Long-document understanding requires locating sparse and heterogeneous evidence across hundreds of pages, yet existing systems remain limited by static retrieval and fragile cross-round memory. Mainstream single-round methods commit to a fixed top-$k$ page set at the outset and struggle to recover from early retrieval errors; recent iterative approaches allow multi-round evidence acquisition, but they do not investigate the propagation mechanism of cross-round states, making it difficult to track the dynamic changes in page relevance. To address these limitations, we propose DocMemo, a memory-guided framework that formulates long-document reasoning as dynamic evidence exploration. DocMemo maintains a tri-level retrieval state consisting of Document Schema Memory, Page Belief Memory, and Question Episodic Memory, which respectively capture structural priors, dynamic relevance estimation, and query-specific reasoning trajectories. During reasoning, DocMemo continuously refines cross-round page selection through Bayesian page belief updating with Thompson sampling, spatial proximity propagation, and structure-aware adaptive-granularity evidence access, while supplementing page-level evidence with fine-grained visual regions. Experiments on 3 benchmarks show that DocMemo achieves state-of-the-art performance and validate the efficacy of structured memory and dynamic page belief updating. Code is available at https://github.com/Harrygof/DocMemo.
papers.comment: DocMemo is a memory-guided framework for long-document reasoning that uses tri-level memory and dynamic Bayesian belief updating to overcome static retrieval limits and improve evidence tracking. 16 pages, 4 figures, 14 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DocMemo 是一个面向多模态长文档理解的记忆引导检索框架，将长文档推理建模为动态证据探索。它维护三层检索状态（Document Schema Memory、Page Belief Memory、Question Episodic Memory），通过贝叶斯页面信念更新、Thompson 采样、空间邻近传播和结构感知的自适应粒度证据访问来跨轮修正页面选择，并用细粒度视觉区域补充页面级证据。在 3 个基准上取得 state-of-the-art 性能。
Motivation: 现有单轮方法一开始就固定 top-k 页面集合，难以从早期检索错误中恢复；迭代式方法虽支持多轮证据获取，但没有研究跨轮状态的传播机制，导致难以追踪页面相关性的动态变化。
Method: 提出 tri-level memory 框架，分别用 Document Schema Memory、Page Belief Memory、Question Episodic Memory 编码结构先验、动态相关性估计和查询专属推理轨迹；推理过程中通过带 Thompson 采样的贝叶斯页面信念更新、空间邻近传播以及结构感知的自适应粒度证据访问来持续精炼跨轮页面选择。
Result: 在 3 个基准上的实验显示 DocMemo 达到 state-of-the-art 性能，并验证了结构化记忆与动态页面信念更新的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调使用结构化记忆和动态页面信念更新可以克服静态检索与脆弱跨轮记忆带来的限制，并公开了代码仓库；其应用范围聚焦于长文档多模态理解，未涉及天气或降水相关任务。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: PTQ4SNN: Membrane-Aware Post-Training Quantization for Spiking Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) enable sparse and event-driven computation, but their low-bit deployment remains incomplete because recurrent membrane states are commonly retained in floating point even after weight quantization. Quantizing these states is challenging because their distributions differ across channels and from the preceding weights, while small perturbations near the firing threshold may alter spike decisions and accumulate over time. We propose PTQ4SNN, a membrane-aware post-training quantization framework that jointly quantizes weights and recurrent membrane states using only a small calibration set. First, a channel-wise Unified Scale Bridge constrains the membrane scale as s_mem,c = s_w,c * 2^k_c, adapting to membrane distributions while enabling shift-compatible scale conversion. Second, Mixed-Precision Bit Allocation assigns 2/4/8-bit precision to membrane channels according to firing activity and quantization sensitivity under an average-bit budget. The framework operates on reusable projection-LIF pairs and supports both convolutional SNNs and spike-driven Transformers without backbone retraining. Experiments on static and event-based classification and semantic segmentation show that PTQ4SNN effectively preserves model accuracy under W4 quantization and approximately 4-bit membrane precision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PTQ4SNN，一个面向脉冲神经网络 (SNN) 的膜电位感知后训练量化框架，用少量校准集联合量化权重和循环膜电位。其核心是通道级 Unified Scale Bridge，将膜电位尺度约束为 s_mem,c = s_w,c * 2^k_c，配合按发放活动与量化敏感性分配 2/4/8 位精度的 Mixed-Precision Bit Allocation。框架可作用于可复用的 projection-LIF 对，无需重训练骨干网络，支持卷积 SNN 和 spike-driven Transformer。实验覆盖静态与事件驱动分类及语义分割，表明在 W4 权重和约 4 位膜电位精度下能保持精度。
Motivation: SNN 低比特部署不完整，因为即使在权重量化后，循环膜电位 (recurrent membrane states) 仍通常以浮点保留。膜电位分布跨通道不同且与前置权重不同，且接近发放阈值的小扰动可能改变脉冲决策并随时间累积，导致量化困难。
Method: 提出膜电位感知的后训练量化框架 PTQ4SNN：首先用通道级 Unified Scale Bridge 将膜电位尺度约束为与权重尺度相关的移位兼容形式；其次用 Mixed-Precision Bit Allocation 在平均位宽预算下根据发放活跃度和量化敏感度分配 2/4/8 位精度。整个流程在可复用的 projection-LIF 对上运行，不需要对骨干网络重训练。
Result: 在静态与事件驱动分类以及语义分割任务上的实验表明，PTQ4SNN 在 W4 权重量化和约 4 位膜电位精度的设置下能有效保持模型精度。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架无需重训练即可联合量化 SNN 的权重与循环膜电位，并同时支持卷积 SNN 和 spike-driven Transformer 的部署。

papers.title: AutoIntervene: Calibrated Intervention for Action-Chunking Imitation Learning Policies
papers.abstract_en: Action-chunking visuomotor policies learn from demonstrations and improve temporal consistency by predicting short action sequences rather than single-step commands. Yet perception errors and execution drift can move the robot outside the demonstration distribution, while the policy continues to produce smooth action chunks that are inconsistent with the observed state. We present AutoIntervene, an online framework that selectively transfers control between an action-chunking policy and an operator during deployment. AutoIntervene evaluates proposed chunks against a visual-action support memory built from successful task executions, combining visual similarity with consistency between proposed and reference actions. Phase-local support governs policy-to-operator transfer within the current task phase, whereas global support governs the return to policy control after operator recovery. We calibrate separate switching thresholds for the two directions from empirical quantiles of evaluation-level scores on held-out expert demonstrations, avoiding direct manual tuning of score cutoffs. Intervention segments retained from successful rollouts target learner-induced states and provide corrective supervision for subsequent policy updates. Experiments on real-world bimanual manipulation tasks show higher post-adaptation task success and lower operator-control time than manual intervention. Videos and additional results are available at https://aus.bot/research/autointervene/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AutoIntervene，一个面向 action-chunking 模仿学习策略的在线干预框架，在部署时选择性地在策略与操作员之间转移控制。它利用由成功任务执行构建的视觉-动作支持记忆 (visual-action support memory) 评估候选动作块，并结合视觉相似性与参考动作一致性来判断是否需要干预。实验在真实双手操作任务上显示，相比手动干预，该方法获得了更高的适应后任务成功率并降低了操作员控制时间。
Motivation: Action-chunking 视觉运动策略会预测短动作序列以提升时间一致性，但感知错误和执行漂移可能使机器人偏离演示分布，而策略仍持续输出与当前状态不一致的平滑动作块。
Method: AutoIntervene 在线框架使用视觉-动作支持记忆评估候选动作块；phase-local support 控制当前任务阶段内策略到操作员的转移，global support 控制操作员恢复后返回策略控制的时机。两个方向的切换阈值分别从留出专家演示上评估分数的经验分位数标定，避免手动调节分数阈值；成功回滚保留的干预片段用于对后续策略更新提供纠正性监督。
Result: 在真实世界的双手操作任务上，该方法相比手动干预取得更高的适应后任务成功率，并降低操作员控制时间。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过经验分位数标定的非对称切换阈值可以实现免手动调参的在线干预，且干预片段可作为后续策略更新的纠正监督来源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Soft Redaction of Image Provenance via Zero-Knowledge Proofs
papers.abstract_en: Content provenance standards, such as C2PA, are increasingly used to attach signed records of origin, editing history, and rights to digital images. However, provenance transparency can conflict with privacy -- assertions that strengthen trust in an image may also reveal sensitive information about the creator or capture context. We propose soft redaction for image provenance: a mechanism that replaces sensitive provenance assertions with zero-knowledge proofs (ZKPs) of selected properties over hidden data. Our work focuses on distance proofs. We first show how location assertions can support proofs of proximity to a public reference point, using Chebyshev polynomial approximations within the ZKP proof circuit. We then extend the approach to L2 distance proofs over biometric embeddings, enabling privacy-preserving claims related to likeness to help enforce personality rights with images. Finally, we apply the same distance-proof construction to perceptual hashes (visual fingerprints), supporting an anti-spoofing use case in watermark-based recovery of stripped provenance metadata. Our results demonstrate that ZKPs over image provenance can provide practical soft-redaction capabilities, compatible with C2PA, that may be constructed in seconds and verified in milliseconds.
papers.comment: To appear at ECCV 2026 workshop on Privacy Fairness Accountability and Transparency in Computer Vision (PFATCV)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对内容溯源标准（如 C2PA）在增强图像可信度的同时可能泄露创作者隐私信息的问题，提出软编辑剔除（soft redaction）机制：用零知识证明（ZKP）替换敏感的溯源断言，仅证明隐藏数据上满足的选定性质。工作围绕距离证明展开：先通过 Chebyshev 多项式近似在 ZKP 电路中实现位置断言到公共参考点的邻近证明，再扩展为生物特征嵌入上的 L2 距离证明，并将同一距离证明结构应用于感知哈希以支持基于水印的反欺骗恢复。摘要报告该方案兼容 C2PA，可在数秒内构建、毫秒级验证。
Motivation: C2PA 等内容溯源标准通过签名记录图像的来源、编辑历史和权利，但透明性可能与隐私冲突：增强可信度的断言也可能泄露创作者或拍摄环境的敏感信息。
Method: 提出软剔除机制，用 ZKP 证明隐藏数据的选定性质而非公开断言本身；具体实现三类距离证明：位置邻近证明（基于 Chebyshev 多项式近似）、生物特征嵌入的 L2 距离证明（用于相似度主张以支持人格权），以及感知哈希上的同一距离证明结构（用于反欺骗与恢复被剥离的溯源元数据）。
Result: 摘要报告结果显示，基于图像溯源的 ZKP 可提供实用的软剔除能力，兼容 C2PA，证明可在秒级构建、毫秒级验证。
Conclusion: 作者强调软剔除能够在隐藏敏感属性数据的同时保持溯源的验证能力，并表明该距离证明方案具备实际可行性；论文聚焦于距离证明这一类性质。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Explanation Stability of Test-Time Adaptation in Computational Pathology: A Large-Scale Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Test-time adaptation (TTA) has become a practical way to adapt deployed models to unlabeled target data, a setting that is especially relevant in computational pathology where staining, scanner, and cohort shifts are routine. While most TTA methods are evaluated by their effect on accuracy, clinical use also depends on whether the model's explanations remain reliable after adaptation. In this paper, we take a closer look at this largely unmeasured effect. We study explanation stability under TTA across two histopathology benchmarks, Camelyon17 and NCT CRC-HE, using five architectures ranging from convolutional networks to vision transformers and a pathology foundation model, seventeen TTA methods, and four attribution families. Across 2,958 adaptation runs, we observe a clear and systematic pattern: TTA methods differ sharply in how much they move model explanations, with frozen-backbone methods leaving attributions almost unchanged and continual methods such as CoTTA and RoTTA causing the largest drift. This effect is not uniform. Convolutional networks are substantially more sensitive than transformer and foundation-model backbones, and explanation drift increases with adaptation strength while remaining largely insensitive to batch size. Surprisingly, explanation stability is only weakly coupled to adaptation quality. Some methods preserve explanations almost perfectly while degrading calibration or accuracy, producing silent failures that would be missed by accuracy-only or explanation-only evaluation. These findings show that explanation stability is a distinct reliability axis for TTA in computational pathology. We release the metric, protocol, and full benchmark to support future work on adaptation methods that are not only accurate, but also stable and clinically auditable. Code: https://github.com/bahumanyarg11/tta-explanation-stability-pipeline
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对计算病理学中测试时自适应 (test-time adaptation, TTA) 的解释稳定性进行了大规模基准研究，覆盖 Camelyon17 和 NCT CRC-HE 两个基准、五种架构、十七种 TTA 方法和四种归因方法族，共 2,958 次自适应运行。结果显示 TTA 方法在解释漂移上差异显著，冻结骨干的方法几乎不改变归因，而 CoTTA、RoTTA 等持续学习方法引起最大漂移；解释稳定性与自适应质量仅弱耦合，可能产生准确性或解释性评估无法发现的静默失败。
Motivation: 临床部署中的 TTA 方法通常只用准确性评估，但临床使用还要求模型在自适应后保持解释可靠；解释稳定性这一维度在很大程度上未被度量，作者希望系统量化该效应。
Method: 构建大规模基准协议，在两种组织病理学基准上，跨五种架构（含卷积网络、视觉 Transformer 和病理基础模型）、十七种 TTA 方法与四种归因方法族，运行 2,958 次自适应实验，并公开指标、协议和完整基准。
Result: 发现冻结骨干方法几乎不改变归因，持续学习方法（如 CoTTA、RoTTA）导致最大解释漂移；卷积网络比 Transformer 和基础模型骨干更敏感，解释漂移随自适应强度增加，但对批大小基本不敏感；解释稳定性与自适应质量仅弱相关，存在精度或校准下降而解释几乎不变的情况。
Conclusion: 作者认为解释稳定性是 TTA 在计算病理学中的一个独立可靠性轴，并发布指标、协议和基准，以支持未来开发不仅准确而且稳定、可临床审计的自适应方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: KnifeHunter: Structured Local Representation Learning for Fine-Grained Knife Image Retrieval in Law Enforcement
papers.abstract_en: Knife-enabled violence presents a major public safety challenge, and law enforcement agencies require scalable tools for catalogue-level knife identification, intelligence analysis, and source attribution. Manual visual comparison is specialist, time-consuming, and difficult to scale under operational imaging conditions. We introduce KnifeHunter, an end-to-end forensic knife image retrieval system developed with UK law enforcement. The work contributes the KnifeHunter dataset, comprising 25,843 images across 543 knife classes from police evidence, retail catalogues, and border-force seizures, with structured metadata, Medium/Hard evaluation protocols, and large-scale distractor evaluation. We further propose CoRe-Net, a compact single-descriptor retrieval architecture that combines global context with spatially localised discriminative evidence. CoRe-Net introduces Structured Complementary Representation Learning (SCRL) to organise local evidence into complementary prototype-based representations, and Bi-Directional Reciprocal Fusion (BDRF) to integrate global and local evidence through residual projection and gated local-to-global injection. Using an EVA02-Base backbone and cosine-similarity retrieval, CoRe-Net achieves 88.0% mAP and 86.7% mP@10 on the Medium protocol, and 85.1% mAP and 83.8% mP@10 under distractor conditions. KnifeHunter was deployed by UK police forces during Operation Sceptre deployments from 2023 to 2025, achieving 99.2% mP@1 on field queries. These results demonstrate a practical and effective multimedia retrieval framework for fine-grained forensic knife matching in operational law-enforcement settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 KnifeHunter，一个与英国执法部门合作开发的端到端法医刀具图像检索系统。作者贡献了包含 25,843 张图像、543 个刀具类别的数据集，以及配套的 Medium/Hard 评估协议和大规模干扰项评估。提出的 CoRe-Net 通过结构化互补表示学习（SCRL）和双向倒数融合（BDRF）结合全局与局部证据，在检索基准上取得较高指标，并在 2023-2025 年的 Operation Sceptre 实际部署中获得 99.2% 的 mP@1。
Motivation: 刀具暴力是重大公共安全挑战，执法机构需要可扩展的目录级刀具识别、情报分析和来源溯源工具；人工视觉比对专业性强、耗时且难以在操作性成像条件下规模化。
Method: 提出端到端法医刀具图像检索系统 KnifeHunter，包含 25,843 张图像、543 个类别的数据集（源自警方证据、零售目录和边境部队缴获物品）及结构化元数据。核心是 CoRe-Net 架构，采用 EVA02-Base 骨干和余弦相似度检索，通过 SCRL 将局部证据组织为互补的基于原型的表示，并用 BDRF 以残差投影和门控局部到全局注入整合全局与局部证据。
Result: CoRe-Net 在 Medium 协议上达到 88.0% mAP 和 86.7% mP@10，在干扰项条件下达到 85.1% mAP 和 83.8% mP@10；在 Operation Sceptre 2023-2025 实际部署中，现场查询的 mP@1 为 99.2%。
Conclusion: 结果表明该方法为执法场景下的细粒度法医刀具匹配提供了实用且有效的多媒体检索框架，并已在英国警方的实际操作中得到部署验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BONSAI: Evolvability-Guided Tree Search over Skills
papers.abstract_en: A skill is a naturallanguage document that steers a frozen agent whose weights cannot be updated so any capability the agent lacks must be supplied in prose Optimising a skill is therefore optimising text against a score and the standard recipe which keeps any edit that raises a heldout score is blind in a specific way a single score cannot tell a document perched on a narrow overfit spike from one resting on a broad plateau even though only the second can still be improved We introduce BONSAI a novel skilloptimisation framework that steers instead by evolvability the capacity of a region of documentspace to keep producing viable variation under further mutation a property biology treats as separate from present fitness BONSAI grows skills as a MonteCarlo search tree in which every child document is a mutation of its parent and descends it under an upperconfidence selection rule whose exploitation term blends a skills own fitness with the fitness of its mutational neighbourhood Because every child is a mutation the mean score recorded beneath a node estimates that neighbourhoods evolvability at no extra cost so the rule concentrates budget on regions that keep improving while its exploration term keeps a currently weak branch in contention BONSAI ships the single bestscoring document it finds at no cost beyond the acceptifbetter loop it replaces With a frozen 30B agent and averaged over three benchmarks BONSAI lifts heldout accuracy over the skillfree agent by 2313 points and improves on two budgetmatched baselines GEPA and SkillOpt by 387 and 397 points respectively
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BONSAI，一个用于优化自然语言技能（skill）文档的框架，目标是让不可更新权重的冻结智能体通过文本获得新能力。BONSAI 将技能优化建模为蒙特卡洛树搜索（Monte Carlo tree search）：每个子文档是父文档的突变，并用融合自适应评分与突变邻域得分的上限置信选择来引导搜索。摘要报告在冻结的 30B 智能体上，BONSAI 较无技能基线平均提升 23.13 个百分点，并优于两个预算匹配的基线 GEPA 和 SkillOpt。
Motivation: 标准的 accept-if-better 技能优化只根据单一保留分数决定是否保留编辑，无法区分位于窄的过拟合尖峰上的文档与位于宽平台上的文档；只有后者仍可能被继续改进，因此需要以可进化性（evolvability）作为优化引导。
Method: BONSAI 将技能文档作为蒙特卡洛搜索树中的节点，每个孩子是父节点的突变；搜索采用上限置信（upper-confidence）选择规则，其利用项结合技能自身适应度与其突变邻域的平均得分，从而以零额外成本估计邻域的可进化性，探索项则让当前较弱的分支保持竞争。最终返回搜索中找到的最佳得分文档。

papers.title: Unsupervised Adaptation of PDE Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained partial differential equation (PDE) foundation models can generalize across different equations, but adapting them to unseen PDE systems typically requires dense solution data, which is often expensive or unavailable. To address this limitation, we propose an unsupervised PDE-based finetuning framework that eliminates the need for ground-truth solutions. We first pretrain a neighborhood attention Transformer on diverse time-dependent PDEs spanning varying spatial scales, yielding transferable representations across heterogeneous equations. In the adaptation stage, we construct a physics-based objective using the PDE residual and boundary conditions, and finetune the model on unseen equations via low-rank adaptation (LoRA). To address the uneven learning across physical quantities in standard LoRA, we introduce NSLoRA, a Newton-Schulz orthogonalized variant that rebalances adaptation. Our method achieves performance comparable to supervised LoRA finetuning without requiring any ground-truth solutions, while consistently outperforming competitive neural operator baselines and recent PDE foundation models across heterogeneous PDE benchmarks spanning multiple spatial dimensions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需真实解数据的无监督 PDE 基础模型微调框架。作者先在不同时间依赖且空间尺度多样的 PDE 上预训练邻域注意力 Transformer，再在适应阶段用 PDE 残差与边界条件构造物理目标，通过低秩适应 (LoRA) 微调未见方程；并针对标准 LoRA 在物理量上学习不均衡的问题引入 NSLoRA。实验显示其性能与有监督 LoRA 微调相当，且优于多种神经算子基线和现有 PDE 基础模型。
Motivation: 预训练的 PDE 基础模型虽能跨方程泛化，但适应未见 PDE 系统通常需要密集的真实解数据，而这类数据常因成本高或不可得而缺乏。
Method: 构建无监督微调框架：先用覆盖不同空间尺度的时变 PDE 预训练邻域注意力 Transformer，再以 PDE 残差和边界条件作为损失微调；微调采用 LoRA 并引入经 Newton-Schulz 正交化改进的 NSLoRA 以重平衡不同物理量的学习。
Result: 摘要报告该方法无需任何真实解即可达到与监督 LoRA 微调相当的性能，并在跨多个空间维度的异构 PDE 基准上稳定优于竞争性神经算子基线与近期 PDE 基础模型。
Conclusion: 作者认为无监督的 PDE 物理约束微调可以有效替代依赖真实解的有监督适应，NSLoRA 则缓解了标准 LoRA 在物理量间学习不均衡的问题。
