papers.title: YOLO-PEFT: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning on YOLO Family
papers.abstract_en: Generic parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods transferred from language models can fail silently on real-time detectors, whose heterogeneous operators and detection-specific components impose placement constraints absent from regular Transformer stacks. We propose YOLO-PEFT, a structure-aware framework that formulates adapter placement as an auditable constraint-planning problem. Given a detector graph, a PEFT request, and a resource budget, YOLO-PEFT assigns operator and semantic roles, evaluates explicit operator-validity, detector-semantic, graph-interface, and deployment predicates, records a reason code for each excluded module, and either emits a budgeted target-module plan or returns Refuse before training. Under the official VOC07+12 trainval-to-VOC07 test protocol, planner-selected RS-LoRA reaches 0.7138 and 0.7307 mAP50-95 on YOLO11s and YOLO12s, respectively, compared with 0.6428 and 0.6662 for Full-SFT. On RT-DETR-L, all seven evaluated LoRA-family configurations cross the predefined catastrophic threshold, supporting a calibrated Refuse-to-Full-SFT decision within the evaluated coverage. A controlled YOLO11 audit further shows that LoRA reduces peak training memory by 43.9 percent, although training takes 1.72 times longer. Within the evaluated detector families, placement policies, and calibration coverage, YOLO-PEFT replaces manual target-module trial and error with explicit, inspectable planning while preserving verified train-save-merge-export paths; refusal on unseen detector architectures remains an open validation problem. Project Page: github.com/Tencent/YOLO-Master
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 YOLO-PEFT，一种面向 YOLO 系列实时检测器的结构感知参数高效微调框架，将适配器放置形式化为可审计的约束规划问题。摘要报告在 VOC07+12 协议下，规划器选出的 RS-LoRA 在 YOLO11s 和 YOLO12s 上分别达到 0.7138 和 0.7307 mAP50-95，优于 Full-SFT；在 RT-DETR-L 上所有 LoRA 变体均低于预设阈值，从而支持校准后的 Refuse-to-Full-SFT 决策。
Motivation: 从语言模型迁移的通用 PEFT 方法在实时检测器上可能静默失效，因为检测器具有异构算子和检测特定组件，其放置约束不同于常规 Transformer 堆栈。
Method: 提出结构感知框架，将适配器放置建模为可审计的约束规划问题：给定检测器图、PEFT 请求和资源预算，分配算子与语义角色，评估算子有效性、检测语义、图接口和部署谓词，为每个被排除模块记录原因码，并输出预算化的目标模块计划或在训练前返回拒绝。
Result: 在 VOC07+12 trainval-to-VOC07 测试协议下，规划器选择的 RS-LoRA 在 YOLO11s 和 YOLO12s 上达到 0.7138 和 0.7307 mAP50-95，而 Full-SFT 分别为 0.6428 和 0.6662；在 RT-DETR-L 上七种 LoRA 配置均超过预设灾难阈值。YOLO11 审计显示 LoRA 将峰值训练内存降低 43.9%，但训练耗时延长 1.72 倍。
Conclusion: 在所评估的检测器家族、放置策略和校准覆盖范围内，YOLO-PEFT 用显式可检查的规划替代手动目标模块试错，并保留经过验证的 train-save-merge-export 路径；对未见检测器架构的拒绝行为仍是开放验证问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: C2Dex: Contact-Consistent Reconstruction and Retargeting for Dexterous Manipulation from Monocular Video
papers.abstract_en: High-quality demonstrations for dexterous robot manipulation are costly and difficult to collect, whereas monocular human videos provide a scalable source of diverse manipulation behaviors. However, transferring such demonstrations to dexterous robots remains challenging: monocular hand-object interaction (HOI) reconstruction often produces temporally unstable contacts and physically implausible interactions, while conventional retargeting methods struggle to preserve task-relevant contacts and local interaction geometry across different hand embodiments. We present C2Dex, a video-to-dexterous-manipulation framework built around a shared interaction representation: stable object-side contacts recovered by aggregating noisy frame-wise observations in the canonical object space. These stable contacts serve a dual role: as trajectory-level constraints that guide reconstruction toward temporally coherent and physically plausible human HOI trajectories, and as explicit transfer targets for the dexterous hand, where Laplacian interaction optimization preserves the local hand-object geometry across embodiments and residual reinforcement learning refines the trajectory in simulation. Experiments on DexYCB and TACO show that C2Dex achieves end-to-end trajectory success rates of 57.78% and 26.67%, respectively, substantially outperforming the strongest baselines (17.78% and 10.00%) under identical evaluation criteria. Real-robot replay experiments further demonstrate physical feasibility across diverse contact-rich manipulation tasks. Project page: https://k-jie.github.io/C2Dex/
papers.comment: 9 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L). Project page: https://k-jie.github.io/C2Dex/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 C2Dex，一个从单目视频重建人手-物体交互 (HOI) 并将其重定向到灵巧机器人的框架。核心是共享交互表示：在规范物体空间 (canonical object space) 中聚合噪声逐帧观测，得到稳定的物体侧接触点；这些稳定接触兼具轨迹级约束与显式迁移目标的双重作用，其中 Laplacian 交互优化保持跨手部形态的局部几何，残差强化学习 (residual reinforcement learning) 在仿真中精修轨迹。在 DexYCB 和 TACO 上端到端轨迹成功率分别为 57.78% 和 26.67%，显著优于最强基线（17.78% 和 10.00%），真实机器人重放实验验证了物理可行性。
Motivation: 灵巧机器人操作的高质量演示数据昂贵且难以收集，单目人类视频是多样化操作行为的大规模来源；但单目 HOI 重建常产生时间上不稳定、物理上不合理的交互，且传统重定向方法难以在不同手部形态间保持任务相关接触和局部交互几何。
Method: 在规范物体空间中聚合帧级噪声观测以恢复稳定的物体侧接触，作为共享交互表示；该表示同时作为重建的轨迹级约束和灵巧手的显式迁移目标，配合 Laplacian 交互优化保持跨手部形态的局部手-物几何，并用残差强化学习在仿真中精修轨迹。
Result: 在 DexYCB 和 TACO 上，C2Dex 的端到端轨迹成功率分别达到 57.78% 和 26.67%，在相同评估标准下大幅超过最强基线（17.78% 和 10.00%）；真实机器人重放实验进一步展示了多种接触密集操作任务中的物理可行性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调稳定的物体侧接触作为共享交互表示，可同时改善单目人体 HOI 重建的时空一致性以及跨本体重定向的接触保留，并通过仿真残差 RL 与真实机器人实验验证了方法的物理可行性。

papers.title: Tensor Network Kernel Machines: A JAX Framework for Machine Learning and Nonlinear System Identification
papers.abstract_en: Developing nonlinear models that are both expressive and computationally efficient remains a challenge in machine learning and nonlinear system identification. Tensor network kernel machines (TNKM) address this challenge by combining nonlinear feature representations with compact low-rank tensor-network parameterizations. However, practical and extensible software frameworks for developing TNKM models remain limited. In this work, we introduce "tnkm", an open-source Python library for constructing and training TNKM models using JAX. The library provides a unified interface for combining different feature maps, tensor-network architectures, and optimization strategies, including alternating least squares and gradient-based methods. We demonstrate the capabilities of "tnkm" on nonlinear benchmark problems, showing that the implemented models achieve competitive prediction accuracy while retaining compact parameterizations and efficient training. The proposed framework facilitates reproducible development and application of tensor-network-based learning methods.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables, 1 listing. Code available at: https://github.com/AlbMLpy/tnkm
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 "tnkm"，一个基于 JAX 的开源 Python 库，用于构建和训练张量网络核机器 (Tensor Network Kernel Machines, TNKM)。该库将非线性特征映射、紧凑低秩张量网络参数化与交替最小二乘、梯度下降等优化策略统一在同一个接口下，并通过非线性基准问题展示其预测精度与参数效率。
Motivation: 非线性模型需要在表达力与计算效率之间取得平衡，TNKM 通过低秩张量网络实现这一目标，但缺乏实用、可扩展的软件框架来开发和训练此类模型。
Method: 提出开源库 tnkm，基于 JAX 实现，支持多种特征映射、张量网络结构和优化策略（交替最小二乘与基于梯度的方法）的统一组合。
Result: 在非线性基准问题上，实现的模型在保持紧凑参数化和高效训练的同时达到有竞争力的预测精度。
Conclusion: 该框架有助于张量网络学习方法在机器学习与非线性系统辨识中的可复现开发与应用。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: Limit Points of Reflow with Minibatch Optimal Transport
papers.abstract_en: Rectified flows, also called flow matching or stochastic interpolants, are generative models that learn a time-dependent vector field steering a probability curve between two probability distributions, usually referred to as latent and target distributions. Reflow accelerates inference by iteratively straightening the trajectories induced by this vector field. We study the asymptotic behavior of this iteration and characterize its limit points. First, we define weak rectified couplings which always exist. Next, when rectified flow updates are alternated with minibatch optimal transport steps of fixed batch size, we show that any limit is $N$-cyclically monotone, where $N$ is the batch size. Such $N$-cyclically monotone couplings enjoy favorable structural and stability properties such as rectifiability and straightness. Finally, restricting velocities to gradient fields and assuming additional support conditions, we prove that reflow limits coincide with the optimal transport map between the endpoint distributions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究整流流 (rectified flows) 中 reflow 迭代的渐近行为，并刻画其极限点。作者定义始终存在的弱整流耦合 (weak rectified couplings)，证明当 reflow 更新与固定批次大小的 minibatch 最优传输 (minibatch optimal transport) 交替进行时，任何极限都是 N-循环单调的 (N-cyclically monotone)。进一步限制速度为梯度场并附加支撑条件后，reflow 的极限与端点分布之间的最优传输映射一致。
Motivation: Reflow 通过迭代拉直轨迹来加速整流流生成模型的推理，但其迭代的收敛行为与极限结构缺乏理论刻画。
Method: 定义弱整流耦合并研究其存在性；分析 reflow 更新与 minibatch 最优传输交替作用下的极限点，利用 N-循环单调性建立结构性质；最后在速度场为梯度场且满足支撑条件时证明极限与最优传输映射的一致性。
Result: 摘要表明任何极限均为 N-循环单调的，从而具有可整流性 (rectifiability) 和直线性 (straightness) 等有利的结构与稳定性性质；在梯度速度场和额外支撑条件下，reflow 极限等于端点分布间的最优传输映射。
Conclusion: 该工作从理论上刻画了 reflow 迭代的极限，揭示了其与 N-循环单调性和最优传输映射的联系。

papers.title: Not All Problems Are Best Modeled as MILP: A DSL-Centric Framework for Flexible and Accurate Optimization Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Solving combinatorial optimization problems (COPs) requires not only efficient algorithms but also carefully crafted formulations. While recent works have leveraged LLMs to automate optimization modeling, current frameworks predominantly rely on a rigid mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) paradigm. In this paper, we argue that not all problems are best modeled as MILP, as forcing complex domains into linear constraints can induce prohibitive modeling complexity and severely restrict solver flexibility. To address this, we propose OptiDSL, a framework that shifts the focus from rigid MILP formulations to domain-specific language (DSL) representations. By utilizing LLMs to map natural language onto standardized, domain-accepted structures, OptiDSL decouples problem formulation from execution. This paradigm enables seamless integration with a diverse library of specialized solvers, ranging from traditional heuristics to modern learning-based methods. Experimental results on the comprehensive benchmark of 44 COP types show that OptiDSL significantly surpasses MILP-based pipelines, yielding a 51.66% gain in formulation accuracy and a 91.71% decrease in modeling time. Notably, it also outperforms MILP-based pipelines on the existing benchmark, achieving a 23.09% higher formulation accuracy. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/OptiDSL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OptiDSL，一个基于领域特定语言 (DSL) 的组合优化建模框架，利用 LLM 将自然语言问题映射为标准化、领域接受的 DSL 表示，从而将问题建模与求解执行解耦。在包含 44 类 COP 类型的综合基准上，它相比 MILP 管线将建模准确率提升 51.66%、建模时间降低 91.71%；在已有基准上也获得 23.09% 的建模准确率提升。
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的优化建模工作大多依赖固定的混合整数线性规划 (MILP) 范式，但将复杂领域强制编码为线性约束会带来高昂的建模复杂度并限制求解器灵活性；论文认为并非所有问题都适合用 MILP 建模。
Method: 提出 OptiDSL 框架，借助 LLM 将自然语言描述转化为标准化的 DSL 结构，解耦问题公式化与执行过程，从而能无缝对接从传统启发式到现代学习式方法的多种专用求解器。
Result: 在 44 种 COP 类型的综合基准上，OptiDSL 相比 MILP 管线实现建模准确率 51.66% 的提升和建模时间 91.71% 的下降；在已有 benchmark 上建模准确率比 MILP 管线高 23.09%。
Conclusion: 作者认为，转向 DSL 而非固定 MILP 的建模范式能显著提高自动优化建模的准确率与效率，并适用于更多样的求解器生态。

papers.title: Beyond Text Matching: Towards Reference-Free Evaluation for Human-Oriented Binary Reverse Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Human-Oriented Binary Reverse Engineering (HOBRE) aims to transform decompiled pseudocode into a more human-friendly representation, thereby reducing the cognitive burden of reverse analysis and improving efficiency. However, reliably evaluating HOBRE outputs remains a fundamental challenge: human evaluation is costly, time-consuming, and difficult to scale, while existing automated metrics either require executable test cases and runtime environments that are often unavailable for real-world binaries, or rely on high-quality source code references that are typically inaccessible and fail to capture semantically equivalent but lexically diverse outputs. Although LLM-as-a-Judge paradigm is naturally well-suited to HOBRE evaluation, its effectiveness remains underexplored. This paper presents the first systematic investigation of the LLM-as-a-Judge paradigm for HOBRE across three representative tasks: function name recovery, binary code summarization, and decompilation optimization. We introduce BinJudgeBench, the first expert-annotated, reference-free evaluation benchmark based on multi-dimensional human judgment, where LLM-as-a-Judge achieves an average correlation of 63.20\% with human judgment, outperforming traditional automated metrics at 35.04\%. By analyzing judge configurations across backbone LLMs, prompting strategies, and decoding temperatures, we find that no ``one-size-fits-all'' configuration exists, as the optimal setup varies across tasks and individual samples. To address this, we propose BinJudge, which employs a lightweight routing mechanism to adaptively select the optimal judge configuration for each task and sample. BinJudge improves correlation with human experts by 4.5\%-24.7\% and reduces API cost to 0.06$\times$-0.84$\times$ of that of static best configurations, providing a scalable, cost-effective, and high-fidelity automated evaluation scheme for HOBRE.
papers.comment: Accepted by the 41st IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究 LLM-as-a-Judge 范式在人类导向的二进制逆向工程 (HOBRE) 评估中的有效性，覆盖函数名恢复、二进制代码摘要和反编译优化三个任务。作者构建了第一个基于专家标注、无参考 (reference-free) 的评测基准 BinJudgeBench，实验表明 LLM-as-a-Judge 与人类判断的平均相关性为 63.20%，显著高于传统自动化指标的 35.04%。针对不同骨干 LLM、提示策略和解码温度的分析显示不存在"一刀切"的最优配置，因此提出带轻量路由机制的 BinJudge，按任务和样本自适应选择判断配置。
Motivation: HOBRE 旨在把反编译伪代码转换为更易读的表示，但其输出评测是根本难题：人工评估成本高、难以扩展；现有自动化指标要么依赖可执行测试用例和运行环境（真实二进制常不可用），要么依赖高质量源码参考（通常不可获取且无法捕捉语义等价但词法多样的输出）。LLM-as-a-Judge 范式天然适合该任务，但其有效性此前未被充分探索。
Method: 构建 BinJudgeBench，一个基于多维人类判断的专家标注、无参考评测基准；通过系统分析判断器配置（骨干 LLM、提示策略、解码温度）发现最优配置因任务和单个样本而异。据此提出 BinJudge，使用轻量路由机制为每个任务和样本自适应选择最优判断配置。
Result: 在 BinJudgeBench 上，LLM-as-a-Judge 与人类判断的平均相关性达 63.20%，传统自动化指标仅为 35.04%。BinJudge 将相关性相对提升 4.5%-24.7%，并将 API 成本降至静态最优配置的 0.06 倍至 0.84 倍。
Conclusion: 作者认为不存在通用的最优判断器配置，自适应路由是提高 HOBRE 自动化评估保真度的有效途径；BinJudge 为 HOBRE 提供了可扩展、低成本且高保真的评估方案。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Accounting Graph Transformer for Short-History Multi-KPI Forecasting in Small Businesses
papers.abstract_en: Small businesses often have only 12-24 months of accounting history, yet planning and risk workflows require coordinated forecasts across financial statements. We study joint 12-month forecasting of 13 income-statement, balance-sheet, cash-flow, and working-capital key performance indicators (KPIs) from 71 monthly ledger series. We introduce the Accounting Graph Transformer (AGT), which represents each ledger series as a masked token, exchanges information through typed attention on a fixed accounting-relation graph, pools target-specific context, and fuses it with a gated three-month recency path. Across 11,993 forecast origins from 1,060 unseen companies, AGT achieves sample-weighted KPI-macro mean absolute error (MAE) $0.6990 \pm 0.0013$ over three independent seeds, compared with $0.7378 \pm 0.0014$ for the strongest baseline, LightGBM. At the pre-specified seed 42, a paired company-clustered bootstrap gives a LightGBM-minus-AGT difference of 0.0395 with 95% confidence interval (CI) $[0.0350,0.0439]$. AGT is best on all 13 KPIs against LightGBM, TimeMixer, and SOFTS in the matched seed-42 comparison, while final-architecture ablations show that relational attention, accounting topology, and the recency path each improve validation and test accuracy. On 7,094 additional unseen companies with origins sampled from January-May 2025, AGT obtains 0.7548 MAE versus 0.7694 for SOFTS. A single 5.3M-parameter model produces 156 aligned forecasts without company-specific fitting, providing one forecasting layer for integrated planning, liquidity, and working-capital analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出会计图 Transformer (Accounting Graph Transformer, AGT)，面向小企业仅有 12-24 个月会计历史时的多 KPI 联合预测任务，从 71 条月度账目序列预测 13 个利润表、资产负债表、现金流和营运资本 KPI 的未来 12 个月。AGT 将每条账目序列表示为掩码 token，通过固定会计关系图上的类型化注意力交换信息，池化目标特定上下文并与带门控的三个月近期路径融合。在 1,060 家未见公司的 11,993 个预测起点上，AGT 的样本加权 KPI-macro 平均绝对误差 (MAE) 为 0.6990，优于最强基线 LightGBM 的 0.7378。
Motivation: 小企业通常只有 12-24 个月的会计历史，但规划和风险工作流需要协调多个财务报表的预测，这是一个历史短、多序列、多目标联合预测问题。
Method: AGT 使用掩码 token 表示每条账目序列，在会计关系图上进行类型化注意力 (typed attention) 实现信息交换，通过池化构建目标特定上下文，并用门控机制融合最近三个月的近期信息路径。
Result: 在 1,060 家未见公司、11,993 个预测起点上，AGT 的 MAE 为 0.6990 ± 0.0013，优于 LightGBM 的 0.7378 ± 0.0014；种子 42 下配对公司聚类 bootstrap 显示 LightGBM 减 AGT 差值为 0.0395，95% CI [0.0350, 0.0439]，AGT 在全部 13 个 KPI 上优于 LightGBM、TimeMixer 和 SOFTS。在额外 7,094 家公司的 2025 年 1-5 月预测起点上，AGT 取得 0.7548 MAE，优于 SOFTS 的 0.7694。
Conclusion: 一个 5.3M 参数的模型无需公司特定拟合即可生成 156 个对齐预测，为综合规划、流动性和营运资本分析提供单一预测层；消融表明关系注意力、会计拓扑和近期路径均提升验证与测试精度。

papers.title: CAS2UML: A Handwritten Sketch-to-PlantUML Dataset for Class and Activity Diagrams
papers.abstract_en: Automated UML generation from sketches and images is gaining renewed attention with the rise of large language models and multimodal AI. However, reproducible evaluation remains difficult due to the lack of public datasets with executable groundtruth models. We present CAS2UML, a public dataset of 557 handdrawn UML diagrams, including 271 class diagrams and 286 activity diagrams, each paired with manually validated PlantUML code. We also provide a PlantUML-based validation tool and reusable scripts for checking the syntactic correctness and renderability of generated UML artifacts, enabling reproducible benchmarking of sketch-to-UML approaches. The dataset, validation tool, processing scripts, documentation, and demonstration video are publicly available at: Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Seym0n /cas2uml_hand-drawn_to_plantuml_dataset; Tool and Scripts: https://github.com/Seym0n/handwritten-uml-dataset; Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KQrYeGgT3hs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CAS2UML，一个包含 557 张手绘 UML 图（271 张类图、286 张活动图）的公开数据集，每张图配有经人工验证的 PlantUML 代码。作者还提供基于 PlantUML 的验证工具和可复用脚本，用于检查生成 UML 工件的语法正确性与可渲染性，以支持 sketch-to-UML 方法的可复现基准测试。
Motivation: 随着大语言模型和多模态 AI 兴起，从草图或图像自动生成 UML 重新受到关注，但缺乏带可执行 ground truth 模型的公开数据集，导致可复现评估困难。
Method: 构建手绘 UML 图数据集，并为每张图提供人工验证的 PlantUML 代码；同时实现基于 PlantUML 的验证工具与处理脚本，用于自动检查生成结果的语法正确性和可渲染性。
Result: 摘要报告数据集规模为 557 张手绘图，其中类图 271 张、活动图 286 张；数据与工具以公开链接提供（Hugging Face 数据集、GitHub 工具与脚本、演示视频）。

papers.title: ZIPBrain: Can EEG Foundation Models Be Faster, Locally Deployable, but Accurate?
papers.abstract_en: This work investigates whether Electroencephalograph (EEG) foundation models (EFMs) can be made faster and locally deployable without sacrificing accuracy. EEG foundation models are a major trend, offering strong general-purpose representations. However, their computational burden grows quadratically with input length, hindering deployment on resource-constrained scenario, particularly for real-time clinical monitoring. EEG's low SNR further suggests many of these tokens are redundant and compressible with little accuracy cost. We propose ZIPBrain, a novel redundancy-aware EEG token pooling module that leverages this low-SNR characteristic to reduce token count. Given a token sequence, ZIPBrain partitions tokens into redundant and unique groups, then merges each redundant token with its most similar counterpart in the unique group. Furthermore, ZIPBrain serves as a training-free, plug-and-play module that seamlessly integrates into standard Transformer encoders with negligible computational overhead. Extensive experiments across multiple EEG foundation models show ZIPBrain's strong versatility, achieving 1.3%-10.5% average improvement over baselines, while reducing wall-clock inference time by 32.7% (up to 41.8% with CUDA Graph) compared to the original EEG foundation models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ZIPBrain，一个冗余感知的 EEG token 池化模块，旨在让 EEG 基础模型（EFM）推理更快、可本地部署且不牺牲精度。该模块利用 EEG 低信噪比特性，将 token 分为冗余组与独特组，并把每个冗余 token 与其在独特组中最相似的对应 token 合并，从而减少 token 数量。作为免训练、即插即用模块，它能以极小计算开销集成进标准 Transformer 编码器；实验显示在多个 EEG 基础模型上平均提升 1.3%-10.5%，推理时间较原始模型减少 32.7%（配合 CUDA Graph 最高达 41.8%）。
Motivation: EEG 基础模型的计算开销随输入长度二次增长，阻碍其在资源受限场景（尤其是实时临床监测）中的部署；EEG 的低信噪比又暗示大量 token 冗余、可在很小精度损失下压缩。
Method: 提出 ZIPBrain，一个冗余感知的 EEG token 池化模块：给定 token 序列后，将其划分为冗余 token 组和独特 token 组，再将每个冗余 token 与其在独特组中最相似的 counterpart 合并，从而减少 token 数量；该模块免训练、即插即用，可无缝嵌入标准 Transformer 编码器并仅带来可忽略的额外计算。
Result: 在多个 EEG 基础模型上的实验表明，ZIPBrain 相对基线取得平均 1.3%-10.5% 的提升，同时将端到端墙钟推理时间较原始 EEG 基础模型减少 32.7%，使用 CUDA Graph 时最高减少 41.8%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，利用 EEG 低信噪比带来的 token 冗余可以显著降低推理成本，使 EEG 基础模型在不牺牲精度的前提下更快、可本地部署。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Hyperbolic Graph Embedders for Link Prediction and Topology Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Hyperbolic embeddings provide compact geometric representations of complex networks in hyperbolic spaces, but systematic comparisons of methods developed in machine learning, network science, and algorithmics remain rare. We benchmark 13 unsupervised hyperbolic graph embedders under a unified protocol for link prediction and topology reconstruction on synthetic and empirical networks. The protocol captures both missing-link recovery and the preservation of local and global network structure. Maximum-likelihood and representation-learning-based approaches, including hybrid variants, achieve the strongest overall performance, although no method dominates across all tasks and structural regimes. Performance is more strongly associated with embedding paradigm than with disciplinary origin. We identify the network regimes in which different paradigms succeed or fail and provide practical guidance for method selection in downstream applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在统一评测协议下对 13 种无监督双曲图嵌入方法 (hyperbolic graph embedders) 进行链接预测与拓扑重建的系统比较，覆盖合成网络和实证网络。摘要报告最大似然方法和表示学习方法（含混合变体）整体表现最强，但没有任何方法在所有任务与结构机制下占优，且性能与嵌入范式的关系强于学科来源。作者还识别了不同范式适用或失败的网络机制，并为下游应用给出方法选择建议。
Motivation: 双曲嵌入可用于在双曲空间中对复杂网络进行紧凑几何表示，但机器学习、网络科学与算法学各自发展的方法之间缺乏系统性比较，这给方法选择带来困难。
Method: 设计了统一评测协议，同时度量缺失链接恢复以及网络局部与全局结构的保持，并基于该协议对来自不同学科的 13 种无监督双曲图嵌入器进行基准测试。
Result: 最大似然类和表示学习类方法（包括混合变体）整体性能最强，但不存在跨所有任务与结构机制占优的单一方法；性能与嵌入范式关联更紧密，而非方法所属学科。
Conclusion: 作者指出不同范式在不同网络机制下各有成败，并据此为下游应用中的方法选择提供实用指导。

papers.title: An Agentic Hybrid Top-Down and Bottom-Up Approach to Knowledge Graph Generation
papers.abstract_en: Organizing thousands of unstandardized, multilingual expertise declarations is a persistent challenge for Human Resources (HR) platforms, directly impacting downstream tasks like accurate talent matching. To address this, we propose a hybrid knowledge graph generation pipeline that grounds a Large Language Model (LLM) in the Wikidata multilingual Knowledge Graph (KG) while employing an agentic reflexion pattern to synthesize emerging concepts and their associated metadata. Unlike rigid top-down methods or fragmented bottom-up approaches, our system anchors recognized concepts to stable Knowledge Graph entities while dynamically creating new nodes and relational metadata for unrecognized skills. Executed across five stages, entity reconciliation, multilingual canonicalization, active curation, deduplication, and the iterative recovery of unmapped concepts, the system autonomously adapts to rapidly evolving, noisy skill mentions across five European languages. Ultimately, this pipeline provides a highly scalable, explicable, and self-healing framework for generating a comprehensive skills knowledge graph, from which a structured taxonomy is derived, using unstructured, noisy text.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合知识图谱生成流水线，用于将非标准化、多语言的技能声明组织为结构化技能知识图谱。该方法以 Wikidata 多语言知识图谱为锚点，结合智能体反思 (agentic reflexion) 模式合成新兴概念及其元数据，并通过实体消解、多语言规范化、主动策展、去重和未映射概念迭代恢复五个阶段，在五种欧洲语言上自主适应噪声技能提及。
Motivation: 人力资源平台面临数千条非标准化、多语言技能声明，直接影响人才匹配等下游任务的准确性。刚性自顶向下方法或碎片化自底向上方法难以兼顾稳定锚定与动态扩展。
Method: 提出混合知识图谱生成流水线：将 LLM 锚定在 Wikidata 多语言知识图谱中，采用 agentic reflexion 模式合成新兴概念；系统将已识别概念稳定映射到现有 KG 实体，同时为未识别技能动态创建新节点和关系元数据，并执行五个阶段（实体消解、多语言规范化、主动策展、去重、未映射概念迭代恢复）。
Result: 摘要描述该系统能自主适应四种（原文为五种）欧洲语言中快速演化、含噪声的技能提及，并产出高可扩展、可解释、自愈的技能知识图谱及衍生结构化分类体系；未给出定量实验数值。
Conclusion: 该流水线为从非结构化噪声文本生成综合技能知识图谱提供了可扩展、可解释且自愈的框架，并强调从图谱推导出结构化分类体系。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: ReQuant: Fixed-Grid Discrete Refinement for Post-Training Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is widely used to reduce the memory and computational cost of large language models. Existing PTQ methods typically obtain an initial quantized model through heuristic rules or greedy optimization, and once quantization is completed the resulting integer assignments are usually treated as final. This observation motivates a complementary optimization stage within PTQ that keeps quantized weights improvable after an executable quantized model has been produced, while preserving the quantized format. We introduce ReQuant, a backpropagation-free fixed-grid refinement procedure for this stage. Agnostic to the PTQ initializer, ReQuant takes an existing quantized model as a feasible starting point and iteratively revisits its discrete weight assignments on the fixed quantization grid. Accepted updates strictly reduce the mean squared reconstruction error and remain on the original grid. In this way, ReQuant turns the initially fixed PTQ output into an iteratively optimizable discrete solution and serves as a plug-and-play post-processing stage for existing PTQ pipelines. Experiments across diverse model families, bit-widths, and downstream tasks show that ReQuant consistently improves quantized models from heterogeneous PTQ initializers, with especially large gains on simple initializers and lower bit-widths. Notably, ReQuant can refine a simple round-to-nearest initialization across multiple sweeps until it approaches or surpasses GPTAQ under the same quantization format. These results establish ReQuant as a practical complementary stage for further improving existing PTQ pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReQuant，一种免反向传播的固定网格离散细化 (fixed-grid refinement) 程序，用于大语言模型的后训练量化 (PTQ)。ReQuant 与具体 PTQ 初始化器无关，以已有量化模型为可行起点，在原始量化网格上迭代重访离散权重赋值，接受的更新严格降低均方重构误差并保持网格不变，从而把 PTQ 的固定输出变成可迭代优化的离散解。实验覆盖多种模型族、位宽与下游任务，表明它对异构 PTQ 初始化器均带来一致改进，在简单初始化器和低比特下收益尤其明显。
Motivation: 现有 PTQ 方法通常通过启发式规则或贪心优化得到初始量化模型，量化完成后整数赋值往往被视为最终结果；本文针对这一环节提出量化完成后仍可继续改进权重的互补优化阶段，同时保持量化格式不变。
Method: ReQuant 是即插即用 (plug-and-play) 的后处理阶段，不依赖反向传播，且对 PTQ 初始化器不可知 (agnostic)。它以已执行可行的量化模型为起点，在固定量化网格上迭代地重新考虑离散权重赋值，只接受严格降低均方重构误差且停留在原始网格上的更新。
Result: 在多种模型族、位宽和下游任务上的实验显示，ReQuant 能一致地改进来自异构 PTQ 初始化器的量化模型，对简单初始化器和较低位宽提升最大；摘要特别指出，它可将简单的 round-to-nearest 初始化经多轮扫描细化至接近或超过同量化格式下的 GPTAQ。
Conclusion: ReQuant 被定位为现有 PTQ 流水线的一个实用互补阶段，把原本固定的 PTQ 输出转化为可迭代优化的离散解，从而进一步提升已有 PTQ 方法的表现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: IceHorizon: A Dataset for Horizon Detection in Ice-Covered Maritime Environments and Comparative Evaluation of Detection Methods
papers.abstract_en: Horizon detection in images of ice-covered waters is a challenging problem for maritime navigation due to low contrast between water and sky, cluttered ice structures, and varying illumination conditions. This paper presents a comparative evaluation of six horizon detection algorithms, including four classical computer vision methods and two hybrid approaches combining deep learning with classical line detection. A new bespoke IceHorizon dataset consisting of 30 ship-based and 8 drone-based videos is used to evaluate detection accuracy, horizon coverage, and computational performance. The results show that hybrid methods achieve the highest accuracy and most reliable horizon estimates. In contrast, purely classical methods exhibit reduced robustness, particularly in visually ambiguous scenes. Performance on ship-based imagery was consistently higher than on drone-based imagery, indicating a strong dependency on acquisition characteristics. The created dataset and codes used in this study are made publicly available to support further research on this topic. The code is available at https://github.com/allythe/HorizonDetection. The dataset is available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20411867
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出并公开了一个用于冰覆盖海域图像中地平线检测的新数据集 IceHorizon，包含 30 个船载视频和 8 个无人机视频，并比较了六种地平线检测算法：四种经典计算机视觉方法和两种结合深度学习与经典直线检测的混合方法。结果发现混合方法准确率最高且最可靠，纯经典方法在视觉模糊场景下鲁棒性较差，船载图像上的性能普遍高于无人机图像。
Motivation: 冰覆盖水域中天空与水面低对比度、冰结构杂乱以及光照变化使地平线检测成为海事导航中的难题，而现有研究缺乏针对此类环境的专门数据集和系统的算法比较。
Method: 构建了一个包含船载和无人机拍摄视频的 IceHorizon 数据集，并在此数据集上对六种地平线检测算法进行对比评估，包括四种经典计算机视觉方法和两种结合深度学习的混合方法，评估指标涵盖检测精度、地平线覆盖率和计算性能。

papers.title: Understand Before Detect: Vision--Language Learning for Omni-Domain Infrared Small Target Detection
papers.abstract_en: Omni-domain infrared small target (IRST) detection is crucial for infrared surveillance, yet remains challenging due to heterogeneous imaging domains and inconsistent target characteristics. Previous deep learning-based methods have been developed for visual-only paradigms and achieved promising performance on domain-specific tasks. However, existing methods follow the task-specific supervised learning paradigm. This paradigm simplifies the full-scene infrared observations to sparse target supervision, discarding the semantics that remain invariant across heterogeneous domains. Consequently, detection performance suffers substantially under domain shifts. To handle this issue, we introduce \textbf{``understand before detect''}, a paradigm that formulates omni-domain IRST detection as an understanding-driven process, where holistic infrared target understanding precedes precise detection. Building on this paradigm, we propose \textbf{JinSight}, which first develops holistic IRST understanding through language supervision and then transfers the learned cross-domain representations to precise small-target detection. By grounding infrared representations in language semantics, JinSight enables a single model to generalize across heterogeneous infrared domains. We then introduce Latent Semantic Interaction (LSI), which exchanges language-aligned global semantics with fine-grained spatial features in a compact low-rank space. To address the lack of multimodal omni-domain IRST benchmarks, we build \textbf{OmniIRST-VL}, the first large-scale, highly diverse vision--language dataset for omni-domain IRST detection. It comprises over 39k annotations across six complementary instruction tasks covering both scene-level understanding and target-centric reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“先理解后检测”（understand before detect）范式用于全领域红外小目标（IRST）检测，将检测重构为理解驱动的过程，并据此提出模型 JinSight：先通过语言监督进行整体红外目标理解，再将跨域表示迁移到精确小目标检测。为支持该范式，作者引入 Latent Semantic Interaction (LSI)，在紧凑低秩空间中交互语言对齐的全局语义与细粒度空间特征，并构建了首个大规模视觉-语言全领域红外小目标数据集 OmniIRST-VL，包含超过 39k 条标注、覆盖六种互补指令任务。
Motivation: 现有深度学习方法采用任务特定的监督学习范式，把全场景红外观测简化为稀疏目标监督，丢弃了异构红外域间不变的语义，导致域偏移下检测性能明显下降。
Method: 提出 JinSight 模型，先通过语言监督建立整体红外目标理解，再迁移所学跨域表示到精确小目标检测；引入 LSI 在低秩空间交换语言对齐的全局语义与细粒度空间特征；同时构建多模态数据集 OmniIRST-VL。
Result: 摘要未报告具体量化指标，定性声称该方法使单一模型能够泛化到异构红外域，并提供了包含超 39k 标注、六种指令任务的大规模视觉-语言数据集。
Conclusion: 作者强调将红外表示锚定在语言语义上可使单一模型跨域泛化，并指出现有基准缺乏多模态全领域数据，因此构建了 OmniIRST-VL 以填补空白。

papers.title: Stable Curves, Unstable Items: Item-Level Scaling Heterogeneity in Video LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Aggregate scaling curves suggest that Video LLMs improve smoothly or saturate as visual budgets grow. We show that this view can conceal large, opposing changes at the item level. We represent each frozen model--item pair by its response trajectory under controlled visual budgets and derive matched-grid measures of configuration complementarity, harmful transitions, and text overwrite. Across five open Video LLMs from three architecture families, four multiple-choice benchmark splits, open-ended QA and summarization, and fixed-history dialogue generation, no single budget serves all items. On the four-model matched MCQA grid, item-level oracle headroom spans $8.8$--$18.9$ accuracy points and $12.5$--$25.5\%$ of items are correct at a lower budget but wrong at a higher one. Task-appropriate continuous metrics show the same complementarity beyond multiple choice: Token-F1 oracle gaps are $2.7$--$3.7$ score points on MLVU generation and $3.8$--$4.8$ points on AVSD current-turn generation, even when mean quality improves with budget. The effect persists across frame count, spatial resolution, sampling policy, temporal--spatial allocation, and independently executed raw-video and cached pipelines, with per-item rates and membership tracking protocol choices. A controlled sampling intervention recovers $29.0\%$ of terminal regressions, and a structured frame audit identifies several recurring evidence pathways. We release per-item trajectories, protocol provenance, derived annotations, and reproducible analysis code as an auditing artifact. A confidence cascade matches fixed-$128f$ accuracy while reducing average shared frame cost by $31.7\%$, illustrating one operational use of the response matrix.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出视频大语言模型（Video LLM）的聚合缩放曲线会掩盖逐项目（item-level）级别的、方向相反的视觉预算响应变化。作者为每个冻结模型-项目对在受控视觉预算下记录响应轨迹，并构造匹配网格度量（configuration complementarity、harmful transitions、text overwrite）。在五个开源模型、三个架构家族、多个选择题与生成任务上，发现不存在适用于所有项目的单一预算；四模型匹配 MCQA 网格上，item-level oracle headroom 达 8.8–18.9 个准确率点，且 12.5%–25.5% 的项目在较低预算下正确、较高预算下反而错误。受控采样干预可恢复 29.0% 的终端回归，置信级联在保持 128 帧准确率的同时将平均共享帧成本降低 31.7%。
Motivation: 现有聚合缩放曲线给人视频模型随视觉预算平滑提升或饱和的印象，可能掩盖逐项目级别的相反变化，导致对预算-性能关系的误判。
Method: 为每个冻结模型-项目对构建响应轨迹，定义匹配网格下的互补性、有害转换和文本覆盖度量，并在多种视觉预算维度（帧数、空间分辨率、采样策略、时空分配、原始视频与缓存管线）上系统审计；同时进行受控采样干预和结构化帧审计，并发布逐项目轨迹、协议溯源、派生注解和可复现分析代码。
Result: 没有任何单一预算对所有项目最优；MCQA 的 oracle headroom 为 8.8–18.9 个准确率点，12.5%–25.5% 的项目出现预算升高反而错误的 harmful transition。Token-F1 的 oracle 差距在 MLVU 生成为 2.7–3.7 分、在 AVSD 当前轮生成为 3.8–4.8 分，即便均值质量随预算上升也如此。受控采样干预恢复了 29.0% 的终端回归；置信级联匹配固定 128 帧准确率并减少 31.7% 的平均共享帧成本。
Conclusion: 摘要强调项目级视觉预算异质性在视频 LLM 中普遍存在且跨任务、跨协议保持稳定，作者以审计工件形式公开轨迹与代码，并用置信级联展示响应矩阵的实用价值。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Scenix: Sparse-View 3D Scene Reconstruction via Executable Scene Programs
papers.abstract_en: Synthesizing a structured and editable 3D indoor scene from a few uncalibrated RGB views requires more than generating high-quality individual assets: a system must infer the room structure, associate objects across incomplete observations, and recover a globally consistent spatial configuration. Previous methods mainly focus on 3D scene generation with text input or require continuous visual inputs with additional priors, \ e.g., human-annotated masks or accurate 3D layouts, which makes these methods labor demanding and hard to apply in general cases. We present \textsc{Scenix}, a sparse-view 3D scene reconstruction framework via executable scene programs, a structured representation that can be directly instantiated into editable 3D scenes. Given sparse views, \textsc{Scenix} predicts executable scene programs through perception-grounded asset instantiation and closed-loop spatial refinement. % We present \method, a framework that predicts an executable scene representation from sparse views and realizes it through perception-grounded asset instantiation and closed-loop spatial refinement. To support this task, we construct \dataset, a dataset of approximately 110,000 synthetic and real indoor scenes with multiview imagery, room structures, object-centric descriptions, and metric spatial annotations. We further introduce observation-consistent supervision that aligns each target scene with the visual evidence available in its input views. Experiments on held-out \textsc{XScene} scenes, real indoor images, and out-of-distribution SpatialGen cases evaluate structured scene prediction, object grounding, and spatial refinement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Scenix，一个基于可执行场景程序（executable scene programs）的稀疏视角 3D 室内场景重建框架。给定少量未标定 RGB 视图，Scenix 通过感知驱动的资产实例化（perception-grounded asset instantiation）和闭环空间精化（closed-loop spatial refinement）预测可执行场景程序，并将其直接实例化为可编辑的 3D 场景。作者还构建了约 110,000 个合成与真实室内场景的数据集，并引入观测一致性监督（observation-consistent supervision）以对齐目标场景与输入视图中的视觉证据。实验在 held-out XScene 场景、真实室内图像和分布外 SpatialGen 案例上评估了结构化场景预测、物体定位与空间精化。
Motivation: 从少量未标定 RGB 视图合成结构化且可编辑的室内 3D 场景，需要推断房间结构、在不完整观测间关联物体并恢复全局一致的空间配置。现有方法多依赖文本输入或需要连续视觉输入及额外先验（如人工标注掩码或精确 3D 布局），导致费时费力且难以泛化到一般场景。
Method: Scenix 将场景表示为可执行场景程序，该结构化表示可直接实例化为可编辑 3D 场景；框架从稀疏视图预测这些程序，采用感知驱动的资产实例化和闭环空间精化两个关键机制。为支撑该任务，作者构建约 110,000 个合成与真实室内场景的数据集，包含多视角图像、房间结构、物体中心描述和度量空间标注，并提出观测一致性监督，使每个目标场景与输入视图中的视觉证据对齐。
Result: 实验在 held-out XScene 场景、真实室内图像以及分布外 SpatialGen 案例上进行，评估了结构化场景预测、物体定位和空间精化三方面能力。摘要未报告具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调可执行场景程序配合观测一致性监督，能够从稀疏视图实现结构化且可编辑的 3D 室内场景重建，并在 held-out 与分布外设定下验证了方案的有效性。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: FedLBW: A Loss-Based Weighting Strategy for Federated Learning on Non-IID Data in Wireless Networks
papers.abstract_en: Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative machine learning (ML) across distributed clients while preserving privacy. However, efficient model convergence in FL remains challenging, especially in wireless networks where non-independent and identically distributed (non-IID) data and frequent client dropouts are common. Traditional FL algorithms, such as FedAvg, rely solely on dataset size to weight client updates. This introduces biases towards clients with larger datasets and makes the process sensitive to non-IID data, outliers, and client dropouts. To address these challenges, we propose Federated Learning with Loss-Based Weighting (FedLBW), a novel aggregation method that assigns each client's update a weight proportional to the inverse of its validation loss, computed using a small proxy dataset on the server, rather than its dataset size. This ensures that lower-loss models exert greater influence during aggregation, prioritizing the most reliable updates and boosting overall performance. Through extensive experiments across multiple datasets, including FashionMNIST (CNN), CIFAR-10 (ResNet-18), and CIFAR-100 (ResNet-34), we demonstrate that FedLBW achieves higher accuracy and faster convergence compared to baseline algorithms such as FedAvg, FedAvgM, FedProx, FedNova, FedLAW and FedDkw, with notable improvements of up to 7.6 % higher accuracy on CIFAR-10 in extreme non-IID cases. Moreover, FedLBW showcases exceptional resilience to increasing dropout probabilities, consistently maintaining significantly higher accuracy even in challenging conditions. These results establish FedLBW as an effective and resilient solution for FL in wireless network environments, offering marked improvements in model accuracy, convergence speed, and robustness to non-IID data and client dropouts.
papers.journal_ref: Kundroo, Majid, Tinku Singh, and Taehong Kim. "FedLBW: A loss-based weighting strategy for federated learning on non-IID data in wireless networks." Expert Systems with Applications (2025): 130487
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FedLBW，一种面向无线网络中非独立同分布 (non-IID) 数据与客户端掉线的联邦学习聚合策略。该策略不再按客户端数据集大小加权，而是用服务器端的小型代理数据集计算每个客户端更新的验证损失，并以其倒数作为聚合权重，使损失更低的模型在聚合中发挥更大作用。实验表明，在 FashionMNIST、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 等数据集上，FedLBW 相比 FedAvg、FedAvgM、FedProx、FedNova、FedLAW 和 FedDkw 获得更高的准确率与更快的收敛速度，并在极端 non-IID 情况下于 CIFAR-10 上提升最高达 7.6%。
Motivation: 传统联邦学习算法（如 FedAvg）只按数据集大小加权客户端更新，这会给数据集较大的客户端引入偏差，并使聚合对 non-IID 数据、离群值和客户端掉线敏感，从而影响无线网络环境中的模型收敛效率。
Method: FedLBW 提出一种基于损失的加权聚合方法：在服务器端维护一个小型代理数据集，计算每个客户端更新在该代理集上的验证损失，并分配与验证损失倒数成正比的聚合权重，而不是使用数据集大小作为权重。
Result: 在 FashionMNIST (CNN)、CIFAR-10 (ResNet-18) 和 CIFAR-100 (ResNet-34) 上的实验显示，FedLBW 相比 FedAvg、FedAvgM、FedProx、FedNova、FedLAW 与 FedDkw 取得更高准确率和更快收敛，极端 non-IID 下 CIFAR-10 准确率最高提升 7.6%；同时随着掉线率增加，FedLBW 仍能保持显著更高的准确率。
Conclusion: 作者认为 FedLBW 是无线网络环境下联邦学习的一种有效且稳健的解决方案，在模型准确率、收敛速度和面对 non-IID 数据与客户端掉线的鲁棒性方面均带来明显改善。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Does More Retrieved Evidence Help Visual Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Diffusion Language Models?
papers.abstract_en: Visual retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) commonly expands the retrieved evidence set to improve answer-page coverage, implicitly assuming that all available evidence should be passed to the generator. We show that this assumption does not hold for diffusion language models (DLMs): retrieving more pages increases answer-page recall, whereas unconditionally passing all retrieved pages to the generator often reduces answer accuracy, primarily because of semantic conflict. A latent-source analysis explains this mismatch through source-coherence loss in parallel denoising, where position-wise proposals can combine incompatible visual sources into unsupported answers. We further find that such interference is already visible in the first-step answer-block distribution, making it possible to assess evidence before decoding. To preserve retrieval coverage while limiting harmful visual exposure, we propose the Entropy-Based Candidate Filter (ECF), a training-free evidence-admission framework. To reduce irrelevant content within individual candidates, ECF constructs multi-granularity evidence units; to identify beneficial additional evidence, it uses blank-controlled block confidence and retrieval rank to determine whether and which candidate should enter the final context. Across three multimodal DLMs and five visual QA benchmarks, ECF improves answer accuracy by 2.62 percentage points on average over the strongest fixed top-$k$ input and, with LLaDA2.0-Uni, by 2.37 percentage points on average over the best competing training-free result for each dataset. These results show that broader retrieval benefits visual DLM-RAG through selective evidence admission rather than unconditional evidence expansion. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/wjkuser/ECF.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉检索增强生成 (RAG) 与扩散语言模型 (DLM) 组合时“检索越多越好”的假设是否成立。摘要发现扩增检索页能提升答案页召回，但无条件把所有检索页传给生成器常因语义冲突而降低答案准确率；作者提出训练无关的证据准入框架 Entropy-Based Candidate Filter (ECF)，在三个多模态 DLM 和五个视觉问答基准上将答案准确率平均提升 2.62 个百分点。
Motivation: 视觉 RAG 通常默认所有可用检索证据都应传给生成器，该假设对扩散语言模型并不成立：更多检索页虽然提高了答案页召回，却可能因并行去噪中位置级提案组合不兼容视觉来源而产生语义冲突，因此需要选择性的证据准入机制。
Method: 提出 Entropy-Based Candidate Filter (ECF)，一个无需训练的证据准入框架：构建多粒度证据单元以减少单个候选中无关内容的影响；利用 blank-controlled block confidence 和检索排名判断是否以及哪个候选应进入最终上下文，在保留检索覆盖率的同时限制有害视觉暴露。
Result: 在三个多模态 DLM 和五个视觉问答基准上，ECF 相比最强固定 top-k 输入平均提升 2.62 个百分点答案准确率；对 LLaDA2.0-Uni，相比每个数据集上最佳的无训练对比方法平均提升 2.37 个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调更广的检索通过选择性的证据准入而非无条件扩充来惠及视觉 DLM-RAG；代码已公开。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: HRDiT: Training-Free High-Resolution Image Generation with Off-the-Shelf Diffusion Transformer Models
papers.abstract_en: Training-free text-to-high-resolution image generation has recently attracted growing research attention. However, existing studies on this task primarily focus on adapting off-the-shelf U-Net-based diffusion models to high resolutions, with limited progress on adapting off-the-shelf Diffusion Transformer (DiT) models despite their strong text-to-image generation capabilities at limited resolutions. In this work, we find two key challenges particularly hindering the application of off-the-shelf DiT models for high-resolution image synthesis in a training-free manner, namely, spatial disorder and long generation time. To address these challenges, we propose a novel method tailored to adapt off-the-shelf DiT models for high-resolution image synthesis. Extensive experiments show the efficacy of our method. Our code is available at: https://github.com/zylwithxy/HRDiT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HRDiT，一种无需训练即可将现成 Diffusion Transformer (DiT) 模型适配到高分辨率文本到图像生成的方法。作者指出直接使用现成 DiT 模型存在空间混乱与生成时间过长两大挑战，并针对性地设计解决方案。实验表明该方法有效，代码已开源。
Motivation: 现有训练无关的高分辨率文本到图像生成研究主要适配 U-Net 架构的扩散模型，而对具有更强生成能力的现成 Diffusion Transformer (DiT) 模型适配进展有限，且面临空间混乱和生成时间长的关键障碍。
Method: 提出 HRDiT，一种专门针对现成 DiT 模型的高分辨率图像合成适配方法，无需任何训练过程，用于解决空间无序性和长生成时间问题。
Result: 摘要报告大量实验验证了所提方法的有效性，但未给出具体量化指标或基准对比。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法成功克服了现成 DiT 模型在高分辨率生成中的两大挑战，并公开代码以支持复现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Every Cache Entry Earns Its Place: Global Allocation of Resolution and Coverage for KV Cache Compression
papers.abstract_en: As large language models (LLMs) process increasingly long contexts, KV cache storage and repeated access have become a major bottleneck. Existing KV cache compression methods rely on predefined, fixed compression rules and are typically developed around either token eviction or merging. As a result, cache resources can neither flow freely across layers, heads, and context slots, nor be jointly allocated to balance local resolution and information coverage. Therefore, we propose GraceKV, a global approach for the allocation of resolution and coverage in KV cache compression, and formulate the compression process as a global resource allocation problem under a fixed cache budget. GraceKV treats each layer-KV head-slot combination as an atomic unit and builds a prototype tree. Leaf nodes correspond to token-level KV entries, while each internal node uses a single prototype to compress the KV space covered by its children. A set of non-overlapping nodes in the tree forms the representation of an atomic unit. Adding the root of a new tree expands information coverage, whereas splitting a selected node improves local resolution. All candidate actions compete globally for a shared cache budget. Finally, the nodes retained across all trees form the compressed KV cache. This process adaptively determines the allocation of cache resources among atomic units globally and the balance between resolution and coverage. GraceKV requires no additional training, and the entire compression and inference process is performed on the GPU. Systematic experiments across diverse long-context tasks and compression ratios show that GraceKV ranks first in 24 of 32 settings and remains robust up to 128-fold compression. These results validate the effectiveness of global budget allocation in coordinating information coverage and local resolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GraceKV，一种面向 KV cache 压缩的全局分配方法，将压缩过程形式化为固定缓存预算下的全局资源分配问题。GraceKV 以层-注意力头-上下文槽的原子单元为基本单位构建原型树，叶节点对应 token 级 KV 条目，内部节点用单个原型压缩其子节点覆盖的 KV 空间；添加树根扩大信息覆盖，分裂节点提升局部分辨率，所有候选操作在全球共享预算下竞争。该方法无需额外训练，压缩与推理全程在 GPU 上完成，系统实验显示其在 32 个设置中 24 个排名第一，并能稳健支持 128 倍压缩。
Motivation: 现有 KV cache 压缩方法依赖预定义的固定压缩规则，通常只围绕 token 驱逐或合并展开，导致缓存资源无法跨层、跨头和跨上下文槽流动，也无法在局部分辨率与信息覆盖之间进行联合分配。
Method: 将 KV cache 压缩建模为固定预算下的全局资源分配问题；每个层-KV 头-槽组合被视为原子单元，并构建原型树来表示其 KV 空间，保留一组不重叠的树节点作为原子单元的表示；新增树根扩展覆盖，分裂节点提升分辨率，各候选动作共同竞争缓存预算，最终所有树上保留的节点构成压缩后的 KV cache。整个过程无需训练，且在 GPU 上完成。
Result: 在多种长上下文任务和压缩比设置下，GraceKV 在 32 个设置中的 24 个中排名第一，并能在高达 128 倍压缩下保持稳健表现。
Conclusion: 全局缓存预算分配能够有效协调信息覆盖与局部分辨率，且该方法无需额外训练、全程在 GPU 上执行。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Decoupling Intention from Trajectory: A Representational Deduction Framework for World Action Models
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) aim to construct a unified architecture capable of understanding world state evolution and guiding to generative motion planning. However, existing visual branches focus on predicting static visual observation, rather than reflecting potential transition information that captures the evolution of world states under motion interactions. This leads to representational entanglement between high-level physical condition evolution and low-level action trajectory generation within the Action Model, creating a structural bottleneck while weakening the predictive capability of world evolution modeling for action generation. We propose PILOT (Physical Inference for Latent Optimized Trajectories), whose core Representational Deduction (RD) bridges this gap by integrating motion thought-of-chain (CoT) guidance as a native model capability. Specifically, RD aims to encourage the action branch to explicitly model potential state transition tokens, which are retained as CoT in the reasoning space to guide fine-grained motion trajectory. Experiments demonstrate that RD not only significantly improves the success rate and generalization ability of WAMs in complex robotic manipulation tasks but also enhances the model's physical interpretability by decoupling high-level motion semantics from low-level trajectory details. Furthermore, the abundant state transition supervision signals introduced by RD effectively alleviate the sparse supervision in action generation, enabling it to serve as an efficient few-shot real-robot fine-tuning strategy and demonstrating superior scalability for migration to mainstream WAM architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 World Action Models (WAMs) 中视觉分支只预测静态视觉观测、难以捕捉运动交互下世界状态演化转移信息的问题，提出 PILOT（Physical Inference for Latent Optimized Trajectories）框架。其核心是 Representational Deduction (RD)，通过把运动思维链（motion CoT）作为模型原生能力引入动作分支，显式建模潜在状态转移 token 并保留在推理空间中，以解耦高层物理条件演化与低层动作轨迹生成。实验表明该框架提升复杂机器人操作任务的成功率、泛化能力和物理可解释性，并可作为少样本真实机器人微调策略。
Motivation: 现有 WAM 的视觉分支侧重于预测静态视觉观测，而未反映运动交互下世界状态的转移信息，导致 Action Model 内部高层物理条件演化与低层动作轨迹生成出现表征纠缠，形成结构瓶颈并削弱世界演化建模对动作生成的预测能力。
Method: 提出 PILOT 及其核心 Representational Deduction (RD) 方法，将运动思维链（motion CoT）作为原生模型能力，激励动作分支显式建模潜在状态转移 token，并将这些 token 保留在推理空间中作为 CoT，用以引导细粒度运动轨迹生成。
Result: 实验显示 RD 显著提升 WAM 在复杂机器人操作任务中的成功率和泛化能力，并通过解耦高层运动语义与低层轨迹细节增强物理可解释性；丰富的状态转移监督信号有效缓解动作生成的稀疏监督问题，使该方法成为高效的少样本真实机器人微调策略，且具备迁移至主流 WAM 架构的可扩展性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过 RD 将意图（intention）与轨迹（trajectory）解耦，可提升 WAM 的预测能力、可解释性和少样本微调效率，并有望推广到主流 WAM 架构。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.motivation: 现有 WAM 的视觉分支侧重于预测静态视觉观测，而未反映运动交互下世界状态的转移信息，导致 Action Model 内部高层物理条件演化与低层动作轨迹生成出现表征纠缠，形成结构瓶颈并削弱世界演化建模对动作生成的预测能力。
summary_sections.method: 提出 PILOT 及其核心 Representational Deduction (RD) 方法，将运动思维链（motion CoT）作为原生模型能力，激励动作分支显式建模潜在状态转移 token，并将这些 token 保留在推理空间中作为 CoT，用以引导细粒度运动轨迹生成。
summary_sections.result: 实验显示 RD 显著提升 WAM 在复杂机器人操作任务中的成功率和泛化能力，并通过解耦高层运动语义与低层轨迹细节增强物理可解释性；丰富的状态转移监督信号有效缓解动作生成的稀疏监督问题，使该方法成为高效的少样本真实机器人微调策略，且具备迁移至主流 WAM 架构的可扩展性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调，通过 RD 将意图（intention）与轨迹（trajectory）解耦，可提升 WAM 的预测能力、可解释性和少样本微调效率，并有望推广到主流 WAM 架构。

papers.title: Beyond Foundation Models: Dimension-Aware Neural Architecture Search with Small-Data Representation Models for Cryocooler Lifetime Prediction
authors: (4) Alma Mater Studiorum - Universita di Bologna
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale pretrained time-series models achieve strong results through large-scale pretraining and task-agnostic representation learning, but they rely on abundant, diverse data that industrial and scientific domains often lack. We therefore propose the FSD-RM (Family of Small-Data Representation Models) paradigm as a practical alternative for limited, domain-specific telemetry. Rather than relying on large-scale pretraining, we focus on capacity-controlled representation learning using established encoder architectures (CNN1D, LSTM, GRU, Transformer), selected for their suitability in small-data settings and interpretability. These encoders are trained unsupervised on multivariate telemetry data and integrated into a two-stage pipeline for downstream lifetime prediction. To systematically examine architectural trade-offs under data constraints, we employ \textbf{dimension-aware neural architecture search (NAS)} to jointly optimize model capacity and input dimensionality. Experiments on cryocooler telemetry show that the proposed approach achieves competitive predictive performance while reducing training cost and model complexity. The contribution lies in combining established representation learning techniques within a coherent, NAS-driven framework tailored to small-data regimes, with explicitly defined parameter settings and design choices. The results indicate that effective representation learning can be achieved without large-scale pretraining when appropriate inductive bias and capacity control are applied.
papers.journal_ref: Reliability Engineering and System Safety 277 (2027) 113105
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对工业与科学领域小数据遥测场景，提出 FSD-RM (Family of Small-Data Representation Models) 范式，用 CNN1D、LSTM、GRU、Transformer 等既有编码器进行容量受控的无监督表示学习，并集成到两阶段流水线做下游寿命预测；同时采用 dimension-aware NAS 联合优化模型容量与输入维度。摘要称该方法在低温制冷机 (cryocooler) 遥测数据上取得有竞争力的预测性能，同时降低训练成本和模型复杂度，表明无需大规模预训练也能实现有效表示学习。
Motivation: 大规模预训练时间序列模型依赖充足且多样的数据，而工业与科学领域通常缺乏这类数据；论文因此针对稀缺、领域特定的遥测数据提出一个实用的替代学习范式。
Method: 提出 FSD-RM 范式，利用 CNN1D、LSTM、GRU、Transformer 等编码器在无监督设置下对多变量遥测数据进行容量受控表示学习，再接入两阶段下游寿命预测流水线；并用 dimension-aware NAS 联合搜索模型容量与输入维度，系统考察数据受限条件下的架构权衡。
Result: 在低温制冷机遥测数据上的实验显示，所提方法能达到有竞争力的预测性能，同时降低训练成本与模型复杂度。
Conclusion: 作者认为在适当的归纳偏置和容量控制下，无需大规模预训练即可获得有效的表示学习；论文的贡献在于将既有表示学习技术组织成一个面向小数据、参数设置与设计选择明确且由 NAS 驱动的框架。

papers.title: GPTKB 2.0: Browsing, Querying, and Auditing a Disambiguated LLM-Derived Knowledge Base
papers.abstract_en: We present a web demo for exploring a large-scale disambiguated knowledge base (KB) materialized from a large language model (LLM). GPTKB 2.0 contains 38.4M triples over 1.6M canonical entities, together with 207.6K consolidated relations and 66K consolidated classes. Unlike prior LLM-derived knowledge bases that largely identify entities by surface strings, GPTKB 2.0 performs context-guided disambiguation during recursive KB construction, separating homonyms and merging synonymous mentions as facts are elicited. The demo makes this process inspectable: users can browse entities, follow links across the KB, and audit the provenance of individual facts, including surface forms, candidate matches, source triples, and disambiguation decisions. The interface further supports structured SPARQL queries, natural-language questions translated to SPARQL, and entity linking from user-provided text to canonical GPTKB 2.0 entries. GPTKB 2.0 is available at https://gptkb.org/, with the full KB downloadable for offline use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 GPTKB 2.0 的网页演示，这是一个从大语言模型 (LLM) 物化的大规模消歧知识库，包含 3840 万条三元组、覆盖 160 万个规范实体、20.76 万条合并后的关系和 6.6 万个合并后的类别。与以往主要靠表面字符串识别实体的 LLM 知识库不同，GPTKB 2.0 在递归构建过程中进行上下文引导的实体消歧，区分同形异义词并合并同义提及。演示支持实体浏览、跨 KB 链接追踪、事实溯源审计、SPARQL 查询、自然语言转 SPARQL，以及从用户文本到规范实体的实体链接。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 派生知识库大多以表面字符串识别实体，导致同形异义词混淆、同义提及分散，知识库的可靠性难以审计。
Method: GPTKB 2.0 在递归知识库构建时采用上下文引导的消歧过程，将事实抽取与实体规范化结合；同时提供一个可交互 Web 演示，展示消歧决策、表面形式、候选匹配、源三元组等溯源信息，并支持 SPARQL 与自然语言查询。
Result: 摘要报告 GPTKB 2.0 包含 38.4M 三元组、1.6M 规范实体、207.6K 合并关系和 66K 合并类别，并提供在线演示及可下载的完整知识库。
Conclusion: 作者强调该演示使 LLM 派生知识库的实体消歧过程可检查、可审计，并开放 GPTKB 2.0 供在线浏览与离线使用。

papers.title: Density-aware Hierarchical Clustering Based on Element-Categorized Connection Subgraphs
papers.abstract_en: Clustering is a fundamental data mining technique for pattern recognition through unsupervised learning. Among various clustering methods, hierarchical clustering, density-based clustering, and graph clustering stand out as representative approaches. For hierarchical clustering, it can be categorized into agglomerative and divisive modes to construct clusters in a recursive manner. The key aspect of both modes is the calculation of inter-cluster similarity, which determines whether to merge the sub-clusters into one cluster or divide a current cluster into sub-clusters. Traditionally, the similarity is derived from pairwise distances, often overlooking density variations and structural connectivity in graphs. To address this, we propose a density-aware hierarchical clustering method based on element-categorized connection subgraphs (DHC-ECS), which effectively integrates the hierarchical clustering, density-based clustering, and graph clustering. Particularly, a novel inter-cluster similarity metric is introduced that considers not only distances but also the element categorization in the KNN connection subgraphs, kernel density estimation, and local connectivity within sub-clusters. Extensive evaluations on heterogeneous benchmark datasets demonstrate that DHC-ECS exhibits superior overall performance in terms of clustering accuracy and parameter robustness compared with the baseline methods (including AChameleon, RNN-DBSCAN, McDPC, and G-RMS). The work indicates the great potential of the proposed clustering algorithm for low-dimensional datasets by leveraging local density and graph-structured connectivity (i.e., the duality of vertices and edges), as well as the possibility to determine an intrinsic threshold, reducing the reliance on manual parameter tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种密度感知的分层聚类方法 DHC-ECS，基于元素分类的连接子图，将分层聚类、密度聚类和图聚类思想整合到一个框架中。其核心是新的簇间相似度度量，同时考虑 KNN 连接子图中的元素分类、核密度估计和子簇内局部连通性。在异构基准数据集上的评估显示，该方法在聚类精度和参数鲁棒性上优于 AChameleon、RNN-DBSCAN、McDPC 和 G-RMS 等基线方法。
Motivation: 传统分层聚类（无论是凝聚式还是分裂式）的簇间相似度通常仅由成对距离推导，容易忽略密度变化和图结构连通性，限制了对复杂低维数据结构的识别能力。
Method: 提出 DHC-ECS，设计了一种新的簇间相似度度量，融合 KNN 连接子图中的元素分类（element categorization）、核密度估计（kernel density estimation）以及子簇内的局部连通性（local connectivity），从而同时利用局部密度与图结构信息（顶点与边的对偶性）。
Result: 在异构基准数据集上的大量评估表明，DHC-ECS 相比基线方法（AChameleon、RNN-DBSCAN、McDPC 和 G-RMS）在聚类精度和参数鲁棒性方面表现出更优的整体性能。
Conclusion: 摘要指出该方法对低维数据集具有较大潜力，能够借助局部密度和图结构连通性工作，并可能确定内在阈值，从而减少对人工参数调优的依赖。

papers.title: HarnessSafe: Evaluating Safety Across Persistent Carriers in Agent Harnesses
papers.abstract_en: Modern agent harnesses persist state across tasks and sessions through persistent carriers like memory, skills, tools, and shared artifacts. However, this capability creates delayed safety risks: attacker-influenced content can cross system boundaries and later affect the execution of a benign request. Existing benchmarks typically focus on a few carriers or harnesses, while end-to-end attack-success rates reveal little about how risks propagate. To this end, we present HarnessSafe, a benchmark comprising 328 executable cases across seven persistent-carrier families and evaluated on most mainstream agent harnesses. Each case is specified as a Persistent-Risk Lifecycle that traces attacker influence from its initial entry, through persistence across carriers and system boundaries, to a later benign trigger and an observable violation. We further introduce a multi-stage, trace-based evaluation that uses observable execution evidence to determine how far each attack chain progresses and where it is stopped. Experiments show that containment is carrier-specific and strongly depends on the harness-model configuration. Both the harness and model backend substantially shape containment outcomes, while attack success rates cannot reflect distinct lifecycle progression patterns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HarnessSafe，一个针对智能体框架（agent harness）持久化载体安全风险的基准，包含 328 个可执行用例，覆盖七类持久化载体（如 memory、skills、tools、shared artifacts）。每个用例以 Persistent-Risk Lifecycle 形式描述攻击影响从初始注入、跨载体与系统边界持久化，到后续良性触发并产生可观测违规的完整链条。作者还引入基于可观测执行证据的多阶段追踪评估，用来判断攻击链推进到哪一步以及在哪被阻断。实验表明，风险遏制（containment）具有载体特异性，并强烈依赖 harness-model 配置，攻击成功率无法反映不同的生命周期推进模式。
Motivation: 现代智能体框架会在任务与会话之间通过持久化载体保留状态，这带来延迟性安全风险：受攻击者影响的内容可能跨越系统边界，并在之后影响良性请求的执行。现有基准通常只覆盖少数载体或框架，端到端攻击成功率也难以揭示风险如何在系统中传播。
Method: 构建 HarnessSafe 基准，将每个攻击用例规范化为 Persistent-Risk Lifecycle，并设计多阶段、基于追踪的评估方法，利用可观测的执行证据判断攻击链推进程度及被拦截位置；该基准覆盖七类持久化载体家族，并在多数主流智能体框架上评测。
Result: 实验显示风险遏制具有载体特异性且强烈依赖框架与模型的配置；框架本身和模型后端都会显著影响遏制结果，而攻击成功率无法体现不同生命周期推进模式的差异。
Conclusion: 作者强调持久化载体是多阶段安全风险的关键传播途径，HarnessSafe 提供了比端到端攻击成功率更细粒度的评估视角，用于定位攻击链在何处被阻断。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Local Epistemic Uncertainty Guided Active Sampling for Plug-and-play Diffusive Image Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have demonstrated remarkable effectiveness in image restoration tasks. However, when guiding image reconstruction, existing Diffusion Model-based Image Restoration (DMIR) methods typically rely on fixed data constraints and uniform step sizes, thereby overlooking the dynamic nature of the generative process. Such rigid designs render the models vulnerable to spatially non-uniform degradations, thus resulting in structural distortions and loss of fine details. Meanwhile, uniform step sizes introduce computational redundancy, whereas naïve step reduction strategies tend to accumulate approximation errors. To address these limitations, we propose a Local Epistemic Uncertainty Guided Active Sampling framework (LEADer). In the spatial domain, LEADer leverages pixel-wise uncertainty to dynamically modulate the prior strength within the null space, which effectively balances detail preservation and artifact suppression. In the temporal domain, it quantifies sampling stability via the uncertainty trace to enable adaptive trajectory pruning, thereby accelerating convergence. Theoretical proofs demonstrate that our framework achieves strict data consistency, while the trajectory pruning strategy admits a deterministic error bound, thereby guaranteeing stable convergence under skip sampling. Notably, our plug-and-play method can be seamlessly integrated into various DMIR baselines. Extensive experiments show that LEADer improves the performance of multiple state-of-the-art DMIR methods, while significantly reducing sampling time with negligible memory overhead. Code is available at https://github.com/JiaqiZhang-Sengoku/LEADer.

Motivation: 现有DMIR方法通常依赖固定数据约束和均匀步长，忽视生成过程的动态性，导致对空间非均匀退化敏感，易产生结构失真和细节丢失；均匀步长带来计算冗余，而简单的跳步策略会累积近似误差。

papers.title: PHASE-Tree: Modeling Character-State Evolution in Long-Horizon Role-Playing Dialogue
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon role-playing demands that characters remain recognizable as they evolve with the narrative. Yet existing work falls short on two fronts: representations are typically static profiles that cannot be updated locally without destabilizing unchanged traits, and benchmarks mainly test persona preservation and memory recall rather than whether a model speaks from a character's currently evolved state. We address both. PHASE-Tree is a multi-timescale character-state tree with an immutable identity root and mutable persona, session, and moment layers, making each mutable field an addressable target for localized within- and cross-episode updates. It conditions generation through explicit textual provision or implicit parametric adaptation. To measure evolved-state generation, we introduce LongEvoRoleBench, which pairs four long-dialogue corpora for cross-episode evolution with four short-dialogue corpora as within-scene state-tracking checks, under a unified next-utterance protocol. On the long-dialogue core, textual PHASE-Tree ranks first in 11 of 12 dataset-metric cells against internal variants and all 12 cells against external textual baselines, improving character-level, semantic, and embedding scores by 19.7%, 12.4%, and 15.1% respectively. In a blinded 200-response study, human ratings correlate with the GPT-4.1 judge (Pearson r= 0.65); on descriptive n= 10 PT and NR prompt subsets, the Overall difference is +0.20. The long-dialogue Sem advantage persists across LLM judges and generation backbones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PHASE-Tree，一种面向长时程角色扮演对话的多时间尺度角色状态树，包含不可变的身份根节点与可变的 persona、session、moment 层，使每个可变字段成为局部更新的可寻址目标，支持篇章内与跨篇章的状态更新。作者同时引入 LongEvoRoleBench 基准，用四个长对话语料评估跨篇章演化、四个短对话语料作为场景内状态追踪检查，采用统一的下一句生成协议。摘要报告在长对话核心上，文本版 PHASE-Tree 在 12 个 dataset-metric 单元中对内部变体取得 11 个第一、对外部文本基线全部 12 个第一，字符级、语义与嵌入分数分别提升 19.7%、12.4% 与 15.1%。
Motivation: 现有长时程角色扮演工作存在两方面不足：角色表示通常是静态档案，无法在不破坏未变化特质的前提下进行局部更新；已有基准主要测试人设保持与记忆召回，而非检验模型是否从角色当前演化状态出发进行生成。
Method: PHASE-Tree 构建多时间尺度角色状态树，以不可变的身份根节点和可变的 persona、session、moment 层组织状态，并通过显式文本供给或隐式参数适配两种方式条件化生成。为评测演化状态生成，作者提出 LongEvoRoleBench，统一采用下一句生成协议，结合四个跨篇章演化的长对话语料与四个场景内状态追踪的短对话语料。
Result: 在长对话核心上，文本版 PHASE-Tree 对内部变体在 12 个 dataset-metric 单元中取得 11 个第一，对外部文本基线全部 12 个单元第一，字符级、语义与嵌入分数分别提升 19.7%、12.4% 与 15.1%。盲评 200 条回复中，人类评分与 GPT-4.1 评判的相关性为 Pearson r=0.65；在描述性的 PT 与 NR 提示子集（n=10）上 Overall 差异为 +0.20。长对话语义优势在不同 LLM 评判与生成骨干下保持稳定。
Conclusion: 作者认为现有基准不足以反映角色演化状态下的生成能力，PHASE-Tree 通过结构化、可局部更新的状态树满足长时程角色演化建模需求，LongEvoRoleBench 可用于衡量演化状态生成质量。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: When One Modality Is Not Enough: Multimodal Sex and Life-Stage Classification of Red Deer from Aerial RGB-Thermal Video
papers.abstract_en: Aerial drone surveys increasingly support wildlife population estimation, yet a useful census is more than a count: population dynamics are defined by species composition, sex ratios and age structure, that is, by which species are present and how a herd splits into adult males, adult females and juveniles. We use red deer ($\textit{Cervus elaphus}$) as a test case, because managers act on these dynamics and because the visible cue defining adult males, the antlers, is seasonally variable. Surveys are flown nadir, high enough not to disturb the animals, so each deer occupies only a small, low-resolution patch. The two recording modalities fail in opposite conditions: in color a deer under canopy blends into the ground, while in thermal it becomes a bright blob that loses fine detail. Rather than trust either modality alone, we fuse them at every stage using self-supervised DINOv3 features. Our pipeline tracks animals in both modalities, treats an animal as confirmed only when the two cameras agree, keeps only the clear, non-occluded frames, and assigns species and sex by a vote across them; life stage is read separately from geo-referenced body size, since at survey resolution a juvenile often only differs from an adult female in size. Across four flights spanning the antler season the fused pipeline correctly classifies 25 of the 26 detected individuals (7 of 8 adult males, all 16 adult females and 2 juveniles), against 20 of 26 for either sensor alone. Multimodal species classification reaches 96.0%, while for sex classification fusing the two sensors matters most: the combined RGB+thermal model is the most robust across environments and seasons. Automating the demographic classification turns a drone flight from a count into a repeatable reading of herd structure, so the sex ratios and age structure that managers already act on can be gathered as often as a survey can be flown.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何从无人机航拍的 RGB 与热成像 (thermal) 视频中自动完成红鹿 (Cervus elaphus) 的物种、性别和生命阶段分类。作者提出一个全程融合两种模态的流水线：用自监督 DINOv3 特征跟踪动物，双相机一致时才确认个体，过滤遮挡帧后对物种和性别投票，生命阶段则由地理参考的体型单独判定。摘要报告在覆盖鹿角季节的四次飞行中，融合流水线正确分类 26 个检测个体中的 25 个（8 个成年雄性中 7 个、全部 16 个成年雌性和 2 个幼体），而任一单模态只达到 26 个中的 20 个。
Motivation: 野生动物调查需要的不只是数量，还包括性别比例和年龄结构，但航拍分辨率低且两种模态各有缺陷：可见光下树冠中的鹿难以分辨，热成像则失去细节。需要多模态融合来获得可靠的种群结构信息。
Method: 提出全流程多模态融合流水线：在 RGB 和热成像两路视频中均进行动物跟踪，仅当两个相机一致时确认个体，保留清晰无遮挡帧，然后在帧间投票分类物种和性别；生命阶段依据地理参考的体型 (geo-referenced body size) 单独判断，因为幼体与成年雌性在调查分辨率下主要差别是体型。
Result: 四次飞行中融合流水线正确分类 26 个检测个体中的 25 个，优于任一单传感器的 20/26；多模态物种分类准确率达 96.0%，并且 RGB+热成像联合模型在性别分类上跨环境和季节最稳健。
Conclusion: 自动化人口统计分类能把无人机飞行从简单计数转变为可重复获得的群群结构读数，使管理者能按需收集性别比例和年龄结构。摘要未提及明显局限，但强调融合两种模态是提升稳健性的关键。

papers.title: Generative Embedding Benchmark: How Much Information Survives in a Dense Embedding?
papers.abstract_en: Embeddings have emerged as a standard representational interface linking foundation models with downstream systems. Most embedding benchmarks assess representations through discriminative tasks or geometric criteria centered on separability in embedding space. However, strong performance on such evaluations does not establish whether content compressed into an embedding remains accessible to a downstream generator. To address this gap, we introduce the Generative Embedding Benchmark (GEB), in which a decoder answers questions using only a frozen embedding and question text, without access to the original image or intermediate visual features. Answer quality under this readout measures generative information: the answer-relevant content recoverable from an embedding. GEB includes a curated visual-question-answering dataset with a 1,800-item development split and a held-out 900-item test split covering natural images, scene text, and visual documents. Using a common decoder and training recipe, we evaluate seven public embedding models in visual-only and vision-language joint modes. On the test set, visual-only scores range from 28.25 to 33.21; with image-question joint encoding, all five VLM-based embedding models score higher, and the best reaches 65.56. Matched embeddings also outperform text-only inputs, zero embeddings, and shuffled embeddings. Natural-image information is much easier to recover than scene text or visual-document information, while a Qwen3-VL-2B reference with access to the original image reaches 84.30. Together, these results show that generative readout exposes information bottlenecks that separability-based evaluation does not capture.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出生成式嵌入基准 (Generative Embedding Benchmark, GEB)，用于检验稠密嵌入 (dense embedding) 中被压缩的内容是否仍可供下游生成器恢复。GEB 仅给解码器一个冻结的嵌入和问题文本，禁止访问原始图像或中间视觉特征，并包含 1,800 项开发集与 900 项测试集的视觉问答数据，覆盖自然图像、场景文本和视觉文档。作者用统一解码器与训练方案评估七个公开嵌入模型，结果显示生成式读取能暴露基于可分性 (separability) 的评测无法捕捉的信息瓶颈。
Motivation: 现有嵌入基准大多通过判别式任务或嵌入空间中的几何可分性标准来评估表示质量，但这类评测表现好并不能说明嵌入中压缩的内容对下游生成器仍然可访问。
Method: GEB 的评测协议是让解码器仅依据冻结的嵌入与问题文本回答问题，并基于此定义生成信息 (generative information)。作者构建了覆盖自然图像、场景文本和视觉文档的 VQA 数据集，在视觉单模态与视觉-语言联合两种模式下，用统一解码器和训练方案评估了七个公开嵌入模型，并设置文本输入、零嵌入 (zero embeddings) 和打乱嵌入 (shuffled embeddings) 作为对照。
Result: 测试集上视觉单模态得分区间为 28.25 到 33.21；加入图像-问题联合编码后，五个基于 VLM 的嵌入模型均得分更高，最优达到 65.56。匹配嵌入优于纯文本输入、零嵌入和打乱嵌入；自然图像信息比场景文本或视觉文档信息更容易恢复，而能访问原始图像的 Qwen3-VL-2B 参考模型达到 84.30。
Conclusion: 生成式读取能够揭示基于可分性的评测未捕获的信息瓶颈；虽然匹配嵌入输入优于各对照设置，但与直接访问原始图像的参考模型相比仍有明显差距。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.conclusion: 生成式读取能够揭示基于可分性的评测未捕获的信息瓶颈；虽然匹配嵌入输入优于各对照设置，但与直接访问原始图像的参考模型相比仍有明显差距。

papers.title: Mixture of Geodesic Factor Analyzers on Riemannian Homogeneous Spaces
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces Mixtures of Geodesic Factor Analyzers (MGFA) on Riemannian homogeneous spaces. MGFA uses a geodesic factor model within each mixture component, providing greater expressiveness than mixtures of Riemannian radial distributions and enabling clustering of manifold-valued data with anisotropic subpopulations. We establish root-$n$ consistency for the MGFA maximum likelihood estimator (MLE), thereby filling a theoretical gap for mixtures of Riemannian radial distributions as a special case. We also propose an iterative estimation algorithm and implement it on spheres, shape spaces, and hyperbolic spaces. Numerical experiments show that MGFA substantially outperforms competing methods in well-specified regimes while remaining robust under model misspecification. Finally, case studies on corpus callosum and left hippocampus shape datasets demonstrate MGFA's effectiveness for both 2D contour and 3D shape analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在黎曼齐次空间 (Riemannian homogeneous spaces) 上提出测地线因子分析器混合模型 (Mixtures of Geodesic Factor Analyzers, MGFA)，每个混合分量使用测地线因子模型，从而比黎曼径向分布混合更具表达力，可对具有各向异性子群的流形值数据进行聚类。作者建立了 MGFA 极大似然估计 (MLE) 的根 n 相合性，填补了黎曼径向分布混合作为特例时的理论空白，并在球面、形状空间和双曲空间上实现了迭代估计算法。数值实验显示 MGFA 在设定正确的场景下明显优于对比方法，且在模型误设定下仍保持稳健；胼胝体与海马体形状数据的案例研究验证了其在 2D 轮廓与 3D 形状分析中的有效性。
Motivation: 现有流形值数据聚类方法多依赖黎曼径向分布混合，难以刻画各向异性 (anisotropic) 的子群结构；同时该类混合模型的极大似然估计缺乏相应的渐近理论保证。
Method: 在每个混合分量内采用测地线因子模型 (geodesic factor model)，构造 MGFA 似然并给出迭代估计算法；算法分别在球面、形状空间和双曲空间上实现。
Result: 理论上证明 MGFA 的 MLE 具有 root-n 相合性；实验中 MGFA 在设定正确的场景下显著优于竞争方法，并在模型误设定下保持稳健；在胼胝体和左海马体形状数据集上展示了 2D 轮廓与 3D 形状分析的适用性。
Conclusion: MGFA 以各向同性混合模型的特殊情形补全了理论缺口，并为流形值数据的各向异性子群聚类提供了兼具理论保证和实际效果的建模工具。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Finding Usable Weight Mechanisms with Tiled SVD
papers.abstract_en: The dominant approach to mechanistic interpretability trains proxy dictionaries such as sparse autoencoders and labels features from max-activating text. The best such atlases identify con- cepts, but that identity lives in the learned dictionary rather than in the network weights them- selves. We propose extracting mechanism mounts directly from linear sites by column-tiled SVD: each mount is a triple (v,u,σ) read as trigger, write, and strength. Identity is the weight rule. We evaluate mounts with a pre-registered suite judged on full-write energy lift rather than tile-local lift. On Gemma-2-2B with WikiText-2 (16,384-token subsample), all seven linear maps are scored: residual writes (mlp.down, attn.o) receive full A/B/C with steer after post-sublayer RMSNorm and pass 52/52 site-layers; other maps receive A/B only (mlp.gate/attn.q/attn.k/effective mlp.up/attn.v 26/26 each). Aggregate: 182/182 GO. We release library code, the corpus builder, the experiment entrypoint, and unit tests.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Finding usable weight mechanisms via column-tiled SVD; pre-registered A/B/C eval on Gemma-2-2B (WikiText-2)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于列分块SVD（column-tiled SVD）的机制可解释性方法，直接从线性层权重中提取“机制挂载点”（mechanism mounts），每个挂载点用三元组 (v,u,σ) 表示 trigger、write 和 strength，身份即权重规则。在 Gemma-2-2B 与 WikiText-2（16,384 token 子样本）上对七个线性映射进行预注册 A/B/C 评估，所有 182/182 站点层通过。作者同时发布库代码、语料构建器、实验入口和单元测试。
Motivation: 主流机制可解释性依赖训练稀疏自编码器等代理字典，并从最大激活文本中标注特征，但学到的身份存在于字典而非网络权重本身。作者希望直接从线性层权重中提取可用的机制，而不是通过代理字典间接解释。
Method: 对线性层权重做列分块SVD（column-tiled SVD），将每个分解出的三元组 (v,u,σ) 解读为 trigger、write 和 strength；评估采用预注册的完整写入能量提升（full-write energy lift）而非 tile-local lift，并在后子层 RMSNorm 之后进行 steer。
Result: 在 Gemma-2-2B 与 WikiText-2（16,384 token 子样本）上，七个线性映射全部评分：residual writes（mlp.down、attn.o）获得完整 A/B/C 评估并 52/52 站点层通过，其余映射（mlp.gate、attn.q、attn.k、effective mlp.up、attn.v）各 26/26 通过 A/B，总计 182/182 GO。
Conclusion: 该工作表明列分块SVD可以直接从权重中获得可用的机制挂载点，并提供了完整可复现的代码与实验入口。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Same physical state, different collective dynamics: state encodings select synchronization outcomes in language-model agents
papers.abstract_en: Language-model agents act on state encodings of their environment, yet these are treated as interchangeable interfaces. Using pretrained language models, we designed a circular-synchronization experiment applying a state-encoding intervention while holding the physical system fixed: each agent sees only a summary of its neighbours' relative phases and chooses to advance, stay or retard. Encoding that state as low-order circular moments rather than as a histogram selected different collective outcomes. In GPT the moment encoding synchronized the population in 6/6 seeds and the histogram encodings in 0/6; the effect replicated in Claude but reversed direction. Replaying identical fields shifted each agent's advance/stay/retard probabilities far beyond within-encoding repeat variation, in GPT, Claude and Gemini; in GPT, presentation alone shifted the operator with the moment values fixed. State encodings therefore form part of a model-dependent effective interaction law, not a neutral interface.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型智能体如何受环境状态编码方式影响其集体行为。作者设计了一个圆形同步实验，在物理系统保持不变的前提下对状态编码进行干预：每个智能体只看到邻居相对相位的某种摘要，并在前进、保持、后退之间选择。结果显示，把同一物理状态编码为低阶圆矩而非直方图，会在 GPT 中导致完全不同的同步结果，且该效应在 Claude 中可复现但方向相反；重放相同输入也会显著改变智能体决策概率。作者由此认为状态编码不是中性接口，而是模型依赖的有效相互作用规律的一部分。
Motivation: 语言模型智能体基于环境的状态编码（state encoding）行动，但这些编码通常被视为可互换的中性接口。作者想检验在物理系统完全不变时，仅改变状态编码是否就会改变智能体的集体动力学。
Method: 设计圆形同步（circular-synchronization）实验，让每个智能体仅观察邻居相对相位的摘要并选择前进、保持或后退；在固定物理系统下对比低阶圆矩（circular moments）与直方图两种状态编码，并通过重放相同输入和控制呈现方式来分离编码内容与呈现方式的影响。
Result: 在 GPT 中，矩编码在 6/6 个种子下使群体同步，而直方图编码在 0/6 个种子下同步；该效应在 Claude 中复现但方向相反。在 GPT、Claude 和 Gemini 中，重放相同输入会使各智能体的前进/保持/后退概率发生远超编码内重复变异的变化；在 GPT 中，仅改变呈现方式、固定矩取值也能改变算子行为。
Conclusion: 摘要认为状态编码构成模型依赖的有效相互作用规律（effective interaction law），而非与模型无关的中性接口，因此在使用语言模型智能体研究集体动力学时不能将编码视为可互换的界面。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning in Deep Networks under Dale's Constraint
papers.abstract_en: Biologically plausible learning models aim to explain how neural circuits can implement effective learning under the constraints of real neurons. Although significant progress has been made, a major remaining challenge is that existing models often allow neurons or synapses to represent mixed-sign values, both positive and negative, in violation of a basic aspect of cortical circuitry -- Dale's constraint: biological neurons are either excitatory or inhibitory, but not both, and synapses cannot change sign. In this work, we address this discrepancy by introducing a biologically motivated neural architecture in which both neural activations and learning signals are represented by non-negative activity, and synapses have fixed sign, while still supporting backpropagation-like learning. Our approach uses two complementary interacting non-negative channels to represent positive and negative contributions, inspired by evidence of on-off representations in the brain. These channels are implemented through a simple neural circuit motif, which is repeated throughout the network in both bottom-up and top-down pathways. Combined with a local Hebbian learning rule, the resulting model propagates learning signals and updates weights using only local interactions between neurons. We show theoretically that our learning scheme can exactly recover the backpropagation update despite relying solely on non-negative error signals. Empirically, beyond satisfying stronger biological constraints, the on-off architecture learns efficient representations, yielding substantial gains over comparable vanilla networks on the Tiny ImageNet benchmark. These results demonstrate that effective learning can emerge from biologically plausible mechanisms without requiring mixed-sign signals, providing a step toward more realistic models of neural computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对生物可塑性学习模型中普遍违反 Dale 约束（Dale's constraint）的问题——即神经元或突触常被允许表示正负混合符号值——提出一种生物启发的网络架构，其中神经活动和学习信号均为非负，突触符号固定，但仍支持类似反向传播的学习。作者采用两个互补交互的非负通道表示正负贡献，并通过重复的局部神经回路与 Hebbian 学习规则传播误差；理论上证明该方案能精确恢复 backpropagation 更新，实验在 Tiny ImageNet 上取得显著增益。
Motivation: 现有生物可塑性学习模型常允许神经元或突触表示混合符号值，违反皮层回路的基本事实：生物神经元要么兴奋要么抑制，突触不能改变符号；这一差异阻碍了更真实的神经计算模型。
Method: 提出由两个互补的非负通道（on-off 表征）构成的简单神经回路，在网络的 bottom-up 和 top-down 通路中重复使用；配合局部 Hebbian 学习规则，仅依靠非负误差信号和神经元间局部交互来传播学习信号并更新权重。
Result: 理论上证明仅依赖非负误差信号即可精确恢复反向传播更新；经验上，在满足更强生物约束的同时，on-off 架构在 Tiny ImageNet 基准上比可比的 vanilla 网络获得显著性能提升。
Conclusion: 摘要认为有效学习可以从生物可塑性机制中涌现，而不需要混合符号信号，为更现实的神经计算模型迈出一步。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CAi Copilot: Reducing Operational Workload in Molecular Design through Intent-Driven Agentic Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Early-stage molecular design is an iterative process, not just a task of generating molecules. Researchers turn broad goals into design strategies, refine candidates, assess many properties, and gather evidence before synthesis and tests. AI methods can generate molecules, optimize several goals, predict properties, dock compounds, and account for synthesis. Yet these functions are spread across specialized tools. Experts must still coordinate each step, judge interim results, and integrate evidence. The central challenge is thus to turn research intent into adaptive, traceable runs grounded in scientific tools. We cast this challenge as intent-to-evidence molecular design workflow execution and present CAi Copilot, an expert-oriented agent with three linked layers. The Research Interface Layer turns intent into an executable plan. The Agent Reasoning Layer uses interim results to guide each run. The Execution Substrate supplies molecular tools, metrics, reusable utilities, and backend services. Across 45 tasks, CAi achieves the strongest overall performance, with an outcome score of 84.59, exceeding the next-best result by 18.07 points. Additional benchmarks test how CAi coordinates generation, screening, and multi-criteria evaluation, while exposing limits in long-horizon execution. These results show that CAi turns broad molecular-design intent into transparent, traceable workflows that connect interim decisions to candidate-level evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CAi Copilot，一个面向分子设计专家的智能体，将研究意图转化为可执行、可追溯的分子设计工作流，覆盖生成、筛选、多准则评估等环节。系统由研究接口层（Research Interface Layer）、智能体推理层（Agent Reasoning Layer）和执行基底（Execution Substrate）三层组成。在 45 个任务上，CAi 以 84.59 的结果分数超过次优方法 18.07 分；作者也指出其在长时程执行（long-horizon execution）上存在局限。
Motivation: 早期分子设计是迭代过程，但现有 AI 功能分散在专门工具中，专家仍需手动协调各步骤、判断中间结果并整合证据。核心挑战是将研究意图转化为基于科学工具的自适应、可追溯运行，即 intent-to-evidence 分子设计工作流执行。
Method: 提出由三层组成的专家导向智能体：研究接口层将意图转为可执行计划；智能体推理层利用中间结果引导每次运行；执行基底提供分子工具、指标、可复用工具和后台服务。
Result: 在 45 个任务上取得最强综合性能，outcome score 为 84.59，比次优结果高 18.07 分；额外基准测试考察其对生成、筛选和多准则评估的协调能力，同时暴露出长时程执行方面的局限。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 CAi 能把宽泛的分子设计意图转化为透明、可追溯的工作流，将中间决策与候选级证据连接起来，但长时程执行仍是待改进之处。
Relevance: 0
