papers.title: Summarize First, Download Later: Onboard VLMs for Bandwidth-Efficient Earth Observation
papers.abstract_en: Modern Earth observation (EO) satellites carry increasingly advanced sensors that produce vast volumes of high-resolution, multispectral data, yet downlink capacity remains a critical bottleneck -- often causing significant latency or the loss of valuable observations within limited contact windows. We propose a "Summarize First, Download Later" paradigm that exploits recent advances in onboard edge computing and Vision-Language Models (VLMs). Rather than indiscriminately downlinking raw imagery, the system follows a three-phase interaction protocol: the satellite first transmits concise natural language summaries generated by a quantized onboard VLM; ground operators then issue targeted Visual Question Answering (VQA) queries to verify scene relevance (e.g., wildfires or maritime anomalies); and full-resolution images are downloaded only when critical information is confirmed. This transforms the downlink from passive bulk transfer into an active, semantics-aware dialogue. We implement and evaluate the system on a resource-constrained NVIDIA Jetson platform, and experiments on diverse remote sensing scenes show that the proposed strategy substantially reduces bandwidth consumption while accelerating time-to-insight for time-sensitive missions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出面向地球观测卫星的“先总结、后下载”（Summarize First, Download Later）范式，利用机载边缘计算和量化视觉语言模型（VLM）在星上生成自然语言摘要，地面操作员再通过视觉问答（VQA）查询确认场景相关性，仅对确认关键信息的影像下载全分辨率数据。系统在资源受限的 NVIDIA Jetson 平台上实现并评估，实验显示可显著降低带宽消耗并加快时效敏感任务的信息获取时间。
Motivation: 现代地球观测卫星产生大量高分辨率、多光谱数据，但下行链路容量是关键瓶颈，往往在有限联络窗口内造成显著延迟或观测数据丢失。
Method: 提出三阶段交互协议：星上量化 VLM 先传输简洁的自然语言摘要；地面操作员随后发出针对性 VQA 查询以验证场景相关性（例如野火或海上异常）；仅在确认关键信息时才下载全分辨率图像。
Result: 在资源受限的 NVIDIA Jetson 平台上实现并评估，针对多种遥感场景的实验表明该方法大幅降低带宽消耗，同时加速时效敏感任务的信息获取。
Conclusion: 该方法将被动批量下行传输转变为主动的、语义感知的对话过程，适用于时间敏感的地球观测任务。

papers.title: How Molecular Generative Models Organize Molecular Identity
papers.abstract_en: Generative models for matter are often evaluated as samplers over output representations, and their latent spaces are commonly used as proxies for navigating chemical space. Much less is known about how these models internally arrange discrete chemical identities within those representations. We study this arrangement by making molecular identity explicit and pulling it back through the generative process. Through these pullbacks we probe the regions that generate the same object, exposing the trained model's internal repertoire: a fixed partition that determines which objects (novel or not) the model can produce. Across three molecular generative architectures, we find that this repertoire is arranged into piecewise-constant regions separated by recurring coarse-to-fine boundaries. Its organization depends on the representation probed, the identity convention, decoder stochasticity, and the metric used to compare coordinates. During training, local chemical organization stabilizes while the number of distinct molecular identities represented within each neighborhood continues to change. Internal organization must therefore be characterized, rather than assumed, before a generative space can be treated as chemically navigable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究分子生成模型如何在内部表示中组织离散的化学身份（molecular identity）。作者将分子身份显式化并通过生成过程做 pullback，探测产生同一对象的区域，从而揭示训练模型内部的“repertoire”：一个固定划分，决定模型能生成哪些对象（新颖与否）。在三种分子生成架构上，他们发现该 repertoire 被组织成分片常数区域（piecewise-constant regions），由反复出现的由粗到细（coarse-to-fine）边界分隔，且组织方式取决于所探测的表示、身份约定、解码器随机性和比较坐标所用的度量。
Motivation: 现有的物质生成模型通常被当作输出表示的采样器来评估，其潜空间常被用作导航化学空间的代理，但人们很少了解这些模型如何在内部排列离散的化学身份。本文旨在填补这一空白，主张在把生成空间视为化学上可导航之前，必须先刻画其内部组织。
Method: 通过将分子身份显式化并沿生成过程做 pullback，探测生成同一对象的区域，以暴露训练模型内部的固定划分；研究在三种分子生成架构上进行，并系统考察表示、身份约定、解码器随机性及坐标比较度量等因素的影响。
Result: 摘要报告该内部 repertoire 排列为分片常数区域，并由重复出现的 coarse-to-fine 边界分隔；其组织高度依赖探测的表示、身份约定、解码器随机性和度量。训练过程中，局部化学组织趋于稳定，但每个邻域内所表示的 distinct molecular identities 数量持续变化。
Conclusion: 作者强调，生成空间必须先被刻画而不能被假定，才能被当作化学上可导航的空间使用；这提示内部组织本身应作为评估与理解生成模型的关键对象。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Critical Acclaim Orientation in Large Language Models: Evidence from Film Preference Elicitation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are trained on corpora that contain expressions of human judgment about films, books, music, and more. Yet whether LLMs systematically reproduce evaluative hierarchies remains unclear. Prior research on cultural bias in LLMs suggests competing expectations: models may mirror the popularity signals of internet texts, or may reproduce forms of prestige embedded in critical discourse. We probe this question through a study of film evaluations with eight models from four families (Anthropic, OpenAI, Alibaba, and Mistral), using a 200-film benchmark partitioned into critically acclaimed, commercially successful, and dual-legitimacy (critical acclaim + commercial success) films. Across 20,000 pairwise forced-choice comparisons per model analyzed with Bradley--Terry estimation, we observe a consistent critical acclaim orientation with all models: critically acclaimed yet commercially obscure films are selected over commercially successful yet critically unrecognized ones. This pattern grows with model scale within each family. In addition, nested OLS regression analyses show that evaluative orientation, public visibility, and popular reception distinctly help explain preferences. Adjusting for public visibility reverses the models' preference for dual-legitimacy films over critical acclaim-only films, while additionally accounting for popular reception attenuates much of the disadvantage of films with commercial success only. Finally, evaluative and recommendation-oriented prompt framings produce divergent rankings, suggesting that critical acclaim orientation may manifest indirectly in real-world LLM deployments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文以电影评价为实验域，考察大语言模型是否系统性地复现人类评价等级体系。作者构建了包含评论界认可、商业成功和双重合法性三类电影的 200 部电影基准，对来自 Anthropic、OpenAI、Alibaba、Mistral 四个家族的八个模型进行每模型 20,000 次成对强制选择，并用 Bradley-Terry 模型估计偏好。结果显示所有模型都表现出一致的评论界认可取向，且该取向随模型规模增强；嵌套 OLS 回归和不同提示框架的分析进一步揭示了评价取向、公开可见性与大众接受度对偏好的不同作用。
Motivation: 以往关于 LLM 文化偏见的研究给出了竞争性预期：模型可能模仿互联网文本中的流行度信号，也可能复现批评性话语中嵌入的声望形式，因此模型是否系统性地复现评价等级尚不清楚。
Method: 采用 200 部电影基准，将电影划分为评论界认可、商业成功和双重合法性三类；对四个模型家族的八个模型分别进行 20,000 次成对强制选择，以 Bradley-Terry 估计偏好；并使用嵌套 OLS 回归检验评价取向、公开可见性和大众接受度等因素的解释力，同时比较评价型与推荐型提示框架下的结果。
Result: 所有模型均倾向于选择评论界认可但商业上不知名的电影，而非商业成功但评论界未认可的电影，且该模式随模型规模扩大而增强。控制公开可见性后，模型对双重合法性电影相对于仅评论界认可电影的偏好发生反转；再加入大众接受度后，仅商业成功电影的劣势被大幅削弱。评价型与推荐型提示框架产生不同的排名。
Conclusion: 摘要指出 LLM 在电影评价中呈现一致的评论界认可取向，并认为该取向可能在真实 LLM 部署中间接显现，评价取向、公开可见性与大众接受度等因素共同影响模型偏好。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Explicit, Not Longer: What Makes Epistemic Stance Survive Memory Compression
papers.abstract_en: Agent memory systems compress what they store, and compression is built to drop qualifiers, so a claim's epistemic standing tends not to survive being written to memory. We ask what governs whether it does. Matched notes carry the identical claim and identical stance and differ only in where that stance sits; one model compresses both under the same budget among the same filler notes, and a blind reader that never sees the condition scores the result. Across 60 claims in seven registers, writing the stance as a labelled field rather than a bracketed aside raises retention by about 15 points on two models (37 claims to 2 on one, 30 to 8 on the other; permutation p=0.00005), and a pre-registered replication on Haiku, its prediction and decision rule committed before the run, gives +15.6 points, 38 claims to 1. Ablating the format on both models gives the same net effect from different parts: labels help on both (+9.7 and +12.8) and length helps on neither, but wording the stance as a full sentence is the largest component on one model (+12.5) and worth nothing on the other (+0.6). Either model alone would have licensed a confident and different mechanism, so we claim only the intersection: make the stance explicit, not merely longer, and expect the best way of being explicit to depend on the model. A deterministic readout with no model reproduces the two-cell direction and five of seven ablation contrasts, but not length or labels, which we therefore do not claim on one instrument. Fifty hand labels (kappa=0.75) agree on direction; we print their seven disagreements in full. We also report nine withdrawn claims, three of them former title claims of this paper.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Code, per-trial data, and the pre-registration commit: https://github.com/collapseindex/factwash
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究智能体记忆系统在压缩存储时，认知立场（epistemic stance，如不确定限定词）能否留存。作者构造携带相同主张和相同立场的匹配笔记，仅改变立场位置（标记字段 vs 括号附注），在相同预算和填充笔记下由同一模型压缩，再由不了解条件的盲评者打分。60 条主张、七种语域下，标记字段相比括号附注在两个模型上分别将保留量提高约 15 个点（37 对 2 和 30 对 8；置换检验 p=0.00005），预注册的 Haiku 复现实验得到 +15.6 点（38 对 1）。消融显示标签对两个模型都有帮助、长度对两者都无帮助，而完整句表述在一个模型上是最大贡献项（+12.5）、在另一个模型上几乎无效（+0.6）。
Motivation: 记忆压缩系统倾向于丢弃限定词，因此主张的认知地位在写入记忆后往往无法留存；作者希望弄清决定其能否留存的因素。
Method: 采用匹配笔记实验，立场分别写为标记字段或括号附注，在相同压缩预算和填充笔记下压缩，并由盲评者判定立场是否保留；同时在 Haiku 上进行了预注册复现，运行前承诺预测与判定规则；还使用无模型的确定性读出作为对照。
Result: 标记字段在两个模型上分别带来 37 对 2 和 30 对 8 的保留量（置换 p=0.00005），预注册复现为 +15.6 点（38 对 1）。消融方面，标签在两个模型上均有效（+9.7 和 +12.8），长度在两者上均无效，完整句表述在一个模型上贡献 +12.5、在另一个上仅 +0.6。
Conclusion: 作者只主张两个模型的交集：让立场更显式（explicit）而非仅仅更长，并且显式化的最佳方式取决于具体模型。由于确定性读出未能复现长度和标签的对比，他们不在单一仪器上宣称这两项结论；另外报告了 50 个手工标注（kappa=0.75）的方向一致性及 9 条撤销主张。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Casting the Net! Revisiting MasterFace Impersonation Attacks
papers.abstract_en: Impersonation is a fundamental security threat in face recognition systems (FRSs). While the security of FRSs has been challenged by various attack vectors, under realistic adversarial capabilities, e.g., a limited number of decision-only authentication trials and no internal system knowledge, most attack techniques become infeasible. As a result, impersonation by zero-effort impostors, characterized by false match rate (FMR), is commonly regarded as a standalone baseline. A few years ago, impersonation attacks based on MasterFaces emerged as a notable security threat that could break the barrier of the FMR-based baseline under such realistic constraints. However, they were believed not to yield impersonation above the standard FMR in modern FRSs, as discussed by multiple follow-up studies. In this paper, we demonstrate that even legitimate access to public commercial APIs allows an adversary to amplify impersonation rates through MasterFaces, resulting in a non-trivial impersonation attack beyond FMR on downstream applications built on top of these APIs. We observe that several real-world FRS deployments are implemented using commercial APIs, and that the backend service provider is publicly disclosed or trivially inferable. As a result, the adversary can purchase these pay-as-you-go API services without requiring any additional privilege over the target FRS. From this observation, we formalize the MasterFaces attack as a maximum coverage problem over the biometric representation space, which we call a NET, and show that the adversary can construct an API-tailored NET by leveraging the geometric structure of the representation space. We demonstrate that our attack amplifies the impersonation rates of several open-source and commercial API-based FRSs by up to 9.5$\times$ within at most 30 authentication trials, compared to those expected from the standard FMR.
papers.comment: To appear at ACM CCS 2026; Seunghun Paik and Sunpill Kim contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视 MasterFace 冒充攻击，指出在现实约束（有限的仅决策认证尝试、无系统内部知识）下，即使仅通过公开商业 API 的合法访问，攻击者也能利用 MasterFace 将下游人脸识别系统 (FRS) 的冒用率放大到超过标准误匹配率 (FMR) 基线。作者将攻击形式化为生物特征表示空间上的最大覆盖问题，并利用表示空间的几何结构构建 API 定制的 NET。实验显示，在至多 30 次认证尝试内，多个开源和商业 API 型 FRS 的冒用率比标准 FMR 预期值最高放大 9.5 倍。
Motivation: 在现实对抗能力下，多数人脸识别攻击技术不可行，零努力冒用者对应的 FMR 基线被视为独立基准；此前研究认为 MasterFace 攻击在现代 FRS 中无法超过标准 FMR。本文发现真实 FRS 部署常基于商业 API 且后端可公开推断，攻击者可付费使用这些 API 而无需额外特权，从而恢复 MasterFace 攻击的威胁性。
Method: 将 MasterFace 攻击形式化为生物特征表示空间上的最大覆盖问题，称为 NET；利用表示空间的几何结构，构造针对特定商业 API 的 NET，以最大化给定认证尝试次数下的冒用率。
Result: 在至多 30 次认证尝试内，攻击将多个开源和商业 API 型 FRS 的冒用率放大到标准 FMR 预期值的最高 9.5 倍。
Conclusion: 论文表明，即使对手只具备公共商业 API 的合法访问权限，也能在现实约束下实施超过 FMR 基线的非平凡 MasterFace 冒充攻击，提示依赖商业 API 的下游人脸识别应用存在被放大的冒充风险。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Rate Separation for Agnostic Direct Sums
papers.abstract_en: Hanneke, Moran, and Waknine \cite{HannekeMoranWaknine2024} asked how the agnostic PAC learning curve of the direct sum $C^r$ depends on the single-instance learning curve $\epsagn(n\mid C)$ and on $r$. We show that the single-instance learning rate does not determine the direct-sum rate. Let $\F$ be the class of the two constant binary functions and let $\G$ consist of the zero function and the identity function. Both classes have agnostic learning curve of order $n^{-1/2}$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 agnostic PAC 学习下直接和 (direct sum) C^r 的学习曲线如何依赖于单实例学习曲线 epsagn(n|C) 和 r。作者构造两个二值函数类 F（两个常数函数）和 G（零函数与恒等函数），二者单实例 agnostic 学习曲线均为 n^{-1/2} 阶，以此证明单实例学习速率不能决定直接和的学习速率。这是一个关于样本复杂度速率分离的理论结果。
Motivation: Hanneke、Moran 和 Waknine 曾提出直接和 C^r 的 agnostic PAC 学习曲线如何依赖单实例学习曲线与 r 的问题；本文针对其中“单实例学习速率是否决定直接和速率”这一缺口给出否定回答。
Method: 通过构造两个具体函数类 F 和 G 进行对比：F 由两个常数二值函数组成，G 由零函数和恒等函数组成；两个类都被设计为具有同阶的单实例 agnostic 学习曲线，用于考察直接和速率的差异。
Result: 摘要报告 F 和 G 的单实例 agnostic 学习曲线均为 n^{-1/2} 阶，但直接和的学习速率并不相同，从而说明单实例学习速率无法决定直接和速率。
Conclusion: 直接和问题的样本复杂度并不能仅由单实例学习曲线确定，还依赖于函数类的额外结构信息；本文属于理论分离结果，具体直接和速率的量化细节未在摘要中给出。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Does Splitting a Triage Decision Across Agents Hide Bias or Help Catch It? A Multi-Agent Simulation Study of LLM-Based Resource Allocation Under Audit Capacity Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Prior benchmarking work has shown that a single large language model (LLM), forced to make life-or-death resource-allocation decisions, exhibits measurable demographic bias. Real deployments, however, rarely use a single agent: they use pipelines, with review steps meant to catch exactly this kind of failure. We study what happens to bias when the same decision is distributed across a role-differentiated multi-agent pipeline (assessment, allocation, independent audit) instead of made and checked by one model alone. Using a synthetic disaster-triage simulator with paired cases that are clinically identical except for one demographic attribute, we run 192 episodes (2,304 resolved case pairs) on GPT-4o-mini comparing a single-agent control condition to a nine-agent pipeline under three independently varied pressure dimensions. We find no measurable difference in how often biased outcomes occur between the two conditions (6.9% vs. 6.1%, p = 0.498). We do find a large and significant effect of audit capacity on whether bias is caught: 30.0% of biased outcomes go entirely undetected, rising to 43.8% when the auditor is overloaded and falling to 18.4% when it is not. Decomposing this effect shows it is driven almost entirely by coverage (whether a case is reviewed at all, which collapses from 100.0% to 65.6% under load, p < 0.001) rather than by degraded judgment on the cases that are reviewed (81.6% vs. 85.7%, p = 1.000, direction reversed). A follow-up experiment shows that reordering the audit queue by estimated risk, rather than first-come-first-served, recovers most of the lost coverage under the same capacity constraint (65.6% to 91.7%, p = 0.028). We discuss the implications for any system that adds independent oversight to an LLM agent pipeline under resource constraints, and report the study's limitations honestly: one model, modest sample sizes, and no adversarial replication.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Code and data available at https://github.com/Polpii/policy-town
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文用合成灾难分诊模拟器研究偏见在多智能体流水线中的表现：将同一决策分散给角色不同的多个 LLM（评估、分配、独立审计），而非由单一模型完成并自查。作者在 GPT-4o-mini 上运行 192 个 episode（2,304 对已解决病例），比较单智能体对照与九智能体流水线，发现偏见发生频率无显著差异（6.9% vs 6.1%，p=0.498），但审计容量对偏见能否被发现影响很大：30.0% 的偏见结果完全未被检测到，审计过载时升至 43.8%，不 overload 时降至 18.4%，且该效应几乎完全由审计覆盖率驱动（100.0% 降至 65.6%，p<0.001）而非被审病例上的判断质量下降（81.6% vs 85.7%，p=1.000）。后续实验显示，按估计风险重排审计队列而非先到先服务，可在相同容量约束下恢复大部分覆盖率（65.6% 到 91.7%，p=0.028）。
Motivation: 已有基准工作表明单个 LLM 在生死攸关的资源分配决策中存在可测的人口统计偏见，但真实部署通常使用带审查环节的多智能体流水线；作者想弄清这种分布式决策是掩盖偏见还是有助于发现偏见，尤其是在审计容量受限时。
Method: 构建合成灾难分诊模拟器，使用除人口统计属性外临床相同的配对病例；将单智能体对照条件与包含评估、分配、独立审计三种角色的九智能体流水线进行比较，在三个独立变化的压力维度下运行 192 个 episode，并额外做了一项改变审计队列排序（按风险估计而非先到先服务）的后续实验。
Result: 两种条件下偏见结果发生率无显著差异（6.9% vs 6.1%，p=0.498）；审计容量对偏见检测有显著大效应，未检测率从 30.0% 升至过载时的 43.8%、降至非过载时的 18.4%，该效应由覆盖率崩溃驱动（100.0% 到 65.6%，p<0.001）而非被审病例的判断质量变化；基于风险的队列重排将覆盖率从 65.6% 恢复至 91.7%（p=0.028）。
Conclusion: 作者讨论了在资源约束下向 LLM 智能体流水线添加独立监督的系统性含义，并诚实地报告了局限性：仅一个模型、样本量适中、未做对抗性复制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LMM Modality Transfer: A Pre-requisite for Autonomous GIS Agents
papers.abstract_en: AI models are becoming increasingly adept at understanding and processing spatial information, thereby facilitating agentic problem-solving in spatial tasks and workflows. However, most of the research on their spatial capabilities (e.g., spatial reasoning) has focused on the textual modality as input and output. This contrasts with the human approach to GIS workflows, where text and visual modalities are often used together, interchangeably, and in a complementary manner. Thus, to truly achieve an automated GIS analysis pipeline or carry out human-designed GIS workflows, AI models --- Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) in particular --- need to be able to seamlessly transition between image- and text-based modalities that are traditionally used in such workflows. We present a modality transfer task that (1) asks an LMM to first describe an input image of colored squares in a regular grid, and (2) asks a new LMM instance to re-generate an image of the original spatial scene using the textual description output by the former model. This task quantifies the ability of LMMs to transfer spatial information between image and text modalities. Ultimately, by examining the modality transfer capability of LMMs through the lens of spatial information theory, this work highlights a critical bottleneck: achieving strong and robust geospatial understanding in LMMs requires rigorous, multi-modal alignment. Our results indicate that recent LMMs (here from OpenAI) still struggle with modality transfer, when tasked with re-generating an image of a simple spatial grid of color squares.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出当前对 AI 空间能力的研究大多局限于纯文本输入输出，而真实 GIS 工作流通常同时、互换且互补地使用文本与视觉模态。作者提出一种模态迁移 (modality transfer) 任务：先让 LMM 描述一张规则网格中彩色方块的输入图像，再由新的 LMM 实例根据该文本描述重新生成原始空间场景的图像，以此量化 LMM 在图像与文本之间传递空间信息的能力。结果显示，即便是 OpenAI 的最新 LMM 在重新生成简单的彩色方块空间网格时仍然表现不佳。
Motivation: 现有空间能力研究（如空间推理）主要聚焦文本模态，这与人类使用 GIS 工作流时文本与视觉模态并用互补的方式相悖。若要实现自动化 GIS 分析流程或执行人类设计的 GIS 工作流，LMM 需要能够在图像与文本模态之间无缝转换，该能力尚未得到充分研究。
Method: 提出模态迁移任务：第一步让一个 LMM 描述输入图像（规则网格中的彩色方块），第二步让一个新的 LMM 实例依据前者的文本描述重新生成原始空间场景的图像。该任务借由空间信息论的视角，量化 LMM 跨模态传递空间信息的能力。
Result: 摘要报告，近期 LMM（文中为 OpenAI 的模型）在重新生成简单的彩色方块空间网格图像时仍难以完成模态迁移，表明其空间理解与多模态对齐尚不稳健。

papers.title: Stream Learning: Partition-Fair Gossip Learning Without Tokens
papers.abstract_en: In gossip learning, a network of nodes trains a shared model collaboratively, without a central coordinator, by repeatedly exchanging parts of their local models. The state-of-the-art protocol, Partitioned Token Gossip Learning (PTGL) of Heged{ü}s et al., splits the weight matrix into S fixed partitions and disseminates them using a token-based fairness mechanism coupled with per-neighbor metadata exchange. We revisit partition scheduling by analogy with peer-to-peer live streaming, where model partitions act as video chunks and partition age acts as chunk scarcity. The analogy yields a design space of two-stage selection strategies (partition first, or neighbor first), from which we instantiate ten concrete protocols collectively called Stream Learning. Our main finding is that the simplest of these protocols, which transmits the locally least-trained partition to a uniformly random neighbor (Ri), matches PTGL on fault-free workloads while requiring neither token counters nor metadata exchange. Under an adversarial 30% permanent crash of the best-performing nodes, Ri matches or outperforms PTGL across all complete-graph configurations tested, with the gap reaching 5.53% on HAR and 5.41% on MNIST in the most heterogeneous regime (Dirichlet $β$ = 0.1). In our experiments, partition fairness, captured by a single local rule on partition age, accounts for the gap; token-based rate control and utility maximization do not improve over this rule and, under heterogeneity, sit below it.
papers.journal_ref: SSS 2026, 28th International Symposium on Stabilization, Safety, and Security of Distributed Systems, Oct 2026, Gothenburg, Sweden
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Stream Learning，一组借鉴 P2P 直播流媒体思想的分区调度协议，用于去中心化的 gossip 学习。最简单的协议 Ri（向随机邻居传输本地训练最少的分区）在无故障负载下与 PTGL 表现持平，且在 30% 最优秀节点永久崩溃的对抗场景中全面匹配或超越 PTGL。作者将收益归因于基于分区年龄（partition age）的单一局部公平性规则，而非 token 机制或效用最大化。
Motivation: 现有最优协议 PTGL 依赖 token 计数器与邻居元数据交换来实现分区公平性，带来额外通信和状态开销。作者希望通过流媒体类比重新审视分区调度，简化协议并提升对节点故障和异构数据的鲁棒性。
Method: 将模型分区视为视频块、分区年龄视为块稀缺性，据此构造两阶段选择策略的设计空间（先选分区或先选邻居），并实例化十种具体协议，统称 Stream Learning。重点分析最简单协议 Ri，即向均匀随机邻居发送本地训练程度最低的分区。
Result: 在无故障工作负载下，Ri 匹配 PTGL 性能；在 30% 最优节点永久崩溃的对抗设置中，Ri 在所有测试的完全图配置上匹配或超越 PTGL，在最异构的 Dirichlet β=0.1 情形下，HAR 差距达 5.53%，MNIST 差距达 5.41%。实验表明分区年龄这一局部规则足以解释公平性差距，token 速率控制与效用最大化未能进一步提升性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调分区公平性可通过单一局部分区年龄规则实现，无需 token 或元数据交换；在异构和故障场景下，简单规则优于复杂机制。

papers.title: Dual-Space Modality Consistency Learning for Universal Cross-Modal Re-Identification
papers.abstract_en: Cross-modal Re-Identification (ReID) aims to retrieve the same identity across heterogeneous imaging modalities and has been widely studied in visible-infrared person ReID and cross-modal ship ReID. Existing methods have achieved promising performance by learning modality consistency in the spatial embedding space, yet often overlook frequency-domain modality discrepancy, particularly in high-frequency representations that are both highly discriminative and modality-sensitive. In addition, most approaches are tailored to specific modality settings, limiting their applicability across diverse cross-modal scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose a Dual-Space Modality Consistency Learning (DSMCL) framework for universal cross-modal ReID. Specifically, DSMCL jointly models spatial feature distribution consistency and frequency-domain discriminative consistency. A Spatial Modality Consistency Learning (SMCL) branch performs Gaussian-based feature alignment, while a Frequency-aware Discriminative Consistency Learning (FDCL) strategy regularizes high-frequency representations through identity-aware cross-modal contrastive learning. By jointly capturing modality-specific characteristics and modality-shared identity cues, DSMCL learns robust representations and establishes a unified framework capable of accommodating diverse heterogeneous modality settings. Moreover, DSMCL is a plug-and-play framework that can be readily integrated into existing cross-modal ReID architectures. Extensive experiments on SYSU-MM01, RegDB, LLCM, HOSS-ReID, and CMShipReID across seventeen evaluation protocols show that DSMCL consistently improves multiple representative baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Dual-Space Modality Consistency Learning (DSMCL) 框架，用于通用跨模态 ReID（如可见光-红外行人、跨模态舰船）。DSMCL 在空间嵌入空间之外同时建模频域判别一致性，通过高斯对齐和身份感知跨模态对比学习处理高频表示的模态差异，并作为即插即用模块集成到现有 ReID 架构。在五个数据集、十七个评估协议上的实验显示它能一致提升多个代表性基线。
Motivation: 现有跨模态 ReID 方法主要学习空间嵌入空间中的模态一致性，忽略了频域模态差异，尤其是既高度判别又对模态敏感的高频表示；同时多数方法针对特定模态设置定制，难以推广到多样化的跨模态场景。
Method: 提出 DSMCL 框架，包含 Spatial Modality Consistency Learning (SMCL) 分支，通过基于高斯的特征对齐建模空间分布一致性；以及 Frequency-aware Discriminative Consistency Learning (FDCL) 策略，通过身份感知跨模态对比学习 (identity-aware cross-modal contrastive learning) 正则化高频表示。两者共同捕获模态特有与模态共享的身份线索，并设计为即插即用模块。
Result: 在 SYSU-MM01、RegDB、LLCM、HOSS-ReID 和 CMShipReID 五个数据集、共十七个评估协议上，DSMCL 一致提升了多个代表性跨模态 ReID 基线的性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为联合建模空间与频域一致性可以获得稳健的跨模态表示，并建立一个能适配多种异构模态设置的统一框架；DSMCL 的即插即用特性使其易于集成到现有 ReID 架构中。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ELMZip: Onboard Satellite Image Compression via Extreme Learning Machines for Efficient Downlink
papers.abstract_en: The acquisition of multispectral imagery via small satellites (e.g., CubeSats) presents significant data downlink challenges due to high data volumes and restricted communication windows. While onboard image compression is critical to address this bottleneck, traditional methods often struggle to adapt to the nonlinear statistics of multi-band, multi-resolution data. To overcome these limitations, we propose ELMZip, a novel framework based on Extreme Learning Machines (ELM) and domain decomposition strategies for efficient, resolution-free onboard neural representation. ELMZip formulates the fitting process as a convex least-squares problem using random-feature single-layer networks, thereby eliminating the need for computationally expensive backpropagation. By adopting an asymmetric transmission protocol that sends only the compact output weights, the proposed method significantly reduces the downlink payload. Unlike previous neural representation approaches that rely on iterative optimization and require transmitting full network parameters, ELMZip achieves significant compression efficiency while maintaining high reconstruction fidelity. This capability enables immediate image reconstruction for analysis, allowing resource-constrained platforms to maximize data return and advancing real-time AI-powered Earth observation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ELMZip，一种基于极限学习机（ELM）和域分解（domain decomposition）策略的星载多光谱图像压缩框架，用于小卫星下行链路。该方法将拟合过程构造为凸最小二乘问题，使用随机特征单层网络，避免反向传播，并采用仅传输紧凑输出权重的非对称传输协议以降低下行载荷。摘要声称在保持高重建保真度的同时实现显著压缩效率，并支持直接重建以用于分析。
Motivation: 小卫星（如CubeSat）获取多光谱图像时，高数据量和受限通信窗口导致下行传输成为瓶颈；传统压缩方法难以适应多波段、多分辨率数据的非线性统计特性。
Method: 基于ELM和域分解，将神经表示拟合转化为凸最小二乘问题，使用随机特征单层网络替代需要反向传播的迭代优化；采用非对称传输协议，仅发送输出权重而非完整网络参数，实现分辨率无关（resolution-free）的星载压缩表示。
Result: 与依赖迭代优化并需传输完整网络参数的先前神经表示方法相比，ELMZip在显著减少下行载荷的同时保持高重建保真度。
Conclusion: 该框架使资源受限平台能够最大化数据回报，推进实时AI驱动的地球观测。

papers.title: Blind to the Pivotal Vote: Aggregate Independence Metrics Miss Where Verification Actually Helps
papers.abstract_en: LLM judge panels are a standard evaluation tool, but prior work reports highly correlated panel errors: nine judges provide roughly the effective information of two independent ones, and aggregation closes only a small fraction of the gap. A natural remedy--a signal from a different evidence source, e.g., executing a test suite--produced no distinguishable change in the panel's effective-vote count at scale (-0.04, 95\% CI [-0.10, +0.02]). Aggregate dependence and conditional decision utility are different questions. Elementary majority arithmetic fixes the affected set for single-ballot substitution: only decisions with a one-vote margin can change. The empirical question is whether panel error rates rise and useful substitutions concentrate there. They do: the entire accuracy gain concentrates on these pivotal queries, where it is large (+10.4 to +23.3 percentage points across three headline configurations), and is exactly zero elsewhere. We confirm the pattern across three code benchmarks and four panel sizes (a 9-judge extension and 56 dependent subsampling checks, gain +6.5 to +16.1 percentage points). On HumanEval+/MBPP+, a majority-side replacement rule raises overall accuracy from 82.44\% to 85.62\% while invoking the signal on 16.2\% of queries; signal-only remains stronger at 87.60\%. Thus population-level dependence diagnostics and margin-stratified utility are complementary, and the affected-set characterization yields a call-reduction rule for any specified single-ballot substitution policy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究LLM法官面板的聚合错误，指出总体依赖性与条件决策效用是不同的问题。作者用基本多数算术证明，单票替换只有在一票之差的决策上才可能改变结果；实证显示准确率增益完全集中在这些关键查询上，在其他地方为零。在HumanEval+/MBPP+上，多数侧替换规则将整体准确率从82.44%提升到85.62%，且只在16.2%的查询上调用信号。
Motivation: 先前工作报告LLM法官面板错误高度相关，九位法官的有效信息约等于两位独立法官，聚合只缩小很小一部分差距；引入不同证据源（如执行测试套件）在总体有效票数上没有可辨别变化。作者认为聚合依赖性和条件决策效用被混淆，需要刻画真正受单票替换影响的决策集合。
Method: 通过基本多数算术推导受影响集：只有一票之差的决策可能因单票替换而改变；然后在三个代码基准和四个面板规模上实证检验，包括9法官扩展、56个依赖子抽样检查，以及多数侧替换规则。
Result: 摘要在三种主要配置下报告准确率增益完全集中在关键（一票之差）查询上，幅度+10.4至+23.3个百分点，其他地方精确为零；在HumanEval+/MBPP+上，多数侧替换规则将整体准确率从82.44%提升到85.62%，仅调用16.2%的查询，而仅使用信号时更强，为87.60%。
Conclusion: 总体层面的依赖诊断与边际分层的决策效用互补，受影响集的刻画可为任意指定的单票替换策略提供调用减少规则；聚合指标本身会掩盖验证真正起作用的查询。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 摘要在三种主要配置下报告准确率增益完全集中在关键（一票之差）查询上，幅度+10.4至+23.3个百分点，其他地方精确为零；在HumanEval+/MBPP+上，多数侧替换规则将整体准确率从82.44%提升到85.62%，仅调用16.2%的查询，而仅使用信号时更强，为87.60%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 总体层面的依赖诊断与边际分层的决策效用互补，受影响集的刻画可为任意指定的单票替换策略提供调用减少规则；聚合指标本身会掩盖验证真正起作用的查询。

papers.title: Degradation-Aware Prompt Learning with Cross-Modal Compensation for Adverse Weather Removal
papers.abstract_en: Adverse weather causes diverse and complex image degradations, severely compromising the reliability of computer vision systems. Existing all-in-one restoration models attempt to address multiple degradation types within a unified framework, but often lack explicit spatial and semantic modeling of degradation characteristics, limiting their adaptability to diverse weather conditions. To address this limitation, we propose a Degradation-Aware Cross-Modal Prompt Compensation Network (DCMPC-Net) that leverages cross-modal degradation cues from a pretrained vision-language model to condition restoration features within a unified backbone. Specifically, our DCMPC-Net mainly consists of the Cross-Modal Prompt Generator (CMPG), Prompt-Guided Attention Alignment Module (PGAAM), and Dual Feature Compensation Module (DFCM). The CMPG integrates textual embeddings with visual features to produce degradation-aware prompts that encode degradation-related semantic and contextual cues. These prompts are injected into the decoder via a PGAAM, which adaptively aligns semantic information with degraded regions to facilitate context-aware restoration. To further enhance structural fidelity, DFCM is introduced that disentangles degradation artifacts from scene structures, thereby improving the reconstruction of fine textures and detailed content. By integrating cross-modal semantic guidance with spatial alignment and structural enhancement, DCMPC-Net achieves robust and perceptually consistent restoration across diverse weather conditions. Extensive experiments show that DCMPC-Net outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both task-specific and unified settings, achieving superior accuracy and visual fidelity.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Image Processing. The code is available at: https://github.com/fanamber831/DCMPC-Net
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出面向恶劣天气图像复原的退化感知跨模态提示补偿网络 (DCMPC-Net)，利用预训练视觉-语言模型提供的跨模态退化线索来调制统一骨干网络中的复原特征。网络由跨模态提示生成器 (CMPG)、提示引导注意力对齐模块 (PGAAM) 和双特征补偿模块 (DFCM) 组成，分别在语义、空间对齐与结构保真层面处理多种天气退化。实验表明该方法在任务特定和统一设置下均优于现有方法，取得更高的精度与视觉保真度。
Motivation: 现有全合一 (all-in-one) 复原模型试图在统一框架内处理多种退化类型，但往往缺乏对退化特征的显式空间与语义建模，导致对不同天气条件的适应性有限。
Method: 提出 DCMPC-Net：CMPG 融合文本嵌入与视觉特征生成编码退化语义和上下文线索的退化感知提示；PGAAM 将这些提示注入解码器，使语义信息与退化区域自适应对齐；DFCM 将退化伪影与场景结构解耦，以改善细粒度纹理和细节的重建。
Result: 摘要报告 DCMPC-Net 在任务特定与统一设置的广泛实验中均优于最先进方法，在准确性和视觉保真度上表现更佳；未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为将跨模态语义引导、空间对齐与结构增强相结合，可以在多种恶劣天气条件下实现稳健且感知一致的复原；代码已公开。

papers.title: Debias in Text, Believe Your Eyes: Text-Anchored Cross-Modal Transfer for Visual Counter-Commonsense Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: The visual reasoning ability of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is crucial for downstream applications, particularly counter-commonsense reasoning, which requires models to reason beyond common assumptions. Recent studies mainly improve visual counter-commonsense reasoning by enhancing visual inputs, following the assumption that failures originate from insufficient visual grounding. However, our empirical analysis reveals that the bottleneck is not visual perception. MLLMs already capture the relevant visual evidence, and the correct answer exists in their decoding space. Instead, the shared language decoder resolves prior--evidence conflicts by favoring dominant language priors, especially for low-frequency factual scenarios. Motivated by this, we first propose a text-anchored data construction pipeline, whose core component, Fact-Frequency Distillation (FFD), estimates the prior strength of commonsense facts and distills verified counter-commonsense scenarios into a high-quality text corpus. Building upon this corpus, we introduce TACT, a text-anchored post-training framework that debiases the shared language decoder without requiring any visual training data. TACT routes evidence-following and prior-driven reasoning trajectories into different optimization stages, enabling the decoder to resolve prior--evidence conflicts. Across counter-commonsense visual benchmarks, TACT substantially improves visual reasoning while preserving general capabilities, demonstrating effective text-to-vision cross-modal transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 在视觉反常识推理 (counter-commonsense reasoning) 中的失败原因，提出瓶颈并非视觉感知而是共享语言解码器偏向语言先验。作者构建基于文本锚定的数据流水线，核心组件为事实频率蒸馏 (Fact-Frequency Distillation, FFD)，并引入文本锚定后训练框架 TACT，在不使用视觉训练数据的情况下对解码器去偏，实现文本到视觉的跨模态迁移。多个反常识视觉基准上 TACT 显著提升视觉推理能力并保持通用能力。
Motivation: 现有研究假设视觉反常识推理的失败源于视觉输入不足，但实证分析表明 MLLM 已捕获相关视觉证据且正确解码存在，真正瓶颈是共享语言解码器在低频事实场景中偏向主导语言先验，导致先验-证据冲突。
Method: 提出文本锚定数据构造流水线，核心是事实频率蒸馏 (FFD) 估计常识事实的先验强度并蒸馏验证过的反常识场景为文本语料；在此基础上提出 TACT，一种文本锚定后训练框架，将证据跟随与先验驱动推理轨迹分配到不同优化阶段，使解码器能解决先验-证据冲突。
Result: 在反常识视觉基准上，TACT 大幅提升视觉推理性能，同时保持通用能力，证明文本到视觉的跨模态迁移有效。
Conclusion: 作者强调视觉反常识推理的主要瓶颈是语言解码器的先验偏差而非视觉感知，文本驱动的去偏后训练可有效迁移到视觉任务。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Walkable to Whom? Capturing Subjective Variability in Walkability Perception Using Multimodal Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Visual perception of walkability varies substantially across individuals, reflecting differences in personal characteristics, experiences, and preferences. Existing studies, however, often reduce these diverse judgements to aggregated scores, implicitly assuming uniform perception, and commonly rely on vehicle-mounted street-view imagery that does not reflect the pedestrian's visual experience. This paper introduces a dataset of 29,870 walkability ratings from 1,196 respondents, linking sidewalk-view imagery across urban, suburban, and regional Australian environments with individual rater attributes, and proposes the first user-conditioned multimodal deep learning framework for walkability perception, fusing visual features with respondent-level representations. A viewpoint-comparison study shows that sidewalk-view images receive significantly higher walkability ratings than matched street-view images, indicating that imagery source is a substantive design decision in perception surveys. The user-conditioned model improves rank agreement with observed ratings by 65% over an image-only baseline (quadratic weighted kappa 0.47 vs. 0.29), demonstrating that who is evaluating an environment carries predictive indication beyond image content alone. These findings support moving from aggregated, observer-independent walkability scores toward models that represent diverse users, enabling more inclusive assessment of pedestrian environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对步行性视觉感知中的主观差异问题，构建了一个包含 29,870 条步行性评分、1,196 名受访者数据的澳大利亚数据集，并首次提出用户条件化的多模态深度学习框架，将街道视角图像与个体受访者属性表征融合。视角对比实验表明，人行道视角图像比匹配的街景图像获得显著更高的步行性评分；用户条件化模型相比仅图像基线将排序一致率提升 65%（二次加权 kappa 从 0.29 升至 0.47），说明评估者身份对感知预测具有增量价值。
Motivation: 现有步行性感知研究常将不同个体的评价聚合成单一分数，隐含假设感知具有一致性，且多使用车载街景图像，不能反映行人的真实视觉体验。
Method: 提出首个用户条件化的多模态深度学习框架，融合视觉特征与受访者层面的表示；同时构建包含人行道视角图像和个体属性的步行性评分数据集，并进行视角对比研究。
Result: 人行道视角图像获得的步行性评分显著高于匹配的街景图像；用户条件化模型将排序一致率较仅图像基线提升 65%，二次加权 kappa 为 0.47 对比 0.29。
Conclusion: 研究支持从聚合的、观察者无关的步行性评分转向能够表征多样化用户的模型，以更包容地评估步行环境；同时强调图像来源是感知调查中的一个实质性设计选择。

papers.title: Ask-E: An Environment for Calibrated Question Generation
papers.abstract_en: Today, we improve models by training and evaluating them on problems at the frontier of their abilities. Creating such problems is itself a demanding task, requiring the ability to probe model limits and generalize beyond existing question distributions. It also means placing problems at a precise difficulty level, which requires understanding what it takes to solve them. In short, generating problems calibrated to a model's current frontier demands capability beyond it, an increasingly burdensome constraint as models improve. Our key insight is that we can leverage this constraint to our advantage: a model that can generate problems consistently calibrated to a given frontier must possess capability beyond it. Accordingly, we present Ask-E, an environment that benchmarks and trains models on their ability to write questions at a given skill level, rather than answer them. Concretely, we define target skill levels as ranges bounded by the capabilities of two existing language models. A generated question is successfully calibrated if exactly one of the two models can solve it, placing it precisely within the target range and differentiating the capabilities of these models. Ask-E serves both as a benchmark and a training environment, where models generate problems calibrated to a variety of skill levels. We find that even frontier models achieve below 50% calibration on the benchmark, leaving significant headroom to measure future progress. We also show that training on this environment leads to improvements across a number of downstream math benchmarks even with no new math data, no interaction with stronger models, and no correctness-based reward.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Ask-E，一个用于训练和评测模型生成“校准问题”的环境与基准。其核心设定是：给定由两个现有语言模型能力边界定义的目标技能区间，一个生成的问题只有恰好被两个模型中一个解出、另一个解不出时才算校准成功。作者发现即使前沿模型在该基准上的校准成功率也低于 50%，并表明在该环境上训练可以提升多个下游数学基准的性能，且无需新增数学数据、无需与更强模型交互、也无需基于正确性的奖励。
Motivation: 为模型前沿能力构造问题是困难且成本递增的任务，因为问题必须被精确放置在某个难度水平，这需要超出目标模型本身的能力。作者将这一约束反过来利用：能稳定生成与给定前沿校准的问题，本身就意味着生成模型具备超越该前沿的能力。
Method: Ask-E 既是一个基准也是一个训练环境：目标技能水平被定义为两个现有语言模型能力区间，生成问题只有在恰好被其中一个模型解出时才算校准成功；模型在该环境下被训练生成针对多种技能水平的校准问题。
Result: 摘要报告即使前沿模型在该基准上的校准成功率也低于 50%，说明仍有较大提升空间；在此环境上训练能够改善一系列下游数学基准的表现，且不需要新数学数据、无更强模型交互、无正确性奖励。
Conclusion: 作者认为生成校准问题的能力可以作为一种训练信号和评测维度，且这种基于能力区间的校准定义能持续衡量模型进步。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Science Edge Evaluation: SEE the Missing Step Toward Real Scientific Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly involved in scientific discovery, yet it remains unclear whether they can support complex real laboratory science. Here we introduce Science Edge Evaluation (SEE), a multimodal benchmark of expert-curated questions grounded in peer-reviewed literature and experimental practice in chemistry, biology, and materials science. Evaluation of 19 multimodal large language models (MLLMs) shows that even the best-performing model reaches only 48.7% accuracy. Moreover, general-purpose models outperform science-specialized models on average. In the visual-agent evaluation, the use of tools increases the best accuracy to 52.7%. Tool use can expand the information available to models, but more information does not necessarily lead to reliable scientific reasoning. The key challenge is whether models can manage tool-derived information within the boundaries of the original experimental evidence. Together, these findings reveal that current MLLMs still cannot reliably make justified and evidence-bounded inferences from experimental results, which is an essential capability in real scientific discovery. Bridging this gap requires MLLMs to transition from explaining established scientific concepts to deriving novel and evidence-based insights from experimental data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Science Edge Evaluation (SEE)，一个基于同行评审文献和实验实践、由专家撰写问题的多模态基准，覆盖化学、生物学和材料科学。作者评估了 19 个多模态大语言模型 (MLLM)，发现最佳模型准确率仅 48.7%，工具使用可将最佳准确率提升至 52.7%，但模型仍难以在原始实验证据边界内进行可靠的推理。
Motivation: 大语言模型越来越多地参与科学发现，但现有评估难以判断它们是否真正支撑复杂真实实验室科学；缺少直接锚定同行评审文献和实验实践的多模态评估基准。
Method: 构建 SEE 基准，包含化学、生物和材料科学中专家筛选的问题，并对 19 个 MLLM 进行文本-图像多模态评估；同时设计视觉智能体 (visual-agent) 评估，考察工具使用对模型推理的影响。
Result: 最佳模型准确率为 48.7%；通用模型平均优于科学专用模型；工具使用将最佳准确率提升至 52.7%，但更多信息并不必然带来可靠的科学推理。
Conclusion: 当前 MLLM 仍不能可靠地从实验结果中做出有依据且受证据约束的推断，而这正是真实科学发现的关键能力；模型需要从解释既定科学概念转向从实验数据中推导新颖、基于证据的见解。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: AVCap: Reinforcing Audio-Video Joint Caption with Detail-Aware Reward
papers.abstract_en: Detailed audio-video joint captioning is essential for multimodal video understanding and generation. However, prior works are constrained by three main limitations: (1) the scarcity of high-quality public datasets with fine-grained audio-visual joint captions; (2) reinforcement-learning methods that rely on coarse reward signals; and (3) the lack of a benchmark and metric for evaluating detailed audiovisual captions at the atomic level. To address these challenges, we propose: (1) AVCap-100K, a high-quality dataset of 100K temporally aligned, detail-rich audio-video captions; (2) AVCap, a model optimized via Detail-Aware GRPO (Da-GRPO) that achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source models and matches or surpasses proprietary models on several evaluations; and (3) AVCap-Bench and AVCap-Score, a specialized benchmark and metric for evaluating atomic-level details in audiovisual captions. Our code, models, and datasets are available at https://huggingface.co/collections/Apryle/avcap.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对细粒度音视频联合字幕生成（detailed audio-video joint captioning）提出数据集、训练方法和评估基准。作者构建了 AVCap-100K，包含 10 万条时序对齐、细节丰富的音视频字幕；提出用细节感知奖励的 Da-GRPO 优化模型 AVCap；并发布 AVCap-Bench 与 AVCap-Score 用于原子级细节评估。摘要报告 AVCap 在开源模型中达到最优性能，并在若干评估上匹配或超越专有模型。
Motivation: 现有工作受三方面限制：高质量细粒度音视频联合字幕的公开数据集稀缺；强化学习方法依赖粗粒度奖励信号；缺乏在原子级（atomic level）评估音视频字幕细节的基准和指标。
Method: 提出三部分贡献：AVCap-100K 数据集；通过 Detail-Aware GRPO（Da-GRPO）优化的 AVCap 模型；以及用于评估原子级细节的 AVCap-Bench 基准和 AVCap-Score 指标。
Result: 摘要报告 AVCap 在开源模型中达到 state-of-the-art 性能，并在多项评估上匹配或超越专有模型（proprietary models）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调高质量数据、细粒度奖励与原子级评估基准相结合可以提升音视频联合字幕的细节质量；代码、模型和数据集均已公开。

papers.title: MaskFlow: Precise, Consistent and Seamless Regional Image Editing
papers.abstract_en: Regional image editing has attracted considerable attention for its spatial controllability. Although instruction-based and mask-reference-based editing methods can achieve strong semantic alignment, reliable regional control remains challenging, where an edit must be accurately localized and naturally integrated with the preserved context. We propose \textbf{MaskFlow}, a training framework for precise localization, consistent background preservation, and seamless boundary transitions. MaskFlow incorporates the mask into the probability path and flow-matching objective, coordinating generation within the editable region with source preservation outside it. The proposed Soft-Poisson de-seaming module further refines the predicted vector field during both training and sampling to improve the smooth integration of the edited foreground with the preserved background. We also design a data synthesis pipeline to construct MEData, a mask-based image editing dataset for training regional image editing models and facilitating further research. Experiments on natural scenes and infographic images demonstrate consistent improvements over competing methods in both quantitative and qualitative evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MaskFlow，一个面向区域图像编辑 (regional image editing) 的训练框架，目标是在精确局部定位、背景一致保留和边界无缝过渡之间取得平衡。方法将掩码融入概率路径 (probability path) 与 flow-matching 目标，并引入 Soft-Poisson de-seaming 模块在训练和采样阶段细化预测向量场；同时构建了基于掩码的图像编辑数据集 MEData。在自然场景和信息图上的实验表明，该方法在定量与定性评估上均优于对比方法。
Motivation: 区域图像编辑虽然具有空间可控性，但可靠地同时实现编辑区域的精确定位、与保留上下文的自然融合仍然困难；现有方法难以兼顾语义对齐与局部控制的准确性。
Method: 核心是将掩码纳入概率路径和 flow-matching 目标，从而在可编辑区域内协调生成、在区域外保持源图像内容；Soft-Poisson de-seaming 模块在训练和采样中细化预测向量场，改善前景编辑与背景的平滑衔接；另设计数据合成流程构建 MEData 数据集用于训练区域编辑模型。
Result: 在自然场景图像和信息图 (infographic) 图像上的实验显示，MaskFlow 在定量和定性评估中均持续优于竞争方法；摘要未报告具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为将掩码机制引入 flow-matching 训练并配合边界去缝模块可以实现精确、一致且无缝的区域编辑，同时 MEData 数据集可支持后续研究。

papers.title: TRIBE: Predicting Team Performance via Communication Behavior Ensembles
papers.abstract_en: Designing autonomous agents that effectively assist human teams hinges on understanding team dynamics, often without task specific knowledge. We present TRIBE, a domain independent approach that reveals team behavioral dynamics invisible to traditional performance metrics. We show that communication patterns can categorize teams into performance predictive behavioral tribes, as early as 10% into the task, enabling timely interventions. We test TRIBE on four diverse datasets and demonstrate that communication patterns predict team performance while the prediction strength varies by the degree a task structure allows for behavioral freedom. Our temporal analysis reveals that AI agents significantly alter team behavioral trajectories while human advisors align with natural dynamics, and that teams maintain behavioral flexibility throughout collaboration. Further, we compare TRIBE to Llama and optimize the pipeline, achieving significant speedup with performance improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TRIBE，一种领域无关的团队行为动态分析方法，利用沟通模式将团队划分为可预测绩效的行为部落 (behavioral tribes)，最早在任务进行到 10% 时即可预测团队绩效。作者在四个数据集上验证了沟通模式对团队绩效的预测能力，并发现预测强度受任务结构允许的行为自由度影响。时间分析显示 AI 代理会显著改变团队行为轨迹，而人类顾问更顺应自然动态；与 Llama 对比并优化流水线后获得显著加速和性能提升。
Motivation: 设计能有效协助人类团队的自主代理需要理解团队动态，但往往缺乏任务特定知识，而传统绩效指标无法揭示团队行为动态。论文针对这一缺口，提出领域无关的团队动态建模方法，以便早期识别并干预。
Method: 提出 TRIBE，一种领域无关的集成方法，通过沟通行为模式将团队归类为绩效可预测的行为部落，并支持在任务早期阶段进行预测；同时包含与 Llama 的对比以及流水线优化。
Result: 在四个不同数据集上，沟通模式能够预测团队绩效，且预测强度随任务结构允许的行为自由度而变化；时间分析表明 AI 代理显著改变团队行为轨迹，而人类顾问与自然动态一致；优化后的流水线相比 Llama 获得显著加速并伴有性能提升。
Conclusion: 论文强调领域无关的沟通行为分析可在任务早期支持及时干预，且预测强度受任务结构自由度影响；AI 代理对团队行为轨迹的改变是一个值得关注的发现。

papers.title: Deal Me Maybe: The Role of Emotions in Multi-Agent Negotiation
papers.abstract_en: Negotiation is a demanding social task for LLM agents, requiring strategic reasoning, persuasion, and interpersonal adaptation. Yet existing benchmarks often treat agents as emotionally neutral, overlooking a key driver of human bargaining behavior. We study how prompt-conditioned emotions affect LLM-based price negotiation. In a controlled framework, buyer and seller agents are independently assigned one of six emotional states and negotiate over 350 real consumer products under two budget conditions. Across 36 emotion-pair settings and five widely used LLMs, we find that emotions strongly shape outcomes. Angry buyers almost never reach agreement (0.39% deal rate), while happy buyers agree most often (28.91%), but obtain worse prices than fearful buyers. Emotion effects are role-dependent: buyer emotion mainly drives acceptance and rejection, whereas seller emotion shapes concession dynamics. These effects influence not only language, but also termination behavior and price trajectories, raising concerns for emotion-conditioned agents in commerce.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究提示词条件化情绪 (prompt-conditioned emotions) 如何影响基于 LLM 的价格谈判。在受控框架中，买方和卖方智能体被独立赋予六种情绪状态之一，在两种预算条件下就350个真实消费品进行谈判，覆盖36种情绪配对和五个常用LLM。结果显示情绪强烈影响谈判结果：愤怒买方几乎无法达成协议（成交率0.39%），快乐买方成交率最高（28.91%），但价格劣于恐惧买方；且情绪效应具有角色依赖性，不仅影响语言，还影响终止行为和价格轨迹。
Motivation: 现有谈判基准通常把智能体当作情绪中立的，忽视了人类议价行为的关键驱动因素——情绪。作者试图填补这一空白，考察情绪条件化对LLM谈判智能体的系统性影响。
Method: 提出一个受控实验框架：买方和卖方智能体分别被分配六种情绪状态之一，在350个真实消费品和两种预算条件下进行谈判；通过36种情绪配对设置，在五个广泛使用的LLM上比较结果。
Result: 情绪强烈影响谈判结果：愤怒买方几乎无法达成协议（成交率0.39%），快乐买方成交率最高（28.91%）但价格比恐惧买方更差。效应是角色依赖的——买方情绪主要驱动接受和拒绝，卖方情绪塑造让步动态；影响不仅体现在语言上，还体现在终止行为和价格轨迹上。
Conclusion: 作者强调情绪条件化智能体在商业场景中引发担忧，因为情绪效应会渗透到谈判的语言、终止行为和价格结果等多个层面。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Vernata: Self-Supervised Learning of LiDAR Point Representations
papers.abstract_en: LiDAR serves as a primary sensing modality for robots operating in outdoor environments. However, the performance of deep learning models in this domain is severely limited by the scarcity of labeled data, a direct result of the high cost of 3D annotation. Self-supervised learning addresses this scarcity by learning general-purpose features from unlabeled data. In this work, we present a multi-modal, multi-teacher distillation framework for self-supervised learning on outdoor LiDAR point clouds. Building upon the Sonata architecture, we introduce Vernata, consisting of three extensions: sparse view augmentation to improve robustness against varying point densities, a memory bank mechanism to stabilize resource-constrained training, and cross-modal distillation utilizing dense, high-resolution 2D image features to enable fine-grained semantic guidance. We evaluate our method on the GrandTour, TartanGround, and Waymo datasets, as well as data collected from our own robotic platforms. Our experiments demonstrate a significant performance improvement over Sonata baselines, yielding mIoU scores of 54.7 on TartanGround (+5.9 points, +12.1%) and 57.1 on Waymo (+7.3 points, +14.7%). Finally, we show that the self-supervised approach maintains strong performance even in reduced-modality settings (lacking color or normals), achieving competitive mIoU scores of 49.4 and 50.2 on the respective datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Vernata，一个面向户外 LiDAR 点云的自监督学习 (self-supervised learning) 多模态多教师蒸馏框架，在 Sonata 架构基础上加入稀疏视图增强、记忆库机制和跨模态蒸馏。作者在 GrandTour、TartanGround、Waymo 及自有机器人平台数据上评估，相比 Sonata 基线在 TartanGround 上取得 mIoU 54.7（+5.9 点，+12.1%），在 Waymo 上取得 57.1（+7.3 点，+14.7%），并展示了缺少颜色或法线的 reduced-modality 设定下仍保持竞争力。
Motivation: 户外机器人依赖 LiDAR 作为主要感知模态，但 3D 标注成本高昂导致有标签数据稀缺，限制了深度学习模型在该领域的性能；自监督学习旨在从无标注数据中学习通用特征，缓解标签稀缺问题。
Method: 基于 Sonata 架构提出多模态、多教师蒸馏框架，包含三个扩展：稀疏视图增强 (sparse view augmentation) 以提升对不同点密度的鲁棒性，记忆库 (memory bank) 机制以稳定资源受限训练，以及利用密集高分辨率 2D 图像特征的跨模态蒸馏 (cross-modal distillation) 以提供细粒度语义引导。
Result: 在 TartanGround 和 Waymo 上相比 Sonata 基线显著提升，mIoU 分别为 54.7（+5.9 点，+12.1%）和 57.1（+7.3 点，+14.7%）；在缺少颜色或法线的 reduced-modality 设定下，mIoU 分别达到 49.4 和 50.2。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该自监督方法在 reduced-modality 条件下仍能保持有竞争力的性能，评估覆盖 GrandTour、TartanGround、Waymo 以及自有机器人平台数据。

papers.title: ReGraph: Learning to Generate Recipe Graphs from Food Images
papers.abstract_en: Recent Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) have achieved impressive performance in recipe generation from food images.However, cooking is a structured transformation process in which ingredients undergo state changes through ordered actions,while free-form recipe language leaves the corresponding entities, intermediate states, and dependencies largely implicit and entangled.A graph representation makes this procedural knowledge explicit and compositional, providing a structured basis for assessing whether model outputs encode process-level knowledge rather than merely presenting plausible textual descriptions. To address this limitation, we present ReGraph, a large-scale recipe graph dataset that represents ingredients, cooking actions, and tools as entities, uses entity attributes to describe ingredient state changes, and employs typed relations to encode manipulation targets, destinations, and procedural ordering. ReGraph further incorporates explicit Recipe Reasoning Chain-of-Thought (RR-CoT) traces, providing auxiliary supervision for procedural decomposition and structured graph generation. Building on ReGraph, we propose Recipe Graph Learning (RGL), a two-stage framework that enables LMMs to generate a plausible fine-grained cooking workflow from a food image in the form of a structured recipe graph. Under a deterministic, schema-aware matching protocol, our experiments reveal a substantial gap between text-generation quality and recoverable procedural structure: recipes produced by existing approaches achieve competitive text-generation scores yet yield limited reference-aligned entity and relation structure under the ReGraph schema. In contrast, across two representative LMM backbones, RGL consistently improves the generation of cooking entities and procedural relations, while our analysis further shows that fine-grained ingredient-state capture remains the most challenging dimension.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReGraph，一个大规模菜谱图数据集，将食材、烹饪动作和工具表示为实体，用实体属性描述食材状态变化，并用类型化关系编码操作对象、目的地和工序顺序，同时附带显式的 Recipe Reasoning Chain-of-Thought (RR-CoT) 轨迹。在此基础上提出 Recipe Graph Learning (RGL)，一种两阶段框架，使大型多模态模型 (LMM) 能从食物图像生成结构化的细粒度烹饪流程图。实验表明，现有方法在文本生成指标上表现接近，但可恢复的程序化结构有限；RGL 在两个代表性 LMM 骨干上一致提升了烹饪实体与工序关系的生成质量，而细粒度食材状态捕获仍是最困难的部分。
Motivation: 现有的自由形式菜谱语言将实体、中间状态和依赖关系大多隐含且纠缠在一起，难以评估模型是否真正编码了过程级知识；图表示能够显式且组合地表达程序化知识，为评估结构化烹饪流程提供基础。
Method: 构建 ReGraph 菜谱图数据集，引入实体、实体属性、类型化关系及 RR-CoT 推理轨迹作为辅助监督；提出 RGL 两阶段学习框架，让 LMM 从食物图像生成符合模式的菜谱图。
Result: 在确定性的 schema-aware 匹配协议下，已有方法在文本生成分数上具有竞争力，但与 ReGraph 模式的参照对齐实体和关系结构有限；在两个 LMM 骨干上，RGL 持续提升烹饪实体和工序关系的生成，分析显示细粒度食材状态捕获最具挑战性。
Conclusion: 作者强调图表示有助于检验输出是否编码过程级知识，并指出 RGL 改善了结构化菜谱图的生成，同时食材状态这一细粒度维度仍是后续难点。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MiCoPro: End-to-End Mixed Precision HW/SW Co-design with HW-aware Proxy Model
papers.abstract_en: Quantized Neural Networks~(QNN) with low-bitwidth data have proven promising in efficient storage and computation on edge devices. To mitigate accuracy degradation while maximizing speedup, layer-wise mixed-precision quantization~(MPQ) becomes a popular solution. However, existing algorithms for exploring MPQ schemes are limited in flexibility and efficiency. Comprehending the complex impacts of different MPQ schemes on post-training quantization and quantization-aware training results is a challenge for conventional methods. Furthermore, an end-to-end framework for the optimization and deployment of MPQ models is missing in existing work. To address these challenges, we propose the MiCo framework, a holistic MPQ exploration and deployment framework for edge AI applications. The framework adopts a novel optimization algorithm to search for accuracy-optimal quantization configurations under strict latency constraints. We further extended the framework to MiCoPro, which introduces a robust Hardware-Aware Proxy (HAP) model to enhance prediction accuracy and hardware versatility. By leveraging target-specific latency modeling, MiCoPro enables rapid exploration and direct deployment from PyTorch models to bare-metal C code. We demonstrate the versatility of our framework on both the BitFusion accelerator and SIMD-extended RISC-V processors, achieving up to 40\% of latency reduction with less than 3\% of accuracy drop.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MiCo/MiCoPro 框架，用于边缘 AI 应用中层级混合精度量化 (layer-wise mixed-precision quantization, MPQ) 的端到端探索与部署。MiCoPro 引入硬件感知代理模型 (Hardware-Aware Proxy, HAP) 和针对目标硬件的延迟建模，支持从 PyTorch 模型直接部署到裸机 C 代码。作者在 BitFusion 加速器和 SIMD 扩展 RISC-V 处理器上验证，实现最多 40% 的延迟降低，同时精度下降小于 3%。
Motivation: 现有 MPQ 方案探索算法在灵活性和效率上受限，难以理解不同 MPQ 方案对后训练量化和量化感知训练结果的影响，且缺少端到端的优化与部署框架。
Method: 提出 MiCo 框架，采用新的优化算法在严格延迟约束下搜索精度最优的量化配置；扩展为 MiCoPro，引入硬件感知代理模型 (HAP) 提升预测精度与硬件适应性，并结合目标特定的延迟建模实现快速探索和从 PyTorch 到裸机 C 代码的直接部署。
Result: 在 BitFusion 加速器和 SIMD 扩展 RISC-V 处理器上验证，实现最多 40% 的延迟降低，且精度下降小于 3%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 MiCoPro 提供了兼顾硬件多样性与部署效率的端到端 MPQ 解决方案；其验证范围限于所提及的两种硬件平台。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RibAssist 3D: Biplanar Rib-Fracture Detection, Addressing, and Selective 3D Localization from CT-Derived Projections
papers.abstract_en: Rib fractures are common, clinically significant, and time-consuming to localize on computed tomography (CT). We ask whether fractures detected in two orthogonal projections (anteroposterior, AP, and lateral) can be paired across views and triangulated into reliable 3D fracture points at a controlled rate of false 3D outputs. We answer this with a staged diagnostic study. Biplanar geometry is exact: detector-predicted centers reconstruct to median 4.0 mm 3D error when correspondence is correct. On the sealed cohort, dual-view availability reaches 61.1% and the candidate graph contains a correct pair for 58.4% of fractures. The binding limitation is not geometry or localization but confidence-limited cross-view correspondence. Lateral-detector retraining lifts dual-view availability (0.52 to 0.76 in development) and moves the frontier from 0% to 2.44% recall at 10 mm. When the policy commits a correct pair, the emitted point is geometrically accurate (sealed median 1.49 mm, rib-exact 93%). A pre-specified pass on the untouched 55-case cohort promotes 15 of 601 fractures to correct 3D localizations at 0.436 false 3D points per case, yielding 2.50% end-to-end commitment yield. The contribution is validated biplanar reconstruction geometry with high conditional localization fidelity, a staged identification of cross-view correspondence confidence as the effective bottleneck, and a selective assistive workflow that preserves uncertain findings rather than a standalone automatic reconstructor.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 6 figures. Code available at: https://github.com/kabJhai/RibAssist-3D
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RibAssist 3D，利用 CT 导出的双平面投影（前后位 AP 与侧位）进行肋骨骨折检测和选择性 3D 定位。作者通过分阶段诊断研究发现，双平面几何本身是精确的，检测器预测中心在对应正确时重建 3D 误差中位数为 4.0 mm；真正的瓶颈是跨视图对应（cross-view correspondence）的置信度限制。在密封队列中，正确配对时发出的 3D 点几何准确（中位数 1.49 mm，肋骨精确 93%），端到端承诺收益为 2.50%。
Motivation: 肋骨骨折在 CT 上常见且具有临床意义，但定位耗时。作者想验证一个假设：在两个正交投影中检测到的骨折能否跨视图配对并被三角化为可靠的 3D 骨折点，同时将假 3D 输出的比率控制在可接受范围内。
Method: 采用分阶段诊断研究：先验证双平面重建几何的精确性，再量化双视图可用性与候选图覆盖，并对侧位检测器进行重训练以提升双视图可用性。整体设计为选择性辅助工作流（selective assistive workflow），保留不确定的发现而不是构建独立的自动重建器。
Result: 密封队列中双视图可用性为 61.1%，候选图包含 58.4% 骨折的正确配对。侧位检测器重训练将开发集双视图可用性从 0.52 提升至 0.76，并将 10 mm 处的召回率前沿从 0% 推进到 2.44%。在未触碰的 55 例队列上，预设策略将 601 处骨折中的 15 处提升为正确 3D 定位，每例产生 0.436 个假 3D 点，端到端承诺收益为 2.50%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调其贡献是经过验证的双平面重建几何（条件定位保真度高）、将跨视图对应置信度识别为有效瓶颈，以及选择性辅助工作流；性能受限因素是对应置信度而非几何或定位本身。

papers.title: MuST-VAD: Mutual Structured Learning for Video Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose MuST-VAD, a mutual structured learning framework for weakly supervised video anomaly detection (VAD) in which an anomaly detector and a large vision-language model (LVLM) exchange their acquired knowledge. Detectors in weakly supervised VAD learn anomaly scores from features extracted by a fixed, task-agnostic backbone. These fixed features bound the achievable detection accuracy. Recent methods therefore transfer LVLM semantics into the detector as richer features. However, this transfer is one-way: what the detector learns about the target videos never returns to the LVLM. MuST-VAD extends the one-way transfer into a bidirectional learning loop. In this loop, the latest detector predictions supervise the LVLM adaptation, and the adapted LVLM returns updated representations that retrain the detector; the two models alternate these updates over small video groups. Both models train on detector-selected key clips, while confidence weighting and annotation-anchored question answering keep the exchanged supervision reliable. On UCF-Crime, our mutual learning improves the one-pass transfer baseline from 88.15% to 88.63% AUROC and from 37.25% to 42.46% average precision (AP), outperforming the state-of-the-art method in AP by 4.13 points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MuST-VAD，一种用于弱监督视频异常检测 (weakly supervised VAD) 的相互结构化学习框架，让异常检测器与大视觉语言模型 (LVLM) 进行双向知识交换。摘要报告在 UCF-Crime 上将单次迁移基线的 AUROC 从 88.15% 提升到 88.63%，平均精度 (AP) 从 37.25% 提升到 42.46%，并在 AP 上超过现有最佳方法 4.13 个百分点。
Motivation: 弱监督 VAD 中，检测器基于固定的任务无关骨干特征学习异常分数，这些固定特征限制了检测精度的上限；近年方法将 LVLM 语义作为更丰富的特征单向迁移给检测器，但检测器学到的目标视频知识从未回流到 LVLM。
Method: 将单向迁移扩展为双向学习循环：检测器的最新预测用于监督 LVLM 的适应，适应的 LVLM 返回更新后的表示来重新训练检测器，两个模型在小型视频组上交替更新；两者都在检测器选出的关键片段上训练，并用置信度加权和基于标注锚定的问答来保证交换监督的可靠性。
Result: 在 UCF-Crime 上，相互学习将单次迁移基线的 AUROC 从 88.15% 提升到 88.63%，AP 从 37.25% 提升到 42.46%，AP 比现有最佳方法高 4.13 个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将单向 LVLM 语义迁移扩展为检测器与 LVLM 之间的双向学习循环可以提升弱监督视频异常检测性能，且双向交换的监督可靠性是关键设计。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 MuST-VAD，一种用于弱监督视频异常检测 (weakly supervised VAD) 的相互结构化学习框架，让异常检测器与大视觉语言模型 (LVLM) 进行双向知识交换。摘要报告在 UCF-Crime 上将单次迁移基线的 AUROC 从 88.15% 提升到 88.63%，平均精度 (AP) 从 37.25% 提升到 42.46%，并在 AP 上超过现有最佳方法 4.13 个百分点。

papers.title: Fast LapSum: Exact Differentiable Top-k at Million Scale
papers.abstract_en: The top-$k$ operation is a fundamental building block of modern sparse computation, enabling token routing, expert activation, memory selection, and attention pruning. Yet standard hard top-$k$ blocks gradients, while existing continuous (soft) relaxations remain too costly for large-scale models. We introduce Fast LapSum, an exact-budget soft top-$k$ primitive whose GPU solver runs in linear time after sorting. Unlike prior linear-time methods such as DFTopK, which relax the normalization constraint, Fast LapSum is, to our knowledge, the first method to preserve an exact selection mass of $k$ while remaining fully differentiable end-to-end. Our solver combines a linear-time threshold computation with an analytical vector--Jacobian product, and for extreme scales employs probabilistic bracketing to sort only the uncertain middle band of kernel-noised scores. The resulting overhead is almost negligible: the solver processes $10^6$, $10^7$, and $10^8$ scores in $0.41$, $1.15$, and $5.23$\,ms, respectively. This makes exact soft top-$k$ practical for sparse routing, retrieval, and large-scale optimization. We demonstrate Fast LapSum on two demanding applications operating over millions of coordinates inside the training loop: generating megapixel sparse adversarial examples with an exact soft budget of ${\sim}0.02\%$ of an image's pixels, achieving an order-of-magnitude speedup over state-of-the-art methods, and training a fully differentiable sparse image coder from scratch.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Fast LapSum，一种精确预算的软 top-k 原语（exact-budget soft top-k），其 GPU 求解器在排序后以线性时间运行，在保持精确选择质量 k 的同时实现端到端可微。摘要报告其在 10^6、10^7、10^8 规模上分别耗时 0.41、1.15、5.23 ms，并在百万坐标稀疏对抗样本与可微稀疏图像编码器两个应用中验证。
Motivation: 标准硬 top-k 会阻断梯度，而现有连续（软）松弛方法在大规模模型上成本过高；先前线性时间方法如 DFTopK 放松了归一化约束。需要一个既保持精确选择质量又完全可微的高效 top-k 算子。
Method: Fast LapSum 结合线性时间阈值计算与分析向量-雅可比积（vector--Jacobian product）；在极端规模下采用概率括约（probabilistic bracketing），仅对带核噪声分数的中间不确定带进行排序。
Result: GPU 求解器在排序后线性时间内处理 10^6、10^7、10^8 个分数，分别耗时 0.41、1.15、5.23 ms；在生成约 0.02% 像素预算的百万像素稀疏对抗样本时，比现有最先进方法快一个数量级，并能从头训练完全可微的稀疏图像编码器。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作使精确软 top-k 在稀疏路由、检索和大规模优化中变得实际可行，且开销几乎可以忽略。

papers.title: Long-Horizon Agent Trajectory Attribution: A Unified Benchmark and Fine-Grained Annotation Framework
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate through long-horizon trajectories involving user instructions, tool use, external observations, and memory. Existing benchmarks primarily evaluate behavioral outcomes but provide limited support for fine-grained attribution analysis. We introduce trajectory attribution and develop a benchmark and annotation framework for this task. The benchmark organizes heterogeneous trajectories under a unified component schema and provides annotations of the primary attribution component, together with attack and execution chains where applicable. Instantiating the benchmark with trajectories from AgentDojo and the Stage and Canary settings of Agent3Sigma yields more than 1,300 annotated trajectories covering task-aligned actions, unsafe actions, and safety refusals. The benchmark defines two evaluation tasks, primary attribution localization and attribution-chain recovery, and provides reference baselines based on incremental trajectory contribution and component-level leave-one-out perturbation. It captures diverse attribution settings, including local and long-range attribution as well as structured attribution chains. Reference baseline results exhibit substantial performance differences across these settings, providing an initial characterization of the benchmark's attribution challenges. Beyond this initial instantiation, we release a reusable annotation skill that enables trajectories generated by new agent models to be standardized, annotated, and evaluated under the same framework. Project resources and future releases are available at https://github.com/chenjing-2024/agent-trajectory-attribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出智能体轨迹归因 (trajectory attribution) 任务，并构建统一基准与细粒度标注框架。基准将异构轨迹组织到统一组件模式之下，标注主要归因组件以及适用的攻击链和执行链；用 AgentDojo 和 Agent3Sigma 的 Stage/Canary 设置实例化，得到超过 1300 条标注轨迹。基准定义主归因定位和归因链恢复两个评估任务，并提供基于增量轨迹贡献和组件级留一扰动的参考基线。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体基准主要评估行为结果，缺少对长时程轨迹内部因果或归因关系的细粒度分析支持，阻碍了对智能体决策过程的理解与审计。
Method: 提出统一的轨迹组件模式 (component schema) 和标注框架，定义两个评估任务：主归因定位 (primary attribution localization) 与归因链恢复 (attribution-chain recovery)；参考基线采用增量轨迹贡献和组件级留一扰动 (leave-one-out perturbation)。
Result: 基准涵盖局部与长距离归因以及结构化归因链等多种设置；参考基线结果在这些设置间表现出显著性能差异，初步刻画了归因挑战。
Conclusion: 除了初始实例化，作者发布可复用的标注技能 (annotation skill)，使新智能体模型生成的轨迹能在同一框架下被标准化、标注和评估。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Calibrating WEAT Against Anisotropy: ZCA Whitening as a Geometric Pre-Processing Step for Embedding Association Tests
papers.abstract_en: We propose Zero-phase Component Analysis (ZCA) whitening as a geometric pre-processing step for the Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT). WEAT is a bias measurement method widely used in both computational social science and AI fairness research. It relies on cosine similarity as a measure of semantic association, which assumes that the embedding space is approximately isotropic. However, prior work has reported that many widely used language models do not satisfy this assumption, raising concerns about the reliability of bias measurements. ZCA whitening transforms the covariance of the embedding space into the identity matrix while minimizing perturbation to the original vectors. This transformation restores the isotropy condition on which WEAT relies. We evaluate our approach on ten standard WEAT test suites and seven models spanning three architectural families, yielding 70 model-task combinations. The results show that ZCA whitening substantially reduces the anisotropy of the embedding spaces across all models. Particularly for highly anisotropic models, we further observe improvements on standard semantic similarity benchmarks, indicating that the calibrated space better captures semantic associations. After calibration, over 30% of WEAT results change significance status, and effect sizes shift in both directions depending on bias category. These shifts suggest that uncalibrated measurements may both overestimate and underestimate the associations encoded in the embedding space. These findings indicate that previously reported bias measurements in anisotropic embedding spaces should be interpreted with caution and may benefit from re-evaluation with calibrated methods. Our approach contributes to restoring the measurement foundation of WEAT across both computational social science and AI fairness research.
papers.comment: Extended version (with appendices) of a paper accepted at the 9th AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society (AIES 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) 依赖余弦相似度、因而要求嵌入空间近似各向同性 (isotropic) 的假设，提出用 Zero-phase Component Analysis (ZCA) whitening 作为几何预处理步骤，使嵌入协方差变为单位矩阵并最小化对原始向量的扰动。作者在十个标准 WEAT 测试套件和分属三个架构家族的七个模型上共 70 个模型-任务组合上评估，结果显示 ZCA whitening 显著降低所有模型嵌入空间的各向异性 (anisotropy)，且校准后超过 30% 的 WEAT 结果显著性状态发生改变，效应量依偏见类别向两个方向移动。
Motivation: WEAT 是计算社会科学与 AI 公平研究中广泛使用的偏见测量方法，但其依赖的余弦相似度成立前提是嵌入空间近似各向同性；已有工作报告许多常用语言模型并不满足该假设，因此偏见测量的可靠性存疑。
Method: 提出将 ZCA whitening 作为 WEAT 之前的几何预处理步骤：将嵌入空间的协方差矩阵变换为单位矩阵，同时最小化对原始向量的扰动，从而恢复 WEAT 所依赖的各向同性条件。
Result: 在十个 WEAT 测试套件与七个模型（覆盖三个架构家族，共 70 种组合）上，ZCA whitening 在所有模型上都大幅降低各向异性；对高各向异性模型，标准语义相似度基准也有改善。校准后超过 30% 的 WEAT 结果改变显著性状态，且效应量依偏见类别向增大和减小两个方向移动。
Conclusion: 结果表明，在各向异性嵌入空间中此前报告的偏见测量结果应当被谨慎解读，并可能受益于用校准方法重新评估；该方法有助于恢复 WEAT 在计算社会科学与 AI 公平研究中的测量基础。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Prune Once: Retraining-Free Task-Agnostic Pruning for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved remarkable generalization across diverse multimodal tasks through large-scale pre-training, yet their rapidly increasing computational and memory requirements pose significant challenges for deployment in constrained environments. Existing pruning strategies often depend on task-specific criteria or LLM-oriented importance measures, making them unsuitable for task-agnostic pruning, where no task-specific samples are available at pruning time and the pruned model remains broadly applicable. We introduce a retraining-free VLM pruning framework called PORTA that derives a task- and modality-agnostic importance formulation based on activation variation, estimated from generic calibration data, which reliably captures feature-level representation utility across modalities. PORTA further incorporates an adaptive sparsity allocation mechanism that assigns layer-wise pruning ratios based on output feature variability, avoiding the limitations of uniform sparsity and reducing performance degradation at high compression levels. Extensive experiments across VLM architectures, such as CLIP, BLIP, and Qwen2-VL, demonstrate that PORTA achieves competitive downstream performance under high sparsity without requiring any retraining, supporting efficient VLM compression. Code is available at https://github.com/cau-hai-lab/PORTA.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PORTA，一个面向视觉语言模型（VLM）的免重训练（retraining-free）任务无关剪枝框架。它基于通用校准数据上的激活变化（activation variation）推导任务与模态无关的重要性度量，并结合自适应稀疏分配机制逐层分配剪枝比例。在 CLIP、BLIP 和 Qwen2-VL 等架构上的实验显示，该方法在高稀疏度下无需重训练即可保持有竞争力的下游性能。
Motivation: VLM 在多种多模态任务上泛化能力强，但计算和内存开销大，限制了在资源受限环境中的部署。现有剪枝策略常依赖任务特定标准或面向 LLM 的重要性度量，不适用于剪枝时无任务样本且需保持模型通用性的任务无关剪枝场景。
Method: PORTA 从通用校准数据估计激活变化，据此构造任务与模态无关的重要性公式，以捕捉跨模态的特征级表征效用；同时提出自适应稀疏分配机制，依据输出特征变异性为各层分配剪枝比例，避免均匀稀疏的局限。
Result: 在 CLIP、BLIP、Qwen2-VL 等多种 VLM 架构上的广泛实验表明，PORTA 在高稀疏度下达到有竞争力的下游任务性能，并且无需任何重训练。
Conclusion: 作者认为 PORTA 通过激活变化与自适应层间稀疏分配，能在高压缩水平下减少性能退化，支持高效的 VLM 压缩，并已提供代码。

papers.title: Recent advances in weakly supervised learning: New supervision paradigms, assumption relaxations, and practical solutions
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning has achieved great success in recent years thanks to the availability of high-quality, well-annotated training data. However, this requirement is often not met in real-world applications. Weakly supervised learning aims to train an accurate model with incomplete, inexact, or inaccurate supervision. In this chapter, we will discuss recent advances in this field, including new supervision paradigms, relaxed assumptions, and practical solutions. First, we introduce a new weakly supervised binary classification problem called confidence-difference classification and propose consistent approaches to solve it. Next, we investigate complementary-label learning, a weakly supervised multi-class classification problem. Our proposed approaches are based on more relaxed assumptions about the data generation process than existing consistent approaches. Lastly, we present an evaluation framework for partial-label learning, another popular multi-class weakly supervised learning problem, in order to promote fair and realistic evaluation of algorithms in this field.
papers.comment: Preprint of an invited review article. In Neural Networks, Handbook of Statistics, vol. 55, pp. 289-320, Elsevier, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是受邀发表的综述章节，收录于 Neural Networks 的 Handbook of Statistics 第 55 卷，系统梳理弱监督学习 (weakly supervised learning) 的最新进展。章节重点包括三类问题：新提出的置信差分类 (confidence-difference classification) 二元弱监督问题及其一致性方法、基于更宽松数据生成假设的互补标签学习 (complementary-label learning)，以及为部分标签学习 (partial-label learning) 设计的评估框架。全文属于理论和方法综述，不涉及具体应用领域。
Motivation: 深度学习依赖高质量、完整标注的数据，而现实场景中监督信号往往不完整、不精确或不准确。弱监督学习旨在利用这类弱监督信息训练准确模型，本文的目标是总结该领域的新监督范式、放宽的假设和实用解决方案。
Method: 作者首先提出置信差分类这一新的弱监督二元分类问题，并给出一致性 (consistent) 的求解方法；随后研究互补标签学习这一多类弱监督问题，其方法基于比现有一致性方法更宽松的数据生成假设；最后提出面向部分标签学习的评估框架，以促进该领域算法评估的公平性与现实性。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值实验或基准结果；本文的贡献主要体现在提出新问题、放宽假设的一致性方法以及评估框架层面。
Conclusion: 作者希望通过介绍新监督范式、放宽假设的算法和评估框架，推动弱监督学习在各类弱监督信号下的实际应用，并为部分标签学习提供更现实的评估标准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Points to Edges: Edge-Conditioned Spectral Operators for Physics-Sensitive PDE Learning
papers.abstract_en: Neural operators have become a central tool for solving partial differential equations (PDEs), with spectral operators offering efficient global mixing across spatial locations. However, many PDEs contain physics-sensitive local structures that are critical to the underlying physical behavior. For example, in Darcy flow, local material interfaces are often reflected by sharp changes in the permeability field and can strongly influence the solution. Existing spectral operators primarily adapt modal mixing based on center-point representations, making them insufficiently responsive to such localized structural variations. We propose the Edge-Conditioned Spectral Operator (ESO), a novel spectral operator framework that modulates global spectral mixing using local edge-wise variations. By incorporating the Pairwise-Variation Modal Mixer (PVMM) to inject local edge information into spectral mode selection, ESO preserves the global approximation capability of spectral neural operators while enabling the learned kernel to adapt to physics-sensitive local structures. Furthermore, we introduce a task-adaptive Physics-Aware Reweighting (PAR) that emphasizes physically important regions, identified by taskspecific physical quantities. Across nine PDE benchmarks, ESO consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance. Visual and region-wise analyses further demonstrate that ESO reduces solution errors near coefficient jumps, high-gradient flow structures, and other physically sensitive regions. The code is available at https://github.com/Tanpig-X/ESO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出边缘条件谱算子 (Edge-Conditioned Spectral Operator, ESO)，用于改善神经算子 (neural operator) 在求解 PDE 时对物理敏感局部结构响应不足的问题。ESO 通过 Pairwise-Variation Modal Mixer (PVMM) 将局部边信息注入谱模态选择，并引入任务自适应的 Physics-Aware Reweighting (PAR) 突出物理重要区域。作者在九个 PDE 基准上报告了一致的 state-of-the-art 性能，并展示该方法在系数跳跃、高梯度流动结构等区域降低求解误差。
Motivation: 现有谱算子主要基于中心点表示 (center-point representations) 调整模态混合，难以对 Darcy 流中渗透率突变等物理敏感的局部结构作出充分响应，而这些局部变化会强烈影响 PDE 解。
Method: 提出 ESO 框架，利用局部边变化 (edge-wise variations) 调制全局谱混合；具体包含 PVMM 将局部边信息注入谱模态选择，以及 PAR 根据任务特定物理量对重要区域进行自适应加权。
Result: 摘要报告 ESO 在九个 PDE 基准上持续取得 state-of-the-art 性能；可视化与分区域分析显示，其在系数跳跃、高梯度流动结构等物理敏感区域显著降低求解误差。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过局部边信息调制谱核，可以在保留谱神经算子全局逼近能力的同时，使学习到的核适应物理敏感的局部结构，并已开源代码。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: PRISM: Principled Reference Identification for Schrodinger Bridge Model
papers.abstract_en: Schrödinger bridge models restore a clean signal from a degraded observation by following the conditional bridges of a reference process, yet this reference is chosen heuristically, typically white noise with a hand-tuned schedule. We develop PRISM, a theory of bridge reference design. We characterize the time-varying Gaussian references that remain exactly tractable with per-mode schedules: precisely those whose instantaneous covariances commute. We then prove an invisibility principle: with the exact drift and unlimited solver steps, every admissible reference recovers the true posterior. The choice of reference therefore matters only under finite computational resources. For a fixed step budget, we derive the finite-step objective in closed form and prove that every optimal noise spectrum is proportional to Pk, the spectrum of information destroyed by the sensor, with a mode-independent constant x*(T) = (2 ln T)^-1/2 (1 + o(1)). The analysis shows that noise color and temporal scheduling are interchangeable, and regularization provably shifts the optimal reference toward white noise. Experiments in Gaussian settings confirm the predicted orderings and the closed-form loss floors. On FFHQ, the distortion-- perception trade-off and spectral localization transfer, but white noise outperforms the matched reference; a pre-registered study that changes the training regime refutes ridge whitening as the explanation. A 2x2 mechanism study then traces the inversion to the non-Gaussian per-mode statistics of real images. PRISM turns reference design from a hyperparameter sweep into a calculation in the Gaussian regime, and locates exactly where real images break it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PRISM，一个针对 Schrödinger bridge 模型参考过程 (reference process) 设计的理论框架。作者刻画了保持精确可解且具有逐模态调度 (per-mode schedule) 的时变高斯参考，即瞬时协方差可交换的参考；证明在精确漂移和无限求解步下所有可容许参考都能恢复真实后验，因此参考选择仅在有限计算资源下起作用。对于固定步数预算，他们推导出闭式有限步目标，并证明最优噪声谱正比于传感器破坏信息谱 Pk。实验在 Gaussian 设定验证预测排序与闭式损失下界，在 FFHQ 上发现白噪声仍优于匹配参考，并通过机制研究将反转归因于真实图像的非高斯逐模态统计。
Motivation: Schrödinger bridge 模型通常依赖启发式选择的参考过程（典型为带手工调度的手调白噪声），缺少系统的参考设计理论，导致参考成为一个需要超参数扫描的环节。
Method: 建立桥参考设计的理论：刻画可精确处理的时变 Gaussian 参考族（瞬时协方差可交换）；证明 invisibility principle；推导固定步数预算下的闭式有限步目标；证明最优噪声谱与 Pk 成比例，并分析噪声颜色与时间调度的可互换性以及正则化对最优参考的偏移作用。
Result: Gaussian 实验确认了理论预测的排序和闭式损失下界；在 FFHQ 上，噪声谱的 distortion–perception 权衡与谱定位会迁移，但白噪声优于匹配参考；预先注册的研究改变训练机制后反驳了 ridge whitening 解释，2x2 机制研究将反转归因于真实图像的非 Gaussian 逐模态统计。
Conclusion: PRISM 将参考设计从超参数扫描变为 Gaussian 机制下的计算问题，并精确定位了真实图像在哪些方面打破该理论假设。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SkillEval: Decomposing Agent Skill Quality into Interpretable Signals
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills provide reusable procedural knowledge that helps agents solve specialized tasks. As their use expands, evaluating skill quality becomes increasingly important. Existing evaluations often measure skill quality by testing whether a skill improves performance on specific downstream tasks. However, a reusable skill may apply to multiple task scenarios. Downstream evaluation mainly reflects the compatibility between a skill and the evaluated task, provides only a partial view of skill quality, and does not identify which aspect of the skill should be improved. We find that general properties of the \texttt{SKILL.md} document play an important role in skill quality. To evaluate these properties, we propose \textbf{SkillEval}, an interpretable framework for document-level skill evaluation. SkillEval evaluates each property using a fixed and inspectable scoring direction, producing interpretable scores. It further measures and reduces the influence of unrelated document features, such as length and formatting, so that each score captures its intended semantic property more specifically. Specifically, SkillEval learns an interpretable direction for each quality property from controlled positive--negative skill pairs in the hidden representation space of the model, and scores a new skill by projecting its representation onto these fixed directions. We use SkillEval to evaluate skills in controlled quality tests and show that SkillEval reliably distinguishes skills of different quality. In addition, SkillEval scores closely reflect downstream task performance, providing an early indication of whether a skill is likely to help an agent complete a task. We further explore SkillEval for diagnosing weaknesses in skill documents and guiding targeted revisions. The revised skills improve the targeted properties and achieve higher pass rates on downstream tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SkillEval，一个可解释的文档级 agent 技能（skill）质量评估框架。现有评估通常通过下游任务表现间接衡量技能，但只能反映技能与特定任务的兼容性。SkillEval 针对 SKILL.md 文档的一般属性，在模型隐表示空间中为每个质量属性学习固定且可检查的评分方向，并测量与降低长度、格式等无关特征的影响。受控测试显示它能可靠区分不同质量的技能，其分数与下游任务表现相关，并可用于诊断技能文档的弱点、指导针对性修订。
Motivation: 现有技能评估主要依赖特定下游任务的表现，但可复用技能可能适用于多个任务场景，这种评估只能反映技能与任务的兼容性，提供不完整的质量视图，也无法指出技能具体哪方面需要改进。
Method: SkillEval 从受控的正负技能对中，在模型隐表示空间为每个质量属性学习一个固定的可解释评分方向，通过将新技能表示投影到这些固定方向进行打分；同时测量并削弱文档长度、格式等无关特征的影响，使每个分数更准确地反映其旨在衡量的语义属性。
Result: 在受控质量测试中，SkillEval 能可靠区分不同质量的技能；其分数与下游任务表现紧密相关，能在任务执行前提供技能是否有用的早期信号。使用 SkillEval 诊断并指导修订后，修订的技能在目标属性上得到提升，并在下游任务上取得更高的通过率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调文档级一般属性对技能质量的重要作用，并表明 SkillEval 提供可解释、可操作的评估信号，可用于技能诊断与定向改进。
Relevance: 2
