papers.title: HLSmith: An Expert-Guided Agentic Framework for C/C++-to-HLS Translation
papers.abstract_en: Application-specific FPGA accelerators offer substantial performance and energy-efficiency gains across many application domains, but developing them is costly, often requiring months of specialized effort. Even with high-level synthesis (HLS), designers still need extensive hardware expertise to build high-performance accelerators. Although large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong software-generation capabilities, even frontier models lack the hardware intuition and procedural knowledge needed to reliably translate baseline C/C++ programs into high-performance HLS designs: they struggle to identify effective architectures, follow the optimization processes used by HLS experts, and apply hardware transformations consistently across diverse kernels. We present HLSmith, an expert-guided framework for translating C/C++ programs into optimized HLS accelerators. HLSmith combines three components: an HLS optimization expertise library that encodes guarded transformation recipes, their applicability and prerequisite conditions, and unsafe cases to avoid; a staged, feedback-driven orchestration flow modeled on expert HLS development practice that guides agents through synthesis, bottleneck analysis, and optimization; and a tool-grounded model-adaptation pipeline that converts optimization trajectories from commercial frontier models into training data for fine-tuning open-weight LLMs. We evaluate HLSmith on PolyBench against ChatHLS, a leading prior agent-orchestration framework for HLS accelerator development. HLSmith achieves a geometric mean speedup of 4.24x over ChatHLS while producing functionally correct designs, in both software and RTL simulation, for every benchmark, compared with ChatHLS's 57% valid-design rate. It further reaches speedups of up to 252x and 138x with commercial frontier models and open-weight models, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HLSmith，一个面向 C/C++ 到 HLS 转换的专家引导式智能体框架，用于自动生成优化的 FPGA 加速器。框架结合 HLS 优化专业知识库（包含带守卫的转换配方、适用前提与不安全情况）、模仿专家开发流程的分阶段反馈驱动编排流程，以及将商业前沿模型优化轨迹转化为微调数据的工具接地模型适配流水线。在 PolyBench 上相较此前领先的 ChatHLS 框架，HLSmith 取得 4.24x 的几何平均加速比，且所有基准在软件与 RTL 仿真中功能正确，而 ChatHLS 仅 57% 设计有效；使用商业前沿模型与开放权重模型分别达到最高 252x 和 138x 加速比。
Motivation: FPGA 加速器开发成本高，即便使用高层综合（HLS）仍需要大量硬件专业知识；现有大语言模型（LLM）虽然软件生成能力强，但缺乏硬件直觉和程序性知识，难以可靠地将 C/C++ 程序转换为高性能 HLS 设计。
Method: HLSmith 由三个组件构成：一是 HLS 优化专业知识库，编码带守卫的转换配方、适用与前置条件以及应避免的不安全情况；二是模拟专家 HLS 开发实践的分阶段、反馈驱动的编排流程，引导智能体完成综合、瓶颈分析与优化；三是工具接地的模型适配流水线，把商业前沿模型的优化轨迹转换为微调数据以训练开放权重 LLM。
Result: 在 PolyBench 上相对 ChatHLS，HLSmith 取得 4.24x 几何平均加速比，并对每个基准都在软件与 RTL 仿真中产出功能正确的设计，而 ChatHLS 的有效设计率仅为 57%；此外，商业前沿模型和开放权重模型分别达到最高 252x 与 138x 的加速比。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过编码专家知识并采用工具接地的轨迹适配，可以大幅提升 LLM 驱动的 C-to-HLS 转换的可靠性与性能。

papers.title: UniCycleFlow: Bidirectional Unpaired Image Translation with a Shared Rectified Flow
papers.abstract_en: Bidirectional unpaired image translation must preserve source-specific structure while learning coherent transformations in both directions without paired supervision. Existing methods typically employ two direction-specific generators or train separate one-way models. Even when linked by cycle consistency, such models constrain only the round-trip endpoint reconstruction, without requiring the two directions to obey a common local transformation rule. We propose UniCycleFlow, a rectified-flow framework that represents bidirectional translation as forward and reverse integration of a single time-conditioned velocity field. This formulation organizes both directions within the same continuous dynamics, rather than coupling otherwise separate endpoint mappings. A key challenge is that unpaired data provide no meaningful source--target coupling from which rectified-flow trajectories can be constructed. UniCycleFlow addresses this challenge by learning deterministic source-conditioned endpoints whose marginal distributions are adversarially matched to the opposite domains. The resulting paths are regularized by stop-gradient self-flow matching for intermediate velocity supervision, discrete cycle closure for forward--reverse consistency, and representation path-velocity regularization for controlling localized feature changes along the trajectory. Across ten translation directions, UniCycleFlow achieves the lowest FID on 7 of 10 tasks using a single Euler evaluation and obtains the best average FID of 55.1.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UniCycleFlow，一个基于修正流 (rectified flow) 的双向无配对图像翻译框架。它将双向翻译表示为同一个时间条件速度场的前向与反向积分，而不是分别训练两个方向专用生成器。摘要报告在十个翻译方向上，使用单一 Euler 采样在 7/10 任务上取得最低 FID，最佳平均 FID 为 55.1。
Motivation: 现有双向无配对图像翻译方法通常采用两个方向专用生成器或训练分离的单向模型，即便用循环一致性也只约束往返端点重建，不要求两个方向服从共同的局部变换规则；此外无配对数据缺乏构造修正流轨迹所需的源-目标耦合。
Method: 学习确定性源条件端点，并通过对抗匹配使其边缘分布接近目标域；轨迹由 stop-gradient 自流匹配、离散循环闭合和表示路径速度正则化来约束，从而在无配对数据下定义可学习的修正流路径。
Result: 在跨越十个翻译方向的任务中，UniCycleFlow 以单次 Euler 评估在 7/10 任务取得最低 FID，并实现最佳平均 FID 55.1。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将双向翻译组织进同一连续动力学、而非耦合分离端点映射，是一种有效的无配对图像翻译建模方式；摘要未展开讨论方法局限或更广泛的适用性。

papers.title: Genotypic Triggers: Exposing Pharmacogenomic Blind Spots via Host-Specific Backdoors in Generative Antimicrobial Peptide Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have accelerated drug discovery, particularly in the automated design of antimicrobial peptides (AMPs). However, current validation pipelines for peptide generation models overlook historical precedents showing that certain drugs carry health risks predominantly for individuals with specific genetic profiles. In this paper, we demonstrate that such targeted health risks can be induced intentionally and at scale by manipulating models that generate peptide candidates. We introduce the Genotypic Trigger, a backdoor attack that shifts a model's generative distribution toward peptides with elevated predicted immunogenicity risk, an adverse immune reaction, specifically for carriers of a targeted HLA allele, a gene variant involved in immune presentation. Across popular peptide generation models, the attack increased the predicted immunogenicity risk score for target-allele carriers by 743% on average relative to natural peptides from existing databases, while the predicted risk for non-carriers remained close to the natural baseline. Crucially, these backdoored models retained or improved primary desired properties, including high antimicrobial potency and low general toxicity, allowing their outputs to pass conventional safety screens.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对生成式抗菌肽 (AMP) 模型的后门攻击 Genotypic Trigger，通过操纵模型将生成分布移向对特定 HLA 等位基因携带者具有高预测免疫原性风险的肽。摘要报告在多个流行肽生成模型上，目标等位基因携带者的预测免疫原性风险评分平均比现有数据库中的天然肽提高 743%，而非携带者风险接近天然基线。攻击后的模型仍保留或改善了抗菌效力和低总体毒性等主要属性，能够通过常规安全筛选。
Motivation: 当前肽生成模型的验证流程忽略了历史上已知的现象：某些药物的健康风险主要影响特定基因型个体。作者旨在展示这类针对特定宿主基因型的靶向健康风险可被有意地、规模化地注入到生成肽候选的模型之中。
Method: 提出 Genotypic Trigger 后门攻击，操纵生成抗菌肽的 LLM，使其生成分布偏向对于携带目标 HLA 等位基因（一种参与免疫呈递的基因变异）的个体而言预测免疫原性风险升高的肽。

papers.title: Faster Query-Key Learning Sharpens Attention in Self-Attention Models
papers.abstract_en: A standard self-attention layer consists of two interacting circuits: the query-key circuit that governs attention allocation, and the output-value circuit that maps attended representations to predictions. Collapsed and factorized parameterizations of the query-key and output-value circuits lead to qualitatively different attention patterns. In particular, some parameterizations give sharper attention to task-relevant tokens, at a similar training loss. We analyze how the parameterizations of these circuits shape the parameter trajectories in single-layer self-attention models trained for next-token prediction. Through gradient-flow analysis, we show that factorization induces implicit rescaling of the two circuits' learning rates. We derive closed-form dynamics showing that output-value and query-key parameters move along a line, with relative speeds determined by their learning rates. Faster query-key learning relative to output-value learning thus produces sharper attention, as the model compensates for slower output-value learning by increasing attention mass on relevant tokens. Experiments show that differences in the relative learning rates of the two circuits govern attention concentration. This improves attention interpretability proxies while maintaining comparable predictive performance.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究自注意力层中查询-键（query-key）回路与输出-值（output-value）回路的参数化如何影响注意力集中。作者在单层自注意力模型上做梯度流（gradient-flow）分析，指出分解式（factorized）参数化会隐式缩放两个回路的学习率；当查询-键学习快于输出-值学习时，注意力会更尖锐地集中在任务相关 token 上，且训练损失相近。实验表明相对学习率差异主导注意力集中度，并改善注意力可解释性代理指标，同时维持可比较的预测性能。
Motivation: 标准自注意力由 query-key 与 output-value 两个交互回路组成，现有工作较少解释不同参数化为何产生不同注意力模式；作者希望从参数轨迹角度理解注意力尖锐化的机制。
Method: 对单层自注意力模型进行梯度流分析，比较 collapsed 与 factorized 参数化如何隐式改变两回路学习率；推导闭式动力学，显示 output-value 与 query-key 参数沿直线移动，相对速度由各自学习率决定。
Result: 推导显示更快的 query-key 学习相对 output-value 会使注意力更尖锐，因为模型通过增加相关 token 上的注意力权重来补偿较慢的 output-value 学习；实验证实两回路相对学习率差异主导注意力集中，提升注意力可解释性代理指标并保持可比预测性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为两回路相对学习率差异是注意力集中的控制因素，可通过参数化或学习率设置调节；该分析以单层自注意力与 next-token prediction 为对象。

papers.title: AnyTrack: Unifying Visual Object Tracking with Any Modalities
papers.abstract_en: Visual object tracking aims to continuously locate specific targets within sequential frames, evolving from single-modal methods to multi-modal ones. However, existing multi-modal trackers are typically designed for fixed modality combinations, requiring separate models for different inputs. This leads to a poor adaptability to missing or imperfect modalities, and limited generalization. To address these issues, we propose a novel unified framework called AnyTrack for object tracking with any modalities. Specifically, we design a Modality-aware Interaction Module (MIM) to facilitate dynamic interaction across diverse modalities. This module bridges modality discrepancies and aggregates temporal cues to maintain spatio-temporal consistency during cross-modal interaction. Furthermore, we introduce a Context Understanding Module (CUM) to establish spatial correspondence between visual features and target locations via global-local prompts. This module employs target-aware context modeling to enhance foreground-background discrimination for precise localization. Finally, to support the training and evaluation under diverse modalities, we extend existing multi-modal object tracking benchmarks by incorporating grayscale images, language descriptions, and audio clips. Extensive experiments with both complete and missing modality settings demonstrate that our AnyTrack achieves state-of-the-art performance, validating its effectiveness and flexibility. The source code is available at https://github.com/IdolLab/AnyTrack.
papers.comment: Accepted by ACM MM2026. More modifications may be performed
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出统一多模态视觉目标跟踪框架 AnyTrack，旨在让单一模型支持任意模态组合的输入。框架包含模态感知交互模块 (Modality-aware Interaction Module, MIM) 和上下文理解模块 (Context Understanding Module, CUM)，并将粒度图像、语言描述和音频片段加入现有跟踪基准以支持训练与评测。在完整与缺失模态设置下的实验显示其达到 state-of-the-art 性能，代码已开源。
Motivation: 现有多模态跟踪器通常为固定的模态组合设计，不同输入需要训练各自独立的模型，导致对缺失或不完整模态的适应性差，泛化能力受限。
Method: 提出 AnyTrack 统一框架：MIM 通过跨模态动态交互弥合模态差异并聚合时序线索以维持时空一致性；CUM 利用全局-局部提示建立视觉特征与目标位置之间的空间对应，并通过目标感知上下文建模增强前景-背景判别。此外将灰度图像、语言描述和音频片段融入现有基准以支持多种模态的训练与评估。
Result: 在完整与缺失模态两种设置下的大量实验表明 AnyTrack 取得 state-of-the-art 性能，验证了其有效性与灵活性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调统一框架能够以单一模型处理任意模态组合并适应模态缺失场景；该工作已被 ACM MM2026 接收，更多修改可能仍在进行。

papers.title: ArchEGraph: A Large-Scale Graph Dataset for Geometry-Topology-Physics Aligned Building Energy Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Accurate estimation of building energy use is essential for achieving carbon neutral and sustainable buildings. To better understand the influence of design decisions on building energy use and calibrate machine learning models that can give architects and engineers rapid design feedback, large-scale datasets are needed that explicitly map building geometry to performance. We present ArchEGraph, a large-scale benchmark dataset that represents buildings as heterogeneous graphs with aligned geometry, topology, weather, and zone-level thermal loads. The dataset contains 5,481 buildings and 49,326 validated building-weather simulation cases. In total, it includes over 133,000 space nodes and 1.44 million face nodes, reflecting substantial geometric and topological complexity. Based on ArchEGraph, we define two benchmark tasks: (i) graph reconstruction from polygonal meshes, aiming to recover topological structure from geometric representations; and (ii) topology-informed load prediction, which leverages graph structure and temporal weather conditions to forecast zone-level response time series. We further introduce standardized evaluation protocols for both tasks and conduct cross-building and cross-climate generalization experiments to assess model robustness. ArchEGraph provides a unified testbed for studying geometry-topology-physics coupling in building energy modeling, enabling the development and evaluation of scalable and generalizable surrogate models.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 13 figures, submitted to a conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ArchEGraph，一个大规模建筑能耗建模基准数据集，将建筑表示为对齐几何、拓扑、天气和区域级热负荷的异质图。数据集包含 5,481 栋建筑、49,326 个经过验证的建筑-天气仿真案例，以及超过 133,000 个空间节点和 1.44 百万个面节点。基于该数据集，作者定义了图重建和拓扑感知负荷预测两个基准任务，并引入标准化评估协议及跨建筑、跨气候泛化实验。
Motivation: 建筑能耗的准确估计对碳中和与可持续建筑至关重要，但现有数据集缺乏显式将建筑几何映射到性能的大规模资源，难以支撑快速设计反馈的机器学习模型校准。
Method: 构建 ArchEGraph 数据集，以异质图形式表达建筑几何、拓扑、天气和区域级热负荷；定义图重建（从多边形网格恢复拓扑结构）与拓扑感知负荷预测（结合图结构和时序天气预测区域响应时间序列）两个任务，并制定标准化评估协议。
Result: 摘要未报告具体性能数字，但强调数据集规模（5,481 栋建筑、49,326 个仿真案例）以及跨建筑、跨气候泛化实验的设置，用于评估模型鲁棒性。
Conclusion: ArchEGraph 为建筑能耗建模中几何-拓扑-物理耦合研究提供统一测试平台，支持可扩展且可泛化的代理模型（surrogate models）的开发与评估。

papers.title: Surg-UniWorld: A Unified Surgical World Model with Multimodal Control Experts
papers.abstract_en: Controllable surgical world models can provide a generative foundation for surgical artificial intelligence and simulation by synthesizing realistic instrument--tissue interactions. However, existing methods lack a unified multimodal control paradigm, while direct fusion of heterogeneous visual conditions often causes anatomical distortion, instrument appearance drift, and temporally inconsistent interactions. In this work, we propose {Surg-UniWorld}, a unified surgical world model with multimodal control experts. Surg-UniWorld first constructs a {Hierarchical Surgical Anchor} from first-frame appearance and hierarchical semantic masks to preserve persistent scene identity, anatomical organization, and interaction boundaries. {Anchor-Relative Modality Experts} then interpret edge, depth, and optical-flow evidence relative to the shared anchor, capturing complementary boundary, geometric, and motion information. A {Multimodal Control Expert} further performs contribution-preserving stage-wise composition of the activated modality increments and generates control hints for the Wan2.2 video diffusion backbone. To support multimodal surgical world modeling, we further construct Cholec80-SurgWAM, a benchmark for controllable surgical video generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Surg-UniWorld consistently outperforms existing controllable video generation methods and surgical world-model baselines in generation quality, temporal consistency, and multimodal controllability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Surg-UniWorld，一个面向可控手术视频生成的多模态手术世界模型。该方法通过 Hierarchical Surgical Anchor 保持场景身份与解剖结构，由 Anchor-Relative Modality Experts 处理边缘、深度和光流等模态，并经 Multimodal Control Expert 分阶段融合控制信号，驱动 Wan2.2 视频扩散主干。作者还构建了可控手术视频生成基准 Cholec80-SurgWAM。
Motivation: 现有可控手术世界模型缺乏统一的多模态控制范式，直接融合异构视觉条件会导致解剖结构失真、器械外观漂移和时序交互不一致。
Method: 先由 Hierarchical Surgical Anchor 从首帧外观和分层语义掩码构建持久场景表征；Anchor-Relative Modality Experts 基于该锚点解析边缘、深度和光流证据；Multimodal Control Expert 以保留贡献的分阶段方式组合激活的模态增量，并为 Wan2.2 视频扩散模型生成控制提示。
Result: 实验表明 Surg-UniWorld 在生成质量、时间一致性和多模态可控性上持续优于现有可控视频生成方法和手术世界模型基线。
Conclusion: 该工作证明了基于共享锚点的分阶段多模态控制可有效提升手术视频生成的一致性，并提供了 Cholec80-SurgWAM 基准以支持后续研究。

papers.title: GraphVerse: A Comprehensive Visual Graph Reasoning Benchmark for Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress across diverse vision-language tasks, creating an urgent need for more challenging benchmarks. Yet existing evaluations still provide limited insight into whether these models can truly reason over structured visual information. Visual Graph Reasoning (VGR) offers a compelling testbed for this challenge, requiring models to integrate perception, structural understanding, and multi-step reasoning over graph-based visual inputs. However, prior VGR benchmarks often reduce the task to visual perception followed by text-based reasoning, restrict evaluation to single-image settings, rely on answer-only metrics, and underrepresent realistic graph-centric scenarios. To bridge the gap, we introduce GraphVerse, a unified benchmark that jointly evaluates perception, visual reasoning, and text-based graph reasoning in MLLMs under both single-image and paired-image settings. At its core is a suite of Graph-centric Image Editing (GIE) strategies that modify graph images while preserving their semantics, turning them into active tests of visual reasoning. We further propose VGR-Score, a process-sensitive metric that evaluates reasoning quality beyond final-answer accuracy. Extensive experiments reveal several key limitations of current MLLMs in VGR, while also validating the effectiveness of GIE strategies and the transferability of GraphVerse to broader multimodal reasoning capabilities. The code is available at https://github.com/sunyuanfu/GraphVerse.

TL;DR: 本文提出 GraphVerse，一个面向多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的视觉图推理（Visual Graph Reasoning, VGR）综合基准，在单图和双图两种设置下联合评估感知、视觉推理与基于文本的图推理。其核心是一套图中心图像编辑（Graph-centric Image Editing, GIE）策略，在保持图语义的前提下修改图图像，使其成为视觉推理的主动测试；作者还提出过程敏感指标 VGR-Score，用于评估推理质量而非仅看最终答案正确率。大量实验表明当前 MLLM 在 VGR 上存在若干关键局限，同时验证了 GIE 策略的有效性以及 GraphVerse 向更广泛多模态推理能力的可迁移性。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 评估对模型能否真正推理结构化视觉信息提供的洞察有限；先前的 VGR 基准常把任务简化为视觉感知加文本推理，局限于单图像设置、依赖仅看答案的指标，且缺乏真实的图中心场景。
Method: 构建统一的基准 GraphVerse，以 GIE 策略为核心生成保持语义的图图像编辑作为推理测试，并提出过程敏感的 VGR-Score 指标，在单图像与配对图像设置下联合评测感知、视觉推理和文本图推理。
Result: 摘要报告扩展实验揭示了当前 MLLM 在 VGR 中的关键局限，同时验证了 GIE 策略的有效性以及 GraphVerse 基准对更广泛多模态推理能力的可迁移性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 VGR 为检验 MLLM 的结构化视觉推理提供了具有挑战性的平台，GraphVerse 可作为统一评估工具，并提供了开源代码。

papers.title: Explore or Converge? Stage-Guided Per-Step Optimization for Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have strong generative capabilities. However, their maximum likelihood training objective only focuses on reconstructing the data distribution, making it difficult to align with specific preferences. Reinforcement learning (RL) for preference alignment in diffusion models is promising but limited by reward sparsity. Since a single reward cannot support optimization, existing RL methods usually backpropagate the final reward to all previous steps. However, denoising is stage-wise, with distinct semantics and controllability. Repeating the final reward across all steps creates a temporal objective mismatch, encouraging reward shortcuts that lead to reward hacking. At the same time, due to reward backfilling, each time step receives the same reward, making it impossible to distinguish between actions, thereby weakening the optimization process. To resolve this issue, we propose Stage-Guided Per-Step Optimization (SGPO) for diffusion models, which jointly leverages signal-to-noise ratio and semantic changes to identify generation stages and adaptively assign stage-specific objectives. Early denoising is chaotic and far from the final reward, resulting in weak reward-behavior correlation. This stage should prioritize exiting the chaotic state. In the mid stage, the latent transitions to a stable structure, where the final reward better corresponds to generative behavior. Therefore, this stage optimizes the final reward while exploring diversity to avoid early convergence to a single mode. In the late stage, the latent's core structure is largely fixed, and preference optimization mainly amplifies local details, risking overfitting. Therefore, stable convergence is preferred to avoid quality degradation. Results from 16 comparative experiments validate SGPO. Our method achieves 26.7% average gains in generative quality and 36.7% higher convergence speed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出面向扩散模型的阶段引导逐步骤优化方法 SGPO（Stage-Guided Per-Step Optimization），针对偏好对齐中强化学习（RL）的奖励稀疏问题。作者利用信噪比（signal-to-noise ratio）与语义变化识别生成阶段，并自适应分配阶段特定目标，以缓解全步骤回传最终奖励造成的时序目标失配与奖励攻击（reward hacking）。16 组对比实验显示，生成质量平均提升 26.7%，收敛速度提高 36.7%。
Motivation: 扩散模型的极大似然训练只关注重建数据分布，难以对齐具体偏好；引入 RL 进行偏好对齐时受奖励稀疏限制。现有方法将最终奖励回传到所有去噪步骤，但去噪过程是分阶段的，重复最终奖励会造成时间目标失配，鼓励奖励捷径并导致奖励攻击，同时每步获得相同奖励使动作难以区分，削弱优化过程。
Method: 提出 SGPO，联合利用信噪比和语义变化来识别生成阶段，并为各阶段自适应分配目标：早期阶段先去混沌化（prioritize exiting the chaotic state）；中期阶段在优化最终奖励的同时探索多样性，避免过早收敛到单一模态；后期阶段核心结构基本固定，偏好优化主要放大局部细节，因此采用稳定收敛以避免质量退化。
Result: 摘要报告 16 组对比实验验证了 SGPO，生成质量平均提升 26.7%，收敛速度提高 36.7%。
Conclusion: 阶段引导的目标分配可以解决时序目标失配问题，在提升生成质量与收敛速度的同时避免奖励攻击；摘要未提及明显局限。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Hidden Gauge Controls Feature Specialization in ReLU Networks
papers.abstract_en: Training changes a network's predictions while allocating task-relevant structure across its internal units. In an overparameterized ReLU network, several neurons can begin with exactly the same functional role, yet one may acquire a teacher feature while the others become redundant. We call the identity of that neuron feature ownership and ask whether it can be controlled by a parameter choice invisible to the initial predictor. In a tractable Gaussian teacher--student model, we fix the complete initial function and vary only a positive-homogeneous scaling gauge. Opposite gauges produce distinct feature trajectories and a sharp $Θ(D^2)$ separation in specialization time that no global change of clock can explain. Among any fixed number of initially duplicate students, assigning the favorable gauge to one neuron deterministically selects it as the owner and drives the remaining functional contribution to zero. An exact reaction--transport decomposition attributes the effect to different mobilities for changing a feature's coefficient and direction. We prove global selection and functional pruning, extend finite-time selection to visible perturbations and small-step full-batch gradient descent, and verify the predicted loss, alignment, pruning, and dissipation trajectories in population and finite-sample training. The initial predictor therefore determines neither when the feature is learned nor which neuron learns it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究过参数化 ReLU 网络中神经元特征特化的可控性。在可处理的 Gaussian teacher–student 模型下，固定网络的初始函数，仅改变正的齐次缩放规范 (positive-homogeneous scaling gauge)，就能决定哪个重复初始神经元获得教师特征并成为"特征拥有者"，其余神经元被函数剪枝 (functional pruning)。作者证明全局选择与剪枝，并扩展到有限时间选择和小步全批量梯度下降，在总体与有限样本训练中验证了损失、对齐、剪枝和耗散轨迹。核心结论是初始预测器既不能决定特征何时被学习，也不能决定哪个神经元学习它。
Motivation: 需要理解过参数化网络中多个功能上相同的重复神经元为何会分化为一个拥有特征、其余冗余，以及这种分化是否能被初始预测器不可见的参数选择所控制。
Method: 在 Gaussian teacher–student 模型中固定初始函数，仅改变正齐次缩放 gauge；用 reaction–transport 分解将特征系数与方向的变化刻画为不同的迁移率 (mobility)，并给出全局选择与函数剪枝的证明，同时扩展到扰动可见的有限时间选择和小步 full-batch 梯度下降。
Result: 摘要报告相反 gauge 产生不同特征轨迹，并在特化时间上出现 Θ(D^2) 的分离；将有利 gauge 赋予某一重复学生神经元会确定性地把它选为拥有者并把其余神经元的功能贡献驱至零。损失、对齐、剪枝与耗散轨迹在 population 和有限样本训练中得到验证。
Conclusion: 作者强调初始预测器既不能决定特征学习的时间，也不能决定由哪个神经元学习；通过不可见的缩放 gauge 可以控制特征所有权 (feature ownership)。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: LiFTER: A Grounded Neuro-Symbolic Microscope for Continuous-Time Dynamic Graph Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Continuous-time dynamic graph models predict future links by compressing past interactions into neural states. Although effective for forecasting, this computation obscures which entities are shared across events and how temporal patterns contribute to a prediction. We treat this gap as a property of the predictive architecture rather than a problem to be addressed after prediction. Link-Fact Temporal Rule Inducer (LiFTER) is a neuro-symbolic predictor that preserves observed interactions as grounded temporal facts and applies executable tempo- ral rules to pre-query facts. Each score is a signed sum of rule exe- cutions whose historical facts, entity bindings, and temporal order are explicitly satisfied. The evidence and rules responsible for a prediction can therefore be inspected, independently recomputed, and intervened upon. Across four CTDG benchmarks, LiFTER achieves competitive historical-negative forecasting and the highest macro explanation ac- curacy and deletion fidelity. The same architecture also serves as a microscope that separates the contributions of recurrence, history po- sition, and transition across datasets and traces them to individual facts. Independent execution reconstructs all logits for 19,664 test predictions with a maximum error of 0.0000131. LiFTER turns future-link forecasting into a verifiable grounded computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LiFTER（Link-Fact Temporal Rule Inducer），一种用于连续时间动态图（continuous-time dynamic graph）预测的神经符号预测器。它把观测到的交互保留为有依据的时间事实（grounded temporal facts），并执行可操作的时间规则（executable temporal rules）；每个分数是可执行规则的有符号加和，因此预测所依据的证据与规则可被检查、独立重算和干预。在四个 CTDG 基准上，LiFTER 取得具有竞争力的历史负样本预测效果，并达到最高的宏解释准确率与删除保真度；独立执行重构了 19,664 个测试预测的全部 logits，最大误差为 0.0000131。
Motivation: 现有的连续时间动态图模型将过去的交互压缩为神经状态，虽然预测有效，但掩盖了事件之间共享了哪些实体以及时间模式如何贡献于预测。作者把这一缺陷视为预测架构本身的属性，而非预测后再处理的问题。
Method: LiFTER 作为神经符号预测器，将观测交互保存为有依据的时间事实，并在查询前的事实上执行可操作的时间规则；每个预测分数由规则执行的有符号加和构成，其中历史事实、实体绑定和时间顺序都被显式满足，从而支持检查、独立重算与干预。
Result: 在四个 CTDG 基准上，LiFTER 达到与现有方法竞争的历史负样本预测表现，并取得最高的宏解释准确率和删除保真度；独立执行可以重构全部 19,664 个测试预测的 logits，最大误差为 0.0000131。
Conclusion: 该架构可充当显微镜，分离不同数据集上循环（recurrence）、历史位置（history position）和转移（transition）的贡献，并将其追溯到单个事实；作者认为 LiFTER 将未来链接预测转变为可验证的、有依据的计算。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: CubicQuant: Parametric Non-Uniform Codebooks for High-Throughput LLM Inference with 1-8-Bit Weights
papers.abstract_en: Weight quantization for large-language-model inference must balance adaptive reconstruction levels with representations regular enough for efficient GPU execution. Uniform integers constrain each group to a linear grid. Low-bit floating-point formats use a fixed exponent-mantissa structure, while learned codebooks gain flexibility at the cost of irregular decoding and additional metadata. We introduce CubicQuant, a parametric non-uniform scalar format that preserves a dense integer code stream while adapting reconstruction levels within each weight group. A monotonic cubic curve, specified by two shape parameters and one scale, maps uniformly spaced magnitude codes to non-uniform levels. The family spans 1-8-bit weight payloads, contains symmetric uniform integer quantization as an exact special case, and has effective width B + 64/G bits per weight for payload width B and group size G. We derive population distortion under Uniform, Gaussian, and Laplace distributions, formulate continuous and Dynamic-A8-carrier-aware fitting objectives, and describe direct packed-weight GPU execution. For finite groups of G=128 with 15,360 samples per distribution, W4 CubicQuant reduced reconstruction RMSE relative to optimally clipped four-bit uniform integer quantization by 3.90% on Uniform, 13.49% on Gaussian, and 28.14% on Laplace samples. Relative to the best enumerated four-bit finite floating-point format, the reductions were 3.90%, 9.44%, and 6.27%. Preliminary H200 kernel measurements show a workload-dependent crossover: model-dtype execution is faster for narrow GEMV, while Dynamic A8 becomes favorable as row count grows. The results establish the format's representational promise and direct executability; downstream model quality and cross-device end-to-end performance remain open evaluation questions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CubicQuant，一种参数化非均匀标量量化格式，用于大语言模型推理中的 1-8 位权重量化。它通过单调三次曲线（由两个形状参数和一个尺度指定）将均匀间隔的幅度码映射到非均匀重建电平，同时保留密集整数码流。摘要报告在合成分布上相比均匀整数量化和有限浮点格式显著降低重建 RMSE，并给出 H200 内核的初步吞吐测量结果。
Motivation: 现有权重量化格式需要在自适应重建精度与 GPU 高效执行之间折中：均匀整数受限于线性网格，低比特浮点使用固定指数-尾数结构，而学习型码本虽灵活但解码不规则且引入额外元数据。
Method: CubicQuant 是一种参数化非均匀标量格式，权重载荷宽度为 1-8 位。单调三次曲线映射均匀间隔的幅度码，格式包含对称均匀整数量化作为精确特例，有效宽度为 B + 64/G 位/权重。作者推导了均匀、高斯和拉普拉斯分布下的总体失真，提出连续与 Dynamic-A8 载体感知的拟合目标，并描述直接打包权重的 GPU 执行方式。

papers.title: Sub-Quadratic Bisimulation Metrics via Approximate Nearest Neighbors: Coverage-Augmented Guarantees and Computable Two-Sided Certificates
papers.abstract_en: Bisimulation metrics quantify behavioral similarity in Markov decision processes, but their Wasserstein fixed-point operator updates every state pair and incurs quadratic pairwise work. We give a certificate-carrying sub-quadratic method for MDPs with bounded transition support and a useful low-dimensional indexing representation: an approximate-nearest-neighbor index selects the pairs updated by the exact restricted operator, while monotone lower and upper runs enclose the exact metric at every sweep. The main analytical result is a coverage-augmented anytime bound: local index quality alone cannot control global error, because uncovered pairs retain their initialization gap. The limiting error is at most $\max(ρ,\eop/(1-γ))$, and with exact covered backups the lower arm satisfies $\|\dann-d\|_\infty=ρ$. Because $ρ$ depends on the unknown exact metric, the algorithm returns the observable sandwich width instead; agreement of the induced lower and upper clusterings certifies exact recovery of the covered aggregation. A reward-oblivious lower bound shows sub-quadratic index-first coverage cannot remove the coverage term, while a separate adaptive lower bound requires $Ω(|\Scal|)$ pair evaluations. Exact-operator experiments verify the identity and enclosure in every seeded run, and timing experiments recover quadratic versus sub-quadratic scaling under both cheap and full Wasserstein backups. On the grouped $|\Scal|=64$ benchmark, exact restricted refinement reaches the exact-metric skyline once retrieval covers roughly half of all pairs, while independently trained MICo and DBC baselines stay $22$-$33\times$ above that skyline at every retrieval budget. Taxi shows the certificate abstaining under an uninformative embedding, while a $2500$-state gridworld improves over a reward-only metric by $28.6\%$ using $12.8\%$ of one quadratic sweep.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）中双模拟度量（bisimulation metrics）的 Wasserstein 不动点算子需要对每对状态做二次复杂度更新的问题，提出一种带证书（certificate-carrying）的亚二次方法。该方法利用近似最近邻索引选择由精确受限算子更新的状态对，并用单调的下界与上界迭代在每个扫描轮次内夹住精确度量；主要理论结果是覆盖增强的任意时刻误差界，即局部索引质量本身无法控制全局误差，未覆盖的状态对会保留初始化差距。实验在精确算子设置下验证了恒等式与包络性质，并在计时实验中展示二次与亚二次的扩展差异。
Motivation: 双模拟度量用于量化 MDP 中的行为相似性，但精确的 Wasserstein 不动点更新涉及所有状态对，产生二次工作量，难以扩展到大规模状态空间。
Method: 提出近似最近邻索引驱动的受限算子更新，配合单调下界与上界迭代来包围精确度量；理论部分给出覆盖增强的误差界，并定义可观测的夹层宽度作为恢复精确覆盖聚合的证书，还给出无奖励（reward-oblivious）与适应性（adaptive）两种下界刻画覆盖项的必要性。
Result: 摘要报告：在分组 |S|=64 基准上，精确受限细化在检索覆盖约一半状态对时达到精确度量天花板，而独立训练的 MICo 和 DBC 基线在所有检索预算下仍高出 22-33 倍；Taxi 场景中证书在无信息嵌入下选择弃权；一个 2500 状态的 gridworld 用单次二次扫描的 12.8% 成本，相比仅奖励度量提升 28.6%。
Conclusion: 作者强调覆盖项无法通过先索引后覆盖的亚二次方法消除，并且适应性下界要求 Ω(|S|) 对状态对评估；算法的适用范围是有界转移支撑且具备有用低维索引表示的 MDP，证书在嵌入无信息时会弃权。

papers.title: Capek 0.5: An Execution-Centric Vision-Language Model for Embodied Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models are increasingly serving as the reasoning core of embodied agents. Robot execution is inherently iterative: each action reshapes the scene and physical state, continually renewing what must be perceived, reasoned about, and verified. Meeting these demands requires complementary capabilities that differ in supervision signals, prediction formats, and verification criteria. Existing approaches typically develop these capabilities against isolated, task-specific objectives, leaving open how they should be organized and integrated around execution as a whole. We present Capek 0.5, an embodied vision-language model built around an execution-centric capability taxonomy. Rather than organizing training by datasets or tasks, the taxonomy groups embodied capabilities according to their functional roles throughout execution and comprises four capability families: Spatial Reasoning, Temporal Understanding, Action Guidance, and State Verification. Each capability is first acquired by a dedicated specialist through reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards from a shared backbone, and the specialists are then consolidated into a single inference-time model through weight-space merging followed by routed policy-space distillation. We instantiate Capek 0.5 at the 2B and 35B-A3B scales and evaluate it from three complementary perspectives: comprehensive benchmark suites including Capek-StateBench, a new benchmark for state verification; a controlled study of capability retention from specialists to the unified model; and closed-loop evaluation in simulated embodied environments. Capek 0.5 improves the large majority of matched benchmark rows over its initialization, retains all four specialized capabilities in one checkpoint with quantified losses, and transfers to closed-loop embodied task execution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Capek 0.5，一个以执行为中心的具身视觉语言模型 (embodied vision-language model)。模型基于执行中心的能力分类法 (execution-centric capability taxonomy)，将具身能力分为空间推理、时间理解、动作引导和状态验证四类，先通过带可验证奖励的强化学习分别训练专家，再用权重空间合并与路由策略空间蒸馏整合为单一推理时模型。作者在 2B 和 35B-A3B 规模上实例化模型，并引入状态验证基准 Capek-StateBench，从基准测试、能力保留研究和闭环仿真环境三方面评估。
Motivation: 机器人执行本质上是迭代的，每次动作都会改变场景和物理状态，需要持续感知、推理和验证，这些能力在监督信号、预测格式和验证标准上各不相同。现有方法通常针对孤立的、任务特定的目标开发这些能力，缺乏围绕执行整体来组织和集成它们的方式。
Method: 提出以执行为中心的具身能力分类法，将能力分为 Spatial Reasoning、Temporal Understanding、Action Guidance、State Verification 四个家族。每个能力先由共享骨干网络上的专用专家通过带可验证奖励的强化学习获得，随后通过权重空间合并 (weight-space merging) 和路由策略空间蒸馏 (routed policy-space distillation) 将专家整合为单个推理时模型。
Result: 摘要报告 Capek 0.5 在大多数匹配的基准行上优于其初始化，在一个检查点中保留全部四种专业化能力且有量化损失，并能迁移到闭环具身任务执行。评估包括综合基准套件（含新的状态验证基准 Capek-StateBench）、从专家到统一模型的能力保留受控研究，以及模拟具身环境中的闭环评估。
Conclusion: 作者认为，按功能角色而非数据集或任务组织能力、并通过专家整合得到统一推理时模型，能够使具身 VLM 在保留多种能力的同时支持闭环执行。摘要未明示局限性。

papers.title: Mind the Gap: A Dual Knowledge Graph Framework for Unified Multi-task User Intent Inference
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes DKG-MTI, a dual knowledge graph framework for unified multi-task user intent inference from online travel reviews. Existing approaches often rely on hierarchical pipelines that suffer from error propagation or retrieval methods that ignore structural relationships in domain knowledge. To address these limitations, we introduce an inference-only knowledge augmentation framework that dynamically constructs a User-Specific Intent Knowledge Graph from each review and aligns it with a Global Hotel Knowledge Graph through structure-aware semantic smoothing. The aligned knowledge is combined with the original review and processed by a large language model to simultaneously predict aspect ratings and generate reverse user intent statements. Experiments on TripAdvisor reviews show that DKG-MTI consistently outperforms strong LLM and retrieval-based baselines in both classification and intent generation tasks, demonstrating the effectiveness of structure-aware knowledge alignment for scalable and explainable intent inference.

papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the Pacific Asia Conference on Information Systems (PACIS 2026), Paper 12, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DKG-MTI，一个用于在线旅游评论统一多任务用户意图推断的双知识图谱框架。该框架从每条评论动态构建用户特定意图知识图谱（User-Specific Intent Knowledge Graph），并通过结构感知语义平滑（structure-aware semantic smoothing）与全局酒店知识图谱（Global Hotel Knowledge Graph）对齐，再将对齐后的知识与原始评论输入大语言模型，同时预测方面评分并生成反向用户意图陈述。在 TripAdvisor 评论上的实验表明，DKG-MTI 在分类和意图生成任务上均一致优于强 LLM 与检索式基线。
Motivation: 现有方法要么依赖容易产生错误传播的分层流水线，要么采用忽略领域知识中结构关系的检索方法，难以同时做好用户意图分类与生成。
Method: 提出仅推理（inference-only）的知识增强框架：动态构建用户特定意图知识图谱并与全局酒店知识图谱进行结构感知语义平滑对齐，将融合后的知识与原始评论文本交给大语言模型并行处理，以联合完成方面评分预测和反向用户意图语句生成。
Result: 在 TripAdvisor 评论数据上，DKG-MTI 在分类和意图生成两类任务上都稳定优于强 LLM 基线和基于检索的基线，验证了结构感知知识对齐的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调结构感知的知识对齐能够在不引入额外训练流水线的情况下，为可扩展且可解释的用户意图推断带来一致提升。

papers.title: Beyond Starry Night: Shortcut-Aware Control-State Planning for Artist-Grounded Text to Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Artist-grounded image generation requires more than appending an artist name to a prompt. Image models often respond to artist names through canonical shortcuts, such as recurring motifs, generic palettes, or overrepresented period signatures, rather than preserving the user's intended scene. We introduce Atelier, a shortcut-aware control-state planning framework for artist-grounded image generation. Atelier translates underspecified artistic intent into an explicit control state that separates scene anchors, preserve/transform decisions, style-regime hypotheses, role-bound artist evidence, and shortcut-avoidance constraints. It grounds this state using artist-level knowledge and local patch references, compiles backend-aware generation plans, and iteratively refines candidates through global and local authenticity feedback. We further introduce ArtIntentBench, a benchmark covering Van Gogh and Qi Baishi across artwork re-rendering, period/style-controlled generation, historically unseen subjects, shortcut auditing, and human preference evaluation. Across open-weight and closed-source generators, Atelier improves artist-level style fidelity, preserves source structure more faithfully, and substantially reduces shortcut substitution compared with prompt-engineered, retrieval-augmented, and general-purpose agent baselines. These results suggest that artist-grounded generation is bottlenecked not only by image synthesis, but by the upstream inference of explicit, evidence-grounded artistic controls.
papers.comment: 47 pages, 13 figures, including appendices. Kuan Xing and Ye Wang contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对艺术家风格图像生成中模型倾向于走捷径（如重复母题、通用色调、时代签名）而忽略用户场景的问题，提出 Atelier 框架。Atelier 将模糊的艺术意图翻译为显式控制状态，区分场景锚点、保留/变换决策、风格体制假设、角色绑定证据与避开捷径的约束，并借助画家级知识与局部 patch 参考进行落地，编译后端感知的生成计划，通过全局与局部真实性反馈迭代优化候选。作者还引入 ArtIntentBench 基准，覆盖梵高与齐白石的画作重渲染、时期/风格控制生成、历史未见主体、捷径审计与人类偏好评估。
Motivation: 艺术家名称常常通过模型中的经典捷径响应，而不是保持用户预期的画面内容，导致生成结果偏离意图；作者认为问题不仅在于图像合成本身，更在于缺乏显式、有证据支撑的艺术控制推理。
Method: 提出 Atelier，一种面向艺术家接地图像生成的捷径感知控制状态规划框架：将未明确表达的艺术意图转化为包含场景锚点、保留/变换决策、风格体制假设、角色绑定艺术家证据和避开捷径约束的显式控制状态；利用艺术家级知识与局部 patch 参考进行接地，生成后端感知计划，并通过全局与局部真实性反馈迭代修正候选。
Result: 在开源权重与闭源生成器上，Atelier 相比提示工程、检索增强和通用智能体基线，提升了艺术家级风格保真度，更忠实地保留源结构，并显著减少捷径替换；评测基于新引入的 ArtIntentBench 基准。
Conclusion: 作者认为艺术家接地生成的主要瓶颈不在图像合成，而在上游对显式、有证据支撑的艺术控制的推理。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Progressive Content Refinement with Decaying Reward Joint LinUCB
papers.abstract_en: Iterative refinement has significantly enhanced Large Language Model (LLM) performance; however, existing methods ranging from feedback-based Self-Refine to traditional bandit approaches often rely on static options or overlook the saturation effect. This neglect leads to over-exploitation, where the continuous use of identical prompts or arms results in diminishing rewards over time. To address this challenge, we propose a novel contextual bandit algorithm that explicitly incorporates reward decay modeling. Utilizing an Expectation-Maximization (EM) algorithm, our method simultaneously estimates both arm-specific and decay parameters. Furthermore, by embedding prompts as arms, we facilitate the joint learning of arm values, distinguishing our approach from the traditional disjoint Linear Upper Confidence Bound (LinUCB) framework. Experimental results on Sentiment Reversal and GSM8K benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves significant performance gains over strong baselines. Finally, our ablation study confirms that the integration of reward decay modeling within the bandit framework is crucial for mitigating over-exploitation and optimizing the iterative refinement process.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 LLM 迭代细化中的过利用 (over-exploitation) 问题，提出一种显式建模奖励衰减 (reward decay) 的上下文赌博机算法。该方法用 EM 算法同时估计臂特定参数和衰减参数，并将提示 (prompt) 嵌入为臂，实现臂值的联合学习，区别于传统的独立 LinUCB。在 Sentiment Reversal 和 GSM8K 基准上，该方法相比强基线取得显著性能提升，消融实验证实奖励衰减建模对缓解过利用至关重要。
Motivation: 现有迭代细化方法如 Self-Refine 和传统赌博机方法要么依赖静态选项，要么忽略饱和效应 (saturation effect)，导致持续使用相同提示或臂时奖励递减，产生过利用问题。
Method: 提出一种新的上下文赌博机算法，显式加入奖励衰减建模；使用期望最大化 (EM) 算法联合估计臂特定参数与衰减参数，并把提示作为臂以联合学习臂值，从而扩展传统独立 LinUCB 框架。
Result: 在 Sentiment Reversal 和 GSM8K 两个基准上的实验表明，该方法相对强基线取得显著性能提升。
Conclusion: 消融实验确认，将奖励衰减建模整合进赌博机框架是缓解过利用并优化迭代细化过程的关键。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: KReF: Training-Free Retrieval for Long-Term Time-Series Forecasting and Predictive Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: Probabilistic long-term time-series forecasting commonly relies on trained models. Training-free conformal methods typically construct intervals around a pre-existing point forecaster and do not natively represent a complete predictive distribution; sequential variants additionally suffer from increasingly delayed feedback at long horizons. We propose KReF, a training-free retrieval framework that treats retrieved historical futures as a querylocal empirical predictive distribution. After robust preprocessing, KReF embeds each lookback using handcrafted statistics or frozen random Fourier features and retrieves similar historical lookback-future pairs. Their similarity weights directly define predictive masses, quantiles, CRPS, and a weighted-mean point forecast. KReF further uses the observed query lookback to construct a probability-integral-transform map and applies validation-selected expansion and shrinkage rates to adapt interval boundaries. Across six LTSF benchmarks and four horizons, KReF obtains the lowest CRPS in all 12 dataset-embedding settings and the lowest IS90 in 9 settings. Without gradient-based fitting, its point forecasts also match or surpass trained baselines on two of six datasets. An archive-oracle analysis further reveals substantial headroom under finer horizon- and channel-wise routing. These results establish retrieval as a useful and underexplored inductive bias for LTSF.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 KReF，一个免训练 (training-free) 的检索框架，用于概率性长期时间序列预测 (probabilistic long-term time-series forecasting)。KReF 将检索到的历史 lookback-future 对视为查询局部的经验预测分布，用相似度权重直接定义预测质量、分位数、CRPS 和加权均值点预测，并通过概率积分变换映射和验证集选择的扩张/收缩率调整区间边界。在六个 LTSF 基准和四个预测时长上，KReF 在所有 12 个 dataset-embedding 设置中取得最低 CRPS，并在 9 个设置中取得最低 IS90。
Motivation: 概率性长期时间序列预测通常依赖训练好的模型，而免训练 conformal 方法只能围绕既有逐点预测器构造区间，无法原生表示完整的预测分布；顺序变体在长预测时长上还会受到越来越延迟的反馈影响。
Method: KReF 先进行稳健预处理，用手工统计量或冻结的随机傅里叶特征 (random Fourier features) 对每个 lookback 进行嵌入，检索相似的历史 lookback-future 对；其相似度权重直接定义预测质量、分位数、CRPS 和加权均值点预测。此外，KReF 利用观测到的查询 lookback 构造概率积分变换 (probability-integral-transform, PIT) 映射，并应用验证集选择的扩张和收缩率来调整区间边界。
Result: 在六个 LTSF 基准和四个预测时长上，KReF 在所有 12 个 dataset-embedding 设置中获得最低 CRPS，在 9 个设置中获得最低 IS90；无需基于梯度的拟合，其点预测在六个数据集中的两个上达到或超过训练基线。archive-oracle 分析还表明，在更细的预测时长维度和通道维度路由下存在显著提升空间。
Conclusion: 摘要将检索确立为 LTSF 中一种有用且未被充分探索的归纳偏置 (inductive bias)。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: MemPrism: Task-Conditioned Relational Memory Views for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon agents rely on memory to reuse experiences, yet existing memory systems often assume that evidence can be directly consumed through a fixed representation. This leads to representation mismatch, where relevant information is available but not organized for the current decision. To this end, we propose MemPrism, a task-conditioned relational memory framework that separates persistent experience storage from decision-time working memory. MemPrism records interactions as the event stream and dynamically constructs relational views according to the current task context. A lightweight view policy selects the relation structure, evidence range, outcome condition, and granularity, while a deterministic composer and render transform historical facts into a temporary optical working-memory view for a frozen task policy. Experiments on long-horizon embodied and web-agent benchmarks show that MemPrism consistently improves the task performance, especially as trajectories become longer, while reducing memory token consumption. Furthermore, the learned view policy transfers across different VLMs without additional adaptation, demonstrating the effectiveness of task-conditioned relational views as a general memory interface for agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MemPrism，一个面向长时程智能体 (long-horizon agents) 的任务条件关系记忆框架，将持久经验存储与决策时工作记忆分离。MemPrism 以事件流记录交互，并根据当前任务上下文动态构建关系视图；一个轻量视图策略选择关系结构、证据范围、结果条件与粒度，确定性组合器与渲染器将历史事实转换为临时的工作记忆视图，供冻结的任务策略使用。实验表明该方法在长时程具身与网页智能体基准上持续提升任务表现，随轨迹变长收益更明显，同时降低记忆 token 消耗，且学到的视图策略可跨不同 VLM 迁移。
Motivation: 现有记忆系统通常假设证据可通过固定表示直接消费，导致表示不匹配 (representation mismatch) 问题：相关信息虽然存在，但未按当前决策需求组织，限制了长时程智能体对经验的复用。
Method: MemPrism 将持久经验存储（事件流）与决策时工作记忆分离，通过轻量视图策略选择关系结构、证据范围、结果条件和粒度，并由确定性组合器与渲染器把历史事实转化为临时的光学工作记忆视图，供冻结的任务策略直接使用。
Result: 在长时程具身与网页智能体基准上，MemPrism 一致提升任务表现，轨迹越长提升越明显，同时减少记忆 token 消耗；学到的视图策略无需额外适应即可迁移到不同 VLM。
Conclusion: 作者认为任务条件关系视图可作为智能体通用记忆接口，其有效性体现在跨 VLM 迁移与长轨迹下的性能增益上。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Solver-Guided Reasoning for Mixed-Equilibrium Strategies
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning in large language models (LLMs) is often grounded in human text, human demonstrations, and human-generated rationales. For equilibrium reasoning in complex games, however, relying on human data can be suboptimal. In fact, human play is often guided by intuition and heuristics and can deviate substantially from game equilibrium. This discrepancy is amplified in games with mixed-strategy equilibria, where human data is heavily biased toward pure strategies. Consequently, conditioning LLMs on this data yields weak game strategies. To grant LLMs the reasoning capacity in games, in this work, we study how to elicit equilibrium play using solver output. We propose Mixed-Strategy Decision Tree (MDT), which articulates the silent optimality of the equilibrium into sparse strategic rules that both humans and LLMs could understand. Using solver output rather than human annotation allows us to extend the input to arbitrarily new states and continuations. We instantiate this study on No-Limit Texas Hold'em by querying a solver oracle for over \textbf{250 million mixed-strategy decisions}; MDT together with other techniques \textbf{reduces the $\ell_1$ distance to the equilibrium by $52.6\%$} across $8$ different LLM configurations. A Route-only ablation tests the incremental contribution of the shadow-based contrast, while complete River-endgame and Liar's Dice experiments evaluate strategic fidelity and portability beyond the original NLH communication setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何用求解器输出而非人类数据来引导大语言模型在复杂博弈中进行均衡推理。作者提出混合策略决策树 (Mixed-Strategy Decision Tree, MDT)，将均衡的隐性最优性转化为稀疏策略规则，并在无限制德州扑克中查询求解器 oracle 获得超过 2.5 亿个混合策略决策。摘要报告 MDT 结合其他技术在 8 种 LLM 配置下将到均衡的 L1 距离降低 52.6%，并通过 River-endgame 和 Liar's Dice 实验评估其策略保真度与可移植性。
Motivation: LLM 的推理通常基于人类文本、演示和理由，但人类游戏常受直觉和启发式支配，会显著偏离博弈均衡；在混合策略均衡中人类数据尤其偏向纯策略，导致以人类数据训练的 LLM 产生较弱的博弈策略。
Method: 提出 Mixed-Strategy Decision Tree (MDT)，将均衡的隐性最优性组织为稀疏且人类与 LLM 可理解的策略规则。使用求解器输出而非人工标注以支持任意新状态和后续扩展，并在 No-Limit Texas Hold'em 上通过查询求解器 oracle 实例化研究。
Result: 摘要报告在 8 种不同 LLM 配置下，MDT 结合其他技术将到均衡的 L1 距离降低 52.6%；Route-only 消融检验了基于 shadow-based contrast 的增量贡献，完整的 River-endgame 和 Liar's Dice 实验用于评估策略保真度及超出原始 NLH 通信设置的迁移性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调使用求解器输出替代人类数据能够为 LLM 注入博弈中的均衡推理能力，并显著缩小与均衡的差距。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究如何用求解器输出而非人类数据来引导大语言模型在复杂博弈中进行均衡推理。作者提出混合策略决策树 (Mixed-Strategy Decision Tree, MDT)，将均衡的隐性最优性转化为稀疏策略规则，并在无限制德州扑克中查询求解器 oracle 获得超过 2.5 亿个混合策略决策。摘要报告 MDT 结合其他技术在 8 种 LLM 配置下将到均衡的 L1 距离降低 52.6%，并通过 River-endgame 和 Liar's Dice 实验评估其策略保真度与可移植性。

papers.title: IB-RL: Isolated Bilateral Reinforcement Learning for Strategic Dialogue Agents
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has achieved strong results in improving large language models (LLMs) on tasks with stationary, verifiable rewards, such as mathematical reasoning and code execution. In these settings, the environment follows fixed rules and does not adapt strategically to the agent. Strategic dialogue differs in this respect: the environment is another agent that adapts to the policy, and success depends on the interaction between the two sides. Despite this interactive nature, current RL approaches typically train a target agent against a fixed counterpart or simulator. We find that this training paradigm encourages the policy to exploit counterpart-specific regularities rather than learn strategies that generalize across counterparts. We call this problem the static-counterpart mismatch, which we quantify directly in our experiments. To address it, we propose Isolated Bilateral Reinforcement Learning (IB-RL), in which the two roles coevolve through joint rollouts while each role optimizes its own reward through fully independent advantages, action masks, and update paths. We evaluate frozen policies against fully independent held-out counterparts in both domains. On Vehicle TeleSales, IB-RL achieves 89.6% Success@1, compared to 84.6% for the best unilateral RL baseline. On Deal-or-NoDeal, it reaches 98.4% agreement against DeepSeek V4 Pro, compared to 86.4% for the best unilateral baseline. These results indicate that jointly training both roles with strict peragent isolation produces policies that generalize more effectively to unseen counterparts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对战略对话中强化学习（RL）训练时环境为固定对手或模拟器的问题，提出 Isolated Bilateral Reinforcement Learning (IB-RL)：两个角色通过联合 rollout 共同进化，但各自使用完全独立的优势、动作掩码和更新路径优化自身奖励。在 Vehicle TeleSales 和 Deal-or-NoDeal 两个领域，用冻结策略对抗完全独立的 held-out 对手评估，IB-RL 分别达到 89.6% Success@1 和 98.4% agreement，优于最佳单边 RL baseline。
Motivation: 现有 RL 方法在战略对话中通常针对固定对手或模拟器训练目标智能体，导致策略利用对手特定规律而非学习跨对手泛化的策略。作者将这一问题称为 static-counterpart mismatch（静态对手失配），并在实验中直接量化了它。
Method: 提出 Isolated Bilateral Reinforcement Learning (IB-RL)，两个角色在联合 rollouts 中共同进化（coevolve），但每个角色通过完全独立的优势（advantages）、动作掩码（action masks）和更新路径（update paths）优化自身奖励，实现严格的按智能体隔离。
Result: 在 Vehicle TeleSales 上，IB-RL 取得 89.6% Success@1，最佳单边 RL baseline 为 84.6%；在 Deal-or-NoDeal 上，IB-RL 对 DeepSeek V4 Pro 取得 98.4% agreement，最佳单边 baseline 为 86.4%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，对两个角色进行严格的按智能体隔离的联合训练，可以产生对未见对手泛化更有效的策略。

papers.title: From Cheap Fakes to Pure Synthesis: Addressing the New Era of T2V Fake News Videos
papers.abstract_en: Recent text-to-video (T2V) generation models enable fake news videos to be synthesized from scratch, shifting the threat beyond cheap fakes assembled from existing footage. Such news videos can closely match fabricated narratives, creating a modality alignment trap for existing detectors. Existing datasets lack pure synthesis fake news videos. Although directly prompting T2V models with descriptions of fake news videos can yield perfectly aligned samples, it reduces the fake news video detection (FNVD) to unimodal shortcuts and causes semantic-visual degeneration. To counter this, we formulate T2V-FNVD as a novel ternary classification task with three labels (real, cheap fake, and pure synthesis fake) and construct the first pure synthesis fake news video dataset (PS-FNVD). PS-FNVD includes fabricated events with aligned deception (Type 1) and true events with false visual provenance (Type 2), preventing models from exploiting unimodal shortcuts. Furthermore, we propose the Reasoning-guided T2V-FNVD (R-T2V) framework. Trained through conditioned rationale generation and supervised fine-tuning, R-T2V integrates high-level semantic logic with low-level physical generative traces to predict the ternary veracity label. Extensive experiments across 10 prevailing baselines show that R-T2V achieves the state-of-the-art performance, outperforming the second-best baseline by 12.20 percentage points in accuracy and 8.46 percentage points in macro $F_1$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对文本到视频（T2V）生成模型带来的全新假新闻视频威胁，将假新闻视频检测（FNVD）重新定义为三分类任务（真实、廉价伪造、纯合成伪造），并构建首个纯合成伪造新闻视频数据集 PS-FNVD。作者提出 Reasoning-guided T2V-FNVD（R-T2V）框架，通过条件化理由生成和监督微调，将高层语义逻辑与低层物理生成痕迹结合来预测三元真实性标签。在 10 个主流基线上，R-T2V 达到最优性能。
Motivation: 现有 T2V 生成模型能从零合成伪造新闻视频，超越基于已有素材组装的 cheap fakes，并使现有检测器陷入模态对齐陷阱；同时现有数据集缺乏纯合成伪造样本，而直接提示 T2V 模型生成又会把检测退化为单模态捷径并造成语义-视觉退化。
Method: 将 T2V-FNVD 建模为三元分类任务，构建包含两类造假样本（Type 1：对齐欺骗的虚构事件；Type 2：真实事件但视觉来源错误）的数据集 PS-FNVD。提出 R-T2V 框架，通过条件化理由生成（conditioned rationale generation）和监督微调训练，整合高层语义逻辑与低层物理生成痕迹来预测真实性标签。
Result: 在 10 个主流基线上的广泛实验显示，R-T2V 取得最优性能，准确率比第二好的基线高 12.20 个百分点，宏 F1 高 8.46 个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调纯合成伪造新闻视频需要新的三分类范式以及同时利用语义逻辑和生成痕迹的检测框架，PS-FNVD 与 R-T2V 为这一方向提供了首个数据集和领先方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AtlasVLA: Persistent World-Ego State Modeling for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have advanced embodied AI, their fundamentally reactive paradigm severely limits performance in partially observable and long-horizon tasks. When restricted to a single wrist-mounted camera, they inevitably suffer from perception forgetting as objects exit the field of view, and temporal task-progress forgetting} during multi-step execution. To overcome these bottlenecks, we propose AtlasVLA, a novel framework that transitions from direct reactive manipulation to proactive reasoning through a persistent world-ego state. AtlasVLA features a dual-memory architecture: a 4D Persistent World State Memory that lifts transient 2D observations into a globally updated, voxel-hashed spatial state to resolve visual blind spots, and an Ego-Working State Memory that tracks historical ego state and task progress. By conditioning a diffusion transformer (DiT) on this joint World-Ego state, AtlasVLA enables robust spatial reasoning. Extensive evaluations across LIBERO, RLBench, and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that AtlasVLA achieves state-of-the-art performance using solely a wrist camera. Remarkably, it decisively outperforms multi-view baselines, yielding absolute success rate improvements of 9.4% on LIBERO-Long and 17.5% in real-world long-horizon tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AtlasVLA，一个面向视觉-语言-动作模型 (VLA) 的框架，将直接反应式操作转为基于持久世界-自我状态 (persistent world-ego state) 的主动推理。它采用双记忆架构：4D 持久世界状态记忆 (4D Persistent World State Memory) 用体素哈希空间状态缓解视觉盲区，自我工作状态记忆 (Ego-Working State Memory) 跟踪历史自我状态和任务进度，并以扩散 Transformer (DiT) 条件化联合状态。在 LIBERO、RLBench 和真实世界基准上，仅用腕部相机即达到 SOTA，绝对成功率超多视角基线 9.4% (LIBERO-Long) 和 17.5% (真实长程任务)。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型本质上是反应式 (reactive) 的，在部分可观测和长程任务中性能受限；仅用腕部相机时，物体会离开视野导致感知遗忘，多步执行中还会发生时间任务进度遗忘。
Method: 提出双记忆架构：4D 持久世界状态记忆将瞬时 2D 观测提升为全局更新的体素哈希空间状态以解决视觉盲区；自我工作状态记忆跟踪历史自我状态与任务进度；用扩散 Transformer (DiT) 对联合世界-自我状态进行条件化，实现空间推理。
Result: 在 LIBERO、RLBench 和真实世界基准上的评估表明，仅使用腕部相机即取得 SOTA 结果，并显著优于多视角基线：LIBERO-Long 绝对成功率提升 9.4%，真实世界长程任务提升 17.5%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调从反应式操作转向基于持久世界-自我状态的主动推理，能够克服单腕部相机场景下的感知遗忘与任务进度遗忘，为 VLA 在长程部分可观测任务中提供更鲁棒的空间推理。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: bioMoR: Biology-Guided Mixture-of-Recursions for Effective Genomic Learning
papers.abstract_en: Transformer models for high-dimensional omics analysis process thousands of genes or pathways, although only a subset requires deep computation. Mixture-of-Recursions (MoR) improves efficiency through adaptive token-choice or expert-choice routing. We propose bioMoR, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first framework to apply MoR to gene-level and pathway-level learning. Our contributions include identifying three locations for integrating structured biological knowledge within an MoR backbone: graph-based information sharing refines token embeddings, a structural bias guides self-attention toward biologically related tokens, and a graph-aware router uses neighborhood information to determine each token's recursion depth. These techniques are centered on our insight that additional knowledge of token interaction can effectively help models construct embeddings and select which tokens should be learned more deeply. Across eight benchmarks spanning diverse omics data types and evaluated under a unified five-fold cross-validation protocol, bioMoR improves average macro-F1 by 8.2 percentage points and balanced accuracy by 7.1 percentage points over the strongest biology-agnostic MoR baseline while using 75 percent fewer parameters and up to 58 percent fewer FLOPs than a non-recursive Transformer. The selected marker genes or pathways provide biological interpretability, while their token-specific recursion depths reveal how computation is allocated.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 bioMoR，据作者称是首个将 Mixture-of-Recursions (MoR) 应用于基因级和通路级组学学习的框架。MoR 通过自适应的 token-choice 或 expert-choice 路由提升计算效率；bioMoR 在 MoR 骨干中融入结构化生物学知识，具体包括三个集成位置：基于图的信息共享细化 token 嵌入、引导自注意力关注生物学相关 token 的结构偏置、以及利用邻域信息决定每个 token 递归深度的图感知路由器。在八个涵盖多种组学数据类型的基准上、统一五折交叉验证协议下，bioMoR 相比最强的生物学无关 MoR 基线平均 macro-F1 提升 8.2 个百分点、balanced accuracy 提升 7.1 个百分点，同时比非递归 Transformer 少 75% 参数和最多 58% FLOPs。
Motivation: 高维组学分析中的 Transformer 会对数千个基因或通路都进行深度计算，但实际上只有其中一部分需要深度计算；现有 MoR 尚未被应用到基因级与通路级学习。作者的核心观察是，关于 token 交互的额外结构知识能帮助模型更好地构建嵌入，并决定哪些 token 需要更深入的学习。
Method: 提出 bioMoR，在 MoR 骨干的三个位置集成结构化生物学知识：图基信息共享用于细化 token 嵌入；结构偏置引导自注意力集中于生物学相关的 token 对；图感知路由器利用邻域信息判断每个 token 的递归深度。
Result: 在八个组学基准、统一五折交叉验证下，bioMoR 相对最强的生物学无关 MoR 基线平均 macro-F1 提高 8.2 个百分点、balanced accuracy 提高 7.1 个百分点，且相比非递归 Transformer 参数减少 75%、FLOPs 最多减少 58%；选出的标记基因或通路提供生物学可解释性，token 特定的递归深度揭示计算资源的分配方式。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将 token 交互的结构知识引入 MoR 的路由与嵌入可以同时改善组学学习的性能与效率，并带来可解释的标记基因/通路选择和递归深度分配。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 在八个组学基准、统一五折交叉验证下，bioMoR 相对最强的生物学无关 MoR 基线平均 macro-F1 提高 8.2 个百分点、balanced accuracy 提高 7.1 个百分点，且相比非递归 Transformer 参数减少 75%、FLOPs 最多减少 58%；选出的标记基因或通路提供生物学可解释性，token 特定的递归深度揭示计算资源的分配方式。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调，将 token 交互的结构知识引入 MoR 的路由与嵌入可以同时改善组学学习的性能与效率，并带来可解释的标记基因/通路选择和递归深度分配。

papers.title: Multi-Level Modeling of Large Language Model Inference Latency and Energy via Hybrid Analytical--Machine-Learning Predictors
papers.abstract_en: The rapid scaling of Large Language Models (LLMs) has significantly increased computational cost, energy consumption, and inference latency, making accurate estimation essential for sustainable artificial intelligence deployment and hardware-aware design. In this work, we introduce Hybrid Modeling for Energy and Latency of LLMs (HYMELL), a hybrid three-level framework for estimating LLM inference latency and energy by combining analytical modeling with machine learning (ML). HYMELL models LLM execution through a three-level hierarchy: analytical estimation of primitive operations, ML prediction of higher-level components, and an end-to-end model that captures system-level overheads across both prefill and decode phases. The framework supports diverse architectures, including dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) feed-forward networks (FFNs), as well as multi-head attention (MHA) and grouped-query attention (GQA) mechanisms. Evaluated on an NVIDIA H100 graphics processing unit (GPU), HYMELL achieves high predictive accuracy; notably, for LLaMA 3 8B, it attains less than 5% error for both prefill and decode phases. By predicting execution costs directly from architectural parameters, it enables fast, hardware-free design space exploration and energy-efficient optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HYMELL，一个三层混合框架，将解析建模与机器学习结合，用于估计 LLM 推理延迟与能耗。框架按三层层级建模：原始操作（primitive operations）的解析估计、高层组件的 ML 预测，以及覆盖 prefill 与 decode 阶段的端到端系统开销模型。在 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上评估时，对 LLaMA 3 8B 的 prefill 与 decode 阶段误差均低于 5%。
Motivation: LLM 的快速扩展显著提高了计算成本、能耗与推理延迟，准确估计对于可持续 AI 部署和硬件感知设计至关重要。
Method: 提出 HYMELL 混合三层框架：底层对原始操作进行解析估计，中层用机器学习预测高层组件，顶层用端到端模型捕获系统级开销，并同时覆盖 prefill 和 decode 阶段；框架支持多种架构，包括稠密与 MoE 前馈网络（FFN）以及 MHA 与 GQA 注意力机制。
Result: 在 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上，HYMELL 达到高预测精度；对 LLaMA 3 8B，prefill 与 decode 两个阶段的误差均小于 5%。
Conclusion: 通过直接从架构参数预测执行成本，该方法支持快速、无需硬件的设计空间探索与能耗优化。

papers.title: WaveFreqAnchor: Wave-Structural Anchoring and Frequency Correction Diffusion for Training-Free Face Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based face restoration that adjusts the sampling trajectory of pre-trained diffusion models has achieved remarkable progress. However, existing approaches provide insufficient constraints during reverse diffusion, causing identity-related structural drift and degraded fidelity under severe degradations. To address this, we propose WaveFreqAnchor, a training-free framework based on Wave-Structural Anchoring and Frequency Correction Diffusion. Specifically, Anchor-Space Wave-Structural Guidance (ASWG) constrains facial structures through anisotropic wave-response consistency, while Multi-scale Wavelet-Fourier Injection (MWFI) aligns the predicted low-frequency subband with the observation by replacing its phase, correcting inconsistencies accumulated during reverse diffusion. For real-world scenes, we further introduce Subband High-Frequency Enhancement (SHE), which performs bounded, spatially masked refinement on the predicted high-frequency subbands to recover fine facial details under unknown compound degradations. Together, these designs effectively preserve facial identity while restoring sharp and realistic facial details. Extensive experiments show that our method consistently outperforms existing methods, achieving high-quality and high-fidelity face restoration.
papers.comment: training-free wavelet-structural diffusion sampling framework for face restoration that improves structural stability, identity consistency, and real-world perceptual quality without task-specific fine-tuning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WaveFreqAnchor，一个无需训练 (training-free) 的扩散采样框架，用于人脸修复。它通过波结构锚定与频率校正来约束预训练扩散模型的逆向采样轨迹，包含 Anchor-Space Wave-Structural Guidance (ASWG)、Multi-scale Wavelet-Fourier Injection (MWFI) 和 Subband High-Frequency Enhancement (SHE) 三个模块。摘要称该方法在保持身份一致性的同时恢复清晰真实的人脸细节，并在实验中一致优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有基于扩散的人脸修复方法在逆向扩散过程中约束不足，导致严重退化下出现身份相关的结构漂移 (identity-related structural drift) 和保真度下降。
Method: 提出 ASWG，通过各向异性波响应一致性约束人脸结构；提出 MWFI，用观测的低频子带相位替换预测相位以对齐低频信息；针对真实场景引入 SHE，对预测的高频子带进行有界、空间掩蔽的精化以恢复细节。
Result: 摘要报告在广泛实验中人脸修复的质量和保真度一致优于现有方法，未给出具体数值或基准细节。
Conclusion: 该方法在无需任务特定微调的情况下提升了结构稳定性、身份一致性和真实世界感知质量，适用于人脸修复任务；摘要未说明局限性。

papers.title: The Optimizer Is the Agent: Reasoning-Driven Search across Prompts, Programs, and ML Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Recent systems for optimizing prompts, programs, and ML workflows typically rely on explicit outer-loop controllers such as evolutionary search, bandits, or textual-gradient methods. We ask a fundamentally different question: how much of this search policy can be internalized by a single tool-using agent? We present ReASearch, a unified framework for reasoning-driven optimization in which the agent autonomously decides what to evaluate, how to diagnose failures, which edits to make, and when to verify or restart. Rather than serving only as a proposal generator guided by hand-designed heuristics, the agent actively analyzes outcomes, allocates budget, and refines its strategy over long horizons through persistent memory. With a shared agent loop and domain-specific tools, ReASearch instantiates the exact same scaffold to optimize prompts, programs, and ML workflows. Across 14 diverse tasks, it is competitive with and mostly better than specialized optimization systems, achieving gains of 2% to 40% over strong domain-specific baselines, and in some cases discovering solutions that improve on prior human best-known results. Crucially, we observe that complex search behaviors, which are typically implemented by explicit controllers, emerge naturally from the agent's reasoning process.
papers.journal_ref: COLM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReASearch，一个基于推理驱动的统一优化框架，让单一工具使用智能体 (tool-using agent) 内化搜索策略：自主决定评估什么、如何诊断失败、做什么修改、何时验证或重启。该框架用共享的智能体循环和领域特定工具，以相同的脚手架优化提示词、程序和 ML 工作流。在 14 个不同任务上，它相对强领域特定基线取得 2% 到 40% 的提升，并在部分案例中发现优于人类已知最佳结果的方案。作者观察到，通常由显式控制器实现的复杂搜索行为会从智能体的推理过程中自然涌现。
Motivation: 现有优化提示词、程序和 ML 工作流的系统通常依赖显式外层控制器，如进化搜索、bandit 或文本梯度方法。本文追问一个不同的问题：有多少搜索策略可以被单个工具使用智能体内化。
Method: 提出 ReASearch 统一框架：智能体自主决定评估内容、诊断失败、进行编辑并决定验证或重启，通过持久记忆 (persistent memory) 在长时间跨度内分配预算并调整策略。同一智能体循环配合领域特定工具，可分别用于优化提示词、程序和 ML 工作流。
Result: 在 14 个不同任务上，ReASearch 与专门优化系统相比具有竞争力且大多数情况下更优，相对强领域特定基线取得 2% 到 40% 的增益；某些情况下发现的方法还改进了先前人类已知的最佳结果。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通常由显式控制器实现的复杂搜索行为可以从智能体的推理过程中自然涌现，表明将搜索策略内部化于单一智能体是可行且有效的方向。

papers.title: MolBioKG: Grounding Out-of-Graph Molecules in Biomedical Knowledge Graphs via Multi-Resolution Structural Anchoring
papers.abstract_en: Biomedical knowledge graphs (KGs) accelerate drug discovery, but standard pipelines assume query molecules already exist as graph entities, leaving unregistered molecules disconnected. We address this cold-start challenge, termed the out-of-graph molecule problem, by introducing MolBioKG. This two-layer system grounds unseen molecules in biomedical evidence via multi-resolution structural anchoring. It connects an index of 2.74 million molecules (represented by scaffolds, fragments, functional groups, and fingerprints) to a 9.6-million-edge KG. Given only a SMILES string, MolBioKG retrieves structurally related graph entities and traverses their biomedical neighborhoods without task-specific training. It features two inference mechanisms: static multi-anchor retrieval using Reciprocal Rank Fusion, and Adapt-KG, a tool-using LLM policy for adaptive traversal. Evaluated across in-graph link recovery, complex multi-hop reasoning, and out-of-graph generalization, MolBioKG outperforms strong baselines. Notably, it raises Hits@10 from 0.585 to 0.876 in multi-hop reasoning and out-of-graph target recall from 0.145 to 0.269, all while ensuring predictions retain traceable structural anchors and source-attributed KG evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MolBioKG，一个用于解决 out-of-graph 分子问题的两层系统，通过多分辨率结构锚定（multi-resolution structural anchoring）将未见分子接入生物医学知识图谱。系统连接包含 274 万个分子（以 scaffold、fragment、官能团和指纹表示）的索引与一个 960 万条边的知识图谱；仅给定 SMILES 字符串即可检索结构相关的图实体并遍历其生物医学邻域，无需任务专属训练。系统包含两种推理机制：基于 Reciprocal Rank Fusion 的静态多锚点检索，以及名为 Adapt-KG 的工具调用 LLM 策略用于自适应遍历。摘要报告其在图内链接恢复、复杂多跳推理和 out-of-graph 泛化上优于强基线。
Motivation: 现有生物医学知识图谱管线假设查询分子已经是图实体，导致未注册分子与图谱脱节；这种冷启动问题被称为 out-of-graph molecule problem，会阻碍药物发现流程。
Method: MolBioKG 采用两层结构：以多分辨率分子表示（scaffolds、fragments、functional groups、fingerprints）建立分子索引，再将其与生物医学知识图谱连接。给定 SMILES，系统检索结构相关的图实体并遍历其邻域；推理通过静态多锚点检索（Reciprocal Rank Fusion 融合）和 Adapt-KG（工具使用的 LLM 策略，自适应遍历）两种机制实现，全程无需任务专属训练。
Result: 摘要报告 MolBioKG 在 in-graph link recovery、复杂多跳推理和 out-of-graph generalization 上均优于强基线：多跳推理的 Hits@10 从 0.585 提升到 0.876，out-of-graph 目标召回率从 0.145 提升到 0.269。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 MolBioKG 在保持预测可追溯性（可保留结构锚点和带来源标注的图谱证据）的同时实现性能提升。

papers.title: Suppress and Diversify: Refining Robust Pathways for Corruption Robustness
papers.abstract_en: Model robustness against natural image corruptions is essential for safety-critical applications. While existing methods primarily focus on implicit representation learning, we provide the first systematic exploration of computational pathways to explicitly characterize internal robustness. We identify a progressive decay of robust features across network layers and establish a functional dependency between the prevalence of these features and model performance. To exploit these insights, we propose Suppress and Diversify (S\&D), a non-intrusive refinement approach that enhances robustness by dynamically selecting robust pathways and diversifying them through symmetry-preserving transformations. S\&D is architecture-agnostic, parameter-free, and incurs zero test-time overhead. Extensive evaluations across eight benchmarks demonstrate that S\&D consistently improves performance across multiple vision tasks, diverse backbones, and complex real-world scenarios, highlighting its broad efficacy and scalability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自然图像损坏下的模型鲁棒性，首次系统性地从计算通路（computational pathways）角度显式刻画内部鲁棒性，发现鲁棒特征随网络层加深逐渐衰减，并建立其特征流行度与模型性能之间的函数依赖。作者据此提出 Suppress and Diversify (S&D)，一种非侵入式的鲁棒性精炼方法，通过动态选择鲁棒通路并用保持对称性的变换使其多样化；该方法与架构无关、无参数、测试时零开销。在八个基准上的大量评估显示该方案在多种视觉任务、骨干网络和真实场景中持续提升性能。
Motivation: 现有损坏鲁棒性方法主要依赖隐式表示学习，缺乏对网络内部鲁棒机制的显式刻画；作者希望系统性地探索计算通路，解释鲁棒特征随层深变化与性能之间的关系，从而为鲁棒性提升提供更直接的干预依据。
Method: 提出 Suppress and Diversify (S&D) 精炼方法，动态选择网络中的鲁棒通路（robust pathways），并通过保持对称性的变换（symmetry-preserving transformations）对通路进行多样化。该方法架构无关、无参数，且不引入测试时开销。
Result: 在八个基准上的广泛实验表明，S&D 在多种视觉任务、不同骨干网络以及复杂真实场景中均能一致地提升鲁棒性表现，验证了其广泛有效性与可扩展性。

papers.title: Dueling World Models: Advantage-Style Action Channels for Common-Mode Distractor Rejection
papers.abstract_en: Latent world models plan by predicting future states from an action, but when a scene contains motion the agent does not control, they quietly go action-blind: predictions for different actions become indistinguishable even as the training loss keeps improving. Existing remedies suppress this distraction with reconstruction, task reward, or auxiliary objectives, each adding machinery or assumptions. We show that a minimal alternative suffices, borrowed from the dueling decomposition of value into a state baseline and an action advantage: in latent dynamics, subtracting a prediction's mean effect over actions cancels whatever the actions share--the action-independent variation where distractors live--leaving a clean, controllable channel, with no reward, no reconstruction, and no distractor-specific auxiliary loss. Because this is only a subtraction at readout time, it applies unchanged to any action-conditioned world model, including frozen pretrained ones. Across a gridworld, synthetic generators with known factors, distracting continuous control, and natural-pixel Atari, the isolated channel recovers the agent's own effect where entangled predictors fail, with nuisance leak indistinguishable from zero; applied post hoc it surfaces an action channel in off-the-shelf models that their raw readouts miss, and it converts into goal-reaching control in the gridworld. We prove the cancellation is exact in finite samples for both discrete and sampled action sets, and we state its measured boundary--distractors whose motion tracks the action--together with the remaining limitations in the appendix.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 6 figures, 11 tables. Includes supplementary appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对潜在世界模型 (latent world model) 在场景包含非受控运动时出现的“动作盲”问题，提出一种极简方案：在潜在动力学预测中减去所有动作上的平均效应，即借用价值函数 dueling 分解中的 advantage 通道，从而在读取时消除动作无关的公共干扰 (common-mode distractor)。该方法不需要奖励、重建或干扰物专属的辅助损失，可直接套用于任何动作条件世界模型，包括冻结的预训练模型。作者在网格世界、已知因子的合成生成器、干扰连续控制和自然像素 Atari 上验证了该通道能恢复智能体自身效应，并证明离散与采样动作集下有限样本中的抵消是精确的。
Motivation: 潜在世界模型通过动作预测未来状态来进行规划，但场景中包含不受智能体控制的运动时，模型会悄悄变得动作盲：即使训练损失持续下降，不同动作对应的预测也变得难以区分。现有缓解手段依赖重建、任务奖励或辅助目标，都会增加额外机制或假设。
Method: 受 dueling 分解（将价值拆分为状态基线和动作优势）启发，作者在潜在动力学中对预测结果减去动作上的平均效应，以抵消动作共享的部分——即干扰物所在的与动作无关的变化——从而留下干净、可控的动作通道。该操作仅在读取 (readout) 时进行减法，因此无需改动训练目标，可直接作用于任何动作条件世界模型，包括冻结的预训练模型。
Result: 在网格世界、已知因子的合成生成器、干扰连续控制和自然像素 Atari 上，该隔离通道在纠缠式预测器失效的场景中恢复了智能体自身效应，且干扰泄漏与零不可区分；事后应用还能在现成模型中揭示原始读取缺失的动作通道，并在网格世界中转化为目标到达控制。作者还证明离散与采样动作集下该抵消在有限样本中精确成立，并给出了其边界——动作跟踪式干扰物。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，仅靠读取时的 advantage 式减法即可拒绝常见的公共模式干扰，无需奖励、重建或干扰物专属辅助损失；其适用范围受限于干扰物运动与动作相关的情形，其余局限性在附录中说明。

papers.title: WebRider: Persona-Conditioned Intent Controllers for Live-Web Assistance
papers.abstract_en: Delegating a web task involves more than asking a question; it requires transferring a policy: what to verify, how to handle uncertainty, which preferences matter, and when to stop. Yet, current live-web agents are evaluated solely on the final answer, ignoring the policy constraints that define the delegation. A plausible final answer can conceal violations of that policy. Our full live audit reveals this critical gap: a strong controller completes 99.2% of tasks but honors all policy constraints in only 38.8% of cases. Finishing does not imply fidelity. WebRider bridges this gap by formalizing the delegated policy as an intent contract---an operational record of goals, constraints, evidence obligations, answer form, and task-local persona controls that must hold even as web pages change. WebRider employs a hierarchical architecture: a top-layer controller maintains the contract, a middle layer realizes intentions as guarded executable actions, and a tool layer executes these actions via browser, search, and maps tools. Our benchmark, RiderBench, evaluates this design on 4,096 live-web contracts across 42 public websites, auditing both the internal contract state and the visible user experience to determine if a rollout preserved its policy and if the steps were persona-consistent. The guarded middle interface also serves as a high-quality training signal; an 8B action-policy model trained through this interface outperforms executable-only baselines under a fixed controller. By making the browsing path a first-class object, WebRider enables a system that is auditable, human-judgeable, and learnable without conflating action realization with final-answer decisions. Dataset URL: hf.co/datasets/WebRider/WebRider.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WebRider，一个面向实时网页任务委托的智能体系统。作者认为当前直播网页智能体只按最终答案评估，忽略了任务委托中的策略约束（如验证什么、如何处理不确定性、何时停止）。通过完整直播审计发现，强控制器能完成 99.2% 的任务，但只有 38.8% 的情况满足全部策略约束，说明“完成”不等于“守约”。WebRider 将委托策略形式化为意图契约（intent contract），并采用层级架构来实现可审计、可人工评判且可学习的网页浏览路径。
Motivation: 现有直播网页智能体仅以最终答案作为评价标准，忽视了委托策略中的约束条件，导致看似合理的答案可能掩盖策略违规。作者通过实时审计揭示了这一关键缺口：完成任务并不等于忠实于策略。
Method: WebRider 将委托策略形式化为意图契约，即目标、约束、证据义务、答案形式和任务局部人设控制的运行记录；采用层级架构，顶层控制器维护契约，中间层将意图实现为受防护的可执行动作（guarded executable actions），工具层通过浏览器、搜索和地图工具执行动作。作者还构建了 RiderBench 基准，包含 42 个公开网站上的 4,096 个实时网页契约，并同时审计内部契约状态和可见用户体验。
Result: 审计显示强控制器在 99.2% 的任务上能够完成，但仅在 38.8% 的情况下遵守全部策略约束。通过该受防护的中间接口训练的 8B 动作策略模型，在固定控制器下优于仅基于可执行动作训练的基线。
Conclusion: 将浏览路径作为一等对象，使系统具备可审计性、可人工评判性和可学习性，不必将动作实现与最终答案决策混为一谈。

papers.title: Scalable Long-Horizon Planning with Staggered Updates for Lifelong MAPF
papers.abstract_en: Lifelong Multi-Agent Path Finding (LMAPF) requires generating collision-free paths for large agent fleets under strict real-time constraints. Reactive frameworks such as PIBT and Enhanced PIBT (EPIBT) scale effortlessly to thousands of agents through rule-based, step-by-step coordination but suffer from severe temporal myopia, making them ineffective in scenarios where long-horizon reasoning is essential. RHCR plans windowed paths over multi-step horizons but incurs substantial planning overheads that hinder scalability. TP tackles both challenges by planning only subsets of agents at each timestep, yet its applicability is restricted to highly structured maps. To achieve long-horizon planning at scale across general maps, we propose Path Updates over Staggered Horizons (PUSH), a LMAPF planner capable of coordinating thousands of agents in under a second while planning over multi-step horizons. PUSH combines the key advantages of PIBT, RHCR, and TP. Like TP, PUSH reduces computational complexity by planning only a subset of agents at each timestep using staggered planning windows. Unlike TP, however, PUSH plans RHCR-style windowed paths in general maps without relying on restrictive map assumptions. To maintain high throughput in congested environments, PUSH further integrates EPIBT-inspired priority inheritance, backtracking, and anytime improvements into its windowed planning. Empirical evaluations across two realistic MAPF scenarios requiring long-horizon reasoning show that PUSH scales to the same massive agent loads as EPIBT (e.g., 10k agents) while achieving significantly higher system throughput than all baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PUSH (Path Updates over Staggered Horizons)，一种面向终身多智能体路径规划 (Lifelong MAPF) 的大规模规划器，通过交错规划窗口 (staggered planning windows) 每次只规划一部分智能体，在通用地图上实现多步视野规划。它结合了 PIBT/EPIBT 的轻量协调、RHCR 的窗口式规划和 TP 的子集规划思想，并引入优先级继承、回溯与 anytime 改进。实验显示 PUSH 可协调上万智能体，且在需要长视野推理的两个现实场景中显著提升系统吞吐量。
Motivation: 现有 LMAPF 方法存在权衡困境：PIBT/EPIBT 虽能扩展到数千智能体但视野短浅，RHCR 虽有多步规划但开销大、扩展性差，TP 仅适用于高度结构化地图；因此需要在通用地图上同时实现大规模与长视野规划。
Method: PUSH 借鉴 TP 的思路，在每时间步仅规划部分智能体，但使用交错规划窗口；窗口内采用类似 RHCR 的多步路径规划，不依赖地图结构假设。为了在拥挤环境中保持高吞吐，PUSH 集成 EPIBT 启发的优先级继承、回溯和 anytime 改进。
Result: 在两个需要长视野推理的现实 MAPF 场景中，PUSH 可扩展到与 EPIBT 相同量级的智能体负载（如 10k 智能体），同时比所有基线实现显著更高的系统吞吐量。
Conclusion: 摘要强调交错子集规划与窗口式规划的结合能够在通用地图上实现大规模长视野 LMAPF，避免 TP 对地图结构的限制，同时保持接近 EPIBT 的扩展性。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Online Monitoring and Corrective Steering of Programming Agents
papers.abstract_en: Fixing GitHub issues in large-scale projects is a long-horizon task, especially when a fix requires changes across multiple locations or the issue description lacks the information needed to localize and repair it. As a result, agents traverse long trajectories that are prone to inefficiency and error: they drift away from their intended plan, repeat failed actions, or terminate without a working patch. This paper proposes LivePlan to monitor, detect, and correct such behavioral inefficiencies and drifts in real time. LivePlan decouples judging from advising: a deterministic, rule-based monitor examines general signals over the trajectory to detect issues without invoking an LLM, and only when an issue is detected does it consult an advisor LLM for a high-level, next-step correction. This design avoids the misleading re-planning and costly interventions of prior approaches. We implement LivePlan on top of SWE-agent and evaluate it using five LLMs (three as executor agents and two as advisors) across SWE-bench Verified and SWE-bench Pro. Compared to vanilla SWE-agent, LivePlan notably improves issue resolution rates, achieving consistent gains of up to 15.2% (average: 9.9%), while incurring only an additional cost of $0.08 per instance. The additional solutions concentrate on medium and hard instances. LivePlan consistently outperforms alternative approaches in resolution rate, with minimal regression on already successful runs and new successes on problems that no baseline solves.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LivePlan，一个面向编程智能体（programming agents）的在线监控与纠偏框架，用于实时检测并修正长时间跨度 GitHub issue 修复轨迹中的行为低效与漂移。LivePlan 将评判（judging）与建议（advising）解耦：不调用 LLM 的确定性规则监控器负责检测问题，仅在检测到问题后才调用顾问 LLM 给出高层下一步修正。基于 SWE-agent 的实现与五组 LLM 的评测显示，在 SWE-bench Verified 和 SWE-bench Pro 上最高提升 15.2%（平均 9.9%）的问题解决率，额外成本仅每实例 $0.08。
Motivation: 大规模项目中的 GitHub issue 修复是长时程任务，修复常需跨多处改动，且 issue 描述可能缺乏定位和修复所需信息。智能体因此会走过长轨迹，容易偏离原计划、重复失败动作或最终没有可用补丁，现有方法存在误导性重规划和成本高昂的干预。
Method: 提出 LivePlan，将监测与建议分离：一个确定性、基于规则（rule-based）的监控器通过轨迹上的通用信号检测问题而不调用 LLM，只有在检测到问题时才咨询顾问 LLM 以获取高层级、下一步修正建议。实现基于 SWE-agent，并使用五个 LLM（三个执行智能体，两个顾问）在 SWE-bench Verified 和 SWE-bench Pro 上评估。
Result: 相比 vanilla SWE-agent，LivePlan 持续提升 issue 解决率，最高 15.2%，平均 9.9%，额外成本仅每实例 $0.08。新增的解决方案集中在中等和困难实例上。与替代方法相比，LivePlan 在解决率上一致更优，对已成功运行的回归极小，并在所有基线都无法解决的难题上取得新成功。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将 LLM 参与限制在问题检测之后的纠偏环节，可以在不显著增加成本的情况下提升编程智能体的长时程任务表现，避免前期方法中误导性重规划和昂贵干预的问题。
Relevance: 0
