papers.title: AgentPatch: Coarse-to-Fine Weak-Task Repair for Merging Agentic Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Agentic multimodal large language models (MLLMs) extend multimodal perception and reasoning with planning, tool use, and interaction in dynamic environments. Yet current models are specialized for particular tools or environments, complicating consolidation into a single generalist. We formulate Agentic MLLM Merging and identify two challenges: asymmetric capability preservation, whereby capabilities with different interaction complexity are retained unevenly, producing weak tasks after merging, and behavior-critical forgetting, whereby losing decisive actions can derail long-horizon execution. We propose AgentPatch, a training-free coarse-to-fine repair framework. It selects a stable merged backbone, restores diluted weak-task-specific signals through Weak-Task Unique Residual Recovery, and applies an Agent-Guided Behavior-Critical Patch that recovers decisive behaviors under explicit capability protection. AgentPatch produces a single static checkpoint without routing or ensembles. Experiments across six agentic and multimodal benchmarks show that AgentPatch improves diverse merged backbones, alleviates weak-task degradation, and better balances weak-task recovery with the preservation of complementary search and agentic visual processing capabilities. Code is available at https://github.com/ziboshao/AgentPatch.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgentPatch，一个无需训练 (training-free) 的粗到细修复框架，用于合并面向智能体 (agentic) 场景的多模态大语言模型 (MLLMs)。作者将 Agentic MLLM Merging 形式化，指出合并后存在非对称能力保持与行为关键遗忘两个问题，并通过 Weak-Task Unique Residual Recovery 与 Agent-Guided Behavior-Critical Patch 来恢复弱化任务信号和关键行为。摘要称在六个智能体与多模态基准上，该方法改善了多种合并骨干模型的弱任务退化，并在弱任务恢复与互补的搜索和智能体视觉处理能力保持之间取得更好平衡，且只产生单个静态 checkpoint，无需路由或集成。
Motivation: 现有智能体多模态大语言模型往往针对特定工具或环境专门化，难以整合为单一通用模型；简单合并会导致不同交互复杂度能力的非对称保留，产生弱任务，并因丢失关键决策行为而破坏长程执行。
Method: AgentPatch 采用粗到细的免训练修复框架：先选取稳定的合并骨干，再通过 Weak-Task Unique Residual Recovery 恢复被稀释的弱任务特有信号，最后用 Agent-Guided Behavior-Critical Patch 在显式能力保护下恢复关键行为，最终产出单一静态 checkpoint，不使用路由或集成。
Result: 在六个智能体与多模态基准上的实验表明，AgentPatch 能提升多种合并骨干模型的性能，缓解弱任务退化，并更好地平衡弱任务恢复与此类模型应有的搜索和智能体视觉处理能力保持。
Conclusion: 作者认为免训练、单 checkpoint 的粗到细修复策略可以有效解决智能体多模态大模型合并中的弱任务退化与行为关键遗忘问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Transferable Autologistic Model for Predicting Rare Failures in Heterogeneous Equipment
papers.abstract_en: Predicting failures before they occur remains a major challenge in predictive maintenance, particularly when failures are rare, when equipment of the same family differ in sensor configurations, and when the goal is anticipation rather than diagnosis of an already observed fault. This paper proposes a common-to-target probabilistic model that learns shared failure-related patterns across a family of heterogeneous equipment and adapts parsimoniously to target equipment. The model explicitly accounts for sensor heterogeneity, operating context, and degradation dynamics to produce calibrated failureprobability estimates suitable for maintenance planning. papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种可迁移的自逻辑模型 (autologistic model)，用于在异构设备族中预测罕见故障。模型学习共享的故障相关模式，并以简约方式适配目标设备，显式刻画传感器异构性、运行环境和退化动态，输出适合维护规划的校准故障概率。摘要报告其在包含27台模拟冰箱的合成数据集上进行了评估。
Motivation: 预测性维护中罕见故障预测具有挑战，尤其当同一设备族的传感器配置不同、需要提前预测而非诊断已观察故障时，现有方法难以在异构设备间迁移。
Method: 提出一种 common-to-target 概率模型，先在设备族上学习共同故障模式，再对目标设备做少量参数适配；模型显式处理传感器异构性、运行情境和退化动态，以生成校准后的故障概率估计。
Result: 在包含27台模拟冰箱、传感器配置和故障类型各异的合成数据集上评估性能；摘要未给定量化结果。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法可为目标设备提供校准的故障概率估计，适合用于维护规划；但实验仅限于合成冰箱数据。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Multi-Agent Framework for Automated Coarse-Grained Molecular Dynamics of Polymers
papers.abstract_en: Coarse-grained (CG) molecular dynamics extends polymer simulation beyond the scales accessible to all-atom (AA) methods, but bottom-up CG modeling is laborious. The CG resolution is a design choice, so a transferable parameter set is generally not available and the potentials are derived anew for each polymer mapping. Here we present CGMas, a multi-agent framework that automates topology construction, equilibration, mapping, potential derivation, and validation from a natural-language specification of the polymer and target resolution. A large-language-model (LLM) reasoning agent infers the AA topology from polymer name, while layered self-correction resolves physical errors common to unsaturated, heteroatom-containing, and polar polymers. Downstream agents equilibrate the system, map it onto CG representation, derive potentials through Boltzmann inversion, and benchmark the model against its atomistic reference. CGMas completed all 27 homopolymer and copolymer tasks, matched the AA density to within 5% in 22, and reduced simulation from 38-88 min to 1 min, establishing agentic LLMs as a route to automated polymer coarse-graining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CGMas，一个多智能体框架，用于从自然语言描述自动完成聚合物的粗粒化分子动力学建模，包括拓扑构建、平衡、映射、势能推导与验证。摘要报告该框架在全部 27 个均聚物和共聚物任务上成功完成，其中 22 个任务的 AA 密度误差在 5% 以内，并将模拟时间从 38-88 分钟缩短至约 1 分钟。
Motivation: 自底向上的粗粒化建模非常费时费力，CG 分辨率是一种设计选择，通常不存在可迁移的参数集，每个聚合物映射都需要重新推导势函数。
Method: 提出 CGMas 多智能体框架：一个基于大语言模型的推理智能体从聚合物名称推断 AA 拓扑，分层自纠错机制处理不饱和、含杂原子和极性聚合物中的常见物理错误；下游智能体依次完成系统平衡、映射到 CG 表示、通过 Boltzmann inversion 推导势能，并与原子级参考进行基准验证。
Result: 在 27 个均聚物和共聚物任务上全部完成，22 个任务的 AA 密度匹配误差在 5% 以内，模拟时间从 38-88 分钟降至 1 分钟。
Conclusion: 摘要将智能体化 LLM 确立为一条自动化聚合物粗粒化的可行路线，未提及明显局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CoDAT: Collaborative Dual-Attention Transformer with Low-Cost Temporal Modeling for Efficient Edge Action Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Real-time human action recognition on Internet-of-Things (IoT) edge devices requires models that capture rich spatio-temporal cues within strict latency, memory, and power envelopes. Current 3D CNNs, video transformers, and shift-based ViT deliver high accuracy but come at computational costs that preclude edge IoT deployment. This paper proposes CoDAT, a Collaborative Dual-Attention Transformer that replaces conventional multi-head attention with a lightweight dual-branch module: Spatial Convolutional Attention (SCA) for local aggregation and Strided Single-Head Attention (SSHA) for global context. SSHA jointly compresses the spatial resolution and channel dimensions of the query, key, and value tensors via stride-based sparse projection, then fuses the resulting global and local features at a markedly reduced cost. To enable temporal communication across frames, a parameter-free TShift module is embedded in each block. Extensive experiments on Jetson AGX Orin and Raspberry Pi 5 demonstrate that CoDAT achieves an energy-accuracy balance in both image and action recognition. On ImageNet-1K, CoDAT-M runs 2x faster than EfficientViT384 and FastViT-S12 at comparable accuracy, and CoDAT-L matches ViT-S with 3x fewer parameters at 2x higher throughput. On Kinetics-400 and MA-52, CoDAT achieves competitive Top-1 accuracy against state-of-the-art CNN, transformer, and hybrid baselines while running up to 2.9x faster than VSwin-T, 2x faster than ViT-Temporal-Shift variants, and 5x faster than UniFormer-B. On UCF-101, CoDAT-S384 matches TokShift and LAPS while being 6x faster and requiring up to 13x fewer FLOPs, establishing an efficiency-accuracy balance for real-time action recognition in edge IoT perception systems. Code is available at https://github.com/novendrastywn/CoDAT .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CoDAT，一个面向 IoT 边缘设备实时动作识别的协作双注意力 Transformer。它用轻量双分支模块替代传统多头注意力：空间卷积注意力 (SCA) 负责局部聚合，跨步单头注意力 (SSHA) 通过基于步长的稀疏投影同时压缩空间分辨率和通道维度来捕捉全局上下文，并在每个 block 中嵌入无参数的 TShift 模块实现帧间时间通信。在 Jetson AGX Orin 和 Raspberry Pi 5 上的实验表明，CoDAT 在图像与动作识别任务上实现了能耗-精度平衡。
Motivation: 在 IoT 边缘设备上做实时人体动作识别需要在严格的延迟、内存和功耗限制下捕捉丰富的时空线索。现有 3D CNN、视频 Transformer 和基于 shift 的 ViT 精度高但计算成本过高，无法部署到边缘 IoT 场景。
Method: 提出协作双注意力 Transformer (CoDAT)，其核心是一个轻量双分支模块：SCA 用于局部特征聚合，SSHA 通过跨步稀疏投影同时压缩 query、key、value 的空间分辨率和通道维度以获取全局上下文，再以显著降低的成本融合全局与局部特征。每个 block 中嵌入无参数 TShift 模块以实现跨帧的时间通信。
Result: 在 ImageNet-1K 上，CoDAT-M 在相近精度下比 EfficientViT384 和 FastViT-S12 快 2 倍；CoDAT-L 以 3 倍更少的参数和 2 倍更高的吞吐量匹配 ViT-S。在 Kinetics-400 和 MA-52 上，CoDAT 达到有竞争力的 Top-1 精度，同时比 VSwin-T 快至多 2.9 倍，比 ViT-Temporal-Shift 变体快 2 倍，比 UniFormer-B 快 5 倍。在 UCF-101 上，CoDAT-S384 匹配 TokShift 和 LAPS，但快 6 倍且 FLOPs 减少至多 13 倍。
Conclusion: CoDAT 在边缘 IoT 感知系统中建立了实时动作识别的效率-精度平衡，实验覆盖 Jetson AGX Orin 和 Raspberry Pi 5，代码已开源。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 在 ImageNet-1K 上，CoDAT-M 在相近精度下比 EfficientViT384 和 FastViT-S12 快 2 倍；CoDAT-L 以 3 倍更少的参数和 2 倍更高的吞吐量匹配 ViT-S。在 Kinetics-400 和 MA-52 上，CoDAT 达到有竞争力的 Top-1 精度，同时比 VSwin-T 快至多 2.9 倍，比 ViT-Temporal-Shift 变体快 2 倍，比 UniFormer-B 快 5 倍。在 UCF-101 上，CoDAT-S384 匹配 TokShift 和 LAPS，但快 6 倍且 FLOPs 减少至多 13 倍。
summary_sections.conclusion: CoDAT 在边缘 IoT 感知系统中建立了实时动作识别的效率-精度平衡，实验覆盖 Jetson AGX Orin 和 Raspberry Pi 5，代码已开源。

papers.title: Policy-Masked Private Experts: Auditable and Reversible Capability Access Control in Sparse MoE Models
papers.abstract_en: Most language-model access controls regulate behavior while leaving the same computation available to every request. We study a different systems question: can trusted authorization determine which newly trained parameters are reachable by the forward pass? Policy-Masked Private Experts freezes a pretrained sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model, trains a disjoint expert branch, and selects the public or private pool before top-k routing. The resulting claim is narrow but testable: under the declared trusted computing base (TCB), an unauthorized request executes no private expert. It does not imply that the public model lacks the same semantic capability. We test this separation between execution control and task utility in Qwen3-30B-A3B and DeepSeek-V2-Lite. Three Qwen BF16 seeds update all 32 private experts while the public fingerprint remains unchanged. Across 64 adversarial scenarios and 96 deny/fail-closed events, unauthorized private execution is zero; independent hooks exactly match 11,616 routed private rows and allow-deny-allow recovery is exact. On two prospectively frozen Qwen benchmarks, the private branch improves exact tool use by 5.0 percentage points (pp) (five versus zero discordances; one-sided Holm p = 0.03125, corresponding two-sided exact p = 0.0625) and 21.3 pp (percentile-bootstrap 95% CI [13.3, 29.3], Holm p = 0.000031). Three arm-blinded model evaluators retain a positive external effect of 18.7 pp (95% CI [9.3, 28.0]). A parameter-matched Lora has similar external utility, but a post-hoc request gate leaves 1,225 adapter calls under deny; the disjoint expert branch leaves none. DeepSeek reproduces the route invariant and gains 27.0 pp. A valid sealed evaluation is near-neutral. These results support auditable, reversible control over a trained parameter path, while showing that useful transfer remains distribution dependent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Policy-Masked Private Experts，一种针对稀疏 MoE（Mixture-of-Experts）模型的能力访问控制方法：冻结预训练 MoE，训练一个不相交的专家分支，并在 top-k 路由前选择公共或私有专家池。摘要声称在声明的可信计算基（TCB）下，未授权请求不会执行任何私有专家，但该模型不保证公共模型缺少相同语义能力。作者在 Qwen3-30B-A3B 和 DeepSeek-V2-Lite 上验证了执行控制与任务效用的分离。
Motivation: 大多数语言模型访问控制只是调节行为，但每个请求仍可访问相同的计算资源。作者研究一个不同的系统问题：可信授权能否决定哪些新训练参数在前向传播中可达，从而实现参数路径级的细粒度控制。
Method: 冻结预训练稀疏 MoE 模型，训练一个不相交的私有专家分支，在 top-k 路由之前根据授权策略选择公共或私有专家池，实现可审计且可逆的能力访问控制。
Result: 三个 Qwen BF16 种子更新全部 32 个私有专家而公共指纹不变；在 64 个对抗场景和 96 个 deny/fail-closed 事件中，未授权私有执行次数为零，独立 hooks 精确匹配 11,616 条私有路由记录，allow-deny-allow 恢复精确。在两个前瞻性冻结的 Qwen 基准上，私有分支将精确工具使用率分别提升 5.0 个百分点（pp）（Holm p=0.03125）和 21.3 pp（95% CI [13.3, 29.3]）；盲评估者外部效应为 18.7 pp（95% CI [9.3, 28.0]）。DeepSeek 复现路由不变性并提升 27.0 pp；参数匹配的 LoRA 在 deny 下遗留 1,225 次适配器调用，而不相交专家分支为零。
Conclusion: 这些结果支持对已训练参数路径进行可审计、可逆的控制，同时表明这种能力转移的效用具有分布依赖性；密封评估（sealed evaluation）结果接近中性。

papers.title: Optimal Neural Network Approximation via Empirical Least Squares with Deterministic Samples
papers.abstract_en: We develop a rigorous theory of discrete residual least-squares approximation for elliptic spectral equations $\mathfrak L_βu=f$ using linearized ReLU$^k$ neural networks on the sphere, where $\mathfrak L_β$ is a positive elliptic spectral multiplier of order $β$. Given a parameter set $Θ_n=\{θ_{j}^*\}_{j=1}^n\subset\mathbb S^d$, we approximate $u$ in the linearized network space $L_n^k(Θ_n)$ by the discrete residual on the collocation points $\{η_i^*\}_{i=1}^m$ \begin{equation*} u_{n,m}\in\arg\min_{v_n\in L_n^k(Θ_n)}\frac1m\sum_{i=1}^m\left(f(η_i^*)-\mathfrak L_βv_n(η_i^*)\right)^2. \end{equation*} With $k>\frac{d-1}{2}+β$, for antipodally quasi-uniform network parameter sets and any quasi-uniform collocation points with $m\gtrsim n$, we prove that \begin{equation*} \|u-u_{n,m}\|_{\mathcal H^β(\mathbb S^d)}\eqsim\|f-\mathfrak L_βu_{n,m}\|_{\mathcal L^2(\mathbb S^d)}\lesssim n^{-\frac{r}{d}} \begin{cases} \|f\|_{\mathcal W^{r,p}(\mathbb S^d)},&\frac{d}{p}<r\leq \frac{d}{2},~p>2,\\ \|f\|_{\mathcal H^r(\mathbb S^d)},&r>\frac{d}{2}. \end{cases} \end{equation*} We also establish a high-probability residual estimate, up to a logarithmic factor and an arbitrarily small smoothness loss, for i.i.d.\ uniformly distributed collocation points. The key analytical ingredient is a Bernstein inequality for linearized ReLU$^k$ network spaces. If $\underline h$ denotes the antipodal separation distance of the network parameters, then \begin{equation*} \|v_n\|_{\mathcal H^r(\mathbb S^d)}\lesssim\underline h^{-(r-s)}\|v_n\|_{\mathcal H^s(\mathbb S^d)},\qquad 0\leq s<r<k+\tfrac12. \end{equation*}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为球面上的椭圆谱方程 L_βu=f 建立了离散残差最小二乘神经逼近的严格理论，使用线性化 ReLU^k 网络空间，在拟均匀配点和网络参数集下证明误差以 n^{-r/d} 阶收敛，并给出 i.i.d. 均匀随机配点的高概率残差估计。关键分析工具是线性化 ReLU^k 网络空间上的 Bernstein 不等式。
Motivation: 椭圆谱方程的神经网络数值求解通常缺乏严格的逼近误差理论，本文旨在为离散最小二乘神经网络逼近提供收敛性保证和速率估计。
Method: 在球面 S^d 上对正椭圆谱乘子算子 L_β 的方程，用线性化 ReLU^k 网络空间 L_n^k(Θ_n) 在配点 {η_i^*} 上做离散残差最小二乘逼近；对反极准均匀网络参数集和准均匀配点（m≳n）推导误差界，并利用 Bernstein 不等式建立高概率估计。
Result: 在 k>(d-1)/2+β 条件下，摘要证明 H^β 范数误差满足 ‖u-u_{n,m}‖_{H^β}≲n^{-r/d} 乘以 f 的正则性范数（p>2 时用 W^{r,p}，r>d/2 时用 H^r）；对 i.i.d. 均匀配点，残差估计至多含对数因子和任意小的光滑度损失。
Conclusion: 摘要强调所建立的 Bernstein 型不等式是核心，给出线性化 ReLU^k 网络空间在球面椭圆谱方程上的离散最小二乘逼近收敛理论；范围限于球面设置，未讨论其他域或一般非线性问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Corrupting Attention: Evasion-Based Adversarial Attacks on Encoder Attention in Detection Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Adversarial vulnerabilities remain a major concern for the safe deployment of neural networks, particularly in object detection, a core task embedded in many safety-critical systems. Detection transformers have emerged as leading object detectors, yet their adversarial robustness remains comparatively underexplored. Most existing attacks target the detection output rather than the attention mechanism that makes these models distinctive. In this paper, we introduce the first attack that directly optimizes an encoder-attention objective under an imperceptible, bounded $\ell_\infty$ perturbation. Rather than introducing an attacker-owned sink token through a visible patch, it drives the model's own attention toward a corrupted target. We argue that encoder attention concentrates the model's spatial reasoning, so corrupting it propagates through the detection pipeline more disruptively than perturbing the detection output alone. Our attack reduces DETR-R50 mAP on COCO from 42.1 to 0.97, a $\sim 4\times$ reduction in resulting mAP over the strongest existing attack under an identical perturbation budget and iteration count. We further show that this vulnerability is not specific to a particular corruption objective: across four qualitatively distinct targets, dispersion, re-ranking, permutation, and peak-suppression, detection consistently drops below 3 mAP, suggesting that the weakness arises from disrupting the attention structure itself rather than from any single target. Finally, we demonstrate that the attack generalizes across attention formulations, reducing DINO-Swin-L from 56.8 to 1.44 mAP against 7.3 for the strongest prior attack, establishing state-of-the-art on both dense and deformable attention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个直接优化编码器注意力目标的对抗攻击，在不可感知的有界 ℓ∞ 扰动下，将 DETR-R50 在 COCO 上的 mAP 从 42.1 降至 0.97，并表明该攻击能推广到 DINO-Swin-L 等不同注意力形式，攻击效果优于现有最强攻击。
Motivation: 检测 Transformer 已成为领先的目标检测器，但其对抗鲁棒性仍相对未被充分探索；现有攻击大多针对检测输出而非使这些模型具有独特性的注意力机制。
Method: 攻击直接优化编码器注意力目标，不使用攻击者拥有的 sink token 可见补丁，而是在不可感知、有界 ℓ∞ 扰动下驱动模型自身注意力朝向被破坏的目标；论文测试了 dispersion、re-ranking、permutation、peak-suppression 四种不同的注意力破坏目标。
Result: 在相同扰动预算和迭代次数下，该攻击将 DETR-R50 在 COCO 上的 mAP 从 42.1 降至 0.97，相比最强现有攻击约 4 倍降低；四种目标下检测均低于 3 mAP；对 DINO-Swin-L 将 mAP 从 56.8 降至 1.44，而先前最强攻击为 7.3，在密集和可变形注意力上均达到最优。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该脆弱性源于破坏注意力结构本身而非某一特定目标，并说明攻击在不同注意力公式上具有泛化性。

papers.title: When Semantics Saturate or Emerge: Adaptation-Conditional Semantic Utility in Source-Free Cross-Domain Few-Shot Learning
papers.abstract_en: Language descriptions in source-free cross-domain few-shot learning (SF-CDFSL) are often selected according to zero-shot accuracy obtained with a frozen vision--language model. This paper asks whether that ranking remains valid after target-domain visual adaptation. Under a strictly paired protocol, we compare a generic class-name template with fixed detailed class descriptions before and after visual Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) on EuroSAT, CropDisease, ISIC, and ChestX. Let $\deltazero$ and $\deltalora$ denote the Detailed-minus-Base accuracy before and after adaptation, respectively. Two recurring regimes emerge. In \emph{semantic saturation}, $\deltazero>0$ but $0<\deltalora\ll\deltazero$: on EuroSAT and CropDisease, initial gains of 8.13--21.54 percentage points contract to 0.69--2.96 points after LoRA. In \emph{semantic emergence}, $\deltazero\leq0$ but $\deltalora>0$: on ISIC and ChestX, detailed descriptions become more useful only after the visual representation is updated. Training trajectories and sample-level decomposition show that saturation is driven mainly by Base-LoRA recovering errors already solved by detailed semantics, whereas emergence is associated with prediction turnover and newly formed Detailed-only correct decisions. Fixed-point-free shuffled-semantic controls, a second CLIP backbone, and multiple random seeds support the broad pattern while identifying ChestX 1-shot as a weak boundary case. These findings establish that zero-shot prompt quality is an incomplete proxy for adaptation-anchor quality and motivate evaluating language on both sides of the adaptation boundary.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在源自由跨域小样本学习 (SF-CDFSL) 中研究语言描述的选择是否在目标域视觉适配后仍然有效。作者在严格配对协议下比较通用类名模板与固定详细描述在视觉 LoRA 适配前、后的准确率，在 EuroSAT、CropDisease、ISIC、ChestX 上发现两种重复出现的模式：语义饱和 (semantic saturation) 与语义涌现 (semantic emergence)。结论是零样本提示质量不足以作为适配锚点质量的完整代理。
Motivation: 现有 SF-CDFSL 通常依据冻结视觉-语言模型上的零样本准确率来挑选语言描述，但该排序在目标域视觉适配后是否仍然成立尚不明确。论文针对这一 gap，考察语言描述的价值会否随视觉表示更新而变化。
Method: 采用严格配对协议，在视觉 Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) 前后分别对比通用类名模板与固定详细描述；还使用了一种打乱语义的对照 (shuffled-semantic controls)、第二个 CLIP 骨干和多个随机种子来检验结果的稳健性，并借助训练轨迹与样本级分解分析两种机制的成因。
Result: 在 EuroSAT 和 CropDisease 上，初始 8.13–21.54 个百分点的详细描述收益在 LoRA 后收缩到 0.69–2.96 个百分点，呈现语义饱和；在 ISIC 和 ChestX 上，详细描述仅在视觉表示更新后才变得有用，呈现语义涌现。饱和主要由 Base-LoRA 恢复那些已被详细语义解决的错误驱动，涌现则与预测翻转和新形成的仅详细 (Detailed-only) 正确决策相关；ChestX 1-shot 被识别为较弱的边界情况。
Conclusion: 作者认为零样本提示质量是不完整的适配锚点质量代理，语言选择的评估应当横跨适配边界两侧，即在适应前后都加以考察。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.method: 采用严格配对协议，在视觉 Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) 前后分别对比通用类名模板与固定详细描述；还使用了一种打乱语义的对照 (shuffled-semantic controls)、第二个 CLIP 骨干和多个随机种子来检验结果的稳健性，并借助训练轨迹与样本级分解分析两种机制的成因。
summary_sections.result: 在 EuroSAT 和 CropDisease 上，初始 8.13–21.54 个百分点的详细描述收益在 LoRA 后收缩到 0.69–2.96 个百分点，呈现语义饱和；在 ISIC 和 ChestX 上，详细描述仅在视觉表示更新后才变得有用，呈现语义涌现。饱和主要由 Base-LoRA 恢复那些已被详细语义解决的错误驱动，涌现则与预测翻转和新形成的仅详细 (Detailed-only) 正确决策相关；ChestX 1-shot 被识别为较弱的边界情况。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为零样本提示质量是不完整的适配锚点质量代理，语言选择的评估应当横跨适配边界两侧，即在适应前后都加以考察。

papers.title: EpiFlow: A framework for improving the utility of wastewater signals for disease forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Wastewater-based surveillance is an effective tool for disease monitoring and can provide early warning of outbreaks. Although wastewater viral loads (WVL) correlate with disease burden, their utility for improving real-time forecasting remains under investigation. During the early phases of an epidemic, many indicators can effectively monitor disease spread, but their reliability may decline because of reporting fatigue and low prevalence. Hospital burden can vary substantially even during low-prevalence periods, making accurate forecasting of burden indicators essential for minimizing disease impacts. In this paper, we present principled approaches for processing wastewater data, characterizing its relationship with burden indicators, and generating real-time forecasts. We assess the predictability of WVL using entropy measures. We analyze the relationship between WVL and burden indicators using causality tests that capture temporal dynamics and the leading-indicator behavior of WVL. We incorporate these insights into a time-varying forecasting model that accounts for the evolving relationship between the signals. We also evaluate the effects of delays in WVL reporting through simulations. We test the utility of our methods by forecasting COVID-19 hospital admissions across Virginia and its health regions during periods of varying disease prevalence. Incorporating WVL improves forecast accuracy relative to baseline models, particularly during critical epidemic phases, and results in a 20 percentage point improvement in forecast coverage. Our results demonstrate that WVL signals can improve infectious disease forecasting even under conditions of low prevalence or delayed reporting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EpiFlow 框架，用于处理污水监测数据、刻画污水病毒载量（WVL）与疾病负担指标的关系，并生成实时预测。作者用熵测度评估 WVL 的可预测性，用捕捉时序动态和前导指标行为的因果检验分析其与负担指标的关系，并将这些见解纳入时变预测模型，同时通过模拟评估 WVL 报告延迟的影响。在弗吉尼亚州及其卫生区域的 COVID-19 住院预测中，纳入 WVL 相比基线模型提升预测精度，尤其在关键疫情阶段，预测覆盖率提高 20 个百分点。
Motivation: 污水中病毒载量与疾病负担相关，但其对改善实时预测的效用仍在研究之中；疫情早期许多指标有效，但报告疲劳和低患病率会使可靠性下降，而医院负担即使在低流行期也可能大幅波动，因此准确预测负担指标对减少疾病影响至关重要。
Method: 提出处理污水数据的规范化方法，使用熵测度评估 WVL 的可预测性，并通过捕捉时间动态与领先指标行为的因果检验分析 WVL 与负担指标的关系；将这些洞察整合进一个考虑信号间时变关系的预测模型中，同时用模拟评估 WVL 报告延迟带来的影响。
Result: 在对弗吉尼亚州及其卫生区域不同疾病流行期的 COVID-19 住院人数进行预测的实验里，纳入 WVL 相比基线模型提升了预测准确性，尤其是在关键疫情阶段，并带来 20 个百分点的预测覆盖率提升。
Conclusion: 结果表明即使在低患病率或延迟报告的条件下，WVL 信号也能改善传染病预测。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Bootstrap validity in Bayesian semi-parametric models
papers.abstract_en: We discuss Bayesian inference on a low-dimensional targeted parameter in the presence of possibly highly complex nuisance components within the semi-parametric inference framework using an estimating function approach. We obtain a posterior distribution using non-parametric Bayesian methods through the Dirichlet process and the Bayesian bootstrap. We relax the commonly deployed notion of stochastic equicontinuity and develop a framework leading to posterior inference with good frequentist properties, specifically we demonstrate that the posterior distribution is asymptotically Normal and concentrates at the true value of the parameter. We emphasize the specific assumptions that are required to obtain these results, and how relaxing any of them alters the conclusions. We verify the analytical results in simulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在半参数推断框架下，用估计方程（estimating function）讨论低维目标参数的贝叶斯推断，其中 nuisance 成分可能高度复杂。作者通过 Dirichlet process 与 Bayesian bootstrap 构造后验分布，并放宽常用的随机等度连续（stochastic equicontinuity）假设，证明后验渐近正态且以真实参数值为中心。文中强调了推导结果所需的具体假设，以及放松任一假设如何改变结论，并用模拟验证了分析结果。
Motivation: 半参数模型中存在复杂 nuisance 成分时，非参数贝叶斯方法（如 Bayesian bootstrap）的后验是否具有良好频率性质尚需严格刻画；已有结果通常依赖较强的随机等度连续条件，作者希望放宽这一假设并厘清哪些条件是必要的。
Method: 采用估计方程方法构造推断，使用 Dirichlet process 和 Bayesian bootstrap 获得后验分布；在放松随机等度连续假设的前提下建立后验渐近正态性与集中性的理论框架，并明确列出所需假设。
Result: 摘要报告后验分布渐近服从正态分布，并以参数真值处集中；该结果在模拟研究中得到验证。
Conclusion: 作者强调其结论依赖若干特定假设，并指出放宽其中任一假设都会改变结论，提示这类半参数贝叶斯推断的频率性质对假设条件较为敏感。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Vehicle routing problem using deep reinforcement learning - A case study about truck planning in the industry
papers.abstract_en: As an important component of the supply chain industry, transportation has experienced rapid development in the past decade with the assistance of digital platforms and intelligent algorithms. Within the field of transportation research, Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP) has remained a persistent and enduring challenge. In the realm of management science, experts, and scholars from both the industrial and academic sectors have continuously explored optimization models and algorithms to effectively address routing problems, from the classical Traveling Salesman Problem to the more general Vehicle Routing Problem. These models and algorithms are applied in real-world industrial scenarios to achieve cost optimization and reduce carbon footprints. However, due to the complexity of real-world problems, numerous specific constraints are often added, and challenges such as information opacity, uncertainty, and irrational human behavior may arise. Therefore, deploying and optimizing mathematical models for VRP in practical scenarios while maintaining optimal results poses numerous challenges. This paper discusses and provides solutions for three different logistic use cases involving external truck network design. Through these industrial case study, the paper introduces how deep reinforcement learning-based vehicle routing optimization has been implemented. As a result, it can be observed that the routes optimized by reinforcement learning agent have over 10% total cost compared to baseline results. Furthermore, the paper proposes that in future research, DRL algorithms for vehicle routing problems could be generalized into more variations of VRP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文讨论深度强化学习 (deep reinforcement learning) 在车辆路径问题 (Vehicle Routing Problem, VRP) 上的实际工业落地，针对外部卡车网络设计给出三个物流用例。文中介绍了基于深度强化学习的车辆路径优化如何实施，并指出强化学习智能体优化的路线相比基线在总成本上有超过 10% 的优势。作者还提出未来可将 VRP 的 DRL 算法推广到更多 VRP 变体。
Motivation: 现实场景中的 VRP 因额外约束、信息不透明、不确定性以及非理性人为行为等因素而变得复杂，导致经典优化模型在实际部署中难以保持最优结果，需要探索可落地的求解方案。
Method: 基于深度强化学习的车辆路径优化方法，并通过三个涉及外部卡车网络设计的工业物流用例来展示具体实现。
Result: 摘要报告强化学习智能体优化后的路线相比基线结果在总成本上获得超过 10% 的改善。
Conclusion: 作者认为深度强化学习算法可用于工业 VRP 场景，并建议未来将其推广到更多 VRP 变体。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CellWorld: From Gene-Level Reconstruction to Latent Cell Prediction in Spatial Transcriptomics Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: This paper shows that latent-space predictive pretraining can provide a scalable route to foundation models for spatial transcriptomics. Existing spatial transcriptomics foundation models primarily reconstruct masked gene identities or expression values, potentially encouraging the reproduction of assay-specific technical variation and limiting representation transferability. To avoid directly reconstructing such variation, we shift the prediction target from observed gene measurements to latent cell representations and introduce CellWorld, which predicts the latent representations of masked cells from visible spatial context and a limited partial-expression hint. We pretrain four CellWorld variants, spanning 5.74M to 94.56M trainable parameters, on a corpus of 46 million human cells. Our controlled scaling experiments show that performance improves with model capacity, particularly on spatial tasks, while spatial transfer depends more on sufficient optimization and broad biological source diversity than on cell count alone. Across four held-out datasets, even CellWorld-Small, with 5.74M trainable parameters, outperforms every baseline on all 11 linear-probe benchmarks and all seven fine-tuned spatial benchmarks. Most notably, a frozen CellWorld-Large pretrained on only 5\% of the corpus with broad biological source coverage outperforms every fully fine-tuned baseline across all seven spatial benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/UoM-HealthAI/CellWorld.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CellWorld，一种面向空间转录组学基础模型的潜在空间预测预训练方法，将预测目标从重建被掩蔽的基因身份或表达值，改为根据可见空间上下文和有限的局部表达提示预测掩蔽细胞的潜在表示。作者在包含 4600 万人类细胞的语料上预训练了四个规模的 CellWorld 变体（参数量 5.74M 至 94.56M），并报告 CellWorld-Small 在四个保留数据集上的全部 11 个线性探测基准和 7 个微调空间基准上均超过所有基线。
Motivation: 现有空间转录组学基础模型主要重建被掩蔽的基因身份或表达值，可能鼓励模型复现检测方法特有的技术变异，从而限制表征的可迁移性。
Method: 将预测目标从观测到的基因测量值转移到潜在细胞表示上，CellWorld 从可见空间上下文和受限的部分表达提示中预测被掩蔽细胞的潜在表示；作者在 4600 万人类细胞语料上预训练了四个规模变体，并设计受控缩放实验。
Result: 缩放实验显示性能随模型容量提升，尤其在空间任务上；空间迁移更依赖充分的优化和广泛的生物来源多样性而非单纯细胞数量。CellWorld-Small（5.74M 参数）在四个保留数据集上超越所有基线的全部 11 个线性探测基准和 7 个微调空间基准；仅用 5% 语料预训练且具有广泛生物来源覆盖的冻结 CellWorld-Large，在全部 7 个空间基准上超越所有完全微调的基线。
Conclusion: 作者认为潜在空间预测预训练为空间转录组学基础模型提供了一条可扩展路径，能够避免直接重建检测技术变异；论文还提供了代码仓库链接。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TRACE: A Multi-Layer Benchmark for Human AI Controller Coordination Under Drift and Failure
papers.abstract_en: Modern cyber-physical and AI-assisted systems couple human operators, AI decision modules, and automated controllers in a single control loop, so trustworthiness depends on the whole loop, not any one model. Yet no standard benchmark captures time-aligned, multi-layer traces of how drift and failures propagate across these layers, so we cannot diagnose where coordination breaks down, why, or how to recover. This paper targets one facet of that gap: drift, a deviation that can originate in any stack layer and that conventional single-modality monitoring cannot localize to a layer or pin to an onset time. We construct a benchmark by injecting controlled drift into traces derived from ALFRED, a grounded-instruction benchmark for everyday household tasks, yielding 1,918 drifted traces. Each trace is a time-aligned sequence of per-step records across five execution layers (state, observation, decision, rules, control), labeled with the drift type, affected layer, onset time, responsible actor, and causal mechanism, and validated by independent raters with inter-annotator agreement reported. We pair the dataset with a leak-aware protocol that removes a near-perfect onset leak, and a baseline study across classical, recurrent, and attention-based model families. Under this honest protocol, drift is identifiable and attributable well above random and majority baselines across every family (affected layer macro-F1 near 0.70, responsible actor near 0.85, causal mechanism near 0.49), and heavy attention offers no advantage over simpler models on this symbolic benchmark.
papers.comment: This work was accepted for presentation and publication at the 25th IEEE International Conference on Machine Learning and Applications (ICMLA 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TRACE，一个用于研究人类-AI 控制器协调中漂移与故障传播的多层基准。作者从 ALFRED 日常家居任务轨迹中注入受控漂移，构造 1,918 条时间对齐的漂移轨迹，每条轨迹覆盖状态、观察、决策、规则、控制五个执行层，并标注漂移类型、受影响层、起始时间、责任主体和因果机制。配合一种泄漏感知协议（leak-aware protocol）和经典、循环、注意力三类模型的基线研究，结果表明漂移可被识别与归因，且重注意力模型在该符号基准上并无优势。
Motivation: 现有基准缺少时间对齐的多层跟踪数据，无法刻画漂移和故障如何在人类、AI 决策模块与自动控制器耦合的闭环中传播，因而难以诊断协调在何处失效、为何失效以及如何恢复；单模态监控也无法将漂移定位到具体层或起始时间。
Method: 构建 TRACE 基准：向 ALFRED 的轨迹中注入受控漂移，生成 1,918 条漂移轨迹；每条轨迹是按步骤时间对齐的五层（状态、观察、决策、规则、控制）记录序列，标注漂移类型、影响层、起始时间、责任主体和因果机制，并由独立评注员验证一致性。同时提出泄漏感知协议去除近完美的起始时间泄漏，并在经典、循环和注意力模型家族上完成基线研究。
Result: 在诚实协议下，所有模型族的漂移识别与归因都显著高于随机和多数类基线：受影响层 macro-F1 约为 0.70，责任主体约为 0.85，因果机制约为 0.49；重注意力模型在此符号基准上相比简单模型没有带来优势。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了可复用的多层漂移诊断基准与评估协议，表明在去除泄漏后漂移的定位和归因是可行的，并指出简单的符号模型在该任务上已足够有效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dirichlet Follow-the-Leader Closes the Gap in Simultaneous Multiclass U-Calibration
papers.abstract_en: Can one forecaster attain the optimal regret rate for every bounded proper loss and also adapt to every smooth proper loss? Recent work answered this up to a dimension gap. Its self-concordant perturbation gives roughly $K^{5/4}\sqrt{T}$ worst-case regret and incurs an additional $β\sqrt{K}\log K$ for $β$-smooth losses. We close both gaps with a one-line forecaster. After observing class counts $c_{t-1}$, draw the next prediction from $\operatorname{Dir}(c_{t-1})$, on the face of classes seen so far. This is a fresh Bayesian bootstrap of the outcomes. The analysis rests on an exact identity: averaging any bounded proper loss under $\operatorname{Dir}(α)$ equals a discrete derivative of its Dirichlet-averaged Bayes risk. The identity makes the be-the-perturbed-leader term telescope to a nonpositive Jensen gap. A one-count likelihood ratio then bounds stability by the inverse square root of that class's count. The resulting single, horizon-free algorithm satisfies $\sup_{\ell}\mathbb{E}\operatorname{Reg}_{\ell}\leq 4\sqrt{S_T T}\leq 4\sqrt{K T}$ and $\mathbb{E}\operatorname{Reg}_{\ell}\leq \frac{5}{2}β(1+\log T)$ for every $β$-smooth proper loss. Here $S_T$ is the number of observed classes. Known lower bounds show that both rates are optimal in their nontrivial regimes. The proof covers nondifferentiable losses and changes of the active simplex face.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个单行的在线预测器：观测到各类别计数 c_{t-1} 后，在已见类别构成的单纯形面上按 Dirichlet 分布 Dir(c_{t-1}) 抽样作为下一预测，即对历史结果的贝叶斯自助法 (Bayesian bootstrap)。作者证明该算法同时闭合了同时多类 U-校准 (simultaneous multiclass U-calibration) 中两个已知的维数间隙：对所有有界适当损失 (bounded proper loss) 达到最优遗憾率，并能自适应所有 β-光滑适当损失。分析核心是一个精确恒等式，使 be-the-perturbed-leader 项 telescoping 为非正 Jensen 间隙，稳定性则由单计数似然比界住。
Motivation: 近年工作证明单个预测器可以同时实现对任意有界适当损失的最优遗憾率并适应光滑适当损失，但存在维数间隙：其自和谐扰动 (self-concordant perturbation) 在最坏情形下给出约 K^{5/4}√T 的遗憾，并对 β-光滑损失额外付出 β√K log K 的代价。本文目标是闭合这两个间隙。
Method: 提出单行预测器：在观察到类别计数 c_{t-1} 后，从已见类别面上的 Dir(c_{t-1}) 分布抽取下一预测向量。证明依赖一个精确恒等式：在有界适当损失下对 Dir(α) 求平均等价于 Dirichlet 平均 Bayes 风险的离散导数；该恒等式使 be-the-perturbed-leader 项 telescoping 成非正的 Jensen 间隙，并用单计数似然比将该类别计数平方根倒数界住稳定性。证明覆盖不可微损失以及活动单纯形面的变化。
Result: 该单一、无 horizon 依赖的算法满足 sup_ℓ E Reg_ℓ ≤ 4√(S_T T) ≤ 4√(KT)，其中 S_T 为观测到的类别数；对任意 β-光滑适当损失满足 E Reg_ℓ ≤ (5/2)β(1+log T)。已知下界表明这两个速率在其非平凡区间内均为最优。
Conclusion: 作者强调该工作闭合了多类 U-校准中关于任意有界适当损失与光滑适当损失的两个遗憾率间隙，且证明能够处理不可微损失和活动单纯形面变化；该结果属于理论性结论，摘要中未报告实验。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SmartMage: Dynamic Modality Orchestration for 3D Scene Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Understanding 3D scenes is fundamental to embodied intelligence, requiring joint reasoning over heterogeneous information from multiple modalities, including visual and geometric cues. However, the relevance of these modalities often varies across queries. Existing Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) typically rely on fixed modality combinations, overlooking query-dependent modality needs. Such a rigid design can introduce semantic noise from irrelevant modalities while underutilizing more informative ones, leading to wasted computation and diluted reasoning. To address these challenges, this paper proposes SmartMage, a unified MLLM that dynamically orchestrates heterogeneous modalities for semantic-aware 3D scene understanding. Specifically, SmartMage incorporates: (1) a Semantic-guided Modality Adaptive RouTng (SMART) module that selects task-relevant modalities using semantic priors, text-modality alignment, and modality quality; and (2) a Modality-Aware Gating Expert (MAGE) module that leverages modality priors to guide expert activation, fostering adaptive specialization in multimodal reasoning. Empirically, SmartMage achieves state-of-the-art performance across five 3D scene understanding benchmarks, and attains competitive results on RGB-only video understanding benchmarks. In our diagnostic benchmark ScanFacet, tasks are divided into fine-grained semantic categories, enabling analysis of modality combinations preferred by each semantic type. The observed modality-semantic patterns provide further evidence of SmartMage's effectiveness. Project page: https://yuecheong.github.io/SmartMage/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SmartMage，一个面向 3D 场景理解的多模态大语言模型 (MLLM)，核心是动态编排视觉与几何等异构模态，而不是使用固定模态组合。模型包含语义引导的模态自适应路由模块 SMART 和模态感知门控专家模块 MAGE，在五个 3D 场景理解基准上取得 SOTA，并在 RGB-only 视频理解基准上取得有竞争力的结果。作者还引入诊断基准 ScanFacet，按细粒度语义类别分析各语义类型偏好的模态组合。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 通常依赖固定模态组合，忽略了不同查询对模态相关性的差异，可能引入不相关模态的语义噪声并低估更有信息量的模态，导致计算浪费和推理质量下降。
Method: SmartMage 采用统一 MLLM 架构，包含 SMART 模块，利用语义先验、文本-模态对齐和模态质量来选择任务相关模态；以及 MAGE 模块，利用模态先验指导专家激活，实现多模态推理中的自适应专业化。
Result: 摘要报告 SmartMage 在五个 3D 场景理解基准上达到最先进性能，并在 RGB-only 视频理解基准上取得有竞争力的结果；诊断基准 ScanFacet 中观察到的模态-语义模式进一步验证了方法的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调动态模态编排能够依据查询自适应地选择相关模态，改善 3D 场景理解中的多模态推理效率与效果。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SSTQ:Privacy-Preserving Vector Quantization via Subsampled Stochastic TurboQuant
papers.abstract_en: Achieving local differential privacy in distributed optimization while maintaining low communication cost remains challenging. Existing vector quantization methods, such as vqSGD, use high-dimensional geometric constructions but incur unfavorable dimension-dependent variance. In this work, we propose Subsampled Stochastic TurboQuant (SSTQ), a framework that combines overcomplete equal-norm tight frames, coordinate subsampling, and privacy-aware one-dimensional quantization. SSTQ includes two variants: a Flat Randomized Response version and a Metric-Aware Laplace version, the latter being better suited to higher codebook bit-width regimes. We show that SSTQ achieves optimal mean squared error scaling while using only $\lceil \log_2 N \rceil + b$ bits per client, where $N = Θ(d)$ is the frame size. We also derive a surrogate privacy-aware codebook objective that reduces the codebook-dependent MSE scaling from $O(4^b)$ to $O(2^b)$. Finally, we empirically evaluate SSTQ against established baselines on federated learning tasks using CIFAR-10 and Fashion-MNIST, demonstrating favorable utility and communication efficiency. Some of the analytical derivations were first obtained using a fully automated Gemini-based agentic system developed internally at Google. The authors have verified those derivations and edited them for clarity of presentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Subsampled Stochastic TurboQuant (SSTQ)，一种在分布式优化中实现局部差分隐私 (local differential privacy) 并保持低通信成本的向量量化框架。SSTQ 结合过完备等范数紧框架 (overcomplete equal-norm tight frames)、坐标子采样与隐私感知的一维量化，包含 Flat Randomized Response 和 Metric-Aware Laplace 两个变体。作者证明 SSTQ 在每客户端仅使用 ⌈log2 N⌉ + b 比特（N=Θ(d) 为框架大小）时达到最优均方误差缩放，并在 CIFAR-10 与 Fashion-MNIST 的联邦学习任务上验证了效用与通信效率。
Motivation: 在分布式优化中同时实现局部差分隐私与低通信成本仍然困难；现有向量量化方法如 vqSGD 依赖高维几何构造，但存在与维度相关的方差，影响隐私-效用权衡。
Method: 提出 SSTQ 框架，将过完备等范数紧框架、坐标子采样与隐私感知的一维量化相结合，并给出 Flat Randomized Response 与 Metric-Aware Laplace 两个变体；还推导了一个替代的隐私感知码本目标函数，将码本相关的 MSE 缩放从 O(4^b) 降至 O(2^b)。
Result: 摘要表明 SSTQ 在仅用 ⌈log2 N⌉ + b 比特每客户端的情况下取得最优均方误差缩放；在 CIFAR-10 和 Fashion-MNIST 的联邦学习任务上相比既有基线展现出更好的效用与通信效率。
Conclusion: 作者认为 SSTQ 提供了一种在隐私约束下兼顾通信效率与量化精度的可行方案，其中 Metric-Aware Laplace 变体更适合更高的码本位宽区间；部分推导由 Google 内部基于 Gemini 的自动化代理系统辅助完成并经过人工验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Unleashing the Potential of Vision-Language Models for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection
papers.abstract_en: Recent work has shown that a simple linear probe on frozen representations from modern vision foundation models (VFMs) can achieve state-of-the-art AIGI detection performance, substantially outperforming specialized detectors in challenging in-the-wild scenarios. This finding has established DINOv3 as the dominant foundation-model baseline for subsequent improvements. However, we find that the vision-language model Perception Encoder (PE) holds greater potential for AIGI detection, because its language-aligned representation preserves high-level provenance semantics. Specifically, PE exhibits stronger local provenance organization than DINOv3 in its frozen feature space. However, semantic-agnostic linear probing fails to exploit this structure, as PE-Linear still underperforms DINOv3-Linear by 4.1% on In-the-Wild. Based on this observation, we propose Semantic Prototype Calibration (SPC), which constructs category prototypes from forensic semantic information and calibrates them with supervised data. We apply SPC to PE and refer to the resulting detector as PE-SPC. Our analysis shows that this simple design achieves stronger generalization. Across cross-generator, post-processing, and in-the-wild benchmarks, PE-SPC surpasses the previous DINOv3 baseline and achieves new state-of-the-art results.

papers.title: An active-learning framework for real-time depth perception from monocular vision streams
papers.abstract_en: Biological visual systems can perceive depth from monocular vision flow, continuously integrating temporal visual cues while maintaining a balance between stability and plasticity in dynamic environments. In contrast, artificial perception models deployed on resource-constrained edge devices are typically trained in a static offline manner and remain frozen after deployment, often suffering severe performance degradation under domain shifts. While large-scale models may encode broad knowledge through massive parameter redundancy, lightweight networks face a static optimization dilemma: forcing compact models to learn universal geometric representations is computationally inefficient and often leads to performance saturation. To resolve this issue, an Online Active Learning (OAL) mechanism is introduced to endow compact neural networks with the capability to adapt continuously during operation. A closed-loop Predict-Evaluate-Correct learning paradigm is established to actively select high-confidence, information-rich signals from streaming visual input. Crucially, Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC) is employed not merely to prevent catastrophic forgetting, but to enforce Selective Plasticity, preserving parameters that encode globally relevant structural knowledge while allowing local alignment to newly observed environments. Built upon a MobileNetV3-Small backbone, the proposed system achieves approximately a 75% reduction in computational cost while maintaining competitive depth estimation accuracy. Experimental results demonstrate that adaptability is not solely determined by model size, but rather by how effectively parameter plasticity is regulated in dynamic environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对资源受限边缘设备上轻量级单目深度感知模型离线静态训练后冻结、域偏移下性能退化的问题，提出在线主动学习（Online Active Learning, OAL）机制，构建 Predict-Evaluate-Correct 闭环学习范式，从流式视觉输入中主动选择高置信、信息丰富的信号进行持续适应，并用弹性权重巩固（Elastic Weight Consolidation, EWC）实现选择性可塑性（Selective Plasticity），保留全局结构知识同时允许局部对齐新环境。基于 MobileNetV3-Small 骨干，计算开销降低约 75%，同时保持有竞争力的深度估计精度。
Motivation: 部署在资源受限边缘设备上的人工感知模型通常离线静态训练并冻结，在域偏移下性能严重退化；轻量级网络学习普适几何表示计算效率低且容易饱和。因此需要让紧凑模型在运行中持续适应动态环境。
Method: 引入在线主动学习机制，建立 Predict-Evaluate-Correct 闭环范式，从流式视觉输入中主动选择高置信、信息丰富的信号；使用 EWC 并非仅防止灾难性遗忘，而是强制选择性可塑性，保留编码全局相关结构知识的参数，同时允许对新环境进行局部对齐。系统基于 MobileNetV3-Small 骨干构建。
Result: 实验表明该系统在保持有竞争力深度估计精度的同时，计算成本降低约 75%；适应性并非由模型大小单独决定，而是取决于动态环境中参数可塑性如何被有效调控。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过在线主动学习与选择性可塑性，轻量级网络能够在部署后持续适应动态环境，为资源受限设备上的实时单目深度感知提供了有效途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: YOLOv14: Adaptive Real-Time Object Detection for Diverse Imaging Conditions
papers.abstract_en: Real-time object detectors achieve remarkable accuracy under controlled conditions, yet degrade sharply on non-ideal inputs: fisheye distortion, game-renderedcharacters, aerial viewpoints, and 360°panoramas. We present YOLOv14, a detection framework with four adaptive mechanisms designed for specific types of inputvariation:(1) Deformable Area-Attention with windowed computation and shiftedwindows for geometric distortion;(2) Multi-level Game2Real Alignment with progressive adversarial training for domain shift;(3) View-Aware Contrastive Learning with adaptive temperature for viewpoint invariance; and (4) Scene-Adaptive Augmentation with dynamic loss balancing for scene diversity. Together, YOLOv14 achieves 49.1 mAP on COCO val2017 at 2.91 ms (T4 GPU), and delivers substantial gains on fisheye (+4.1 mAP), panorama (+6.6 mAP), drone (+6.4 mAP), andour synthesized game-character benchmark (+26.1 mAP). We release code and models to facilitate reproducible research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 YOLOv14，一个针对非理想输入（鱼眼畸变、游戏渲染角色、空中视角、360°全景）的实时目标检测框架，包含四种自适应机制：Deformable Area-Attention、Multi-level Game2Real Alignment、View-Aware Contrastive Learning 和 Scene-Adaptive Augmentation。在 COCO val2017 上达到 49.1 mAP，推理耗时 2.91 ms（T4 GPU），并在鱼眼、全景、无人机和合成游戏角色基准上分别提升 +4.1、+6.6、+6.4 和 +26.1 mAP。作者同时开源代码与模型。
Motivation: 现有实时目标检测器在受控条件下精度高，但在鱼眼畸变、游戏渲染、空中视角和 360° 全景等非理想输入下性能急剧下降，缺乏针对多种输入变化的统一自适应机制。
Method: 提出四种自适应机制：Deformable Area-Attention 采用窗口计算与移动窗口处理几何畸变；Multi-level Game2Real Alignment 通过渐进对抗训练缓解域偏移；View-Aware Contrastive Learning 使用自适应温度学习视角不变性；Scene-Adaptive Augmentation 结合动态损失平衡应对场景多样性。
Result: 在 COCO val2017 上实现 49.1 mAP、2.91 ms（T4 GPU）的实时性能；在鱼眼（+4.1 mAP）、全景（+6.6 mAP）、无人机（+6.4 mAP）和合成游戏角色基准（+26.1 mAP）上均取得显著提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架通过四种自适应机制能够覆盖多种非理想成像条件，并开源代码与模型以支持可复现研究。

papers.title: GEB-Bench: Abstract Structures Told in Many Voices
papers.abstract_en: Can a model look at a river delta and a lightning bolt and see that they share a structure? We introduce GEB-Bench, a benchmark whose unit is an abstract structural motif--self-reference, a strange loop, a Mobius twist--in the spirit of Godel, Escher, Bach. Each motif is told in several voices: a natural scene whose composition is the structure, a folk story whose telling enacts it through a mechanically checkable form device, a mathematical theorem, and a programmatic skeleton; surface parameters are declared nuisance variables and never scored. Motifs, voices, and the structural changes between them form a small cross-modal category, and GEB-Bench's tasks are its questions. Evaluating twelve open and proprietary models, we find that abstraction failure is lawful. The central finding is a gap between recognition and cross-voice mapping: models identify a structure within one voice far better than they carry it across voices; every model pays this tax, and mapping strong enough to narrow it appears only at the frontier tier. Two patterns support it. Errors align more strongly with the designed formal geometry than with measured perceptual geometries, and frontier models from different vendors converge on the same wrong answers; and surface complexity taxes every model that reads structure, with capacity buying headroom rather than immunity. GEB-Bench is fully generative and released with its pipeline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GEB-Bench，一个以抽象结构母题（如自指、怪圈、莫比乌斯扭转）为单元的基准，每个母题以自然场景构图、民间故事、数学定理和程序骨架等多种“声音”呈现，表面参数被声明为 nuisance variables 不计分。作者评估了 12 个开源与闭源模型，发现抽象失败的规律性：模型在单一声音内识别结构的能力远好于跨声音映射能力，所有模型都付出这种“税”，且只有前沿模型能缩小这一差距。基准完全生成式，并随 pipeline 一起发布。
Motivation: 现有基准难以检验模型是否真正抓住跨模态的抽象结构，而不仅仅是表面模式；本文旨在构造以结构母题为单位、多种声音承载同一抽象结构的评测框架。
Method: 以哥德尔-艾舍尔-巴赫 (Gödel, Escher, Bach) 为灵感，将每个抽象结构母题通过自然场景、民间故事、数学定理和程序化骨架四种声音表述，形成小型跨模态范畴，并以其结构变化为任务问题；基准完全生成式并附带生成管线。
Result: 在 12 个开源与闭源模型上的评估显示，识别与跨声音映射之间存在稳定差距：模型在单一声音内的结构识别明显优于跨声音转移；错误与设计的正式几何（formal geometry）而非感知几何更吻合，不同厂商的前沿模型趋向于同样的错误答案；表面复杂度对所有读结构的模型都会造成负担，算力只带来余量而非免疫。
Conclusion: 摘要强调抽象失败是有规律的，跨声音映射是模型普遍的薄弱环节，前沿模型也只能缓解而不能避免这一现象；GEB-Bench 提供了一种可复现的生成式评测途径。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Cross-Layer Interaction under Weight-Space Ablation: A Closed-Form Attention Jacobian Bound and a Test on a Real Pretrained Model
papers.abstract_en: A companion paper studies when activation patching and weight-space ablation agree, inside an idealized model where a conditional computation is carried additively through a residual stream. For the one composition in that model where two carriers are architecturally dependent, an attention head and its own layer's normalization-MLP composition, it derives an exact first-order interaction formula, zero when only the MLP is ablated and second-order bounded when the head is also ablated. That result is confined to a single residual block and checked only on small transformers on a synthetic task. This paper extends the result past both limits. First, the interaction from ablating carriers spanning several layers decomposes exactly into same-block terms, one per touched layer, plus a cross-layer remainder on which the decomposition makes no claim of smallness. Second, we isolate that remainder exactly, for two layers, as a double integral of a mixed second derivative, and name the missing ingredient needed to bound it: a Jacobian bound for the attention sub-block. We derive this bound in closed form and verify it, without a single violation, against Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct's real weights, though we do not yet chain it across layers. We also give, in closed form, the curvature constant the companion paper's bound leaves unexhibited. Third, on that same model, we search for and find an emergent circuit for indirect object identification, never designed into it, using the original activation-patching method for this task, and test collapse, dissociation, and interaction on it. The result is mixed: a shared carrier emerges across all five tested instances, collapse and dissociation hold on most but not all, and a nonzero interaction is measurable on three of five, at layer pairs outside the same-block case the companion theorem covers.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 2 figures. Part II of a two-part series; see the companion paper "A Theory of Conditional Collapse under Low-Rank Weight-Space Ablations" (Part I)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是两篇系列论文的第二部分，研究权重空间消融（weight-space ablation）下跨层交互的封闭形式理论。第一部分在理想化模型中将注意力头与其所在层的归一化-MLP组合视为单一架构依赖载体，并给出单残差块内的一阶交互公式；本工作将该结果扩展到跨层情形，将跨层载体消融的交互分解为逐层同块项加跨层余项，并在两层情形下将余项精确表示为混合二阶导数的二重积分。作者在闭式中推导了注意力子块的 Jacobian 界，并在 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 的真实权重上验证零违反，但尚未跨层链式推广。该文还在同一模型上发现了涌现的间接宾语识别（indirect object identification）电路，并用激活修补测试其坍缩、解离与交互，结果为混合。
Motivation: 第一部分结果仅适用于单个残差块及小规模合成任务，本工作旨在突破这两个限制：处理跨越多层的消融交互，并为界定跨层余项提供可验证的注意力 Jacobian 界。
Method: 方法包含三部分：将跨层载体消融的交互精确分解为逐层同块项加跨层余项；对两层情形把余项写成混合二阶导数的二重积分，并闭式推导注意力子块的 Jacobian 界及曲率常数；在 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 上使用原始激活修补方法搜索间接宾语识别电路并测试坍缩、解离和交互。
Result: 闭式 Jacobian 界在 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 真实权重上无一次违反地通过验证；五个测试实例中出现共享载体，坍缩和解离在大多数但非全部实例上成立，五个实例中的三个在层对上测得非零交互，且这些层对不属于第一部分定理覆盖的同块情形。

papers.title: A Theory of Conditional Collapse under Low-Rank Weight-Space Ablations: I. The Single-Block Theory and Synthetic Validation
papers.abstract_en: Activation patching and weight-space ablation both claim a component is causally responsible for a behavior, yet they act on different objects: one forward pass versus the parameters behind every forward pass. We ask when they agree. We study an idealized model where a conditional computation is carried additively through a residual stream, $F(x)=F_0(x)+\sum_iα_i(x)v_i$, read out by a linear functional, and prove three exact results. First, deleting a subset of carriers collapses a matched input pair onto the same unconditional output \emph{if and only if} the removal is symmetric on the pair and leaves no outside contrast; the error is deterministic, and we give its exact form even when the two conditions hold only approximately. Second, patching a carrier moves the readout by its donor-receiver \emph{contrast}, while ablating it moves the readout by its \emph{absolute level}; neither bounds the other, and we construct pairs where every single-carrier patch flips the decision while no single-carrier ablation does. Third, for an attention head composed with its own layer's normalization and MLP, we derive an exact first-order interaction formula with a provably second-order remainder, vanishing identically when only the MLP is ablated but not, in general, when a head is. Small transformers trained on a synthetic conditional task illustrate all three predictions: across thirty-nine ablation configurations the measured interaction is strongly rank-correlated with the idealized model's predictive accuracy (Spearman $-0.83$), and a second task and architecture reproduces the same pattern, including a further polarity reversal. The single-block interaction result extends past one residual block, and the synthetic validation is tested against a real pretrained model, in a companion paper that takes this theory further along both axes.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 2 figures. Part I of a two-part series; see the companion paper "Cross-Layer Interaction under Weight-Space Ablation" (Part II)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究激活修补（activation patching）与权重空间消融（weight-space ablation）何时给出一致的因果判断。作者在一个加性残差流模型上证明三个精确结果：删除载体子集使配对输入坍缩到同一无条件输出的充要条件、修补与消融分别由对比差和绝对水平驱动、注意力头与其层归一化及MLP组合的一阶交互公式。合成条件任务上的小Transformer实验在39种消融配置中验证了这些预测，测量交互与理想模型预测准确率强相关（Spearman -0.83）。
Motivation: 激活修补和权重消融都声称某组件对行为有因果责任，但二者作用的对象不同——一个是单次前向传播，另一个是所有前向传播背后的参数；论文追问这两种因果归因手段何时一致。
Method: 建立理想化条件计算模型 F(x)=F0(x)+∑α_i(x)v_i，由线性泛函读出。在该模型上推导三种精确结果：子集删除的对称性条件及近似情形下的确定性误差表达式、单载体修补与消融对读出改变量的对比差与绝对水平表达式、以及注意力头与其层归一化及MLP组合的带可证二阶余项的一阶交互公式。使用合成条件任务训练的小Transformer验证理论预测。
Result: 在三十九种消融配置中，实测交互与理想化模型预测准确率的秩相关为Spearman −0.83；另一个任务和架构复现了相同模式，并出现了一次额外的极性反转。摘要还指出单块交互结果可扩展到多个残差块之外。
Conclusion: 摘要将单块交互公式的扩展和真实预训练模型上的验证放在伴生论文（Part II）中，强调该理论在两个方向上继续推进。

papers.title: Provably Learning Multi-Head Attention with Queries
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of learning multi-head softmax attention from black-box input-output access. The learner may query arbitrary real-valued token sequences and observe only the scalar output at the final token. Recent work gives an algorithm using $O(d^2)$ value queries to recover the single-head parameters $(W,v)$. For multiple heads, the same work establishes identifiability under the assumption that the heads occupy pairwise orthogonal subspaces. Applying the single-head recovery algorithm separately to the heads additionally requires bases for these subspaces to be known. We recover a canonical representation by merging heads with the same $W_h$, summing their corresponding $v_h$, and discarding a merged head when this sum is zero, without these subspace assumptions. By varying the number of copies of a token, our algorithm obtains samples of a rational function whose interpolation separates the canonical heads. Additional queries formed by adding selected token vectors then match the same head across different queries. When the oracle outputs and all subsequent computations are exact, the learner chooses its query vectors at random and recovers the canonical pairs $\{(W_h,v_h):h\in[H]\}$ up to permutation with probability one. When $H$ is known, it uses exactly $4Hd^2-2H+1$ value queries of maximum length $2H+1$. If only a known upper bound $H_0$ is available, the algorithm uses $4H_0d^2-2H_0+1$ value queries of maximum length $2H_0+1$. For approximate oracle outputs, we give conditions under which the parameter error is at most a model- and query-dependent constant multiple of the output error. Finally, we extend our result to a one-layer Transformer with multi-head attention followed by a bias-free ReLU feed-forward network. Under additional conditions, we recover a functionally equivalent Transformer without relying on a separate algorithm for learning the feed-forward network.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究从黑盒输入-输出访问中学习多头 softmax 注意力的问题：学习者可查询任意实数 token 序列，仅观察最终 token 的标量输出。作者证明无需既有工作中的成对正交子空间假设，也能恢复 canonical 表示：合并具有相同 W_h 的头部、累加对应 v_h、并在累加和为零时丢弃该合并头。算法在精确 oracle 下以概率 1 恢复 canonical 对，并给出查询复杂度与近似情形下的误差界。
Motivation: 近期工作给出了用 O(d^2) 次值查询恢复单头参数 (W,v) 的算法，但多头情况依赖头部占据成对正交子空间的假设，且分别恢复各头还需要已知这些子空间的基。本文旨在去除这些假设，直接恢复规范化的多头表示。
Method: 通过改变某个 token 的复制次数，算法获得一个有理函数在若干点的采样值，再通过插值分离出各 canonical 头；随后添加由选定 token 向量构成的额外查询，以在不同查询间匹配同一头部。在精确 oracle 下，查询向量随机选择即可恢复 canonical pairs；对近似 oracle，给出参数误差受输出误差常数倍控制的条件。该方法还扩展到带 bias-free ReLU 前馈网络的一层 Transformer。
Result: 当 H 已知时，算法恰好使用 4Hd^2-2H+1 次值查询，最大查询长度为 2H+1；若只知道上界 H_0，则使用 4H_0d^2-2H_0+1 次查询，最大长度 2H_0+1。对近似 oracle 输出，参数误差至多为模型与查询相关的常数倍输出误差。
Conclusion: 摘要强调不依赖正交子空间假设即可恢复注意力的 canonical 表示，并将结果推广到带 ReLU 前馈网络的一层 Transformer，恢复功能等价的模型而无需单独学习前馈网络。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: iFAN: Inference-Aware Learning for Plain Mask Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Query-based mask transformers assemble segmentation outputs through pixel-wise competition among query predictions of the final layer, yet this inference process is not explicitly optimized during training. We identify two key mismatches: the query with the highest probability-mask score does not necessarily produce the most accurate mask, and final-layer decoding may discard superior predictions from intermediate layers. To address these issues, we propose Inference-Aware Learning (iFAN), a general training framework for plain mask transformers. iFAN introduces Adjusted Probability-Mask Ranking (APMR), which aligns query competition with predicted mask quality and suppresses high-confidence but inaccurate competitors. We further employ Cross-Layer Self-Distillation (CLSD) to transfer stronger intermediate predictions to the final layer. The ranking and distillation objectives are training-only, while inference retains efficient final-layer decoding. Experiments on COCO, ADE20K, and Cityscapes demonstrate consistent improvements across panoptic, instance, and semantic segmentation, as well as across different architectures, backbone scales, and input resolutions. Overall, iFAN improves performance by an average of 1.20 PQ, 1.30 AP, and 0.63 mIoU, with negligible additional parameters, FLOPs and inference latency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 iFAN (Inference-Aware Learning)，一种针对普通掩码 Transformer (plain mask transformer) 的通用训练框架。作者指出查询式掩码 Transformer 在推理时通过最终层查询预测之间的像素级竞争来组装分割输出，但这一推理过程并未在训练中被显式优化，存在两个不匹配：概率掩码得分最高的查询不一定产生最准确的掩码，且最终层解码可能丢弃中间层更优的预测。iFAN 通过 Adjusted Probability-Mask Ranking (APMR) 和 Cross-Layer Self-Distillation (CLSD) 在训练时对齐查询竞争与掩码质量，推理时仍保持高效的最终层解码。
Motivation: 查询式掩码 Transformer 的分割输出依赖于最终层查询预测的像素级竞争，但训练过程没有显式优化这一推理机制，导致高置信度但不准确的查询可能胜出，且中间层更优的预测在最终层解码中被丢弃。
Method: 提出 iFAN 训练框架，包含两个训练专用目标：Adjusted Probability-Mask Ranking (APMR) 将查询竞争与预测掩码质量对齐，并抑制高置信度但不准确的竞争者；Cross-Layer Self-Distillation (CLSD) 将中间层更强的预测迁移到最终层。排名与蒸馏目标仅在训练时使用，推理仍采用高效的最终层解码。
Result: 在 COCO、ADE20K 和 Cityscapes 上的实验表明，iFAN 在全景分割 (panoptic segmentation)、实例分割 (instance segmentation) 和语义分割 (semantic segmentation) 上均取得一致提升，且适用于不同架构、骨干网络规模和输入分辨率；平均提升 1.20 PQ、1.30 AP 和 0.63 mIoU，而额外参数量、FLOPs 和推理延迟可忽略。
Conclusion: iFAN 表明训练时期对齐推理竞争机制并蒸馏中间层预测，可以在不改变推理解码结构的前提下提升掩码 Transformer 的分割性能；其收益具有跨任务、跨架构和跨分辨率的泛化性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: LoCA: Forward-Only LLM Tuning after One-Shot Calibration with Local Credit Assignment
papers.abstract_en: Parameter-efficient post-training reduces the number of trainable parameters, but still requires repeated end-to-end backpropagation through the frozen backbone. Every adaptation step therefore needs backward-capable hardware and must store or recompute activations. We ask whether this repeated backward chain can be replaced by a one-time calibration. We introduce Local Credit Assignment (LoCA), a two-stage method for small-shift adaptation. One probe backward pass fits a low-rank map at each transformer block from the final prediction error to a local hidden-state correction. LoCA then reuses these maps to form blockwise regression targets from forward activations and fits low-rank adapters with closed-form ridge solves. No further backbone backward pass is required. We evaluate LoCA on five discriminative benchmarks with Qwen2.5 models from 0.5B to 14B. In 16 of 25 reported task--scale comparisons, LoCA yields lower evaluation cross-entropy than the corresponding LoRA run. Its measured full-run GPU peak, including calibration, is 26--29\% lower than LoRA's. After calibration, its CPU steady-state memory is 36--52\% lower and its per-pass time is 43--48\% lower. A shared scale-normalized candidate set is reused across all tested Qwen2.5 sizes and on SmolLM2-1.7B. LoCA thus amortizes global credit assignment into one calibration and enables later forward-only tuning when repeated backpropagation is impractical. The code associated with this paper is available \href{https://github.com/Xia12121/LoCA}{here}.

Method: LoCA 为两阶段方法：先做一次探测反向传播，为每个 transformer 块拟合一个从最终预测误差到局部隐状态修正的低秩映射；然后复用这些映射，从前向激活生成分块回归目标，用闭式岭回归 (closed-form ridge solve) 拟合低秩适配器。之后的调优不再需要任何骨干网络反向传播。

papers.title: LiveMem: Maintaining Memory State Continuity in Long-Running LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Long-running assistants and agents consume interaction streams that eventually outgrow the context. Existing context retention, summarization, and retrieval preserve access to selected history, but do not provide a persistent state over the full lifecycle when working context changes. We formulate this missing inference capability as \emph{state continuity under context turnover}: carrying computation forward through a fixed-capacity memory state whose lifetime is independent of the active context. We introduce an intrinsic memory method, \textbf{LiveMem}, which augments a pretrained full-attention LLM with a memory state that preserves the historical information over the whole lifecycle while the main attention path retains a bounded KV window. Context turnover and memory state maintaining, memory-oriented post-training, and state-aware serving jointly make this memory state load bearing after its originating tokens are released. Our experiments show that LiveMem achieves leading overall performance among evaluated systems and other intrinsic memory methods. Experiments on LongMemEval show that LiveMem is able to answer the question based on the memory state, even when the supporting evidence has been removed from the current context, and evidence-distance analysis shows that useful information persists beyond the active window. LiveMem thus establishes state continuity as a distinct and complementary abstraction for continual LLM inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长期运行的 LLM 推理提出 LiveMem，一种内在记忆 (intrinsic memory) 方法，通过独立于活动上下文生命周期的固定容量记忆状态实现“上下文更替下的状态连续性”(state continuity under context turnover)。主注意力路径保留有界 KV 窗口，记忆状态由上下文更替维护、面向记忆的后训练 (memory-oriented post-training) 与状态感知服务 (state-aware serving) 联合支撑。实验显示 LiveMem 在评估系统中整体表现领先，在 LongMemEval 上即使支持证据已从当前上下文移除，仍能基于记忆状态回答问题，且证据距离分析表明有用信息持续超出活动窗口。
Motivation: 长期运行的助手和智能体消费交互流，最终会超出上下文长度；现有上下文保留、摘要和检索只能保留对部分历史的访问，无法在活动上下文变化时提供贯穿整个生命周期的持久状态。作者将此缺失的推理能力形式化为上下文更替下的状态连续性。
Method: 为预训练的全注意力 LLM 增加一个记忆状态，用于在完整生命周期内保留历史信息，同时主注意力路径只维护有界 KV 窗口。方法联合使用上下文更替与记忆状态维护、面向记忆的后训练以及状态感知服务，使记忆状态在原始 token 释放后仍承担实际负载。
Result: 摘要报告 LiveMem 在对比的系统中，包括其他内在记忆方法中取得领先的整体性能。在 LongMemEval 上，即使支持性证据已从当前上下文中移除，模型仍能基于记忆状态回答问题；证据距离分析显示有用信息在活动窗口之外持续存在。
Conclusion: 作者认为 LiveMem 将状态连续性确立为持续 LLM 推理中一个独立且互补的抽象。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Homebot: A Personal AI Agent for Conversational Home Assistance and Automation
papers.abstract_en: \texttt{Homebot} is a locally deployable AI agent for conversational household assistance and automation. It accepts voice and instant-messaging requests through a shared runtime that combines language-model responses with registered tools and task-specific skills. The design separates common request processing from session ownership: messaging history remains scoped to a channel and chat, whereas voice interaction is bounded by wake-word activation. For hands-free use, \texttt{Homebot} combines local wake-word detection, streaming speech recognition and synthesis, and an explicit dialogue-state protocol for ending, following up, or continuing a conversation. Clear channel, tool, and skill contracts support practical customization for household use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Homebot 是一个本地可部署的个人 AI 代理，面向家庭对话式助手与自动化。它通过共享运行时同时接受语音和即时消息请求，将语言模型响应与注册的工具及任务技能结合，并将会话所有权与请求处理分离：消息历史限定在 channel 与 chat 内，语音交互由唤醒词边界约束。摘要未报告实验评估，主要贡献在于系统设计与可定制接口。
Motivation: 家庭助手需要本地运行并支持语音与即时消息两种交互方式，同时要处理会话归属与唤醒边界的划分，以便可靠地结束、跟进或继续对话。
Method: 提出共享运行时架构：语言模型响应与注册工具及任务特定技能结合；将请求处理与会话所有权分离，消息历史按 channel 和 chat 限定，语音交互受唤醒词约束。语音通路采用本地唤醒词检测、流式语音识别与合成，以及显式对话状态协议来管理结束、跟进或继续对话。
Conclusion: 摘要强调清晰的 channel、工具和技能契约是支持家庭场景实际定制的关键，Homebot 以此实现本地可部署的家居对话助手与自动化。

papers.title: Ranking Image Fusion the Way Humans Do: A Learned Pairwise Preference Measure for Infrared-Visible Fusion Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Infrared-visible image fusion (IVIF) has no ideal fused reference, so algorithms are ranked by scalar objective metrics that formalize proxies for information transfer, structure, or source similarity. These proxies often disagree with the judgment that ultimately matters: given the same sources, which of two fused results does a human prefer? Direct pairwise comparison is an established protocol for relative subjective assessment, but its cost grows quadratically with the number of algorithms. We present the Learned Perceptual Image Fusion Measure (LPIFM), a source-conditioned model that operationalizes the human A/B/Tie comparison protocol as a repeatable, scalable surrogate. LPIFM jointly observes the two sources and two fused candidates and predicts whether A is better, B is better, or the two are perceptually equivalent. Supervision comes from a new dense preference corpus covering all 6,300 unordered comparisons among 25 fusion methods on the 21 scenes of the VIFB benchmark, labeled under a blinded, randomized, two-stage protocol with expert adjudication. Across scene- and method-generalization settings, LPIFM attains pairwise accuracy of 0.792-0.840 and Spearman correlation of 0.941-0.977 with human-derived tie-aware Bradley-Terry rankings; on full 25-method pools it exceeds the strongest conventional metric by 0.163-0.211 in accuracy. Its verdicts are also antisymmetric under candidate swap, free of preference cycles, and fully transitive, matching or exceeding the internal consistency of the human panel. We publicly release the dataset, model weights, and code. LPIFM offers a practical instrument for human-aligned comparison and ranking of IVIF methods at scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对红外-可见光图像融合（IVIF）评估中客观指标与人类主观偏好不一致的问题，提出一种学得的成对偏好度量 LPIFM（Learned Perceptual Image Fusion Measure）。该模型以双源图像和两个融合候选为输入，预测 A 优于 B、B 优于 A 或两者感知等价，并基于 VIFB 基准上 25 种融合方法、21 个场景的全部 6300 组无序比较构建的密集偏好语料进行监督。结果表明其在场景泛化和方法泛化设置下的成对准确率达 0.792-0.840，与人类 Bradley-Terry 排名的 Spearman 相关达 0.941-0.977，并具有反对称、无偏好循环、完全传递的一致性。
Motivation: 红外-可见光图像融合没有理想的参考图，现有标量客观指标只代理信息传递、结构或源相似性，常与人类对两个融合结果的实际偏好不一致；直接成对比较虽是人因评估的标准协议，但成本随算法数量二次增长。
Method: 提出 LPIFM，一种源条件模型（source-conditioned model），它将人类的 A/B/Tie 成对比较协议实现为可重复、可扩展的替代品；模型联合观察两个源和两个融合候选，输出三类偏好判断。监督数据来自新的密集偏好语料库，覆盖 VIFB 基准 21 个场景上 25 种融合方法的所有 6300 组无序比较，并采用盲法、随机化、两阶段标注和专家裁决。
Result: 在场景和方法泛化设置下，LPIFM 的成对准确率为 0.792-0.840，与人类 tie-aware Bradley-Terry 排名的 Spearman 相关系数为 0.941-0.977；在完整 25 方法池上，其准确率超过最强常规指标 0.163-0.211。其判断在候选交换下反对称、无偏好循环且完全传递，达到或超过人类评审团的一致性。
Conclusion: 作者认为 LPIFM 提供了一种实用工具，可在大规模上实现与人类一致的 IVIF 方法比较与排名，并公开了数据集、模型权重和代码。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: WAM-Diff2: Hierarchical AR-to-Diffusion Distillation for Highly Efficient Autonomous Driving VLA
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a prominent paradigm for end-to-end autonomous driving; however, their efficient deployment is severely constrained by high computational latency and exposure bias arising from sequential autoregressive decoding. Conversely, while specialized diffusion policies enable low-latency, parallel execution, training them from scratch typically yields narrow, single-task architectures that lack holistic visual-linguistic reasoning. Successfully transforming pre-trained autoregressive generalists into parallel diffusion models could combine multi-task cognitive intelligence with execution efficiency, yet this transition presents a formidable architectural challenge due to mismatched attention patterns (causal versus bidirectional) and divergent optimization objectives. To bridge this divide, we introduce WAM-Diff2, a multi-task discrete diffusion VLA framework powered by a three-stage hierarchical distillation strategy. By structuring the architectural shift through progressive block-wise adaptation, block-wise distillation, and model-wise cross-scale distillation, WAM-Diff2 preserves the underlying semantic foundations of the base model while accelerating inference. Extensive evaluations across driving understanding, perception, and planning benchmarks demonstrate that WAM-Diff2 effectively mitigates exposure bias and achieves performance parity with autoregressive baselines. Crucially, the autoregressive-to-diffusion transition yields a 2.8x decoding speedup, which scales to an ultimate 15.1x acceleration when combined with system-level optimizations including FlashInfer and CUDA Graphs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WAM-Diff2，一个多任务离散扩散 VLA 框架，通过三阶段层级蒸馏策略将预训练的自回归通用模型转化为并行扩散模型。摘要报告该方法在驾驶理解、感知和规划基准上缓解了暴露偏差（exposure bias），并与自回归基线达到性能持平，同时解码加速 2.8 倍，结合 FlashInfer 和 CUDA Graphs 等系统级优化后加速可达 15.1 倍。
Motivation: 自回归 VLA 模型因顺序解码产生高计算延迟和暴露偏差，而扩散策略虽支持低延迟并行执行，但从头训练难以获得多任务视觉-语言推理能力。将预训练自回归通用模型转化为并行扩散模型面临因果注意力与双向注意力不匹配、优化目标不一致等架构挑战。
Method: 提出三阶段层级蒸馏策略：渐进式块级适应（progressive block-wise adaptation）、块级蒸馏（block-wise distillation）和模型级跨尺度蒸馏（model-wise cross-scale distillation），以此实现从自回归到离散扩散的结构转换，并保留基础模型的语义基础。
Result: 在驾驶理解、感知和规划基准上，WAM-Diff2 缓解暴露偏差并与自回归基线性能持平；模型转换带来 2.8 倍解码加速，叠加 FlashInfer 和 CUDA Graphs 系统级优化后可达到 15.1 倍整体加速。

papers.title: ODEWorld: A Continuous Predictive Architecture via Physical-Time Flow
papers.abstract_en: In the physical world we inhabit, space and time are fundamentally continuous. However, existing machine learning paradigms for world modeling are largely confined to discrete-time prediction, thereby exhibiting significant inefficiency in capturing the dynamics of physical world. We introduce Physical-Time Flow (PT-Flow), a novel approach that learns a continuous latent velocity field operating in physical time. Crucially, the underlying dynamics of sequential data are parameterized by an ordinary differential equation (ODE) embedded in a well-structured representation space. Under this paradigm, the prediction of future can be recast as temporal integration via an ODE solver in the compressed latent space. Building upon PT-Flow, we construct ODEWorld, a continuous-time latent world model that is both efficient and versatile. By extracting time-variant features and enforcing ODE properties on both the dynamical representation space and the latent velocity field, ODEWorld effectively addresses the long-standing representation collapse issue in latent world model literature. This also enables high-quality image reconstruction even after long-horizon prediction. Moreover, its continuous nature allows for arbitrary temporal resolution and even backward prediction, which is impossible for most discrete-time models. Lastly, ODEWorld can provide rich planning-oriented information to facilitate downstream policy learning. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that ODEWorld successfully reconciles planning-conducive dynamics abstraction with visual realism, excelling in both video generation and robotic control. Project page: https://odeworld.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Physical-Time Flow (PT-Flow)，将序列数据的潜在动力学建模为物理时间中的连续速度场，并用常微分方程 (ODE) 参数化，进而构建连续时间潜在世界模型 ODEWorld。通过提取时变特征并在动力学表示空间与潜在速度场上施加 ODE 约束，ODEWorld 缓解了潜在世界模型中的表示坍缩问题，支持任意时间分辨率预测和逆向预测。实验表明其在视频生成与机器人控制任务上同时兼顾规划友好的动力学抽象与视觉真实感。
Motivation: 现有机器学习世界模型大多局限于离散时间预测，在捕捉物理世界连续时空动力学时效率显著不足。
Method: PT-Flow 学习一个在物理时间中运行的连续潜在速度场，将未来预测转化为在压缩潜在空间中通过 ODE 求解器进行的时间积分；ODEWorld 在此基础上提取时变特征，并对动力学表示空间和潜在速度场施加 ODE 性质约束。
Result: 摘要报告 ODEWorld 有效解决潜在世界模型中长期存在的表示坍缩问题，即便在长时程预测后仍能保持高质量的图像重建，并在视频生成和机器人控制实验中表现优异。
Conclusion: 连续时间特性使模型支持任意时间分辨率甚至逆向预测，这是大多数离散时间模型无法实现的；ODEWorld 旨在兼顾规划导向的动力学抽象与视觉真实感。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: FinanceHarness: Autonomous Financial Deep Research Framework
papers.abstract_en: Powered by advances in LLMs and autonomous agents, deep research has become one of the most widely adopted agentic products. However, most deep research systems write general-purpose reports, which are inadequate for financial deep research. Financial research demands specialized knowledge to analyze historical patterns and forecast upcoming events. Automating financial deep research therefore requires both a layered harness to drive the research agent and a verifiable, point-in-time benchmark that prevents leakage of future information. We present FinanceHarness, a harness that runs finance-oriented tools and practitioner-guided workflows, automating financial deep research end to end: environment and data construction, the agent execution loop, and reward modeling. We further propose FinanceGym, comprising thesis-driven research questions and rubrics that combine pre-cutoff and post-cutoff criteria. Professional expert validation yields an 82% pass rate. With the same open-weight backbone, FinanceHarness improves the overall rubric score from 25.3% to 32.4%, demonstrating the effectiveness of our specialized harness design. However, even pairing FinanceHarness with the most cutting edge LLM (e.g. Opus-5), the FinanceGym score is below 45%, showing that it is a challenging benchmark for financial deep research. Leaderboard is available at: https://financegym.github.io/ and FinanceHarness code is available at: https://github.com/Yijia-Xiao/FinanceHarness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FinanceHarness，一个面向金融深度研究的自动化框架，包含金融专用工具、从业者引导的工作流、环境与数据构建、智能体执行循环和奖励建模；同时提出 FinanceGym 基准，包含以论点驱动的研究问题与结合截止前/截止后标准的评分细则。摘要报告专家验证通过率 82%，在同开源权重骨干下将总体评分从 25.3% 提升至 32.4%，但最先进模型得分仍低于 45%。
Motivation: 大多数深度研究系统生成通用报告，难以满足金融研究对历史模式分析与事件预测的专业需求；自动化金融深度研究还需要防止未来信息泄露的可验证、时点 (point-in-time) 基准。
Method: 提出分层 harness 来驱动研究智能体，实现端到端自动化：环境与数据构建、智能体执行循环与奖励建模；并用 FinanceGym 提供基于论点的研究问题和结合 cutoff 前后标准的评分细则。
Result: 专业专家验证显示 82% 通过率；在相同开源权重骨干下，FinanceHarness 将总体 rubric 得分从 25.3% 提高到 32.4%；即便搭配最先进的 LLM（如 Opus-5），FinanceGym 得分仍低于 45%，说明该基准具有挑战性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调专用 harness 设计对金融深度研究的有效性，同时指出 FinanceGym 仍是挑战性基准，当前最强模型也尚未达到高分。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Can AI agents conduct open-ended AI research? Early evidence from two case studies
papers.abstract_en: Forecasts of explosive AI progress hinge on AI agents automating AI research. But evidence on whether agents can carry out open-ended AI research is thin. Current evaluations either test agents on narrow, verifiable tasks, which excludes open-ended research, or submit AI-generated papers to blind peer review, which is overstretched, stochastic, and suffers from poor review quality. We introduce a third way to measure progress towards AI R\&D automation. An agent takes on the central, open-ended research question of a high-quality unpublished paper, and the paper's original authors grade its output. We call these shadow evaluations. We ran shadow evaluations on two unpublished NeurIPS 2026 submissions, giving frontier agents six days and thousands of dollars of compute. The agents completed all of the engineering without human help, yet could not make substantial progress towards answering the research questions. As a result, both papers were unambiguously rejected by the authors. We identify five recurring failure modes: poor judgment about the bar for publishable research, uncreative responses to shortcomings in the research design, ineffective backtracking from dead ends, poor resource awareness, and instruction drift. A robustness check with a second model and scaffold reproduced these failures. We release the expert reviews, survey responses, agent repositories, and logs. Our results provide early evidence that today's agents can do the engineering of AI research, but struggle with critical parts of the research lifecycle.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种衡量 AI 研发自动化进展的第三类评估方法——影子评估 (shadow evaluation)：让智能体接手一篇高质量未发表论文的核心开放性研究问题，并由原论文作者对其产出打分。作者在两个未发表的 NeurIPS 2026 投稿上进行了影子评估，给予前沿智能体六天时间和数千美元计算资源。结果显示智能体能在无人帮助下完成全部工程任务，但无法在研究问题上取得实质性进展，两篇论文均被原作者明确拒绝。
Motivation: 现有评估要么局限在狭窄、可验证的任务上，排除了开放性研究；要么依赖盲审，而盲审过载、随机且评审质量差。该文希望提供一种衡量向 AI 研发自动化进展的新途径。
Method: 提出影子评估范式：选取高质量未发表论文的核心研究问题作为任务，让智能体独立开展工作，并由论文原作者对产出进行评判。作者在两个 NeurIPS 2026 投稿上运行评估，并额外用第二种模型和脚手架 (scaffold) 做了稳健性检验。
Result: 智能体在两例中均完成了全部工程实现，但未能对研究问题作出实质性推进，两篇论文都被原作者明确拒绝。作者归纳出五个反复出现的失败模式：对可发表研究标准的判断力差、对研究设计缺陷的回应缺乏创造性、从死胡同中回溯无效、资源意识差以及指令漂移 (instruction drift)。稳健性检验复现了这些失败。
Conclusion: 这些结果提供了早期证据：当前智能体能完成 AI 研究中的工程部分，但在研究生命周期的关键环节上仍存在困难。作者发布了专家评审、调查回复、智能体代码仓库和日志以支持进一步研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PRISM-Net: Patient-specific reference-guided inter-breast symmetry matching for three-class breast DCE-MRI classification
papers.abstract_en: Breast DCE-MRI AI is increasingly being explored for breast-level classification of no-lesion, benign, and malignant findings, beyond conventional lesion-centered diagnosis. Within this broader diagnostic scope, however, patient-specific background variability remains a major source of imaging confounding across classification tasks. Existing approaches predominantly focus on unilateral or lesion-centric analysis, whereas bilateral methods offer limited explicit modeling of spatially adaptive cross-breast correspondence. We propose PRISM-Net, a registration-free bilateral framework that leverages contralateral breast features as patient-specific references for background-aware representation learning. PRISM-Net integrates bilateral feature matching and asymmetry-aware attention to establish adaptive inter-breast correspondence and enhance representations of discriminative asymmetric patterns. On ODELIA, Macro AUC, Micro AUC, and quadratic weighted kappa were $84.11 \pm 2.33$, $90.64 \pm 1.61$, and $60.94 \pm 5.64$ on the in-distribution test set, and $68.51 \pm 4.54$, $80.74 \pm 2.68$, and $43.45 \pm 7.10$ on the held-out institution, respectively, outperforming the evaluated baseline methods across the primary evaluation metrics. PRISM-Net further demonstrated performance on independent institutional and background-complexity evaluations. Ablation experiments revealed that both bilateral relation modeling and asymmetry-aware reweighting contributed to improved classification performance. These findings highlight patient-specific bilateral reference modeling as a clinically grounded strategy for DCE-MRI interpretation, improving asymmetric pattern discrimination through explicit modeling of background complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PRISM-Net，一种免配准 (registration-free) 的双侧乳腺 DCE-MRI 分类框架，利用对侧乳腺特征作为患者特定参考进行背景感知表示学习，用于无病灶、良性、恶性三类乳腺水平分类。摘要报告在 ODELIA 数据集上，in-distribution 测试集 Macro AUC 为 84.11±2.33、Micro AUC 为 90.64±1.61、二次加权 kappa 为 60.94±5.64，held-out 机构上分别为 68.51±4.54、80.74±2.68、43.45±7.10，均优于所评估的基线方法。
Motivation: 现有乳腺 DCE-MRI 分类主要局限于单侧或病灶中心分析，双侧方法对空间自适应的跨乳腺对应关系建模不足；患者特定背景变异是跨分类任务的主要影像混淆因素，需要显式建模背景复杂度的双侧框架。
Method: 提出免配准双侧框架 PRISM-Net，集成双侧特征匹配 (bilateral feature matching) 与不对称感知注意力 (asymmetry-aware attention)，建立自适应跨乳腺对应关系，并增强判别性不对称模式的特征表示。
Result: 在 ODELIA 数据集上，in-distribution 测试集 Macro AUC、Micro AUC、二次加权 kappa 分别为 84.11±2.33、90.64±1.61、60.94±5.64；held-out 机构上分别为 68.51±4.54、80.74±2.68、43.45±7.10，在主要评价指标上优于基线。消融实验表明双侧关系建模与不对称感知重加权均有助于分类性能提升。
Conclusion: 患者特定双侧参考建模是一种临床上有依据的 DCE-MRI 解读策略，通过显式建模背景复杂度改进不对称模式判别；摘要强调该方法在独立机构与背景复杂度评估中的表现及临床意义。
Relevance: 0
