summary_sections.method: 提出免配准双侧框架 PRISM-Net，集成双侧特征匹配 (bilateral feature matching) 与不对称感知注意力 (asymmetry-aware attention)，建立自适应跨乳腺对应关系，并增强判别性不对称模式的特征表示。
summary_sections.result: 在 ODELIA 数据集上，in-distribution 测试集 Macro AUC、Micro AUC、二次加权 kappa 分别为 84.11±2.33、90.64±1.61、60.94±5.64；held-out 机构上分别为 68.51±4.54、80.74±2.68、43.45±7.10，在主要评价指标上优于基线。消融实验表明双侧关系建模与不对称感知重加权均有助于分类性能提升。
summary_sections.conclusion: 患者特定双侧参考建模是一种临床上有依据的 DCE-MRI 解读策略，通过显式建模背景复杂度改进不对称模式判别；摘要强调该方法在独立机构与背景复杂度评估中的表现及临床意义。

papers.title: F(AI)2R: Who Did What, and Who Checked? Verifiable AI Provenance as an Executable Skill
papers.abstract_en: F(AI)2R is FAIR research with AI in the loop, twice: an AI-assisted authoring pass and a machine-readable audit pass over every artefact. AI systems now draft, refactor, and verify research artefacts, yet their contributions are rarely recorded in a form a later human or machine can audit. Building on the original F(AI)2R experiment, we generalize its provenance model beyond scholarly writing into aiprov, a PROV-O extension covering any AI-in-the-loop artefact, and we package the method as an executable skill that an AI agent operates itself: setup asks the human operator for their ORCID ID, resolves their identity from the public registry, and scaffolds continuous integration that gates every push on graph conformance and publishes the current build of this very paper. The paper is its own case study. Every activity, claim, and source in its production is recorded in the repository's provenance graph under two invariants: no parentless claim, and verification rungs that only humans may grant.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 F(AI)2R，即 AI 参与两轮的 FAIR 研究：一轮 AI 辅助写作，一轮机器可读审计。作者将原有 F(AI)2R 实验中的溯源模型推广为 aiprov——一个覆盖任意 AI-in-the-loop 制品的 PROV-O 扩展，并将方法打包成可由 AI 代理自行操作的可执行技能。论文本身就是其案例研究，其生产过程中的每个活动、声明和来源都被记录在仓库的溯源图中，并遵循两条不变量：无无父声明（no parentless claim），以及只有人类才能授予的验证等级（verification rungs）。
Motivation: AI 系统现在会起草、重构和验证研究制品，但它们的贡献很少以可供后续人类或机器审计的形式被记录下来，这导致 AI 参与的研究过程缺乏可追溯性。
Method: 在原始 F(AI)2R 实验基础上，将溯源模型从学术写作推广为 aiprov（PROV-O 扩展），覆盖任意 AI-in-the-loop 制品；并打包为可执行技能：设置阶段要求人类操作者提供 ORCID ID、从公开注册表解析身份，并搭建持续集成（CI），每次推送都以图一致性（graph conformance）为门禁，同时发布当前构建的论文本身。
Result: 论文自身作为案例研究，其生产过程中的所有活动、声明和来源均记录于仓库溯源图，并满足两条不变量：无无父声明，以及只有人类才能授予的验证等级。
Conclusion: 该工作的要点是将 AI 溯源模型从学术写作推广到任意 AI-in-the-loop 制品，并以可执行技能的形式让 AI 代理自主运维；摘要未明确讨论局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Neurai-VN Benchmark: Standardized Machine Learning Models for Multimodal Digital Phenotyping in Mental Health Classification
papers.abstract_en: Digital phenotyping (DP) using smartphones and wearable devices has shown considerable potential for mental health monitoring. However, progress remains difficult to evaluate due to heterogeneous datasets, inconsistent preprocessing pipelines. In this work, we present a reproducible benchmark built upon the Neurai-VN dataset, a high-resolution, multimodal dataset comprising passive sensing and active assessment from wearable and smartphone devices, collected from 100 Vietnamese adults over two weeks. We define four binary classification tasks evaluated using standardized subject-wise cross-validation. Representative linear, tree-based, and neural baseline models are evaluated systematically across predefined feature-group configurations. Mean subject-level F1 scores across five cross-validation folds reached 0.71 for Healthy Control vs. Depression and Healthy Control vs. Clinical, while Healthy Control vs. Anxiety and Depression vs. Anxiety achieved 0.69 and 0.56, respectively. These baseline results provide reproducible baselines for future research on multimodal DP for mental health classification tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于 Neurai-VN 数据集的可复现基准，用于心理健康分类中的多模态数字表型分析（digital phenotyping）。该数据集包含从 100 名越南成年人两周内采集的可穿戴设备和智能手机被动感知与主动评估数据。作者定义了四个二分类任务，采用标准化的 subject-wise 交叉验证，系统评估线性、树模型和神经网络基线模型。五折交叉验证的平均 subject-level F1 分数在 Healthy Control vs Depression 和 Healthy Control vs Clinical 上达到 0.71，在 Healthy Control vs Anxiety 和 Depression vs Anxiety 上分别为 0.69 和 0.56。
Motivation: 基于智能手机和可穿戴设备的数字表型分析在心理健康监测中显示出潜力，但异构数据集和不一致的预处理流程使得进展难以评估，缺乏可复现的基准。
Method: 基于 Neurai-VN 多模态数据集定义四个二分类心理健康分类任务，采用标准化的 subject-wise 交叉验证，并在预定义的特征组配置上系统比较线性、树模型和神经网络基线模型。
Result: 五折交叉验证的平均 subject-level F1 分数：Healthy Control vs Depression 与 Healthy Control vs Clinical 均为 0.71，Healthy Control vs Anxiety 为 0.69，Depression vs Anxiety 为 0.56。
Conclusion: 这些基线结果为未来多模态数字表型分析心理健康分类研究提供了可复现的参考基线。

papers.title: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Kimi K3, a 2.8T parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 104 billion activated parameters, native vision capabilities, and a 1-million-token context window. Kimi K3 is built on Kimi Delta Attention and Attention Residuals, which improve information flow across sequence length and model depth. Together with Stable LatentMoE, which effectively activates 16 of 896 routed experts per token, and refined training and data recipes, these advances yield an approximately 2.5x improvement in overall scaling efficiency over Kimi K2. Post-training highlights reinforcement learning across general, agentic, and coding domains and multiple reasoning-effort levels, enabling compositional generalization and robust long-horizon execution. At 2.8T scale, Kimi K3 is supported by infrastructure advances in multiple areas: algorithm-system co-design for KDA, perfectly balanced expert-parallel training with efficient memory management, million-token agentic RL with persistent rollout and sandbox states, and deployment innovations. Extensive evaluations show that Kimi K3 achieves frontier-level performance across long-horizon coding, agentic, knowledge, reasoning, and vision tasks. While its overall performance still trails the most powerful proprietary models, namely Claude Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol, Kimi K3 consistently outperforms other open and proprietary models evaluated in our suite. We release the full Kimi K3 model weights to facilitate future research and accelerate the broader deployment and adoption of frontier intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是 Kimi K3 的技术报告：一个 2.8T 参数的混合专家 (Mixture-of-Experts) 模型，激活参数 104B，具备原生视觉能力和 1M token 上下文窗口。模型基于 Kimi Delta Attention 与 Attention Residuals 改善序列长度和模型深度上的信息流动，结合 Stable LatentMoE（每 token 激活 896 个 routed experts 中的 16 个）以及精炼的训练和数据配方，整体扩展效率约为 Kimi K2 的 2.5 倍。后训练涵盖通用、智能体 (agentic) 和编码领域的强化学习及多种推理努力水平，并在长程编码、智能体、知识、推理和视觉任务上达到前沿水平。
Motivation: 目标是在开源社区推动前沿智能 (frontier intelligence) 的发展，同时通过架构和训练改进提升大规模 MoE 模型的扩展效率与长程任务能力。
Method: 提出 Kimi K3 架构，核心包括 Kimi Delta Attention (KDA)、Attention Residuals 和 Stable LatentMoE，并配合算法-系统协同设计、完美均衡的专家并行训练、支持百万 token 智能体 RL 的持久 rollout 与 sandbox 状态，以及部署层面的创新。
Result: 摘要报告整体扩展效率相比 Kimi K2 提升约 2.5 倍；Kimi K3 在长程编码、智能体、知识、推理和视觉任务上达到前沿水平，整体表现仍落后于 Claude Fable 5 和 GPT-5.6 Sol，但优于评测套件中其他开源和专有模型。
Conclusion: 作者强调 Kimi K3 仍不及最强专有模型，但作为开放前沿模型在多个任务上表现领先，并已发布完整模型权重以促进后续研究和部署。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SARATR-X-v2: Scale-Aware Structural Pre-Training for SAR Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Masked image modeling has become a dominant paradigm for SAR pre-training, yet the design of the reconstruction target remains fundamentally unsettled. This article argues that a SAR pre-training target should satisfy two conditions to produce transferable representations: (i) physics-grounded stability, i.e., approximate invariance of the target operator to multiplicative speckle inherent in coherent imaging; and (ii) semantic scale compatibility, i.e., coverage of the heterogeneous spatial scales that downstream tasks demand. These two conditions are individually achievable but jointly difficult: physics-grounded stability favors fixed operators, while semantic scale compatibility favors data-driven composition. To this end, SARATR-X-v2 reconciles both within a single design. The target is constructed through fixed structural extractors spanning six receptive fields, from blind-spot local aggregation to directional log-ratio region contrast, and fused via learnable weights into one unified supervision signal for masked reconstruction. On twelve SAR benchmarks across classification, detection, and segmentation, SARATR-X-v2 achieves state-of-the-art transfer performance. Under synthetic speckle variation, the proposed target reduces perturbation drift in the learned representation by nearly two orders of magnitude relative to pixel-space supervision. Taken together, these results establish physics-grounded stability and semantic scale compatibility as a principled framework for pre-training target design under coherent imaging, and suggest that effective SAR pre-training is not about reconstructing more signal, but about reconstructing the right structural target.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SARATR-X-v2，一种面向 SAR 基础模型的尺度感知结构预训练方法。作者论证 SAR 预训练重构目标应同时满足物理稳定性（对相干成像固有的乘性散斑近似不变）与语义尺度兼容性（覆盖下游任务所需的不同空间尺度），并用固定结构提取器（覆盖六个感受野，从盲点局部聚合到方向对数比区域对比）经可学习权重融合为统一监督信号。在分类、检测、分割三个方向的十二个 SAR 基准上取得最优迁移性能，并在合成散斑扰动下将表征漂移较像素空间监督降低近两个数量级。
Motivation: 掩码图像建模已成为 SAR 预训练的主流范式，但重构目标的设计仍未定论；此前目标难以同时兼顾物理稳定性与语义尺度兼容性，导致迁移表征受限。
Method: 通过固定结构提取器构造重构目标，覆盖六种感受野并利用可学习权重融合为统一的掩码重建监督信号，从而在同一设计中兼顾散斑不变性与多尺度语义。
Result: 在十二个 SAR 基准（分类、检测、分割）上取得 state-of-the-art 迁移性能；在合成散斑变化下，相比像素空间监督，表征的扰动漂移降低约两个数量级。
Conclusion: 作者提出将物理稳定性与语义尺度兼容性作为相干成像下预训练目标设计的框架，并强调 SAR 预训练的关键不是重建更多信号，而是重建正确的结构目标。

papers.title: IFCLoRA: Topology-Aware Rank Allocation for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is a widely used approach to parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) of LLMs whose effectiveness depends on rank allocation. Existing adaptive LoRA methods derive ranks from local gradient, activation, or matrix statistics collected before or during fine-tuning; training-time variants add overhead, and local signals reveal little about each module's structural role in information propagation, giving weak global grounding for scarce-capacity allocation. We propose IFCLoRA, a topology-aware method for pre-fine-tuning rank allocation and adapter initialization. Using a small calibration set, IFCLoRA performs intervention tracing on the frozen model and constructs a sparse task-conditioned interaction graph over LoRA target modules. From this graph it extracts a global information-flow topology prior and fuses it with each node's local gradient sensitivity to form a topology-dominant Information-Flow Centrality (IFC) score, measuring participation in task-conditioned multi-hop propagation. The IFC scores then serve as module-level routing signals for one-shot discrete rank allocation under a rank-budget constraint. Reusing response vectors from tracing, IFCLoRA constructs a function-preserving flow-response subspace initialization, giving adapters task-relevant output subspaces. Across all settings, IFCLoRA achieves higher mean scores than standard LoRA with comparable fine-tuning time and peak memory; it requires a one-time offline calibration stage. On GSM8K, IFCLoRA attains the highest mean accuracy among compared PEFT methods on both base models, exceeding standard LoRA by 4.75 percentage points on LLaMA-3.1-8B. Resulting rank allocations are non-uniform and vary across tasks and base models, suggesting that task-conditioned global information-flow topology can serve as a useful structural prior for rank allocation in low-budget PEFT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IFCLoRA，一种面向 LoRA 参数高效微调 (PEFT) 的拓扑感知的预训练前秩分配与适配器初始化方法。该方法用小型校准集在冻结模型上做干预追踪 (intervention tracing)，构建 LoRA 目标模块上的稀疏任务条件交互图，提取全局信息流拓扑先验并将其与局部梯度敏感性融合为信息流中心性 (Information-Flow Centrality, IFC) 分数，用于在秩预算约束下进行一次性的离散秩分配；同时复用追踪响应向量构建保持函数映射的流响应子空间初始化。摘要报告该方法在多数设置下比标准 LoRA 获得更高平均分数，且微调时间与峰值内存相当，只需一次性离线校准。
Motivation: 现有自适应 LoRA 方法依赖局部梯度、激活或矩阵统计来分配秩，训练期变体带来额外开销，而局部信号难以反映各模块在信息传播中的结构角色，导致稀缺容量分配缺乏全局依据。
Method: IFCLoRA 在冻结模型上用小校准集进行干预追踪，构建任务条件的稀疏交互图并提取全局信息流拓扑先验；将该先验与节点局部梯度敏感性融合成 IFC 分数，作为模块级路由信号在秩预算约束下进行一次性离散秩分配，并利用追踪响应向量构建保持函数映射的流响应子空间初始化。
Result: 摘要报告 IFCLoRA 在所有设置下平均分数均高于标准 LoRA，且微调时间与峰值内存相当；在 GSM8K 上于两个基础模型上均取得所比较 PEFT 方法中最高的平均准确率，其中在 LLaMA-3.1-8B 上比标准 LoRA 高 4.75 个百分点。所得秩分配呈非均匀分布，并随任务和基础模型变化。
Conclusion: 作者认为任务条件的全局信息流拓扑可以作为低预算 PEFT 秩分配的有效结构先验；该方法需要一次性离线校准阶段。

papers.title: OpenForgeRL: Train Harness-native Agents in Any Environment
papers.abstract_en: Modern AI agents rely on elaborate inference harnesses such as Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw to drive multi-turn reasoning, tool use, and access to external systems. While powerful, these complex harnesses also make agents hard to train end-to-end with open infrastructure, whose SFT/RL stacks cannot natively express stateful, multi-process harness inference. To address this, we present OpenForgeRL, an open-source framework for training harness-based agents end-to-end in diverse environments. OpenForgeRL achieves this with a lightweight proxy that serves the harness's model calls while recording them as training data for a standard RL codebase (e.g., veRL), and a Kubernetes orchestrator that runs each rollout in its own remote container, together enabling training on any harness in any environment at scale. By decoupling training and inference, OpenForgeRL allows researchers to easily train, study, and improve agents directly in the real harnesses and environments they are deployed with. We validate our framework across diverse, complex harnesses and environments, spanning tool/claw-based agents and multimodal GUI browser- and computer-use agents. Using only hundreds to a few thousand tasks, OpenForgeClaw reaches 31.7 pass^3 and 55.9 pass@3 on ClawEval and 33.7 on QwenClawBench. OpenForgeGUI reaches 37.7 on OSWorld-Verified, 63.0 on Online-Mind2Web, and 72.3 on WebVoyager. Both outperform open baselines of similar size on nearly all benchmarks, and in the GUI setting match or surpass models several times larger. Beyond benchmarks, we analyze how harness choice (e.g., ZeroClaw, OpenClaw, Codex) and RL shape agent behavior. We find that some harnesses are substantially harder to learn than others, and that RL improves agentic reliability, such as self-verification, tool coverage, and completing multi-step plans, though critical abilities such as error recovery remain weak.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OpenForgeRL，一个开源框架，用于在多种环境中对基于推理 harness 的智能体进行端到端训练。其核心是一个轻量代理，将 harness 的模型调用记录为标准 RL 代码库（如 veRL）的训练数据，并用 Kubernetes 编排器让每次 rollout 在独立远程容器中运行，从而实现训练与推理的解耦。作者在工具/claw 类智能体和多模态 GUI 浏览器/电脑使用智能体上验证了该框架，报告了多个基准上的性能并与开源基线及更大模型进行了比较。
Motivation: 现代 AI 智能体依赖 Claude Code、Codex、OpenClaw 等复杂推理 harness 来驱动多轮推理、工具使用和外部系统访问，但这些有状态、多进程的 harness 推理难以被现有开源 SFT/RL 训练栈原生表达，导致这类智能体难以用开放基础设施端到端训练。
Method: OpenForgeRL 采用一个轻量代理来代理 harness 的模型调用，同时将调用记录为训练数据供标准 RL 代码库使用；配合 Kubernetes 编排器在独立远程容器中运行每个 rollout，从而支持在任意 harness、任意环境中大规模训练。该方法将训练与推理解耦，使研究者能直接在部署所用的真实 harness 与环境中训练和改善智能体。
Result: 在 ClawEval 上 OpenForgeClaw 达到 31.7 pass^3 和 55.9 pass@3，在 QwenClawBench 上达到 33.7；OpenForgeGUI 在 OSWorld-Verified、Online-Mind2Web、WebVoyager 上分别达到 37.7、63.0、72.3。两者在几乎所有基准上都超过相似规模的开源基线，其中 GUI 设置下能匹敌或超过数倍规模的模型。
Conclusion: 作者认为解耦训练与推理可让研究者直接在真实 harness 和环境中训练智能体；分析显示不同 harness（如 ZeroClaw、OpenClaw、Codex）的学习难度差异很大，RL 能提升自我验证、工具覆盖和多步计划完成等智能体可靠性，但错误恢复等关键能力仍然薄弱。

papers.title: The Ethics of Autonomous AI Agents for Offensive Security
papers.abstract_en: LLM-driven autonomous agents are reshaping offensive security. Unlike traditional penetration-testing tooling - deterministic, narrowly scoped, and operated by trained practitioners - agentic security tools exhibit indeterminacy along three independent dimensions. First, their actions are drawn from a non-deterministic policy whose outputs resist both ex-ante and ex-post explanation. This complicates incident attribution and pre-deployment safety reviews. Second, their impact is open-ended due to their non-deterministic actions, agency of utilized models, and opaque LLM supply-chains. Third, their user population is indeterminate in both size and required skill: the operating skill floor for using or developing offensive capabilities has dropped sharply. These three properties are linked thematically, but are not derivable from one another. Combined with the structural cost asymmetry between offense and defense, they enable the industrialization of offensive capability. The net short-term effect favors attackers, even if the same technology may, in the long run, democratize access to defensive practice. Existing dual-use cybersecurity and AI-ethics frameworks struggle to address this combination. Our work analyzes how moral attribution becomes diffuse between users, tool-makers, and third parties when employing autonomous AI agents for offensive security. We also examine the stakeholder impact of this technology and provide stratified recommendations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析 LLM 驱动的自主智能体用于进攻性安全(offensive security)时的伦理问题，指出这类工具在行为、影响和用户群体三个维度上具有不确定性，并讨论道德归因如何在用户、工具制造者和第三方之间扩散。作者认为现有双重用途网络安全与 AI 伦理框架难以应对这一组合，并给出分层建议。
Motivation: LLM 驱动的自主智能体正在重塑进攻性安全，但其非确定性策略、开放影响和降低的技能门槛使得现有伦理与监管框架失效，需要专门分析。
Method: 通过三个独立维度（行为不可解释性、影响开放性、用户群体不确定性）刻画 agentic security tools，并结合进攻与防御之间的结构性成本不对称，分析道德归因扩散及利益相关者影响，提出分层建议。
Result: 摘要指出这些特性共同促成进攻性能力的工业化，短期净效应有利于攻击者；长期可能促进防御实践的民主化。
Conclusion: 现有双重用途网络安全和 AI 伦理框架不足以处理该组合，文章提供利益相关者影响分析与分层建议。

papers.title: SenWorld: A Digital-Twin Simulation for Generating Context-Rich Evaluation Data
papers.abstract_en: Smartphone personal assistants reason over longitudinal personal data, yet evaluating them requires context-rich evaluation data whose correct answers are known, and real device traces are too privacy-sensitive to share. To address this challenge, we present SenWorld, a physically grounded, deterministic, event-sourced digital-twin simulation that generates such data with ground truth fixed by construction. In SenWorld, personas live through a full day in a world built from real map, weather, holiday, and network data; every observable signal is archived in full-system snapshots; and each evaluation case is labeled by a pointer to an existing record rather than by post-hoc annotation or a large language model (LLM) judge. We evaluate this method with 16 personas in Beijing. The generated data closely matches the held-out real-user benchmark in category distribution (Jensen--Shannon divergence (JSD) 0.070) and in the daily rhythm of communication records (JSD below 0.1), though generated records remain shorter than real ones. Without scripted interaction, personas form a fully reciprocated dialogue subgraph and differentiated behavioral repertoires. Projected into 717 evaluation cases, the generated data exposes 78 failures in a production smartphone assistant, concentrating on call and Short Message Service (SMS) records while contacts, schedules, and alarms never fail. The snapshot pointer confirms each failure as an assistant-side retrieval error, with no LLM judge involved. Overall, SenWorld offers a privacy-safe, reproducible, and distribution-checked path to evaluation data whose labels are fixed by construction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SenWorld 是一个基于物理约束、确定性的事件溯源 (event-sourced) 数字孪生仿真系统，用于生成智能手机个人助理的上下文丰富评估数据，其 ground truth 通过指向已有记录的指针固定，而非事后标注或 LLM 裁判。作者用北京 16 个 persona 验证，生成数据在类别分布 (JSD 0.070) 和通信记录的日常节奏 (JSD 低于 0.1) 上与留出的真实用户基准接近，但生成记录比真实记录更短。将数据投影为 717 个评估用例后，在生产级助理中暴露了 78 个失败，主要集中在电话和短信记录上。
Motivation: 智能手机个人助理需要对纵向个人数据进行推理，但评估这类系统需要答案已知且上下文丰富的评估数据，而真实设备轨迹因隐私敏感难以共享。
Method: SenWorld 利用真实地图、天气、节假日和网络数据构建一个物理 grounded 的确定性数字孪生世界，让 persona 在其中度过完整一天；所有可观测信号被归档为全系统快照，每个评估用例通过指向已有记录的指针进行标注，不依赖事后注释或 LLM 裁判。
Result: 在 16 个北京 persona 上，生成数据的类别分布与留出真实用户基准的 JSD 为 0.070，通信记录日常节奏的 JSD 低于 0.1，但生成记录偏短；无脚本交互下 persona 形成了完全互惠的对话子图和差异化的行为模式。投影为 717 个评估用例后，发现生产助理有 78 个失败，集中于电话和短信记录，快照指针确认这些失败均为助理端检索错误。
Conclusion: SenWorld 提供了一条隐私安全、可复现且经过分布校验的评估数据生成路径，其标签由构造本身固定。

papers.title: Counterfactual Shapley Credit Assignment
papers.abstract_en: The Credit Assignment Problem (CAP) is fundamental to developing efficient and explainable Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents. Existing frameworks, whether relying on temporal contiguity or hindsight-conditioned reward reweighting, frequently fail to attribute properly between an agent's policy (skill) and environmental stochasticity (luck). A principled approach to CAP must isolate the true causal drivers of observed outcomes from spurious correlations and environmental randomness. We introduce Counterfactual Shapley Credit Assignment, a novel framework grounded in causal theory that attributes credit and blame via the Counterfactual Shapley Value ($φ$-value). By redistributing environmental rewards, $φ$-values enhance temporal credit assignment across three critical dimensions: sparse causality, high stochasticity, and delayed rewards, all while preserving the optimal policy. We derive a consistent estimator that computes $φ$-values efficiently, enabling a new class of policy gradient methods, $φ$-PPO, combined with Prioritized Trajectory Replay (PTR). Empirical results demonstrate that $φ$-values align precisely to the ground truth causes of task rewards with superior sample efficiency in challenging environments where prior state-of-the-art methods fail to converge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于因果理论的反事实 Shapley 值（Counterfactual Shapley Value, φ-value）来求解强化学习中的信用分配问题（Credit Assignment Problem）。通过重新分配环境奖励，φ-value 在稀疏因果、高随机性和延迟奖励三个维度改善时序信用分配，并保持最优策略不变。作者推导了一致估计器并构建 φ-PPO 结合优先轨迹回放（Prioritized Trajectory Replay, PTR）的策略梯度方法；实验显示 φ-value 与任务奖励的真实因果原因精确对齐，在先前最先进方法无法收敛的挑战性环境中样本效率更优。
Motivation: 现有信用分配框架（基于时间邻近性或事后条件奖励重加权）常常无法正确区分智能体策略（技能）与环境随机性（运气），导致归因错误。需要一种原则性方法，从虚假相关和环境随机性中分离出观测结果的真实因果驱动因素。
Method: 提出 Counterfactual Shapley Credit Assignment 框架，基于因果理论，用反事实 Shapley 值计算信用与责任；通过重新分配环境奖励来增强时序信用分配，并推导出一致估计器；由此得到策略梯度方法 φ-PPO，并与 Prioritized Trajectory Replay (PTR) 结合。
Result: 实验表明 φ-value 与任务奖励的真实因果原因精确对齐，并在先前最先进方法无法收敛的挑战性环境中实现了更优的样本效率；摘要未给出具体量化数值。
Conclusion: 作者强调该框架能够在保持最优策略不变的前提下区分技能与运气，改善稀疏因果、高随机性和延迟奖励场景中的信用分配，为高效可解释的强化学习提供新的原则性路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Energy-Based Physics-Informed Form Finding for Clustered Tensegrity Structures
papers.abstract_en: Tensegrity form-finding and physical property prediction are fundamental inverse problems in structural mechanics, which aim to determine equilibrium configurations and internal force distributions. These problems are challenging due to strong nonlinearity arising from the coupling between geometry and forces, the need to ensure structural stability, and the enforcement of constraints such as boundary conditions and symmetry. Moreover, traditional methods often lack robustness to noise and outliers. This paper proposes an energy-based learning framework for clustered tensegrity form finding and physical property prediction. The proposed approach incorporates total potential energy minimization and constitutive relations into the training objective, enabling the simultaneous prediction of equilibrium nodal configurations and associated physical quantities, including member forces and force densities. By incorporating energy-based physical losses directly into the learning process, the framework improves physical consistency, robustness, and data efficiency. Numerical experiments on tensegrity structures, including prism and lander systems, show the great potential of the proposed approach and demonstrate its capability for scalable form finding and accurate prediction of structural properties.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于能量的学习框架，用于聚簇张拉整体结构（clustered tensegrity structures）的形态寻找（form-finding）与物理属性预测。框架将总势能最小化和本构关系纳入训练目标，可同时预测平衡节点构型以及构件内力和力密度等物理量。数值实验在棱柱和着陆器系统上展示了该方法的可扩展性与结构属性预测能力。
Motivation: 张拉整体的形态寻找和物理属性预测是结构力学中的基本逆问题，难点在于几何与力耦合带来的强非线性、稳定性保障以及边界条件和对称性等约束；同时传统方法对噪声和离群值的鲁棒性不足。
Method: 提出基于能量的学习框架，将总势能最小化（total potential energy minimization）和本构关系（constitutive relations）直接嵌入训练目标，通过基于能量的物理损失同时预测平衡节点构型和相关物理量（构件力与力密度）。
Result: 摘要报告在包括棱柱系统（prism）和着陆器系统（lander）的张拉整体结构数值实验中，该方法展现出可扩展的形态寻找能力和准确的结构属性预测，但未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 将基于能量的物理损失直接纳入学习过程可提升物理一致性、鲁棒性和数据效率；摘要强调该方法在可扩展形态寻找与结构属性预测上的潜力，但未明确说明局限性。

papers.title: VisCo: Leveraging Large Language Models as Intrinsic Encoders for Visual Token Compression
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) process large numbers of visual tokens, resulting in substantial inference latency and memory overhead. This has motivated extensive research on visual token compression. While training-free strategies rely on heuristic metrics and suffer significant performance degradation under high compression ratios, many training-based methods introduce external compression modules that force the VLM backbone to adapt, incurring substantial retraining cost and compromising VLMs' priors. Effective visual token compression hinges on strong information encoding, a capability already present in pretrained VLMs but underutilized by existing approaches. Motivated by this, we propose VisCo, a training-efficient self-compression framework that reuses the pretrained VLM itself as an intrinsic compressor. VisCo is a parameter-sharing autoencoder that compresses visual information using a small set of memory tokens and transfers hierarchical information from encoding to decoding. Experiments show that VisCo surpasses prior methods across all evaluated compression ratios, with larger gains under more aggressive compression, and remains stable even in the extreme single-token setting. Moreover, when combined with the original visual tokens, the learned memory tokens can even improve the base model, suggesting that VisCo captures complementary representations beyond compression. Code is available at: \href{https://github.com/Zyvpeng/VisCo}{\textcolor{blue}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VisCo，一种训练高效的视觉 token 压缩框架，核心思路是复用预训练 VLM 自身作为内在压缩器，而不是引入外部压缩模块。VisCo 通过参数共享自编码器，用少量记忆 token（memory tokens）压缩视觉信息，并在编码与解码之间传递层次信息。摘要报告该方法在所有评估的压缩比下均优于先前方法，在更激进的压缩下收益更大，并且在极端单 token 设置下仍然稳定。
Motivation: VLM 处理大量视觉 token 导致推理延迟与内存开销显著。现有训练免费策略依赖启发式度量，在高压缩比下性能损失严重；而基于训练的方法引入外部压缩模块，迫使 VLM 主干重新适配，带来高昂重新训练成本并损害 VLM 已有的先验。作者指出有效压缩依赖强信息编码能力，而预训练 VLM 已具备该能力但未被现有方法充分利用。
Method: VisCo 是一个训练高效的自压缩框架，直接复用预训练 VLM 作为内在编码器，采用参数共享自编码器结构：使用一组可学习的记忆 token 压缩视觉信息，并将编码阶段的层次化表示转移到解码阶段，从而无需额外外部压缩模块，也无需对整个 VLM 主干进行大规模重新训练。
Result: 实验表明 VisCo 在所有评估的压缩比下都超越先前方法，且压缩越激进优势越大；在极端情况下的单 token 压缩中仍能保持稳定。此外，将学到的记忆 token 与原始视觉 token 拼接还能提升基础模型性能，说明 VisCo 学到的表征不仅服务于压缩，还具有互补性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调复用预训练 VLM 自身的编码能力可以在不破坏原有先验的前提下实现训练高效且稳定的视觉 token 压缩，并且记忆 token 可带来超越单纯压缩的增益。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reducing information dependency does not cause training data privacy. Adversarially non-robust features do
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we challenge the prevailing view that information dependency (including rote memorization) drives training data exposure to image reconstruction attacks. We show that extensive exposure can persist without rote memorization and is instead caused by a tunable connection to adversarial robustness. We begin by presenting three surprising results: (1) recent defenses that inhibit reconstruction by Model Inversion Attacks (MIAs), which evaluate leakage under an idealized attacker, do not reduce standard measures of information dependency (HSIC); (2) models that maximally memorize their training datasets remain robust to MIA reconstruction; and (3) models trained without seeing 97% of the training pixels, where recent information-theoretic bounds give arbitrarily strong privacy guarantees under standard assumptions, can still be devastatingly reconstructed by MIA. To explain these findings, we provide causal evidence that privacy under MIA arises from what the adversarial examples literature calls ``non-robust'' features (generalizable but imperceptible and unstable features). We further show that recent MIA defenses obtain their privacy improvements by unintentionally shifting models toward such features. To establish this causal relationship, we introduce Anti Adversarial Training (AT-AT), a training regime that intentionally learns non-robust features to obtain both superior reconstruction defense and higher accuracy than state-of-the-art defenses. Our results revise the prevailing understanding of training data exposure and reveal a new privacy-robustness tradeoff.
papers.comment: In The Fourteenth International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR'26), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文挑战"信息依赖（包括死记硬背）驱动训练数据暴露于图像重建攻击"的主流观点，主张隐私泄露实际上与对抗鲁棒性相关，源于对抗样本文献中的"非鲁棒特征"（non-robust features）。作者通过三个反直觉实验展示记忆并非重建泄露的必要条件，并提出 Anti Adversarial Training (AT-AT) 来有意学习此类特征，在防御模型反转攻击 (MIAs) 的同时取得更高准确率。
Motivation: 现有研究普遍认为信息依赖、尤其是死记硬背式的训练数据记忆是模型反转攻击泄露隐私的主要原因；但该观点与若干防御现象不符，作者希望厘清真正决定隐私暴露的可调机制。
Method: 作者先检验近期 MIA 防御是否降低标准信息依赖度量（如 HSIC），并设计最大记忆化与"缺失 97% 训练像素"等训练设置；随后提出 Anti Adversarial Training (AT-AT)，一种有意学习非鲁棒特征的训练方式，用以在归一化信息论隐私界之外获得实际重建防御。
Result: 摘要报告三个结果：现有 MIA 防御并未降低 HSIC；最大程度记忆训练集的模型仍对 MIA 重建鲁棒；即使模型未见 97% 的训练像素、标准假设下信息论界给出任意强的隐私保证，MIA 仍能造成严重重建。AT-AT 相比现有先进防御在重建防御与准确率上均更优。
Conclusion: 作者认为 MIA 下的隐私来自非鲁棒特征，现有防御的隐私收益是对此类特征的无意偏移；这些发现修正了对训练数据暴露的理解，并揭示一种新的隐私-鲁棒性权衡（privacy-robustness tradeoff）。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Beyond Scaffold Splits: Structural-Frontier Evaluation Reveals Hidden Failures in ADMET Models
papers.abstract_en: Molecular property models are commonly evaluated by holding out Bemis-Murcko scaffolds, yet a scaffold identifier is only one notion of chemical unfamiliarity. We introduce a label-free structural-frontier split that reserves the sparsest and most physicochemically remote scaffold groups, and evaluate it on six public experimental or curated ADMET tasks. Against a 70/10/20 scaffold control with identical acyclic grouping, the frontier inflates equally weighted primary error with a taskwise median of 87.0% and a skew-sensitive mean of 130.3% (descriptive task/seed bootstrap interval, 52.1-246.0%). The mean falls to 75.9% once BBB is removed; that endpoint is the one whose score ranking inverts at the frontier. A message-passing graph-network control still shows a large gap (mean 82.8% over four tasks) and does not invert, so a low-capacity head does not explain the effect. We also test Multi-View Frontier Risk Extrapolation (MV-FREX), a count-adjusted tail-risk penalty over four molecular views, and treat it as a falsifiable probe. It changes normalized frontier error by only 0.16% relative to empirical risk minimization for the perceptron head (interval, -0.43-0.84%) and by -1.9% for the graph network; three fixed robust-penalty controls are likewise inconclusive. Against the published Lo-Hi and DataSAIL splitters, the frontier inflates error more on average, though no split is uniformly hardest. An audit of 31,561 marine natural products further shows that OOD status and agreement with legacy ADMET predictions depend on the molecular view, endpoint, and teacher coverage. Split construction and label provenance are important evaluation constraints in their own right, and the tested training penalties do not resolve the frontier failures we observe.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 4 figures, and 4 tables. Version 3 updates figures and tables caption in the main PDF
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出基于 Bemis-Murcko scaffold 的拆分只是化学陌生性的一种度量，并提出一种无标签的结构前沿 (structural-frontier) 拆分，将最稀疏且物理化学性质最遥远的 scaffold 组留作测试集，在六个公开 ADMET 任务上评估分子性质模型。相比 70/10/20 scaffold 控制拆分，前沿拆分使等权主误差中位数提升 87.0%、均值提升 130.3%（描述性区间 52.1–246.0%），移除 BBB 端点后均值降至 75.9%。作者还提出多视图前沿风险外推 (MV-FREX) 作为可证伪的探针，但该惩罚与多个稳健惩罚控制均未能解释前沿失效。
Motivation: 现有 ADMET 模型评测常用 Bemis-Murcko scaffold 留出作为化学新颖性的代理，但 scaffold 标识只是化学陌生性的一种概念，可能掩盖模型在更极端结构前沿上的失败，因此需要更严苛的拆分来暴露这些隐藏错误。
Method: 构造无标签的结构前沿拆分，保留最稀疏且物理化学上最遥远的 scaffold 组；将其与相同无环分组的 scaffold 控制拆分对比，并在消息传递图网络 (message-passing graph network) 上验证。同时提出 Multi-View Frontier Risk Extrapolation (MV-FREX)：一种基于四种分子视图的计数调整尾部风险惩罚，作为可证伪的稳健训练探针。
Result: 前沿拆分在六个 ADMET 任务上使等权主误差中位数提高 87.0%、均值提高 130.3%（bootstrap 区间 52.1–246.0%），删除 BBB 端点后均值降为 75.9%，且该端点在前沿下发生排序反转；低容量感知机头无法解释该效应，图网络控制仍显示 82.8% 的较大差距。MV-FREX 对感知机头仅改变归一化前沿误差 0.16%（区间 -0.43–0.84%），对图网络改变 -1.9%，三个固定稳健惩罚控制同样效果不显著；与已发表的 Lo-Hi 和 DataSAIL 拆分相比，前沿拆分平均产生更大误差，但没有任何拆分在所有任务上一致最难。对 31,561 个海洋天然产物的审计进一步显示，OOD 状态与传统 ADMET 预测的一致性取决于分子视图、端点与教师覆盖率。

papers.title: MultiView-Bench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for World-Centric Multi-View Integration in VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Recent benchmarks for VLMs largely assess single- or limited-view perception, leaving untested the core cognitive ability to integrate observations across viewpoints into a coherent, world-centric (allocentric) 3D mental model. We introduce MultiView-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark expressly designed to evaluate multi-view integration for holistic 3D scene comprehension. Unlike existing datasets that focus on pixel-level mapping or camera-relative navigation, MultiView-Bench requires models to decouple object positioning from transient perspectives and ground them in a fixed global coordinate system. This capability serves as a prerequisite for VLMs before being deployed for downstream tasks such as mechanical part assembly. Our systematic evaluation of frontier VLMs reveals consistent failure modes: strong performance on 2D planar relations from a single image, but marked difficulty with 3D spatial relations and with aggregating information across views. We further identify biases in VLMs, such as struggles with unconventional axis directions and sensitivity to object colorways and texture variations. Acknowledging these limitations, we propose ViewNavigator, which uses active viewpoint selection and evidence fusion to improve four base models by 12.3--20.0 percentage points under a six-image cap matching the fixed-view baseline; budget-extended gains are model-dependent and reach 27 percentage points for GPT-5.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MultiView-Bench，一个专门用于诊断视觉语言模型（VLM）跨视角整合能力的基准，目标是评估模型是否能在固定全局坐标系中构建以世界为中心（allocentric）的 3D 场景理解。对前沿 VLM 的系统评测发现，模型在单张图像的 2D 平面关系上表现强，但在 3D 空间关系及跨视角聚合上明显困难，并且存在非常规轴方向、颜色与纹理变化带来的偏差。作者进一步提出 ViewNavigator，通过主动视角选择和证据融合，在六张图像上限下将四个基础模型提升 12.3–20.0 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 基准多评估单视角或有限视角感知，未测试将多视角观测整合为一致的三维世界心理解模型这一核心认知能力；该能力是 VLM 部署到如机械零件装配等下游任务的前提。
Method: 构建 MultiView-Bench 诊断基准，要求模型将物体位置与瞬时视角解耦并锚定到固定全局坐标系；同时提出 ViewNavigator，结合主动视角选择（active viewpoint selection）与证据融合（evidence fusion）来改进多视图整合。
Result: 评测显示前沿 VLM 在单图像 2D 平面关系上表现良好，但难以处理 3D 空间关系和跨视角信息聚合；模型还对非常规轴方向和物体颜色、纹理变化敏感。ViewNavigator 在六图像上限下使四个基础模型提升 12.3–20.0 个百分点，扩展预算时对 GPT-5 最高提升 27 个百分点，且增益因模型而异。
Conclusion: 作者认为多视图整合能力是 VLM 面向 3D 场景任务部署的前提，现有模型在该能力上存在系统性不足；诊断基准与 ViewNavigator 可用于识别和缓解这些局限。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: LoCA: Spatially-Aware Low-Rank Convolutional Adaptation of Vision Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Pre-trained Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) provide strong visual representations for diverse downstream tasks. The key challenge of VFM adaptation stems from the prohibitive costs of full fine-tuning and catastrophic forgetting. To address this, Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has emerged as the prevailing paradigm for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT). However, LoRA is typically designed for transformer self-attention layers parameterized by 2D matrices. Since convolutional kernels inherently couple spatial and channel information within a 4D tensor, forcing them into a monolithic 2D matrix disrupts the inherent spatial topology. In this paper, we propose Low-Rank Convolutional Adaptation (LoCA), a convolution-aware PEFT framework that addresses spatial-channel entanglement by decoupling channel and spatial adaptation. LoCA introduces a low-rank channel adaptation for dense cross-channel mixing and refines spatial bases extracted from pre-trained kernels via Singular Value Decomposition (SVD). Experimental results show that LoCA preserves pre-trained spatial priors and achieves competitive or state-of-the-art performance across fine-grained classification, domain-generalized semantic segmentation, and generative benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LoCA（Low-Rank Convolutional Adaptation），一种面向视觉基础模型（VFM）的卷积感知参数高效微调（PEFT）框架。LoCA 针对卷积核在 4D 张量中耦合空间与通道信息的问题，将通道与空间适配解耦：用低秩通道适配实现密集跨通道混合，并通过 SVD 从预训练核中提取空间基进行精化。实验表明 LoCA 保留预训练空间先验，在细粒度分类、域泛化语义分割和生成基准上达到有竞争力或最优性能。
Motivation: LoRA 作为主流 PEFT 范式通常针对 2D 矩阵参数的 Transformer 自注意力层设计，而卷积核在 4D 张量中天然耦合空间与通道信息，强行压成单一 2D 矩阵会破坏固有空间拓扑，导致 VFM 适配中空间结构信息受损。
Method: 提出卷积感知的 PEFT 框架 LoCA，解耦通道与空间适配：引入低秩通道适配用于密集跨通道混合，并利用 SVD 从预训练卷积核中提取空间基加以精化，从而在微调中保留预训练空间先验。
Result: 摘要报告 LoCA 在细粒度分类、域泛化语义分割和生成基准上取得有竞争力或最先进的性能，同时保留预训练空间先验。
Conclusion: LoCA 表明卷积感知的低秩适配方式可以在保留预训练空间先验的前提下实现高效的 VFM 下游适配。

papers.title: RenderFormer++: Scalable and Physics-Informed Feed-Forward Neural Rendering
papers.abstract_en: We present RenderFormer++, a scalable and physics-informed feed-forward neural rendering framework for global illumination in mesh scenes. Existing Transformer-based neural rendering methods such as RenderFormer achieve promising cross-scene generalization, but lack explicit transport priors and scale poorly due to quadratic triangle-level attention. To address these issues, we introduce Physics-Informed Transport Guidance (PITG), which embeds rendering-equation-inspired inductive biases into the attention mechanism and introduces a transport consistency loss, encouraging physics-informed light transport modeling. We further propose Hierarchical Object-Centric Tokenization (HOCT), which aggregates triangle-level features into compact object-level tokens via cross-attention with learnable queries, substantially reducing computational and memory costs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RenderFormer++ achieves scalable and generalizable feed-forward global illumination rendering across complex large-scale scenes with competitive rendering quality and substantially improved efficiency over RenderFormer. The code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RenderFormer++，一个面向网格场景全局光照的可扩展、物理信息前馈神经渲染框架。针对现有基于 Transformer 的神经渲染方法（如 RenderFormer）缺乏显式传输先验且三角形级注意力二次复杂度导致扩展性差的问题，作者提出物理信息传输引导（PITG）和层次化对象中心分词（HOCT）。实验表明该方法在复杂大规模场景上实现具有竞争力的渲染质量和相比 RenderFormer 显著提升的效率。代码将在论文被接收后公开。
Motivation: 现有前馈 Transformer 神经渲染方法虽有跨场景泛化能力，但缺乏显式的光传输先验，并且三角形级注意力呈二次复杂度，难以扩展到大规模场景。
Method: 提出 PITG，将渲染方程启发的归纳偏置嵌入注意力机制，并引入传输一致性损失；提出 HOCT，通过可学习查询的交叉注意力将三角形级特征聚合成紧凑的对象级 token，从而降低计算和内存成本。
Result: 实验表明 RenderFormer++ 在复杂大规模场景上获得可扩展且可泛化的前馈全局光照渲染，渲染质量与 RenderFormer 相当，效率显著提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架面向大规模网格场景的全局光照渲染，具备可扩展性和泛化能力，并指出代码将在论文被接收后公开。

papers.title: Ordinal Neural Collapse as a Representation Prior for Visual Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Learning robust navigation policies directly from visual observations remains a fundamental challenge in vision-based robotic navigation. In end-to-end imitation learning approaches, the visual encoder and action decoder are jointly optimized using a single action loss, which provides only an indirect supervisory signal to the encoder. This indirect supervision frequently results in the encoder learning ambiguous, action-agnostic representations. The problem is further complicated by substantial variations in scene structure and appearance across diverse environments, as well as the prevalence of visual distractors inherent to real-world navigation settings. Such action-agnostic features cause the navigation policy to produce inconsistent actions at ambiguous decision points, leading to navigation failure. To overcome these limitations, we propose ORION (Ordinal Neural Collapse for Visual Navigation), a method that explicitly organizes the encoder's representation space according to the ordinal structure of navigation actions. In the context of goal-directed navigation, ego-centric control categories from Far Left to Far Right exhibit a natural ordinal relationship in which neighboring classes share similar visual contexts, while semantically opposing classes differ substantially in appearance. We encourage class representations to be arranged sequentially along a single discriminative axis, while suppressing off-axis variance within each class. The pretrained encoder is then integrated into a diffusion-based navigation framework, and the full pipeline is fine-tuned end-to-end. Extensive experiments in both simulation and real-world settings show that ORION consistently outperforms end-to-end and neural collapse baselines in navigation success rate and goal progress, with notable gains in visually challenging scenarios such as complex multi-way intersections.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ORION (Ordinal Neural Collapse for Visual Navigation)，一种面向视觉导航的表示学习方法。它利用导航动作的序数结构（从 Far Left 到 Far Right）组织编码器的表示空间，使类表示沿单一判别轴顺序排列并抑制轴外方差，预训练编码器再接入基于扩散的导航框架进行端到端微调。在仿真和真实世界实验中，ORION 相比端到端和神经坍缩基线在导航成功率和目标进展上持续提升，尤其在复杂的多路口等视觉挑战场景中提升显著。
Motivation: 端到端模仿学习中，视觉编码器与动作解码器仅用单一动作损失联合优化，编码器只能得到间接监督，容易学到与动作无关的模糊表示；场景结构差异和视觉干扰物进一步导致导航策略在歧义决策点产生不一致动作，造成导航失败。
Method: 提出 ORION，显式按照导航动作的序数关系组织编码器的表示空间：目标导向导航中，自我中心控制类别从 Far Left 到 Far Right 具有自然序数关系，相邻类别共享相似视觉上下文，语义对立的类别外观差异大。方法鼓励类表示沿单一判别轴顺序排列，同时抑制类内偏离轴方向的方差；预训练编码器集成到扩散式导航框架中并端到端微调。
Result: 仿真和真实世界实验表明，ORION 在导航成功率和目标进展（goal progress）上持续优于端到端和神经坍缩（neural collapse）基线，在复杂多路口等视觉具有挑战性的场景中提升显著。
Conclusion: 摘要强调利用动作的序数结构作为表示先验可以改善视觉导航编码器的表示质量，从而提升策略的一致性和导航表现；方法在视觉干扰和场景变化明显的真实世界环境中验证了有效性。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 ORION (Ordinal Neural Collapse for Visual Navigation)，一种面向视觉导航的表示学习方法。它利用导航动作的序数结构（从 Far Left 到 Far Right）组织编码器的表示空间，使类表示沿单一判别轴顺序排列并抑制轴外方差，预训练编码器再接入基于扩散的导航框架进行端到端微调。在仿真和真实世界实验中，ORION 相比端到端和神经坍缩基线在导航成功率和目标进展上持续提升，尤其在复杂的多路口等视觉挑战场景中提升显著。
summary_sections.motivation: 端到端模仿学习中，视觉编码器与动作解码器仅用单一动作损失联合优化，编码器只能得到间接监督，容易学到与动作无关的模糊表示；场景结构差异和视觉干扰物进一步导致导航策略在歧义决策点产生不一致动作，造成导航失败。

summary_sections.result: 仿真和真实世界实验表明，ORION 在导航成功率和目标进展（goal progress）上持续优于端到端和神经坍缩（neural collapse）基线，在复杂多路口等视觉具有挑战性的场景中提升显著。

papers.title: Compositional Behavioral Semantics for State Abstraction in Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: State abstraction plays a key role in scaling reinforcement learning to complex but structured systems. In studying such systems, a wide range of behavioral structures have been studied in reinforcement learning, including value functions, invariants, bisimulation relations, and behavioral metrics. However, a general principle for determining what structures are provably preserved under state abstraction is still lacking. In this paper, we present a unified framework for defining and analyzing behavioral structures in reinforcement learning. Our framework provides a compositional way to specify behavioral semantics based on local, one-step descriptions of system dynamics. Using this framework, we establish results showing how behavioral structures can be safely transferred between abstract and concrete systems. We further show how to construct quantitative metrics from logical behavioral semantics with soundness guarantees. Together, these results provide a principled foundation for reasoning about behaviors under state abstraction in reinforcement learning and offer reusable definition and proof principles for a broad class of behavioral structures in reinforcement learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的组合式框架，用于在强化学习中定义与分析各类行为结构（如价值函数、不变量、双模拟关系和行为度量）。该框架基于系统动力学的局部单步描述来组合式地指定行为语义，并证明行为结构可以在抽象系统与具体系统之间安全传递。文中还展示了如何从逻辑行为语义构造具有可靠性保证的定量度量，为状态抽象下的行为推理提供了原则性基础。
Motivation: 强化学习中已研究过多种行为结构，但缺少一个通用原则来判断哪些结构能在状态抽象下被可证明地保持。该论文瞄准这一空白，希望为行为结构的保真传递提供统一理论。
Method: 提出一种统一框架，以局部、单步的系统动力学描述为基础，组合式地指定行为语义；利用该框架证明行为结构可在抽象系统和具体系统之间转移，并从逻辑行为语义出发构造带可靠性保证的定量度量。
Result: 摘要报告建立了行为结构在抽象与具体系统间安全传递的结果，并给出了从逻辑行为语义构造定量度量的可靠性保证。
Conclusion: 该工作为强化学习中状态抽象下的行为推理提供了原则性基础，并为一大类行为结构提供了可复用的定义与证明原则。

papers.title: High-Fidelity Synthetic Transmission Electron Microscopy Image Generation Using Diffusion Probabilistic Models for Data-Limited Semiconductor Metrology
papers.abstract_en: Advanced semiconductor nodes drastically increased demand for Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM), yet destructive sample preparation, slow imaging and high costs severely limit the availability of diverse datasets needed for downstream machine learning (ML). Synthetic data generation is becoming essential, but current generative models often miss TEM-specific noise, structural detail, and stochastic variability crucial for evaluation. We present a Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM) framework for synthetic TEM image generation under extreme data scarcity. A progressive patch-based training strategy scales from low-resolution patches to full images, enabling from-scratch training with only 15 samples. We integrate a custom TrivialAugment adaptation, cross-process domain transfer, classifier guidance, and RePaint-style inpainting, culminating in full-image generation that preserves global structural and spatial relationships in compliance with FAB metrology requirements. Beyond synthesis, we repurpose DDPM feature representations for segmentation, partitioning encoder feature maps to obtain coherent region masks. Our synthetic images achieve up to MS-SSIM > 0.98 and qualitative expert assessment consistent with structural similarity results, facilitating downstream ML training for defect detection, segmentation, and metrology while preserving statistical and physical realism.
papers.comment: To be presented at the 2026 International Symposium ELMAR, published by IEEE in the conference proceedings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用于半导体计量 (semiconductor metrology) 的合成透射电子显微镜 (TEM) 图像生成框架，基于去噪扩散概率模型 (DDPM)。在仅有 15 个训练样本的极端数据稀缺条件下，通过渐进式 patch 训练策略从低分辨率 patch 扩展到全图生成，并集成 TrivialAugment 适配、跨工艺域迁移、分类器引导 (classifier guidance) 与 RePaint 风格修复 (inpainting)。摘要报告合成图像 MS-SSIM 超过 0.98，专家定性评估与结构相似性结果一致，可用于缺陷检测、分割与计量等下游机器学习任务。
Motivation: 先进半导体节点对 TEM 的需求激增，但破坏性样品制备、慢速成像和高成本严重限制了下游机器学习所需多样化数据集的可用性。现有生成模型常缺失 TEM 特有的噪声、结构细节和随机变异性，难以满足评估需求。
Method: 提出 DDPM 生成框架，采用渐进式 patch 训练策略从低分辨率 patch 扩展到全图，实现仅用 15 个样本的从零训练；并整合自定义 TrivialAugment 适配、跨工艺域迁移、分类器引导和 RePaint 风格修复。此外，复用 DDPM 编码器特征进行分割，将特征图划分为连贯的区域掩码。
Result: 摘要报告合成图像达到 MS-SSIM > 0.98，专家定性评估与结构相似性结果一致，并且合成数据支持缺陷检测、分割和计量等下游机器学习训练。
Conclusion: 该方法能在极端数据稀缺下生成保持全局结构与空间关系、符合 FAB 计量要求的合成 TEM 图像，同时保留统计与物理真实性。

papers.title: Dirac-Frenkel dynamics with inertia for nonlinearly parametrized solutions of evolution problems
papers.abstract_en: Even when Dirac-Frenkel dynamics determine a well-defined evolution in function space, the corresponding parameter dynamics can be non-unique or ill-conditioned for redundant nonlinear parametrizations, such as typical neural networks or mixture models. We propose to add inertia to the Dirac-Frenkel dynamics and show that this allows useful parameter velocity information to persist from the past trajectory in directions that are weakly informed, while well-informed parameter velocity directions continue to follow the Dirac-Frenkel dynamics. We prove that the inertial formulation yields well-posed parameter dynamics and provide a posteriori error bounds. After time discretization, the method requires the solution of the same type of regularized linear least-squares problem as standard Dirac-Frenkel dynamics, but with the previous velocity appearing as an anchor. Numerical experiments demonstrate the increased robustness obtained with inertia.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 Dirac-Frenkel 动力学在冗余非线性参数化（如典型神经网络或混合模型）下参数动力学不唯一或病态的问题，提出在 Dirac-Frenkel 动力学中加入惯性项。作者证明惯性形式给出适定的参数动力学并提供后验误差界；时间离散后仍需求解与标准 Dirac-Frenkel 动力学相同类型的正则化线性最小二乘问题，只是将先前速度作为锚点。数值实验表明该惯性机制提升了鲁棒性。
Motivation: 即使 Dirac-Frenkel 动力学在函数空间中定义良好，对应的参数动力学在冗余非线性参数化（例如典型神经网络或混合模型）下也可能不唯一或病态，影响演化问题的数值求解稳定性。
Method: 方法是在 Dirac-Frenkel 动力学中增加惯性，使过去轨迹中的参数速度信息在信息较弱的参数方向上得以保持，而信息充分的参数速度方向仍遵循 Dirac-Frenkel 动力学。时间离散后，该方法与标准 Dirac-Frenkel 动力学求解相同类型的正则化线性最小二乘问题，区别在于先前速度作为锚点出现。
Result: 作者证明了惯性形式下参数动力学的适定性，并给出后验误差界；数值实验表明加入惯性后鲁棒性得到提升。
Conclusion: 结论是惯性公式能够产生适定的参数动力学并增强鲁棒性，同时保持与标准 Dirac-Frenkel 动力学相同的计算流程。抽象未明确讨论局限或适用范围的限制。

papers.title: Training-free Task Classification for Multi-Task Model Merging
papers.abstract_en: Ever since the advent of foundation models and the pre-training-finetuning paradigm, there have been numerous efforts to merge multiple task-specific experts into a single multi-task model. Prior work largely focuses on finding a single merged model, but it often underperforms individual experts due to parameter interference. To resolve this, dynamic model merging employs routing to activate task-relevant parameters per input. However, existing routers typically require either additional training with abundant labeled datasets or assume the access to task IDs of each input at inference time. In this work, we aim to close the gap to expert performance without additional training or task-ID-access assumption. To this end, we formulate routing as training-free task classification for each test input. Using singular value decomposition (SVD)-based low-rank manifold approximations for each task, SiM scores tasks by the projection residual of the test input feature onto each task manifold and routes accordingly. The task manifolds are pre-computable offline from a pretrained backbone using a small per-task support set (e.g., 32 examples per task) prior to merging process, requiring no router training and no data during the merging process. Moreover, SiM integrates seamlessly with subspace-/mask-based merging that represents task-expert via lightweight compressed task vectors, avoiding the need to store full expert parameters. Experiments across computer vision and natural language processing benchmarks under task-unknown inference demonstrate that SiM substantially improves merged-model performance and consistently narrows the gap to individual task experts. Our code is available at https://github.com/BAIKLAB/SiM
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SiM，一种针对多任务模型合并的免训练 (training-free) 路由方法。其核心是把路由建模为对每个测试输入的无监督任务分类：利用奇异值分解 (SVD) 为每个任务构建低秩流形近似，再用测试输入特征在各任务流形上的投影残差打分并路由。任务流形可在合并前从预训练骨干和每任务少量支持集（如 32 个样本）离线计算，无需路由器训练、也无需在合并过程中使用数据，并能与基于子空间/掩码的轻量任务向量合并方式集成。实验在视觉和 NLP 基准的 task-unknown 推理设置下显示 SiM 显著提升合并模型性能，并持续缩小与独立任务专家的差距。
Motivation: 现有动态模型合并 (dynamic model merging) 的路由器通常需要额外的带标签数据训练，或假设推理时能获得每个输入的任务 ID，这两种条件在实际中常不成立。作者希望在不进行额外训练、也不依赖任务 ID 的前提下，让合并模型逼近各任务专家 (task experts) 的性能。
Method: 将路由视为免训练的任务分类问题：对每个任务用 SVD 构造低秩流形近似，测试输入的特征投影到各任务流形后计算投影残差，残差越小则任务得分越高，据此为输入选择任务相关参数。任务流形可由预训练骨干和每任务少量支持集离线预计算，且该方法可与子空间/掩码类合并方法结合，避免保存完整专家参数。
Result: 在视觉和自然语言处理基准的 task-unknown 推理设置下，SiM 显著提升了合并后模型的性能，并一致地缩小了与各任务独立专家之间的差距。
Conclusion: 摘要强调无需路由器训练、无需推理时任务 ID、合并过程中无需数据，即可实现接近专家性能的动态合并；同时该方法可无缝集成到基于子空间/掩码的轻量任务向量合并中。

papers.title: An Empirical Study of openPangu Quantization on Ascend NPUs
papers.abstract_en: openPangu models are attractive targets for private and domestic large-language-model deployment, yet their robustness under aggressive post-training quantization on Ascend NPUs has not been systematically characterized. This paper conducts a controlled empirical study of openPangu 1B and 7B models on Huawei Ascend 910B1 NPUs. We evaluate representative weight-only and weight-activation post-training quantization methods, including RTN, GPTQ, AWQ, SmoothQuant, GPTAQ, BiLLM, and SliM-LLM, under a unified calibration and evaluation protocol. Across 18 evaluation tasks, we find that 8-bit weight-only quantization is effectively lossless for both models, while 4-bit quantization remains practical for the 7B model but is visibly more harmful for the 1B model on reasoning, math, and code tasks. Ultra-low precision remains challenging: most 2-bit and binary settings collapse to near-random behavior, and W4A4 SmoothQuant produces non-finite perplexity in our evaluation. These results provide an NPU-oriented accuracy map for selecting openPangu quantization settings and highlight the persistent difficulty of extreme low-bit compression.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Semantic Adapter Routing with Fine-Tuning Task Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) has led to model ecosystems in which a single backbone is paired with many task-specialized adapters. Given such a library, routing aims to select the most appropriate adapter for a user query. While existing adapter routers typically require access to adapter weights or supervised training, we develop training-free semantic adapter routing methods using task embeddings. In ARIADNE, we reframe adapter selection as a classification problem, where PEFT adapters are represented by task embeddings and an unlabeled query is routed to the nearest adapter in the encoder's latent space. Evaluated on 23 tasks, ARIADNE recovers 97.4% of Oracle task performance and scales to 44 adapters at 89.7% selection accuracy, without touching a single adapter parameter. However, training data needed for ARIADNE may not be available when adapters come from public hubs or third-party providers. To overcome this limitation, we introduce GRACE, which recovers an adapter's fine-tuning data from its output logits alone via a modified contrastive decoding diffing (CDD) procedure. Synthetic data generated from CDD-UM is then used to construct task embeddings. Across three backbones (Llama-3.2-1B, Qwen2.5-3B, Qwen2.5-32B), GRACE recovers 72--100\% of Oracle task accuracy and matches or exceeds ARROW on 48 of 69 task/backbone combinations, while requiring neither training data nor model weights. Overall, we demonstrate that fine-tuning task embeddings provide an accurate and efficient path to semantic adapter routing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于任务嵌入的训练无关语义适配器路由方法。ARIADNE 将适配器选择建模为分类问题，在编码器隐空间中将无标签查询路由到最近的适配器；GRACE 则从适配器输出 logits 中通过改进的对比解码差分（CDD）过程恢复微调数据并生成任务嵌入。评估显示 ARIADNE 在 23 个任务上恢复 97.4% 的 Oracle 性能，GRACE 在三个骨干上恢复 72–100% 的 Oracle 准确率。
Motivation: 现有适配器路由通常需要访问适配器权重或有监督训练数据，而公共模型库中的第三方适配器往往两者都不可得，限制了路由方法的实用性。
Method: ARIADNE 将 PEFT 适配器用任务嵌入表示，将无标签查询路由到最近邻；GRACE 仅利用适配器输出 logits，通过修改后的对比解码差分（CDD）过程恢复微调数据并生成合成数据来构造任务嵌入，全程不触碰适配器参数。
Result: ARIADNE 在 23 个任务上恢复 97.4% 的 Oracle 任务性能，可扩展到 44 个适配器且选择准确率为 89.7%；GRACE 在 Llama-3.2-1B、Qwen2.5-3B、Qwen2.5-32B 三个骨干上恢复 72–100% 的 Oracle 任务准确率，并在 69 个任务/骨干组合中的 48 个上匹配或超过 ARROW。
Conclusion: 作者认为微调任务嵌入可以为语义适配器路由提供准确高效的路径，且无需训练数据或模型权重。

papers.title: Persistence without Multifractality in Tropical Atlantic SST Indices: Scaling-Range Artefacts and a Reappraisal of the ENSO Association
papers.abstract_en: We investigate the scaling properties of three weekly tropical Atlantic sea-surface-temperature indices (SAT, TSA and the interhemispheric gradient TASI) over 1981--2025 using multifractal detrended fluctuation analysis and its sign-preserving cross-correlation extension. Exponents are estimated over $s\in[18,100]$ weeks, bounded by $s_{\min}\gtrsim6(m+1)$ for second-order detrending and a crossover near 100 weeks. On these scales all three indices are strongly persistent and locally non-stationary ($h(2)=1.32$--$1.35$). Comparison with shuffled and phase-randomised surrogates shows that none of the indices are multifractal within record resolution. SAT ($Δh=0.077$) and TASI ($Δh=0.054$) are fully consistent with both null models. Although TSA yields a larger width ($Δh=0.217$), its increasing $h(q)$ implies the unphysical condition $f(α)>1$, indicating a crossover rather than a multiplicative cascade. At the available record length ($N\approx2300$), apparent multifractal widths are not identifiable because confidence intervals overlap and rankings remain sensitive to analysis choices. The increments are only mildly leptokurtic, excluding heavy tails as the source of the apparent widths. Pairwise couplings reveal strong positive cross-correlations between the regional indices and anticorrelation of the gradient with both, all described by a single cross-scaling exponent, consistent with monofractal behaviour. A lagged analysis further shows that the previously reported TASI--ENSO association disappears after surrogate testing accounting for multiple lags. These results substantially revise downward previous estimates of multifractal strength in tropical Atlantic SST and show that reported widths should not be interpreted without verifying both the sign of $h'(q)$ and the stability of the scaling range.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文使用多重分形去趋势波动分析（MF-DFA）及其符号保持的互相关扩展，对1981–2025年三个周尺度热带大西洋海表温度指数（SAT、TSA、TASI）的标度性质进行检验。在s∈[18,100]周范围内，三个指数均表现为强持续且局部非平稳（h(2)=1.32–1.35），但与打乱和相位随机化代理比较后，没有证据表明它们在记录分辨率内具有真实的多重分形性。TSA较大的宽度（Δh=0.217）被解释为交叉效应而非乘性级联；滞后分析还显示TASI–ENSO关联在代理检验后消失。
Motivation: 以往对热带大西洋SST指数多重分形强度的估计可能被高估，且报告宽度时往往未验证h'(q)的符号和标度范围的稳定性；作者旨在重新评估这些指数的持续性与多重分形性，并检验TASI–ENSO关联的稳健性。
Method: 对三个周尺度SST指数应用多重分形去趋势波动分析及其符号保持的互相关扩展，在s∈[18,100]周区间估计标度指数；将结果与打乱及相位随机化代理比较，并通过检查h(q)递增导致f(α)>1这一非物理条件来判断伪多重分形；对TASI–ENSO关系做考虑多重滞后的代理检验。
Result: 三个指数在所选尺度上强持续且局部非平稳；SAT（Δh=0.077）和TASI（Δh=0.054）与两个零模型完全一致，TSA（Δh=0.217）的宽度来自交叉而不是乘性级联；较长记录（N≈2300）下表观多重分形宽度因置信区间重叠而对分析选择敏感；幅度增量仅轻度尖峰，排除重尾作为宽度来源；TASI–ENSO关联在代理检验后不再显著。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，此前对热带大西洋SST多重分形强度的估计应大幅下调，且报告多重分形宽度前必须同时验证h'(q)的符号与标度范围的稳定性；当前记录长度不足以识别真正的多重分形。

papers.title: CloudDiffusion: Diffusion-Based Scene Completion in the Point Cloud Domain
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing dense 3D scenes from sparse LiDAR point clouds (LiDAR scene completion) is a fundamental challenge in autonomous driving, where diffusion models offer a promising solution. However, existing approaches rely on object-level autoencoders that collapse into unstable global representations at outdoor scale, and suffer from ground truth data corrupted by odometry drift that systematically degrades supervision quality. Furthermore, multi-step diffusion inference incurs prohibitive latency for real-time deployment. We present CloudDiffusion, addressing these issues with three independent components. First, a multi-token Gaussian VAE with cross-attention pooling provides stable scene-scale LiDAR compression as a standalone reconstruction module, avoiding the global-pooling and codebook-collapse failure modes of prior point-cloud autoencoders. Second, an anchor-based ICP ground truth refinement pipeline eliminates drift-induced noise from training supervision, reducing our single-step x0 diffusion teacher's squared Chamfer distance by approximately 16x on SemanticKITTI seq. 08 (0.396 to 0.024 m^2) with no model change (partly aided by the denser, more compact refined references). Third, the same teacher completes scenes in a single x0 step, operating directly in coordinate space, not in the VAE latent. It runs in near real time at 209ms/frame, 65-138x lower inference latency than iterative diffusion baselines. Our results indicate that data quality dominates model design in this regime, and suggest that multi-token latent spaces could serve as a stable first stage for future latent diffusion-based scene completion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CloudDiffusion，用于从稀疏 LiDAR 点云重建稠密 3D 场景的 LiDAR 场景补全 (scene completion) 任务。方法包含三个独立组件：多 token 高斯 VAE 与 cross-attention pooling 实现稳定的场景尺度压缩；基于 anchor 的 ICP 真值精化流程消除里程计漂移噪声；以及直接在坐标空间运行的单步 x0 扩散教师模型。在 SemanticKITTI seq. 08 上，该教师模型的平方 Chamfer distance 从 0.396 降至 0.024 m^2（约 16 倍），推理延迟为 209ms/帧，比迭代扩散基线低 65-138 倍。
Motivation: 现有基于扩散的 LiDAR 场景补全依赖物体级自编码器，在户外尺度下会坍缩为不稳定的全局表示；同时真值受里程计漂移污染，系统性地降低监督质量；此外多步扩散推理延迟过高，难以实时部署。
Method: 方法由三部分组成：一是带 cross-attention pooling 的多 token 高斯 VAE，作为独立重建模块提供稳定的场景尺度 LiDAR 压缩，避免全局池化与 codebook collapse 失效模式；二是 anchor-based ICP 真值精化流程，去除训练监督中的里程计漂移噪声；三是单步 x0 扩散教师模型，直接在坐标空间而非 VAE 潜空间中完成场景补全。
Result: 摘要报告，在 SemanticKITTI seq. 08 上，单步 x0 扩散教师的平方 Chamfer distance 由 0.396 降至 0.024 m^2，约 16 倍改进且无需改动模型；推理延迟为 209ms/帧，比迭代扩散基线低 65-138 倍，接近实时。
Conclusion: 作者认为在该任务区间数据质量对结果的影响超过模型设计，并提议多 token 潜空间可作为未来基于潜空间的扩散场景补全的稳定第一阶段。

papers.title: The Perils of Agency: How Developers Perceive, Prioritize, and Address Risks in Agentic AI Products
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI systems act autonomously, use tools, adapt to context, and operate in complex real-world environments. However, these same characteristics can create or exacerbate product risks. We studied how industry developers (n=35) perceive, prioritize, and address the risks in their agentic AI products. We found that developers' perceptions of risk were closely tied to the qualities that made the product agentic, such as autonomy, tool use, and usage in a real-world context. Developers prioritized product and business risks before considering downstream societal risks like job displacement and end-user privacy. This prioritization also impacted developers' ability and motivation to mitigate agentic risks. Finally, developers lacked mature controls for containing agentic risks, often relying on constraining the same characteristics that make agents useful: e.g., autonomy and goal complexity. These findings reveal a capability vs. risk control tension in agentic AI development: developers need to address risks that emerge from agentic capabilities, yet they currently have limited support for doing so without constraining agentic functionality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过调研35名产业界开发者，研究他们如何感知、优先级排序并应对 agentic AI 产品中的风险。研究发现，开发者对风险的感知与产品之所以具备 agentic 性质的特性（如自主性、工具使用、真实世界场景）紧密相关；他们优先处理产品与商业风险，而非失业、终端用户隐私等下游社会风险；同时缺乏成熟的风险控制手段，常通过限制自主性和目标复杂度来约束风险。
Motivation: Agentic AI 系统的自主决策、工具调用和情境适应等特性在提升能力的同时，也可能产生或加剧产品风险，但业界对开发者如何实际应对这些风险缺乏系统认识。
Method: 对35名产业界开发者进行实证研究（n=35），分析他们感知、优先级排序和应对 agentic AI 产品风险的方式。
Result: 开发者风险感知与 agentic 特性密切相关；产品与商业风险优先于失业、终端用户隐私等社会风险；开发者缺少成熟的风险控制手段，常用约束自主性和目标复杂度等方式来限制风险。
Conclusion: 研究揭示 agentic AI 开发中存在能力与风险控制的张力：开发者需要应对由 agentic 能力引发的风险，但当前支持有限，若不限制 agentic 功能则难以有效控制风险。

papers.title: ForesightSafety-SAGE:A Fully Automated Scenario Generation and Safety Evaluation Framework for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly evolving from simple text-based interaction systems into LLM agents that can maintain memory, use tools, access external environments, and execute tasks. As their capabilities and autonomy expand, the safety risks they face also become more diverse. Existing evaluations often rely on manually written scenarios, static prompts, or final-output judgments, making it difficult to capture the diverse risks that agents may face during task execution. We introduce ForesightSafety-SAGE, a fully automated scenario generation and safety evaluation framework for LLM agents. Based on five risk dimensions,we instantiae abstract and diverse safety risks in real-world task execution into 1,072 measurable evaluation scenarios. Using the automated evaluation pipeline, 12 LLM agents are evaluated under two authority contexts. The results show that current agents still face substantial behavioral safety risks during task execution, with an average ASR of 47.1% and several models exceeding 70%. These findings demonstrate the importance of executable, process-level evaluation for understanding and improving LLM agent safety.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ForesightSafety-SAGE，一个面向 LLM 智能体的全自动场景生成与安全评估框架。作者基于五个风险维度，把真实任务执行中的抽象安全风险实例化为 1,072 个可测量的评估场景，并用自动化流水线在两种权限上下文下评估了 12 个 LLM 智能体。结果显示当前智能体在任务执行中仍存在显著的行为安全风险，平均 ASR 为 47.1%，部分模型超过 70%。
Motivation: 现有评估多依赖人工编写的场景、静态提示或仅对最终输出进行判断，难以捕捉智能体在任务执行过程中可能面临的多样化安全风险。
Method: 提出 ForesightSafety-SAGE 框架，基于五个风险维度将抽象安全风险转化为 1,072 个可测量的具体评估场景，并通过自动化的评估流水线在两种权限上下文下对 12 个 LLM 智能体进行安全评估。
Result: 摘要报告当前智能体的平均攻击成功率 (ASR) 为 47.1%，且多个模型超过 70%，表明任务执行中仍存在较大的行为安全风险。
Conclusion: 作者强调可执行、过程级的安全评估对于理解和改进 LLM 智能体安全性的重要性。

papers.title: TIDE: Task-Isolated Diffusion for Unified Video Editing and Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Diffusion Transformers have driven rapid progress in video generation and editing, yet these capabilities are still handled by separate, task-specific models. Building a unified framework that supports diverse video tasks remains an open challenge: existing unified attempts either require dedicated auxiliary encoders or lack explicit mechanisms to distinguish heterogeneous conditioning tokens, struggling when the number and type of visual conditions vary across tasks. We propose TIDE, a unified framework that integrates instruction-based editing, reference-guided editing, and multi-reference generation. At its core, we introduce per-token task embeddings that assign each input token a task-specific identifier, enabling the model to explicitly disambiguate target, source, and reference tokens. To simultaneously capture high-level semantic understanding and fine-grained structural fidelity, we design a dual-path conditioning scheme that couples a vision-language model with a VAE latent path for complementary signals. We further devise a multi-task progressive training strategy that incrementally introduces tasks of increasing complexity, effectively harmonizing diverse objectives and enabling smooth generalization across heterogeneous task distributions. Extensive experiments on multiple video editing and generation benchmarks demonstrate that TIDE achieves state-of-the-art performance across all evaluated tasks. Our project page is available at https://LittleWork123.github.io/tide.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TIDE，一个统一的视频编辑与生成框架，整合了基于指令的编辑、参考引导编辑和多参考生成。核心是引入逐 token 的任务嵌入 (per-token task embeddings)，为每个输入 token 分配任务标识符，以显式区分目标、源和参考 token；并设计双路径条件化方案，将视觉语言模型与 VAE 潜在路径耦合，兼顾高层语义理解和细粒度结构保真。多任务渐进训练策略按复杂度递增引入任务，摘要称在多个视频编辑与生成基准上取得最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有视频生成与编辑能力仍由分离的任务专用模型处理，缺少统一框架；已有的统一尝试要么需要专用辅助编码器，要么缺乏区分异构条件 token 的显式机制，在任务间视觉条件的数量和类型变化时难以应对。
Method: 提出 TIDE 统一框架：引入逐 token 任务嵌入以显式区分目标、源与参考 token；设计双路径条件化机制，将视觉语言模型与 VAE 潜在路径耦合以获取互补信号；并采用多任务渐进训练策略，逐步引入复杂度递增的任务，协调多样目标并支持跨异构任务分布的泛化。
Result: 摘要报告在多个视频编辑和生成基准上的大量实验表明，TIDE 在所有评估任务上均达到最先进性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调逐 token 任务嵌入与双路径条件化使统一视频编辑与生成成为可能，并指出渐进式多任务训练有助于平滑泛化到异构任务分布。

papers.title: Vector Space of Cycles
papers.abstract_en: Most statistical and machine learning methods for directed interactions focus on pairwise effects among variables. Even existing cyclic models represent feedback primarily through node-level dependencies, making large-scale recurrent organization difficult to estimate and compare. This limitation is particularly acute in biological and neural systems, where interactions are highly recurrent and involve many overlapping cycles. We introduce a variational framework for statistical inference on cyclic interactions. Directed interactions are represented as edge flows on a simplicial complex and evolved under an energy-minimizing dynamical system. The resulting dynamics separate transient interaction components from persistent harmonic flows, yielding a low-dimensional cycle space that captures stable recurrent organization. Rather than enumerating individual cycles, the proposed framework represents cyclic interactions as elements of a Hilbert space, enabling projection, averaging, comparison, and population-level statistical inference. We establish theoretical properties of the harmonic projection, including characterization of the cycle space, variance reduction, and population inference. Simulations demonstrate substantially improved recovery of cyclic structure in dense recurrent systems compared with existing directed-interaction methods. Applied to resting-state fMRI from 400 human subjects, the framework reveals reproducible large-scale cyclic organization that is not detectable through edgewise averaging. These results provide a scalable statistical framework for studying recurrent interactions in high-dimensional dynamical systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于环状交互统计推断的变分框架，将 directed interactions 表示为单纯复形 (simplicial complex) 上的边流，并通过能量最小化动力学将其分解为瞬态分量与持久调和流，从而得到一个低维 cycle space。该框架把环状交互视为 Hilbert 空间元素，支持投影、平均、比较与群体级推断，并在模拟和 400 人静息态 fMRI 数据上展示了优于现有 directed-interaction 方法的环结构恢复能力。
Motivation: 现有针对有向交互的统计与机器学习方法大多只考虑变量间的成对效应，即使已有循环模型也主要借助节点级依赖表达反馈，导致大规模循环组织难以估计和比较；这一问题在交互高度循环且存在大量重叠环的生物与神经系统中尤为突出。
Method: 提出一个变分框架：将有向交互表示为单纯复形上的边流，并在一能量最小化动力系统下演化，从而将瞬态交互分量与持久调和流 (harmonic flows) 分离，得到捕捉稳定循环组织的低维 cycle space；循环交互以 Hilbert 空间元素表示，并建立调和投影的理论性质，包括 cycle space 表征、方差缩减和群体推断。
Result: 模拟实验显示，在密集循环系统中该方法对循环结构的恢复明显优于现有 directed-interaction 方法；应用于 400 名受试者的静息态 fMRI 时，揭示了可复现的大规模循环组织，而这类组织通过边级平均 (edgewise averaging) 无法检测。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了一个可扩展的统计框架，用于研究高维动态系统中的循环交互。

papers.title: DisPOSE: Projected Polystochastic Diffusion for Self-Supervised Multi-View 3D Human Pose Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Recovering 3D human poses for multiple individuals from different camera views is a fundamental bottleneck for analyzing interacting behaviors. Existing self-supervised approaches leverage synthetic catalogues of 3D poses; however, this leads to poor generalization in real-world scenarios due to distribution shifts. We therefore introduce DisPOSE, a self-supervised framework that approximates the inherently discrete multi-view person-assignment problem as a generative diffusion process over the space of polystochastic tensors. By employing differentiable Sinkhorn projections during denoising, our model learns to guide solutions toward valid and feasible assignments based on 2D image priors. The complete 3D skeletons of localized individuals are then regressed using a Hypergraph-Convolutional Decoder that explicitly models relational structures and articulated joints across multiple views. The proposed approach outperforms current state-of-the-art self-supervised methods on standard datasets and demonstrates strong performance on a newly proposed benchmark featuring highly occluded scenes from surgical operating rooms. Our diffusion-based localization demonstrates high label efficiency, retaining 99% of its performance with only 10% of the pseudo-labels. Notably, disentangling the assignment and root regression components while maintaining differentiability makes DisPOSE nearly agnostic to different camera arrangements. Project site and code: https://wngtn.github.io/DisPOSE/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DisPOSE，一种自监督的多视角 3D 人体姿态估计框架，将多视角下的人员分配问题建模为 polystochastic 张量空间上的生成式扩散过程。去噪过程中使用可微 Sinkhorn 投影来引导解朝向有效的分配，并通过超图卷积解码器 (Hypergraph-Convolutional Decoder) 回归完整 3D 骨架。方法在标准数据集上优于现有自监督方法，并在高度遮挡的手术室场景新基准上表现良好。
Motivation: 现有自监督方法依赖合成 3D 姿态目录训练，但在真实场景中存在分布偏移导致泛化差；同时多视角多人姿态估计中的离散人员分配问题缺少有效的可微建模。
Method: 将多视角人员分配近似为 polystochastic 张量空间上的扩散过程，在去噪阶段引入可微 Sinkhorn 投影以约束分配的有效性，并用 2D 图像先验引导；随后用超图卷积解码器基于跨视角关系结构回归完整 3D 骨架。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在标准数据集上优于当前最优的自监督方法，并在高度遮挡的手术室新基准上表现强；仅用 10% 伪标签即可保留 99% 性能，且通过解耦分配与根回归并保持可微性，使其对摄像机布置几乎不敏感。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将分配与根回归解耦并保持可微性，是 DisPOSE 对不同摄像机布置具有鲁棒性的关键，也体现了扩散式定位的高标签效率。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Where Rectified Flows Leak: Characterising Membership Signals Along the Interpolation Path
papers.abstract_en: Understanding memorization in generative models remains challenging, with implications for copyright and privacy. Beyond verbatim reproduction, models can encode subtler traces of their training data that never surface in their outputs yet remain exploitable. We refer to these measurable asymmetries as the \emph{membership signal}, and we study this regime for Rectified Flows (or Flow Matching), which are increasingly used in deployed generative systems. We analyze the interpolation path $X_λ= (1-λ)X_0 + λX_1$ that defines the Rectified Flow training. We show that a gap exists between the reconstruction of train and test data that follows a bell-shaped curve over $λ$, which accumulates during training, while the validation metrics remain stable. The signal has a maximum whose location we derive in closed form under Gaussian assumptions. We validate these predictions on both audio and images and show that the bell-shaped structure is universal, while the peak prediction holds when our assumptions are satisfied. As a proof of concept, we exploit this specific $λ$-resolved structure to perform a Membership Inference Attack, distinguishing members of the training set from non-members.
papers.comment: ICML 2026 article, 9 main pages and 25 with annexes, 11 figures
papers.journal_ref: 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, Seoul, South Korea, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Rectified Flow（Flow Matching）生成模型中沿插值路径泄露的训练数据成员信号。作者分析插值路径 X_λ=(1-λ)X_0+λX_1，证明训练集与测试集重建误差之间存在随 λ 呈钟形曲线的差距，该差距在训练中累积而验证指标保持稳定，并在高斯假设下闭式推导出信号峰值位置。作者在音频和图像上验证了钟形结构的普适性，并利用该 λ 分辨结构实现成员推理攻击 (Membership Inference Attack)。
Motivation: 生成模型中的记忆化问题对版权和隐私有重要影响；除逐字复现外，模型可能编码训练数据中不直接出现在输出中但仍可利用的细微痕迹，现有工作对此类成员信号沿插值路径的分布缺乏刻画。
Method: 针对 Rectified Flow 训练定义的插值路径 X_λ=(1-λ)X_0+λX_1，分析训练与测试数据重建之间的差距；在高斯假设下闭式推导信号最大值的 λ 位置，并在音频和图像数据上验证预测，同时将 λ 分辨结构用于构造成员推理攻击。
Result: 摘要报告训练与测试数据重建之间存在随 λ 呈钟形曲线的差距，该差距在训练中累积而验证指标稳定；钟形结构在音频和图像上具有普适性，峰值位置的预测在假设满足时成立，且该结构可成功用于区分训练集成员与非成员。
Conclusion: 作者强调沿插值路径的成员信号具有可预测的结构性，并可作为成员推理攻击的依据；峰值位置的闭式推导依赖于高斯假设，因此适用范围受该假设限制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Visual Spatial Planning from Symbolic State via Modality-Gap-Aware Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: While Vision-Language Models excel at general multimodal understanding, they still struggle with visual spatial planning. We attribute this limitation to a perception--reasoning modality gap. Visual planning requires models to infer latent state structures from pixels and then reason over the recovered structure to produce valid actions, whereas symbolic planning directly leverages explicit representation. This discrepancy introduces two sequential bottlenecks: visual state recovery at the perception stage and multi-step planning at the reasoning stage. To address this, we propose MGSD, a two-stage modality-gap-aware self-distillation framework. First, a cold-start grounding stage establishes reliable visual state recovery before on-policy training. Second, a symbol-guided on-policy self-distillation stage transfers the privileged teacher's planning behavior to the student through token-level supervision on student-generated prefixes. Crucially, symbolic information is used only during training, while inference relies exclusively on visual inputs. Experiments on visual planning benchmarks show that MGSD consistently improves performance across different model scales, raising the macro average by 19.3% and 18.4%, respectively. The resulting models substantially reduce the gap to the upper bounds obtained with symbolic inputs. Ablation studies and diagnostic analyses further confirm that the gains arise from improvements in both visual state recovery and optimal-path reasoning. These results demonstrate that MGSD strengthens not only the recovery of actionable states from visual observations but also the ability to plan over the inferred structures. Code is available at https://github.com/Oranger-l/MGSD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MGSD，一个两阶段的模态差距感知自蒸馏框架，用于改善视觉空间规划 (visual spatial planning) 能力。作者将视觉语言模型在此任务上的不足归因于感知-推理模态差距，即视觉输入需先恢复潜在状态结构再进行多步推理，而符号规划可直接使用显式表征。实验显示 MGSD 在不同模型规模上一致提升视觉规划基准表现，宏平均分别提高 19.3% 和 18.4%，并显著缩小了与符号输入上界之间的差距。
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在多模态理解上表现优秀，但在视觉空间规划上仍存在明显不足。作者认为根本原因是感知-推理模态差距：视觉规划需要先从像素中恢复潜在状态，再基于恢复的结构推理出有效动作，而符号规划直接使用显式表征，由此产生视觉状态恢复与多步规划两个顺序瓶颈。
Method: 提出两阶段自蒸馏框架 MGSD。第一阶段为冷启动接地 (cold-start grounding) 阶段，在策略训练前建立可靠的视觉状态恢复；第二阶段为符号引导的在线自蒸馏 (symbol-guided on-policy self-distillation) 阶段，通过对学生生成前缀 (student-generated prefixes) 的 token 级监督，将特权教师 (privileged teacher) 的规划行为迁移给学生。符号信息仅在训练时使用，推理时只依赖视觉输入。
Result: 在视觉规划基准上，MGSD 在多个模型规模下一致提升性能，宏平均分别提升 19.3% 和 18.4%，并明显缩小与符号输入所获上界之间的差距。消融实验和诊断分析表明，增益同时来自视觉状态恢复和最优路径推理两方面的改进。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 MGSD 不仅增强了从视觉观测中恢复可执行状态的能力，也提升了基于恢复结构进行规划的能力。符号信息只在训练阶段使用，推理完全依赖视觉输入。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: AsyncWebRL: Efficient Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Step Visual Web Agents
papers.abstract_en: Training vision-language web agents with multi-step RL is compute-intensive, with two dominant forms of inefficiency: idle GPUs in synchronous RL, and trajectories that use more steps and tokens than necessary. We present AsyncWebRL, which addresses both. On the system side, an asynchronous design overlaps rollout, gradient update, and policy refresh across iterations, paired with two web-agent-specific adaptations, namely an everlasting rollout pool and lightweight screenshot handling, that together deliver up to a $2.9\times$ end-to-end training-throughput speedup over the previously fastest open synchronous pipeline (WebGym). On the algorithmic side, we identify the per-trajectory normalizer $1/|τ_i|$ in multi-step GRPO as the root cause of trajectory-level and token-level inefficiency: because failures are systematically longer than successes, it down-weights the negative gradient on failed tokens, so the policy keeps producing verbose memory schemas. Replacing $1/|τ_i|$ with a constant $1/k$ breaks this coupling, contracting trajectories while preserving aggregate success. Together, these contributions set a new open-source state of the art on the WebGym out-of-distribution test split (+5.8% relative over the 42.9% prior best), with the largest gains on the harder slices (+42% relative on Medium, +48% relative on Hard).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AsyncWebRL，一个面向多步视觉 web 智能体的异步强化学习训练框架。系统端通过异步设计将 rollout、梯度更新与策略刷新重叠，并引入常驻 rollout 池和轻量截图处理；算法端将多步 GRPO 中的逐轨迹归一化因子 1/|τ_i| 替换为常数 1/k，解除失败轨迹长度与负梯度权重的耦合。摘要报告该方法相对此前最快的开源同步训练管线 WebGym 获得最高 2.9 倍端到端吞吐加速，并在 WebGym 分布外测试集上刷新开源 SOTA。
Motivation: 多步 RL 训练视觉-语言 web 智能体计算代价高昂，主要低效来源是同步 RL 中 GPU 空闲，以及轨迹比必要情况使用更多步数与 token。作者进一步识别出多步 GRPO 中 1/|τ_i| 归一化是轨迹级与 token 级低效的根源，因为失败轨迹系统性更长，该归一化会压低失败 token 上的负梯度，使策略持续产出冗长的记忆结构。
Method: 系统侧采用异步设计，重叠 rollout、梯度更新与策略刷新，并配备针对 web 智能体的两处适配：常驻 rollout 池（everlasting rollout pool）与轻量截图处理。算法侧将多步 GRPO 的逐轨迹归一化 1/|τ_i| 改为常数 1/k，从而切断轨迹长度对梯度权重的耦合，在保留聚合成功率的同时缩短轨迹。
Result: 摘要报告端到端训练吞吐量相对此前最快的开源同步管线 WebGym 最高提升 2.9 倍；在 WebGym 分布外测试集上相对此前 42.9% 的最佳结果取得 5.8% 的相对提升，其中 Medium 分片相对提升 42%、Hard 分片相对提升 48%。
Conclusion: 作者将新的开源 SOTA 归因于异步系统设计与常数长度归一化的联合贡献，并强调用常数 1/k 替代 1/|τ_i| 能够在保持聚合成功率的同时压缩轨迹长度。摘要未讨论明确的方法局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Structural Symmetries: Linear Mode Connectivity via Neuron Identifiability
papers.abstract_en: Many striking phenomena in deep learning, such as linear mode connectivity and the structured behavior of training dynamics, are closely tied to parameter symmetries: transformations that leave the realized function unchanged. Despite growing attention to parameter symmetries, the exact interplay between parameters, data, and representations remains underexplored. To investigate this, we develop a theoretical framework of effective function classes, i.e., the set of functions a neuron can realize on its input support, and the norm cost of realizing them. We then formalize effective symmetry breaking via neuron identifiability across independent training runs. Our analysis shows that neural networks can admit large families of approximately equivalent solutions even in structurally asymmetric models. We further show that neuron identifiability enables representation merging without prior alignment, and characterize when such merging admits a linear low-loss path. These findings highlight the role of effective function classes in affecting the loss landscape.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇论文提出一个关于神经网络参数对称性与损失景观的理论框架，引入有效函数类（effective function classes）和神经元可辨识性（neuron identifiability）的概念。摘要表明，即使网络结构不对称，也可能存在大量近似等价的解；神经元可辨识性还能在无需预对齐的情况下支持表示合并，并刻画了这种合并何时具有线性低损路径。
Motivation: 虽然参数对称性已受到广泛关注，但参数、数据与表示之间的精确相互作用仍未被充分探索。该论文试图从有效函数类的角度解释线性模式连通性和训练动态的某些结构化行为。
Method: 作者形式化了有效函数类的概念，即神经元在其输入支持上可实现的一组函数及其范数成本，并通过跨独立训练运行的神经元可辨识性来形式化有效对称性破缺。
Result: 分析显示神经网络在结构不对称的模型中也能拥有大族近似等价的解；神经元可辨识性使得表示合并无需先前对齐，并给出了这种合并可以产生线性低损路径的刻画。
Conclusion: 摘要强调有效函数类对损失景观的重要影响，并将这些发现作为理解线性模式连通性与训练动态结构的理论基础。
Relevance: 0
