papers.title: TiWeaver: Unified Temporal Dynamics Modeling via Contextual Patching
papers.abstract_en: Multivariate time series forecasting plays a critical role in real-world applications, including weather prediction, stock analysis, and health monitoring. Due to the diversity of data sources, time series exhibit diverse temporal dynamics, often accompanied by various irregularities such as missing values and non-uniform sampling frequencies. Such irregularities lead to complex and asynchronous temporal dependencies across channels. Thus, a single model with a fixed patching scheme often fails to adapt well to diverse multivariate time series, hindering accurate forecasting. In this paper, we propose TiWeaver, a unified framework designed to handle temporal dynamics and fine-grained inter-channel dependencies adaptively. Specifically, we introduce a Graph-Guided Adaptive Tokenizer (G$^2$AT) that divides time series into high contextually coherent patches by jointly considering temporal density and representation consistency. In addition, we propose a Fine-grained Asynchronous Dependency Extractor (FADE), which is designed to model fine-grained asynchronous inter-channel dependencies while incorporating long-term historical dependencies. We evaluate TiWeaver on 12 real-world time series datasets, where it achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming existing methods up to 25%. These results demonstrate its robustness and effectiveness across diverse domains and data characteristics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TiWeaver，一个面向多元时间序列预测的统一框架，旨在自适应处理不同数据源带来的多样时序动态以及缺失值、非均匀采样等不规则性。框架包含 Graph-Guided Adaptive Tokenizer (G²AT) 和 Fine-grained Asynchronous Dependency Extractor (FADE)，前者按时间密度与表示一致性切分上下文高连贯的 patch，后者建模细粒度异步跨通道依赖并融合长期历史依赖。摘要报告在 12 个真实数据集上达到 state-of-the-art 性能，最多比现有方法提升 25%。
Motivation: 多元时间序列常伴随缺失值和非均匀采样等不规则性，导致跨通道出现复杂且异步的时间依赖；单一模型配合固定 patching 方案难以适应多样化的多元时间序列，从而制约预测精度。
Method: 提出 TiWeaver 统一框架，包含两个核心组件：G²AT 通过联合考虑时间密度与表示一致性将序列划分为上下文高连贯的 patches；FADE 用于建模细粒度异步通道间依赖，同时纳入长期历史依赖。

papers.title: Rethinking Evaluation Paradigms in IBP-based Certified Training
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks achieve strong performance on many supervised learning tasks but remain vulnerable to adversarial perturbations. Neural network verification provides mathematically rigorous robustness guarantees, yet at substantial computational cost. To mitigate this, certified training techniques optimise for verifiable robustness during training, typically inducing a trade-off between natural and certified accuracy controlled by method-specific hyperparameters. Because these metrics are inherently conflicting, the common practice of reporting a single configuration is problematic: it can mislead conclusions about overall performance and prevents unbiased assessments of the state of the art. We address this by evaluating certified training methods via Pareto front comparisons over the natural--certified accuracy trade-off. To enable fair, method-agnostic comparisons, we perform efficient automated multi-objective hyperparameter optimisation to identify a set of Pareto-optimal configurations for each method. This approach often uncovers substantial undertuning in previously reported configurations, yielding superior performance and establishing a new state of the art. Leveraging these fronts, we present the first comprehensive multi-objective comparison of certified training approaches, showing that prior advancements are less pronounced than assumed and revealing previously unreported performance complementarities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新思考基于区间边界传播（IBP）的对抗性训练（certified training）的评估范式，主张用自然精度与可验证精度之间的 Pareto 前沿比较来替代单一配置的报告。作者通过高效的自动化多目标超参数优化为每种方法寻找一组 Pareto 最优配置，并据此给出首个综合性的多目标比较。结果表明先前报告的多项配置存在明显欠调优，新配置取得了更优性能并刷新了当前最优水平，同时揭示先前进展被高估。
Motivation: 对抗性训练通常要在自然精度和可验证精度之间做权衡，二者本质冲突，而常见做法只报告单一配置，容易误导对整体性能的结论，也无法公平评估当前最优方法。
Method: 提出基于 Pareto 前沿比较的评估框架，通过高效的自动化多目标超参数优化（automated multi-objective hyperparameter optimisation），以方法无关的方式为每种对抗性训练方法寻找一组 Pareto 最优配置。
Result: 发现先前报告配置普遍存在明显欠调优，新配置带来更优性能并确立新的最优结果；综合多目标比较显示此前声称的进展其实没有那么显著，并揭示出未被报告过的性能互补性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调单一配置报告会误导评估结论，Pareto 前沿式多目标比较能更公正地反映对抗性训练方法的真实能力。

papers.title: The Challenges of Using Reinforcement Learning for Controlling Industrial Energy Systems
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has shown promising results for optimizing the control of industrial energy systems, yet most existing studies remain limited to the application in simulation environments. We investigate the challenges of deploying reinforcement learning in a real-world industrial energy system, considering a thermal heating network as a use case. We formulate the task as a Markov Decision Process and systematically analyze the associated challenges along the structure of the formal description, including partial observability, action space design, reward design, and the simulation-to-reality gap. The challenges are grounded in an existing real-world deployment, where reinforcement learning achieves operational stability but shows a significant performance gap compared to simulation.
papers.comment: Accepted to Finding the Frame Workshop at RLC 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究强化学习（reinforcement learning）在真实工业能源系统中部署的挑战，以热力供热网络为用例。作者将任务建模为马尔可夫决策过程，并沿形式化描述的结构系统分析部分可观测性、动作空间设计、奖励设计以及仿真到现实差距（simulation-to-reality gap）。基于实际部署，强化学习虽实现运行稳定性，但与仿真相比存在显著性能差距。
Motivation: 现有强化学习优化工业能源系统控制的研究大多局限于仿真环境，缺乏对真实世界部署挑战的系统分析。
Method: 以热力供热网络为真实用例，将控制任务形式化为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），并依据形式化描述结构逐项分析部分可观测性、动作空间设计、奖励设计和仿真到现实差距。
Result: 在实际部署中，强化学习实现了运行稳定性，但与仿真结果相比存在显著性能差距。
Conclusion: 摘要强调工业能源系统中强化学习从仿真走向真实部署仍面临系统性挑战，需要针对形式化建模各环节进行专门处理。

papers.title: Multi-Legal-Bench: Evaluating LLMs on Legal Reasoning Across Jurisdictions, Languages, and Legal Traditions
papers.abstract_en: Legal NLP benchmarks overwhelmingly evaluate a single language or aggregate tasks that differ fundamentally across jurisdictions, making cross-lingual comparison impossible. We introduce Multi-Legal-Bench, the first cross-jurisdictional legal benchmark that evaluates identical tasks across six countries (Ukraine, France, Netherlands, Poland, Czech Republic, Lithuania), four language families, and 165 million full-text court decisions. The benchmark defines five tasks (court-type classification, judgment form classification, case-outcome prediction, legal norm extraction, and cause category prediction) mapped to structured metadata from national court registries, forming a deliberately sparse 5x6 task-jurisdiction matrix (20 of 30 cells filled). We evaluate 7 frontier LLMs under zero-shot and 3-shot prompting via AWS Bedrock, with 4 additional small/medium models (3-12B) for scaling analysis. Our results reveal that: (1) few-shot gains are uneven and track how much headroom a cell leaves rather than its language, with 8 of 28 judgment-form model-jurisdiction pairs losing accuracy; (2) no single model dominates any language, rankings shift with both task and jurisdiction; (3) cross-lingual few-shot transfer does not follow language proximity: UA->FR (Romance, -2.0 pp) transfers better than UA->PL (Slavic, -13.8 pp), with label-set alignment predicting transfer quality better than language family; and (4) tokenizer fertility, despite a 2.3x spread, does not significantly predict cross-lingual accuracy (r=-0.14, p=0.24), suggesting that model architecture and pretraining data dominate tokenizer efficiency. We release all data, prompts, and model predictions.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. v2 corrects scorer and taxonomy defects, adds no-model baselines showing label leakage, re-runs the Lithuanian cells on de-leaked text, and withdraws the claim that few-shot helps on judgment-form classification everywhere; all tables and figures regenerated. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/overthelex/multi-legal-bench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Multi-Legal-Bench，一个跨司法辖区的法律推理基准，覆盖六个国家、四个语系和 1.65 亿份裁判文书，并定义五个任务映射到国家法院登记处的结构化元数据。作者在 AWS Bedrock 上评估 7 个前沿 LLM 的零样本与 3-shot 提示，外加 4 个 3-12B 的小/中模型进行规模分析。结果发现 few-shot 收益不均匀、模型排名随任务和司法辖区变化、跨语言迁移不遵循语言亲缘关系，而 tokenizer fertility 不能显著预测跨语言准确率。
Motivation: 现有法律 NLP 基准大多评估单一语言或将不同司法辖区中本质不同的任务聚合在一起，导致跨语言比较不可能。
Method: 构建 5x6 任务-司法辖区稀疏矩阵（30 格中填 20 格），定义法院类型分类、判决形式分类、案件结果预测、法律规范抽取和原因类别预测五个任务，并在零样本与 3-shot 下通过 AWS Bedrock 评估多个 LLM。
Result: 摘要报告：judgment-form 的 28 个模型-司法辖区对中 8 个在 few-shot 下准确率下降；UA->FR（罗曼语族，-2.0 pp）的跨语言迁移优于 UA->PL（斯拉夫语族，-13.8 pp），标签集对齐比语系更能预测迁移质量；tokenizer fertility 虽有 2.3 倍差异，但对跨语言准确率无显著预测力（r=-0.14, p=0.24）。
Conclusion: 作者认为跨司法辖区的法律评估需要显式建立任务-司法辖区矩阵，并指出标签集对齐而非语言亲缘关系主导 few-shot 迁移效果，同时模型架构和预训练数据比 tokenizer 效率更关键。

papers.title: Ω-QVLA: Robust Quantization for Vision-Language-Action Models via Composite Rotation and Per-step Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models unify perception, reasoning, and control within a single policy, yet their multi-billion-parameter backbones and diffusion-based action heads make on-device deployment prohibitively expensive. Prior quantization efforts offer only partial solutions, compressing the LLM backbone while leaving the DiT action head at full precision, or resorting to mixed-precision schemes, driven by the belief that uniformly quantizing the action head is inherently unstable. We challenge this assumption with Omega-QVLA, the first training-free post-training quantization framework that compresses both the language backbone and the entire diffusion action head of a VLA model to a uniform W4A4 precision, eliminating the need for mixed-precision allocation. Omega-QVLA combines a composite SVD-Hadamard rotation that equalizes per-channel weight energy while diffusing residual activation outliers with per-step DiT activation scaling quantization that absorbs dynamic-range drift across denoising steps. On LIBERO, Omega-QVLA compresses Pi 0.5 and GR00T N1.5 to W4A4 with 98.0% and 87.8% task success rates, matching or exceeding their FP16 references of 97.1% and 87.0%, while reducing the static memory footprint by 71.3%. Real-world manipulation experiments further confirm smooth, accurate manipulation where prior methods fail. Code is available at https://github.com/UCMP13753/Omega-QVLA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Omega-QVLA，一个无需训练的 post-training quantization (PTQ) 框架，首次将 VLA 模型的 LLM 主干和完整 DiT 扩散动作头统一压缩到 W4A4 精度，无需混合精度分配。方法结合复合 SVD-Hadamard 旋转以均衡逐通道权重能量并扩散激活离群值，以及逐 denoising 步的 DiT 激活缩放量化来吸收动态范围漂移。在 LIBERO 上，Pi 0.5 和 GR00T N1.5 压缩至 W4A4 后任务成功率分别为 98.0% 和 87.8%，匹配或超过其 FP16 参考值，并将静态内存占用降低 71.3%。
Motivation: VLA 模型因数十亿参数主干和扩散动作头导致设备端部署成本过高，现有量化工作只压缩 LLM 主干或使用混合精度，源于均匀量化动作头不稳定的假设。本文挑战这一假设，目标是统一 W4A4 压缩整个模型。
Method: 提出 Omega-QVLA，结合复合 SVD-Hadamard 旋转来均衡逐通道权重能量并扩散残差激活离群值，再配合逐 denoising 步的 DiT 激活缩放量化，吸收跨步动态范围漂移，从而实现对语言主干和完整扩散动作头的训练无关均匀量化。
Result: 在 LIBERO 基准上，Pi 0.5 和 GR00T N1.5 被压缩到 W4A4，任务成功率分别为 98.0% 和 87.8%，超过或匹配其 FP16 参考值 97.1% 和 87.0%，静态内存占用减少 71.3%。真实世界操作实验也显示平稳准确的操作，而先前方法失败。
Conclusion: 摘要表明均匀量化 VLA 的扩散动作头是可行的，无需混合精度；Omega-QVLA 可作为消除动作头量化不稳定性假设的有效方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Same Answer, Different Confidence: Protocol Sensitivity in LLM Confidence Calibration
papers.abstract_en: Is verbalized confidence better calibrated than token likelihood? The answer depends on how the token likelihood is measured: which answer is scored, and under which prompt. Published comparisons diverge on this, and in a twelve-study audit five never state the choice. We fix one prediction event per question, the model's own answer together with its correctness label, and score that same answer under a plain query and inside the confidence prompt, holding the answer and its label fixed. Across four QA datasets and three 7-8B Instruct models this changes which signal performs better, by point estimate, in 4 of 12 settings under ECE and 9 of 12 under AUROC. The AUROC result cannot come from rescaling the likelihoods, since AUROC is invariant to any common order-preserving transformation; the items are ordered differently. Two further choices behave the same way: substituting the reference string for the model's own answer, and reading the first answer token instead of the answer span. Crossing three answer slots, two scored strings, and two readouts gives twelve measured operational variants that leave the sign of the ECE comparison ndetermined in 6 of 12 settings, whereas alternative calibration estimators move it substantially less, although one changes a single prompted-context winner. Verbalized confidence is sensitive to answer formulation as well: replacing an accepted TriviaQA alias with the canonical reference raises confidence by $0.072$ although both answers are correct. Comparing the two signals therefore requires an explicit answer, context, and evaluation protocol.

TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）中口头表达置信度（verbalized confidence）与 token 似然（token likelihood）在校准上的比较，指出结论取决于具体的评估协议。作者固定每个问题的预测事件（模型自身答案及其正确性标签），在普通查询和置信度提示下对同一答案打分，跨四个问答数据集和三个 7-8B Instruct 模型，发现哪个信号更优在 ECE 下 12 个设置中的 4 个、AUROC 下 12 个设置中的 9 个发生翻转。
Motivation: 已有研究对 verbalized confidence 与 token likelihood 的校准优劣结论不一致，作者审计了十二项研究，其中五项从未说明 token 似然的具体测量方式（对哪个答案、在哪个提示下打分）。这种协议不明确导致比较结果难以复现。
Method: 固定每个问题的一个预测事件：模型自己的答案及其正确性标签，然后在普通查询和置信度提示下对同一答案打分，保持答案和标签不变。进一步交叉三种答案槽位、两种被评分的字符串（模型答案 vs 参考答案）、两种读取方式（答案跨度 vs 第一个 token），得到十二种操作变体。
Result: 在四个问答数据集和三个 7-8B Instruct 模型上，比较方向在 ECE 下 12 个设置中的 4 个、AUROC 下 12 个设置中的 9 个发生改变。AUROC 的变化不能归因于似然的重新缩放，因为 AUROC 对保序变换不变。此外，将 TriviaQA 中已接受的别名替换为规范参考答案会使置信度提高 0.072。

papers.title: Mitigating Gradient Pathology in PINNs through Aligned Constraint
papers.abstract_en: While Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) are powerful for solving Partial Differential Equations (PDEs), their training is often paralyzed by gradient pathology. The gradients from the PDE residuals and boundary constraints oppose each other, trapping the model in local minima. Current solutions, such as adaptive weighting or hard constraints, either fail to fundamentally resolve this ill-conditioning or are limited to simple geometries. In this study, we systematically analyze the possible causes of this gradient pathology from the perspectives of loss landscapes and optimization dynamics. Based on the obtained conclusion, we propose Constraint-Aligned loss with Manifold Lifting (CAML). By reformulating all zeroth-order terms into aligned constraints, our method effectively mitigates gradient conflicts. In addition, we introduce a delay factor to help the optimizer skip the high-curvature area. Experiments demonstrate that our CAML significantly enhances numerical stability and efficiency in highly complex PINN problems. Our code is open-sourced on https://github.com/YichenLuo-0/CAML.
papers.journal_ref: Forty-Third International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究物理信息神经网络 (PINNs) 训练中的梯度病理问题，提出 Constraint-Aligned loss with Manifold Lifting (CAML)。该方法将零阶项重构为对齐约束，并引入延迟因子帮助优化器跳过高曲率区域，从而缓解 PDE 残差与边界约束之间的梯度冲突。实验表明 CAML 在高度复杂的 PINN 问题上显著提升数值稳定性与效率，代码已开源。
Motivation: PINN 训练常因 PDE 残差与边界约束的梯度方向相互对抗而陷入局部极小值，导致训练瘫痪；现有自适应加权或硬约束方法要么未能根本解决病态条件，要么局限于简单几何。
Method: 从损失景观和优化动力学两个角度系统分析梯度病理的可能成因，提出 CAML：将所有权 zeroth-order 项重构为对齐约束以缓解梯度冲突，并引入延迟因子以帮助优化器跳过高曲率区域。
Result: 实验表明 CAML 在高度复杂的 PINN 问题中显著增强数值稳定性并提高训练效率；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为将零阶项重构为对齐约束可有效缓解 PINN 训练中的梯度冲突，并强调该方法在复杂 PINN 问题上的适用性。

papers.title: Ratchet: How Reliable Must an LLM Judge Be to Retire a Skill?
papers.abstract_en: A large language model (LLM) agent that writes and edits its own skill library must also decide which skills to keep, from one noisy scalar per skill. The answer is exact: a judge scoring failures as passes at rate $(1-τ)/2$ or above retires nothing, at any sample size, for eviction margin $τ$. Audits find that machinery is rarely built: LLM-written skills are worth $+0.0$ percentage points (pp) against a no-skill control, human-written ones $+16.2$pp. Unmaintained, a library enters \emph{library drift}, growing until injecting a skill scores worse than injecting nothing. \textbf{Ratchet} repairs this: it evicts each skill on its measured contribution, caps the library at width $C$, and constrains synthesis, lifting held-out $pass@1$ by $+0.328$ on a hard MBPP+ slice. The matching non-divergence bound is finite for exactly two reasons, $C$ and $τ$. Our contribution is the condition this repair carries and no deployed system states. In reference-free domains the scalar comes from an LLM judge, whose two error directions, modelled as a binary channel, behave nothing alike. Passes scored as failures cost sample efficiency, which more trials buy back; failures scored as passes displace the eviction statistic, and no correction inside the rule recovers it. End-task score is a poor alarm, moving by at most a fifth of the governed lift and not monotonically in the rate. We prove both edges of the certifiable region, confirm them in a running loop, and place a judge on a known side in one offline pass.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 LLM 智能体维护自身技能库时如何决定保留或淘汰技能，形式化地刻画了 LLM judge 的可靠性要求。作者给出精确条件：当 judge 以速率 $(1-τ)/2$ 或更高把失败判为通过时，在任意样本量下都不应淘汰任何技能（eviction margin 为 τ）。他们发现实际系统中很少构建这类机制，LLM 编写的技能相对无技能对照仅 +0.0pp，人工编写的为 +16.2pp；未维护的技能库会进入 library drift，最终注入技能比什么都不注入更差。文中提出 Ratchet 机制，通过按实测贡献淘汰技能、限制库宽度 C 并约束合成，在困难的 MBPP+ 子集上将 held-out pass@1 提升 +0.328。
Motivation: LLM 智能体自己编写并编辑技能库，必须根据每个技能的单个含噪标量决定保留哪些技能，但现有部署系统几乎不构建这种评估/淘汰机制，导致技能库退化甚至有害。
Method: 将 LLM judge 的两类错误方向建模为二元信道（binary channel），证明可认证区域的两个边界，并提出 Ratchet：按测得贡献逐技能淘汰、把技能库宽度限制为 C、约束技能合成过程。
Result: 理论证明非发散界因 C 和 τ 两个因素而有限，并在运行循环中确认两端边界；Ratchet 在困难的 MBPP+ 切片上使 pass@1 提升 +0.328；端到端分数作为预警信号不佳，最多只反映所治理提升的五分之一且不随差错率单调变化。
Conclusion: 作者强调其贡献是 Ratchet 所携带的可认证条件（C 与 τ），而非某个部署系统本身；在无参考域中 judge 的标量来自 LLM judge，失败判为通过会干扰淘汰统计量且无法通过规则内修正恢复，而通过判为失败只损失采样效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Thinking in Scales: Accelerating Gigapixel Pathology Image Analysis via Adaptive Continuous Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Traditional whole slide image (WSI) analysis methods typically rely on the multiple instance learning (MIL) paradigm, which extracts patch-level features at high magnification and aggregates them for slide-level prediction. However, such exhaustive patch-level processing is computationally expensive, severely limiting the efficiency and scalability of WSI analysis. To address this challenge, we propose PathCTM (a Pathology-oriented Continuous Thought Model) that enables token-efficient scale-space continuous reasoning for gigapixel WSIs. PathCTM formulates diagnostic inference as a dynamic sequential information pursuit. It progressively transitions from low-magnification global to high-magnification local inspection, and adaptively terminates inference when sufficient evidence is gathered to effectively bound decision uncertainty. Specifically, it uses conditional computation for dynamic scale switching with attention-guided region pruning, coupled with confidence-aware early stopping. Extensive experiments demonstrate that, compared with standard MIL-based methods, PathCTM reduces the number of required image patches by 95.95% and shortens inference time by approximately 95.62%, while maintaining AUC without degradation. Code is available at https://github.com/JSGe-AI/PathCTM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PathCTM（面向病理学的连续思维模型，Pathology-oriented Continuous Thought Model），用于十亿像素全切片图像（WSI）的高效分析。它将诊断推理建模为动态的顺序信息追寻，从低倍率全局观察逐步过渡到高倍率局部检查，并在证据充分时自适应终止。实验显示，与标准 MIL 方法相比，PathCTM 将所需图像块数量减少 95.95%，推理时间缩短约 95.62%，且 AUC 不下降。
Motivation: 传统 WSI 分析依赖多示例学习（MIL）范式，在高倍率下逐块提取特征并聚合，这种穷举式块级处理计算开销大，严重限制 WSI 分析的效率与可扩展性。
Method: PathCTM 将诊断推理构建为动态序列化信息追寻，通过条件计算实现动态尺度切换，结合注意力引导的区域剪枝（attention-guided region pruning）与置信度感知的提前停止（confidence-aware early stopping），从低倍率全局逐步转向高倍率局部检查并自适应终止。
Result: 在广泛实验中，与标准 MIL 方法相比，PathCTM 减少 95.95% 的所需图像块数量，缩短约 95.62% 的推理时间，同时 AUC 无退化。
Conclusion: PathCTM 表明面向病理图像的 token 高效尺度空间连续推理能够大幅降低 WSI 分析的计算代价，其核心技术是自适应终止以有效约束决策不确定性。

papers.title: Trustworthy Agent Network: Trust in Agent Networks Must Be Baked In, Not Bolted On
papers.abstract_en: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models has given rise to autonomous LLM-based agents capable of complex reasoning and execution. As these agents transition from isolated operation to collaborative ecosystems, we witness the emergence of the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) network, a paradigm where heterogeneous agents autonomously coordinate to solve multi-step tasks. While these networks may offer better task performance compared to simply using one agent to complete the entire task, they introduce systemic vulnerabilities, such as adversarial composition, semantic misalignment, and cascading operational failures, that existing agent alignment techniques cannot address. In this vision paper, we argue that the trustworthiness of A2A networks cannot be fully guaranteed via retrofitting on existing protocols that are largely designed for individual agents. Rather, it must be architected from the very beginning of the A2A coordination framework. We present a comprehensive conceptual framework that situates trust in A2A systems through four design pillars.
papers.comment: Accepted at SIGKDD 2026 Blue Sky Ideas Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇愿景论文，讨论大语言模型驱动的自主智能体所组成的 Agent-to-Agent (A2A) 网络的信任问题。作者认为，针对单个智能体的对齐技术无法解决 A2A 网络中的系统性漏洞，如对抗性组合、语义错位和级联性运行故障，因此信任必须在 A2A 协调框架设计之初就内建，而不是事后修补。论文提出一个将信任置于 A2A 系统中的概念框架，包含四个设计支柱。
Motivation: LLM 智能体正从孤立运行转向协作生态，A2A 网络虽可能提升多步任务性能，但引入了现有智能体对齐技术无法应对的系统性漏洞，信任问题成为关键缺口。
Method: 作为愿景论文，作者提出概念性框架，主张从 A2A 协调框架的初始设计阶段即内置信任，并通过四个设计支柱来定位 A2A 系统中的信任。
Result: 论文未报告实验或量化结果，主要贡献是论证信任必须内建于 A2A 网络架构，而非依赖事后改造现有协议。
Conclusion: 作者强调 A2A 网络的信任无法通过对主要为单个智能体设计的协议进行改造来完全保证，必须从协调框架构建之初就进行架构设计。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 论文未报告实验或量化结果，主要贡献是论证信任必须内建于 A2A 网络架构，而非依赖事后改造现有协议。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调 A2A 网络的信任无法通过对主要为单个智能体设计的协议进行改造来完全保证，必须从协调框架构建之初就进行架构设计。

papers.title: The Expressive Power of Low Precision Softmax Transformers with (Summarized) Chain-of-Thought
papers.abstract_en: Existing expressivity results for transformers typically rely on hardmax attention, high precision, and other architectural modifications that disconnect them from the models used in practice. We bridge this gap by analyzing standard transformer decoders with softmax attention and rounding of activations and attention weights, while allowing depth and width to grow logarithmically with the context length. As an intermediate step, we construct hardmax transformers with ternary activations and well-separated attention scores that simulate Turing machines using Chain-of-Thought (CoT). This lets us convert the constructions to equivalent softmax transformers without the unrealistic parameter magnitudes or activation precision that prior approaches would require. Using the same technique, we analyze a recently proposed summarized CoT paradigm and show that it simulates Turing machines more efficiently, with model size scaling logarithmically in a space bound rather than a time bound. We empirically test predictions made by our results on a Sudoku reasoning task and find better alignment with learnability than for prior high-precision results. Our code is available at https://github.com/moritzbroe/transformer-expressivity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究低精度（low precision）softmax Transformer 的表达能力，考察标准 decoder 结构在 softmax attention、激活与注意力权重取整（rounding）的条件下，允许深度和宽度随上下文长度对数增长时能模拟什么计算。作者先用三元激活且注意力分数分离良好的 hardmax Transformer 模拟图灵机（借助 Chain-of-Thought），再将该构造转换为不需要不现实参数幅度或激活精度的 softmax 版本，并进一步分析最近提出的 summarized CoT 范式。
Motivation: 现有 Transformer 表达能力结果大多依赖 hardmax attention、高精度数值以及其他与实用模型脱节的架构修改，难以解释实际训练出的模型。作者希望在不引入这些不现实假设的前提下，分析标准 softmax Transformer 在低精度设置下的表达能力。
Method: 以中间步骤构造带三元激活（ternary activations）和良好分离注意力分数的 hardmax Transformer，用 Chain-of-Thought（CoT）模拟图灵机；再将构造转换为等价的 softmax Transformer，避免先前方法所需的极端参数幅度或激活精度。作者用同一技术分析 summarized CoT 范式，并给出其模拟图灵机的规模上界。
Result: 摘要报告称 summarized CoT 能更高效地模拟图灵机，模型规模随空间界（space bound）对数增长而非时间界（time bound）；在 Sudoku 推理任务上，实验预测与可学习性（learnability）的吻合程度优于先前高精度结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为低精度 softmax Transformer 的表达性分析能更好地贴近实践中使用的模型，所提构造在参数幅度和激活精度上比以往方法更现实，并公开了代码。

papers.title: PULSE: Agentic Investigation with Passive Sensing for Proactive Affective Intervention in Cancer Survivorship
papers.abstract_en: Cancer survivors face elevated rates of depression, anxiety, and emotional distress, yet self-report may be unavailable at some moments when support is relevant, a challenge we term the diary paradox. We present PULSE, a system for agentic sensing investigation: LLM agents equipped with eight purpose-built tools query smartphone sensing data, compare current behavior with personal baselines, and retrieve outcome-labeled historical cases. Rather than receiving only a fixed feature summary, agents choose which modalities and time windows to inspect. We evaluate PULSE through a two-by-two evaluation design crossing system architecture (structured single-pass vs. multi-turn agentic) with concurrent input modality (no current diary vs. sensing plus current diary) on 50 cancer survivors. The agentic multimodal condition achieves balanced accuracy of 0.743 for emotion-regulation desire; the agentic no-current-diary condition achieves 0.713 for self-reported intervention availability. This is a system-level comparison because the architecture conditions also differ in tool-mediated information access. The results provide a retrospective benchmark for interactive sensing investigation and motivate prospective evaluation at diary non-response moments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PULSE 是一个面向癌症幸存者情感干预的 LLM 智能体系统，用于主动感知调查（agentic sensing investigation）。智能体配备八种专用工具查询智能手机感知数据、对比当前行为与个人基线，并检索带结果标注的历史案例，而非接收固定的特征汇总。在 50 名癌症幸存者上采用二乘二设计（系统架构与输入模态交叉）评估，智能体多模态条件在情绪调节意愿（emotion-regulation desire）上达到 0.743 的平衡准确率，智能体无当前日记条件在自我报告干预可用性上达到 0.713。
Motivation: 癌症幸存者面临较高的抑郁、焦虑和情绪困扰风险，但在需要支持的相关时刻，自我报告可能不可用，作者称之为日记悖论（diary paradox），因此需要系统能够主动进行感知层面的调查。
Method: 提出 PULSE 系统，让 LLM 智能体通过八个专用工具自主决定检查哪些感知模态和时间窗口；评估采用二乘二设计，交叉系统架构（结构化单遍 vs. 多轮智能体）与并发输入模态（无当前日记 vs. 感知加当前日记），以比较系统级信息访问方式的影响。
Result: 摘要报告智能体多模态条件在情绪调节意愿上达到 0.743 的平衡准确率，智能体无当前日记条件在自我报告干预可用性上达到 0.713。
Conclusion: 作者强调这是系统级比较，因为架构条件在工具介导的信息访问上也有差异；结果提供了交互式感知调查的回顾性基准，并为日记未响应时刻的前瞻性评估提供了动机。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Dropping the Anchor: Statistical Context Summarization for Distributed Systems via Pulsar Attention
papers.abstract_en: Inference with large language models (LLMs) on long sequences is computationally expensive due to the quadratic complexity of self-attention. Distributed blockwise methods such as Star Attention reduce this cost by sharding context across hosts, but rely on prepending a static, content-blind copy of the first block to every host. We propose Pulsar Attention, which replaces the static anchor with two lightweight, content-aware components: a small attention-sink prefix that stabilizes softmax, and compact cross-block summaries built via a Max-IDF heuristic that selects chunks containing globally rare tokens. This reduces the Phase 1 per-GPU FLOPs by up to 3.3x over Star Attention while retaining an identical KV cache footprint. On RULER with Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Pulsar Attention outperforms Star Attention at sequence lengths up to 128K tokens and remains competitive with dense attention across most tasks, with task-dependent absolute gains of up to 4.7% over the dense baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Pulsar Attention，一种用于分布式 LLM 长序列推理的注意力机制，旨在替代 Star Attention 中静态、内容无关的锚点块。该方法用一个小型 attention-sink 前缀和基于 Max-IDF 启发式构建的紧凑跨块摘要（cross-block summaries）来提供内容感知的上下文，从而在不改变 KV cache 占用的情况下减少计算量。在 RULER 基准和 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上，该方法在最长 128K token 序列中优于 Star Attention，并在多数任务上与密集注意力（dense attention）保持竞争力。
Motivation: LLM 在长序列推理中因自注意力的二次复杂度而计算昂贵；Star Attention 通过分片上下文降低成本，但其依赖静态且内容盲的锚点块，可能损害信息保留。
Method: Pulsar Attention 用两个轻量级内容感知组件替换静态锚点：一个稳定 softmax 的小型 attention-sink 前缀，以及通过 Max-IDF 启发式选择包含全局稀有 token 的块来构建的紧凑跨块摘要。
Result: 相比 Star Attention，该方法在 Phase 1 将每 GPU FLOPs 降低最多 3.3 倍，同时保持相同的 KV cache 占用；在 RULER 上使用 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 时，在最长 128K token 序列中优于 Star Attention，并且在大多任务上与密集注意力相当，部分任务相对密集基线有最高 4.7% 的绝对提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为，用内容感知的跨块摘要替代静态锚点可以在分布式长序列注意力中同时改善计算效率与任务表现。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: DualKV: Shared-Prompt Flash Attention for Efficient RL Training with Large Rollouts and Long Contexts
papers.abstract_en: Modern RL post-training methods such as GRPO and DAPO train on N response sequences of R tokens sampled from a shared prompt of P tokens, but standard FlashAttention replicates all P prompt tokens N times across both forward and backward passes -- duplicating compute and memory on identical hidden states. In large-rollout, long-context RL training (N>=16, P>=8K), this redundancy dominates the policy update cost. We observe that in decoder-only models, causal masking makes prompt representations invariant across sequences at every layer, so all per-token operations (norms, projections, MLP) and attention can process the prompt once -- a property not yet exploited at the kernel level for training. We propose DualKV, the first FlashAttention kernel variant that eliminates shared-prompt replication during RL training, via (1) fused CUDA forward and backward kernels that iterate over two disjoint KV regions -- shared context and per-sequence response -- in a single kernel launch, and (2) a data-pipeline redesign in veRL that repacks N(P+R) tokens into P+NR tokens per micro-batch, extending the token reduction from attention to the entire model by a factor rho = N(P+R)/(P+NR). DualKV is mathematically equivalent to standard attention and introduces no approximation. On Qwen3-8B GRPO training with 8xH100 GPUs (N=32, 8K-context), DualKV achieves 1.63--2.09x policy-update speedup, enables 2x larger micro-batches, and raises MFU from 36% to 76%. Similar gains hold for DAPO (2.47x speedup, 77% MFU). At 30B MoE scale on 16xH100, DualKV achieves 3.82x policy-update and 3.38x end-to-end step speedup over FlashAttention (which requires 4-way Ulysses sequence parallelism to avoid OOM). DualKV also extends to hybrid sliding/global attention with head dimension 512 (which FA2 does not support) and integrates with Ulysses sequence parallelism, demonstrated on Gemma-4-31B GRPO at 64K context.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DualKV，一种针对 RL 后训练（GRPO/DAPO）中共享提示词与大规模 rollout、长上下文场景的 FlashAttention kernel 变体。标准 FlashAttention 会把 P 个提示词 token 复制 N 次做前向和反向计算，DualKV 利用 decoder-only 模型因果掩码下提示词表示跨序列不变的性质，通过融合 CUDA 前向/反向 kernel 在一次启动中分别处理共享上下文与逐序列响应的两段 KV，并在 veRL 数据流水线中将 N(P+R) 个 token 重排为 P+NR 个，使 token 缩减因子 rho 作用于整个模型；该方法与标准注意力数学等价、无近似。摘要报告在 Qwen3-8B GRPO、DAPO 及 30B MoE 等规模下取得 1.63–3.82x 的策略更新加速，并将 MFU 从 36% 提升至 76–77%。
Motivation: 现代 RL 后训练如 GRPO 和 DAPO 会对共享提示词采样 N 条响应序列，但标准 FlashAttention 在前向和反向中都把提示词 token 复制 N 次，在 N>=16、P>=8K 的大 rollout 长上下文训练中，这种重复计算与内存占用主导策略更新开销。作者指出 decoder-only 模型中因果掩码使提示词表示逐层跨序列不变，但这一性质此前未在训练 kernel 层面被利用。
Method: DualKV 包含两部分：一是融合的 CUDA 前向和反向 kernel，在单次 kernel launch 中遍历两个不相交的 KV 区域（共享上下文 shared context 与逐序列响应 per-sequence response）；二是 veRL 中的数据流水线重设计，把每 micro-batch 从 N(P+R) 个 token 重排为 P+NR 个，使 token 缩减从注意力层扩展到整个模型，缩减因子为 rho = N(P+R)/(P+NR)。该方法与标准注意力严格等价，不引入近似。
Result: 在 8xH100 上对 Qwen3-8B 做 GRPO 训练（N=32，8K 上下文），DualKV 实现 1.63–2.09x 的策略更新加速，支持 2 倍更大的 micro-batch，并把 MFU 从 36% 提升到 76%；DAPO 得到 2.47x 加速和 77% MFU。在 16xH100 的 30B MoE 规模上，相对需要 4 路 Ulysses 序列并行以避免 OOM 的 FlashAttention，DualKV 取得 3.82x 策略更新和 3.38x 端到端 step 加速。此外它还支持 FA2 不支持的 head 维度 512 的混合 sliding/global attention，并能与 Ulysses 序列并行集成，在 Gemma-4-31B GRPO 的 64K 上下文上得到验证。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 DualKV 与标准注意力数学等价、无近似，将共享提示词的 token 缩减从注意力层扩展到整个模型，并兼容混合注意力结构与 Ulysses 序列并行。其适用场景是 decoder-only 模型的大 rollout、长上下文 RL 训练。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调 DualKV 与标准注意力数学等价、无近似，将共享提示词的 token 缩减从注意力层扩展到整个模型，并兼容混合注意力结构与 Ulysses 序列并行。其适用场景是 decoder-only 模型的大 rollout、长上下文 RL 训练。

papers.title: Teacher-Feature Drifting: One-Step Diffusion Distillation with Pretrained Diffusion Representations
papers.abstract_en: Sampling from pretrained diffusion and flow-matching models typically requires many forward passes to generate diverse and high-fidelity images. Existing distillation methods often rely on multiple auxiliary networks, carefully designed training stages, or complex optimization pipelines. In this work, we revisit the recently proposed Drifting Model objective and show that a single drifting loss can be directly used to simplify one step distillation. A key observation is that the pretrained diffusion teacher itself already provides a strong representation space. Unlike the original Drifting Model, which relies on an additional pretrained feature extractor, we use intermediate hidden states of the pretrained teacher model as the feature representation. This removes the need for training or introducing an extra representation network while preserving a semantically meaningful feature geometry for drifting. Furthermore, we introduce a lightweight mode coverage loss to mitigate mode collapse during distillation and encourage the student generator to cover diverse teacher-supported regions. Extensive experiments on ImageNet and SDXL demonstrate that our method achieves efficient one step generation with competitive image quality and diversity, achieving FID scores of 1.58 on ImageNet-64$\times$64 and 18.4 on SDXL, while substantially simplifying the overall distillation framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视 Drifting Model 目标，提出只用单一 drifting loss 即可简化一步扩散蒸馏。关键观察是预训练扩散教师模型本身的中间隐藏状态已提供强表示空间，因此无需额外预训练特征提取器。作者引入轻量模式覆盖损失来缓解模式坍缩，在 ImageNet-64×64 与 SDXL 上实现有竞争力的单步生成，FID 分别为 1.58 与 18.4。
Motivation: 现有扩散蒸馏方法常依赖多个辅助网络、精心设计的训练阶段或复杂优化流程，目标是简化一步蒸馏框架并降低实现复杂度。
Method: 使用预训练教师模型的中间隐藏状态作为特征表示用于 drifting，替代原始 Drifting Model 中额外引入的预训练特征提取器；同时加入轻量模式覆盖损失，鼓励学生生成器覆盖更多教师支持的分布区域。
Result: 在 ImageNet-64×64 上取得 FID 1.58，在 SDXL 上取得 FID 18.4，实现高效单步生成，图像质量和多样化程度具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 预训练扩散教师自身即可提供语义上有意义的特征几何，移除额外表示网络后仍能保持 drifting 效果；该方法大幅简化整体蒸馏流程，摘要未显式讨论局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: On Seeding Watermarks to Detect Verbatim LLM Copy-Paste Responses
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have made fluent essay writing, code drafting, and quiz answering instantly available to students at every level, from secondary school through graduate study. Many educators do not object to LLM use \emph{per~se}; what they need to detect is the case in which a student pastes the assignment prompt into a chatbot and submits the model's reply verbatim, without engaging with the work. Existing post-hoc AI-text detectors remain unreliable and have been shown to penalise non-native English writers, while output-side watermarks require cooperation from the model provider. We propose an alternative that the educator controls directly: an input-side watermark in which an invisible instruction is embedded inside the visible assignment prompt itself. An LLM that ingests the prompt verbatim quietly reads the hidden instruction and writes a tell-tale signature into its reply, exposing the copy-and-paste pathway specifically. We describe SteganoPrompt, a single-page, zero-dependency web tool that encodes an arbitrary printable-ASCII payload into the deprecated Unicode Tags block (\texttt{U+E0000}--\texttt{U+E007F}). The encoded string is visually identical to the original, survives common copy-paste channels (Word, Google Docs, PDF, Markdown, Slack, e-mail, the major learning-management systems), and is tokenized as ordinary text by most frontier models. We evaluate compliance across eight LLM families and a representative set of educational content channels. To keep deployment transparent, disclosure is built into the tool itself: every encoded brief also carries a brief, always-on academic-integrity reminder for the student, and we set out concrete guidance recommending for its disclosed, ethical use in the classroom. The tool is released under the MIT licence at https://ezharjan.github.io/SteganoPrompt/.
papers.comment: We are pleased to announce that this paper has been accepted by the 9th AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society (AIES 2026). We appreciate the valuable feedback from the reviewers and look forward to sharing our findings with the community
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种由教育者直接控制的输入侧水印方法 SteganoPrompt：在可见作业提示中嵌入不可见指令，当学生把提示原样粘贴给 LLM 时，模型会悄悄在回复中写入可识别的签名，从而专门暴露复制粘贴的路径。工具将任意可打印 ASCII 载荷编码进已废弃的 Unicode Tags 块（U+E0000–U+E007F），编码后视觉上与原文一致，并能通过 Word、Google Docs、PDF、Markdown、Slack、邮件及主流学习管理系统等复制粘贴渠道。摘要报告在八个 LLM 系列和代表性教育内容渠道上评估了合规性，工具内置学术诚信提醒并建议在课堂中披露、合乎伦理地使用。
Motivation: 现有事后 AI 文本检测器不可靠且已被证明会误伤非英语母语写作者，输出侧水印又需要模型提供方配合；教育者需要一种自己就能控制的方法，仅检测学生将作业提示整段粘贴给聊天机器人并原样提交回复的行为。
Method: 提出 SteganoPrompt：一个单页、零依赖的网页工具，将任意 printable-ASCII 载荷编码进废弃的 Unicode Tags 块；LLM 在逐字读取提示时静默地读到隐藏指令，并在回复中写入特征签名。工具还内置常开的学术诚信提醒，以支持透明、合乎伦理的部署。
Result: 摘要报告在八个 LLM 系列以及一组代表性教育内容渠道（如 Word、Google Docs、PDF、Markdown、Slack、邮件、主流学习管理系统）上评估了水印指令的合规性，但未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 作者将 SteganoPrompt 定位为供教育者在课堂中披露、合乎伦理使用的检测工具，并给出具体使用建议；工具以 MIT 许可证发布。

papers.title: RemoteZero: Geospatial Reasoning with Zero Labels
papers.abstract_en: Geospatial reasoning requires models to identify image regions that satisfy complex and often implicit user intents. Recent reinforcement learning approaches improve reasoning without manually annotated reasoning traces, but still require human-provided target labels to construct rewards, limiting their use on large-scale unlabeled Earth observation data. We introduce RemoteZero, a label-free framework for reinforcement-based geospatial reasoning. Our key observation is twofold: MLLMs are often more reliable at evaluating candidates than generating solutions, while aerial imagery reduces interference in region-level verification. Therefore, RemoteZero converts each predicted region into a visual crop and uses its semantic consistency with the query as an intrinsic reward for GRPO optimization. This formulation removes the need for human-provided solution labels and further supports iterative self-evolution by reusing previous-round models as verifiers. Experiments show that RemoteZero outperforms strong supervised baselines, applies effectively to other Earth observation tasks, and continues to improve through self-evolution as the training data expand. We hope this direction can broadly benefit the Earth observation community.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RemoteZero，一个面向地理空间推理的无标签强化学习框架。核心观察是 MLLM 对候选区域进行评估往往比生成解决方案更可靠，且航空影像能降低区域级验证的干扰；因此 RemoteZero 将每个预测区域转为视觉裁剪块，并用其与查询的语义一致性作为 GRPO 优化的内在奖励，从而摆脱人工标注的方案标签，并支持复用上一轮模型作为验证器进行迭代自进化。实验表明该方法优于强监督基线，可迁移到其他地球观测任务，并随训练数据扩展持续提升。
Motivation: 现有基于强化学习的地理空间推理方法虽然无需人工推理轨迹，但构造奖励仍依赖人工提供的目标标签，难以用于大规模无标注地球观测数据。
Method: RemoteZero 采用无标签框架：将模型预测的区域转换为视觉裁剪块，以该裁剪块与用户查询之间的语义一致性作为 GRPO 优化的内在奖励；同时通过复用上一轮模型作为验证器，实现不需要人工方案标签的迭代自进化。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在实验中优于强监督基线，能够有效迁移到其他地球观测任务，并且随着训练数据扩展，自进化过程持续带来提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为这种无标签的强化地理空间推理方向有望广泛惠及地球观测社区；摘要未提及明确的局限性。

papers.title: MILE: Mixture of Incremental LoRA Experts for Continual Semantic Segmentation across Domains and Modalities
papers.abstract_en: Continual semantic segmentation requires models to adapt to new domains or modalities without sacrificing performance on previously learned tasks. Expert-based learning, in which task-specific modules specialize in different domains, has proven effective in mitigating forgetting. These methods include dynamic expansion, which suffers from scalability issues, or parameter isolation, which constrains the ability to learn new tasks. We introduce Mixture of Incremental LoRA Experts (MILE), a modular and parameter-efficient framework for continual segmentation across both domains and modalities. MILE leverages Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to instantiate lightweight experts for each new task while keeping the pretrained base network frozen. Each expert is trained exclusively on its task data, thus avoids overwriting previously learned information. A prototype-guided gating mechanism dynamically selects the most appropriate expert at inference. MILE achieves the benefits of expert-based learning while overcoming its scalability limitations. It requires only a marginal parameter increase per task and tens of LoRA adapters are needed before matching the size of a single full model, making it highly efficient in both training and storage. Across domain- and modality-incremental benchmarks, MILE achieves strong performance while ensuring better stability, plasticity, and scalability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MILE（Mixture of Incremental LoRA Experts），一个用于跨域和跨模态持续语义分割的模块化参数高效框架。MILE 利用低秩适应（LoRA）为每个新任务实例化轻量专家，并冻结预训练基础网络，通过原型引导的门控机制在推理时动态选择专家。摘要报告该方法在域增量和模态增量基准上取得强性能，同时提升稳定性、可塑性和可扩展性，参数增量很小，数十个 LoRA adapter 才接近单个完整模型的大小。
Motivation: 持续语义分割需要在适应新域或新模态时不遗忘已学任务，但现有专家式方法存在扩展性问题（动态扩展）或限制新任务学习能力（参数隔离），难以兼顾效率与稳定性。
Method: MILE 使用 LoRA 为每个任务创建轻量专家，保持预训练基础网络冻结，每个专家仅用任务数据训练以避免覆盖旧知识；推理时由原型引导的门控机制（prototype-guided gating）动态选择最合适的专家。
Result: 摘要称在域增量和模态增量基准上 MILE 取得强性能，同时保证更好的稳定性、可塑性和可扩展性；每任务只需少量参数增加，约数十个 LoRA adapter 即可匹敌单个完整模型的规模。
Conclusion: 作者强调 MILE 兼得专家式学习的优势并克服其扩展性限制，在训练和存储上都很高效。

papers.title: Dependency Parsing Across the Resource Spectrum: Evaluating Architectures on High and Low-Resource Languages
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based models achieve state-of-the-art dependency parsing for high-resource languages, yet their advantage over simpler architectures in low-resource settings remains poorly understood. We evaluate four parsers---the Biaffine LSTM, Stack-Pointer Network, AfroXLMR-large, and RemBERT---across twelve typologically diverse languages, with a focus on low-resource African languages. We find that the Biaffine LSTM consistently outperforms transformer models in low-resource regimes, with transformers recovering their advantage as training data increases. The crossover falls within a resource range typical of treebanks for under-resourced languages. Morphological complexity (measured via MATTR) emerges as a significant secondary predictor of transformers' relative disadvantage after controlling for corpus size. These results indicate that the Biaffine LSTM may be better suited for syntactic tool development in low-resource regimes until sufficient annotated data is available to leverage the representational capacity of pre-trained transformers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在十二种类型多样的语言上系统比较四种依存句法分析器——Biaffine LSTM、Stack-Pointer Network、AfroXLMR-large 与 RemBERT，重点关注低资源非洲语言。结果显示在低资源场景下 Biaffine LSTM 持续优于 Transformer 模型，而随训练数据增加 Transformer 重新取得优势，交叉点落在低资源语言树库的典型规模范围内。形态复杂度（以 MATTR 度量）在控制语料规模后成为Transformer相对劣势的显著次要预测因子。
Motivation: Transformer 模型在高资源语言的依存句法分析上达到当前最佳，但它们在低资源设置下相对于更简单架构的优势尚不清楚。该研究旨在明确这一差距，为资源匮乏语言（尤其是非洲语言）的句法工具开发提供架构选择依据。
Method: 作者在十二种语言上评估四种分析器：Biaffine LSTM、Stack-Pointer Network、AfroXLMR-large 和 RemBERT，并利用语料规模与形态复杂度（MATTR）作为预测因子进行控制分析。
Result: Biaffine LSTM 在低资源条件下持续超过 Transformer 模型；随着训练数据增加，Transformer 重新获得优势，交叉点处于低资源语言树库的典型规模范围内。形态复杂度是 Transformer 相对劣势的显著次要预测因子。

papers.title: SignVerse-2M: A Two-Million-Clip Pose-Native Universe of 55+ Sign Languages
papers.abstract_en: Existing large-scale sign language resources typically provide supervision only at the level of raw video-text alignment and are often produced in laboratory settings. While such resources are important for semantic understanding, they do not directly provide a unified interface for open-world recognition and translation, or for modern pose-driven sign language video generation frameworks: 1. RGB-based pretrained recognition models depend heavily on fixed backgrounds or clothing conditions during recording, and are less robust in open-world settings than style-agnostic pose-processing models. 2. Recent pose-guided image/video generation models mostly use a unified keypoint representation such as DWPose as their control interface. At present, the sign language field still lacks a data resource that can directly interface with this modern pose-native paradigm while also targeting real-world open scenarios. We present SignVerse-2M, a large-scale multilingual pose-native dataset for sign language pose modeling and evaluation. Built from publicly available multilingual sign language video resources, it applies DWPose in a unified preprocessing pipeline to convert raw videos into 2D pose sequences that can be used directly for modeling, resulting in a consolidated corpus of about two million clips covering more than 55 sign languages. Unlike many laboratory datasets, this resource preserves the recording conditions and speaker diversity of real-world videos while reducing appearance variation through a unified pose representation. Toward this goal, we further provide the data construction pipeline, task definitions, and a simple SignDW Transformer baseline, demonstrating the feasibility of this resource for multilingual pose-space modeling and its compatibility with modern pose-driven pipelines, while discussing the evaluation claims it can support as well as its current limitations.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SignVerse-2M，一个大规模多语言、姿态原生 (pose-native) 的手语数据集。作者用 DWPose 统一预处理流水线将公开的多语言手语视频转换为 2D 姿态序列，构建了约两百万个片段、覆盖 55 种以上手语的语料库，并给出一个简单的 SignDW Transformer 基线。该资源保留真实世界视频的录制条件与说话人多样性，同时通过统一姿态表示降低外观变化，面向开放世界识别、翻译和姿态驱动视频生成。
Motivation: 现有大规模手语资源通常只在原始视频-文本对齐层面提供监督，且多在实验室环境中产生，无法直接作为开放世界识别/翻译或现代姿态驱动 (pose-driven) 手语视频生成框架的统一接口；RGB 模型对固定背景和衣物条件敏感，而手语领域缺乏能直接对接姿态原生范式的数据资源。
Method: 从公开的多语言手语视频资源出发，使用 DWPose 作为统一关键点表示，在统一预处理流水线中将原始视频转换为可直接用于建模的 2D 姿态序列；文章还提供数据构建流程、任务定义，并构建了简单的 SignDW Transformer 基线来验证可行性。
Result: 构建了约两百万个手语片段、覆盖超过 55 种手语的统一姿态语料库；SignDW Transformer 基线表明该资源可用于多语言姿态空间建模，并能与现代姿态驱动的手语视频生成流程兼容。
Conclusion: 作者认为该资源支持一系列评估主张，并讨论了其当前局限性；其价值在于用统一姿态表示降低外观变化，同时保留真实世界录制条件和说话人多样性。

papers.title: Intersectional Disentangling of Temporal and Acquisition Bias in Fetal Ultrasound
papers.abstract_en: Fairness studies of medical imaging AI often explain subgroup performance gaps through under-representation in the training data. We show that intersectional analysis can disentangle fairness and performance gaps arising from clinical and acquisition confounders that co-vary with the target. As a case, we study scan-time fetal weight estimation from obstetric ultrasound, analyzing two models: a state-of-the-art deep learning (DL) model and the clinical gold-standard Hadlock formula. Using unsupervised slice discovery, we find that high-error subgroups share extreme in the image-acquisition pixel spacing (PS) and in the scan-to-delivery (STD) interval. Of these, PS is an acquisition parameter that can be optimized, while STD is a potential confounder for both PS and our bias diagnostics. Subgroup inspection alone cannot separate them. We disentangle the factors using a model-agnostic analysis with identical metadata partitions and partial regression. Holding STD fixed, the apparent PS effect collapses to a small residual (standardized coefficient $β=-0.17$), whereas holding PS fixed, STD dominates error ($β=+0.56$). Both models degrade with increasing STD, including the biometric formula, indicating much of the error is intrinsic to the prediction target rather than imaging. The DL model is $\sim$1.5$\times$ more sensitive to STD than Hadlock, though it remains more accurate in every subgroup. We conclude that fairness analyses need to carefully analyze potential confounds, or risk attributing an effect such as temporal or acquisition-related dependency to demographics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对医学影像 AI 公平性研究中常见的归因偏差，提出用交叉性分析 (intersectional analysis) 区分与目标协变的临床混杂因素和采集混杂因素。以产科超声的胎儿体重估计为例，作者比较了 SOTA 深度学习模型与临床金标准 Hadlock 公式，发现高误差亚组同时具有极端的像素间距 (pixel spacing, PS) 和扫描到分娩间隔 (scan-to-delivery interval, STD)。通过模型无关的元数据分区和偏回归分析，作者证明 STD 主导误差，而 PS 的效应在控制 STD 后几乎消失。
Motivation: 现有公平性研究常把亚组性能差距归因于训练数据中的代表性不足，但性能差距可能来自与目标共变的临床或采集混杂因素；若不做混杂分析，容易把时间或采集相关的依赖错误归因于人口学特征。
Method: 采用无监督切片发现 (unsupervised slice discovery) 定位高误差亚组，然后进行模型无关的分析：使用相同的元数据分区和偏回归 (partial regression)，分别固定 PS 或 STD 来分离二者对误差的贡献，并在深度学习模型和 Hadlock 公式上对比。
Result: 固定 STD 后，PS 的表观效应塌缩为小残差 (标准化系数 β=-0.17)；固定 PS 后，STD 主导误差 (β=+0.56)。两种模型都随 STD 增大而退化，包括纯生物测量公式，说明大部分误差源于预测目标本身而非成像；深度学习模型对 STD 的敏感度约为 Hadlock 的 1.5 倍，但在每个亚组中仍更准确。
Conclusion: 作者强调公平性分析必须仔细处理潜在混杂因素，否则可能把时间或采集相关的效应错误地归因于人口学变量；该结论以产科超声为案例，但主张方法具有模型无关的通用性。

papers.title: Learning Coarse-to-Fine Osteoarthritis Representations under Noisy Hierarchical Labels
papers.abstract_en: Knee osteoarthritis (OA) assessment involves a natural but often underused label hierarchy: a coarse binary OA decision and a fine-grained Kellgren--Lawrence (KL) severity grade. Existing deep learning studies commonly treat these targets as separate classification problems, either reducing OA assessment to disease presence or directly optimizing noisy ordinal KL labels. In this work, we ask whether this clinical hierarchy can serve as a representation-level supervisory prior. Rather than introducing a complex architecture, we use a deliberately simple dual-head model with a shared encoder and two task-specific heads as a probe of hierarchical supervision. We compare single-OA, single-KL, and dual-head training across multiple 3D backbones under the same test protocol. Beyond standard classification metrics, we perform paired statistical comparisons, analyze latent severity-axis geometry, and examine saliency overlap with cartilage regions. The results show that dual-head supervision produces backbone-dependent gains, with clear improvements in KL-related metrics for selected backbones. More importantly, the gains are accompanied by a more ordered coarse-to-fine latent organization and, for responsive backbones, stronger anatomical alignment of saliency with cartilage. These findings suggest that even simple hierarchical dual-head supervision can reshape disease representations under noisy coarse/fine labels, providing a useful inductive bias for OA diagnosis and severity grading.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用膝关节骨关节炎 (OA) 评估中天然的标签层级——粗粒度二元 OA 判定与细粒度 Kellgren-Lawrence (KL) 分级——作为表示层面的监督先验。作者没有引入复杂结构，而是用共享编码器加两个任务头的最简双头模型，在多个 3D 骨干网络上对比单 OA、单 KL 和双头训练。结果显示双头监督带来骨干网络相关的收益，并伴随更有序的粗到细潜在组织以及更强的解剖对齐。
Motivation: 现有深度学习研究通常把粗粒度 OA 有无判定和细粒度 KL 分级当作相互独立的分类问题，忽略了临床标签自身的层级结构，同时 KL 标签本身存在噪声。作者想验证这种临床层级能否作为表示层面的监督先验，以改善诊断和严重程度分级。
Method: 采用一个刻意简化的双头模型：共享编码器加两个任务专属头，作为层级监督的探针。在相同测试协议下比较 single-OA、single-KL 与 dual-head 三种训练方式，并进一步做配对统计比较、分析潜在严重度轴几何结构，以及检查 saliency 与软骨区域的重叠。
Result: 双头监督带来骨干网络相关的提升，对选定的部分骨干网络在 KL 相关指标上有明显改善；同时伴随更有序的 coarse-to-fine 潜在组织，且对响应较好的骨干网络，saliency 与软骨区域的解剖对齐更强。
Conclusion: 作者认为即使是最简单的层级双头监督，也能在含噪粗/细标签下重塑疾病表示，为 OA 诊断与严重程度分级提供有用的归纳偏置。

papers.title: Minimal, Local, Causal Explanations for Jailbreak Success in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Safety trained large language models (LLMs) can often be induced to answer harmful requests through jailbreak prompts. Because we lack a robust understanding of why LLMs are susceptible to jailbreaks, future frontier models operating more autonomously in higher-stakes settings may similarly be vulnerable to such attacks. Prior work has studied jailbreak success by examining the model's intermediate representations, identifying directions in this space that causally encode concepts like harmfulness and refusal. Then, they globally explain all jailbreak attacks as attempting to reduce or strengthen these concepts (e.g., reduce harmfulness). However, different jailbreak strategies may succeed by strengthening or suppressing different intermediate concepts, and the same jailbreak strategy may not work for different harmful request categories (e.g., violence vs. cyberattack); thus, we seek to give a local explanation -- i.e., why did this specific jailbreak succeed? To address this gap, we introduce LOCA, a method that gives Local, CAusal explanations of jailbreak success by identifying a minimal set of interpretable, intermediate representation changes that causally induce model refusal on an otherwise successful jailbreak request. We evaluate LOCA on harmful original-jailbreak pairs from a large jailbreak benchmark across Gemma, Llama, and Qwen chat models, comparing against prior methods adapted to this setting. LOCA can successfully induce refusal by making, on average, six interpretable changes; prior work routinely fails to achieve refusal even after 20 changes. LOCA is a step toward mechanistic, local explanations of jailbreak success in LLMs. Code publicly available at https://github.com/skumar-ml/loca-jailbreaks
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LOCA，一种给出越狱成功的局部因果解释 (local, causal explanation) 的方法：通过识别一组最小的、可解释的中间表示 (intermediate representation) 变化，来因果地诱导模型对原本成功的越狱请求产生拒绝 (refusal)。作者在 Gemma、Llama 和 Qwen 聊天模型的大规模越狱基准上评估，LOCA 平均只需六处可解释改动即可诱发拒绝，而此前方法在 20 处改动后仍常常失败。代码已公开。
Motivation: 安全训练的 LLM 常可通过越狱提示 (jailbreak) 被诱导回答有害请求，而现有工作大多从中间表示空间全局地解释越狱，例如将其归结为削弱危害性或增强拒绝等概念。但不同越狱策略可能通过增强或抑制不同的中间概念来生效，且同一策略对不同有害请求类别不一定有效，因此需要解释"为什么这个特定的越狱成功了"的局部解释。
Method: LOCA 通过定位一组最小的、可解释的中间表示变化来给出局部因果解释，这些变化能够在原本成功的越狱请求上因果地诱导模型产生拒绝行为。
Result: 在包含有害原始请求与越狱配对的大规模基准上，LOCA 在 Gemma、Llama 和 Qwen 聊天模型上平均只需六个可解释改动即可诱发拒绝，而此前方法通常即使在 20 个改动后仍无法实现拒绝。
Conclusion: LOCA 是对 LLM 越狱成功进行机制性、局部解释的一步尝试，摘要强调其代码已公开。

summary_sections.motivation: 安全训练的 LLM 常可通过越狱提示 (jailbreak) 被诱导回答有害请求，而现有工作大多从中间表示空间全局地解释越狱，例如将其归结为削弱危害性或增强拒绝等概念。但不同越狱策略可能通过增强或抑制不同的中间概念来生效，且同一策略对不同有害请求类别不一定有效，因此需要解释"为什么这个特定的越狱成功了"的局部解释。
summary_sections.method: LOCA 通过定位一组最小的、可解释的中间表示变化来给出局部因果解释，这些变化能够在原本成功的越狱请求上因果地诱导模型产生拒绝行为。
summary_sections.result: 在包含有害原始请求与越狱配对的大规模基准上，LOCA 在 Gemma、Llama 和 Qwen 聊天模型上平均只需六个可解释改动即可诱发拒绝，而此前方法通常即使在 20 个改动后仍无法实现拒绝。
summary_sections.conclusion: LOCA 是对 LLM 越狱成功进行机制性、局部解释的一步尝试，摘要强调其代码已公开。

papers.title: In-Context Examples Suppress Scientific Knowledge Recall in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Scientific reasoning rarely stops at what is directly observable; it often requires uncovering hidden structure from data. From estimating reaction constants in chemistry to inferring demand elasticities in economics, this latent structure recovery is what distinguishes scientific reasoning from curve fitting. Large language models (LLMs) can often recall and apply relevant scientific formulas, but we show that this ability is surprisingly easy to suppress. We show that adding in-context examples makes models rely less on pretrained domain knowledge, even when those examples are generated by the very same formula. Rather than reinforcing knowledge-driven derivation, examples shift computation toward empirical pattern fitting. We document this knowledge displacement on 60 latent structure recovery tasks across five scientific domains, 6,000 trials, and four models. This displacement is consistent across domains, but its accuracy consequences depend on how the displaced strategy compares to the one that replaces it: the same shift can lower accuracy, leave it unchanged, or appear to improve it. In all cases, however, the model shifts away from knowledge-driven reasoning. For practitioners deploying LLMs on scientific tasks, the message is cautionary: in-context examples may displace, rather than reinforce, the knowledge they are intended to support.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在上下文示例 (in-context examples) 的影响下，大型语言模型 (LLM) 是否仍会调用预训练中获得科学公式知识，而不仅仅是做经验曲线拟合。作者在 5 个科学领域、60 个潜在结构恢复 (latent structure recovery) 任务、6,000 次试验和 4 个模型上发现，即使示例由同一条公式生成，添加示例也会让模型减少对领域知识的依赖，转向经验模式匹配。这种“知识置换”在不同领域一致出现，但其准确性后果取决于被置换的推理策略与替代策略的相对优劣。
Motivation: 科学推理常需从数据中恢复隐藏结构，而非简单拟合曲线；LLM 虽能回忆和运用科学公式，但这种能力可能被上下文示例轻易抑制。论文针对的正是“示例到底强化还是削弱知识驱动推理”这一尚未被系统考察的问题。
Method: 作者设计了覆盖 5 个科学领域的 60 个潜在结构恢复任务，并用同一公式生成上下文示例，对比模型在有无示例时的推理策略变化。试验规模为 6,000 次，涉及 4 个模型，系统记录了模型从知识驱动转向经验模式拟合的位移。
Result: 添加上下文示例会使模型普遍减少对预训练领域知识的依赖，转向经验拟合；该位移在领域间一致，但准确性影响可变——可能下降、不变，甚至看似提升，具体取决于被置换策略与替代策略的相对表现。
Conclusion: 对在科学任务上部署 LLM 的实践者，本文给出警示：上下文示例可能替换而非强化其原本要支持的领域知识，应谨慎使用。

papers.title: Alignment has a Fantasia Problem
papers.abstract_en: In accomplishing complex tasks, human cognition typically progresses from abstract to concrete (e.g., from brainstorming ideas to writing an essay). With the advent of highly capable AI assistants, people now offload various parts of their task to the system. However, instruction-tuned AI systems, even when designed to infer implicit intent, lack an understanding of humans' cognitive processes. When a user approaches AI while their goals and intentions are abstract, AI systems often short circuit their cognitive process through which those goals would be refined by jumping toward a final output (e.g., writing the essay entirely). Doing so takes away the user's agency in achieving the task: they may need to spend more time revising or, worse, settle on a suboptimal outcome. We call these failures Fantasia interactions after the famous Disney scene. We argue that Fantasia interactions demand a rethinking of alignment research, where AI systems optimize how cognitive responsibility is allocated within an interaction. We highlight gaps in state-of-the-art alignment methods, and outline a research agenda for training and evaluating models to achieve this vision.
papers.journal_ref: ICLR 2026 Workshop HCAIR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出对齐研究中的一个问题：当用户带着抽象目标与 AI 交互时，指令微调系统往往直接生成最终输出（例如整篇作文），跳过了人类本应通过逐步细化来明确目标的认知过程。作者称这类失败为 Fantasia interactions，并认为对齐研究应转向让 AI 优化交互中的认知责任分配。文章指出现有对齐方法的不足，并给出相应的训练与评估研究议程。
Motivation: 高度能力的 AI 助手被用于分担复杂任务，但它们即使被设计为推断隐式意图，也缺乏对人类认知过程的理解，容易在目标仍抽象时直接跳到最终结果，削弱用户能动性并可能导致次优结果。
Method: 作者提出重新构想对齐研究，使系统优化认知责任（cognitive responsibility）如何在人机交互中分配；具体包括指出现有最先进对齐方法的缺陷，并勾勒训练与评估模型以实现该愿景的研究议程。
Result: 摘要未报告实验数据或定量结果，主要为概念性论证与未来研究方向。
Conclusion: 作者认为 Fantasia interactions 要求对齐研究超越当前关注点，转向在交互中合理分配认知责任，并呼吁开展相应的方法论与评估研究。

papers.title: Topology-Aware Data Movement for Disaggregated GPU Inference
papers.abstract_en: Disaggregated LLM inference creates a datacenter networking problem that no existing system solves correctly. When prefill and decode run on separate GPU pools, the KV cache must be transferred between them. For a 70B model this is 1.3 GB per request, exceeding 100 GB/s aggregate at production scale. Yet DistServe, Splitwise, and Mooncake all use uniform RDMA, ignoring that bandwidth between two GPUs varies by 72x depending on their physical relationship: 900 GB/s via NVLink 4.0 within a domain (1.8 TB/s on NVLink 5, widening the gap to 144x), 50 GB/s via InfiniBand across nodes, 12.5 GB/s via TCP across data centers. We design a topology-aware transfer orchestrator that discovers interconnect hierarchy at startup and selects optimal transport per transfer. Three mechanisms work together: (1) pipelined layer-by-layer transfer that overlaps transmission with ongoing prefill, hiding 76 to 100 percent of transfer latency behind computation depending on transport, with NVLink and PCIe transfers hidden entirely; (2) NVLink domain-aware placement for Mixture-of-Experts models that co-optimizes expert dispatch with KV cache locality; and (3) CXL 3.0 memory expanders as a shared overflow tier providing 6x capacity at 86x lower latency than NVMe. Full evaluation requires multi-node clusters with heterogeneous interconnects and CXL 3.0 hardware that is beyond academic resources and not yet available in GPU clouds. We present analytical bandwidth models, component implementations, and projected analysis across three architectures showing 3 to 18x transfer latency reduction over uniform RDMA.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 4 tables, 1 algorithm. v2: corrects MLA compression to 57x (576 dims per DeepSeek); fixes a factor-of-two in GQA sizing rows and all dependent transfer numbers (Llama-70B 4K = 1.3 GB); pipelining band recomputed (76 to 100 percent); PCIe on Gen5; NIXL positioning added; NVLink 5 and 2026 model notes (bandwidth- and bytes-parametric); wording fixes
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对分离式 LLM 推理（disaggregated inference）中 prefill 与 decode 分池运行时 KV cache 需跨 GPU 传输的问题，提出拓扑感知（topology-aware）的传输编排器。摘要称该方法在启动时发现互连层级并为每次传输选择最优传输方式，结合流水线化逐层传输、面向 MoE 的 NVLink 域感知放置与 CXL 3.0 内存扩展器，相比统一 RDMA 可将传输延迟降低 3 至 18 倍。
Motivation: 现有 DistServe、Splitwise、Mooncake 等分离式推理系统均使用统一 RDMA，忽略 GPU 间带宽随物理关系变化可达 72 倍（NVLink 4.0 域内 900 GB/s、跨节点 InfiniBand 50 GB/s、跨数据中心 TCP 12.5 GB/s），而 70B 模型每请求需传输 1.3 GB KV cache，生产规模下超过 100 GB/s 聚合需求，成为关键瓶颈。
Method: 设计拓扑感知传输编排器：启动时发现互连层级结构并按传输选择最优传输协议。三种机制协同：流水线化逐层传输，将传输与进行中的 prefill 重叠；针对 MoE 模型的 NVLink 域感知放置，联合优化专家调度与 KV cache 局部性；以及把 CXL 3.0 内存扩展器作为共享溢出层，提供 6 倍容量且延迟比 NVMe 低 86 倍。
Result: 摘要报告了分析性带宽模型、组件实现及跨三种架构的预测分析，显示相对统一 RDMA 的传输延迟降低 3 至 18 倍；流水线可隐藏 76% 至 100% 的传输延迟，其中 NVLink 与 PCIe 传输可完全隐藏。
Conclusion: 完整评测需要具备异构互连与 CXL 3.0 硬件的多节点集群，超出学术资源且 GPU 云尚不可用，因此论文目前以分析模型和预测结果为主，而非实测端到端评估。

papers.title: Predictive Multi-Tier Memory Management for KV Cache in Large-Scale GPU Inference
papers.abstract_en: Key-value (KV) cache memory management is the primary bottleneck limiting throughput and cost-efficiency in large-scale GPU inference serving. Current systems suffer from three compounding inefficiencies: (1) the absence of unified KV cache sizing across all attention architectures--particularly multi-head latent attention (MLA), which is unsupported in general-purpose frameworks, resulting in up to 57x memory over-provisioning; (2) confinement of KV cache to a single memory tier (GPU HBM) despite the availability of a rich hierarchy spanning CPU DRAM, CXL-attached memory, NVMe via GPUDirect Storage, RDMA fabric, and parallel filesystems; and (3) reactive eviction policies that discard reusable state, forcing redundant recomputation. We present a unified system addressing all three. Our architecture-variant-aware sizing engine computes exact memory requirements per attention type; the resulting batch size gain reaches 7.4x for the one MLA model we evaluate (DeepSeek-V3), while the three GQA models see 1.0x, 1.0x, and 0.7x, so the GQA benefit is fleet-wide unified sizing rather than larger per-model batches. A six-tier memory hierarchy extends effective KV cache capacity from 40 GB to over 38 TB per node while maintaining sub-millisecond time-to-first-token (TTFT) for hot entries. A Bayesian reuse predictor with Beta conjugate priors over 16 (block-type, transition-type) pairs drives EMA-scored head-granular eviction and RoPE-aware prefetching. Component-level validation on trace replay using ShareGPT, LMSYS-Chat-1M, and agentic workloads demonstrates 70-84% cache hit rates. Analytical projections combining validated component behavior with published hardware specifications indicate TTFT reductions of 1.4x to 2.1x, throughput improvements of 1.7x to 2.9x, and 47% cost reduction relative to published baselines; these cluster-scale projections are analytical and carry no error bars.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 9 tables, 1 figure. v2: corrects seven bibliography entries, removes one unverifiable one; scopes the batch-size claim to the MLA model; labels cluster-scale projections analytical (no error bars); removes version pins from baseline comparisons; expands related work; adds B200-class hardware and 2026 model-family scaling notes (generation-parametric); companion manuscripts noted
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向大规模 GPU 推理的 KV cache 统一内存管理系统，针对注意力架构感知的缓存容量规划、六层内存层级和预测式驱逐/预取三个问题。架构感知的 sizing 引擎对 MLA 模型（DeepSeek-V3）实现 7.4x 批大小增益，而三个 GQA 模型为 1.0x/1.0x/0.7x；六层内存层级将每节点有效 KV cache 容量从 40 GB 扩展至超 38 TB，并保持热条目亚毫秒 TTFT。trace 回放验证命中率 70-84%，集群规模投影为 1.4x-2.1x TTFT 降低、1.7x-2.9x 吞吐提升和 47% 成本降低，但投影为分析性且无误差棒。
Motivation: KV cache 内存管理是大规模 GPU 推理吞吐与成本效率的主要瓶颈，现有系统缺乏跨注意力架构的统一 sizing（尤其 MLA 不受通用框架支持，导致最高 57x 内存过度预留），将 KV cache 局限于 GPU HBM 单一层级，并采用反应式驱逐策略造成冗余重计算。
Method: 提出统一系统，包含架构变体感知的 sizing 引擎来计算每种注意力类型的精确内存需求，六层内存层级（GPU HBM、CPU DRAM、CXL 内存、GPUDirect Storage NVMe、RDMA fabric、并行文件系统）扩展有效缓存容量，以及基于贝叶斯重用预测器的驱逐与预取：对 16 个 (block-type, transition-type) 对使用 Beta 共轭先验，驱动 EMA 评分的 head 粒度驱逐和 RoPE 感知预取。
Result: 组件级 trace 回放（ShareGPT、LMSYS-Chat-1M 和 agentic 工作负载）显示 70-84% 缓存命中率；批大小增益对单个 MLA 模型 DeepSeek-V3 为 7.4x，三个 GQA 模型为 1.0x/1.0x/0.7x。结合已发布硬件规格的分析性投影表明 TTFT 降低 1.4x-2.1x、吞吐提升 1.7x-2.9x、成本降低 47%，但这些集群规模投影无误差棒。
Conclusion: 作者强调统一的多层 KV cache 管理可消除 MLA 内存过度预留并利用丰富内存层级，但集群规模收益是分析性投影而非实测结果，且 GQA 模型的批大小收益有限，其价值主要在 fleet-wide 统一 sizing。

summary_sections.method: 提出统一系统，包含架构变体感知的 sizing 引擎来计算每种注意力类型的精确内存需求，六层内存层级（GPU HBM、CPU DRAM、CXL 内存、GPUDirect Storage NVMe、RDMA fabric、并行文件系统）扩展有效缓存容量，以及基于贝叶斯重用预测器的驱逐与预取：对 16 个 (block-type, transition-type) 对使用 Beta 共轭先验，驱动 EMA 评分的 head 粒度驱逐和 RoPE 感知预取。
summary_sections.result: 组件级 trace 回放（ShareGPT、LMSYS-Chat-1M 和 agentic 工作负载）显示 70-84% 缓存命中率；批大小增益对单个 MLA 模型 DeepSeek-V3 为 7.4x，三个 GQA 模型为 1.0x/1.0x/0.7x。结合已发布硬件规格的分析性投影表明 TTFT 降低 1.4x-2.1x、吞吐提升 1.7x-2.9x、成本降低 47%，但这些集群规模投影无误差棒。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调统一的多层 KV cache 管理可消除 MLA 内存过度预留并利用丰富内存层级，但集群规模收益是分析性投影而非实测结果，且 GQA 模型的批大小收益有限，其价值主要在 fleet-wide 统一 sizing。

papers.title: MEDLEY-BENCH: Benchmarking Behavioural Metacognition and Belief Revision Under Social Pressure in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Most large language model benchmarks evaluate final-answer quality but reveal little about how models revise beliefs under disagreement or conflicting evidence. We introduce MEDLEY-BENCH, an open benchmark comparing structured private self-review and analyst-conditioned social revision from a common solo baseline. We evaluated 35 models from 12 families on 130 instances using the Medley Metacognition Score (MMS) and four taxonomy-aligned, rubric-derived composites. MMS point estimates were not consistently ordered in the available within-family size or generation comparisons. Under the prespecified ipsative procedure, the Evaluation-mapped composite had the lowest relative rubric score in 30 of 35 models; Self-regulation was lowest in four models and Control in one. This rubric- and centering-dependent pattern may reflect model behavior, judge severity, data-pipeline effects, or their combination; it is not evidence of an absolute Evaluation deficit. In an exploratory adversarial analysis of 11 purposively selected models, sensitivity to manipulated consensus labels ranged from near zero to larger response shifts. A preliminary human rubric-application study of 24 paired vignettes found a mean composite difference of 0.727 (95% CI: 0.500-0.942). Across 24 cross-rated response items from 12 shared vignettes, quadratic-weighted inter-reviewer agreement was kappa = 0.389, and response-profile human-LLM convergence was rho = 0.637. This preprint reports MEDLEY-BENCH v1.0, the audited proof-of-concept release. A separately versioned v1.5 will rerun the full protocol with corrected social-summary rendering and stronger scoring reproducibility, experimental control, and uncertainty analysis. MEDLEY-BENCH complements accuracy-based evaluation by characterizing prompted belief revision under ambiguity and social disagreement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MEDLEY-BENCH，一个用于评估大语言模型在分歧与冲突证据下信念修订 (belief revision) 与行为元认知 (behavioural metacognition) 的开放基准。基准从共同独奏基线出发，比较结构化私有自我审查 (private self-review) 与分析师条件的社会修订 (analyst-conditioned social revision)，并以 Medley Metacognition Score (MMS) 和四个基于 rubric 的复合指标对 35 个模型、12 个家族、130 个实例进行评估。论文同时报告了探索性对抗分析、人工 rubric 应用研究及评审者间一致性结果，并说明 v1.0 为审计后的概念验证版本。
Motivation: 现有大语言模型基准大多只评估最终答案质量，很少揭示模型在分歧或冲突证据下如何修订信念；该论文针对这一评估缺口，提出一个与基于准确率的评测互补的基准。
Method: 构建 MEDLEY-BENCH v1.0，定义从共同独奏基线出发的私有自我审查与社会修订两类提示条件，采用 Medley Metacognition Score (MMS) 以及四个与 taxonomy 对齐、由 rubric 派生的复合指标进行评分；另设计了操纵共识标签的对抗分析和人工 rubric 应用流程。
Result: MMS 点估计在可用的族内规模或代际比较中并不一致；在预先指定的 ipsative 程序下，30/35 个模型的 Evaluation 复合指标相对 rubric 得分最低，Self-regulation 在 4 个模型中最低，Control 在 1 个模型中最低。探索性对抗分析显示 11 个模型的敏感性从接近零到较大响应偏移不等；人工研究得到平均复合差异 0.727（95% CI 0.500-0.942），二次加权评审者间一致性 kappa=0.389，人机响应剖面收敛 rho=0.637。
Conclusion: 作者强调上述模式依赖 rubric 与中心化处理，可能反映模型行为、评审者严苛程度、数据管道效应或其组合，不能视为 Evaluation 存在绝对缺陷的证据；MEDLEY-BENCH 旨在以提示驱动的信念修订刻画补充基于准确率的评测，v1.5 将修正社会摘要渲染并强化评分可重复性、实验控制与不确定性分析。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: From Plan to Action: How Well Do Agents Follow the Plan?
papers.abstract_en: Agents are commonly instructed to follow a task-specific plan for guidance. However, it is unknown to what extent agents actually follow instructed plans. Without such an analysis, determining the extent agents comply with a given plan, it is impossible to assess whether a solution was reached through correct strategic reasoning or through other means, e.g., data contamination or overfitting to a benchmark. This paper presents the first extensive, systematic analysis of plan compliance in programming agents, examining 21,120 trajectories from SWE-agent across four LLMs on SWE-bench Verified and SWE-bench Pro under eight plan variations. Without an explicit plan, agents fall back on internalized workflows during training, which are often incomplete, overfit, or inconsistently applied. Providing the standard plan improves issue resolution, and we observe that periodic plan reminders can mitigate plan violations and improve task success. A subpar plan hurts performance even more than no plan at all. Surprisingly, inserting additional task-relevant phases in the early stage can degrade performance, particularly when these phases do not align with the model's internal problem-solving strategy. These findings call for fine-tuning paradigms that teach models to follow instructed plans, rather than encoding task-specific plans in them, so that they reason and act adaptively, rather than memorizing workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次对编程智能体 (programming agents) 的计划遵从性 (plan compliance) 进行大规模系统分析，检查了 SWE-agent 在 SWE-bench Verified 和 SWE-bench Pro 上、四种 LLM、八种计划变体下的 21,120 条轨迹。结果显示：没有显式计划时，智能体会退回到训练中内化的工作流，而这些工作流往往不完整、过拟合或应用不一致；提供标准计划能提升问题解决率，周期性计划提醒可缓解计划违背并提高任务成功率；质量差的计划比完全没有计划更有害，而在早期阶段插入与模型内部解题策略不一致的额外阶段反而会降低性能。
Motivation: 智能体常被指示遵循任务特定计划，但实际遵循程度未知。没有这种分析，就无法判断解决方案是来自正确的策略推理，还是来自数据污染或对基准的过拟合。
Method: 提出对编程智能体计划遵从性的系统性分析框架：在 SWE-bench Verified 和 SWE-bench Pro 上，用四种 LLM 运行 SWE-agent，并在八种计划变体条件下收集 21,120 条轨迹进行对比。
Result: 摘要报告：无显式计划时模型依赖训练期内化的工作流；提供标准计划可改善问题解决；周期性计划提醒能减少计划违背并提升任务成功；劣质计划比无计划更损害性能；早期插入任务相关但不匹配模型内部策略的阶段会降低性能。
Conclusion: 作者呼吁采用教模型遵循指令式计划 (instructed plans) 的微调范式，而非把任务特定计划编码进模型，使其能够自适应地推理和行动，而不是记忆工作流。研究范围限于编程智能体 (SWE-agent) 及其基准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Decoupled Similarity for Task-Aware Token Pruning in Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Token pruning has emerged as an effective approach to reduce the substantial computational overhead of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) by discarding less informative visual tokens while preserving performance. However, existing methods typically rely on individual attention sources from different LVLM components, resulting in incomplete and suboptimal pruning decisions due to biased attention distributions. To address this problem, we propose DeSAP, a novel Decoupled Similarity-Aware Pruning method for precise, task-aware token pruning within the visual encoder. Specifically, DeSAP introduces a decoupled similarity to capture fine-grained cross-modal relevance between visual features and text tokens, providing explicit task-related guidance for pruning. By integrating decoupled similarity with visual saliency signals derived from visual attention, DeSAP performs token pruning under the guidance of both task-related and visual cues, enabling robust pruning even under aggressive pruning ratios. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks and architectures show that DeSAP consistently outperforms SOTA methods in both accuracy and efficiency. On LLaVA-1.5-7B, DeSAP achieves a 10 times FLOPs reduction and a 2.3 times prefill speedup by retaining only 11.1% of visual tokens, while maintaining 98.1% of the original performance.
papers.comment: Accepted at ACM Multimedia 2026. Camera-ready version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DeSAP，一种用于大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）的解耦相似度感知 token 剪枝方法。DeSAP 在视觉编码器内引入解耦相似度（decoupled similarity）来建模视觉特征与文本 token 间的细粒度跨模态相关性，并结合视觉注意力导出的显著性信号，在任务相关与视觉线索共同指导下进行 token 剪枝。实验表明，在 LLaVA-1.5-7B 上仅保留 11.1% 的视觉 token，即可实现 10 倍 FLOPs 降低和 2.3 倍 prefill 加速，同时保持原始性能的 98.1%。
Motivation: 现有 token 剪枝方法通常依赖 LVLM 不同组件中单一的注意力来源，由于注意力分布存在偏差，导致剪枝决策不完整且次优，难以在激进剪枝率下维持性能。
Method: 提出 DeSAP，通过解耦相似度捕捉视觉特征与文本 token 之间的细粒度跨模态相关性，为剪枝提供显式的任务相关指导，并将该相似度与视觉注意力得到的视觉显著性信号集成，实现在任务相关和视觉线索共同引导下的 token 剪枝。
Result: 在多个基准和架构上的实验显示，DeSAP 在准确率和效率上一致优于现有 SOTA 方法；在 LLaVA-1.5-7B 上，保留 11.1% 视觉 token 时实现 10 倍 FLOPs 减少和 2.3 倍 prefill 加速，同时保持原始性能的 98.1%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将解耦跨模态相似度与视觉显著性信号联合用于剪枝，可以提升视觉编码器在高剪枝率下的鲁棒性，并兼顾任务相关性与视觉信息。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Transferable FB-GNN-MBE Framework for Potential Energy Surfaces: Data-Adaptive Transfer Learning in Deep Learned Many-Body Expansion Theory
papers.abstract_en: Mechanistic understanding and rational design of complex chemical systems depend on fast and accurate predictions of electronic structures beyond individual building blocks. However, if the system exceeds hundreds of atoms, first-principles quantum mechanical (QM) modeling becomes impractical. In this study, we developed FB-GNN-MBE by integrating a fragment-based graph neural network (FB-GNN) into the many-body expansion (MBE) theory and demonstrated its capacity to reproduce first-principles potential energy surfaces (PES) for hierarchically structured systems with manageable accuracy, complexity, and interpretability. Specifically, we divided the entire system into basic building blocks (fragments), evaluated their one-fragment energies using a QM model, and addressed many-fragment interactions using the structure-property relationships trained by FB-GNNs. Our investigation shows that FB-GNN-MBE achieves chemical accuracy in predicting two-body (2B) and three-body (3B) energies across water, phenol, and mixture benchmarks, as well as the one-dimensional dissociation curves of water and phenol dimers. To transfer the success of FB-GNN-MBE across various systems with minimal computational costs and data demands, we developed and validated a teacher-student learning protocol. A heavy-weight FB-GNN trained on a mixed-density water cluster ensemble (teacher) distills its learned knowledge and passes it to a light-weight GNN (student), which is later fine-tuned on a uniform-density (H2O)21 cluster ensemble. This transfer learning strategy resulted in efficient and accurate prediction of 2B and 3B energies for variously sized water clusters without retraining. Our transferable FB-GNN-MBE framework outperformed conventional non-FB-GNN-based models and provided a scalable and accurate route toward interaction energies of large molecular assemblies.
papers.comment: Accepted by The Journal of Chemical Physics. Main text: 23 pages, 11 figures, and 1 table. Supplementary Materials: 29 pages, 6 figures, 15 tables, 4 pseudo-algorithms
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FB-GNN-MBE 框架，将基于片段的图神经网络 (FB-GNN) 引入多体展开 (MBE) 理论，用于在大尺度分子体系上复现第一性原理势能面 (PES)。方法把体系划分为碎片，用 QM 模型计算单碎片能量，并用 FB-GNN 学习多碎片相互作用的结构-性质关系；摘要报告其在 water、phenol 及混合物基准上达到化学精度，并预测二体和三体能量。作者还开发了教师-学生迁移学习协议，将重模型在混合密度水团簇上学习到的知识蒸馏给轻量 GNN，再在均匀密度 (H2O)21 团簇上微调，从而无需重训即可预测不同尺寸水团簇的能量。
Motivation: 当化学体系超过数百个原子时，第一性原理量子力学建模不切实际；需要既能保持精度又具备可扩展性和可解释性的电子结构预测方法。
Method: 将片段化图神经网络 (FB-GNN) 嵌入多体展开 (MBE) 理论：系统划分为基本碎片，QM 模型评估单碎片能量，FB-GNN 通过结构-性质关系处理多碎片相互作用；并采用教师-学生蒸馏与微调的迁移学习协议降低跨体系应用的算力和数据需求。
Result: 摘要报告 FB-GNN-MBE 在 water、phenol 和混合物基准上对二体 (2B) 与三体 (3B) 能量达到化学精度，并能预测水和苯酚二聚体的一维解离曲线；迁移学习无需重训即可高效准确预测不同大小水团簇的 2B 和 3B 能量，且性能优于常规非 FB-GNN 模型。
Conclusion: 作者强调该可迁移框架为大型分子组装体的相互作用能提供了一条可扩展且准确的路径，并表明结合多体展开与图神经网络的迁移学习能在极小数据和算力成本下跨体系推广。

papers.title: GRM: Utility-Aware Jailbreak Attacks on Audio LLMs via Gradient-Ratio Masking
papers.abstract_en: Audio Large Language Models (ALLMs) enable spoken interaction but introduce new jailbreak vulnerabilities. Existing perturbation-based jailbreaks do not explicitly control which frequency bands carry the perturbation. Although such perturbations can elicit unsafe responses, repeatedly applying a universal perturbation across diverse inputs may also degrade utility on normal tasks, leaving a conspicuous behavioral footprint that may expose the attack to users or automated monitoring systems and thereby compromise its stealthiness. To determine whether full-band perturbation is necessary, we vary coverage from partial-band to full-band. Jailbreak Success Rate (JSR) varies non-monotonically, while utility degradation grows with coverage. This mismatch shows that selected bands can yield stronger attacks with less utility degradation than full-band perturbations. Based on this observation, we propose GRM, a utility-aware, frequency-selective jailbreak framework that ranks Mel bands by the ratio between jailbreak contribution and transcript sensitivity, confines a universal perturbation to selected bands, and regularizes deviations from the intended request semantics. Experiments on four ALLMs show that GRM achieves an average JSR of 88.46\% while substantially reducing utility degradation across benign transcription and response tasks relative to baselines. Our code is available at \href{https://github.com/159753Fetter/GRM}{this repository}. Warning: This paper contains potentially sensitive content.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对音频大语言模型 (ALLMs) 的越狱攻击问题，提出 GRM，一个效用感知、频率选择的越狱攻击框架。作者发现从部分频段到全频段覆盖时，越狱成功率 (JSR) 呈非单调变化，而效用退化随覆盖率增加；因此选定频段可以在比全频段扰动更小的效用损失下取得更强攻击。GRM 按梯度比 (gradient-ratio) 对 Mel 频段排序，将通用扰动限制在选定频段，并正则化对请求语义的偏离。
Motivation: 现有基于扰动的越狱攻击没有显式控制扰动承载的频率频段，反复应用通用扰动会损害正常任务的效用，并留下明显行为痕迹，降低攻击的隐蔽性。
Method: 提出 GRM 框架：以越狱贡献与转录敏感度之比对 Mel 频段排序，将通用扰动限制在选定的频段内，并通过正则化约束扰动对预期请求语义的偏离。
Result: 在四个 ALLMs 上的实验显示，GRM 取得 88.46% 的平均越狱成功率 (JSR)，同时相比基线大幅降低良性转录与响应任务上的效用退化。
Conclusion: 研究表明频段选择可以在效用退化更小的条件下实现比全频段扰动更强的攻击；代码已开源，且论文包含潜在敏感内容警告。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Playing Games with My Heart: An Evaluation of AI Companion Apps
papers.abstract_en: The use of chatbots for various forms of companionship is growing rapidly, raising a myriad of questions about simulated relationships, emotional dependence, and psychological harm. While major platforms such as ChatGPT, Grok, and Character AI are the subject of a growing body of research and legal inquiries, apps explicitly built for simulating intimate interpersonal relationships remain under-explored. In this work, we evaluate the five most popular AI companion mobile applications for factors that encourage parasocial interaction and may manipulate users. We do this by manually annotating the user experience each offers. Specifically, we systematically record and quantify design dark patterns, anthropomorphism, stereotypes, erotica, and technical performance issues. We find that all apps contain substantial dark patterns aimed at increasing monetisation and user engagement. Erotica and gamification such as levelling are also prevalent, and although features vary considerably between applications, all apps have highly anthropomorphic design. These findings shed light on the mechanics used to leverage users' simulated relationships. On that basis, we put forward recommendations for regulators to strengthen consumer protection in this rapidly emerging market. Content warning: This article contains objectifying images of women, erotic images, textual references to incest, and other potentially sensitive, offensive, and distressing text.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估五款最流行的 AI 伴侣移动应用，通过手动标注用户体验，系统地记录并量化设计黑暗模式 (dark patterns)、拟人化 (anthropomorphism)、刻板印象、情色内容和技术性能问题。摘要发现所有应用都包含大量旨在提升变现和用户参与的黑暗模式，情色内容与游戏化机制（如升级）普遍存在，且所有应用均具有高度拟人化设计。基于这些发现，作者向监管机构提出加强消费者保护的建议。
Motivation: 大型平台如 ChatGPT、Grok 和 Character AI 已受到广泛研究和法律关注，但专门用于模拟亲密人际关系的应用仍缺乏系统性探索，而这些应用可能鼓励拟社会互动 (parasocial interaction) 并操纵用户。
Method: 对五款最流行的 AI 伴侣移动应用进行手动用户体验标注，系统记录并量化黑暗模式、拟人化、刻板印象、情色内容以及技术性能问题。
Result: 摘要报告所有应用都包含大量以提升变现和用户参与为目的的黑暗模式；情色内容和升级 (levelling) 等游戏化机制普遍存在；应用间功能差异较大，但全部采用高度拟人化设计。
Conclusion: 研究揭示了应用利用用户模拟关系的具体机制，并据此向监管机构提出加强消费者保护的建议。摘要还附有内容警告，说明文中包含物化女性图片、情色图片、乱伦文本引用等可能令人不适的内容。
