papers.title: Cluster Attention for Graph Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: Message Passing Neural Networks have recently become the most popular approach to graph machine learning tasks; however, their receptive field is limited by the number of message passing layers. To increase the receptive field, Graph Transformers with global attention have been proposed; however, global attention does not take into account the graph topology and thus lacks graph-structure-based inductive biases, which are typically very important for graph machine learning tasks. In this work, we propose an alternative approach: cluster attention (CLATT). We divide graph nodes into clusters with off-the-shelf graph community detection algorithms and let each node attend to all other nodes in each cluster. CLATT provides large receptive fields while still having strong graph-structure-based inductive biases. We show that augmenting Message Passing Neural Networks or Graph Transformers with CLATT significantly improves their performance on a wide range of graph datasets including datasets from the recently introduced GraphLand benchmark representing real-world applications of graph machine learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出聚类注意力 (cluster attention, CLATT)，用现成的社区检测算法把图节点划分为簇，让每个节点关注每个簇内的所有其他节点。作者声称在消息传递神经网络 (MPNN) 或图 Transformer 上加入 CLATT，能在包括 GraphLand 基准在内的多种图数据集上显著提升性能。核心卖点是同时获得大感受野和基于图结构的归纳偏置。
Motivation: 消息传递神经网络的感受野受限于消息传递层数；而图 Transformer 的全局注意力不利用图拓扑，缺少对图任务很重要的结构归纳偏置。
Method: 用现成的图社区检测算法将节点分成簇，令每个节点关注每个簇内的所有其他节点，从而获得大感受野并保留基于图结构的归纳偏置。
Result: 摘要报告在多种图数据集（包括 GraphLand 基准）上，将 CLATT 加入消息传递神经网络或图 Transformer 可显著提升性能。
Conclusion: CLATT 提供大感受野且保持基于图结构的归纳偏置，可作为现有图模型的有效增强模块；摘要未给出具体数值或局限性讨论。

papers.title: SciLT: Long-tailed Image Classification under Scientific Image Domains
papers.abstract_en: Long-tailed recognition has benefited from foundation models and fine-tuning paradigms, yet existing studies and benchmarks are mainly confined to natural image domains, where pre-training and fine-tuning data share similar distributions. In contrast, scientific images exhibit distinct visual characteristics and supervision signals, raising questions about the effectiveness of fine-tuning foundation models in such settings. In this work, we investigate scientific long-tailed recognition under a purely visual and fine-tuning paradigm. Experiments on three scientific benchmarks show that fine-tuning foundation models yields limited gains, and reveal that penultimate-layer features play an important role, particularly for tail classes. Motivated by these findings, we propose SciLT, a framework that exploits multi-level representations through adaptive feature fusion and dual-supervision learning. By jointly leveraging penultimate- and final-layer features, SciLT achieves balanced performance across head and tail classes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SciLT consistently outperforms existing methods, establishing a strong and practical baseline for scientific long-tailed recognition and providing valuable guidance for adapting foundation models to scientific data with substantial domain shifts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究科学图像领域的长尾识别（long-tailed recognition），指出现有基准和预训练-微调范式主要面向自然图像，而科学图像存在显著域偏移。实验发现直接微调基础模型（foundation models）收益有限，倒数第二层特征对尾部类别尤为重要，据此提出 SciLT 框架，通过自适应特征融合与双监督学习联合利用倒数第二层和最后一层特征，在三个科学基准上取得均衡且领先的性能。
Motivation: 现有长尾识别研究大多局限于自然图像域，预训练与微调数据分布相近；科学图像具有不同的视觉特征与监督信号，基础模型在此类域偏移场景下的微调效果缺乏系统验证。
Method: 提出 SciLT 框架，利用多层级表征（multi-level representations），通过自适应特征融合（adaptive feature fusion）和双监督学习（dual-supervision learning）联合利用倒数第二层与最后一层特征，以提升头部和尾部类别的均衡性能。
Result: 在三个科学图像基准上的实验表明，微调基础模型仅带来有限增益，而 SciLT 在均衡性能上持续优于现有方法，并建立了科学长尾识别的强基线。
Conclusion: 作者强调倒数第二层特征对尾部类别的重要性，并认为 SciLT 为将基础模型适配到具有显著域偏移的科学数据提供了实用指导。

papers.title: Embedded Variational Neural Stochastic Differential Equations for Learning Heterogeneous Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: This study examines the challenges of modeling complex and noisy data related to socioeconomic factors over time, with a focus on data from various districts in Odisha, India. Traditional time-series models struggle to capture both trends and variations together in this type of data. To tackle this, a Variational Neural Stochastic Differential Equation (V-NSDE) model is designed that combines the expressive dynamics of Neural SDEs with the generative capabilities of Variational Autoencoders (VAEs). This model uses an encoder and a decoder. The encoder takes the initial observations and district embeddings and translates them into a Gaussian distribution, which determines the mean and log-variance of the first latent state. Then the obtained latent state initiates the Neural SDE, which utilize neural networks to determine the drift and diffusion functions that govern continuous-time latent dynamics. These governing functions depend on the time index, latent state, and district embedding, which help the model learn the unique characteristics specific to each district. After that, using a probabilistic decoder, the observations are reconstructed from the latent trajectory. The decoder outputs a mean and log-variance for each time step, which follows the Gaussian likelihood. The Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO) training loss improves by adding a KL-divergence regularization term to the negative log-likelihood (nll). The obtained results demonstrate the effective learning of V-NSDE in recognizing complex patterns over time, yielding realistic outcomes that include clear trends and random fluctuations across different areas.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种变分神经随机微分方程 (V-NSDE) 模型，用于对印度奥里萨邦各区随时间变化的复杂且带噪声的社会经济数据建模。模型把 Neural SDE 的连续时间动态表达能力与 VAE 的生成能力结合，通过编码器把初始观测和区域嵌入 (district embedding) 映射为第一个隐状态的 Gaussian 分布，再由神经网络参数化的漂移和扩散函数驱动隐状态演化，最后用概率解码器按 Gaussian 似然重建观测。摘要报告该方法能够识别随时间变化的复杂模式，并给出包含清晰趋势和随机波动的现实结果。
Motivation: 传统时间序列模型难以同时刻画社会经济区域数据中的趋势与波动，尤其是面向多个区域且含噪声的异质性时间序列。
Method: 设计 V-NSDE，编码器从初始观测与区域嵌入产生隐状态先验的均值和 log-variance；隐状态初始化一个由神经网络决定漂移 (drift) 与扩散 (diffusion) 函数的 Neural SDE，这些函数依赖时间索引、隐状态和区域嵌入；解码器逐时间步输出 Gaussian 分布的均值和 log-variance 以重建观测。训练损失为负对数似然加 KL 散度正则项得到的证据下界 (ELBO)。
Result: 摘要报告 V-NSDE 能有效学习随时间变化的复杂模式，并在不同区域上产生包含明确趋势和随机波动的现实结果；摘要未给出具体定量指标或基准对比。
Conclusion: 作者主要展示 V-NSDE 在区域级社会经济时间序列上的有效学习能力；摘要未讨论明显局限，也没有给出与现有方法的数值比较。

papers.title: TMTE: Effective Multimodal Graph Learning with Task-aware Modality and Topology Co-evolution
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal-attributed graphs (MAGs) are a fundamental data structure for multimodal graph learning (MGL), enabling both graph-centric and modality-centric tasks. However, our empirical analysis reveals inherent topology quality limitations in real-world MAGs, including noisy interactions, missing connections, and task-agnostic relational structures. A single graph derived from generic relationships is therefore unlikely to be universally optimal for diverse downstream tasks. To address this challenge, we propose Task-aware Modality and Topology co-Evolution (TMTE), a novel MGL framework that jointly and iteratively optimizes graph topology and multimodal representations toward the target task. TMTE is motivated by the bidirectional coupling between modality and topology: multimodal attributes induce relational structures, while graph topology shapes modality representations. Concretely, TMTE casts topology evolution as multi-perspective metric learning over modality embeddings with an anchor-based approximation, and formulates modality evolution as smoothness-regularized fusion with cross-modal alignment, yielding a closed-loop task-aware co-evolution process. Extensive experiments on 9 MAG datasets and 1 non-graph multimodal dataset across 6 graph-centric and modality-centric tasks show that TMTE consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TMTE-1873.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TMTE（Task-aware Modality and Topology co-Evolution），一个面向多模态属性图（MAG）的多模态图学习框架，通过联合迭代优化图拓扑与多模态表示来逼近目标任务。作者基于模态与拓扑的双向耦合动机，将拓扑演化建模为基于锚点近似的多视角度量学习，将模态演化建模为带平滑正则的跨模态对齐融合，形成闭环的任务感知协同演化。在 9 个 MAG 数据集和 1 个非图多模态数据集上的 6 类图中心与模态中心任务中，TMTE 均取得当前最优性能。
Motivation: 真实世界 MAG 存在固有拓扑质量缺陷，包括噪声交互、缺失连接和与任务无关的关系结构，因此由通用关系得到的单一图结构难以在不同下游任务中普遍最优。
Method: 提出 TMTE 框架，将拓扑演化实现为对模态嵌入的多视角度量学习并采用锚点近似降低计算复杂度；将模态演化实现为平滑正则化的融合与跨模态对齐，两者交替迭代形成面向目标任务的闭环协同演化。
Result: 在 9 个 MAG 数据集和 1 个非图多模态数据集上，覆盖 6 个图中心与模态中心任务，TMTE 一致达到当前最优（state-of-the-art）性能。
Conclusion: 作者强调模态与拓扑的双向耦合可被显式建模为协同演化过程，从而为不同下游任务自适应地优化图结构与表示；代码已公开。

papers.title: Improving Attributed Long-form Question Answering with Intent Awareness
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being used to generate comprehensive, knowledge-intensive reports. However, while these models are trained on diverse academic papers and reports, they are not exposed to the reasoning processes and intents that guide authors in crafting these documents. We hypothesize that enhancing a model's intent awareness can significantly improve the quality of generated long-form reports. We develop and employ structured, tag-based schemes to better elicit underlying implicit intents to write or cite. We demonstrate that these extracted intents enhance both zero-shot generation capabilities in LLMs and enable the creation of high-quality synthetic data for fine-tuning smaller models. Our experiments reveal improved performance across various challenging scientific report generation tasks, with an average improvement of +2.9 and +12.3 absolute points for large and small models over baselines, respectively. Furthermore, our analysis illuminates how intent awareness enhances model citation usage and substantially improves report readability.
papers.journal_ref: ICLR 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用意图感知（intent awareness）改进带引用的长形式问答/科学报告生成。作者设计结构化、基于标签的方案来显式提取作者写作或引用背后的隐含意图，并将这些意图用于增强大语言模型的零样本生成，以及构建高质量合成数据来微调较小模型。实验在多个科学报告生成任务上显示大模型和小模型分别比基线平均提升 +2.9 和 +12.3 个绝对点，并改善引用使用与报告可读性。
Motivation: LLM 被用于生成知识密集型的长报告，但训练数据虽包含大量学术论文和报告，模型并未接触到作者在撰写或引用时的推理过程与意图。作者假设缺失这种意图感知会限制生成报告的质量，因此需要显式地建模和利用写作及引用背后的隐含意图。
Method: 提出并使用结构化的、基于标签（tag-based）的方案来引出写作（write）或引用（cite）时潜在的隐含意图；提取出的意图一方面直接用于提升大模型的零样本生成能力，另一方面用于生成高质量合成数据，供微调较小模型使用。
Result: 在多个有挑战性的科学报告生成任务上，相对于基线，大模型平均提升 +2.9 个绝对点，小模型平均提升 +12.3 个绝对点；进一步分析表明意图感知改善了模型对引用的使用，并显著提高报告可读性。
Conclusion: 作者认为增强模型的意图感知能够显著提升长形式报告生成质量，并通过改善引用使用和可读性体现出收益。摘要未明确讨论方法在非科学领域或复杂任务上的局限。

papers.title: SparseVoxelDet: Fully Sparse Voxel Networks for Efficient Event-Based Drone Detection
papers.abstract_en: Event cameras excel at detecting small, fast drones, but today's detectors give away their key advantage: they convert the sparse event stream into dense grids and pay dense-processing cost on inputs that are almost entirely empty. We present SparseVoxelDet, to our knowledge the first coordinate-sparse 3D event voxel bounding-box detector: backbone, feature pyramid, temporal reduction, and detection head all operate directly on coordinate-indexed features, with no dense spatial grid at any stage. Building it exposed a hidden failure mode we name support inflation: an input filling a median 0.0652% of the voxel lattice inflates stage by stage until standard pyramid fusion leaves the detection head locally near-dense. We answer with two ideas. Expansion-free inverse-convolution fusion provably creates no active sites beyond the stored backbone supports, cutting head occupancy from a median 78.88% to 10.53%; quality-aligned supervision then recovers more accuracy than preserving sparsity costs. The payoff is measured, not assumed: executing the same trained network densely costs a median 27.5x the work and 4.65x the latency across 5,000 paired frames, with no frame cheaper dense, while the 6.22M-parameter detector reaches 87.01 AP50 on the FRED drone benchmark, ahead of matched dense controls, and holds its lead on the held-out test partition evaluated once. Sparsity, preserved by construction and supervised well, delivers the efficiency and the accuracy together.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SparseVoxelDet，据称是首个坐标稀疏的 3D 事件体素目标检测器，骨干、特征金字塔、时间降维和检测头都直接操作坐标索引特征，任何阶段都不使用稠密空间网格。作者发现并命名了支撑膨胀 (support inflation) 失效模式，并提出无扩张的反卷积融合与质量对齐监督来同时保持稀疏性和精度。在 FRED 无人机基准上，6.22M 参数的检测器达到 87.01 AP50，且比同网络的稠密执行节省中位 27.5 倍计算量和 4.65 倍延迟。
Motivation: 事件相机擅长检测小而快速的无人机，但现有检测器把稀疏事件流转成稠密网格，在几乎全空的输入上付出稠密处理代价，浪费了事件相机的关键优势。
Method: 构建全阶段坐标稀疏的 3D 事件体素框检测器；针对输入仅填满中位 0.0652% 体素格却逐级膨胀到检测头近稠密的问题，提出无扩张的逆卷积融合，从构造上保证不产生超出骨干支撑的活动站点，并用质量对齐监督来弥补精度。
Result: 检测头体素占用率从中位 78.88% 降到 10.53%；同一训练网络以稠密方式执行时，5000 对帧上中位增加 27.5 倍计算量和 4.65 倍延迟，且没有一帧稠密更便宜；FRED 基准上达到 87.01 AP50，超过匹配的稠密对照，并在只评估一次的留出测试集上保持领先。
Conclusion: 作者强调，通过构造保持稀疏性并配合良好监督，可以在事件无人机检测中同时获得效率和精度，而不是在二者之间取舍。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: INTRYGUE: Induction-Aware Entropy Gating for Reliable RAG Uncertainty Estimation
papers.abstract_en: While retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) significantly improves the factual reliability of LLMs, it does not eliminate hallucinations, so robust uncertainty quantification (UQ) remains essential. In this paper, we reveal that standard entropy-based UQ methods often fail in RAG settings due to a mechanistic paradox. An internal "tug-of-war" inherent to context utilization appears: while induction heads promote grounded responses by copying the correct answer, they collaterally trigger the previously established "entropy neurons". This interaction inflates predictive entropy, causing the model to signal false uncertainty on accurate outputs. To address this, we propose INTRYGUE (Induction-Aware Entropy Gating for Uncertainty Estimation), a mechanistically grounded method that gates predictive entropy based on the activation patterns of induction heads. Evaluated across four RAG benchmarks and six open-source LLMs (4B to 13B parameters), INTRYGUE consistently matches or outperforms a wide range of UQ baselines. Our findings demonstrate that hallucination detection in RAG benefits from combining predictive uncertainty with interpretable, internal signals of context utilization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 RAG（retrieval-augmented generation）场景下的不确定性量化（UQ），指出现有基于熵的 UQ 方法会因机制性悖论而失效：上下文利用中 induction heads 促进生成有依据的回答，但同时触发已建立的“熵神经元”，使预测熵虚高，导致模型对正确输出误报不确定性。作者提出 INTRYGUE（Induction-Aware Entropy Gating），依据 induction heads 的激活模式对预测熵进行门控，并在四个 RAG 基准和六个 4B–13B 参数的开源 LLM 上验证其效果。
Motivation: RAG 能提升 LLM 的事实可靠性但无法消除幻觉，因此稳健的不确定性量化仍然必要。摘要揭示标准熵基 UQ 方法在 RAG 中常失败的机制性原因：induction heads 与熵神经元之间的内部“拔河”会抬高预测熵，使模型在准确输出上产生虚假的不确定性信号。
Method: 提出 INTRYGUE，一种基于机制的 UQ 方法：根据 induction heads 的激活模式对预测熵进行门控（gating），以区分由上下文利用引起的熵升高和真正的不确定性。
Result: 在四个 RAG 基准和六个开源 LLM（参数 4B 到 13B）上，INTRYGUE 一致地匹配或优于多种 UQ 基线方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，RAG 中的幻觉检测可以受益于将预测不确定性与可解释的、反映上下文利用情况的内部信号相结合。

summary_sections.result: 在四个 RAG 基准和六个开源 LLM（参数 4B 到 13B）上，INTRYGUE 一致地匹配或优于多种 UQ 基线方法。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调，RAG 中的幻觉检测可以受益于将预测不确定性与可解释的、反映上下文利用情况的内部信号相结合。

papers.title: AutoMOOSE: An Agentic AI for Autonomous Phase-Field Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Phase-field modeling links thermodynamics and kinetics to microstructural evolution, but multiphysics frameworks such as MOOSE require expertise to construct inputs, manage campaigns, diagnose failures, and validate results. We introduce AutoMOOSE, an open-source multi-agent framework that orchestrates the simulation lifecycle from a single natural-language prompt. Six specialized agents--Architect, Input Writer, Runner, Reviewer, Visualization, and a physics-grounded Skeptic--generate, execute, analyze, and adversarially test simulations against conservation laws, asymptotic limits, and scaling relations. We validate AutoMOOSE in two domains: non-conserved copper grain growth governed by Allen-Cahn dynamics and conserved Fe-Cr spinodal decomposition governed by Cahn-Hilliard dynamics. On a prospectively specified 25-task grain-growth benchmark spanning temperature, grain count, resolution, and model formulation, AutoMOOSE generates valid inputs for all 25 tasks, completes 19 simulations with measurable coarsening, and delivers 15 results that satisfy Burke-Turnbull kinetics ($R^2 \geq 0.90$) and survive Skeptic falsification. The failures trace to two identifiable generator defects. An ensemble of 1000 simulations recovers the prescribed activation energy to within 1% after finite-size extrapolation ($Q_\infty = 0.228$ eV versus $0.230$ eV). In the conserved domain, an agent-generated CALPHAD-based Fe-Cr simulation limits relative mass drift to $6.3 \times 10^{-6}$, dissipates free energy to a stable plateau, and evolves toward the equilibrium tie-line. Controlled ablations show that the full pipeline converts stochastic raw generation--3-7 successful tasks out of 8 across repeated trials--into consistent success on all 8 tasks. AutoMOOSE therefore provides a practical route from natural-language specification to reproducible, physics-validated phase-field simulation campaigns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AutoMOOSE，一个开源的多智能体框架，用单个自然语言提示词编排相场模拟 (phase-field simulation) 的完整生命周期。框架包含六个专职智能体，负责生成、执行、分析并基于守恒律、渐近极限和标度关系对抗性检验模拟。摘要报告其在 Allen-Cahn 铜晶粒生长与 Cahn-Hilliard Fe-Cr 旋节分解两个领域的验证结果，并表明能将从自然语言到可复现、物理校验的模拟流程自动化。
Motivation: 相场建模连接热力学与动力学以描述微观结构演化，但 MOOSE 等多物理场框架需要专家经验来构造输入、管理任务、诊断失败和验证结果，这构成了使用门槛。
Method: 提出一个多智能体框架 AutoMOOSE，包含 Architect、Input Writer、Runner、Reviewer、Visualization 以及基于物理的 Skeptic 六个专职智能体；它们协作完成模拟任务的生成、执行、分析与对抗性检验。在两个领域验证：非守恒的 Allen-Cahn 铜晶粒长大和守恒的 Cahn-Hilliard Fe-Cr 旋节分解。
Result: 在预设的 25 项晶粒长大基准上，AutoMOOSE 为全部 25 项生成有效输入，完成 19 个可测粗化模拟，其中 15 个满足 Burke-Turnbull 动力学 (R^2 ≥ 0.90) 且通过 Skeptic 证伪；1000 次模拟集成经有限尺寸外推后恢复激活能误差在 1% 以内 (Q∞ = 0.228 eV 对 0.230 eV)。守恒域中，Fe-Cr 模拟将相对质量漂移限制在 6.3×10^-6，自由能耗散至稳定平台并演化到平衡 tie-line。受控消融显示完整流程将随机原始生成 (8 次试验中 3-7 次成功) 提升为 8/8 的一致成功。
Conclusion: AutoMOOSE 提供了一条从自然语言规范到可复现、物理验证的相场模拟工作流的实用路径；摘要同时指出失败案例可追溯到两个可识别的生成器缺陷，作为其局限性。

papers.title: Conditioning Protein Generation via Hopfield Pattern Multiplicity
papers.abstract_en: Small protein-family alignments often contain a subset of interest but not enough labeled data to train a conditional generator. We condition a training-free stochastic-attention sampler by adding one multiplicity ratio to its logits. Increasing this ratio shifts generation from the full family toward the designated subset. For unit-norm memories, the resulting Boltzmann distribution is exactly a Gaussian mixture whose component weights are set by the multiplicities. This result separates exact conditioning in latent space from losses caused by sampling, PCA reconstruction, and sequence decoding. Across five Pfam families, attention followed the analytic target, but recovery of single-residue markers depended on how well PCA separated the designated and background sequences. A matched weighted profile HMM reproduced these markers more directly, while stochastic attention gave lower ESM2 pseudo-perplexity in the Kunitz comparison. Using a curated set of 23 omega-conotoxin sequences as the target subset produced diverse sequences that preserved the cysteine scaffold and Tyr13 and shifted other residues toward the designated set. These sequences are candidates for experimental testing; they do not establish binding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为小蛋白质家族比对中带指定子集的生成问题提出一种条件化方法：在免训练随机注意力采样器 (stochastic-attention sampler) 的 logits 中加入一个多重性比率 (multiplicity ratio)，使生成从整个家族转向指定子集。作者证明对单位范数记忆，所得玻尔兹曼分布恰好是一个高斯混合，其分量权重由多重性决定，从而把潜空间中的精确条件化与采样、PCA 重构和序列解码造成的损失分离开。在五个 Pfam 家族及 23 条 ω-芋螺毒素 (omega-conotoxin) 子集上验证了该方法的特性。
Motivation: 小蛋白质家族比对中常存在一个感兴趣的子集，但标注数据不足以训练条件生成器，现有方法难以在无训练条件下把生成定向到该子集。
Method: 通过在免训练随机注意力采样器的 logits 中只添加一个多重性比率来改变生成分布；理论分析表明单位范数记忆下该分布的玻尔兹曼形式精确等于高斯混合，分量权重由多重性设定，并在潜空间条件化与采样、PCA 重构、序列解码损失之间建立了解耦。
Result: 在五个 Pfam 家族上注意力分布符合解析目标，但单残基标记的恢复取决于 PCA 对指定与背景序列的分离程度；匹配的加权 profile HMM 更直接地再现这些标记，而随机注意力在 Kunitz 比较中给出更低的 ESM2 伪困惑度 (pseudo-perplexity)；对 23 条 ω-芋螺毒素子集生成出保留半胱氨酸骨架和 Tyr13 并朝指定集合偏移其他残基的多样序列。
Conclusion: 作者强调这些生成序列是候选实验测试对象，并不建立结合活性；方法的效果取决于潜空间中 PCA 对指定与背景序列的分离质量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Identity as Presence: Towards Appearance and Voice Personalized Joint Audio-Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in video synthesis have enabled realistic integration of real individuals, driving demand for identity-aware generation. While emerging methods support joint appearance and voice injection in audio-visual models, they primarily focus on single-subject settings. Multimodal identity integration across multiple subjects remains limited, and precise alignment between visual and vocal identities in multi-subject scenarios remains underexplored. We present Identity-as-Presence, a unified framework for joint personalized audio-video generation. An automated data curation pipeline constructs identity-labeled audio-visual pairs for single- and multi-subject scenes. A unified identity injection mechanism then binds paired appearance and voice through shared cross-modal identity binding and subject-anchored captions. A multi-stage training strategy further leverages large-scale unimodal data alongside scarce paired clips to mitigate modality imbalance. Experiments show superior audio quality, video fidelity, and audio-visual consistency, with stronger multi-subject binding than the compared methods. For more details and qualitative results, please refer to our webpage: \href{https://chen-yingjie.github.io/projects/Identity-as-Presence}{Identity-as-Presence}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Identity-as-Presence，一个面向联合个性化音频-视频生成（joint audio-video generation）的统一框架，重点解决多主体场景下外观与声音身份的绑定问题。框架包含自动化数据整理管线、统一的身份注入机制（通过共享跨模态身份绑定与 subject-anchored captions 绑定配对的外观和声音），以及利用大规模单模态数据和稀缺配对片段的多阶段训练策略。实验表明该方法在音频质量、视频保真度和音视频一致性上优于对比方法，且多主体绑定更强。
Motivation: 现有身份感知的视听生成方法主要聚焦于单主体场景，多主体下的多模态身份整合仍然有限，视觉身份与语音身份之间的精确对齐在多数主体场景中尚未被充分探索。
Method: 提出自动化数据整理管线，为单主体和多主体场景构建带身份标签的视听对；设计统一的身份注入机制，通过共享跨模态身份绑定和 subject-anchored captions 将配对的外观和声音绑定；并采用多阶段训练策略，借助大规模单模态数据缓解配对数据稀缺带来的模态不平衡。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在音频质量、视频保真度和音视频一致性上表现更优，并且在多主体绑定（multi-subject binding）方面比对比方法更强。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架为多主体场景提供了更强的身份绑定能力，并给出项目网页以展示细节和定性结果；摘要未明确说明方法的局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Seeking SOTA: Time-Series Forecasting Must Adopt Taxonomy-Specific Evaluation to Dispel Illusory Gains
papers.abstract_en: We argue that the current practice of evaluating AI/ML time-series forecasting models, predominantly on benchmarks characterized by strong, persistent periodicities and seasonalities, obscures real progress by overlooking the performance of efficient classical methods. We demonstrate that these "standard" datasets often exhibit dominant autocorrelation patterns and seasonal cycles that can be effectively captured by simpler linear or statistical models, rendering complex deep learning architectures frequently no more performant than their classical counterparts for these specific data characteristics, and raising questions as to whether any marginal improvements justify the significant increase in computational overhead and model complexity. We call on the community to (I) retire or substantially augment current benchmarks with datasets exhibiting a wider spectrum of non-stationarities, such as structural breaks, time-varying volatility, and concept drift, and less predictable dynamics drawn from diverse real-world domains, and (II) require every deep learning submission to include robust classical and simple baselines, appropriately chosen for the specific characteristics of the downstream tasks' time series. By doing so, we will help ensure that reported gains reflect genuine scientific methodological advances rather than artifacts of benchmark selection favoring models adept at learning repetitive patterns.
papers.comment: v2 clarifies Transformer temporal-order claims, strengthens benchmark-selection and metric guidance, corrects point-forecast targets for MSE/MAE, improves aggregation/reporting recommendations, adds living-benchmark protocols, revises weather/evaluation wording, makes author emails clickable, and adds five supporting references
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场/批判性论文，针对 AI/ML 时间序列预测模型评估现状提出质疑：现有基准普遍具有强周期性和季节性，导致简单线性或统计方法也能达到与复杂深度学习相当的性能，使报告的性能提升可能只是基准选择的伪影。作者呼吁社区(Ⅰ)淘汰或大幅扩展当前基准，引入结构突变、时变波动率、概念漂移等更丰富的非平稳性；以及(Ⅱ)要求所有深度学习提交必须包含针对任务时间序列特征恰当选择的经典与简单基线。
Motivation: 现有评估基准以强周期性、季节性的数据集为主，忽略了高效经典方法的竞争力，使得深度学习模型的边际改进是否值得其高计算开销与复杂度受到质疑，报告增益可能并非真实科学进展。
Method: 作者基于对标准数据集主导自相关模式与季节周期的分析，提出两项社区行动建议：重新设计覆盖更广非平稳性与真实世界动态的基准，并强制深度学习论文附带匹配数据特征的稳健经典/简单基线。
Result: 论文指出这些标准数据集常呈现可被线性或统计模型有效捕获的主导自相关模式与季节周期，深度学习架构在具有该类数据特征的任务上往往不优于经典基线。
Conclusion: 作者主张通过分类别(task/taxonomy-specific)的评估、更严格的基准选择与报告规范，确保所报告的性能提升反映真实方法学进展，并建议采用living-benchmark协议持续更新评估实践。
Relevance: 62

papers.title: Panoramic Multimodal Semantic Occupancy Prediction for Quadruped Robots
papers.abstract_en: Panoramic imagery provides holistic 360° visual coverage for environmental perception in quadruped robots. However, existing occupancy prediction methods are primarily designed for wheeled autonomous driving and rely heavily on RGB cues, which limits their robustness in complex, dynamically changing environments. To bridge this gap, we introduce PanoMMOcc, the first real-world panoramic multimodal occupancy dataset for quadruped robots, comprising four sensing modalities collected across diverse scenes. We further propose VoxelHound, a panoramic multimodal occupancy perception framework tailored to legged locomotion and spherical imaging. VoxelHound incorporates a Vertical Jitter Compensation (VJC) module to mitigate severe viewpoint perturbations caused by body pitch and roll during locomotion, enabling more consistent spatial reasoning, and a Multimodal Information Prompt Fusion (MIPF) module to effectively integrate panoramic visual cues with auxiliary modalities for enhanced volumetric occupancy prediction. We also establish a comprehensive benchmark on PanoMMOcc and provide detailed dataset analyses to enable systematic evaluation in challenging embodied perception scenarios. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VoxelHound achieves state-of-the-art performance on PanoMMOcc, with a +4.16 gain in mIoU. The dataset and code will be publicly released to facilitate future research on panoramic multimodal 3D perception for embodied robotic systems at https://github.com/SXDR/PanoMMOcc.

papers.title: Deterministic Preprocessing and Interpretable Fuzzy Banding for Cost-per-Student Reporting from Extracted Records
papers.abstract_en: Administrative extracts are often exchanged as spreadsheets and may be read as reports in their own right during budgeting, workload review, and governance discussions. When an exported workbook becomes the reference snapshot for such decisions, the transformation can be checked by recomputation against a clearly identified input. A deterministic, rule-governed, file-based workflow is implemented in cad_processor.py. The script ingests a Casual Academic Database (CAD) export workbook and aggregates inclusive on-costs and student counts into subject-year and school-year totals, from which it derives cost-per-student ratios. It writes a processed workbook with four sheets: Processing Summary (run record and counters), Trend Analysis (schoolyear cost-per-student matrix), Report (wide subject-level table), and Fuzzy Bands (per-year anchors, membership weights, and band labels). The run record includes a SHA-256 hash of the input workbook bytes to support snapshot-matched recomputation. For within-year interpretation, the workflow adds a simple fuzzy banding layer that labels finite, positive school-year cost-per-student values as Low, Medium, or High. The per-year anchors are the minimum, median, and maximum of the finite, positive ratios. Membership weights are computed using left-shoulder, triangular, and right-shoulder functions, with deterministic tie-breaking in a fixed priority order (Medium, then Low, then High). These weights are treated as decision-support signals rather than probabilities. A worked example provides a reproducible calculation of a band assignment from the reported anchors and ratios. Supplementary material includes a claim-to-evidence matrix, a reproducibility note, and a short glossary that links selected statements to code and workbook artefacts.
papers.comment: The authors are withdrawing this preprint because further review identified that the analysis and interpretation are insufficiently developed to support the paper in its current form. The authors do not wish readers to rely on this version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文描述一个确定性预处理工作流，cad_processor.py 将 Casual Academic Database (CAD) 导出工作簿聚合为 subject-year 与 school-year 总计，并推导 cost-per-student 比率，附加一个用于年度内解释的模糊分带 (fuzzy banding) 层，将有限正比率标记为 Low、Medium 或 High。工作簿以四个 sheet 输出，并用 SHA-256 哈希支持快照匹配重算。作者已撤回该预印本，理由是其分析和解释不足以支撑论文当前形式。
Motivation: 行政导出数据常以电子表格形式直接用于预算、工作量审查与治理讨论，但缺乏可复核、规则驱动的转换流程。论文目标是建立一个确定性的、基于文件的预处理工作流，并用可解释的模糊分带辅助年内决策。
Method: 在 cad_processor.py 中实现规则化文件工作流：读取 CAD 导出工作簿，聚合含附加成本 (on-costs) 的学生数到 subject-year 和 school-year 总计，再计算 cost-per-student 比率。输出含 Processing Summary、Trend Analysis、Report 和 Fuzzy Bands 四个 sheet 的工作簿，其中运行记录包含输入文件字节的 SHA-256 哈希。模糊分带以每年最小、中位、最大值为锚点，使用左肩、三角和右肩隶属函数计算隶属权重，并按 Medium、Low、High 的固定优先级进行确定性平局打破，权重仅作决策支持信号而非概率。
Result: 摘要仅提供一个可复现的分带计算实例，展示如何从给定锚点和比率得出带分配；未报告量化效果。补充材料包含 claim-to-evidence 矩阵、可复现性说明和术语表。
Conclusion: 作者因进一步审查发现分析与解释发展不足，主动撤回该预印本，并明确不建议读者依赖此版本。

papers.title: MAC: A Conversion Rate Prediction Benchmark Featuring Labels Under Multiple Attribution Mechanisms
papers.abstract_en: Multi-attribution learning (MAL), which enhances model performance by learning from conversion labels yielded by multiple attribution mechanisms, has emerged as a promising learning paradigm for conversion rate (CVR) prediction. However, the conversion labels in public CVR datasets are generated by a single attribution mechanism, hindering the development of MAL approaches. To address this data gap, we establish the Multi-Attribution Benchmark (MAC), the first public CVR dataset featuring labels from multiple attribution mechanisms. Besides, to promote reproducible research on MAL, we develop PyMAL, an open-source library covering a wide array of baseline methods. We conduct comprehensive experimental analyses on MAC and reveal three key insights: (1) MAL brings consistent performance gains across different attribution settings, especially for users featuring long conversion paths. (2) The performance growth scales up with objective complexity in most settings; however, when predicting first-click conversion targets, simply adding auxiliary objectives is counterproductive, underscoring the necessity of careful selection of auxiliary objectives. (3) Two architectural design principles are paramount: first, to fully learn the multi-attribution knowledge, and second, to fully leverage this knowledge to serve the main task. Motivated by these findings, we propose Mixture of Asymmetric Experts (MoAE), an effective MAL approach incorporating multi-attribution knowledge learning and main task-centric knowledge utilization. Experiments on MAC show that MoAE substantially surpasses the existing state-of-the-art MAL method. We believe that our benchmark and insights will foster future research in the MAL field. Our MAC benchmark and the PyMAL algorithm library are publicly available at https://github.com/alimama-tech/PyMAL.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 5 figures. Updated to the camera-ready version published in the proceedings of KDD 2026. Code and data available at https://github.com/alimama-tech/PyMAL
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 32nd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining V.2 (KDD '26), pp. 10009-10019, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MAC，据称是首个公开的包含多归因机制 (multi-attribution mechanisms) 标签的 CVR 预测数据集，并配套发布开源算法库 PyMAL 以支持可复现的多归因学习 (MAL) 研究。基于 MAC 上的系统实验，作者提出 Mixture of Asymmetric Experts (MoAE) 方法，摘要称其显著超过现有最优 MAL 方法。
Motivation: 现有公开 CVR 数据集的转化标签均由单一归因机制生成，缺乏多归因标签，阻碍了 MAL 这一通过多种归因机制所得标签提升模型性能的学习范式的发展。
Method: 构建多归因基准数据集 MAC，开发包含多种基线方法的开源库 PyMAL，并基于三个实验洞察提出 MoAE：将多归因知识学习与以主任务为中心的知识利用相结合。
Result: 实验显示 MAL 在不同归因设置下带来一致性性能提升，尤其对长转化路径用户；性能增长通常随目标复杂度上升，但预测首次点击转化目标时简单增加辅助目标反而有害。MoAE 在 MAC 上显著超越现有 SOTA MAL 方法。
Conclusion: 作者强调两个关键架构设计原则：充分学习多归因知识，以及充分将该知识用于服务主任务，并希望该基准与洞察推动 MAL 领域后续研究。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SynthRender and I-AsSET: Open-Source Framework and Dataset for Bidirectional Sim-Real Transfer in Industrial Object Perception
papers.abstract_en: Object perception is fundamental for tasks such as robotic material handling and quality inspection. However, modern supervised deep-learning models require large annotated datasets for robust automation under semi-uncontrolled conditions; a major barrier for widespread deployment with proprietary industrial parts. We address this through an integrated framework combining synthetic data generation and structured empirical evaluation for systematic investigation of bidirectional sim-to-real transfer. Our method integrates 2D-to-3D Reality-to-Simulation techniques for 3D asset creation from physical parts with programmatic Guided Domain Randomization (GDR) via SynthRender, an open-source synthetic image generation framework. Structured ablation studies across multiple benchmarks quantify the impact of individual rendering design choices, yielding practical guidelines for data-efficient synthetic training. To support evaluation under realistic industrial conditions, we introduce Industrial Assets for Sim-to-Real Evaluation and Transfer (I-AsSET), a 32-class dataset with diverse textures, intra-class variation, strong inter-class similarities, and 19,672 annotations, providing both CAD models and reconstructed meshes for bidirectional sim-to-real benchmarking. Across three industrial benchmarks, the proposed framework achieves highly competitive performance, reaching 98.7% mAP@50 on a public robotics dataset, 97.9% mAP@50 on an automotive benchmark, and 95.1% mAP@50 on I-AsSET.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个结合合成数据生成与结构化经验评估的框架，用于工业目标感知中的双向 sim-to-real 迁移。作者开源了合成图像生成框架 SynthRender，采用程序化引导域随机化 (Guided Domain Randomization, GDR)，并发布 32 类、含 19,672 个标注的 I-AsSET 数据集，同时提供 CAD 模型与重建网格。在三个工业基准上分别达到 98.7%、97.9% 和 95.1% 的 mAP@50。
Motivation: 工业零件目标感知依赖大量标注数据，而专有工业部件在半受控条件下难以获得充足标注，成为广泛部署的主要障碍。
Method: 集成 2D-to-3D Reality-to-Simulation 技术从物理零件创建 3D 资产，并通过 SynthRender 框架实现程序化 Guided Domain Randomization 生成合成图像；同时引入 I-AsSET 数据集支持双向 sim-to-real 基准评估。
Result: 在公共机器人数据集上达到 98.7% mAP@50，在汽车基准上达到 97.9% mAP@50，在 I-AsSET 上达到 95.1% mAP@50。
Conclusion: 跨多个基准的消融研究量化了不同渲染设计选择的影响，为数据高效的合成训练提供实用指南，并强调双向 sim-to-real 评估的价值。

papers.title: DA-Cal: Towards Cross-Domain Calibration in Semantic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: While existing unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) methods greatly enhance target domain performance in semantic segmentation, they often neglect network calibration quality, resulting in misalignment between prediction confidence and actual accuracy---a significant risk in safety-critical applications. Our key insight emerges from observing that performance degrades substantially when soft pseudo-labels replace hard pseudo-labels in cross-domain scenarios due to poor calibration, despite the theoretical equivalence of perfectly calibrated soft pseudo-labels to hard pseudo-labels. Based on this finding, we propose DA-Cal, a dedicated cross-domain calibration framework that transforms target domain calibration into soft pseudo-label optimization. DA-Cal introduces a Meta Temperature Network to generate pixel-level calibration parameters and employs bi-level optimization to establish the relationship between soft pseudo-labels and UDA supervision, while utilizing complementary domain-mixing strategies to prevent overfitting and reduce domain discrepancies. Experiments demonstrate that DA-Cal seamlessly integrates with existing self-training frameworks across multiple UDA segmentation benchmarks, significantly improving target domain calibration while delivering performance gains without inference overhead.
papers.comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Image Processing (TIP), 2026
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Trans. Image Process., vol. 35, pp. 7206-7221, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无监督域适应 (UDA) 语义分割中网络校准质量被忽视的问题，提出跨域校准框架 DA-Cal。作者观察到跨域场景下用软伪标签替换硬伪标签会导致性能显著下降，并归因于校准不良；DA-Cal 将目标域校准转化为软伪标签优化，引入 Meta Temperature Network 生成像素级校准参数，并结合双层优化与域混合策略。实验表明该方法可无缝集成到现有自训练框架中，在多个 UDA 分割基准上提升目标域校准并带来性能增益，且无推理开销。
Motivation: 现有 UDA 语义分割方法主要提升目标域性能，却忽视网络校准质量，导致预测置信度与实际精度错位，在安全关键应用中存在风险。
Method: 提出 DA-Cal 框架，将目标域校准转化为软伪标签优化：引入 Meta Temperature Network 生成像素级校准参数，采用双层优化 (bi-level optimization) 建立软伪标签与 UDA 监督之间的关系，并利用互补的域混合策略防止过拟合、减小域差异。
Result: 在多个 UDA 分割基准上，DA-Cal 能与现有自训练框架无缝集成，显著提升目标域校准质量，同时带来性能提升且不增加推理开销。
Conclusion: 摘要强调软伪标签的校准质量是跨域性能的关键因素，DA-Cal 通过将校准转化为软伪标签优化来同时改善校准与性能。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Large Causal Models for Temporal Causal Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Causal discovery for both cross-sectional and temporal data has traditionally followed a dataset-specific paradigm, where a new model is fitted for each individual dataset. Such an approach limits the potential of multi-dataset pretraining. The concept of large causal models (LCMs) envisions a class of pre-trained neural architectures specifically designed for temporal causal discovery. Prior approaches are constrained to small variable counts, degrade with larger inputs, and rely heavily on synthetic data, limiting generalization. We propose a principled framework for LCMs, combining diverse synthetic generators with realistic time-series datasets, allowing learning at scale. Extensive experiments on synthetic, semi-synthetic and realistic benchmarks show that LCMs scale effectively to higher variable counts and deeper architectures while maintaining strong performance. Trained models achieve competitive or superior accuracy compared to classical and neural baselines, particularly in out-of-distribution settings, while enabling fast, single-pass inference. Results demonstrate LCMs as a promising foundation-model paradigm for temporal causal discovery. Experiments and model weights are available at https://github.com/kougioulis/LCM/.
papers.comment: Accepted at European Conference on Machine Learning and Knowledge Discovery in Databases (ECML PKDD) 2026. 33 pages (including Appendix), 11 Figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出大型因果模型 (Large Causal Models, LCMs) 的通用框架，用于时间序列因果发现 (temporal causal discovery)，通过组合多样化的合成数据生成器与真实时间序列数据集实现大规模预训练。摘要称在合成、半合成和真实基准上的实验表明，LCMs 能扩展到更高变量数和更深架构，同时在分布外 (out-of-distribution) 场景下达到与经典及神经基线相当或更优的准确率，并支持快速单次推理 (single-pass inference)。
Motivation: 现有因果发现通常对每个数据集单独拟合模型，限制了多数据集预训练的潜力；此前面向时间因果发现的预训练方法受限于小变量数、在大输入上性能退化，且过度依赖合成数据，泛化能力不足。
Method: 提出 LCMs 的原则性框架，结合多种合成数据生成器与真实时间序列数据集进行大规模学习，训练专用于时间因果发现的预训练神经架构。
Result: 在合成、半合成和真实基准上的广泛实验中，LCMs 可扩展到更高变量数和更深架构且保持强性能；相比经典与神经基线取得竞争性或更优的准确率，尤其在分布外设定下表现突出，并实现快速单次推理。
Conclusion: 作者将 LCMs 视为时间因果发现中一种有前景的基础模型范式 (foundation-model paradigm)，并公开了实验与模型权重。

papers.title: SAGEO Arena: A Realistic Environment for Evaluating Search-Augmented Generative Engine Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Search-Augmented Generative Engines (SAGE) have emerged as a new paradigm for information access, bridging web-scale retrieval with generative capabilities to deliver synthesized answers. This shift has fundamentally reshaped how web content gains exposure online, giving rise to Search-Augmented Generative Engine Optimization (SAGEO), the practice of optimizing web documents to improve their visibility in AI-generated responses. Despite growing interest, no evaluation environment currently supports comprehensive investigation of SAGEO. Specifically, existing benchmarks lack end-to-end visibility evaluation of optimization strategies, operating on pre-determined candidate documents that abstract away retrieval and reranking preceding generation. Moreover, existing benchmarks discard structural information (e.g., schema markup) present in real web documents, overlooking the rich signals that search systems actively leverage in practice. Motivated by these gaps, we introduce SAGEO Arena, a realistic and reproducible environment for stage-level SAGEO analysis. Our objective is to jointly target search-oriented optimization (SEO) and generation-centric optimization (GEO). To achieve this, we integrate a full generative search pipeline over a large-scale corpus of web documents with rich structural information. Our findings reveal that existing approaches remain largely impractical under realistic conditions and often degrade performance in retrieval and reranking. We also find that structural information helps mitigate these limitations, and that effective SAGEO requires tailoring optimization to each pipeline stage. Overall, our benchmark paves the way for realistic SAGEO evaluation and optimization beyond simplified settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SAGEO Arena，一个面向搜索增强生成引擎优化（SAGEO）的现实可复现评测环境。该环境集成了完整的生成式搜索流水线，并在包含丰富结构信息的大规模网页语料上进行分阶段分析，同时覆盖 SEO 与 GEO。摘要报告称，现有优化方法在现实条件下大多不切实际，且常损害检索与重排序性能；结构信息可缓解部分问题，有效 SAGEO 需要针对流水线各阶段定制优化。
Motivation: 现有 SAGEO 评测基准缺乏对优化策略的端到端可见性评估，通常基于预定义候选文档，忽略了生成之前的检索与重排序环节；同时丢弃真实网页中存在的结构信息（如 schema markup），未利用搜索系统实际依赖的丰富信号。
Method: 构建 SAGEO Arena 环境，集成完整的生成式搜索流水线（含检索与重排序）以及大规模结构化的网页文档语料，目标是同时针对面向搜索的优化（SEO）与面向生成中心的优化（GEO）进行分阶段评估与分析。
Result: 实验发现，现有 SAGEO 方法在现实条件下大多不切实际，并经常在检索和重排序阶段造成性能下降；结构信息有助于缓解这些局限，且有效的 SAGEO 需要针对每个流水线阶段单独调整优化策略。
Conclusion: 该基准为超越简化设定的现实 SAGEO 评估与优化提供了基础，强调分阶段、利用结构信息进行优化的必要性。

papers.title: Raster2Seq: Polygon Sequence Generation for Floorplan Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing a structured vector-graphics representation from a rasterized floorplan image is typically an important prerequisite for computational tasks involving floorplans such as automated understanding or CAD workflows. However, existing techniques struggle in faithfully generating the structure and semantics conveyed by complex floorplans that depict large indoor spaces with many rooms and a varying numbers of polygon corners. To this end, we propose Raster2Seq, framing floorplan reconstruction as a sequence-to-sequence task in which floorplan elements--such as rooms, windows, and doors--are represented as labeled polygon sequences that jointly encode geometry and semantics. Our approach introduces an autoregressive decoder that learns to predict the next corner conditioned on image features and previously generated corners using guidance from learnable anchors. These anchors represent spatial coordinates in image space, hence allowing for effectively directing the attention mechanism to focus on informative image regions. By embracing the autoregressive mechanism, our method offers flexibility in the output format, enabling for efficiently handling complex floorplans with numerous rooms and diverse polygon structures. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on standard benchmarks such as Structure3D, CubiCasa5K, and Raster2Graph, while also demonstrating strong generalization to more challenging datasets like WAFFLE, which contain diverse room structures and complex geometric variations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Raster2Seq，将栅格化平面图的矢量化重建建模为序列到序列 (sequence-to-sequence) 任务，把房间、窗户、门等元素表示为同时编码几何与语义的带标签多边形序列。方法使用自回归解码器，借助可学习锚点 (learnable anchors) 引导注意力聚焦图像空间中的有效区域，逐角预测多边形顶点。摘要报告该方法在 Structure3D、CubiCasa5K、Raster2Graph 等基准上达到当前最优，并能泛化到结构更复杂多变的 WAFFLE 数据集。
Motivation: 从栅格化平面图重建结构化矢量图形表示是平面图自动化理解与 CAD 工作流的重要前提，但现有技术难以忠实生成包含大量房间和可变多边形角数的复杂平面图的结构与语义。
Method: 将平面图重建视为序列生成问题，以带标签的多边形序列统一表达几何与语义；引入自回归解码器，在图像特征和已生成角点的条件下预测下一角点，并用可学习锚点表示图像空间中的空间坐标以引导注意力聚焦信息丰富的区域。
Result: 摘要称该方法在 Structure3D、CubiCasa5K 和 Raster2Graph 标准基准上取得最先进性能，同时在房间结构多样、几何变化复杂的 WAFFLE 数据集上表现出较强的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 作者强调自回归机制为输出格式提供了灵活性，使方法能够高效处理包含众多房间和多样多边形结构（如 WAFFLE）的复杂平面图重建任务。

papers.title: Optimizing Spectral Prediction in MXene-Based Metasurfaces Through Multi-Channel Spectral Refinement and Savitzky-Golay Smoothing
papers.abstract_en: The prediction of electromagnetic spectra for MXene-based solar absorbers, where MXenes are a family of two-dimensional transition metal carbides and nitrides, is a computationally intensive task traditionally addressed using full-wave solvers. This study introduces an efficient deep learning framework incorporating transfer learning, multi-channel spectral refinement, and Savitzky-Golay smoothing to accelerate and enhance spectral prediction accuracy. The proposed architecture leverages a pretrained MobileNet version 2 model, fine-tuned to predict 102-point absorption spectra from ($64\times64$) metasurface designs. Additionally, the multi-channel spectral refinement module processes the feature map through multiple convolutional channels, enhancing feature extraction, while Savitzky-Golay smoothing mitigates high-frequency noise. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that the proposed model significantly outperforms baseline convolutional neural network and deformable convolutional neural network models, achieving an average root mean squared error of 0.0227, coefficient of determination ($R^2$) of 0.9563, and peak signal-to-noise ratio of 33.10 decibels. The proposed framework presents a scalable and computationally efficient alternative to conventional solvers, positioning it as a viable candidate for rapid spectral prediction in nanophotonic design workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于深度学习的框架，用于快速预测 MXene 基超表面吸收体的电磁吸收光谱。框架结合迁移学习（使用预训练 MobileNetV2）、多通道光谱细化模块和 Savitzky-Golay 平滑，从 64×64 的超表面设计图预测 102 点吸收光谱。实验结果显示该模型在平均均方根误差 0.0227、决定系数 0.9563、峰值信噪比 33.10 dB 上优于基线 CNN 和可变形 CNN 模型，为纳米光子设计提供计算高效的光谱预测替代方案。
Motivation: MXene 基太阳能吸收体的电磁光谱预测传统上依赖全波求解器，计算密集。本文旨在用深度学习加速并提高光谱预测精度。
Method: 提出结合迁移学习的框架：使用预训练 MobileNetV2 微调，加上多通道光谱细化模块处理特征图以增强特征提取，并用 Savitzky-Golay 平滑抑制高频噪声。
Result: 摘要报告平均 RMSE 为 0.0227、R² 为 0.9563、峰值信噪比为 33.10 dB，显著优于基线 CNN 和可变形 CNN 模型。
Conclusion: 该框架作为传统求解器的可扩展、计算高效替代方案，适合纳米光子设计工作流中的快速光谱预测。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Kimi K2.5: Visual Agentic Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Kimi K2.5, an open-source multimodal agentic model designed to advance general agentic intelligence. K2.5 emphasizes the joint optimization of text and vision so that two modalities enhance each other. This includes a series of techniques such as joint text-vision pre-training, zero-vision SFT, and joint text-vision reinforcement learning. Building on this multimodal foundation, K2.5 introduces Agent Swarm, a self-directed parallel agent orchestration framework that dynamically decomposes complex tasks into heterogeneous sub-problems and executes them concurrently. Extensive evaluations show that Kimi K2.5 achieves state-of-the-art results across various domains including coding, vision, reasoning, and agentic tasks. Agent Swarm also reduces latency by up to $4.5\times$ over single-agent baselines. We release the post-trained Kimi K2.5 model checkpoint to facilitate future research and real-world applications of agentic intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Kimi K2.5 是一个开源的多模态智能体模型，强调文本与视觉的联合优化，使两种模态相互增强。技术方案包括文本-视觉联合预训练、零视觉 SFT 以及文本-视觉联合强化学习，并在多模态基础上引入 Agent Swarm 并行智能体编排框架，用于动态分解复杂任务并并发执行。评测显示其在编码、视觉、推理和智能体任务上取得领先结果，Agent Swarm 相比单智能体基线最多降低 4.5 倍延迟。作者发布了训练后的模型权重。
Motivation: 现有智能体模型往往对文本与视觉分离优化，未能充分利用两种模态的相互增强作用；同时复杂任务在单智能体模式下执行时延迟较高。
Method: 提出文本-视觉联合预训练、零视觉 SFT 与文本-视觉联合强化学习等多模态训练技术；在此基础上引入 Agent Swarm，一个自驱动的并行智能体编排框架，能够将复杂任务动态分解为异质子问题并并发执行。
Result: 广泛评测表明 Kimi K2.5 在编码、视觉、推理和智能体任务上达到领先水平；Agent Swarm 相比单智能体基线将延迟降低最多 4.5 倍。
Conclusion: 作者认为联合优化文本与视觉以及并行智能体编排可推进通用智能体智能，并发布后训练模型权重以支持后续研究与实际应用。

summary_sections.result: 广泛评测表明 Kimi K2.5 在编码、视觉、推理和智能体任务上达到领先水平；Agent Swarm 相比单智能体基线将延迟降低最多 4.5 倍。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为联合优化文本与视觉以及并行智能体编排可推进通用智能体智能，并发布后训练模型权重以支持后续研究与实际应用。

papers.title: Concentration Inequalities for Exchangeable Tensors and Matrix-valued Data
papers.abstract_en: We study concentration inequalities for structured weighted sums of random data, including (i) tensor inner products and (ii) sequential matrix sums. We are interested in tail bounds and concentration inequalities for those structured weighted sums under exchangeability, extending beyond the classical framework of independent terms. We develop Hoeffding and Bernstein bounds provided with structure-dependent exchangeability. Along the way, we recover known results in weighted sum of exchangeable random variables and i.i.d. sums of random matrices to the optimal constants. Notably, we develop a sharper concentration bound for combinatorial sum of matrix arrays than the results previously derived from Chatterjee's method of exchangeable pairs. For applications, the richer structures provide us with novel analytical tools for estimating the average effect of multi-factor response models and studying fixed-design sketching methods in federated averaging. We apply our results to these problems, and find that our theoretical predictions are corroborated by numerical evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究可交换随机数据下结构化加权和的集中不等式，涵盖张量内积（tensor inner products）与顺序矩阵和（sequential matrix sums）两类结构。作者在可交换性（exchangeability）假设下发展出依赖结构的 Hoeffding 与 Bernstein 界，并将交换随机变量加权和、i.i.d. 随机矩阵和的已知结果恢复到最优常数；对矩阵阵列的组合和给出了比 Chatterjee 交换对方法更紧的集中界。作为应用，该方法被用于估计多因子响应模型的平均效应以及联邦平均中的固定设计 sketching，理论预测得到数值验证。
Motivation: 经典集中不等式通常假设各项独立，而张量内积、顺序矩阵和等结构化加权和往往只具备可交换性而非独立性，需要推广到更一般的框架；同时，基于交换对方法导出的矩阵阵列组合和上界仍有改进空间。
Method: 在可交换性假设下发展结构依赖的 Hoeffding 与 Bernstein 集中不等式，统一处理张量内积与顺序矩阵和；重新推导交换变量加权和与随机矩阵和的已知结果以恢复最优常数，并为矩阵阵列的组合和构造更锐利的尾部界。
Result: 摘要报告该框架将若干已知集中结果恢复到最优常数，且针对矩阵阵列组合和得到的界优于之前由 Chatterjee 交换对方法导出的结果；在多因子响应平均效应与联邦平均 sketching 的应用中，理论预测与数值证据一致。
Conclusion: 本文把集中不等式工具扩展到可交换的张量与矩阵值数据结构，并为多因子响应模型估计和联邦平均中的固定设计 sketching 提供新的分析手段；摘要未明确讨论局限性，贡献主线是理论界及其应用验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Self-Distillation Enables Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning, enabling models to acquire new skills and knowledge without degrading existing capabilities, remains a fundamental challenge for foundation models. While on-policy reinforcement learning can reduce forgetting, it requires explicit reward functions that are often unavailable. Learning from expert demonstrations, the primary alternative, is dominated by supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which is inherently off-policy. We introduce Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning (SDFT), a simple method that enables on-policy learning directly from demonstrations. SDFT leverages in-context learning by using a demonstration-conditioned model as its own teacher, generating on-policy training signals that preserve prior capabilities while acquiring new skills. Across skill learning and knowledge acquisition tasks, SDFT consistently outperforms SFT, achieving higher new-task accuracy while substantially reducing catastrophic forgetting. In sequential learning experiments, SDFT enables a single model to accumulate multiple skills over time without performance regression, establishing on-policy distillation as a practical path to continual learning from demonstrations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning (SDFT)，一种直接从专家示范中实现 on-policy 学习的持续学习方法。SDFT 利用 in-context learning，让以示范为条件的模型充当自身教师，生成 on-policy 训练信号，从而在不破坏已有能力的前提下获取新技能。摘要报告在技能获取与知识积累任务上，SDFT 一致优于监督微调 (SFT)，新任务准确率更高且显著减少灾难性遗忘，并能在序列学习中让单一模型持续积累多项技能。
Motivation: 持续学习要求模型在不退化已有能力的同时获取新技能，但现有方法存在明显缺口：on-policy 强化学习需要显式奖励函数而往往不可得，从专家示范学习的主流替代方案 SFT 本质上是 off-policy，容易导致遗忘。
Method: 提出 Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning (SDFT)：将示范条件化的模型作为自身教师，通过自蒸馏生成 on-policy 训练信号，在保持先前能力的同时学习新技能，从而把 on-policy 学习直接引入示范数据驱动的持续学习场景。
Result: 在技能学习和知识获取任务上，SDFT 相比 SFT 在新任务准确率上更高，并大幅降低灾难性遗忘；在序列学习实验中，单一模型能够随训练过程逐步积累多项技能而性能不出现回退。
Conclusion: 作者认为实验结果表明 on-policy 蒸馏是从示范进行持续学习的一条实用路径，为无法获得奖励函数时缓解遗忘提供了新的训练策略。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PCAE: Learning Ordered Representations in Latent Space for Intrinsic Dimension Estimation via Principal Component Autoencoder
papers.abstract_en: Autoencoders have long been considered a nonlinear extension of Principal Component Analysis (PCA). Prior studies have demonstrated that linear autoencoders (LAEs) can recover the ordered, axis-aligned principal components of PCA by incorporating non-uniform $\ell_2$ regularization or by adjusting the loss function. However, these approaches become insufficient in the nonlinear setting, as the remaining variance cannot be properly captured independently of the nonlinear mapping. In this work, we propose a novel autoencoder framework that integrates non-uniform variance regularization with an isometric constraint. This design serves as a natural generalization of PCA, enabling the model to preserve key advantages, such as ordered representations and variance retention, while remaining effective for nonlinear dimensionality reduction tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PCAE（Principal Component Autoencoder），一种将非均匀方差正则化与等距约束（isometric constraint）整合进自编码器框架的方法，作为 PCA 在非线性设定下的自然推广。摘要称该方法能够在潜空间中学习有序表示并进行本征维度（intrinsic dimension）估计，同时保留有序表示和方差保留等 PCA 的关键优势，并适用于非线性降维任务。
Motivation: 已有研究表明线性自编码器（LAE）可通过非均匀 ℓ2 正则化或调整损失函数恢复 PCA 的轴对齐有序主成分，但这些方法在非线性设定下失效，因为剩余方差无法独立于非线性映射被恰当捕获。
Method: 提出将非均匀方差正则化与等距约束结合的自编码器框架，使其成为 PCA 的自然推广，从而在非线性降维中保持有序表示与方差保留特性。
Result: 摘要主要给出方法设计层面的声明，指出该框架作为 PCA 的自然泛化在非线性降维中有效，但未报告具体数值实验或基准结果。
Conclusion: 该方法为线性 PCA 向非线性情形的推广提供了一种实现途径，适用于有序潜表示学习与本征维度估计；摘要未明确讨论局限。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: MetaSICL: Globalizing Auditory LLMs for Underserved Speakers and Languages via Meta Speech In-Context Learning
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI for speech and audio is increasingly expected to serve users across languages, cultures, and communities, yet current auditory Large Language Models (LLMs) are still largely trained and evaluated on high-resource data. Globalizing such systems requires handling low-resource settings, where the target speakers, languages, or tasks are poorly represented in training data. In these regimes, collecting enough labeled in-domain data is often impractical, and the small corpora available may still under-represent the test distribution, making direct fine-tuning brittle under domain shift. In-Context Learning (ICL) offers an alternative: instead of updating model parameters for every underserved community, an auditory LLM can adapt at inference time by conditioning on a few local demonstrations. However, vanilla speech ICL remains limited because most auditory LLMs are not explicitly trained to use such demonstrations effectively. We address this gap with Meta Speech In-Context Learning (MetaSICL), a post-training recipe that strengthens an auditory LLM's in-context adaptation ability using only abundant high-resource speech data. Although MetaSICL never trains on the target low-resource domains, it improves performance across two backbones on children's ASR, audio understanding/reasoning, and speech translation and ASR in directions and languages unseen in post-training. We further study the case where some in-domain data is available, using low-resource language ASR as a case study, since recognition for underserved languages is central to globalizing generative AI. Here, using MetaSICL as a warmup for in-domain reinforcement learning yields the strongest results, outperforming direct fine-tuning across five typologically diverse languages. Overall, MetaSICL offers a practical route toward globalizing auditory LLMs by building inference-time adaptation into the model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MetaSICL（Meta Speech In-Context Learning），一种仅使用丰富高资源语音数据的后训练方案，用于增强听觉大语言模型（auditory LLM）的上下文学习（in-context learning）适应能力，使其在推理时借助少量本地示范服务低资源语言与群体。摘要报告该方法在儿童语音识别、音频理解/推理、以及后训练中未见的方向和语言的语音翻译与 ASR 上均有提升；在低资源语言 ASR 中，以 MetaSICL 作为领域内强化学习（RL）的 warmup 优于直接微调。
Motivation: 现有听觉大语言模型主要在高资源数据上训练和评估，难以覆盖低资源场景中的说话人、语言或任务；收集足够的有标注域内数据常不切实际，少量语料也难以代表测试分布，直接微调在领域偏移下不稳定。ICL 提供了不更新参数的推理时适应途径，但大多数听觉 LLM 未被显式训练以有效利用示范。
Method: 提出 MetaSICL 后训练方案，仅用充足的高资源语音数据强化听觉 LLM 的上下文内适应能力，且不需要在目标低资源领域上训练。在仅有少量域内数据的情形下，将 MetaSICL 作为低资源语言 ASR 的域内强化学习（reinforcement learning）的 warmup 使用。
Result: 摘要报告在两个骨干模型上，MetaSICL 提升了儿童 ASR、音频理解/推理、以及后训练中未见的方向和语言的语音翻译与 ASR 性能；在五种类型多样的低资源语言 ASR 上，MetaSICL warmup 结合域内 RL 的效果强于直接微调。
Conclusion: MetaSICL 通过将推理时适应能力构建进模型本体，为听觉 LLM 的全球化提供了一条实践路径；其适用范围限定于未在目标低资源领域训练、仅依赖高资源数据后训练的设置。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Sampling via Stochastic Interpolants by Langevin-based Velocity and Initialization Estimation in Flow ODEs
papers.abstract_en: We propose a novel method for sampling from unnormalized Boltzmann densities based on a probability flow ordinary differential equation (ODE) derived from linear stochastic interpolants. The key innovation of our approach is the use of a sequence of Langevin samplers to enable efficient simulation of the flow. Specifically, these Langevin samplers are employed (i) to generate samples from the interpolant distribution at intermediate times and (ii) to construct, starting from these intermediate times, a robust estimator of the velocity field governing the probability flow ODE. Theoretically, we provide convergence guarantees for both Langevin components, and establish a non-asymptotic convergence rate for the probability flow ODE. Extensive numerical experiments demonstrate the efficiency of the proposed method on challenging multimodal distributions across a range of dimensions, as well as its effectiveness in Bayesian inference tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于线性随机插值 (linear stochastic interpolants) 的概率流常微分方程 (probability flow ODE) 采样方法，用于从非归一化Boltzmann密度中采样。核心创新是使用一列Langevin采样器来辅助模拟该flow：一方面在中间时刻生成插值分布的样本，另一方面从这些中间时刻出发构造速度场的稳健估计。理论部分给出了两种Langevin分量的收敛保证，并建立了概率流ODE的非渐近收敛率；数值实验在多种维度的多峰分布及贝叶斯推断任务中验证了效率。
Motivation: 从非归一化Boltzmann密度采样是贝叶斯推断和统计计算中的基础困难问题；现有基于概率流ODE的方法需要可靠的速度场估计，而中间时刻样本的生成与速度估计的稳健性是关键瓶颈。
Method: 从线性随机插值导出的概率流ODE出发，设计一系列Langevin采样器：(i) 在中间时间生成插值分布的样本；(ii) 从这些中间时间出发构造速度场的稳健估计器。理论上对这两类Langevin分量的收敛性给出保证，并推导概率流ODE的非渐近收敛率。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在跨维度的具有挑战性的多模态分布上表现出采样效率，并在贝叶斯推断任务中有效；未给出具体数值。

papers.title: VLA-Arena: An Open-Source Framework for Benchmarking Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: While Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) are rapidly advancing toward generalist robot policies, quantitatively characterizing their capability boundaries and failure modes remains challenging. To address this, we introduce VLA-Arena, a comprehensive benchmark. It features a novel structured task design framework to quantify difficulty across three orthogonal axes: (1) Task Structure, (2) Language Command, and (3) Visual Observation. This allows us to systematically design tasks with fine-grained difficulty levels, enabling a precise measurement of model capability frontiers. For task structure, VLA-Arena comprises 11 task suites organized into four dimensions: Safety, Distractor, Extrapolation, and Long Horizon, totaling 170 tasks. Each suite spans three difficulty levels (L0-L2), with fine-tuning restricted to L0 to rigorously assess generalization. Orthogonal to this, language (W0-W4) and visual (V0-V4) perturbations can be applied to any task as diagnostic probes to distinguish robust grounding from superficial pattern matching. Our extensive evaluation of state-of-the-art VLAs reveals critical limitations: memorization over generalization, superficial visual perception, and a neglect of safety constraints. Additionally, model rank reversals across L0-L2 validate that each level provides non-redundant insights. To foster research addressing these model limitations and ensure reproducibility, we provide the complete VLA-Arena framework, including an end-to-end toolchain from task definition to automated evaluation and the VLA-Arena-S/M/L datasets for fine-tuning. Our benchmark, datasets, models, and leaderboard are publicly available at https://vla-arena.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VLA-Arena，一个面向视觉-语言-动作模型 (Vision-Language-Action models, VLA) 的开源基准测试框架。它采用结构化任务设计框架，沿任务结构、语言指令、视觉观察三个正交轴量化任务难度，包含 11 个任务套件、共 170 个任务，每个套件分 L0-L2 三个难度等级。对现有 SOTA VLA 的评估揭示了记忆化而非泛化、视觉感知肤浅、忽视安全约束等局限，并提供完整的端到端工具链和 VLA-Arena-S/M/L 微调数据集。
Motivation: VLA 正快速迈向通用机器人策略，但定量刻画其能力边界和失败模式仍然困难，缺少一个能系统区分模型真实泛化能力与表面模式匹配的基准。
Method: 提出三轴正交的难度量化框架：(1) Task Structure、(2) Language Command、(3) Visual Observation。任务结构包含 Safety、Distractor、Extrapolation、Long Horizon 四个维度共 11 个任务套件、170 个任务，每个套件分 L0-L2 三级难度，且微调只允许 L0 以严格评估泛化；语言扰动 (W0-W4) 与视觉扰动 (V0-V4) 可作为诊断探针施加到任意任务上。
Result: 对 SOTA VLA 的广泛评估发现其关键局限：记忆化超过泛化、视觉感知停留在表面、忽视安全约束；L0-L2 之间出现模型排名反转，说明各难度等级提供了非冗余信息。
Conclusion: 作者公开 VLA-Arena 全部框架，包括从任务定义到自动评估的端到端工具链以及 VLA-Arena-S/M/L 数据集，基准、数据集、模型和排行榜均开放，旨在推动针对这些模型局限的研究并保证可复现性。

papers.title: Complexity of Markov Chain Monte Carlo for Generalized Linear Models
papers.abstract_en: Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC), Laplace approximation (LA) and variational inference (VI) methods are popular approaches to Bayesian inference, each with trade-offs between computational cost and accuracy. However, a theoretical understanding of these differences is missing, particularly when both the sample size $n$ and the dimension $d$ are large. LA and Gaussian VI are justified by Bernstein-von Mises (BvM) theorems, and recent work has derived the characteristic condition $n\gg d^2$ for their validity, improving over the condition $n\gg d^3$. In this paper, we show for linear, logistic and Poisson regression that for $n\gtrsim d$, MCMC attains the same complexity scaling in $n$, $d$ as first-order optimization algorithms, up to sub-polynomial factors. Thus MCMC is competitive with LA and Gaussian VI in complexity, under a scaling between $n$ and $d$ more general than BvM regimes. Our complexities apply to appropriately scaled priors that are not necessarily Gaussian-tailed, including Student-$t$ and flat priors, with log-posteriors that are not necessarily globally concave or gradient-Lipschitz.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究贝叶斯推断中 MCMC 与 Laplace 近似 (Laplace approximation, LA)、高斯变分推断 (Gaussian VI) 在计算复杂度上的差异。作者对线性、Logistic 和 Poisson 回归证明，在 n≳d 条件下，MCMC 的复杂度缩放与一阶优化算法一致（至多差次多项式因子），从而在比 Bernstein-von Mises (BvM) 定理适用的 n-d 缩放关系更一般的设定下，与 LA 和高斯 VI 具有同等复杂度。所述复杂度结论适用于恰当缩放的先验，不要求高斯尾部、全局凹性或梯度 Lipschitz 条件。
Motivation: LA 和高斯 VI 的合理性由 Bernstein-von Mises 定理支撑，但缺少在大样本量 n 和大维度 d 下这些方法与 MCMC 之间计算成本与精度权衡的理论理解；近期工作已把 LA/VI 的有效性条件从 n≫d^3 改进到 n≫d^2，但 MCMC 在更一般条件下的复杂度特性仍不清楚。
Method: 对线性、Logistic 和 Poisson 回归设定，在 n≳d 时分析 MCMC 的复杂度缩放，并与一阶优化算法的复杂度进行对比；分析适用于恰当缩放的先验，包括 Student-t 和 flat 先验，且允许 log-posterior 不全局凹或梯度非 Lipschitz。
Result: 摘要报告，在 n≳d 区间内 MCMC 达到与一阶优化算法相同的复杂度缩放（至多 sub-polynomial 因子），因此 MCMC 在与 LA 和高斯 VI 的比较中具有竞争力，且其成立条件比 BvM 正则更宽泛。
Conclusion: 作者认为 MCMC 可以在比 BvM 条件更一般的 n-d 缩放关系下，与 LA 和高斯 VI 在复杂度上竞争，且该结论覆盖非高斯尾先验与较弱的后验正则性假设。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Resolution-Agnostic Neural Operators for Multi-Rate Sparse-View CT
papers.abstract_en: Sparse-view Computed Tomography (CT) reconstructs images from a limited number of X-ray projections to reduce radiation and scanning time, which is an ill-posed inverse problem. Existing methods achieve high-fidelity reconstructions but overfit to a fixed acquisition setup, failing to generalize well across sampling rates. For example, convolutional neural networks (CNNs) use the same kernels across resolutions, leading to artifacts when data resolution changes. This is a critical limitation in clinical practice, where acquisition sampling settings vary across organs and diagnostic protocols. We propose Computed Tomography neural Operator (CTO), the first neural operator (NO) framework for CT reconstruction. CTO extends learning from fixed discretized grids to continuous function space, enabling a single model to generalize across measurement sampling rates without retraining. We also propose new NO architectural designs for CT: (i) a dual-domain NO architecture in both sinogram and image spaces, capturing complementary spatial-frequency information, and (ii) rotation-equivariant DIScrete-COntinuous convolutions (DISCO) that exploit the rotational structure inherent in tomographic acquisition. Empirically, CTO outperforms CNNs (> 3.4dB PSNR gain) and other baselines in multi-resolution settings across multiple CT datasets. Compared to state-of-the-art diffusion methods, CTO has 500x faster inference with an average 3dB gain. CTO further demonstrates strong out-of-distribution robustness, maintaining gains under cross-dataset transfer and noisy sinogram conditions. Ablation studies also validate each design choice. CTO establishes neural operators as a principled and practical paradigm for flexible, discretization-agnostic CT reconstruction. Our code is available at https://github.com/neuraloperator/sparse_ct.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Computed Tomography neural Operator (CTO)，据称是首个用于 CT 重建的神经算子 (neural operator) 框架，将学习从固定离散网格推广到连续函数空间，使单个模型无需重训练即可跨测量采样率泛化。CTO 采用双域 (sinogram 与图像空间) 架构以及旋转等变的 DIScrete-COntinuous convolutions (DISCO)。实验显示其在多分辨率 CT 数据集上超过 CNN 超过 3.4dB PSNR，相比 SOTA 扩散方法推理快 500 倍并平均提升 3dB，且具备跨数据集与噪声 sinogram 下的分布外鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有稀疏视图 CT 重建方法虽能实现高保真重建，但过拟合于固定采集设置，难以跨采样率泛化；例如 CNN 在不同分辨率下使用相同卷积核会导致伪影。这在临床中很关键，因为不同器官和诊断协议的采集采样设置各不相同。
Method: 提出 CTO，将神经算子框架引入 CT 重建，从固定离散网格推广到连续函数空间；并设计两个新架构组件：在 sinogram 和图像空间上的双域神经算子架构以捕捉互补的空间-频率信息，以及利用断层采集旋转结构的旋转等变 DISCO 卷积。
Result: 摘要报告 CTO 在多分辨率设置下、多个 CT 数据集上优于 CNN 超过 3.4dB PSNR；相比 SOTA 扩散方法，推理速度快 500 倍且平均获得 3dB 增益；在跨数据集迁移和有噪声 sinogram 条件下保持增益，消融研究验证了各设计选择的贡献。
Conclusion: 作者强调 CTO 确立了神经算子作为灵活、与离散化无关的 CT 重建的原则性且实用范式，并公开了代码。

papers.title: HFS: Holistic Query-Aware Frame Selection for Efficient Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Key frame selection is essentially a set-level optimization problem: the quality of the selected subset depends on the interactions among frames, rather than the score of any single frame. Existing methods generally exhibit three major limitations. Point-wise methods score each frame independently and ignore inter-frame dependencies. Although the training-free set-level methods explicitly model the inter-frame relationships, their selection criteria are fixed and cannot be adapted through downstream task feedback. Learnable methods can leverage data-driven training; however, they lack an explicit, differentiable set-quality objective and rely on offline-generated supervision signals. To address these limitations, we propose an end-to-end trainable and task-adaptive framework for frame selection. A Chain-of-Thought prompt conditions a Small Language Model (SLM) to extract task-specific latent query vectors, which are combined with multimodal features to enable dynamic, query-aware frame scoring. We further formulate a continuous set-level objective function that jointly accounts for relevance, coverage, and redundancy, enabling differentiable set-level optimization via Gumbel-TopK for selecting optimal frame combinations. Finally, we employ a student-teacher mutual learning strategy, in which the student selector (SLM) and teacher reasoner (MLLM) are trained to align their frame-importance distributions via KL divergence. Combined with cross-entropy loss, this design enables fully end-to-end optimization, eliminating reliance on static pseudo-labels. Experiments across multiple benchmarks, including Video-MME, LongVideoBench, MLVU, and NExT-QA, demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing frame-selection approaches.
papers.comment: Accepted to the Main Track of ACM Multimedia 2026 (ACM MM '26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视频理解中的关键帧选择问题，提出一个端到端可训练、任务自适应的帧选择框架 HFS。作者将帧选择视为集合级优化问题，用 Chain-of-Thought 提示驱动小型语言模型 (SLM) 提取任务特定的潜在查询向量，并结合多模态特征进行查询感知的动态帧评分。文章进一步设计包含相关性、覆盖度和冗余度的连续集合级目标函数，通过 Gumbel-TopK 实现可微的集合级优化，并采用学生-教师互学习策略 (KL 散度对齐) 实现完全端到端训练。实验在 Video-MME、LongVideoBench、MLVU 和 NExT-QA 等基准上显著优于现有帧选择方法。
Motivation: 现有关键帧选择方法存在三类局限：逐点方法独立打分而忽略帧间依赖；免训练的集合级方法虽显式建模帧间关系但准则固定、无法通过下游任务反馈自适应；可学习方法缺乏显式可微的集合级质量目标，且依赖离线生成的监督信号。
Method: 提出 HFS 框架：通过 Chain-of-Thought 提示让 SLM 提取任务相关的潜在查询向量，与多模态特征结合用于动态查询感知的帧评分；构造同时考虑相关性、覆盖度和冗余度的连续集合级目标函数，并用 Gumbel-TopK 实现可微的集合级优化；采用学生选择器 (SLM) 与教师推理器 (MLLM) 的互学习，通过 KL 散度对齐帧重要性分布，配合交叉熵损失实现完全端到端训练，消除对静态伪标签的依赖。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在 Video-MME、LongVideoBench、MLVU 和 NExT-QA 等多个基准上显著优于现有帧选择方法。
Conclusion: 作者强调，通过查询感知的集合级目标与端到端互学习，所提框架能够实现任务自适应的帧选择，并摆脱对离线静态伪标签的依赖。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对视频理解中的关键帧选择问题，提出一个端到端可训练、任务自适应的帧选择框架 HFS。作者将帧选择视为集合级优化问题，用 Chain-of-Thought 提示驱动小型语言模型 (SLM) 提取任务特定的潜在查询向量，并结合多模态特征进行查询感知的动态帧评分。文章进一步设计包含相关性、覆盖度和冗余度的连续集合级目标函数，通过 Gumbel-TopK 实现可微的集合级优化，并采用学生-教师互学习策略 (KL 散度对齐) 实现完全端到端训练。实验在 Video-MME、LongVideoBench、MLVU 和 NExT-QA 等基准上显著优于现有帧选择方法。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有关键帧选择方法存在三类局限：逐点方法独立打分而忽略帧间依赖；免训练的集合级方法虽显式建模帧间关系但准则固定、无法通过下游任务反馈自适应；可学习方法缺乏显式可微的集合级质量目标，且依赖离线生成的监督信号。
summary_sections.method: 提出 HFS 框架：通过 Chain-of-Thought 提示让 SLM 提取任务相关的潜在查询向量，与多模态特征结合用于动态查询感知的帧评分；构造同时考虑相关性、覆盖度和冗余度的连续集合级目标函数，并用 Gumbel-TopK 实现可微的集合级优化；采用学生选择器 (SLM) 与教师推理器 (MLLM) 的互学习，通过 KL 散度对齐帧重要性分布，配合交叉熵损失实现完全端到端训练，消除对静态伪标签的依赖。

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调，通过查询感知的集合级目标与端到端互学习，所提框架能够实现任务自适应的帧选择，并摆脱对离线静态伪标签的依赖。

papers.title: Pathryoshka: Compressing Pathology Foundation Models via Multi-Teacher Knowledge Distillation with Nested Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Pathology foundation models (FMs) have driven significant progress in computational pathology. However, these high-performing models can easily exceed a billion parameters and produce high-dimensional embeddings, thus limiting their applicability for research or clinical use when computing resources are tight. Here, we introduce Pathryoshka, a multi-teacher distillation framework inspired by RADIO distillation and Matryoshka Representation Learning to reduce pathology FM sizes while allowing for adaptable embedding dimensions. We evaluate our framework with a distilled model on ten public pathology benchmarks with varying downstream tasks. Compared to its much larger teachers, Pathryoshka reduces the model size by 86-92% at on-par performance. It outperforms state-of-the-art single-teacher distillation models of comparable size by a median margin of 7.0 in accuracy. By enabling efficient local deployment without sacrificing accuracy or representational richness, Pathryoshka democratizes access to state-of-the-art pathology FMs for the broader research and clinical community.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Pathryoshka，一个面向病理学基础模型 (pathology foundation models) 的多教师知识蒸馏框架，结合 RADIO 蒸馏与 Matryoshka Representation Learning，旨在压缩模型体积并提供可变的嵌入维度。蒸馏模型在十个公开病理学基准上以 86-92% 的体积缩减取得与大型教师相当的性能，并以中位 7.0 的准确率优势超过同规模单教师蒸馏模型。
Motivation: 病理学基础模型常超过十亿参数并产生高维嵌入，在计算资源受限的研究或临床场景中难以部署，因此需要在不损失性能的前提下压缩模型并允许灵活的嵌入维度。
Method: 受 RADIO 蒸馏和 Matryoshka Representation Learning 启发，构建多教师知识蒸馏框架 Pathryoshka，将多个大型教师模型的知识蒸馏到更小的学生模型，并通过嵌套嵌入 (nested embeddings) 支持可裁剪的嵌入维度。
Result: 在十个公共病理学基准上，蒸馏后的 Pathryoshka 相比其更大的教师模型将模型尺寸减少 86-92% 且性能相当，并在同规模模型中比单教师蒸馏方法在中位准确率上高出 7.0。
Conclusion: 作者认为 Pathryoshka 能在不牺牲准确率或表征丰富度的前提下实现高效的本地部署，从而让更广泛的研究与临床社区能够使用先进的病理学基础模型。

papers.title: Direct Visual Grounding by Directing Attention of Visual Tokens
papers.abstract_en: Vision Language Models (VLMs) mix visual tokens and text tokens. A puzzling issue is the fact that visual tokens most related to the query receive little to no attention in the final layers of the LLM module of VLMs from the answer tokens, where all tokens are treated equally, in particular, visual and language tokens in the LLM attention layers. This fact may result in wrong answers to visual questions, as our experimental results confirm. It appears that the standard next-token prediction (NTP) loss provides an insufficient signal for directing attention to visual tokens. We hypothesize that a more direct supervision of the attention of visual tokens to corresponding language tokens in the LLM module of VLMs will lead to improved performance on visual tasks. To demonstrate that this is indeed the case, we propose a novel loss function that directly supervises the attention of visual tokens. It directly grounds the answer language tokens in images by directing their attention to the relevant visual tokens. This is achieved by aligning the attention distribution of visual tokens to ground truth attention maps with KL divergence. The ground truth attention maps are obtained from task geometry in synthetic cases or from standard grounding annotations (e.g., bounding boxes or point annotations) in real images, and are used inside the LLM for attention supervision without requiring new labels. The obtained KL attention loss (KLAL) when combined with NTP encourages VLMs to attend to relevant visual tokens while generating answer tokens. This results in notable improvements across geometric tasks, pointing, and referring expression comprehension on both synthetic and real-world data, as demonstrated by our experiments. We also introduce a new dataset to evaluate the line tracing abilities of VLMs. Surprisingly, even commercial VLMs do not perform well on this task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 VLM 中与查询相关的视觉 token 在 LLM 模块最后几层几乎不被回答 token 关注的问题，提出一种直接监督视觉 token 注意力的 KL 注意力损失 (KL attention loss, KLAL)。该损失将视觉 token 的注意力分布与由任务几何或标准定位标注 (bounding box、点标注) 得到的 ground truth 注意力图对齐，并与标准 next-token prediction (NTP) 损失联合训练。实验表明该方法在几何任务、指向和指代表达式理解上均有显著提升，作者还引入了一个新的线追踪数据集，并发现商业 VLM 在该任务上表现不佳。
Motivation: VLM 的 LLM 注意力层平等对待所有 token，导致与查询最相关的视觉 token 在最终层获得极少注意力，从而产生错误的视觉问答结果；标准 NTP 损失不足以引导注意力指向视觉 token。
Method: 提出一个新的损失函数直接监督视觉 token 的注意力：将视觉 token 的注意力分布与 ground truth 注意力图用 KL 散度对齐，ground truth 可由合成场景的任务几何或真实图像的定位标注获得，无需新标签；该 KLAL 损失与 NTP 联合使用，鼓励回答 token 生成时关注相关视觉 token。
Result: 摘要报告在合成和真实数据上的几何任务、pointing 和 referring expression comprehension 均取得显著提升；同时引入了用于评估 VLM 线追踪能力的新数据集，结果显示即便是商业 VLM 在该任务上也表现不佳。
Conclusion: 作者认为直接对 VLM LLM 模块中的视觉 token 注意力进行监督可以改进视觉任务表现，并指出线追踪能力是一个现有 VLM 尚未解决的短板。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Equivariant Sparse Autoencoders: Mechanistic Interpretability of Neural Networks on Symmetric Data
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning (ML) models achieve remarkable performance but remain hard to interpret due to their scale and complexity. In particular, their activations entangle many concepts into fewer dimensions, a phenomenon known as superposition. Mechanistic interpretability methods such as sparse autoencoders (SAEs) can disentangle these dense activations into sparse sums of interpretable features, but SAEs suffer from unidentifiability: different explanations can fit the data equally well without necessarily being more interpretable or faithful to the underlying model. We show that this problem is exacerbated by data symmetries such as rotations that are prevalent in scientific domains. We extend the Linear Representation Hypothesis, the theory behind SAEs, to account for symmetries and show on synthetic as well as real-world scientific datasets and models that the resulting Equivariant SAEs can (1) avoid the pitfalls of existing SAEs on symmetric data and (2) discover features more useful for downstream tasks despite worse reconstructions. Our results show that incorporating the correct priors in SAEs can significantly improve their usefulness while highlighting that reconstruction quality can be inversely correlated with feature usefulness under symmetries, cautioning against its use as a key measure of interpretability. Code: https://github.com/ege-erdogan/equivariant-sae
papers.comment: NeurIPS 2025 Mechanistic Interpretability and UniReps workshops
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出等变稀疏自编码器（Equivariant SAEs），将线性表示假说（Linear Representation Hypothesis）扩展到对称数据，以解决现有 SAE 在对称数据上的不可辨识性问题。作者在合成及真实科学数据集和模型上验证，等变 SAE 能避免现有 SAE 在对称数据上的缺陷，并发现对下游任务更有用的特征，尽管重构质量反而更差。结果表明，在对称性下重构质量可能与特征有用性负相关，不应作为可解释性的关键度量。
Motivation: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）虽能解耦叠加（superposition）下的密集激活，但存在不可辨识性问题：不同解释可同等拟合数据，却不一定更可解释或忠实。论文指出，科学领域中普遍存在的旋转等数据对称性会加剧该问题。
Method: 扩展线性表示假说以纳入对称性，提出等变稀疏自编码器（Equivariant SAE），将等变约束引入 SAE 的架构和训练过程，使学到的特征满足数据的对称结构。
Result: 在合成数据和真实科学数据集及模型上，等变 SAE 避免了现有 SAE 在对称数据上的陷阱，并发现对下游任务更有用的特征，尽管其重构损失更差。
Conclusion: 在 SAE 中纳入正确先验（对称性）能显著提升特征的有用性，同时提示在对称数据下重构质量与特征有用性可能负相关，应谨慎将重构质量作为可解释性的主要度量。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: BDD2Seq: Enabling Scalable Reversible-Circuit Synthesis via Graph-to-Sequence Learning
papers.abstract_en: Binary Decision Diagrams (BDDs) are instrumental in many electronic design automation (EDA) tasks thanks to their compact representation of Boolean functions. In BDD-based reversible-circuit synthesis, which is critical for quantum computing, the chosen variable ordering governs the number of BDD nodes and thus the key metrics of resource consumption, such as Quantum Cost. Because finding an optimal variable ordering for BDDs is an NP-complete problem, existing heuristics often degrade as circuit complexity grows. We introduce BDD2Seq, a graph-to-sequence framework that couples a Graph Neural Network encoder with a Pointer-Network decoder and Diverse Beam Search to predict high-quality orderings. By treating the circuit netlist as a graph, BDD2Seq learns structural dependencies that conventional heuristics overlooked, yielding smaller BDDs and faster synthesis. Extensive experiments on three public benchmarks show that BDD2Seq achieves around 1.4 times lower Quantum Cost and 3.7 times faster synthesis than modern heuristic algorithms. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to tackle the variable-ordering problem in BDD-based reversible-circuit synthesis with a graph-based generative model and diversity-promoting decoding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BDD2Seq，一个图到序列 (graph-to-sequence) 框架，用图神经网络 (GNN) 编码器配合 Pointer-Network 解码器和 Diverse Beam Search 来预测 BDD 的高质量变量排序。该方法将电路网表视为图，学习传统启发式方法忽略的结构依赖，从而得到更小的 BDD 和更快的综合。三个公开基准上的实验显示，BDD2Seq 比现代启发式算法降低约 1.4 倍的 Quantum Cost，综合速度提升约 3.7 倍；作者称这是首个用基于图的生成模型解决该变量排序问题的工作。
Motivation: 在基于 BDD 的可逆电路综合中，变量排序决定了 BDD 节点数量，进而影响 Quantum Cost 等关键资源指标；而寻找 BDD 的最优变量排序是 NP-complete 问题，现有启发式方法在电路复杂度增长时性能会退化。
Method: BDD2Seq 将电路网表建模为图，用 GNN 编码结构信息，并用 Pointer-Network 解码器生成变量排序，同时结合 Diverse Beam Search 提高候选排序的多样性，从而预测更优的 BDD 变量顺序。
Result: 在三个公开基准上的实验表明，BDD2Seq 相比现代启发式算法可将 Quantum Cost 降低约 1.4 倍，综合速度提升约 3.7 倍。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法证明了基于图的生成模型配合多样性解码策略可以处理 BDD 可逆电路综合中的变量排序问题，并带来更小的 BDD 与更快的综合。
