papers.title: Intelligence per Watt: Measuring Intelligence Efficiency of Local AI
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) queries are predominantly processed by frontier models in centralized cloud infrastructure. Demand growth strains this paradigm faster than providers can scale. Two advances create an opportunity to rethink it: small, local LMs (<=20B active parameters) now achieve competitive performance to frontier models on many tasks, and local accelerators (e.g., Apple M4 Max) can host these models at interactive latencies. This raises the question: can local inference viably redistribute demand from centralized infrastructure? This requires measuring both whether local LMs can accurately answer real-world queries and whether they can do so efficiently on power-constrained devices (e.g., laptops). We propose intelligence per watt (IPW), task accuracy per unit of power, as a unified metric for the capability and efficiency of local inference across model-accelerator configurations. We evaluate 20+ state-of-the-art local LMs, 8 hardware accelerators (local and cloud), and 1M real-world single-turn chat and reasoning queries. For each query, we measure accuracy (local LM win rate against frontier models), energy, latency, and power. We find three key results. First, local LMs successfully answer 88.7% of these queries, with accuracy varying by domain. Second, longitudinal analysis from 2023-2025 shows IPW improved 5.3x, driven by both algorithmic and accelerator advances, with locally-serviceable query coverage rising from 23.2% to 71.3%. Third, local accelerators achieve at least 1.4x lower IPW than cloud accelerators running identical models, revealing significant headroom for local accelerator optimization. These findings demonstrate that local inference can meaningfully redistribute demand from centralized infrastructure for a substantial subset of queries, with IPW serving as the critical metric for tracking this transition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 intelligence per watt (IPW) 指标，即单位功耗下的任务准确率，用于统一衡量本地大语言模型推理的能力与效率。作者在 20+ 个本地 LM、8 种本地/云加速器、100 万条真实单轮对话与推理查询上测量准确率、能量、延迟和功率，发现本地 LM 可正确回答 88.7% 查询，2023-2025 年 IPW 提升 5.3 倍，本地可服务查询覆盖率从 23.2% 升至 71.3%，且本地加速器相比云加速器运行相同模型时 IPW 至少低 1.4 倍。
Motivation: 集中式云端推理面临需求增长快于供给扩张的压力，而小型本地 LM（<=20B active parameters）与本地加速器已具备竞争性性能和交互延迟；作者认为需要统一度量本地推理的准确率与能效，以判断能否将需求从中心化基础设施分流到本地设备。
Method: 提出 IPW（task accuracy per unit of power）作为跨模型-加速器配置的统一指标，并对 20+ 个最新本地 LM、8 种本地与云硬件加速器、100 万条真实单轮对话与推理查询进行系统评估，逐查询测量本地模型对前沿模型的胜率、能量、延迟和功率，同时进行 2023-2025 年的纵向分析。
Result: 三项关键结果：本地 LM 正确回答 88.7% 查询且准确率因领域而异；IPW 在 2023-2025 年间提升 5.3 倍，本地可服务查询覆盖率从 23.2% 升至 71.3%；本地加速器在相同模型上的 IPW 比云加速器至少低 1.4 倍，说明本地硬件仍有显著优化空间。
Conclusion: 作者认为本地推理能在相当一部分查询上有效分担集中式基础设施的压力，IPW 是追踪这一转变的关键指标。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: In Situ Training of Implicit Neural Compressors for Scientific Simulations via Sketch-Based Regularization
papers.abstract_en: Focusing on implicit neural representations, we present a novel in situ training protocol that employs limited memory buffers of full and sketched data samples, where the sketched data are leveraged to prevent catastrophic forgetting. The theoretical motivation for our use of sketching as a regularizer is presented via a simple Johnson-Lindenstrauss-informed result. While our methods may be of wider interest in the field of continual learning, we specifically target in situ neural compression using implicit neural representation-based hypernetworks. We evaluate our method on a variety of complex simulation data in two and three dimensions, over long time horizons, and across unstructured grids and non-Cartesian geometries. On these tasks, we show strong reconstruction performance at high compression rates. Most importantly, we demonstrate that sketching enables the presented in situ scheme to approximately match the performance of the equivalent offline method.
papers.journal_ref: Journal of Computational Physics, Volume 566, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于 sketching 正则化的原位训练协议，用于基于隐式神经表征（INR）的超网络求解器，在有限内存缓冲区中同时保存全量数据和 sketched 数据样本，以缓解灾难性遗忘。作者通过一个简单的 Johnson-Lindenstrauss 型结果给出 sketching 作为正则化器的理论动机，并在二维/三维复杂模拟数据、长时间跨度、非结构化网格和非笛卡尔几何上评估。摘要报告该方法在高压缩率下重建性能强，且 sketching 使原位方案接近等效离线方法的性能。
Motivation: 科学模拟数据的原位（in situ）神经压缩面临有限内存和持续数据流场景下灾难性遗忘的问题，需要一种不依赖存储全部历史数据的训练策略。
Method: 提出一种原位训练协议，使用有限内存缓冲区保存全量数据和 sketched 数据，其中 sketched 数据被用作正则化项以防止遗忘；理论分析基于 Johnson-Lindenstrauss 型结果，目标模型为基于 INR 的超网络（hypernetwork）神经压缩器。
Result: 在多种二维和三维复杂模拟数据、长时间跨度和非结构化/非笛卡尔几何上，该方法在高压缩率下取得强重建性能，并且 sketching 使原位方案与离线方法的性能近似匹配。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 sketching 作为正则化手段能有效缓解灾难性遗忘，使原位神经压缩接近离线性能，并指出方法可能对持续学习（continual learning）领域具有更广泛的意义。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Defining Energy Indicators for Impact Identification on Aerospace Composites: A Structured Feature Selection Approach Guided by Domain Knowledge
papers.abstract_en: Energy estimation is critical to impact identification on aerospace composites, where low-velocity impacts can induce internal damage that is undetectable at the surface. Data sparsity, signal noise, complex feature interdependencies, non-linear dynamics, massive design spaces, and the ill-posed nature of the inverse problem often constrain current methodologies for energy prediction. Machine learning enriched with prior knowledge is a promising direction for overcoming these constraints. Prior knowledge can be incorporated by acting on the input space, where the choice of data representation directly influences how effectively the model relates measured signals to impact energy. Despite its importance, the selection of effective features lacks a systematic procedure, with no consensus on how to choose among the many candidate descriptors available. The present study addresses that gap through a structured workflow that designs the input space using domain knowledge. Features are extracted from the time, frequency, and time-frequency domains, then filtered for statistical significance, correlation, dimensionality reduction, and robustness to noise. Exploratory data analysis further relates the retained descriptors to the dynamics. The resulting indicators form the input space for a fully connected neural network, which is trained and validated on experimental data from multiple impact scenarios, including pristine and damaged states. The model reduces the prediction error by a factor of three relative to conventional time-series techniques and purely data-driven baselines, while every retained or discarded descriptor remains traceable to the aspect it describes. Overall, the framework advances predictive performance, interpretability, and diagnostic confidence by embedding domain knowledge through targeted feature selection.
papers.comment: revised framing from physics-informed to structured feature selection guided by domain knowledge, with greater emphasis on the link to impact dynamics; strengthened comparison with black-box CNN on traceability, interpretability, and model validation; results unchanged
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对航空复合材料冲击识别中的能量估计问题，提出一个以领域知识指导的结构化特征选择流程来设计输入空间。特征从时域、频域和时频域提取，再经过统计显著性、相关性、降维和噪声鲁棒性筛选；保留的描述符作为全连接神经网络的输入，并在包含完好与损伤状态的多场景实验数据上训练验证。摘要报告预测误差相比传统时间序列技术和纯数据驱动基线降低为原来的三分之一，且每个保留或剔除的描述符都可追溯。
Motivation: 在航空航天复合材料中，低速冲击可能导致表面不可见的内部损伤，能量估计至关重要；而数据稀疏、信号噪声、特征间复杂依赖、非线性动力学、庞大设计空间以及逆问题的病态性限制了现有方法。当前缺乏系统化的特征选择流程，领域知识如何通过输入空间设计融入模型尚未达成共识。
Method: 提出结构化工作流：从时域、频域和时频域提取候选特征，依次进行统计显著性检验、相关性过滤、维度约简以及对噪声的鲁棒性评估；探索性数据分析进一步将保留的描述符与冲击动力学联系起来，最终构成全连接神经网络的输入。
Result: 在包含完好与损伤状态的多冲击场景实验数据上，模型将预测误差相对于传统时间序列技术和纯数据驱动基线降低约三倍；同时所有保留或剔除的描述符均保持对所述物理方面的可追溯性。
Conclusion: 作者认为，通过针对性的特征选择嵌入领域知识，该框架同时提升了预测性能、可解释性和诊断置信度；其适用范围为航空复合材料冲击识别中的能量估计。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: UniREditBench: A Unified Reasoning-based Image Editing Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in multi-modal generative models have driven substantial improvements in image editing. However, current generative models still struggle with handling diverse and complex image editing tasks that require implicit reasoning, underscoring the need for a comprehensive benchmark to systematically assess their performance across various reasoning scenarios. Existing benchmarks primarily focus on single-object attribute transformation in realistic scenarios, which, while effective, encounter two key challenges: (1) they largely overlook multi-object interactions as well as game-world scenarios that involve human-defined rules, which are common in real-life applications; (2) they only rely on textual references to evaluate the generated images, potentially leading to systematic misjudgments, especially in complex reasoning scenarios. To this end, this work proposes UniREditBench, a unified benchmark for reasoning-based image editing evaluation. It comprises 2,700 meticulously curated samples, covering both real- and game-world scenarios across 8 primary dimensions and 18 sub-dimensions. To improve evaluation reliability, we introduce multimodal dual-reference evaluation, providing both textual and ground-truth image references for each sample assessment. Furthermore, we design an automated multi-scenario data synthesis pipeline and construct UniREdit-Data-100K, a large-scale synthetic dataset with high-quality chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning annotations. We fine-tune Bagel on this dataset and develop UniREdit-Bagel, demonstrating substantial improvements in both in-domain and out-of-distribution settings. Through thorough benchmarking of both open-source and closed-source image editing models, we reveal their strengths and weaknesses across various aspects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出面向推理式图像编辑的统一评测基准 UniREditBench，包含 2700 个精心筛选的样本，覆盖真实世界与游戏世界场景，并设置 8 个主维度和 18 个子维度。为提升评测可靠性，作者引入文本与真值图像的多模态双参考评估。此外，文中设计了自动化多场景数据合成流程，构建带高质量思维链（CoT）注释的大规模合成数据集 UniREdit-Data-100K，并用其微调 Bagel 得到 UniREdit-Bagel。基于该基准对开源与闭源编辑模型的系统性评测揭示了各模型在不同维度上的优缺点。
Motivation: 现有图像编辑基准大多聚焦于真实场景中的单对象属性变换，忽视了多对象交互以及包含人为规则的游戏世界场景；同时这些基准仅依赖文本参考评估生成图像，在复杂推理场景下容易产生系统性误判。因此需要覆盖多种推理场景的统一评测基准。
Method: 构建 UniREditBench，包含 2700 个样本，覆盖真实与游戏世界场景，并设计多模态双参考评估，为每个样本同时提供文本参考和真值图像参考。作者还提出自动化多场景数据合成流程，生成含高质量思维链（CoT）推理注释的合成数据集 UniREdit-Data-100K，并使用该数据集微调 Bagel 得到 UniREdit-Bagel。
Result: UniREdit-Bagel 在域内和域外设置上相比基线的图像编辑能力均有显著提升；对开源和闭源图像编辑模型的系统基准测试展示了它们在不同推理场景下的优势与不足。
Conclusion: 摘要强调统一的多场景推理式编辑基准以及多模态双参考评估能够提高评测可靠性，并且高质量 CoT 注释的合成数据可以有效改进模型编辑表现。该基准可用于细粒度地刻画现有编辑模型的能力边界。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Iterative Training of Physics-Informed Neural Networks with Fourier-enhanced Features
papers.abstract_en: Spectral bias, the tendency of neural networks to learn low-frequency features first, is a well-known issue with many training algorithms for physics-informed neural networks (PINNs). To overcome this issue, we propose IFeF-PINN, an algorithm for iterative training of PINNs with Fourier-enhanced features. The key idea is to enrich the latent space using high-frequency components through Random Fourier Features. This creates a two-stage training problem: (i) estimate a basis in the feature space, and (ii) perform regression to determine the coefficients of the enhanced basis functions. For an underlying linear model, it is shown that the latter problem is convex, and we prove that the iterative training scheme converges. Furthermore, we empirically establish that Random Fourier Features enhance the expressive capacity of the network, enabling accurate approximation of high-frequency PDEs. Through extensive numerical evaluation on classical benchmark problems, the superior performance of our method over state-of-the-art algorithms is shown, and the improved approximation across the frequency domain is illustrated.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IFeF-PINN，一种带傅里叶增强特征 (Fourier-enhanced features) 的迭代训练算法，用于缓解物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 的谱偏置 (spectral bias) 问题。核心做法是用随机傅里叶特征 (Random Fourier Features) 向隐空间注入高频成分，将训练拆成特征空间基估计与增强基函数系数回归两个阶段。作者证明在底层线性模型下系数回归问题凸且迭代收敛，并在经典基准上展示优于现有方法的精度和频率域近似质量。
Motivation: PINN 训练常受谱偏置影响，神经网络倾向于先学习低频特征，导致高频 PDE 解难以被准确近似；该问题制约 PINN 对含高频成分物理问题的适用性。
Method: 提出 IFeF-PINN 迭代训练框架：利用随机傅里叶特征丰富隐空间的高频信息，形成两阶段问题——先在特征空间估计基，再对增强基函数的系数做回归，并以迭代方式交替求解。
Result: 在底层线性模型下证明了系数回归问题的凸性及迭代训练方案的收敛性；数值实验显示该方法在经典基准问题上优于当前最优算法，并在频率域上获得更好的近似效果。

papers.title: Mean-square and sublinear convergence of a stochastic proximal point algorithm in metric spaces of nonpositive curvature
papers.abstract_en: We define a stochastic variant of the proximal point algorithm in the general setting of nonlinear Hadamard spaces for approximating zeros of the mean of a stochastically perturbed monotone vector field. Generalizing previous work by P. Bianchi, we prove the convergence of this method under a suitable strong monotonicity assumption in (separable) Hilbert-Hadamard spaces, that is assuming that all tangent spaces isometrically embed into Hilbert spaces (covering, but not being limited to, the setting of Hadamard manifolds). Moreover, our convergence proof is fully effective and allows for the construction of explicit rates of convergence for the iteration towards the (unique) solution both in mean and almost surely. These rates are moreover highly uniform, being independent of most data surrounding the iteration, space or distribution. In that generality, these rates are novel already in the context of Hilbert spaces. Sublinear nonasymptotic guarantees under additional second-moment conditions on the Yosida approximates and special cases of stochastic convex minimization are discussed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在一般非线性 Hadamard 空间中定义了随机近端点算法 (stochastic proximal point algorithm) 的变体，用于逼近随机扰动单调向量场均值的零点。作者推广了 P. Bianchi 的先前工作，在（可分）Hilbert-Hadamard 空间中基于强单调性假设证明收敛，并给出完全有效的收敛证明。该证明能得到迭代向唯一解收敛的显式均值和几乎必然速率，且速率高度一致，在 Hilbert 空间情形下也具有新颖性。
Motivation: 现有随机近端点算法及其收敛性研究多局限于 Hilbert 空间或缺乏显式、一致的收敛速率，本文希望将此类算法推广到非线性 Hadamard 空间，并给出可计算的收敛保证。
Method: 提出 Hadamard 空间中随机近端点算法的随机变体，在将所有切空间等距嵌入 Hilbert 空间的 Hilbert-Hadamard 空间（覆盖但不限于 Hadamard 流形）中，借助强单调性假设建立有效收敛证明，并构造显式收敛速率。
Result: 证明了迭代在均值和几乎必然意义下以显式、高度一致的速率收敛到唯一解；这些速率在 Hilbert 空间情形下即为新结果。在 Yosida 近似满足额外二阶矩条件以及随机凸优化的特例下，还讨论了次线性非渐近保证。
Conclusion: 摘要强调其收敛证明是全有效的，所得速率对数据和空间的大多数细节不敏感；适用范围限于强单调性和 Hilbert-Hadamard 空间这一一般性框架。

papers.title: Stability of Transformers under Layer Normalization
papers.abstract_en: Despite their widespread use, training deep Transformers can be unstable. Layer normalization, a standard component, improves training stability, but its placement has often been ad-hoc. In this paper, we conduct a principled study on the forward (hidden states) and backward (gradient) stability of Transformers under different layer normalization placements. Our theory provides key insights into the training dynamics: whether training drives Transformers toward regular solutions or pathological behaviors. For forward stability, we derive explicit bounds on the growth of hidden states in trained Transformers. For backward stability, we analyze how layer normalization affects the backpropagation of gradients, thereby explaining the training dynamics of each layer normalization placement. Our analysis also guides the scaling of residual steps in Transformer blocks, where appropriate choices can further improve stability and performance. Our numerical results corroborate our theoretical findings. Beyond these results, our framework provides a principled way to sanity-check the stability of Transformers under new architectural modifications, offering guidance for future designs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从原理层面研究不同 layer normalization 放置对 Transformer 前向（隐藏状态）与反向（梯度）稳定性的影响，推导了已训练 Transformer 中隐藏状态增长的显式界，并分析归一化如何影响梯度反向传播，从而解释每种放置对应的训练动态。数值实验与理论结论一致，且指出残差步长的合适缩放能进一步提升稳定性与性能。
Motivation: 深度 Transformer 训练常不稳定，layer normalization 虽能改善训练稳定性，但其放置位置多数情况下是 ad-hoc 的，缺少系统性理论解释。
Method: 对不同 layer normalization 放置进行前向和反向稳定性分析，推导隐藏状态增长的显式边界，并考察归一化对梯度回传的作用；同时以该分析指导 Transformer 块中残差步骤的缩放选择。
Result: 摘要给出前向稳定性的显式界，并解释各层归一化放置下的训练动态；数值结果与理论发现一致，合适的残差步长缩放可进一步改善稳定性与性能。
Conclusion: 该框架为在架构修改下检验 Transformer 稳定性提供了原则性手段，可指导未来设计；摘要未涉及具体下游任务的应用验证。

papers.title: Provable Training Data Identification for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Identifying training data of large-scale models is critical for copyright litigation, privacy auditing, and ensuring fair evaluation. However, existing works typically treat this task as an instance-wise identification without controlling the error rate of the identified set, which cannot provide statistically reliable evidence. In this work, we formalize training data identification as a set-level inference problem and propose Provable Training Data Identification (PTDI), a distribution-free approach that enables provable and strict false identification rate control. Specifically, our method computes conformal p-values for each data point using a set of known unseen data and then develops a novel Jackknife-corrected Beta boundary (JKBB) estimator to estimate the training-data proportion of the test set, which allows us to scale these p-values. By applying the Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) procedure to the scaled p-values, we select a subset of data points with provable and strict false identification control. Extensive experiments across various models and datasets demonstrate that PTDI achieves higher power than prior methods while strictly controlling the FIR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将大语言模型的训练数据识别形式化为集合层面的推断问题，提出分布无关的 Provable Training Data Identification (PTDI) 方法。该方法利用一组已知的未训练数据为每个数据点计算 conformal p-values，并通过 Jackknife 校正的 Beta 边界 (JKBB) 估计测试集的训练数据比例来缩放 p-values，再应用 Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) 过程选取子集，从而实现可证明且严格控制的错误识别率 (false identification rate)。实验表明 PTDI 在多个模型和数据集上相比先前方法有更高检验功效 (power)，同时严格控制 FIR。
Motivation: 现有训练数据识别工作通常视为逐样本识别，不对识别结果集合的错误率加以控制，因此无法提供统计上可靠的证据；而可靠识别对于版权诉讼、隐私审计和公平评估至关重要。
Method: 作者将训练数据识别形式化为集合层面的推断问题，提出分布无关的 PTDI 方法：先使用已知未见数据计算各数据点的 conformal p-values，再提出 Jackknife 校正的 Beta 边界 (JKBB) 估计器估计训练数据比例，依此缩放 p-values，最后将缩放后的 p-values 输入 Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) 过程选择数据子集。
Result: 在多种模型和数据集上的大量实验表明，PTDI 相比先前方法取得更高的检验功效，同时严格控制错误识别率 (FIR)。
Conclusion: 论文的核心主张是通过集合级推断和分布无关的 p-values 程序，为大模型训练数据识别提供可证明且严格的错误率控制，从而获得统计上可靠的识别集合。

papers.title: PRTree: An R Package for Probabilistic Regression Trees with Built-in Missing Data Handling
papers.abstract_en: PRTree is an R package for fitting Probabilistic Regression Trees (PRTrees), a class of regression trees that replaces deterministic splits with probabilistic associations to produce smooth prediction functions. The package implements both the original methodology and its recent extension for handling missing predictor values, allowing model fitting and prediction directly from incomplete datasets without prior imputation. It provides a unified framework for model fitting, prediction, visualization, smoothing-parameter selection, cross-validation, and model diagnostics through a standard R interface. Computationally intensive routines are implemented in FORTRAN, while the high-level interface follows the usual R workflow based on S3 classes and generic methods. This paper reviews the underlying methodology, describes the software architecture and main package components, and illustrates their use through reproducible examples.
papers.comment: Associated R package PRTRee available on CRAN. Theoretical companion paper also available on ArXiv
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 PRTree，一个用于拟合概率回归树 (Probabilistic Regression Trees, PRTrees) 的 R 包。该类回归树用概率关联取代确定性分裂以产生平滑预测函数，并内置对缺失预测值的处理，可直接从不完整数据集中建模和预测，无需预先插补。软件包通过 S3 类和泛型方法提供建模、预测、可视化、平滑参数选择、交叉验证与模型诊断的统一 R 接口，计算密集部分用 FORTRAN 实现。文章还回顾了底层方法并给出可复现示例。
Motivation: 传统回归树的确定性分裂会使预测函数不连续，且处理缺失预测变量通常需要事先插补；该工作希望提供一种能直接处理缺失数据并生成平滑预测的回归树软件实现。
Method: PRTree 实现概率回归树方法，以概率关联替代确定性分裂，并纳入近期扩展以应对缺失预测值。软件架构上，计算密集例程用 FORTRAN 编写，高层接口遵循基于 S3 类和泛型函数的常规 R 工作流。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值实验，主要贡献是提供集成建模、预测、可视化、平滑参数选择、交叉验证和诊断的 R 包，并强调其可从含缺失数据的数据集直接拟合与预测。
Conclusion: 该论文倾向于软件与方法的综述性报告，描述 PRTree 包的设计和组件，并通过可复现示例展示使用方式；R 包已发布在 CRAN，并有理论配套论文。

papers.title: Optimization as a Dynamical System: Generative Schedules from Latent ODEs
papers.abstract_en: We present a new meta-learning method to determine the optimal learning rate schedule for gradient descent. It leverages training runs from a hyperparameter search to learn a latent representation of the training process, which is modeled as a dynamical system. Given current training metrics, it predicts the future learning rate schedule with the best long-term validation performance. Our scheduler generalizes beyond previously observed training dynamics and creates specialized schedules that deviate noticeably from even the best-performing parametric functions. It outperforms all baselines we compare to on results for image classification with CNN and ResNet models as well as for next-token prediction with a transformer model. The trained models are located in flatter regions of the loss landscape and thus provide better generalization than those trained with other schedules. Our method is computationally efficient, optimizer-agnostic, and can easily be layered on top of ML experiment-tracking platforms to streamline training of neural networks from scratch.
papers.comment: Accepted in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种元学习方法，将梯度下降的训练过程建模为潜空间中的动力学系统，从而学习最优学习率调度。它利用超参数搜索产生的训练轨迹学习潜表示，并根据当前训练指标预测能在长期验证性能上最优的未来学习率计划。在 CNN、ResNet 图像分类和 Transformer 下一词预测任务上，该方法优于所有对比基线，且训练出的模型位于损失景观更平坦的区域。
Motivation: 学习率调度对深度学习训练至关重要，但通常依赖手工设计或参数化函数，难以适应不同训练动态。作者希望直接从历史训练运行中学习一种能推广到未见训练过程的调度策略，而无需人工调整。
Method: 将训练过程视为动力学系统，使用潜 ODE (latent ODE) 在超参数搜索运行的轨迹上学习训练指标的潜表示；给定当前训练指标后，该方法生成具有最佳长期验证性能的未来学习率调度。该方法是优化器无关的，并可与 ML 实验追踪平台叠加使用。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在 CNN、ResNet 的图像分类以及 Transformer 的下一词预测任务上均优于所有对比基线，生成的调度明显偏离最优参数化函数；训练后的模型位于损失景观更平坦区域，从而获得更好的泛化。

papers.title: Evaluating Useful Surrogate Models for Configuration Tuning Beyond Accuracy: A Fitness Landscape Analysis Perspective
papers.abstract_en: To efficiently tune configuration for better software system performance (e.g., latency) at the deployment and maintenance stage, many tuners have leveraged a surrogate model to expedite the process instead of solely relying on the profoundly expensive system measurement. As such, it is naturally believed that we need more accurate models. However, the fact of "accuracy can lie"-a somewhat surprising finding from prior work-has left us many unanswered questions regarding what role the surrogate model plays in configuration tuning. This paper provides the very first systematic exploration and discussion, together with a resolution proposal, to disclose the many faces of useful surrogate models for configuration tuning beyond accuracy, through the novel perspective of fitness landscape analysis. We present a theory as an alternative to accuracy for assessing the model usefulness in tuning, based on which we conduct an extensive empirical study involving up to 27,000 cases. Drawing on the above, we propose Model4Tune, an automated predictive tool that estimates which model-tuner pairs are the best for an unforeseen system without expensive tuner profiling. Our results suggest that Model4Tune, as one of the first of its kind, performs significantly better than random guessing in 79%-82% of the cases, hence greatly mitigating the required efforts in engineering configuration for software systems. Our results not only shed light on the possible future research directions but also offer a practical resolution that can assist practitioners in evaluating the most useful model for configuration tuning.
papers.comment: This paper is accepted by TOSEM
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次从适应度景观分析 (fitness landscape analysis) 视角系统研究配置调优中替代模型 (surrogate model) 的效用问题。作者提出一个替代准确率 (accuracy) 的模型有用性评估理论，并基于多达 27,000 个案例的实证研究提出 Model4Tune，一个无需昂贵调优器评测即可预测最优 model-tuner 组合的自动化工具。结果表明 Model4Tune 在 79%-82% 的案例中显著优于随机猜测，论文已被 TOSEM 接收。
Motivation: 以往工作发现‘准确率可能具有欺骗性’(accuracy can lie)，即更准确的替代模型并不一定带来更好的调优效果，但其中的原因和替代模型在配置调优中的真实作用尚不清楚。
Method: 采用适应度景观分析视角，先提出一个替代准确率、用于评估模型在调优中有用性的理论，再基于大规模经验研究构建 Model4Tune 自动化预测工具，用于为未知系统估计最优的模型-调优器组合而无须进行昂贵的调优器评测。
Result: 经验研究覆盖多达 27,000 个案例；Model4Tune 作为同类首创工具，在 79%-82% 的案例中显著优于随机猜测，从而减轻软件系统配置工程所需的工作量。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作既指明未来研究方向，也为从业者评估配置调优中最有用的替代模型提供了务实解决方案。

papers.title: Robot guide with multi-agent control and automatic scenario generation with LLM
papers.abstract_en: The article describes the development of a hybrid social robot control architecture to overcome the limitations of traditional approaches, where behavior scripts manually synchronize the robot's actions and text, and existing methods focus primarily on short dialogue responses. The architecture of the proposed system combines a multi-agent resource management system with automatic generation of behavior scenarios based on large language models. This system automates the preparation of text and commands for the robot's non-verbal behavior for extended narratives and resolves resource conflicts between multiple execution mechanisms. The system was tested on the MENTOR-1 tour guide robot, for which it successfully generated scenarios automatically and demonstrated more natural and rich behavior compared to existing approaches. The proposed approach provides full automation of both scenario preparation and execution through efficient resource management, enhancing the quality of social robot interaction in long-term storytelling tasks.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables, 1 demo-video and repository link. There were major changes: an introduction, a review, and a new experiment. Some tables and figures have also been changed
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合社交机器人控制架构，将多智能体资源管理系统与基于大语言模型的自动行为场景生成相结合，以克服传统脚本手动同步动作与文本、以及现有方法仅聚焦短对话响应的局限。系统在MENTOR-1导览机器人上测试，能够自动生成场景并表现出比现有方法更自然和丰富的行为。
Motivation: 传统社交机器人依赖手动编写的脚本同步动作和文本，且已有方法主要处理短对话响应，难以支持长时间叙述和多执行机制间的资源冲突。
Method: 提出混合架构：由多智能体资源管理系统负责调度，结合LLM自动生成行为场景，自动准备文本与非语言行为命令，并解决多个执行机制之间的资源冲突。
Result: 系统在MENTOR-1导览机器人上成功自动生成场景，相比现有方法展现出更自然和丰富的行为。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方案实现了场景准备与执行的完全自动化，通过高效资源管理提升社交机器人在长期叙事任务中的交互质量。

papers.title: Learning to Walk With Less: A Dyna-Style Approach to Quadrupedal Locomotion
papers.abstract_en: Traditional on-policy reinforcement learning (RL) controllers for quadrupedal locomotion often suffer from low data efficiency, requiring millions of interactions with simulated environments to achieve stable control. We integrate model-based techniques that improve sample efficiency by augmenting PPO rollouts with synthetic data in a Dyna-style framework. Our method employs a learned transition model to generate short-horizon synthetic tails for each trajectory, anchored by physics-based simulation to preserve stability. A predefined scheduling strategy gradually integrates synthetic transitions, preventing model usage during early training stages when prediction accuracy is low. Through extensive ablation studies, we analyze how varying data parameters influence PPO's learning behavior. Finally, we validate our method in simulation on a Unitree Go1 robot, reaching convergence with substantially fewer simulation steps (19.64M vs. 27.53M) and a 12.24% reduction in wall-clock training time, without compromising policy performance or convergence. Cross-platform experiments on ANYmal and Unitree Go2 further confirm the framework's ability to learn high-dimensional locomotion control with substantially reduced simulation experience, despite reward trade-offs on complex morphologies.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Access. 13 pages, 10 figures, 8 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种Dyna风格的模型辅助PPO训练框架用于四足机器人运动控制，通过学习到的转移模型为每个轨迹生成短视合成尾部（synthetic tails），并以物理仿真锚定稳定性。在Unitree Go1上，该方法以19.64M仿真步数达到收敛，相比基线27.53M显著减少，墙钟训练时间降低12.24%，且不损害策略性能；在ANYmal和Unitree Go2上的跨平台实验也确认了其能以大幅减少的仿真经验学习高维运动控制，但复杂形态存在奖励权衡。
Motivation: 传统的on-policy强化学习控制（如PPO）在四足运动控制中数据效率低，需要数百万次仿真交互才能实现稳定控制，导致训练成本高。论文旨在通过整合模型基于技术来提升样本效率。
Method: 采用Dyna风格框架，用学习到的转移模型为PPO的rollout生成短视合成轨迹尾部，并以物理仿真锚定以避免不稳定；通过预定义的调度策略逐步引入合成转移，避免在早期预测精度低时使用模型；并进行消融研究分析不同数据参数对PPO学习行为的影响。
Result: 在Unitree Go1仿真中，收敛所需仿真步数从27.53M降至19.64M，墙钟训练时间减少12.24%，策略性能或收敛性没有妥协；ANYmal和Unitree Go2上的跨平台实验进一步证实框架能以显著更少的仿真经验学习高维运动控制，尽管在复杂形态上出现奖励权衡。
Conclusion: 摘要强调Dyna式模型辅助PPO能够大幅提升四足运动控制的数据效率，但复杂形态下存在奖励权衡，需要进一步关注。

papers.title: Symbolic Graphics Programming with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) excel at program synthesis, yet their ability to produce symbolic graphics programs (SGPs) that render into precise visual content remains underexplored. We study symbolic graphics programming, where the goal is to generate an SGP from a natural-language description. This task also serves as a lens into how LLMs understand the visual world by prompting them to generate images rendered from SGPs. Among various SGPs, our paper sticks to scalable vector graphics (SVGs). We begin by examining the extent to which LLMs can generate SGPs. To this end, we introduce SGP-GenBench, a comprehensive benchmark covering object fidelity, scene fidelity, and compositionality (attribute binding, spatial relations, numeracy). On SGP-GenBench, we discover that frontier proprietary models substantially outperform open-source models, and performance correlates well with general coding capabilities. Motivated by this gap, we aim to improve LLMs' ability to generate SGPs. We propose a reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards approach, where a format-validity gate ensures renderable SVG, and a cross-modal reward aligns text and the rendered image via strong vision encoders (e.g., SigLIP for text-image and DINO for image-image). Applied to Qwen-2.5-7B, our method substantially improves SVG generation quality and semantics, achieving performance on par with frontier systems. We further analyze training dynamics, showing that RL induces (i) finer decomposition of objects into controllable primitives and (ii) contextual details that improve scene coherence. Our results demonstrate that symbolic graphics programming offers a precise and interpretable lens on cross-modal grounding.
papers.comment: Accepted by Transactions on Machine Learning Research. (32 pages, 12 figures.) This version refines the paper structure, adds experimental results. Project page: https://spherelab.ai/SGP-Gen/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型（LLM）从自然语言描述生成符号图形程序（SGP，具体为可缩放矢量图形 SVG）的能力，并引入综合基准 SGP-GenBench，覆盖对象保真度、场景保真度与组合性（属性绑定、空间关系、数数）。作者发现前沿专有模型显著优于开源模型，且该能力与通用编程能力相关；随后提出带可验证奖励的强化学习（RL）方法，用格式有效性门控保证可渲染 SVG，并用跨模态奖励（SigLIP 做文本-图像、DINO 做图像-图像）对齐文本与渲染图像。将该方法应用于 Qwen-2.5-7B，SVG 生成质量与语义显著提升，达到与前沿系统相当的水平。
Motivation: LLM 擅长程序合成，但从自然语言生成能渲染为精确视觉内容的符号图形程序（SGP）这一能力尚未被充分探索；该任务也可作为理解 LLM 如何通过生成图像来理解视觉世界的透镜。
Method: 提出 SGP-GenBench 基准评估 LLM 的 SVG 生成能力；并提出带可验证奖励的强化学习（RL）方法，其中格式有效性门控（format-validity gate）确保输出的 SVG 可渲染，跨模态奖励通过强视觉编码器（SigLIP 用于文本-图像对齐，DINO 用于图像-图像对齐）将文本与渲染图像对齐，应用于 Qwen-2.5-7B 模型。
Result: 在 SGP-GenBench 上，前沿专有模型显著优于开源模型，性能与通用编程能力密切相关；所提 RL 方法使 Qwen-2.5-7B 的 SVG 生成质量与语义大幅提升，达到与前沿系统相当的性能；训练动态分析显示 RL 促使对象更细粒度地分解为可控图元，并引入提升场景一致性的上下文细节。
Conclusion: 符号图形编程为跨模态接地（cross-modal grounding）提供了一个精确且可解释的研究视角，表明该任务是检验和提升 LLM 视觉理解与程序生成能力的有效途径。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: Optimization-based Online Conformal Prediction for Multi-step Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Conformal prediction (CP) provides distribution-free coverage guarantees, making it well suited for uncertainty quantification in time series forecasting. However, existing methods often struggle with multi-step settings: they either calibrate horizons independently---ignoring temporal correlations---or enforce strict simultaneous coverage, resulting in overly conservative intervals. In this work, we propose O$^2$CP: Optimization-Based Online Conformal Prediction, a framework that augments a broad family of online CP methods with cross-horizon optimization while preserving their long-term coverage guarantees. We first characterize this family of methods, showing that long-term coverage is preserved as long as, at each forecast horizon, the selected control variable remains within an admissible set around the method's nominal output. Building on this result, O$^2$CP uses a two-layer design: the first layer constructs these admissible sets from the underlying online CP updates, and the second performs constrained optimization across horizons within them, jointly modeling the cross-horizon distributions to minimize a user-specified objective. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets---including autonomous driving, climate forecasting, and public health---demonstrate that O$^2$CP consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving target coverage with significantly sharper prediction intervals and reduced regret over long horizons.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 O$^2$CP（Optimization-Based Online Conformal Prediction），一种为多步时间序列预测设计的在线 conformal prediction 框架，在保留长期覆盖保证的同时引入跨时间步（cross-horizon）优化。方法采用两层设计：第一层从在线 CP 更新构造 admissible sets，第二层在这些集合内执行跨 horizon 的约束优化，以联合建模跨 horizon 分布并最小化用户指定目标。在自动驾驶、气候预测和公共卫生等真实数据集上的实验显示，该方法在达到目标覆盖率的同时产生更尖锐（sharper）的预测区间并降低长期 regret。
Motivation: 现有 conformal prediction 在多步预测中面临两难：要么逐 horizon 独立校准而忽略时间相关性，要么强制严格的 simultaneous coverage 导致区间过度保守。缺少一种既能保持长期覆盖保证、又能利用跨 horizon 信息提升区间效率的方法。
Method: 先刻画一族在线 CP 方法，证明只要每个预测 horizon 上选定的控制变量保持在围绕该方法名义输出的 admissible set 内，长期覆盖性质就得以保留；在此基础上，O$^2$CP 采用两层结构，第一层由底层在线 CP 更新构造 admissible sets，第二层在集合内执行跨 horizon 的约束优化，联合建模跨 horizon 分布以最小化用户指定目标。
Result: 在包含自动驾驶、气候预测和公共卫生的真实数据集上的大量实验中，O$^2$CP 一致优于 state-of-the-art 基线，以更尖锐的预测区间达到目标覆盖率，并在长 horizon 上取得更低的 regret。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，在保持家庭级在线 CP 方法长期覆盖保证的前提下，跨 horizon 优化可以显著改善多步预测区间的 sharpness 与 regret。该方法面向一般多步预测场景，气候预测仅是其中一个应用域。
Relevance: 65

papers.title: Pay Attention to Attention Distribution: A New Local Lipschitz Bound for Transformers
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a novel upper bound on the local Lipschitz constant of the dot-product self-attention block showing its dependence on the attention map distributions. The proposed bound is not only tighter than the prior art, but for the first time, reveals how the distribution of attention probabilities shapes the local Lipschitz constant of the self-attention block. The theoretical basis of the proposed upper bound lies in the refined closed-form upper bounds on singular values of the Jacobian of softmax function. Leveraging these theoretical insights, we introduce JaSMin (Jacobian Softmax norm Minimization), a lightweight regularizer that directly controls the local Lipschitz constant of each block and, consequently, the entire model. Additionally, we discuss how the nature of the attention map distribution contributes to the gradient dynamics and, consequently, transformer training stability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的点积自注意力模块局部 Lipschitz 常数上界，该上界依赖于注意力图分布，且比现有结果更紧。理论基础是 softmax 函数 Jacobian 奇异值的改进闭式上界。作者据此引入轻量正则化器 JaSMin（Jacobian Softmax norm Minimization）来直接控制每个模块乃至整个模型的局部 Lipschitz 常数，并讨论了注意力图分布对梯度动力学与 Transformer 训练稳定性的影响。
Motivation: 已有 Transformer 的 Lipschitz 上界不够紧，且未揭示注意力分布如何影响局部 Lipschitz 常数；理解这种关系对分析训练稳定性具有重要意义。
Method: 从 softmax Jacobian 奇异值的精细闭式上界出发，推导依赖注意力图分布的自注意力块局部 Lipschitz 常数上界；并基于该理论提出轻量正则化器 JaSMin，用于直接约束各模块的局部 Lipschitz 常数。
Result: 摘要声称新上界比先前工作更紧，并首次揭示注意力概率分布如何塑造自注意力块的局部 Lipschitz 常数；JaSMin 可将该控制扩展到整个模型。
Conclusion: 注意力图分布的性质影响梯度动力学和 Transformer 训练稳定性，本文为直接控制模型局部 Lipschitz 常数提供了新的理论依据和正则化工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MotionStrata: Hierarchical Motion Latents for Compact Video Autoencoding
papers.abstract_en: First-frame-conditioned video autoencoders represent a clip with persistent content and a compact motion code. Although this removes much of the appearance redundancy, the remaining motion is typically compressed with a homogeneous latent geometry. Such representations use the same temporal support for broad scene evolution and fine-grained, frame-specific details. We introduce MotionStrata, which organizes a fixed motion budget into Global Motion and Detailed Motion. Temporally compressed Global queries summarize broad evolution, whereas frame-aligned Detailed queries preserve fine-grained structures whose configuration varies across frames. Frequency-guided routing and coarse-to-fine training establish this hierarchy without increasing motion dimensionality. Experiments show that MotionStrata maintains high reconstruction quality under aggressive compression and outperforms uniform and alternative grouped representations. Additional experiments evaluate hierarchical representation, downstream generation, and decoding cost. These results support hierarchical motion organization as a useful design principle for compact video autoencoding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MotionStrata，一种面向首帧条件视频自编码器的分层运动潜在表示方法。它将固定的运动预算划分为 Global Motion 与 Detailed Motion，前者用时间压缩的全局查询概括场景整体演化，后者用与帧对齐的详细查询保留帧间变化的细粒度结构，并通过频率引导路由和由粗到细训练建立层次，且不增加运动维度。摘要报告该方法在激进压缩下保持高重建质量，并优于均匀及替代分组表示。
Motivation: 现有首帧条件视频自编码器虽然去除了大量外观冗余，但剩余运动通常用同质潜在几何（homogeneous latent geometry）压缩，即用相同的时间支持同时表示广泛的场景演化和帧级细粒度细节，缺乏结构区分。
Method: MotionStrata 将运动表示组织为全局运动（Global Motion）和细节运动（Detailed Motion）两个层次：时间压缩的全局查询负责整体演化，帧对齐的详细查询负责随帧变化的细粒度结构；采用频率引导路由（frequency-guided routing）和由粗到细训练（coarse-to-fine training）建立此层次，而不增加运动表示的维度。
Result: 实验表明 MotionStrata 在激进压缩下保持较高的重建质量，并优于均匀表示及替代的分组表示；此外还评估了层次表示、下游生成任务和解码成本。
Conclusion: 作者认为分层运动组织（hierarchical motion organization）可作为紧凑视频自编码（compact video autoencoding）的一个有用设计原则。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Minimal Ingredients for Reward Assignment from Expert Demonstrations
papers.abstract_en: Reward assignment from scarce demonstrations is a key challenge in both offline and online imitation learning. A common and intuitive strategy assigns rewards according to how closely learner trajectories match expert demonstrations. Although this principle underlies many existing methods, the core ingredients that drive performance remain systematically underexplored. We therefore ask: what is the minimal structure that reward assignment must encode to achieve effective downstream RL performance across settings? We approach this question along two design axes: proximity approximation and temporal alignment. Across 32 benchmarks spanning offline and online settings, and with three downstream RL algorithms, our empirical findings suggest: (1) In offline regimes, proximity alone captures the reward structure necessary for effective offline RL, while (2) lightweight temporal correspondence provides consistent gains that are modest offline but essential online or in the presence of multiple demonstrations. We further complement our offline results with a lightweight theory characterizing when simple proximity approximation suffices. Overall, these findings advocate algorithmic minimalism in reward design before introducing complex schemes in both offline and online imitation learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究从稀缺专家演示中进行奖励分配（reward assignment）所需的最小结构，沿邻近近似（proximity approximation）与时间对齐（temporal alignment）两个设计轴展开。在覆盖离线和在线设置的32个基准上、配合三种下游RL算法，作者发现离线场景下仅邻近性就足以获得有效奖励结构，而轻量级时间对应（temporal correspondence）在在线或多个演示时至关重要。作者还给出刻画简单邻近近似何时充分的理论结果，主张奖励设计应追求算法简约。
Motivation: 现有模仿学习方法普遍依据学习轨迹与专家演示的匹配程度分配奖励，但驱动性能的核心成分未被系统研究；作者希望明确奖励分配必须编码的最小结构，以指导离线和在线模仿学习的奖励设计。
Method: 沿两个设计轴（邻近近似和时间对齐）系统比较奖励分配方案；在32个基准上覆盖离线和在线设置，并用三种下游RL算法验证；对离线结果补充了一个刻画简单邻近近似何时足够的轻量级理论。
Result: 离线条件下，仅邻近近似即可捕获离线RL所需的奖励结构；轻量级时间对应在离线时增益适度，但在在线设置或存在多个演示时不可或缺。实证基于32个基准和三种下游RL算法。
Conclusion: 作者主张在引入复杂奖励机制前先采用算法简约的奖励设计，并强调简单邻近近似在离线场景的充分性；在线或多样化演示场景则需要时间对齐信息。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Improving Performance of Spike-based Deep Q-Learning using Ternary Neurons
papers.abstract_en: We propose a new ternary spiking neuron model to improve the representation capacity of binary spiking neurons in deep Q-learning. Although a ternary neuron model has recently been introduced to overcome the limited representation capacity offered by the binary spiking neurons, we show that its performance is worse than that of binary models in deep Q-learning tasks. We hypothesize gradient estimation bias during the training process as the underlying potential cause through mathematical and empirical analysis. We propose a novel ternary spiking neuron model to mitigate this issue by reducing the estimation bias. We use the proposed ternary spiking neuron as the fundamental computing unit in a deep spiking Q-learning network (DSQN) and evaluate the network's performance in seven Atari games from the Gym environment. Results show that the proposed ternary spiking neuron mitigates the drastic performance degradation of ternary neurons in Q-learning tasks and improves the network performance compared to the existing binary neurons, making DSQN a more practical solution for on-board autonomous decision-making tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的三元尖峰神经元（ternary spiking neuron）模型，用于提升深度Q学习中二进制尖峰神经元的表示能力。作者发现已有三元神经元模型在深度Q学习任务中性能反而差于二进制模型，并通过数学和实证分析将原因归于训练过程中的梯度估计偏差（gradient estimation bias）。新模型被用作深度尖峰Q学习网络（DSQN）的基本计算单元，在Gym的七个Atari游戏上验证了效果。
Motivation: 二进制尖峰神经元的表示容量有限，而新引入的三元神经元模型虽然在一般场景下提升容量，但在深度Q学习任务中性能比二进制模型更差，需要解决这一性能退化问题。
Method: 提出一种新的三元尖峰神经元模型，通过降低训练过程中的梯度估计偏差来缓解已有三元模型的性能退化，并将其作为DSQN的基本计算单元进行端到端训练。
Result: 在Gym环境的七个Atari游戏上评估DSQN，结果显示所提出的三元尖峰神经元缓解了三元神经元在Q学习任务中的剧烈性能退化，并且网络性能优于使用现有二进制神经元的版本。
Conclusion: 作者认为改进后的DSQN使尖峰Q学习网络更适合机载自主决策（on-board autonomous decision-making）任务，但其适用范围局限于摘要中报告的Atari基准场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Serious Games: Human-AI Interaction, Evolution, and Coevolution
papers.abstract_en: The serious games between humans and AI have only just begun. Evolutionary Game Theory (EGT) models the competitive and cooperative strategies of biological entities. EGT could help predict the potential evolutionary equilibrium of humans and AI. The objective of this work was to examine EGT models relevant to human-AI interaction, evolution, and co-evolution. Of thirteen EGT models considered, three were examined: the Hawk-Dove Game, Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma, and the War of Attrition. This selection was based on the widespread acceptance and clear relevance of these models to potential human-AI evolutionary dynamics and co-evolutionary trajectories. The Hawk-Dove Game predicts balanced mixed-strategy equilibria based on the costs of conflict. Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma suggests that repeated interaction may lead to cognitive co-evolution. The War of Attrition suggests that competition for resources may result in strategic co-evolution, asymmetric equilibria, and conventions on sharing resources. Each model was examined from the perspective of human and AI decision-making, from psychological and biological perspectives, and from an AI viewpoint. AI is being shaped by human input and is evolving in response to it. So too, neuroplasticity allows the human brain to evolve in response to stimuli. If humans and AI converge in future, what might be the result of human neuroplasticity combined with an ever-evolving AI? There are profound ethical and cognitive implications. EGT may provide a suitable framework to understand and predict human-AI interaction, evolution, and co-evolution. However, future research should extend beyond EGT and explore additional frameworks, empirical validation methods, and interdisciplinary perspectives. In the spirit of further exploration, an illustrative computational simulation is provided.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从演化博弈论 (Evolutionary Game Theory, EGT) 视角分析人类与 AI 之间的交互、演化与共演化。作者从 13 个 EGT 模型中选出 Hawk-Dove Game、Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma 和 War of Attrition 三个模型，分别从人类决策、心理与生物学视角以及 AI 视角进行考察，并提供一个示例性计算模拟。摘要认为 EGT 可为理解与预测人机演化动态提供框架，但未来需结合其他框架、实证验证与跨学科视角。
Motivation: 人类与 AI 之间的严肃博弈刚刚开始，需要预测双方可能达成的演化均衡。作者希望借助 EGT 来刻画人与 AI 在竞争与合作中的演化动态及共演化轨迹。
Method: 综述性考察 13 个 EGT 模型，并重点分析 Hawk-Dove Game、Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma 和 War of Attrition 三个模型；每个模型都从人类决策、心理与生物学视角以及 AI 视角进行解读，另附一个例示性计算模拟。
Result: Hawk-Dove Game 预测基于冲突成本的均衡混合策略；Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma 提示重复互动可能促成认知共演化；War of Attrition 提示资源竞争可能导致策略共演化、非对称均衡与资源分享惯例。
Conclusion: EGT 可能为理解与预测人类-AI 交互、演化和共演化提供合适框架，并带来深刻的伦理与认知影响；但未来研究应扩展到 EGT 之外，探索额外框架、实证验证方法和跨学科视角。

papers.title: CHIME: A Case for Efficient Long-Context Attention-FC Disaggregated Inference with DIMM-PIM
papers.abstract_en: Attention-FC Disaggregated (AFD) LLM inference systems offload memory-bound Attention operations to memory-rich accelerators (e.g., CPUs, HBM-PIM) while retaining compute-bound Fully-Connected (FC) operations on GPUs. In this paper, we first design a Disaggregated Roofline Model (DRM) to characterize AFD performance, revealing that system throughput is constrained by the accelerator's limiting factor: either memory bandwidth or capacity. We observe that prior AFD systems often overlook these constraints and fail to balance them, leading to resource underutilization or constrained throughput. Therefore, we propose CHIME, the first AFD system integrating DIMM-PIM, which is a case of the new accelerator that strikes the balance with scalable capacity and bandwidth. To address the synchronization challenges inherent to the distributed cooperating DRAM chips in DIMM-PIM, CHIME employs bubble-free pipelining and hybrid-grained re-layout for efficient attention computation. Furthermore, it maximizes cross-device resource utilization via rankset-granular communication-computation overlapping and alignment-predicting scheduling. Evaluations show CHIME achieves up to 5.15$\times$ speedup over state-of-the-art HBM-PIM solutions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 Attention-FC Disaggregated (AFD) 大语言模型推理系统，提出首个集成 DIMM-PIM 的 AFD 系统 CHIME。作者先设计了 Disaggregated Roofline Model (DRM) 来刻画 AFD 性能瓶颈，指出吞吐受限于加速器带宽或容量；CHIME 通过无气泡流水线 (bubble-free pipelining)、混合粒度重排、rankset 级通信计算重叠和对齐预测调度来解决 DIMM-PIM 的同步挑战。评估显示 CHIME 相比最先进的 HBM-PIM 方案最高可获 5.15 倍加速。
Motivation: 现有 AFD 系统将内存受限的 Attention 操作卸载到内存丰富的加速器（如 CPU、HBM-PIM），但往往忽视这些加速器在内存带宽或容量上的约束，导致资源利用率不足或吞吐受限。
Method: 提出 DRM 模型用于分析 AFD 性能瓶颈；设计 CHIME，首个集成 DIMM-PIM 的 AFD 系统，采用无气泡流水线和混合粒度重排实现高效 Attention 计算，并通过 rankset 粒度通信计算重叠和对齐预测调度最大化跨设备资源利用。
Result: 评估显示 CHIME 相对最先进的 HBM-PIM 方案最高实现 5.15 倍加速。
Conclusion: CHIME 表明 DIMM-PIM 能以可扩展的容量和带宽来平衡 AFD 系统中的带宽/容量约束，其调度与重排技术可应对分布式 DRAM 芯片协同带来的同步问题。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: A primer on optimal transport for causal inference with observational data
papers.abstract_en: The theory of optimal transportation has developed into a powerful and elegant framework for comparing probability distributions, with wide-ranging applications in all areas of science. The fundamental idea of analyzing probabilities by comparing their underlying state space naturally aligns with the core idea of causal inference, where understanding and quantifying counterfactual states is paramount. Despite this intuitive connection, explicit research at the intersection of optimal transport and causal inference is only beginning to develop. Yet, many foundational models in causal inference have implicitly relied on optimal transport principles for decades, without recognizing the underlying connection. Therefore, the goal of this review is to offer an introduction to the surprisingly deep existing connections between optimal transport and the identification of causal effects with observational data -- where optimal transport is not just a set of potential tools, but actually builds the foundation of model assumptions. As a result, this review is intended to unify the language and notation between different areas of statistics, mathematics, and econometrics, by pointing out these existing connections, and to explore novel problems and directions for future work in both areas derived from this realization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇综述性入门文章 (primer)，系统梳理最优传输 (optimal transport) 与基于观测数据 (observational data) 的因果推断之间已有的深层联系，指出许多因果推断基础模型长期隐式依赖最优传输原理。文章目标是统一统计学、数学与计量经济学之间的语言和记号，并基于这些联系为两个领域提出未来可能的新问题与研究方向。
Motivation: 尽管最优传输与因果推断在思想上天然契合，但两者交叉的明确研究才刚刚起步，且不同学科之间缺乏统一语言。本文希望揭示这些被忽略的既有联系，说明最优传输并非只是可选工具，而是部分因果识别模型假设的基础。
Method: 作为综述，本文不提出新算法或实证方法，而是以统一视角梳理最优传输与因果效应识别的连接，并更新了第 4.2 节内容（据 arXiv comment）。
Result: 摘要未报告数值结果或实验；其贡献主要是概念性的：建立统一语言与记号、识别已有模型中的隐式最优传输假设，并展望两个领域的新研究方向。
Conclusion: 作者强调该综述意在统一统计、数学与计量经济学等不同领域的表述方式，并基于最优传输与因果推断的联系，为两个领域探索新的问题和未来工作方向。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Judge a Book by its Cover: Investigating Multi-Modal LLMs for Multi-Page Handwritten Document Transcription
papers.abstract_en: Handwriting text recognition (HTR) remains a challenging task. Existing approaches require fine-tuning on labeled data, which is impractical to obtain for real-world problems, or rely on zero-shot tools such as OCR engines and multi-modal LLMs (MLLMs). MLLMs have shown promise both as end-to-end transcribers and as OCR post-processors, but to date there is little empirical research evaluating different MLLM prompting strategies for HTR, particularly for the case of multi-page documents. Most handwritten documents are multi-page, and share context such as semantic content and handwriting style across pages, yet MLLMs are typically used for transcription at the page level, meaning they throw away this shared context. They are also typically used as either text-only post-processors or image-only OCR alternatives, rather than leveraging multiple modes. This paper investigates a suite of methods combining OCR, LLM post-processing and MLLM end-to-end transcription, for the task of zero-shot multi-page handwritten document transcription. We introduce a benchmark for this task from existing single-page datasets, including a new dataset, Malvern-Hills. Finally, we introduce OCR+PAGE-1 and OCR+PAGE-N, prompting strategies for multi-page transcription that outperform existing methods by sharing content across pages while minimizing prompt complexity.
papers.comment: 10 pages (36 including references and appendices), 11 figures, accepted at COLM 2026, earlier version accepted at AAAI 2025 Workshop on Document Understanding and Intelligence
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 在零样本多页手写文档转录 (multi-page handwritten document transcription) 上的多种提示策略，提出将 OCR、LLM 后处理与 MLLM 端到端转录结合的若干方法。作者从现有单页数据集构建了该任务的基准，并引入新数据集 Malvern-Hills。摘要报告其提出的 OCR+PAGE-1 和 OCR+PAGE-N 策略通过跨页共享内容同时最小化提示复杂度，优于现有方法。
Motivation: 手写文本识别 (HTR) 仍具挑战性：现有方法要么依赖难以获取的标注数据进行微调，要么依赖 OCR 引擎和 MLLM 等零样本工具。多数手写文档是多页且跨页共享语义内容与笔迹风格，但 MLLM 通常逐页转录而丢弃共享上下文，且仅作为纯文本后处理器或纯图像 OCR 替代品，未充分利用多模态。此前也缺乏对不同 MLLM 提示策略在多页场景下的实证研究。
Method: 研究了一组结合 OCR、LLM 后处理和 MLLM 端到端转录的方法，用于零样本多页手写文档转录。引入从现有单页数据集构建的基准及新数据集 Malvern-Hills，并提出 OCR+PAGE-1 与 OCR+PAGE-N 两种多页转录提示策略，通过跨页共享内容同时尽量降低提示复杂度。
Result: 摘要报告 OCR+PAGE-1 和 OCR+PAGE-N 在零样本多页手写文档转录任务上优于现有方法，但未给出具体量化数字。
Conclusion: 作者认为在零样本多页手写文档转录中，跨页共享上下文能提升性能，且该任务需要同时利用多种模态而非仅文本后处理或仅图像 OCR。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Grad-ECLIP: Gradient-based Visual and Textual Explanations for CLIP
papers.abstract_en: Significant progress has been achieved on the improvement and downstream usages of the Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) vision-language model, while less attention is paid to the interpretation of CLIP. We propose a Gradient-based visual and textual Explanation method for CLIP (Grad-ECLIP), which interprets the matching result of CLIP for specific input image-text pair. By decomposing the architecture of the encoder and discovering the relationship between the matching similarity and intermediate spatial features, Grad-ECLIP produces effective heat maps that show the influence of image regions or words on the CLIP results. Different from the previous Transformer interpretation methods that focus on the utilization of self-attention maps, which are typically extremely sparse in CLIP, we produce high-quality visual explanations by applying channel and spatial weights on token features. Qualitative and quantitative evaluations verify the effectiveness and superiority of Grad-ECLIP compared with the state-of-the-art methods. Furthermore, a series of analysis are conducted based on our visual and textual explanation results, from which we explore the working mechanism of image-text matching, the strengths and limitations in attribution identification of CLIP, and the relationship between the concreteness/abstractness of a word and its usage in CLIP. Finally, based on the ability of explanation map that indicates text-specific saliency region of input image, we also propose an application with Grad-ECLIP, which is adopted to boost the fine-grained alignment in the CLIP fine-tuning. The code of Grad-ECLIP is available here: https://github.com/Cyang-Zhao/Grad-Eclip.
papers.journal_ref: Zhao C, Wang K, Hsiao J H, et al. Grad-eclip: Gradient-based visual and textual explanations for clip[J]. IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Grad-ECLIP，一种基于梯度的 CLIP 视觉与文本解释方法。通过分解编码器结构并建立匹配相似度与中间空间特征之间的关系，该方法为特定图像-文本对生成热力图，以展示图像区域或词语对 CLIP 匹配结果的影响；与依赖自注意力图（在 CLIP 中通常很稀疏）的既有 Transformer 解释方法不同，Grad-ECLIP 对 token 特征施加通道与空间权重。摘要报告定性和定量评估验证了其与 SOTA 方法相比的有效性，并基于解释结果开展机制分析，还提出一种利用解释图提升 CLIP 微调中细粒度对齐的应用。
Motivation: CLIP 的改进与下游应用研究较多，但其可解释性较少受到关注；同时，现有的 Transformer 解释方法依赖在 CLIP 中通常极稀疏的自注意力图，难以产生高质量解释。
Method: Grad-ECLIP 通过分解编码器架构，挖掘匹配相似度与中间空间特征的关系，并在 token 特征上施加通道权重和空间权重，从而生成显示图像区域或词语影响的热力图。
Result: 定性和定量评估表明 Grad-ECLIP 在解释质量上优于现有方法；此外，基于解释结果的分析探讨了图像-文本匹配的工作机制、CLIP 在归因识别上的优势与局限，以及词语具体性/抽象性与其在 CLIP 中使用方式的关系。
Conclusion: 作者还将能够指示文本特定显著性区域的解释图用于提升 CLIP 微调中的细粒度对齐，并开源代码。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.motivation: CLIP 的改进与下游应用研究较多，但其可解释性较少受到关注；同时，现有的 Transformer 解释方法依赖在 CLIP 中通常极稀疏的自注意力图，难以产生高质量解释。
summary_sections.method: Grad-ECLIP 通过分解编码器架构，挖掘匹配相似度与中间空间特征的关系，并在 token 特征上施加通道权重和空间权重，从而生成显示图像区域或词语影响的热力图。

papers.title: CADSpotting: Robust Panoptic Symbol Spotting on Large-Scale CAD Drawings
papers.abstract_en: We introduce CADSpotting, an effective method for panoptic symbol spotting in large-scale architectural CAD drawings. Existing approaches often struggle with symbol diversity, scale variations, and overlapping elements in CAD designs, and typically rely on additional features (e.g., primitive types or graphical layers) to improve performance. CADSpotting overcomes these challenges by representing primitives through densely sampled points with only coordinate attributes, using a unified 3D point cloud model for robust feature learning. To enable accurate segmentation in large drawings, we further propose a novel Sliding Window Aggregation (SWA) technique that combines weighted voting and Non-Maximum Suppression (NMS). Moreover, we introduce LS-CAD, a new large-scale dataset comprising 45 finely annotated floorplans, each covering approximately 1,000 $m^2$, significantly larger than prior benchmarks. LS-CAD will be publicly released to support future research. Experiments on FloorPlanCAD and LS-CAD demonstrate that CADSpotting significantly outperforms existing methods. We also showcase its practical value by enabling automated parametric 3D interior reconstruction directly from raw CAD inputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CADSpotting，面向大规模建筑 CAD 图纸的全景符号识别 (panoptic symbol spotting) 方法。作者用仅含坐标属性的稠密采样点表示图元，并通过统一的 3D 点云模型做特征学习，避免依赖图元类型或图层等额外特征。针对大图纸分割，提出滑窗聚合 (Sliding Window Aggregation, SWA) 技术，结合加权投票与非极大值抑制 (NMS)。同时发布新的大规模数据集 LS-CAD，含 45 张精细标注的平面图，每张约 1,000 m²，远超以往基准。
Motivation: 现有方法在 CAD 图纸中常受符号多样性、尺度变化和元素重叠影响，且通常需要额外特征（如图元类型或图形图层）来提高性能，这限制了方法的通用性。
Method: 将 CAD 图元表示为仅含坐标属性的稠密采样点，使用统一的 3D 点云模型进行鲁棒特征学习；提出滑窗聚合 (SWA) 技术，通过加权投票和非极大值抑制实现大尺寸图纸上的准确分割；并构建并公开大规模数据集 LS-CAD。
Result: 在 FloorPlanCAD 和 LS-CAD 上的实验表明，CADSpotting 显著优于现有方法；摘要还展示了从原始 CAD 输入直接进行自动化参数化 3D 室内重建的实际价值。
Conclusion: 作者强调该方法能摆脱对额外特征的依赖并应对 CAD 符号识别中的多种挑战，且 LS-CAD 数据集将公开以支持后续研究。

papers.title: Harnessing the Synergy between LLM Agents and Knowledge Graphs for Urban Socioeconomic Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Socioeconomic prediction aims to leverage various urban data to predict the socioeconomic indicators of regions such as population and commercial activity level, which plays an important role in understanding urban regions and supporting decision-making. Existing studies leverage knowledge graphs (KG) to model heterogeneous urban data, and further apply graph representation learning methods for socioeconomic prediction. However, these approaches heavily rely on heuristic ideas and expertise to extract task-relevant knowledge from diverse data, which may not be optimal for specific tasks. Additionally, they tend to overlook the inherent relationships between different indicators, limiting the prediction accuracy. Motivated by the remarkable abilities of large language models (LLMs), in this work, we propose a synergistic framework of LLM agents and KG, which integrates the reasoning and representation learning on KG with LLM agents. We first construct an urban knowledge graph (UrbanKG) to model multi-sourced urban data and finetune an embedding language model to generate embeddings for KG entities with semantic information. Then we leverage the reasoning power of LLM to identify relevant meta-paths in the UrbanKG for each type of socioeconomic prediction task, and design a semantic-guided attention module for knowledge fusion with meta-paths. Moreover, we introduce a cross-task communication mechanism to further enhance performance by enabling knowledge sharing across tasks at both LLM agent and KG levels. On the one hand, the LLM agents for different tasks collaborate to generate more diverse and comprehensive meta-paths. On the other hand, the embeddings from different tasks are adaptively merged. Experiments on two datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the synergistic design between LLM and KG, providing insights for information sharing across socioeconomic prediction tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个协同框架，将 LLM agent 与知识图谱结合用于城市社会经济指标预测（如人口、商业活动水平）。方法先构建城市知识图谱 UrbanKG 并微调嵌入语言模型，再借助 LLM 的推理能力为各预测任务选择相关 meta-path，配合语义引导注意力模块进行知识融合，并引入跨任务通信机制在 LLM 与 KG 两个层面共享信息。两个数据集上的实验表明该协同设计有效。
Motivation: 现有基于知识图谱的社会经济预测方法依赖启发式规则和专家经验来提取任务相关知识，可能对特定任务不是最优；同时这些方法忽略不同社会经济指标之间的内在关联，限制了预测精度。
Method: 构建 UrbanKG 建模多源城市数据，微调嵌入语言模型生成含语义信息的实体嵌入；利用 LLM 推理为每类社会经济预测任务识别相关 meta-path，并设计语义引导注意力模块进行知识融合；进一步提出跨任务通信机制，使不同任务的 LLM agents 协作生成更全面多样的 meta-paths，并在 KG 层自适应合并不同任务的嵌入。
Result: 在两个数据集上的实验验证了 LLM 与知识图谱协同设计相对基线方法的有效性，并为社会经济预测任务之间的信息共享提供了见解。摘要未报告具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 LLM agent 与知识图谱的协同以及跨任务知识共享能够提升城市社会经济预测表现，但未在摘要中说明方法的具体局限。

papers.title: Quasi-Bayesian sequential deconvolution
papers.abstract_en: Density deconvolution is the inverse problem of estimating a probability density from observations contaminated by additive noise. Traditionally studied in static or batch settings, it increasingly arises with streaming data, where existing frequentist and Bayesian procedures face substantial computational bottlenecks. We develop a quasi-Bayesian nonparametric method for sequential density deconvolution based on Newton's recursive algorithm. The resulting estimate is straightforward to evaluate and scalable to massive datasets, as its per-observation computational cost remains constant as new data arrive. The quasi-Bayesian interpretation enables uncertainty quantification: local and uniform central limit theorems yield asymptotic credible intervals and bands, respectively. Under a frequentist data-generating model, we establish $L^1$-consistency for the proposed estimate and show that it asymptotically agrees with the estimate that would be obtained if the uncontaminated variables were directly observed. Further, under additional regularity conditions, we derive an $L^1$-Wasserstein convergence rate and establish merging, at an explicit rate, with the Bayesian nonparametric posterior mean estimate under a Dirichlet process mixture model. Synthetic-data experiments, together with an acquisition-ordered flow-cytometry application, demonstrate accuracy comparable to Bayesian nonparametric and Fourier deconvolution methods, while offering a substantial computational advantage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于 Newton 递推算法的拟贝叶斯非参数方法，用于序贯密度反卷积 (sequential density deconvolution)，即在加性噪声污染下从流式观测中估计概率密度。该估计逐观测计算成本恒定，易于评估且可扩展至大规模数据。理论部分在频率派数据生成模型下证明 L^1 一致性、与直接观测未污染变量所得估计的渐近一致性，并在额外正则条件下给出 L^1-Wasserstein 收敛速率以及 Dirichlet 过程混合模型后验均值估计的显式速率合并结果。实验包括合成数据和流式细胞术应用，表明精度与贝叶斯非参数及 Fourier 反卷积方法相当，但计算优势显著。
Motivation: 密度反卷积传统上在静态或批量设置中研究，但流式数据的出现使现有频率派和贝叶斯方法面临巨大计算瓶颈。
Method: 基于 Newton 递推算法构造拟贝叶斯非参数序贯密度反卷积估计，逐观测计算成本恒定；借助拟贝叶斯解释，通过局部和一致中心极限定理获得渐近可信区间与可信带。
Result: 在频率派数据生成模型下建立估计的 L^1 一致性，并证明其渐近等价于直接观测未污染变量时的估计；额外正则条件下得到 L^1-Wasserstein 收敛速率及与 Dirichlet 过程混合模型贝叶斯后验均值估计的显式合并速率。合成实验和流式细胞术应用显示精度与贝叶斯非参数及 Fourier 方法相当，同时计算成本大幅降低。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该拟贝叶斯序贯方法在保持统计精度的同时解决了流式密度反卷积的可扩展性计算瓶颈，并为不确定性量化提供了渐近保证。

papers.title: Decentralized Indoor Localization Based on A Sparse Gaussian Process with Reduced-Dimensional Inputs for Real-Time Sensing and Training on IoT Devices
papers.abstract_en: As a large number of Internet of Things (IoT) devices are deployed in the field, there arises huge potential of edge computing for indoor localization on those devices. Conventional indoor localization based on a centralized server with substantial computational resources, often covering a number of multistory buildings, cannot easily adapt to time-varying indoor electromagnetic environments due to its high cost of fingerprint database update and model retraining; the centralized server is also susceptible to security breaches. To address these issues, we propose a decentralized indoor localization framework, leveraging models based on a Sparse Gaussian Process with Reduced-dimensional Inputs (SGP-RI) deployed to IoT devices for a smaller service area, which can quickly adapt to time-varying indoor electromagnetic environments through real-time sensing and retraining. The experimental results based on a multibuilding, multifloor static database and a single-building, single-floor dynamic database, demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed framework, where the SGP-RI with less than half the training samples can produce localization performance comparable to the standard Gaussian process (GP) with the whole training samples.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, published in IEEE Sensors Journal
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Sensors Journal, Early Access, Aug. 6, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对集中式服务器室内定位难以适应时变电磁环境且存在安全隐患的问题，提出一种去中心化的室内定位框架，将基于降维输入的稀疏高斯过程（SGP-RI）模型部署到 IoT 设备上，通过实时感知与重训练快速适应环境变化。基于多建筑多楼层静态数据库和单建筑单楼层动态数据库的实验表明，SGP-RI 使用不到一半的训练样本即可取得与使用全部训练样本的标准高斯过程（GP）相当的定位性能。
Motivation: 集中式服务器定位覆盖多栋建筑，指纹数据库更新和模型重训练成本高，难以适应时变室内电磁环境，且服务器易受安全攻击。
Method: 提出去中心化定位框架，将基于稀疏高斯过程与降维输入（SGP-RI）的模型部署到服务区域更小的 IoT 设备上，支持实时感知和重训练以快速适应环境变化。
Result: 实验基于多建筑多楼层静态数据库和单建筑单楼层动态数据库，结果显示 SGP-RI 在不到一半训练样本下达到与标准 GP 相当的性能，验证了框架的可行性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该去中心化框架能够以较低训练成本实现与标准 GP 相当的定位性能，并快速适应时变室内电磁环境。

papers.title: Towards a Theoretical Understanding of Two Tower Recommendation Models
papers.abstract_en: Production-grade recommender systems rely heavily on a large-scale corpus used by online media services, including Netflix, Pinterest, and Amazon. These systems enrich recommendations by learning users' and items' embeddings projected in a low-dimensional space with two tower models (two deep neural networks), which facilitate their embedding constructs to predict users' feedback associated with items. Despite its popularity for recommendations, its theoretical behaviors remain comprehensively unexplored. We study the asymptotic behaviors of the two tower model applied in two-stage recommenders that entail a strong convergence to the optimal recommender system. We establish certain theoretical properties and statistical assurance of the two tower recommender. In addition to asymptotic behaviors, we demonstrate that recommendation with two tower architecture attains faster convergence by relying on the intrinsic dimensions of the input features. Finally, we show numerically that the two tower recommender enables encapsulating the impacts of items' and users' attributes on ratings, resulting in better performance compared to existing methods conducted using synthetic and real-world data experiments.
papers.comment: 28 pages (including references and appendix), 3 figures, 11 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论角度研究双塔模型（two tower model）在推荐系统中的应用，分析其在两阶段推荐器中的渐近行为，并证明其向最优推荐系统强收敛。作者还指出该架构的收敛速度依赖于输入特征的内在维度，并通过合成与真实数据实验表明其优于现有方法。
Motivation: 生产级推荐系统普遍依赖双塔深度网络学习用户和物品的低维嵌入，但该模型的理论行为长期未被系统研究；本文旨在建立其理论性质与统计保证。
Method: 研究两阶段推荐器中双塔模型的渐近行为，建立理论性质和统计保证；分析基于输入特征内在维度（intrinsic dimensions）的收敛速度，并用合成数据与真实数据实验验证。
Result: 摘要报告双塔模型能够强收敛到最优推荐系统，且依赖输入特征内在维度时收敛更快；数值实验显示其在捕捉物品和用户属性对评分的影响上优于现有方法。

papers.title: Quantum Generative Diffusion Model: A Fully Quantum-Mechanical Model for Generating Quantum State Ensemble
papers.abstract_en: Mixed quantum states are the native description of many physically important quantum systems, making their generation a fundamental task in quantum information processing. However, constructing a diffusion process that generates density operators while keeping every reverse step physically valid remains nontrivial. This work introduces Quantum Generative Diffusion Model (QGDM), a fully quantum-mechanical model whose forward and backward processes are grounded in quantum channel theory. Through a non-unitary forward process, any target quantum state can be transformed into a completely mixed state. A trainable backward process recovers the former from the latter. We introduce partial trace to make the backward process non-unitary, and share parameters across timesteps by incorporating temporal information as an input. We present QGDM's resource-efficient version to reduce auxiliary qubits while preserving generative capabilities. We theoretically analyze the denoising design, showing it avoids a low-loss shortcut that traps training and cause generation failure. Simulations confirm that QGDM outperforms quantum generative adversarial networks on random pure- and mixed-state generation, with better noise robustness than other quantum generative models and a task-specialized approach for practical Gibbs state generation. Hence, QGDM provides a channel-based diffusion framework for learning fixed mixed-state targets, extending quantum generative modeling toward realistic quantum information settings.
papers.comment: 31 pages, 15 tables. Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence. The supplementary material is included at the end of the manuscript
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出量子生成扩散模型 (QGDM)，一种完全量子力学化的扩散模型，用于生成密度算子（混合量子态）。其前向过程在量子信道论框架下将任意目标态化为完全混合态，可训练的反向过程再恢复目标态。作者引入部分迹 (partial trace) 实现非幺正反向过程，并给出减少辅助量子比特的资源高效版本。模拟表明 QGDM 在随机纯态和混合态生成上优于量子生成对抗网络，且噪声鲁棒性更好。
Motivation: 混合量子态是许多重要量子系统的原生表示，生成它们是量子信息处理的基本任务；但构建每一步反向过程都物理有效、且能生成密度算子的扩散过程仍具挑战。
Method: 将前向与反向过程建立在量子信道论上：前向采用非幺正过程把目标量子态转换为完全混合态；反向通过引入部分迹保持非幺正性，把时间信息作为输入以跨时间步共享参数；另提出降低辅助量子比特开销的资源高效版本。
Result: 理论分析表明其去噪设计可避免低损失捷径 (low-loss shortcut) 导致的训练失败。模拟结果显示 QGDM 在随机纯态与混合态生成上优于量子生成对抗网络，比其他量子生成模型具有更好的噪声鲁棒性，并为实际 Gibbs 态生成提供了任务特化方法。
Conclusion: QGDM 提供了一种基于量子信道的扩散框架，用于学习固定混合态目标，把量子生成建模扩展到更贴近实际量子信息处理的场景。

papers.title: SoRoMoX: Fast, Differentiable, and Parallelizable Soft Robot Models
papers.abstract_en: Reduced-order models based on Cosserat-rod theory are now well established, and modeling theory is no longer the primary bottleneck in soft-robot control. Their implementations, however, do not support the differentiable, GPU-parallel, and control-oriented workflows that underpin advanced rigid-robotics applications. Here, we fill this gap with SoRoMoX (Soft Robot Models in JAX), a fully numerical, JIT-compilable Python/JAX framework. SoRoMoX implements articulated, Piecewise Constant Strain, and Variable Strain models through a unified, control-ready interface that provides inertia matrices, gravitational and elastic forces, Jacobians, and their derivatives. To our knowledge, it is the first rod/strain-based soft-robot modeling framework that runs directly on GPUs and is end-to-end differentiable with respect to states, inputs, and parameters. Sequential CPU rollouts are up to 18.1x faster than state-of-the-art alternatives, while GPU-parallel rollouts increase throughput by up to 234.6x. This performance enables workflows that were previously impractical or impossible: static-equilibrium system identification with 66% lower marker RMSE; residual-force learning with a further 64% reduction; computed-torque tracking with RMSE reduced by a factor of approximately 500 relative to model-free PD; control-gain optimization with up to 62% lower loss than untuned gains; safety-constrained control using high-order control barrier functions to keep the peak contact force within a prescribed 5 N bound, compared with 33.5 N without the safety constraint; and reinforcement-learning policy training up to 7x faster than a CPU PyElastica discrete-rod baseline through massively parallel rollouts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SoRoMoX (Soft Robot Models in JAX)，一个完全数值化、可 JIT 编译的 Python/JAX 软体机器人建模框架。该框架通过统一的控制友好接口实现 articulated、Piecewise Constant Strain 和 Variable Strain 三类模型，并提供惯性矩阵、重力与弹性力、Jacobian 及其导数。摘要报告其在 GPU 上直接运行且对状态、输入和参数端到端可微，Sequential CPU rollout 最高比现有方法快 18.1 倍，GPU 并行 rollout 吞吐量最高提升 234.6 倍。
Motivation: 基于 Cosserat-rod 理论的降阶模型在软体机器人控制中已成熟，建模理论不再是主要瓶颈，但现有实现不支持可微、GPU 并行和控制导向的工作流，阻碍了先进刚性机器人技术的迁移。
Method: 提出 SoRoMoX 框架，以 Python/JAX 构建、完全数值化并可 JIT 编译，统一实现 articulated、Piecewise Constant Strain 与 Variable Strain 模型，提供惯性矩阵、重力/弹性力、Jacobian 及其导数，并支持端到端微分。
Result: 摘要报告 Sequential CPU rollout 最高快 18.1 倍，GPU 并行 rollout 吞吐量最高提升 234.6 倍；静态平衡系统辨识 marker RMSE 降低 66%，残差力学习再降 64%，计算力矩跟踪 RMSE 较无模型 PD 降低约 500 倍，控制增益优化损失最高降低 62%，安全约束控制将峰值接触力限制在 5 N（无约束时为 33.5 N），RL 策略训练比 CPU PyElastica 基线快最多 7 倍。
Conclusion: 作者认为该性能使此前不实际或不可行的工作流成为可能，说明软体机器人领域的瓶颈已从建模理论转移到实现层面的可微性与并行计算能力。

papers.title: Characterizing the Quality Profile of AI-Generated C++ in Production
papers.abstract_en: The widespread integration of AI coding assistants offers undeniable boosts to engineering velocity. Yet, recent studies point to a growing trade-off, revealing persistent challenges with code quality and maintainability. Industry leaders, including frontier AI labs, echo these concerns. As large language models are increasingly relied upon to author production code, understanding their impact on shipped software quality has become a critical priority. However, assessing these effects in industrial workflows remains difficult due to observability barriers. We study the impact of AI-generated code on production quality within a large enterprise operating global products relied upon by billions of users daily. Driven by this scale and user trust, the organization values code quality and has built thorough observability for every line of code deployed into production, enabling us to overcome measurement barriers to assess these effects. This study presents a large-scale empirical analysis of AI-generated C++ code from April 2025 to April 2026, tracking 3.52 million code changes across this enterprise's brownfield codebase. The core purpose is to understand the quality, performance, and maintenance characteristics of AI-generated code compared to human-written code in a production environment at scale. We find that AI-generated C++ code has a distinct quality profile, showing higher rates of interface and coupling burdens, copy and allocation overheads, and a reliance on explicit loops over optimized standard APIs. These issues translate into tangible downstream costs, including increased review effort and a 5-8% increase in compute resource consumption. However, we demonstrate that providing models with targeted, taxonomy-informed feedback can mitigate these effects, leading to an 11.1% reduction in targeted static analysis warnings and improved computational efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一项针对企业生产环境的大规模实证研究，分析2025年4月至2026年4月间3.52百万次C++代码变更，比较AI生成代码与人工编写代码在质量、性能和可维护性上的差异。研究发现AI生成的C++代码具有独特的质量特征，包括更高的接口和耦合负担、拷贝与内存分配开销，以及更依赖显式循环而非优化标准API。这些问题带来可量化的下游成本，如评审工作量增加和5-8%的计算资源消耗提升；而基于分类法（taxonomy）的有针对性反馈可将静态分析告警降低11.1%。
Motivation: AI编码助手提升工程速度，但已有研究指出其对代码质量和可维护性的负面影响，且工业工作流中缺乏可观测性，难以评估AI生成代码对生产软件质量的实际影响。本文利用大型企业对生产环境每行代码的完整可观测性，克服测量障碍，在真实规模下研究这一影响。
Method: 在服务全球数十亿用户的大型企业棕色地带（brownfield）代码库中，对2025年4月至2026年4月的352万次代码变更进行大规模实证分析，建立AI生成C++代码与人工编写代码的质量画像对比，并尝试向模型提供基于分类法的针对性反馈以缓解负面效应。
Result: AI生成的C++代码在接口与耦合负担、拷贝和内存分配开销、以及绕过优化标准API而使用显式循环等方面呈现更差的质量画像，并导致评审工作量增加和5-8%的计算资源消耗上升。提供分类法反馈后，针对性的静态分析告警减少11.1%，计算效率也得到改善。
Conclusion: 作者认为，向模型提供有针对性、基于分类法的反馈可以有效缓解AI生成代码在生产环境中的质量与效率问题，但研究范围限于该企业的C++生产代码库及其可观测性设置。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: MI-MIDI: Mechanistic Interpretability of Text-to-MIDI Generation Models via Probing, Lenses and Steering
papers.abstract_en: Mechanistic interpretability of music generation has concentrated on audio models, leaving symbolic models largely unexplored. We analyze two public text-to-MIDI systems of contrasting design: the purpose-built encoder--decoder text2midi and MIDI-LLM, a Llama~3.2~1B model extended with MIDI tokens using linear probing, the logit and tuned lenses, activation patching and difference-in-means steering. Across these methods, we recover musically meaningful structure and show how architecture shapes its formation and control. Pitch, instrumentation, harmony and texture are linearly decodable in both models. text2midi refines predictions gradually across depth, whereas MIDI-LLM works largely in its inherited textual basis before a sharp late rotation into the musical vocabulary; patching identifies a matching late attenuation of prompt-driven instrument transfer. Steering produces bidirectional changes in register and polyphony in both systems, and in tempo/energy in MIDI-LLM. Our two-orientation protocol isolates directional control and shows that all-layer interventions are robust in text2midi but accumulate disruptively in MIDI-LLM. Together, the results provide a practical toolkit for tracing and controlling musical concepts in symbolic generators. Audio examples are available on a demo website.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对两个公开的文本到 MIDI（text-to-MIDI）生成系统进行机制可解释性分析：专用编码器-解码器架构 text2midi 和扩展了 MIDI tokens 的 Llama 3.2 1B 模型 MIDI-LLM。作者使用线性探针（linear probing）、logit/tuned lenses、激活修补（activation patching）和差均值引导（difference-in-means steering）等方法，发现音高、配器、和声和织体在两类模型中均可线性解码，并揭示架构如何影响音乐概念的形成与控制。摘要还报告了引导可双向改变音区和复音程度，以及两类模型在全层干预下的不同鲁棒性。
Motivation: 音乐生成的机制可解释性研究此前集中于音频模型，符号音乐模型（symbolic models）基本未被探索；本文填补这一空白，对文本到 MIDI 系统进行内部表征和控制的解释性分析。
Method: 采用一组可解释性技术：线性探针、logit lens 与 tuned lens、激活修补以及 difference-in-means steering；并提出一个双方向协议（two-orientation protocol）来隔离方向性控制，用于追踪和操控符号音乐生成器中的音乐概念。
Result: 音高、配器、和声与织体在两种模型中均可线性解码；text2midi 在网络深度上逐步精炼预测，而 MIDI-LLM 主要在继承的文本表征空间中工作，直到后期才急剧转向音乐词表；激活修补定位到提示驱动的乐器转移的后期衰减；引导能在两类模型中双向改变音区和复音程度，在 MIDI-LLM 中还能改变速度/能量；全层干预在 text2midi 中稳健，但在 MIDI-LLM 中会产生累积性破坏。
Conclusion: 该研究为追踪和控制符号音乐生成器中的音乐概念提供了实用工具包（practical toolkit），并表明架构设计显著影响可解释性与干预效果。摘要未明确讨论局限性。

summary_sections.motivation: 音乐生成的机制可解释性研究此前集中于音频模型，符号音乐模型（symbolic models）基本未被探索；本文填补这一空白，对文本到 MIDI 系统进行内部表征和控制的解释性分析。
summary_sections.method: 采用一组可解释性技术：线性探针、logit lens 与 tuned lens、激活修补以及 difference-in-means steering；并提出一个双方向协议（two-orientation protocol）来隔离方向性控制，用于追踪和操控符号音乐生成器中的音乐概念。
summary_sections.result: 音高、配器、和声与织体在两种模型中均可线性解码；text2midi 在网络深度上逐步精炼预测，而 MIDI-LLM 主要在继承的文本表征空间中工作，直到后期才急剧转向音乐词表；激活修补定位到提示驱动的乐器转移的后期衰减；引导能在两类模型中双向改变音区和复音程度，在 MIDI-LLM 中还能改变速度/能量；全层干预在 text2midi 中稳健，但在 MIDI-LLM 中会产生累积性破坏。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该研究为追踪和控制符号音乐生成器中的音乐概念提供了实用工具包（practical toolkit），并表明架构设计显著影响可解释性与干预效果。摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: Bypassing Krum: Selection-Aware Backdoor Attacks in Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Robust aggregation methods are widely used in federated learning to mitigate the impact of adversarial client behavior. Distance-based aggregation rules, such as Krum and Multi-Krum, select updates that are closest to the majority under the assumption that benign updates form a compact cluster. However, these methods rely on geometric properties that can be exploited by adaptive adversaries. We introduce the Krum-Proxy attack, a selection-aware backdoor injection strategy that consistently bypasses Byzantine-robust aggregation. Rather than relying on naive scaling or constraining, our method actively optimizes malicious updates to infiltrate the dense core of the benign distribution. The proposed method constructs adversarial updates that are not only similar to benign updates but are also optimized to lie in regions of the update space that are favored during aggregation. This is achieved through a two-stage optimization procedure that separates task-specific attack objectives from geometry-aware refinement, using a nearest-neighbor proxy, stochastic reference modeling, and anchor-guided alignment. To maintain stealth, we introduce a projection mechanism that constrains adversarial updates within realistic norm and variance bounds. Experiments on standard federated learning benchmarks show that Krum-Proxy achieves higher attack success while preserving clean accuracy, highlighting the vulnerability of distance-based aggregation to selection-aware adversaries.
papers.comment: Accepted and presented at the 2026 International Conference on Intelligent Multimedia, Networking, and Security (IMNS 2026). 6 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Krum-Proxy 攻击，一种针对联邦学习中基于距离的鲁棒聚合规则（如 Krum 和 Multi-Krum）的选择感知后门注入策略。该方法主动优化恶意更新，使其与良性更新分布的核心区域对齐，从而持续绕过 Byzantine-鲁棒聚合。在标准联邦学习基准上的实验显示，该攻击取得更高的攻击成功率，同时保持干净准确率，暴露了距离类聚合规则的脆弱性。
Motivation: 现有的基于距离的聚合规则假设良性更新形成紧凑簇，因此依赖可被自适应攻击者利用的几何特性。作者旨在展示这类聚合方法在面对选择感知对手（selection-aware adversaries）时可以被系统性绕过。
Method: 提出两阶段优化过程：将任务特定的攻击目标与几何感知精炼分离，并利用最近邻代理（nearest-neighbor proxy）、随机参考建模（stochastic reference modeling）和锚定引导对齐（anchor-guided alignment）构造对抗更新；同时引入投影机制，将更新约束在现实的范数与方差边界内以保持隐蔽性。
Result: 摘要报告在标准联邦学习基准上，Krum-Proxy 相比相关方法取得更高的攻击成功，同时保持干净数据上的准确率，说明距离类聚合规则可被选择感知攻击持续规避。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，不依赖朴素缩放或约束、而是主动优化更新以潜入良性分布稠密核心的攻击策略，凸显了基于距离的聚合规则对自适应敌手的脆弱性。

papers.title: Shape Your Feed: An LLM-based Agentic System for Conversational Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Industrial recommendation systems predominantly adopt a passive ranking paradigm that infers user preferences from implicit behavioral signals (e.g., clicks, dwell time) rather than explicit, natural language inputs. As a result, users experience a persistent discrepancy between their explicit interests and what passive behavioral algorithms deliver, limiting their ability to express nuanced preferences or steer their feed in real time. To address this growing gap between how recommendations are optimized and how users wish to articulate their interests, we present Shape Your Feed (SYF), an LLM-based agentic recommendation framework that enables real-time, multimodal co-curation of content. SYF employs a three-tier architecture: (i) a Perception Flow that captures fine-grained user intent from text prompts, voice commands, and UI interactions; (ii) a Serving Flow that performs real-time agentic re-ranking and pruning of candidate items, grounded in a persistent Semantic Profile encoding evolving user preferences; and (iii) a Self-Evolution Flow that aligns system behavior with human judgments via Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) and an LLM-as-a-Judge ensemble. Offline evaluations show that SYF's alignment scoring module achieves 98.85% accuracy, substantially improving over strong few-shot baselines. Large-scale online A/B experiments on production traffic further demonstrate that SYF improves feed relevance and user sentiment, indicating a practical and scalable path toward interactive, user-steerable recommendation in industrial settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Shape Your Feed (SYF)，一个基于 LLM 的智能体推荐框架，用于实现工业推荐系统中的实时、多模态用户可控内容共策。SYF 采用三层架构，包括感知流、服务流和自我进化流，并从自然语言、语音和 UI 交互中捕获用户意图，结合持久化语义画像进行实时重排与剪枝。离线评估显示对齐评分模块达到 98.85% 的准确率，在线 A/B 实验表明能提升 Feed 相关性与用户情感。
Motivation: 工业推荐系统主要依赖点击、停留时间等隐式行为信号进行被动排序，用户无法通过显式自然语言表达细致偏好或实时调整 feed，导致优化目标与用户表达意图之间存在持续鸿沟。
Method: SYF 采用三层架构：感知流 (Perception Flow) 从文本提示、语音指令和 UI 交互中提取细粒度用户意图；服务流 (Serving Flow) 基于持续演化的语义画像 (Semantic Profile) 对候选物品进行实时智能体重排与剪枝；自我进化流 (Self-Evolution Flow) 通过直接偏好优化 (DPO) 和 LLM-as-a-Judge 集成使系统行为与人类判断对齐。
Result: 离线评估中，SYF 的对齐评分模块达到 98.85% 的准确率，明显优于强少样本基线；大规模生产流量上的在线 A/B 实验显示 SYF 提升了 feed 相关性和用户情感指标。
Conclusion: 该工作为交互式、用户可操控的工业级推荐提供了可行且可扩展的路径，表明基于 LLM 的智能体框架能够弥合被动排序与显式用户意图之间的差距。
