papers.title: Cryptanalytic Extraction of Isolated Bias-Free GLU Feed-Forward Blocks by Antipodal Separation
papers.abstract_en: Cryptanalytic extraction has been demonstrated for ReLU networks, for networks using componentwise activations such as GELU or SiLU, and for a Transformer's final projection matrix. These methods do not recover the bias-free Gated Linear Unit (GLU) feed-forward blocks used in many modern language models. Such a block multiplies an activated linear projection by a second learned linear projection within each hidden unit, a two-branch structure absent from the network classes and final-layer setting addressed by those methods. We give a constructive, multi-stage forward-query recovery primitive for isolated bias-free GLU blocks. Finite-difference curvature supplies gate-direction candidates, and paired observations at x and -x separate gate magnitude, orientation, and value-branch coupling. Across high-precision targets, six Qwen layers, an 8,192-unit Llama subproblem, and a full-dimensional Gemma block all reach sub-percent median validation error. Four finite-precision configurations remain below 5 percent median error, but none reproduces every stored weight. These isolated-block experiments are not an end-to-end model-API attack: deriving the required internal block responses from final model outputs remains unsolved.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现有密码分析提取方法无法恢复现代语言模型中无偏置门控线性单元（GLU）前馈块的问题，提出一种构造性的多阶段前向查询恢复原语。该方法利用有限差分曲率提供门控方向候选，并通过 x 与 -x 处的成对观测分离门控幅度、方向与值分支耦合。实验显示，在高精度目标上，六个 Qwen 层、一个 8,192 单元的 Llama 子问题和一个全维 Gemma 块均达到亚百分比中位验证误差；四个有限精度配置的中位误差低于 5%，但均未复现全部存储权重。作者明确指出这些孤立块实验并非端到端模型 API 攻击。
Motivation: 已有的密码分析提取方法覆盖 ReLU 网络、GELU/SiLU 等逐分量激活网络以及 Transformer 的最终投影矩阵，但无法恢复许多现代语言模型中使用的无偏置 GLU 前馈块，因为该块在每个隐藏单元内将激活的线性投影与第二个学习的线性投影相乘，这种双分支结构在已有方法处理的网络类别和最终层设定中不存在。
Method: 提出一种构造性的多阶段前向查询恢复原语：先用有限差分曲率获取门控方向候选，再通过 x 与 -x 处的成对观测将门控幅度、方向与值分支耦合分开求解。
Result: 在高精度目标上，六个 Qwen 层、一个 8,192 单元的 Llama 子问题和一个全维 Gemma 块的中位验证误差均低于 1%；四个有限精度配置的中位误差保持在 5% 以下，但没有一个配置能复现所有存储权重。
Conclusion: 本文的孤立块实验不是端到端模型 API 攻击；从最终模型输出推导所需内部块响应这一问题仍未解决，这是该方法适用的范围边界。

papers.title: The Sparsity Whisperer
papers.abstract_en: Pruning reduces the inference cost of large language models, but existing criteria primarily preserve large activations or reconstruct layer outputs. We argue that this overlooks a key computation performed by particularly sparsity-sensitive neurons in the MLP up and gate projections: separating similar inputs into dissimilar outputs. This suggests that effective pruning should preserve not only activations, but also the differences between outputs more broadly. We introduce a family of difference-informed pruning methods built upon this principle. Wisp is a first-order, update-free method that scores weights using input-difference norms, and Wisp+ refines this score neuronwise using the input pairs each neuron separates most strongly. Finally, Whisper is a second-order method that uses a lightly regularized difference Hessian as its reconstruction objective. Across Llama 2 and 3.1 models from 7B to 405B parameters, our second-order variant consistently improves over strong reconstruction-based baselines, while our update-free variants improve over activation-aware baselines, especially in constrained settings. The improvements over Wanda and SparseGPT extend to structured sparsity, downstream evaluations, and other model families. Augmenting stronger techniques such as RIA and ALPS with our difference-informed criteria yields further improvements, shifting the overall accuracy-runtime frontier outward at negligible additional cost. These results suggest that preserving output differences is a broadly useful and composable signal for post-training LLM sparsification.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 3 figures. Code available at https://github.com/Shavit-Lab/Whisper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一类基于“输出差异”的剪枝准则，用于大语言模型的后训练稀疏化。作者认为现有剪枝主要保留大激活或重建层输出，却忽略了 MLP 上投影与门投影中部分对稀疏性敏感的神经元将相似输入分离为不相似输出的关键计算。据此提出 Wisp（一阶免更新方法）、Wisp+（按神经元最强烈分离的输入对进行精化）以及 Whisper（以带轻正则的差分 Hessian 为重建目标的二阶方法）。在 Llama 2/3.1 的 7B 至 405B 模型上，Whisper 一致优于强重建基线，免更新变体在受限设置中优于激活感知基线。
Motivation: 现有剪枝准则（如保留大激活、重建层输出）忽略了部分对稀疏性敏感的 MLP 神经元执行的关键计算：将相似输入映射为不相似输出；因此有效的剪枝不仅应保留激活，还应更广泛地保留输出之间的差异。
Method: 提出 difference-informed 剪枝方法家族：Wisp 为一阶、免更新方法，用输入差分范数对权重打分；Wisp+ 依据每个神经元分离得最强的输入对，逐神经元精化该得分；Whisper 为二阶方法，使用带轻正则化的差分 Hessian 作为重建目标。
Result: 在 Llama 2 和 3.1 的 7B 至 405B 模型上，二阶变体 Whisper 一致优于强重建基线，免更新变体在受限设置中优于激活感知基线；相对 Wanda 和 SparseGPT 的改进扩展到结构化稀疏、下游评估和其他模型族；将 difference-informed 准则与 RIA、ALPS 等更强技术结合可进一步向外推进准确率-运行时前沿，额外代价可忽略。
Conclusion: 摘要认为保留输出差异是后训练 LLM 稀疏化中一种广泛适用且可组合的信号，可用于改进现有剪枝技术。

summary_sections.result: 在 Llama 2 和 3.1 的 7B 至 405B 模型上，二阶变体 Whisper 一致优于强重建基线，免更新变体在受限设置中优于激活感知基线；相对 Wanda 和 SparseGPT 的改进扩展到结构化稀疏、下游评估和其他模型族；将 difference-informed 准则与 RIA、ALPS 等更强技术结合可进一步向外推进准确率-运行时前沿，额外代价可忽略。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要认为保留输出差异是后训练 LLM 稀疏化中一种广泛适用且可组合的信号，可用于改进现有剪枝技术。

papers.title: Retrofitting Linear Attention into Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion language models (dLLMs) offer a promising alternative to autoregressive models by accelerating inference through parallel decoding. Recent dLLMs commonly use blockwise semi-autoregressive decoding, generating blocks autoregressively while denoising tokens within each active block in parallel. However, despite KV caching, each denoising step still attends to all previous blocks, repeatedly incurring prefix-attention cost. Motivated by this bottleneck, we ask whether dLLM inference can be further accelerated by linearizing attention over previous blocks. We introduce block-hybrid attention, which retains exact softmax attention within the active denoising block while applying linear attention over previous blocks. We show that this hybrid attention can be retrofitted into a pretrained dLLM with minimal post-training: LLaDA-Hybrid replaces 6 of the 20 attention layers in LLaDA~2.1, a 16B open-source dLLM, largely following LoLCAT (Zhang et al, 2024). The conversion takes only approximately 60 hours while preserving benchmark performance: 72.0% vs. 75.6% on HumanEval, 63.0% vs. 57.7% on MBPP+, and 86.7% vs. 88.3% on CMATH. With a Triton implementation, LLaDA-Hybrid achieves up to $1.7\times$ higher decoding throughput and supports more concurrent requests before exhausting memory, showing that pretrained dLLMs can be efficiently linearized for faster inference. Our code is available at: https://github.com/Diuven/LLaDA-Hybrid.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散语言模型 (dLLM) 在块状半自回归解码中，每个去噪步骤仍须 attend 到所有先前块、反复产生前缀注意力 (prefix attention) 开销的瓶颈，提出块混合注意力 (block-hybrid attention)：活跃去噪块内保留精确 softmax 注意力，对先前块改用线性注意力。作者以约 60 小时的后训练将这一方案改装进 LLaDA 2.1 (16B)，替换 20 个注意力层中的 6 层，得到 LLaDA-Hybrid；在 HumanEval、MBPP+、CMATH 上基本保持基准性能，并用 Triton 实现将解码吞吐量最高提升 1.7 倍。研究显示预训练 dLLM 可以被高效线性化以加速推理。
Motivation: dLLM 虽然通过并行解码加速推理，但即便使用 KV cache，每个去噪步骤仍要 attend 到所有先前块，反复产生前缀注意力开销，成为进一步加速推理的瓶颈。
Method: 提出 block-hybrid attention，即活跃去噪块内使用精确 softmax 注意力，先前块使用线性注意力；将该混合注意力改装进预训练 dLLM，LLaDA-Hybrid 替换 LLaDA 2.1 的 20 个注意力层中的 6 个，主要参照 LoLCAT，后训练约 60 小时，并给出 Triton 实现。
Result: 摘要报告 LLaDA-Hybrid 在 HumanEval 上为 72.0% vs 75.6%，MBPP+ 上为 63.0% vs 57.7%，CMATH 上为 86.7% vs 88.3%；解码吞吐量最高提升 1.7 倍，并能在内存耗尽前支持更多并发请求。
Conclusion: 摘要强调预训练 dLLM 可以通过最少量的后训练被高效线性化，从而获得更快推理且基本保持基准性能；代码已开源。

papers.title: NxN E-valuation: Hypothesis Certification via a Conformal CRT Null
papers.abstract_en: We propose NxN E-valuation, a handy, e-value-based hypothesis-certification algorithm that lets a hypothesis be verified without building any case-specific certification procedure---such as constructing a dedicated null hypothesis---as long as a large enough dataset is available. The method is especially suited to LLM-based exploration systems, where LLMs are remarkably good at proposing hypotheses but suffer badly from hallucination; this hallucination prevents us from harvesting LLM outputs directly, and existing remedies each fall short. The most common solutions include letting the LLM verify or correct itself circular verification and held-out testing (where false hypotheses can still pass via spurious correlations), among other remedies detailed in the introduction. To resolve this, NxN E-valuation exploits the naturally existing large training set and lets different samples serve as null hypotheses for one another. This design directly realizes a conditional randomization test (CRT) that certifies each hypothesis. The approach can be a universally better replacement for at least LLM circular verification and held-out-data testing, provided the LLM's generations are hypotheses that apply to each individual sample.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NxN E-valuation，一种基于 e-value 的假设认证算法，使假设无需构建案例专用认证流程（如构造专用零假设）即可被验证，前提是有足够大的数据集。方法面向 LLM 驱动的探索系统，利用大量训练样本互为零假设，直接实现条件随机化检验 (conditional randomization test, CRT)，从而缓解 LLM 幻觉导致输出不可直接采信的问题。
Motivation: LLM 擅长提出假设但存在严重幻觉，现有缓解手段各有缺陷：让 LLM 自我验证或纠错属于循环验证，保留数据上的测试则可能因虚假相关 (spurious correlations) 让错误假设通过。
Method: 利用现成的大规模训练集，让不同样本互为彼此的零假设，从而构造 e-value 假设检验；该设计直接实现了用于认证每个假设的条件随机化检验 (CRT)，无需额外设计案例特定的认证流程。
Result: 摘要声称在 LLM 生成假设适用于每个独立样本的前提下，该方法至少可以成为 LLM 循环验证和保留数据测试的通用更优替代方案；未报告具体量化实验结果。
Conclusion: 作者强调该方法特别适合 LLM 探索系统，并指出其成立依赖一个前提条件，即 LLM 生成的是可应用于每个独立样本的假设。

papers.title: Beyond Co-Movement: Locality by Exposures Enables a Joint Factor-Graph Framework for Portfolio Diversification
papers.abstract_en: Current portfolio construction methods are either agnostic to the effects of idiosyncratic shocks (standard factor models) or to the latent data structure driving systematic returns (recent graph-based approaches). This presents an opportunity to combine the complementary market aspects captured by the factor and graph domains, allowing asset allocations to operate directly on the underlying market structure, rather than on its observed co-movement or its finite-sample artefacts. In this work, we introduce the Mutually-INformed Graph-Locality and Exposures framework (MINGLE), which mutually regularises the factor and graph domains by redefining graph locality through systematic factor exposure profiles, rather than via observed co-movements. This is formalised through a unified Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) framework that jointly learns a latent factor representation and its induced graph topology directly from market returns. The resulting exposure-similarity graph aligns more closely with established economic sectors than conventional correlation-based graphs. Portfolios constructed from this representation are shown to consistently outperform their correlation-based counterparts across a range of volatility regimes and transaction cost levels. For rigour, paired statistical testing confirms that these gains stem from the reconciliation of the graph and factor domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MINGLE（Mutually-INformed Graph-Locality and Exposures）框架，将因子域与图域相互正则化：不再用观测到的共同运动（co-movement），而是用系统性因子暴露谱（factor exposure profiles）重新定义图的局部性，并通过统一的 ADMM 框架从市场收益中联合学习潜在因子表示及其诱导的图拓扑。摘要报告，所得的暴露相似图比传统相关图更贴近经济板块，且基于该表示的组合在多种波动率机制和交易成本水平下持续优于基于相关图的组合。
Motivation: 现有组合构建方法存在割裂：标准因子模型忽略特质冲击的影响，而近期基于图的方法忽略驱动系统性收益的潜在数据结构。作者希望结合因子域与图域互补的市场属性，使资产配置直接作用于底层市场结构，而非观测到的共同运动或其有限样本伪影。
Method: 提出 MINGLE 框架，通过系统性因子暴露而非观测到的共同运动来定义图局部性，并形式化为统一的 ADMM（Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers）优化问题，联合学习潜在因子表示和由其诱导的图拓扑。
Result: 暴露相似图与传统相关图相比，与既定经济板块的一致性更强；基于该表示构建的投资组合在多种波动率机制和交易成本水平下一致优于相关图对应组合，且配对统计检验确认这些收益源于图域与因子域的调和。
Conclusion: 作者认为，联合调和图域与因子域可以更好地捕捉驱动系统性收益的潜在市场结构，从而改进组合多样化。摘要未明确讨论方法局限性。

papers.title: Factorized Hypothesis Search for Evidence-to-Taxonomy Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Large-taxonomy retrieval often assumes that the input already expresses the target concept. In many settings, however, the input is indirect evidence, such as a table cell whose meaning depends on its row, column, datatype, and context. We call this mismatch the retrieval readiness gap. Our analysis shows that the current index retrieves the target reliably when its semantics are explicit, while raw evidence often leaves it deep in the ranking. We propose Factorized Hypothesis Search (FHS), which maintains multiple partial interpretations over named semantic dimensions. These hypotheses support structured query rendering, multi-hypothesis retrieval, and dimension-level candidate verification. On both financial taxonomy tagging and CodiEsp clinical coding tasks, FHS achieves the best Recall@1, MRR, and final accuracy among the non-oracle methods. Replacing the factorized hypothesis path with a free-text ensemble causes the largest drop in head-ranking performance, while sequential refinement provides no additional gain over FHS's strong parallel first round.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大规模分类体系检索中常见的“检索就绪度差距”（retrieval readiness gap）问题——输入往往是间接证据（如表格单元格，其语义依赖行、列、数据类型和上下文），而不是直接表达目标概念——提出因子化假设检索（Factorized Hypothesis Search, FHS）。该方法在命名语义维度上维护多个部分解释，并支持结构化查询渲染、多假设检索和维度级候选验证。在金融分类标注和 CodiEsp 临床编码任务中，FHS 在非 oracle 方法里取得最好的 Recall@1、MRR 和最终准确率。
Motivation: 大规模分类体系检索通常假设输入已经表达了目标概念，但许多场景下输入是间接证据，其含义依赖上下文，导致目标在索引中排名很低；这种输入与索引语义之间的不匹配被定义为检索就绪度差距。
Method: 提出 FHS，它在多个命名的语义维度上维护多个部分解释（partial interpretations）作为假设，利用这些假设进行结构化查询渲染、多假设检索（multi-hypothesis retrieval）以及维度级候选验证（dimension-level candidate verification）。
Result: 在金融分类标注和 CodiEsp 临床编码任务上，FHS 在非 oracle 方法中获得最优的 Recall@1、MRR 和最终准确率；将其因子化假设路径替换为自由文本集成会导致头部排序性能下降最大，而顺序细化相比 FHS 强并行第一轮没有额外增益。
Conclusion: 作者认为因子化假设路径是 head-ranking 性能的关键，顺序细化不带来额外提升；研究范围限定在分类体系检索任务，且对比基线为非 oracle 方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Do 3D Medical Foundation Models See Through MRI Artifacts? A Controlled Study of Representation Robustness
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised 3D medical foundation models are increasingly used as general-purpose feature extractors, yet their sensitivity to MRI artifacts remains poorly understood. We present a controlled evaluation of representation robustness across five pretrained 3D encoders spanning different architectures, objectives, pretraining domains, and dataset scales. Using BraTS-Africa cases with four MRI sequences, we generate seven frequency- and image-domain artifacts at five predefined corruption settings. Robustness is assessed using linear centered kernel alignment (CKA), RankMe, and UMAP, complemented by an independent segmentation-consistency analysis. We find that robustness is strongly model- and artifact-dependent. 3DINO exhibits the most consistently stable representations, while BrainIAC is highly sensitive to several corruptions; NeuroVFM, BrainFM, and Neuro-SimCLR show intermediate but distinct artifact-specific profiles. Across many conditions, CKA decreases substantially while RankMe remains comparatively stable, indicating that artifacts often distort representation geometry without causing dimensional collapse. Segmentation consistency also degrades under corruption, particularly for ghosting and Rician noise, but aligns only partially with representation-level robustness. These findings show that larger-scale or domain-specific pretraining alone does not guarantee artifact invariance and motivate explicit robustness evaluation before deploying 3D foundation models in heterogeneous MRI settings.
papers.comment: Accepted at the ECCV 2026 Workshop on Artificial Intelligence for Medical 3D Vision (AI4M3D)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在受控条件下评估五个预训练3D医学编码器对MRI伪影的表征鲁棒性，使用BraTS-Africa的四个MRI序列生成七种频域和图像域伪影、五种腐蚀设置，并以线性CKA、RankMe、UMAP及分割一致性进行分析。结果显示鲁棒性高度依赖模型与伪影类型：3DINO最稳定，BrainIAC对多种腐蚀敏感，其余模型呈中间但各异的伪影特定特征；CKA下降而RankMe相对稳定，说明伪影扭曲表征几何但未造成维度坍缩。
Motivation: 自监督3D医学基础模型被广泛用作通用特征提取器，但其对MRI伪影的敏感性仍不清楚，而真实异构MRI环境中伪影普遍存在，缺乏系统评估。
Method: 提出一个受控评估框架：选取五个覆盖不同架构、目标、预训练领域和数据集规模的3D编码器，在BraTS-Africa四个MRI序列上生成七种频域与图像域伪影，每种设置五种腐蚀强度；用线性中心核对齐（CKA）、RankMe和UMAP评估表征鲁棒性，并辅以独立的分割一致性分析。
Result: 鲁棒性强烈依赖模型和伪影类型；3DINO表征最稳定，BrainIAC对多种腐蚀高度敏感，NeuroVFM、BrainFM和Neuro-SimCLR表现中等但伪影特定特征各异；多数条件下CKA显著下降而RankMe保持稳定，分割一致性在鬼影和Rician噪声下退化，且与表征级鲁棒性仅部分一致。
Conclusion: 更大规模或领域特定的预训练本身并不能保证对MRI伪影的不变性，在异构MRI环境中部署3D基础模型前需要显式的鲁棒性评估。

papers.title: SLED: Scalable Location Encoding via Distillation
papers.abstract_en: The plethora of readily available geospatial data offers exciting opportunities to learn high quality representations of the planet, but the sheer size of the Earth Observations (EO), differing modalities, and different sensor types pose significant challenges in doing so. Location encoders have emerged as an efficient way of compressing EOs into location-specific embeddings. However, current state-of-the-art location encoders rely on computationally expensive CLIP-style frameworks that require large batch sizes in the 16K--32K range, suffer from false negative samples, and scale poorly with additional modalities. We introduce the Scalable Location Encoder via Distillation (SLED), a distillation-based location encoder that uses geospatial location as a binding modality to pretrain location encoders with any modality of geospatial data. The resulting location encoder framework is lightweight, modular, and can flexibly incorporate multiple modes, while eliminating the need for spatiotemporal coregistration of samples. SLED is performant with batch sizes as small as 128, enabling pretraining at a fraction of the runtime and compute costs of current state-of-the-art models. We demonstrate our approach by pretraining unimodal and multimodal SLED models on Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2, and Landsat imagery. We show that both unimodal and multimodal SLED models keep pace with or outperform existing approaches on a diverse set of 19 human-centric benchmark tasks and explore the benefits of using additional modes in pretraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现有位置编码器依赖 CLIP 风格框架、需要超大 batch size 且难以扩展多模态的问题，提出 SLED（Scalable Location Encoder via Distillation），一种以地理位置作为绑定模态的蒸馏式位置编码器。作者在 Sentinel-1、Sentinel-2 和 Landsat 影像上预训练单模态与多模态 SLED，并在 19 个人类中心任务上表明其性能与现有方法相当或更好，同时将 batch size 从 16K–32K 降至 128，显著降低预训练计算成本。
Motivation: 现有最先进的位置编码器使用 CLIP 风格框架，需要 16K–32K 的大 batch size、存在假负样本问题，且难以随模态数量扩展，这限制了地理空间数据表征学习的效率与可扩展性。
Method: SLED 采用蒸馏（distillation）策略，将地理位置作为绑定模态（binding modality），使位置编码器可以与任意地理空间数据模态进行预训练，无需时空配准，并且框架轻量、模块化，可灵活融合多种模态。
Result: 在 Sentinel-1、Sentinel-2 和 Landsat 影像上预训练的单模态和多模态 SLED，在 19 个人类中心基准任务上与现有方法持平或更好；batch size 小至 128 即可训练，预训练时间和计算成本大幅降低。
Conclusion: 作者表明基于蒸馏的位置编码框架能够以更低资源实现同等或更优性能，并探索了额外模态在预训练中的收益；摘要未提及方法在降水或天气预报任务上的直接验证。

papers.title: Automated item evaluation: Predicting item acceptance and rejection using LLM-generated critiques
papers.abstract_en: Automated item evaluation (AIE) refers to the use of computational methods to assess item quality without requiring manual expert review or field testing of the items under evaluation. We aimed to build a near-comprehensive AIE model by predicting item acceptance and rejection from item text using historical rejection data from a large-scale standardized testing program. The dataset contained 52,759 English language arts (ELA) and mathematics items with 34% permanently rejected from future operational use. Rejection reasons included poor psychometric properties, content issues, bias and sensitivity concerns, and non-content issues. We fine-tuned a DeBERTaV3-large classifier on raw item text, a second DeBERTa classifier on Qwen3-generated item critiques, and a fusion model combining representations from both. The fusion model achieved the strongest overall performance (Accuracy = .75, F1 = .64, AUC = .80, Sensitivity = .64, Specificity = .81). Prediction for math (F1 = .73, AUC = .86) was considerably more accurate than ELA (F1 = .51, AUC = .72). Lowering the decision threshold from .5 to .25 raised average sensitivity for ELA and math to .88 and .91, while reducing specificity to .31 and .56, respectively, which may be preferable in automated item generation contexts where generating items is cheaper than evaluating them. Incorporating item critiques alongside raw item text improved performance across most rejection reasons. The model assigned higher rejection probabilities to more difficult items. However, the fusion model struggled to identify items flagged for bias, sensitivity, fairness, or accessibility, especially for ELA. These findings suggest that text-based AIE is feasible in some areas and may offer a practical tool for reducing the burden of manual review and field testing, while also underscoring the importance of human review for items with fairness concerns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于大语言模型生成批评意见 (critiques) 的自动化试题评估 (automated item evaluation, AIE) 方法，利用某大规模标准化测试项目中 52,759 道 ELA 与数学试题的历史淘汰数据，构建三个 DeBERTa 分类器（原始文本、Qwen3 生成的试题批评、两者融合）来预测试题是否会被永久拒绝。融合模型表现最佳（Accuracy = .75, F1 = .64, AUC = .80），数学题预测明显优于 ELA；降低决策阈值可大幅提升灵敏度。
Motivation: 试题质量评估通常依赖人工专家评审和现场测试，成本高且难以规模化。作者希望利用历史淘汰数据构建近乎全面的文本驱动 AIE 模型，在不需要人工评审或实测的情况下预测试题的接受与拒绝。
Method: 作者在原始试题文本上微调 DeBERTaV3-large 分类器，并在 Qwen3 生成的试题批评文本上微调第二个 DeBERTa 分类器，再融合两者的表示构建 fusion model；数据集包含 52,759 道 ELA 和数学试题，其中 34% 被永久拒绝，拒绝原因涵盖心理测量属性差、内容问题、偏见与敏感性及非内容问题。
Result: 融合模型整体 Accuracy = .75, F1 = .64, AUC = .80, Sensitivity = .64, Specificity = .81；数学题（F1 = .73, AUC = .86）明显优于 ELA（F1 = .51, AUC = .72）。将决策阈值从 .5 降到 .25 后，ELA 和数学的平均灵敏度分别升至 .88 和 .91，特异性降至 .31 和 .56；模型对更难试题给出更高的拒绝概率，但难以识别涉及偏见、敏感性、公平性或可及性的试题，尤其是 ELA。
Conclusion: 摘要认为基于文本的 AIE 在某些领域可行，可作为减轻人工评审和现场测试负担的实用工具；模型与基于批评的表示融合在多数拒绝原因上改善了预测，但涉及公平性问题的试题仍需人工审查。

papers.title: Pre-Inference Routing for Cost-Efficient Document Field Extraction
papers.abstract_en: Most document-extraction systems use a single model for all documents. This is simple but can be costly for easy cases and less effective for difficult ones. We examine whether we can predict a document's difficulty before extraction using inexpensive, document-based signals, and use this to choose between a cheaper and a stronger extractor. We find that routing only helps if two conditions hold: the cheaper model fails often enough to make routing worthwhile, and those failures can be predicted from visible features such as image quality and layout. We turn these into a practical test and apply it to five genres. When both conditions are met, the calibrated router reduces cost by 31-33% on receipts and 77% on degraded ad-buy forms while keeping quality within 0.02 F1 of always choosing the large model. Routing does not help if either condition is missing, as with clean digital invoices or nutrition labels that are already easy to read. A small labeled pilot can predict whether routing will work, and in the two cases where we ran it first, the prediction was correct. A simple bag-of-words router works about as well as engineered features, showing that the main limit is the genre, not the router design; we use interpretable features to help explain which genres can be routed. The router must be retrained for each dataset and does not transfer across datasets, even within the same genre. These results hold for two model pairs with cost differences of 5x and 3x.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究文档字段抽取（document field extraction）中的预推理路由：在抽取前用廉价的文档信号预测难度，并在廉价模型与更强模型之间做选择。摘要报告称，当“廉价模型失败足够频繁”和“失败可从图像质量、版面等可见特征预测”两个条件都满足时，标定的路由器在收据上降低 31-33% 成本、在退化广告购买表单上降低 77% 成本，且 F1 距离始终选择大模型不超过 0.02；任一条件缺失时路由无帮助。结果表明收益主要由文档体裁决定，路由器需按数据集重训，不能跨数据集迁移。
Motivation: 大多数文档抽取系统对所有文档使用单一模型，对简单案例成本过高、对困难案例效果不足。作者希望验证能否在抽取前利用廉价信号判断文档难度，从而在低成本与强抽取模型之间做出路由选择，以降低整体成本。
Method: 提出基于预处理文档信号（如图像质量、版面）的预推理路由，并将路由有效的条件归纳为两条：廉价模型失败率足够高，且失败可从可见特征预测。作者据此构造实用检验，在五类文档体裁上测试，并对比了标定的路由器、简单词袋（bag-of-words）路由与工程化特征路由，同时用小型有标注试点预测路由是否可行。
Result: 在两类满足条件的体裁上，路由在收据上降低 31-33% 成本、在退化的广告购买表单上降低 77% 成本，质量保持在始终选大模型的 0.02 F1 以内；在干净数字发票和营养标签等易读体裁上没有收益。词袋路由器与工程化特征效果相近，说明限制在体裁而非路由器设计；结果在成本差为 5 倍与 3 倍的两组模型对上成立。
Conclusion: 摘要强调路由收益高度依赖文档体裁，两个前置条件缺一不可；路由器针对每个数据集重训且不跨数据集迁移，但小型试点可以提前预测路由是否值得采用。

papers.title: Alkali Metallicity, Mineral Clouds, and Deep Atmospheric Variability on Jupiter
papers.abstract_en: The bulk elemental abundances of Jupiter provide critical insights into its formation history and interior structure. Recent observations by the Juno Microwave Radiometer (MWR) reveal a deep Jovian atmosphere significantly depleted in electrons, implying an alkali metal (Na, K) abundance of 10^-1 - 10^-5 times solar. This depletion stands in sharp contrast to the supersolar volatile enrichments measured by the Galileo probe. We propose that this apparent depletion arises from mineral cloud-induced processes deep in the atmosphere. We explore two physical mechanisms using thermochemical and microphysical modeling. In the "chemical sequestration" scenario, vigorous vertical mixing lofts deep refractory condensates (e.g., spinel) into the 1000-2000 bar region, where they react to form alkali feldspars (albite) and feldspathoids (leucite), efficiently sequestering gaseous Na and K. In the "dust-catalyzed recombination" scenario, the bulk alkali inventory remains gaseous, but the free electron density is suppressed by dust-plasma interactions. Thermally emitted alkali ions from the surfaces of micron-sized iron and silicate grains significantly increase the cation density, driving rapid recombination of free electrons. Both mechanisms allow for a bulk solar or even supersolar alkali inventory while suppressing the electron density to match Juno observations. Analyzing an extended dataset of MWR observations with 61 perijoves, we detect spatial variability in the deep atmosphere that suggests modulation by mineral clouds. Our findings challenge the traditional rainout framework, unveiling a deep "mineralogical zone" in Jupiter shaped by dynamics and heterogeneous chemistry, resembling the photospheres of hot exoplanets and brown dwarfs.

TL;DR: 本文基于 Juno 微波辐射计（MWR）观测发现木星深层大气电子显著耗尽，由此提出碱金属贫乏并非真实丰度，而是深层矿物云过程的产物。作者用热化学和微物理模型提出两种机制：化学封存（深部耐火凝聚物上浮至 1000–2000 bar 区域与气态 Na、K 反应生成碱长石和似长石）与尘埃催化重组（微米级铁和硅酸盐颗粒表面热发射碱金属离子，增大阳离子密度并加速自由电子重组）。两种机制都能在保持太阳或超太阳碱金属总量的同时压低电子密度，匹配 Juno 观测；对 61 个 perijove 的扩展 MWR 数据集分析还检测到深层大气的空间变率。
Motivation: Juno MWR 观测显示木星深层大气电子耗尽，反推碱金属（Na、K）丰度仅为太阳的 10^-1–10^-5 倍，这与 Galileo 探针测得的超太阳挥发性富集直接冲突，现有雨洗（rainout）框架难以解释这种矛盾，需要新的物理机制来调和观测与丰度预期。
Method: 采用热化学与微物理建模，提出两种候选机制：一是化学封存，即强垂直混合将深部耐火凝聚物（如尖晶石）输送到 1000–2000 bar 区域，与气态碱金属反应生成碱性长石（albite）和似长石（leucite）以固定 Na、K；二是尘埃催化重组，即碱金属仍保持气态，但微米级铁和硅酸盐尘埃颗粒表面热发射碱金属离子，增加阳离子密度，驱动自由电子快速复合，从而压低电子密度。
Result: 摘要报告两种机制均可让碱金属总量维持太阳或超太阳丰度，同时将自由电子密度抑制到与 Juno MWR 观测一致的水平；对包含 61 个 perijove 的扩展数据集分析，检测到深层大气存在空间变率，表明矿物云对其有调制作用。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些发现挑战了传统的 rainout 框架，提出木星深层存在一个由动力学和非均质化学塑造的“矿物学带”（mineralogical zone），其行为类似于热木星和褐矮星的光球。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Toward surface-based registration of a virtual preoperative cutting guide onto the mandible for reconstruction surgery
papers.abstract_en: Mandibular reconstruction restores facial continuity and oral function after segmental resection. Patient-specific cutting guides transfer a computed tomography (CT)-based plan to the operating room with three-dimensional information, but printed guides add cost and lead time, cannot adapt after fabrication, and may interrupt surgery if sterility is lost. We investigate a markerless augmented reality (AR) alternative that registers a virtual cutting guide to the exposed mandible from surface geometry. The method extends surface-based registration for the transoral setting, where teeth form the most distinctive visible surface. After camera calibration, a HoloLens 2 time-of-flight camera captures a partial intraoperative point cloud. The user supplies a rough head-based alignment only to crop the region of interest. A teeth-weighted global stage computes correspondences and solves a truncated least-squares rigid alignment. An asymmetric point-to-plane iterative closest point (ICP) stage refines the complete CT mandible against the partial depth cloud target. The guide-to-mandible transform places the guide in the HoloLens world frame, while pose updates and interpolation follow target motion. We define a blinded phantom protocol with 30 target registration error (TRE) points under full, intermediate, and teeth-only exposure, plus a motion-to-display latency test. Our median TRE is 4.05, 6.10, and 7.10 mm respectively, and median latency is 0.805 s. These values support the feasibility of using AR to replace physical prints. The workflow removes mounted fiducials and manual landmark selection and provides a testable path toward transoral cutting guidance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索一种无标记增强现实 (AR) 替代方案，利用表面几何将虚拟切割导板配准到暴露的下颌骨，面向经口下颌骨重建手术。流程在 HoloLens 2 飞行时间相机捕获的部分术中点云上，先用牙齿加权全局配准，再用非对称点面 ICP 细化；盲法体模实验在完全、中等和仅牙齿暴露三种条件下得到 4.05、6.10 和 7.10 mm 的中位目标配准误差 (TRE)，运动到显示延迟中位数为 0.805 s。
Motivation: 患者专用切割导板需要打印，带来成本和交付周期，制作后无法调整，且一旦无菌性受损可能中断手术；本文目标是用无标记 AR 配准替代物理导板，把 CT 三维计划直接转移到手术室。
Method: 提出无标记 AR 配准工作流：相机标定后，HoloLens 2 深度相机采集部分术中点云，用户仅需粗略的头部对齐用于裁剪感兴趣区域；牙齿加权全局配准阶段计算对应关系并求解截断最小二乘刚性对齐，随后非对称点对平面 ICP 阶段将完整 CT 下颌骨细化到部分深度云目标上。导板到下颌骨的变换将导板放入 HoloLens 世界坐标系，并通过姿态更新与插值跟随目标运动。
Result: 在包含 30 个 TRE 点的盲法体模协议下，完全暴露、中等暴露和仅牙齿暴露的中位 TRE 分别为 4.05、6.10 和 7.10 mm，运动到显示延迟中位数为 0.805 s；摘要认为这些数值支持用 AR 替代物理打印导板的可行性。
Conclusion: 该工作流移除了安装式基准标记和手动标志点选择，为经口切割引导提供了可测试的路径；摘要强调其结果支持 AR 替代物理导板的可行性，但未讨论临床精度要求或实际手术验证。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Cascading Through the Hierarchy: Regularizer-Induced Feature Detection as Phase Transitions in Deep Linear Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: A scientific theory of deep learning, comprising learning dynamics and statistical properties of learned models, is rapidly gaining attention. One of the corner stones of this development are analytically solvable toy models, allowing for the fully tractable analysis of the learning dynamics. Here we analytically investigate such a toy model using the regularization strength as a tunable external parameter - akin to external fields in statistical physics. In previous studies, (i) an onset of learning transition was predicted analytically and (ii) it was phenomenologically/numerically established that tuning the regularization strength can result in a cascade of phase transitions. The number of those transitions was linked to the geometry of the loss landscape determined by the model complexity. Setting up a rigorous framework underpinning the previous numerical observations, our investigation reveals a precise connection between those cascades of phase transitions, learnable features and the underlying geometry. We provide analytic predictions of these phase transitions as well as tractable order parameters related to learned features. At the level of the minimal model, we connect this macroscopic perspective (that can be condensed into an effective description) to the microscopic perspective in terms of the geometry of the loss landscape characterized by the Hessian spectrum. Thus, the presented model provides a platform to explore and sharpen advances made in the scientific theory of deep learning rooted in statistical physics concepts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从统计物理视角对深度线性神经网络的 toy model 做解析研究，把正则化强度当作类似外场的可调参数。作者建立了严谨框架，证明调谐正则化强度会导致一串级联相变 (cascade of phase transitions)，并把这些相变、可学习特征与损失景观的几何结构精确联系起来。文章给出了相变的解析预测以及与学习特征相关且可处理的序参量 (order parameters)，在最小模型层面把由 Hessian 谱刻画的微观几何与可压缩为有效描述的宏观视角连接起来。
Motivation: 此前工作已经从解析上预言了学习开始 (onset of learning) 的相变，并通过数值/现象学方法发现正则化强度可诱发级联相变，但缺乏支撑这些数值观察的严格框架。本文旨在建立这一框架，并阐明相变级联与损失景观几何之间的精确联系。
Method: 采用深度线性神经网络的可解析 toy model，以正则化强度作为外部控制参数，对学习动力学做全程可解的解析分析。作者推导了相变的解析条件以及与学习特征相关的序参量，并借助 Hessian 谱把损失景观的微观几何与宏观有效描述联系起来。
Result: 摘要报告该方法揭示了级联相变、可学习特征与底层几何之间的精确对应关系，并提供了相变的解析预测及可处理的序参量；摘要未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 作者强调该最小模型可作为平台，用于检验和发展根植于统计物理概念的深度学习科学理论；其范围限定在深度线性网络的最小模型层级。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Flowing Through States: Neural ODE Regularization for Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Neural networks applied to sequential decision-making tasks typically rely on latent representations of environment states. While environment dynamics dictate how semantic states evolve, the corresponding latent transitions are usually left implicit, creating a potential misalignment between the two. We propose to model latent dynamics explicitly by drawing an analogy between Markov decision process (MDP) trajectories and ordinary differential equation (ODE) flows: in both cases, the current state fully determines its successors. Building on this view, we introduce a neural ODE-based regularization method that enforces latent embeddings to follow consistent ODE flows, thereby aligning representation learning with environment dynamics. Although broadly applicable to deep learning agents, we demonstrate its effectiveness in reinforcement learning by integrating it into Actor-Critic algorithms. Our approach yields major performance gains across various standard Atari benchmarks for A2C and gridworld environments for PPO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于神经 ODE（neural ODE）的正则化方法，用于强化学习中的表示学习。作者将马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）轨迹与常微分方程（ODE）流类比，强制潜在嵌入（latent embeddings）遵循一致的 ODE 流，从而使表示学习与环境动态对齐。将该正则化集成到 Actor-Critic 算法后，在 A2C 的多种标准 Atari 基准和 PPO 的 gridworld 环境中取得显著性能提升。
Motivation: 现有深度智能体依赖环境状态的潜在表示，但环境动态与潜在转移之间往往缺乏显式对应，造成表示学习与环境动态的错位。本文目标是显式建模潜在动态以消除这种错位。
Method: 通过 MDP 轨迹与 ODE 流的类比，引入基于神经 ODE 的正则化项，约束潜在表示沿一致的 ODE 流演化；该正则化可加在深度智能体上，并在本文中集成进 Actor-Critic（A2C、PPO）算法。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在多种标准 Atari 基准上显著提升 A2C 性能，并在 gridworld 环境中提升 PPO 性能；未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法对深度学习智能体具有广泛适用性，并在强化学习场景中验证了其有效性，表明用 ODE 流约束潜在表示有助于对齐表示学习与环境动态。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Beyond "AI Language": The case for the idiolectal nature of LLM output
papers.abstract_en: While large language model outputs are frequently analysed as a collective super variety termed "AI language," this chapter argues that this perspective coexists with distinct, model-specific linguistic signatures akin to human idiolects. We analyse two datasets of LLM-generated texts on societal topics: a 2024 corpus of six models (Improta et al. 2024) and a newly generated 2026 corpus using the same prompts featuring six contemporary models. Our findings, utilising computational descriptors and stylometric principal component analysis reveal a generational shift between the style of the 2024 and 2026 cohorts, while demonstrating that each individual model maintains a unique linguistic profile. This multi-layered interplay is illustrated by contraction frequencies, which vary from over 1,200 to over 30,000 per million words within the same cohort of models (2026). Ultimately, we conclude that treating LLM output as idiolectal in nature provides a valuable framework with potential implications for research on variation and change, LLM-generated text detection, forensic linguistics and usage-based approaches to language.
papers.comment: 33 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Submitted as a chapter to the post-workshop volume "Corpus Linguistics 2040" (Digital Linguistics series)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文主张将大语言模型（LLM）的输出视为具有模型特定语言特征的“个人语言习语”（idiolect），而非单一的整体“AI language”变体。作者分析了两个基于相同提示生成的语料：2024年包含六个模型的语料，以及2026年同样包含六个当代模型的新语料。通过计算描述符和风格计量主成分分析（PCA），研究发现模型风格存在从2024到2026的代际转变，同时每个模型保持独特的语言轮廓。例如，2026年同一批模型中缩写出现的频率在每百万词1200到30000次之间变化。
Motivation: 现有研究常将LLM输出作为集体性的超级变体“AI language”来分析，忽略不同模型可能具有各自稳定的语言特征。本文旨在论证从类似人类个人习语的角度看待LLM输出，能够更准确刻画模型间差异及其随时间的变化。
Method: 使用两组数据集：2024年的六个模型语料（Improta et al. 2024）和新生成的2026年六个当代模型语料，采用相同的提示。分析方法包括计算语言描述符和风格计量主成分分析（stylometric PCA），并借助缩写频率等具体指标进行说明。
Result: 分析显示2024与2026两个模型代际之间存在风格上的整体转变，同时每个单独模型都保持独特的语言轮廓。缩写频率在2026年同批模型中差异显著，从每百万词超过1200到超过30000不等。
Conclusion: 作者认为，将LLM输出视为具有个人习语性质提供了一个有价值的分析框架，对语言变异与变化研究、LLM生成文本检测、法医语言学（forensic linguistics）以及基于用法的语言方法具有潜在启示。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SyncSBC: Decentralized Swarm Behavior Prediction for Synchronized Autonomous Control
papers.abstract_en: Robot swarms utilize many independent limited-sensing agents to produce complex emergent behaviors without requiring centralized control. However, little research explores how agents can infer swarm-level behavior from purely local perception, a capability critical for detecting faults and behavior changes. In this paper, we introduce Synchronized Swarm Behavior Classification (SyncSBC), which combines improvements in machine learning and distributed consensus to classify collective swarm behavior and synchronize swarm decision-making in an entirely decentralized manner. We show that SyncSBC achieves high classification accuracy and low synchronization delay, making it suitable for real-world deployment. Finally, we use SyncSBC to demonstrate two promising swarm applications on real robots where we show that swarms utilizing SyncSBC can accurately identify anomalies in robot behavior and autonomously coordinate collective changes in swarm behavior. Videos, code and supplemental experiments are available at https://sites.google.com/view/sync-sbc/home.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SyncSBC（Synchronized Swarm Behavior Classification），一种完全去中心化的蜂群行为分类与决策同步方法，结合机器学习与分布式共识，使每个智能体仅凭局部感知推断蜂群级别的集体行为。摘要报告该方法在真实机器人上实现了高分类精度和低同步延迟，并演示了异常行为识别与集体行为自主协调两个应用。
Motivation: 机器人蜂群依赖大量感知受限的独立智能体产生涌现行为，但现有研究很少探讨智能体如何仅凭局部感知推断蜂群级行为，而这种能力对检测故障和行为变化至关重要。
Method: 提出 SyncSBC，在改进机器学习分类器的基础上引入分布式共识机制，使蜂群能够在完全去中心化的条件下对集体行为进行分类并同步决策。
Result: 摘要称 SyncSBC 达到高分类精度和低同步延迟，适合实际部署；在真实机器人上成功识别智能体行为异常，并自主协调蜂群集体行为的变化。
Conclusion: 作者认为 SyncSBC 为去中心化蜂群提供了感知集体状态并同步决策的可行途径，并已在真实机器人的两个应用中验证，相关代码和视频已公开。

papers.title: Juno Microwave Observations Reveal Jupiter's Deep Alkali-Chlorine Relation
papers.abstract_en: The longest-wavelength channel of the Juno Microwave Radiometer (MWR) probes Jupiter's kilobar atmosphere through free electrons produced by sodium and potassium ionization. Under equilibrium chemistry the electron abundance is the small residual of the charge balance between alkali cations and the anions Cl- and HS-. Chlorine is not directly measurable in Jupiter's deep atmosphere because gaseous HCl is removed from the observable atmosphere by NH4Cl condensation, whereas sulfur has been measured by the Galileo probe. The MWR-derived electron measurement therefore constrains the alkali-to-chlorine ratio rather than the alkali abundance alone. We combine the MWR observations with equilibrium chemistry and microwave radiative transfer in a Bayesian framework, finding that the deep gas-phase elemental alkali-to-chlorine abundance ratio is (Na+K)/Cl = 0.05 over 0.3-5 times solar in chlorine, about 180 times below the protosolar ratio of 8.7. At 3 times solar chlorine, the inferred alkali metallicity is 1.6 x 10^-2 times solar (1 sigma: 1.2 x 10^-2 - 2.7 x 10^-2 times solar), while at low chlorine abundance HS- sets an alkali floor near 10^-3 times solar. The inferred gas-phase alkali abundance exceeds the ~10^-5 times solar threshold by more than two orders of magnitude and rules out the long-proposed global kilobar radiative zone. Because sodium and potassium are refractory whereas chlorine is volatile, the inferred ratio provides a new diagnostic of the rock-to-ice balance in the solids accreted by Jupiter. This compositional interpretation assumes equilibrium chemistry; if lofted mineral clouds instead control the electron abundance under disequilibrium conditions, the inferred alkali-chlorine relationship need not hold.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 3 figures. Submitted to AAS Journals
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用朱诺号微波辐射计（Juno MWR）最长波长通道探测木星千巴大气中由钠和钾电离产生的自由电子，在贝叶斯框架下结合平衡化学与微波辐射传输，推断深层气相碱金属与氯的丰度比。结果显示 (Na+K)/Cl 约为 0.05，比原太阳比值 8.7 低约 180 倍，并排除了长期提出的全球千巴辐射区。作者指出该解释依赖平衡化学假设，若不平衡条件下抬升矿物云控制电子丰度，则结论不成立。
Motivation: 木星深层大气中的氯无法直接测量，因为气态 HCl 会因 NH4Cl 冷凝而从可观测大气中移除，而硫已有伽利略探测器测量；MWR 的电子测量只能约束碱金属与氯的比例而非碱金属丰度本身，需要结合观测与化学模型来推断深层元素丰度。
Method: 将 Juno MWR 观测与平衡化学模型和微波辐射传输相结合，采用贝叶斯框架推断深层气相碱金属-氯丰度比；考察氯丰度为太阳的 0.3-5 倍的情况，并考虑低氯丰度下 HS- 对碱金属丰度下限的设定。
Result: 推断 (Na+K)/Cl = 0.05，约为原太阳丰度比 8.7 的 1/180；在 3 倍太阳氯丰度下，碱金属金属度为太阳的 1.6×10^-2 倍（1σ: 1.2×10^-2-2.7×10^-2），气相碱金属丰度比约 10^-5 太阳阈值高出两个数量级以上，排除了全球千巴辐射区。
Conclusion: 由于钠、钾为难熔元素而氯为挥发性元素，推断出的碱金属-氯比值可诊断木星吸积固体中岩石与冰的比例；但该结论基于平衡化学假设，若不平衡条件下矿物云控制电子丰度，则碱-氯关系不一定成立。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: CrystalGRPO: Target-Aligned and Coverage-Preserving Reinforcement Learning for Flow-Based Crystal Structure Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Flow-based generative models can efficiently produce candidate structures for crystal structure prediction (CSP), but their pretrained objectives do not directly optimize downstream target recovery. Reinforcement-learning post-training offers a flexible solution, yet existing approaches rely primarily on energy rewards and coordinate-only stochastic policies. Predicted energy does not identify the reference polymorph, while reward-driven concentration can reduce the candidate coverage required for Top-N recovery. We introduce CrystalGRPO, a CSP-aligned post-training framework that extends existing ODE-to-SDE policy constructions to the joint coordinate--lattice state. CrystalGRPO combines MACE-predicted energy with a StructureMatcher-based recovery score and provides two operating modes: CrystalGRPO-Q, which prioritizes single-draw recovery, and CrystalGRPO-C, which combines full-trajectory reference regularization with a coverage-aware group advantage to preserve finite-budget target recovery. Across MP-20 and MPTS-52 with PXRDGen and OMatG backbones, both variants reduce one- and twenty-sample RMSE relative to coordinate-only reinforcement in all four backbone--dataset settings. CrystalGRPO-Q consistently improves Top-1, whereas CrystalGRPO-C achieves a higher Top-20 across all settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CrystalGRPO，一个面向流式晶体结构预测 (CSP) 的强化学习后训练框架。该方法将现有 ODE-to-SDE 策略构建扩展到联合坐标-晶格状态，结合 MACE 预测能量与基于 StructureMatcher 的恢复分数，并提供 CrystalGRPO-Q 和 CrystalGRPO-C 两种模式。在 MP-20 和 MPTS-52 上使用 PXRDGen 与 OMatG 骨干的四个设置中，两种变体均相对仅坐标强化学习降低单样本与二十样本 RMSE，其中 Q 模式稳定提升 Top-1，C 模式在所有设置中获得更高 Top-20。
Motivation: 基于流的生成模型预训练目标不直接优化下游目标恢复，而现有强化学习后处理主要依赖能量奖励和仅坐标的随机策略；预测能量无法识别参考多晶型，且奖励驱动的集中化可能减少 Top-N 恢复所需的候选覆盖。
Method: CrystalGRPO 将 ODE-to-SDE 策略构建扩展到坐标与晶格联合状态，采用 MACE 预测能量和 StructureMatcher 恢复分数作为奖励，并设计两种运行模式：CrystalGRPO-Q 优先单次采样恢复，CrystalGRPO-C 结合全轨迹参考正则化与覆盖感知的组优势以保持有限预算下的目标覆盖。
Result: 在 MP-20 与 MPTS-52 数据集上，分别搭配 PXRDGen 和 OMatG 骨干的四个设置中，CrystalGRPO-Q 与 CrystalGRPO-C 均相对仅坐标强化降低一样本和二十样本 RMSE；Q 模式一致提升 Top-1，C 模式在所有设置中达到更高 Top-20。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，通过扩展策略状态空间并引入覆盖感知优势，CSP 对齐的后训练可以同时改善单次采样与有限预算下的目标恢复性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Improving Low-Resolution Face Recognition under Limited Data: How Synthetic Data Generation Can Close the Domain Gap
papers.abstract_en: Face Recognition (FR) systems in surveillance settings often encounter Low Resolution (LR) faces, those whose face region falls below the standard 112 $\times$ 112 input size. While labelled High Resolution (HR) training data is abundant, labelled native-LR data, and above all paired native LR/HR data, is scarce. One workaround is to synthesize LR data from the available HR faces, but how much synthesis effort is repaid in recognition accuracy remains unclear. We present a study of simple synthetic generation strategies for a compact, edge device-oriented face recognition system, spanning interpolation-based degradation, knowledge distillation, a Prepended Domain Transformer (PDT), Real ESRGAN-style degradation, and a learned Super Resolution (SR) front-end with an identity-aware loss. We evaluate these strategies on synthetic cross-resolution face benchmarks (LFW, CFP-FP, AgeDB-30) and on TinyFace, a real-world native LR dataset, and expose a synthetic-real gap: the degradation setting that is optimal on synthetic benchmarks is not the one that is optimal on real LR. We find that more synthesis effort does not help monotonically: the learned SR front-end does not surpass a direct feed of the aligned LR image into a strong backbone, while simple interpolation augmentation of a compact backbone is the only synthesis that improves over its own baseline. We conclude that generative methods for LR face recognition must be validated on real LR and against a direct-feed baseline, and release our pipeline at https://idiap.ch/paper/synth-lrfr
papers.comment: Accepted at IEEE International Joint Conference on Biometrics (IJCB) 2026, Focus Session on Generative AI for Fair and Secure Biometrics under Limited Data
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对监控场景中低于 112×112 输入尺寸的低分辨率 (Low Resolution, LR) 人脸识别问题，研究了几种从高分辨率 (HR) 人脸合成 LR 数据的简单策略，用于一个面向边缘设备的紧凑人脸识别系统。作者在合成跨分辨率基准 (LFW、CFP-FP、AgeDB-30) 和真实原生 LR 数据集 TinyFace 上评估这些策略，并揭示了合成与真实数据之间的领域差距；他们发现更多合成投入并不单调地带来收益，学习式超分辨率前端未能超过直接将对齐 LR 图像送入强主干的方案，而简单插值增强是唯一能超过自身基线的合成策略。
Motivation: 监控场景中的 FR 系统常遇到人脸区域小于标准 112×112 输入尺寸的 LR 人脸，而有标注的原生 LR 数据、尤其是成对的原生 LR/HR 数据非常稀缺。一种变通方法是从现有 HR 人脸合成 LR 数据，但合成投入多少能换来多少识别精度提升仍不清楚。
Method: 面向紧凑的边缘设备人脸识别系统，研究了多种简单合成生成策略，包括基于插值的退化 (interpolation-based degradation)、知识蒸馏 (knowledge distillation)、前置领域 Transformer (Prepended Domain Transformer, PDT)、Real-ESRGAN 风格退化，以及带身份感知损失 (identity-aware loss) 的学习式超分辨率 (Super Resolution, SR) 前端。
Result: 在 LFW、CFP-FP、AgeDB-30 等合成跨分辨率基准和真实原生 LR 数据集 TinyFace 上的评估显示存在合成-真实差距：在合成基准上最优的退化设置在真实 LR 上并非最优。更多合成努力并不单调地提高性能；学习式 SR 前端并未超过将对齐 LR 图像直接送入强主干的方案，而紧凑主干的简单插值增强是唯一相对自身基线有提升的合成方法。
Conclusion: 作者认为用于 LR 人脸识别的生成式方法必须在真实 LR 数据上、并与直接送入 (direct-feed) 基线对比进行验证，并发布了其 pipeline (https://idiap.ch/paper/synth-lrfr)。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对监控场景中低于 112×112 输入尺寸的低分辨率 (Low Resolution, LR) 人脸识别问题，研究了几种从高分辨率 (HR) 人脸合成 LR 数据的简单策略，用于一个面向边缘设备的紧凑人脸识别系统。作者在合成跨分辨率基准 (LFW、CFP-FP、AgeDB-30) 和真实原生 LR 数据集 TinyFace 上评估这些策略，并揭示了合成与真实数据之间的领域差距；他们发现更多合成投入并不单调地带来收益，学习式超分辨率前端未能超过直接将对齐 LR 图像送入强主干的方案，而简单插值增强是唯一能超过自身基线的合成策略。
summary_sections.motivation: 监控场景中的 FR 系统常遇到人脸区域小于标准 112×112 输入尺寸的 LR 人脸，而有标注的原生 LR 数据、尤其是成对的原生 LR/HR 数据非常稀缺。一种变通方法是从现有 HR 人脸合成 LR 数据，但合成投入多少能换来多少识别精度提升仍不清楚。
summary_sections.method: 面向紧凑的边缘设备人脸识别系统，研究了多种简单合成生成策略，包括基于插值的退化 (interpolation-based degradation)、知识蒸馏 (knowledge distillation)、前置领域 Transformer (Prepended Domain Transformer, PDT)、Real-ESRGAN 风格退化，以及带身份感知损失 (identity-aware loss) 的学习式超分辨率 (Super Resolution, SR) 前端。
summary_sections.result: 在 LFW、CFP-FP、AgeDB-30 等合成跨分辨率基准和真实原生 LR 数据集 TinyFace 上的评估显示存在合成-真实差距：在合成基准上最优的退化设置在真实 LR 上并非最优。更多合成努力并不单调地提高性能；学习式 SR 前端并未超过将对齐 LR 图像直接送入强主干的方案，而紧凑主干的简单插值增强是唯一相对自身基线有提升的合成方法。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为用于 LR 人脸识别的生成式方法必须在真实 LR 数据上、并与直接送入 (direct-feed) 基线对比进行验证，并发布了其 pipeline (https://idiap.ch/paper/synth-lrfr)。

papers.title: Divergent Response Modes in Frontier Language Models Under Steering Pressure
papers.abstract_en: Frontier language models are trained using distinct data, objectives, and safety pipelines. Whether these differences produce measurably different behaviors under explicit steering pressure remains underexplored. This study evaluates behavioral steerability across six frontier models from six developers using 300 paired base and steered items over three categories: values-conflict, reasoning-elicitation, and reasoning-suppression (plus 40 validation items). All six models act as blind peer judges and classify every response based on fixed behavioral rubrics. The resulting 24,480 judgments are scored by leave-one-out consensus. We find that models differ not just in how much steering shifts their behavior but in what kind (mode) of response they give, and some response modes appear in only one or two of them. GPT-5 deflects requests to disclose its reasoning while leaving its answer intact (99% vs. 0% for all other models). Claude Opus 4.7 and GPT-5 resist explicit suppression instructions and in different ways. Using Llama as the open-weight model, we trace the largest behavioral split to its internals. A linear probe decodes the behavior from the residual stream at 0.87 held-out accuracy while injecting that direction during generation drives the behavior from 0% to 86% across an intervention sweep. Every finding holds under both a token-budget remediation and a control experiment with a hypothesis-blind judgment prompt.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文考察六家前沿语言模型在显式引导压力下的行为可引导性，使用 300 对基线与引导项、40 个验证项，覆盖价值观冲突、推理诱发和推理抑制三类任务，并由六模型互评加留一法共识生成 24,480 条判断。研究发现模型不仅在引导改变行为程度上不同，而且响应模式种类也不同，部分模式仅出现在一两个模型中，例如 GPT-5 在 99% 情况下拒绝披露推理过程而答案不变，Claude Opus 4.7 与 GPT-5 以不同方式抵抗显式抑制指令。作者用 Llama 作为开放权重模型，通过线性探针以 0.87 留出准确率从残差流解码行为，并向该方向注入以在干预扫描中将行为从 0% 驱动到 86%；所有发现在 token 预算补救与假设盲判断提示的对照实验下均成立。
Motivation: 前沿语言模型使用不同数据、目标和安全流程训练，但这些差异是否会在明确引导压力下产生可测量的行为差异仍未被充分探索，本文针对这一空白开展跨模型行为可引导性的系统评估。
Method: 选取六个开发者发布的六个前沿模型，用 300 对基线与引导项和 40 个验证项，在价值观冲突、推理诱发、推理抑制三类上评估行为可引导性；所有模型作为盲评审按固定行为标准分类，并用留一法共识打分；对 Llama 使用线性探针从残差流解码行为，并在生成时注入该方向进行干预扫描。
Result: 模型在引导下不仅改变程度不同，响应模式种类也不同，某些模式仅出现在一两个模型中；GPT-5 拒绝披露推理但保持答案完整（99% 对比其余模型 0%），Claude Opus 4.7 与 GPT-5 以不同方式抵抗显式抑制；对 Llama 的线性探针达到 0.87 留出准确率，注入该方向后行为从 0% 升至 86%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调前沿模型在引导压力下呈现出不同的响应模式，部分模式为个别模型独有，且这些发现经受住 token 预算补救和假设盲判断对照实验的检验。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Implicit Neural Speckle Denoising
papers.abstract_en: Speckle fundamentally limits coherent imaging by introducing multiplicative, spatially correlated noise that obscures scene structure. Removing speckle noise from dynamic scenes--that do not benefit from conventional speckle averaging--is particularly challenging. We introduce a training-free framework that combines a spatiotemporal implicit neural representation with an aperture-aware maximum-likelihood formulation to recover dynamic, speckle-free imagery directly from noisy observations. The coherent likelihood explicitly models the aperture-dependent spatial covariance of speckle, enabling adaptation to arbitrary pupil geometries without retraining. A matrix-free implementation based on FFT-accelerated operators, stochastic approximations, and conjugate gradients makes optimization practical for realistic image sizes. Meanwhile, a blind holdout criterion provides automatic early stopping without clean reference data. Simulated and laboratory results demonstrate improved spatial fidelity, temporal consistency, and robustness to varying speckle statistics relative to classical, unsupervised, and supervised baselines.
papers.comment: comments: 9 pages, 9 figures; supplemental document included
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需训练的去斑框架，结合时空隐式神经表示（implicit neural representation）与孔径感知最大似然（aperture-aware maximum-likelihood）建模，直接从噪声观测恢复动态无散斑图像。相干似然显式建模孔径相关的散斑空间协方差，无需重训练即可适应任意光瞳几何；矩阵自由的实现采用 FFT 加速算子、随机近似与共轭梯度，使优化对实际图像尺寸可行。模拟与实验室实验显示，相比经典、无监督和监督基线，该方法在空间保真度、时间一致性以及对不同散斑统计的鲁棒性上均更优。
Motivation: 散斑通过引入乘性、空间相关噪声从根本上限制相干成像，动态场景无法受益于常规的散斑平均，去除其噪声尤其困难。
Method: 提出训练自由的框架，将时空隐式神经表示与孔径感知的最大似然公式结合；通过 FFT 加速算子、随机近似和共轭梯度的矩阵自由实现完成优化，并采用盲留出准则（blind holdout criterion）在无干净参考数据的情况下自动早停。
Result: 摘要报告模拟与实验室结果表明，该方法在空间保真度、时间一致性和对变化散斑统计的鲁棒性上优于经典、无监督和监督基线。
Conclusion: 该框架的核心优势是无需重训练即可适应任意光瞳几何，并且不需要干净参考数据即可自动停止训练；摘要强调其在动态相干成像去散斑中的有效性。

papers.title: Quantization Damage Is Multiplicative, Not Additive
papers.abstract_en: Quantization is how large language models are actually deployed, and below four bits it is known to hurt. What nobody can say is which of the model's decisions will change at a given bit-width. The damage is silent: a compressed agent stops calling its tools, then loses half its safety refusals, yet benchmark scores barely move. Prior work assumes quantization adds noise of a roughly fixed size, which would make confident decisions safe. We measure the decision itself instead. The margin of a two-way decision is the model's score for the option it picks minus the score of its best alternative; we track it before and after quantization across 16 models from 8 model families, three quantization methods, and bit-widths from 8 down to 2. Quantization does not add fixed-size noise to the margin. It multiplies the margin by a factor that collapses with bit-width (median 0.86 at 4 bits, 0.33 at 3, 0.00 at 2); we call this margin shrinkage. This contraction reduces the protection a large margin affords; the model's own small biases pick the direction of failure: at 3 bits the decision to call a tool collapses toward inaction while the choice of which tool is untouched. In fitted statistical comparison, additive-noise accounts never win on the damaged tool and safety decisions. The fitted relation predicts flip rates within a median of 1.8 percentage points on held-out decisions, though no flip was used in the fit; per decision, the predicted flip probabilities are calibrated uncertainty estimates (expected calibration error 0.004 over 131,758 predictions). The same form holds in every model we measure, but the constants are each model's own and do not transfer. A small paired margin set, measured per model and bit-width, estimates which decisions break without full generative evaluation; under our cost-matched tests, nothing repairs damage more cheaply than one more bit.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 9 figures, 7 tables. Under review at the Third Workshop on Uncertainty-Aware NLP (UncertaiNLP), EMNLP 2026 (non-archival)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型量化（quantization）对决策的损害，指出低于 4 bit 的量化虽然使基准分数几乎不变，却已导致工具调用失败和安全拒绝大幅减少。作者直接测量二选一决策的 margin（选中选项得分减次优选项得分）在量化前后的变化，在 16 个模型、8 个模型家族、三种量化方法和 8 到 2 bit 位宽下发现量化不是添加固定大小的噪声，而是乘性地缩小 margin（margin shrinkage）：中位因子在 4 bit 为 0.86、3 bit 为 0.33、2 bit 为 0.00。
Motivation: 量化是 LLM 实际部署的方式，低于 4 bit 会损害模型，但此前无法预测哪些决策会在指定位宽下改变；先前的加法噪声假设认为高置信决策是安全的，与观测到的'基准分数不动但行为崩溃'现象不符。
Method: 定义并跟踪二选一决策的 margin 在量化前后的变化，提出 margin shrinkage 模型，并通过拟合统计比较加法噪声与乘性收缩两种假设；还研究用少量配对 margin 估计哪些决策会失效而不做完整生成式评估。
Result: 摘要报告量化将 margin 乘以随位宽坍缩的因子（中位 0.86@4 bit、0.33@3 bit、0.00@2 bit）；加法噪声模型在受损工具和安全决策上从不胜出。拟合关系在留出决策上预测翻转率的中位误差为 1.8 个百分点，逐决策预测的翻转概率校准误差为 0.004（131,758 个预测）；该形式在所有模型中成立，但常数为各模型特有，不可迁移。
Conclusion: 作者认为量化损害是乘性而非加性的，且大 margin 提供的保护会因收缩而失效；每模型每 bit 宽测量少量配对 margin 即可估计哪些决策会破损，且在成本匹配测试中，没有比增加一个 bit 更便宜的修复手段。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Theoretical Foundations of Communication-Efficient, Robust, and Practical Distributed and Federated Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning and optimization have advanced together, with practical demands motivating new theory and theoretical breakthroughs enabling new applications. Modern large-scale training relies on classical optimization principles, but the constraints of distributed systems require these foundations to be reconsidered. This thesis addresses seven challenges at the intersection of theory and practice, focusing on key bottlenecks in federated learning and distributed optimization. First, we introduce ProxSkip and prove that local gradient steps can accelerate communication, providing a theoretical foundation for this widely used heuristic. Second, we develop Variance Reduced ProxSkip, which eliminates the neighborhood error of stochastic local updates while balancing communication and local computation. Third, we show that local steps retain their communication acceleration under partial client participation. Fourth, we prove that server-side stepsizes and sampling without replacement improve convergence in heterogeneous settings. Fifth, for Random Reshuffling, we demonstrate that compressing gradient differences rather than gradients yields better theoretical and practical performance. Sixth, we establish that Byzantine robustness and partial participation can be achieved simultaneously using gradient-difference clipping. Finally, we develop the first theoretical framework for low-rank adaptation based on randomized asymmetric chains, providing new insights into fine-tuning large models. Across these contributions, we introduce novel algorithmic frameworks, establish sharp guarantees under realistic assumptions, and support the theory with numerical experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本论文是Grigory Malinovsky的博士论文，系统研究分布式与联邦优化中通信效率、鲁棒性和实用性的理论基础。论文包含七个章节，依次提出ProxSkip及其方差缩减变体、部分客户端参与下的本地步骤加速、服务端步长与无放回采样的收敛性、基于压缩梯度差值的Random Reshuffling方法、结合拜占庭鲁棒性与部分参与的梯度差裁剪框架，以及基于随机化非对称链的低秩适配理论。论文强调在现实假设下建立尖锐的收敛保证，并以数值实验支持理论结果。
Motivation: 大规模训练依赖经典优化原理，但分布式系统的约束要求重新审视这些基础。论文瞄准联邦学习与分布式优化中理论与实践结合的七个关键瓶颈，包括本地更新加速通信的机理、随机本地更新的邻域误差、部分参与下的收敛性、异构数据下的步长选择、梯度压缩策略、拜占庭鲁棒性，以及大模型微调中低秩适配的理论缺失。
Method: 论文以理论分析为主线，提出了多种算法与框架：ProxSkip通过本地梯度步骤加速通信；Variance Reduced ProxSkip消除随机本地更新的邻域误差；分析部分客户端参与下的本地步骤加速性质；证明服务端步长与无放回采样在异构环境下的收敛优势；在Random Reshuffling中提出压缩梯度差值而非梯度本身；用梯度差裁剪同时实现拜占庭鲁棒性与部分参与；并建立基于随机化非对称链的低秩适配首个理论框架。

Conclusion: 论文的总体结论是：通过重新设计算法与证明策略，可以在现实假设下同时获得通信效率、鲁棒性和实用收敛保证，并以统一的理论框架覆盖联邦学习与分布式优化的多个核心挑战。

papers.title: Wasserstein Mahalanobis Distances for Recovering Latent Geometry
papers.abstract_en: The Mahalanobis distance is a fundamental covariance-adapted metric for multivariate data and plays a central role in recovering latent geometry from nonlinear observations. We extend this principle from vector-valued data to probability measures by introducing a Wasserstein Mahalanobis distance. Our construction replaces Euclidean displacement vectors with optimal transport displacement fields and local covariance matrices with covariance operators defined on Wasserstein tangent spaces. We show that this construction inherits the geometry-recovery property underlying nonlinear independent component analysis. In particular, for Gaussian measures with common covariance transformed by a smooth nonlinear pushforward, the proposed Wasserstein Mahalanobis distance approximates the classical Mahalanobis distance between the transformed latent means. The correspondence is exact for affine transformations and holds up to controlled higher-order error terms for general smooth transformations. These results establish a distribution-valued analog of classical Mahalanobis geometry and provide theoretical support for covariance-adapted learning directly in Wasserstein space. Numerical experiments confirm the theoretical predictions and demonstrate accurate recovery of latent geometric structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Wasserstein Mahalanobis 距离，将经典 Mahalanobis 距离从向量值数据推广到概率测度：用最优传输位移场替代欧氏位移向量，用 Wasserstein 切空间上的协方差算子替代局部协方差矩阵。作者证明该构造继承非线性独立成分分析 (nonlinear ICA) 的几何恢复性质，对具有共同协方差的高斯测度经光滑非线性推前后，该距离逼近潜在均值间的经典 Mahalanobis 距离；仿射变换下精确成立，一般光滑变换下误差为受控高阶项。数值实验验证了理论预测与潜在几何结构的恢复。
Motivation: 经典 Mahalanobis 距离是面向向量数据的协方差自适应度量，难以直接用于概率测度，而 Wasserstein 空间中缺乏类似的协方差自适应几何，导致从非线性观测恢复潜在结构时缺少理论支撑。
Method: 将位移向量替换为最优传输 (optimal transport) 位移场，并将局部协方差矩阵替换为定义在 Wasserstein 切空间上的协方差算子，由此构造 Wasserstein Mahalanobis 距离，并分析其在光滑非线性推前下的几何恢复行为。
Result: 摘要报告：对带共同协方差的高斯测度经光滑非线性推前，该距离近似等于变换后潜在均值之间的经典 Mahalanobis 距离；仿射变换情形精确成立，一般光滑变换保持到受控高阶误差项。数值实验证实了理论预测并展示潜在几何结构的高精度恢复。
Conclusion: 该工作建立了分布值域上的 Mahalanobis 几何对应物，为直接在 Wasserstein 空间中进行协方差自适应学习 (covariance-adapted learning) 提供理论支撑；其精确性目前针对高斯测度与仿射/光滑变换设定。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Bootstrap-Conditioned Action Selection with Tabular Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Contextual bandits offer a natural framework for sample-efficient personalization, but practical deployment remains difficult under sparse, biased interaction data, unreliable uncertainty estimates, and severe cold starts. We study whether pre-trained tabular foundation models with in-context learning can be turned into randomized policies for online decision making. We propose BC-ICL (Bootstrap-conditioned action selection using ICL), which at each round draws a bootstrap resample of the interaction history, conditions a frozen pre-trained ICL model on that resample, scores all actions, and selects the action with the highest sampled score. We further introduce an arm-context conditioning architecture that promotes shared statistical strength across actions and helps avoid common bootstrap failure modes of isolated-arm bandits. Empirically, this policy delivers strong early-round regret and regret performance on standard contextual bandit suites, outperforming established baselines under a strict online protocol.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究能否把带上下文学习 (in-context learning) 的预训练表格基础模型变成在线决策中的随机化策略，并针对上下文赌博机 (contextual bandits) 提出 BC-ICL。该方法每轮对交互历史做 bootstrap 重采样，用冻结的预训练 ICL 模型对重采样后的历史打分所有动作，再选择采样分数最高的动作；同时引入动作-上下文条件架构来跨动作共享统计强度。摘要报告该方法在标准上下文赌博机测试集上取得较好的早期后悔度 (early-round regret) 性能。
Motivation: 上下文赌博机理论上适合样本高效个性化，但在稀疏、有偏的交互数据、不可靠的不确定性估计和严重冷启动场景下难以实际部署。作者想验证预训练表格基础模型能否通过 ICL 直接用于在线决策。
Method: 提出 BC-ICL：每一轮从交互历史中抽取 bootstrap 重采样，将冻结的预训练 ICL 模型在该重采样上条件化，对所有动作打分并选择采样分数最高的动作。还提出 arm-context conditioning 架构，以促进不同动作间共享统计强度，避免孤立臂赌博机的常见 bootstrap 失败模式。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在标准上下文赌博机测试集上取得较强的前期后悔度和总体后悔度性能，并在严格在线协议下优于既有基线。
Conclusion: 作者认为预训练表格基础模型可以被转化为有效的随机化在线决策策略，且 bootstrap 重采样结合条件架构能缓解冷启动和稀疏数据问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cascade: Exploiting SLO-Aware latency budget for fair and high goodput LLM inference serving
papers.abstract_en: The reasoning and agentic capabilities of large language models have expanded the range of applications they support, from short interactive exchanges to long, compute-heavy requests. LLM serving platforms today define response-latency service-level objectives, even though requests within the same service can differ by orders of magnitude in input length, generation length, execution cost, and the availability of reusable KV-cache state. As a result, requests governed by the same service level objective have different urgency: after accounting for the time required to execute them, some have substantial latency headroom while others have almost none. We define this headroom---the difference between a request's service level objective and its predicted remaining service time---as its per-request latency budget. We present Cascade, an LLM serving system that estimates and continuously updates this budget from request characteristics, KV-cache state, and current system load. Unlike prior SLO-aware schedulers that use deadlines to govern request ordering alone, Cascade uses a single per-request budget to jointly coordinate request scheduling and KV-cache management across the memory hierarchy. Its scheduler prioritizes requests with little remaining budget, while its memory manager uses the same budget to decide whether non-resident KV state should be restored or prefetched from a deeper tier, retained in HBM, or recomputed. By directing queueing and data-movement overhead toward requests that can absorb it, Cascade improves SLO-satisfied goodput while preserving fairness across heterogeneous request classes. On production traces across three large language models, Cascade improves goodput by up to2.4x and reduces SLO violations by 40% relative to the default vLLM first-come, first-served scheduler.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Cascade，一个面向 LLM 推理服务的系统，利用 SLO（服务等级目标）感知的延迟预算（latency budget）来联合调度请求和管理 KV-cache。系统把请求的 SLO 与其预测剩余服务时间之差定义为逐请求延迟预算，并据此协调调度和跨内存层级的 KV-cache 管理。在生产负载和三个大语言模型上，Cascade 相比 vLLM 默认先来先服务（FCFS）调度器，将满足 SLO 的 goodput 提升至多 2.4 倍，并将 SLO 违规降低 40%。
Motivation: LLM 服务中同一 SLO 下的请求在输入长度、生成长度、执行成本和可复用 KV-cache 状态上差异巨大，因此具有不同的紧迫性；现有 SLO 感知调度器仅用截止时间控制请求顺序，没有利用剩余延迟预算来统一协调调度与缓存管理。
Method: Cascade 从请求特征、KV-cache 状态和当前系统负载估计并持续更新每个请求的延迟预算；调度器优先处理剩余预算少的请求，内存管理器则用同一预算决定非驻留 KV 状态应从深层存储恢复/预取、保留在 HBM 还是重新计算。
Result: 摘要报告基于生产负载和三个大语言模型的实验中，Cascade 相对默认 vLLM FCFS 调度器将 goodput 提升至多 2.4 倍，并将 SLO 违规减少 40%，同时在不同异构请求类别间保持公平性。
Conclusion: 作者认为把队列与数据移动开销导向能吸收这些开销的请求，可以在保持公平性的同时提高满足 SLO 的 goodput；系统依赖对逐请求延迟预算的估计与持续更新。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Newton-Schulz Retraction-Based Inference Enables Hidden Quantum Markov Models to Outperform Classical HMMs
papers.abstract_en: Hidden Markov models (HMMs) are widely used probabilistic models for discrete sequential data but can be limited when hidden dynamics are complex. Hidden quantum Markov models (HQMMs) generalize HMMs by replacing probability vectors with density matrices and stochastic transitions with quantum operations, enabling richer latent representations. However, existing HQMM learning methods have not consistently outperformed Expectation--Maximization (EM)-trained HMMs on data not generated by quantum processes, limiting their practical applicability. We introduce NS-RIS, Newton--Schulz Retraction-based Inference on the Stiefel manifold, a scalable algorithm for learning trace-preserving HQMMs. NS-RIS uses Newton--Schulz orthogonalization to compute a polar-factor search direction while preserving Stiefel-manifold feasibility, avoiding costly matrix decompositions. We further establish a finite-time stationarity guarantee under standard assumptions on smoothness, stochastic gradients, and finite Newton--Schulz accuracy. Empirically, NS-RIS provides the first benchmark evidence that an HQMM can significantly outperform an EM-trained HMM on data not generated by a quantum model. On synthetic HMM-generated benchmarks, NS-RIS outperforms both EM and the state-of-the-art HQMM method COSM, improving the evaluation metric by an average of 38.5% and by up to 50.6%. On a synthetic HQMM benchmark, it improves the test metric over COSM by 18.9% while reducing runtime by 12.0%. On the real-world Splice classification benchmark, NS-RIS also surpasses both EM and COSM in higher-dimensional latent regimes, reducing mean classification error by 17.9% for latent dimension 6 and 14.9% for latent dimension 8 relative to COSM. These results move HQMMs beyond a theoretical generalization of HMMs and establish them as practical and expressive models for scientific sequence data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NS-RIS（Newton-Schulz Retraction-based Inference on the Stiefel manifold），一种用于学习保迹隐藏量子马尔可夫模型（HQMM）的可扩展算法。NS-RIS 利用 Newton-Schulz 正交化计算极分解搜索方向，在避开昂贵矩阵分解的同时保持 Stiefel 流形可行性，并在标准光滑性与随机梯度假设下给出有限时间平稳性保证。实验表明，该方法是首个在非量子生成数据上显著优于 EM 训练的 HMM 的 HQMM 方法，并在合成 HMM、合成 HQMM 和真实 Splice 分类基准上超过现有最优 HQMM 方法 COSM。
Motivation: 隐藏量子马尔可夫模型（HQMM）作为 HMM 的量子泛化，理论上具有更丰富的隐状态表达能力，但现有学习算法在非量子过程生成的数据上始终未能一致优于 EM 训练的 HMM，限制了其实用价值。
Method: 提出 NS-RIS 算法，在 Stiefel 流形上进行基于 Newton-Schulz 正交化的推断：用 Newton-Schulz 迭代近似极分解中的正交因子以生成搜索方向，避免直接的矩阵分解，同时保证参数始终满足 Stiefel 流形约束；论文还给出了在光滑性、随机梯度和有限 Newton-Schulz 精度假设下的有限时间平稳性收敛保证。
Result: 在合成 HMM 生成的数据上，NS-RIS 同时优于 EM 和现有最优 HQMM 方法 COSM，评估指标平均提升 38.5%，最高达 50.6%；在合成 HQMM 基准上，相比 COSM 测试指标提升 18.9%，运行时间降低 12.0%；在真实 Splice 分类基准上，潜在维度为 6 和 8 时相对 COSM 的平均分类误差分别降低 17.9% 和 14.9%。
Conclusion: 这些结果将 HQMM 从 HMM 的理论泛化推进为实用且表达力强的序列数据模型，为科学序列数据提供了有竞争力的学习算法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TradeVerse: A Longitudinal Benchmark of Political Negotiation in International Trade
papers.abstract_en: LLMs are increasingly being applied to tasks involving institutional and political texts, but existing benchmarks evaluate them on isolated documents or single tasks. In realpolitik, negotiations are longitudinal data, where participating parties can align or argue over multiple iterations and each turn is an outcome of the previous turns, hence, understanding one turn requires tracking everything before it. We introduce TradeVerse, a benchmark built from the World Trade Organisation (WTO) specific trade concerns, where member states challenge one another and exchange arguments over multiple rounds, sometimes for years. We, in TradeVerse, reconstruct minutes of $1170$ meetings, spanning across 5 groups and $89$ product groups and define three tasks: first, the system has to analyze the longitudinal meeting records and predict the harmonized system codes (HS chapters) of the products under discussion in the particular meeting, second, we examine whether the system, upon analyzing the anonymized content of the meeting, can guess the name of the responding country and third, we ask the system to play the role of the responding country and provide the statement for the very last round. All labels are recovered directly from the proceedings, requiring no manual annotation. Our experiments highlight the challenges these tasks pose for current LLMs. To the best of our knowledge, TradeVerseis the first benchmark to investigate potential of LLMs in understanding longitudinal political trade negotiations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TradeVerse 是一个从世界贸易组织（WTO）特定贸易关切记录中构建的纵向谈判基准，旨在评估 LLM 对多轮政治贸易谈判的理解能力。该基准重建了 1170 场会议记录，覆盖 5 个组别和 89 个产品组，并定义三项任务：预测会议讨论产品的 HS 章节、根据匿名会议内容猜测回应国、以及模拟回应国给出最后一轮陈述。所有标签直接从议事记录中恢复，无需人工标注。实验表明现有 LLM 在这些纵向任务上仍面临挑战，这是首个针对 LLM 理解纵向政治贸易谈判的基准。
Motivation: 现有基准通常基于孤立文档或单一任务来评估 LLM，但现实政治谈判是纵向数据，各方的立场和争论会持续多轮，且每一轮都依赖之前所有轮次的信息；理解当前回合需要追踪完整历史，现有评测无法覆盖这一能力。
Method: 从 WTO 特定贸易关切中重建会议记录，构建覆盖 1170 场会议、5 个组别和 89 个产品组的基准；基于这些记录定义预测 HS 章节、识别回应国、以回应国身份生成最后一轮陈述三项任务，并直接从议事记录中恢复标签以省去人工标注。
Result: 实验显示当前 LLM 在这三项纵向谈判理解任务上均表现不佳，凸显了其对多轮政治贸易文本进行长程追踪与推理的困难。
Conclusion: 作者强调 TradeVerse 是首个考察 LLM 理解纵向政治贸易谈判潜力的基准，并说明这些任务对现有模型构成明显挑战。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Robust Average-Reward Markov Decision Processes: Minimax-Optimal Learning via Plug-in Reductions
papers.abstract_en: Distributionally robust Markov decision processes provide a principled framework for sequential decision making under model uncertainty. We study how many samples are necessary and sufficient to learn an $\varepsilon$-optimal robust policy under the average-reward criterion. A generative model provides samples from the nominal transition kernel, whereas policy performance is evaluated over $(s,a)$-rectangular total-variation uncertainty sets of radius at most $σ$. Let $H_0$ and $H_σ$ denote the nominal and robust optimal bias spans, respectively. We identify $σH_0$ as the perturbation scale separating high- and low-tolerance regimes. Our matching upper and lower bounds show that, up to logarithmic factors, the minimax total sample complexity is $$ NSA \asymp \frac{SA}{\varepsilon^2}\begin{cases} \min\{H_0,H_σ\}, & \varepsilon\gtrsimσH_0,\\ \min\{H_0,H_σ\}+σH_σ^2, & \varepsilon\lesssimσH_0. \end{cases} $$ Here $S$ and $A$ are the numbers of states and actions, and $N$ is the number of samples per state-action pair. The sample complexity consists of a linear-span term that resembles the nominal AMDP results and a robustness-specific term that appears only in the low-tolerance regime. We attain these rates using reduction-based plug-in procedures that select the reduction---nominal or robust---and its discount factor: a span-informed procedure that makes these choices using known span parameters, and a span-agnostic procedure that calibrates both choices from data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究分布鲁棒平均奖励马尔可夫决策过程（robust average-reward MDP）的样本复杂度。在生成模型（generative model）下从名义转移核采样，策略性能在 (s,a)-矩形全变差（total variation）不确定集上评估。作者给出 ε-最优鲁棒策略的极小极大（minimax）总体样本复杂度，并证明上下界匹配。关键尺度为 σH₀，它区分高容忍度与低容忍度两个机制。
Motivation: 现有分布鲁棒 MDP 的样本复杂度研究多聚焦于折扣准则或有限时域设定，平均奖励准则下的必要与充分样本量尚不清楚；该准则在长期运行的序贯决策问题中很重要。
Method: 提出基于归约的 plug-in 程序：在名义或鲁棒归约之间选择归约方式及其折扣因子（discount factor）。包括利用已知 span 参数的 span-informed 程序，以及从数据自适应标定这两种选择的 span-agnostic 程序。
Result: 忽略对数因子，极小极大总体样本复杂度满足 NSA ≍ (SA/ε²)·{min{H₀,H_σ}, ε≳σH₀; min{H₀,H_σ}+σH_σ², ε≲σH₀}。复杂度由类似名义 AMDP 的线性 span 项和仅在低容忍度机制出现的鲁棒性特定项组成。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 σH₀ 是划分高、低容忍度机制的扰动尺度，且所提归约式 plug-in 程序达到匹配的极小极大样本复杂度。结果在生成模型与全变差矩形不确定集假设下成立。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: TaskSense: Focusing on What Matters in World Models
papers.abstract_en: World models for visual control typically learn compact latent states by reconstructing observations, implicitly encouraging representations to preserve information across the entire visual input. However, task-relevant content often occupies only a small fraction of the observation, while background clutter and distractors consume valuable representational capacity. This mismatch between visual reconstruction and control objectives biases latent representations to model task-irrelevant visual content, diluting learning signals for control-relevant features and severely degrading downstream performance under visual distractions. We introduce TaskSense, a task-centric world modeling framework that enforces task relevance before latent encoding through a differentiable stochastic spatial attention mechanism conditioned on the previous latent state. To steer attention toward control-relevant regions, we augment training with an auxiliary inverse-dynamics objective. Rather than reconstructing the full observation, the world model reconstructs only the attended regions, encouraging latent representations to preserve task-relevant information while discarding irrelevant visual content. The decoder is further conditioned on the sampled attention map, enabling consistent reconstruction despite stochastic attention. Compared with the DreamerV3 baseline, TaskSense maintains competitive performance on the DeepMind Control Suite while consistently outperforming DreamerV3 on the Distracting Control Suite, demonstrating substantially improved robustness to visual distractions. Qualitative analysis further confirms that the learned attention, guided by inverse-dynamics supervision, consistently localizes control-relevant regions while suppressing irrelevant visual content.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TaskSense，一个任务中心的 world model 框架，在潜在编码之前通过可微随机空间注意力（stochastic spatial attention）强制关注任务相关区域，并用辅助逆动力学（inverse dynamics）目标引导注意力。与 DreamerV3 相比，该方法在 DeepMind Control Suite 上保持竞争力，在 Distracting Control Suite 上持续优于 DreamerV3，显著提升对视觉干扰的鲁棒性。定性分析显示学习到的注意力能定位控制相关区域并抑制无关内容。
Motivation: 视觉控制中的 world model 通常通过重建完整观测学习紧凑潜在状态，但任务相关内容往往只占观测的一小部分，背景杂乱和干扰物浪费表征容量；重建目标与控制目标的不匹配会稀释控制相关特征的学习信号，在视觉干扰下严重损害下游性能。
Method: 引入 TaskSense 框架，使用以前一潜在状态为条件的可微随机空间注意力机制，在潜在编码前施加任务相关性约束；训练中加入辅助逆动力学目标引导注意力，并只重建被注意的区域而非完整观测，解码器进一步以采样的注意力图为条件以保证随机注意力下重建的一致性。
Result: 在 DeepMind Control Suite 上，TaskSense 达到与 DreamerV3 基线相近的性能；在 Distracting Control Suite 上始终优于 DreamerV3，表明对视觉干扰的鲁棒性显著提升。定性分析确认由逆动力学监督引导的注意力持续定位控制相关区域并抑制无关视觉内容。
Conclusion: 作者认为在潜在编码前强制任务相关性并只重建被注意区域，可以引导表征保留控制相关信息、丢弃无关视觉内容，从而提升视觉干扰下的控制鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Density-Functional Excited-State Gradients and Nonadiabatic Couplings on a Consumer GPU from a Contraction-DAG
papers.abstract_en: Nonadiabatic dynamics needs an excited-state gradient and an interstate nonadiabatic coupling matrix element (NACME) at every nuclear geometry, and a double-hybrid functional's accuracy has been unavailable for the coupling. We report the first analytic derivative NACME for a double-hybrid excited state---deferred in the original hh-TDA method and supplied for hybrids only by Yu \emph{et al.}---derived, with the hole-hole and particle-particle Tamm--Dancoff (\hhTDA/\ppTDA) gradients and NACMEs, as a single reverse-mode transpose of one contraction graph closed under a non-symmetric atomic-orbital-direct $J/K$ kernel. Its double-hybrid excitation energy lowers the vertical-excitation mean absolute deviation from bare-\hhTDA\ $0.86$ to $0.47$~eV and removes the $+0.53\!\rightarrow\!+0.05$~eV over-excitation bias, improving seven of ten states while over-correcting the ionic $ππ^*$ states---the expected perturbative-doubles failure, reported not trimmed. Every coupling is validated to $\sim\!10^{-4}$ against an independent \emph{literal many-electron wavefunction-overlap} oracle that shares no code path with the method, and is physically meaningful at the ammonia $n\!\rightarrow\!σ^*$ \emph{covalent} conical intersection, where the \hhTDA/\ppTDA manifolds recover the $F\!-\!2$ seam and adiabatic linear-response TDDFT gives $τ\!\equiv\!0$ by construction. Gradients, NACMEs, and the double-hybrid coupling all run device-resident and AO-direct through one shared Cholesky-decomposed $J/K$ engine within the 8\,GB of a consumer RTX~4060 (a profile-guided $\sim\!10^2\times$ launch collapse preserving double-precision bit-identity)---placing on a commodity desktop card a correlated excited-state derivative capability that has until now required datacenter hardware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告了首个双杂化 (double-hybrid) 激发态的解析导数非绝热耦合矩阵元 (NACME)，连同 hole-hole 与 particle-particle Tamm–Dancoff (hhTDA/ppTDA) 的梯度和 NACME，统一推导为单一收缩图 (contraction graph) 的 reverse-mode transpose，闭包于非对称的原子轨道直接 (AO-direct) J/K 核。摘要称该实现完全在 8 GB 的消费级 RTX 4060 上设备驻留运行，并将双杂化激发能的垂直激发平均绝对偏差从 bare-hhTDA 的 0.86 eV 降到 0.47 eV，过激发偏差从 +0.53 eV 降至 +0.05 eV。所有耦合都以约 10^-4 精度通过独立的多电子波函数重叠 oracle 验证。
Motivation: 非绝热动力学需要在每个核几何下计算激发态梯度和态间 NACME，而此前双杂化泛函的精度无法用于耦合计算；原始 hh-TDA 方法推迟了该导数，Yu 等人也只对杂化泛函提供了 NACME。
Method: 将 hhTDA/ppTDA 的梯度与 NACME 以及双杂化耦合推导为单个收缩图的 reverse-mode transpose，并在非对称 AO-direct J/K 核闭包下实现；所有计算共享一个经 Cholesky 分解的 J/K 引擎，配合 profile-guided 的约 10^2 倍 launch collapse，在保持双精度位一致的同时将全部工作限制在单张消费级显卡上。

papers.title: KNOWPLAN: Knowledge-Driven AI Agents for Smart Degree Pathway Planning
papers.abstract_en: Planning a degree from official university sources requires solving two problems in order. The institution's curriculum must first be reconstructed from catalogs, departmental pages, JSON endpoints, and PDFs that share no schema, and only then can a student-specific path be optimized under prerequisite logic and overlapping requirement constraints. Coupling the two lets each failure mode hide the other, because a planner that drives its own crawling never learns facts its current plan does not need. We present KnowPlan, which enforces an extraction-first boundary and measures the interface between the stages rather than assuming it. CatalogBrowse explores with no access to any user profile. It scores legal actions by lower-confidence expected marginal gain over a finite set of atomic catalog obligations per unit of source access, parses deterministically through platform adapters with a span-constrained clause-to-AST model fallback, and terminates on a closure certificate over index, schema, provenance, and reference completeness instead of a reward threshold. Its output contract is three provenance-linked JSON documents. DegreeMap consumes only those documents. It compiles them into a typed requirement hypergraph and optimizes lexicographically with CP-SAT over hard feasibility, completion horizon, load and risk, personalized utility, and option value, so that each stage optimizes inside the previous stage's proven optimum and stays certifiable within the solver budget. Across a 100-university broad track and a six-school dense track, CatalogBrowse reaches 96.2% inventory recall and 88.7% masked-source recovery at 47% less source access than an exhaustive crawler, DegreeMap holds 100.0% hard feasibility while improving personalized utility by +0.066 over the strongest baseline, and the full pipeline certifies 99.5% of requests with a utility gap to the privileged gold graph of 0.015.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 KnowPlan，一个面向学位路径规划的知识驱动 AI 智能体系统，强调提取与优化两阶段的严格解耦。CatalogBrowse 在无用户画像条件下从异构大学来源重建课程目录，DegreeMap 仅基于其输出的三个带溯源 JSON 文档，用 CP-SAT 做字典序优化。在 100 所大学的广覆盖和六所学校的密集测试中，系统达到 96.2% 的目录召回率、88.7% 的掩码源恢复率，并保持 100.0% 的硬可行性，最终为 99.5% 的请求提供可证明的规划结果。
Motivation: 从官方大学来源规划学位需要先解决两个顺序问题：先要从无统一模式的目录、页面、JSON 和 PDF 中重建课程结构，然后才能在先修逻辑和重叠约束下优化学生专属路径。若将两阶段耦合，规划器驱动的爬取只会学习当前计划所需的事实，各阶段的失败模式会互相掩盖。
Method: KnowPlan 强制采用先提取后规划的边界，并显式度量阶段间接口而非假设其正确。CatalogBrowse 在无任何用户画像的情况下探索，按有限原子目录义务的置信下界期望边际增益来评分合法动作，通过平台适配器确定性解析，并以跨度约束的 clause-to-AST 模型作为回退；它以索引、模式、溯源和引用完整性的闭包证书而非奖励阈值作为终止条件。DegreeMap 仅消费三个带溯源的 JSON 文档，将其编译为类型化需求超图，并使用 CP-SAT 在硬可行性、完成周期、负荷与风险、个性化效用和期权价值上进行字典序优化。
Result: 在 100 所大学广覆盖轨道和六所学校密集轨道上，CatalogBrowse 以比穷举爬虫少 47% 的源访问达到 96.2% 的库存召回率与 88.7% 的掩码源恢复率；DegreeMap 保持 100.0% 的硬可行性，并将个性化效用比最强基线提高 +0.066；完整流水线以与特权金标图仅 0.015 的效用差距为 99.5% 的请求提供证书。
Conclusion: 论文的核心结论是，通过强制提取与规划解耦、并使每个阶段在前一阶段已证明的最优范围内优化，可以在求解器预算内保持可证明性，同时获得高可行性与高召回。其适用范围是官方大学学位路径规划场景，验证覆盖 100 所大学和六所学校的测试轨道。
