papers.title: Online Security Learning in Cooperative Multi-Agent Systems under Hidden Byzantine Attacks
papers.abstract_en: We study online cooperative control of a multi-agent system under Byzantine attacks. Namely, an unknown, fixed subset of agents are Byzantine comprised and can stealthily overwrite its own coordinates of the team's planned joint action after observing that plan. The learner observes planned actions, public rewards, and public states, but neither the overwrite nor the executed joint action. Our objective is security: to optimize the team performance against the worst overwrites and achieve the optimal security value. We first show that the attacker's information determines the geometry. An attacker that observes the planned action induces an exact $(s,a)$-rectangular robust Markov decision process (MDP) whose rows are convex hulls of overwrite-induced public-outcome laws, whereas a blind attacker induces an $s$-rectangular model. We then identify the information-theoretic limit of security learning, showing that the security regret decomposes exactly into return regret against the response generating the data and a cumulative response gap $D_K$. Two indistinguishable horizon-one instances force $Ω(K)$ expected security regret while return regret is zero, showing that dependence on $D_K$ is unavoidable. Finally, we develop a stage-tied robust estimation-to-decisions learner and prove a regret bound of $\widetilde{\mathcal O}\!\left(H^2S\sqrt{AK}\right)+\mathbb E[D_K]$. Our studies thus provide comprehensive theoretical and algorithmic foundations of reliable multi-agent systems under Byzantine attacks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多智能体系统中存在隐藏拜占庭攻击 (Byzantine attacks) 时的在线安全学习问题。攻击者可观察计划动作并静默覆写自身坐标，学习者只能看到计划动作、公共奖励和公共状态。作者刻画了攻击者信息导致的鲁棒 MDP 几何结构，给出安全遗憾的信息论下界，并提出阶段绑定的鲁棒估计到决策学习器，证明遗憾界为 ~O(H^2 S sqrt(AK)) + E[D_K]。
Motivation: 多智能体系统在拜占庭攻击下可能遭遇个体恶意覆写联合动作，而现有在线学习理论缺乏针对隐藏攻击的安全最优性刻画与可证明算法。
Method: 将问题建模为鲁棒 MDP：可观察计划动作的攻击者诱导出精确的 (s,a)-矩形鲁棒 MDP，其行是覆写诱导公共结果分布的凸包；盲攻击者则诱导 s-矩形模型。随后提出阶段绑定的鲁棒估计到决策 (estimation-to-decisions) 学习器。
Result: 理论结果表明安全遗憾可精确分解为对生成数据响应的回报遗憾与累积响应间隙 D_K 之和；存在两个不可区分的 horizon-one 实例迫使期望安全遗憾为 Ω(K) 而回报遗憾为零，说明对 D_K 的依赖不可避免。算法遗憾界为 ~O(H^2S√(AK)) + E[D_K]。
Conclusion: 作者认为该研究为拜占庭攻击下可靠多智能体系统提供了全面的理论和算法基础。摘要未提及实验验证或实际系统部署。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CertBind from Multimodal Connectivity to Certifiable Retrieval Decisions
papers.abstract_en: Lightweight connectors make frozen multimodal encoders composable at the representation level. Deployment exposes a second problem at the level of task decisions. A connected route can expand cross-modal reach while changing an established native retrieval capability. We introduce CertBind, a multiscale theory of certifiable composition for frozen multimodal connector graphs. At the node scale, native anchors establish the exact task identification boundary under the stated chart model. At the edge scale, contract-aware conformal ranks provide graph-wide family-wise error control. At the path scale, an overlap-aware budget and clean calibration yield a finite-sample recovery radius under declared conditions. At the query scale, this radius yields a covered top-k candidate set that becomes a point certificate when its size equals k. CertBind therefore retains supported routes as Direct, sends only flagged routes to recovery, returns Certified for decisive recovery, and returns Abstain for unresolved queries. The evaluated C-MCR shared route reduced native CLIP R@1 from 0.524 to 0.290. The production fallback recovered 0.963 +- 0.002 of clean retrieval, while the passing branch recorded a no-harm value of 1.000. CertBind extends multimodal composability from connected representations to certifiable task decisions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CertBind，一个面向冻结多模态编码器连接图 (connector graphs) 的多尺度可认证组合理论。它从节点、边、路径、查询四个尺度给出形式化保证，将路由判定分为 Direct、Recovery、Certified 和 Abstain 四类，使得组合后的跨模态检索决策可获得有限样本恢复半径与逐点证书。实验显示共享路线会显著降低 CLIP R@1，而生产回退机制可以基本恢复干净检索性能。
Motivation: 轻量连接器虽能让冻结的多模态编码器在表示层面组合，但部署时任务决策层面的问题尚未解决：一条连接路线可能扩展跨模态覆盖范围，同时改变原有的本地检索能力，缺乏对组合后决策的可靠保证。
Method: CertBind 提出多尺度可认证组合理论：节点尺度上由原生锚点 (native anchors) 在给定图模型下确立精确任务识别边界；边尺度用契约感知的保形秩 (contract-aware conformal ranks) 提供图级族系误差控制；路径尺度用重叠感知预算和干净校准给出有限样本恢复半径；查询尺度由该半径产生覆盖的 top-k 候选集，当候选集大小等于 k 时成为逐点证书 (point certificate)。
Result: 在评估的 C-MCR 共享路线上，原生 CLIP R@1 从 0.524 降到 0.290；生产回退 (production fallback) 恢复了 0.963 ± 0.002 的干净检索性能；通过分支记录的无伤害值 (no-harm value) 为 1.000。
Conclusion: CertBind 将多模态可组合性从连接表示层面扩展到可认证的任务决策层面，为已支持的路线保留 Direct，仅将标记路线送入恢复，并对可判定恢复返回 Certified、对未解析查询返回 Abstain。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Target-Weighted Neyman Allocation: Experimental Design for Heterogeneous Treatment Effects under Population Shift
papers.abstract_en: Randomized experiments are often run in one population to guide decisions in another. Allocating by experimental proportions wastes budget on groups that rarely appear in deployment, whereas allocating by deployment proportions under-samples groups that are hard to measure precisely. We propose \textbf{TWNA} (Target-Weighted Neyman Allocation), a two-stage stratified design that uses pilot estimates of group--arm outcome variances to allocate final-stage sample sizes and treatment probabilities for target-weighted group average treatment effect (GATE) precision. The oracle rule has a closed form and balances deployment importance with statistical difficulty; the plug-in rule recovers it as pilot variance estimates stabilize. We also extend TWNA to handle uncertainty about deployment composition, remaining robust whether the target mix is roughly known or entirely unknown. Finally, we distinguish this weight robustness from a pilot-robust variant for skewed, rare-event, or contaminated outcomes. Simulations and real-covariate benchmarks show the largest gains when groups are both deployment-important and difficult to measure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TWNA（Target-Weighted Neyman Allocation），一种面向人群迁移（population shift）下异质性处理效应估计的两阶段分层实验设计。该方法利用先导阶段对分组-干预结果方差的估计，分配正式阶段的样本量与处理概率，以优化目标加权组平均处理效应（GATE）的估计精度。摘要给出闭式最优分配规则，并证明插件估计在方差估计稳定时能恢复该规则，同时扩展了应对部署人群构成不确定性的版本。
Motivation: 随机实验常在一个人群中运行，却用于指导另一个人群的决策；按实验比例分配预算会浪费在部署中很少出现的群体上，而按部署比例分配又会低估难以精确测量的群体，导致目标人群上的估计不准确。
Method: 提出两阶段分层设计 TWNA：先导阶段估计各分组-干预组合的结果方差，据此分配正式阶段的样本量和处理概率，以最小化目标加权 GATE 的估计方差；最优分配存在闭式解，插件估计随先导方差稳定而收敛到该最优规则。进一步扩展到部署人群构成不确定的情形，并区分权重稳健性与针对偏态、稀有事件或污染结果数据的先导稳健变体。
Result: 模拟实验和真实协变量基准显示，当某些群体既在部署中重要又难以测量时，TWNA 的增益最大。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 TWNA 在目标人群构成大致已知或完全未知时均能保持稳健，并区分了权重不确定性与先导估计质量问题这两类鲁棒性来源。

papers.title: Unmasking Removal-Budget Confounding: A Matched Operating-Point Evaluation Framework for Adaptive Data Cleaning
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive data-cleaning methods replace manual filtering thresholds with data-driven partitions. However, changing the partition granularity, the number of groups used to segment samples by estimated corruption risk, can implicitly shift the decision boundary and alter the overall number of removed samples. This creates a bias known as removal-budget confounding, where apparent gains in metrics like precision or false-positive rate reflect a smaller removal budget rather than superior corruption discrimination. To address this evaluation bias, we introduce an operating-point-aware evaluation framework that evaluates methods using matched-budget and matched-recall controls alongside threshold-independent metrics (AUROC and AUPRC). We test this framework on a multi-cue adaptive cleaner redesign featuring a reweighted learning-difficulty cue, an auxiliary Euclidean-distance cue, and increased partition granularity intended to isolate clean-but-difficult samples. While naive evaluations (assessing configurations at their own induced operating points) suggest substantial performance improvements for the redesign, these gains disappear once operating points are equalized. False-positive decomposition reveals that clean-but-difficult samples primarily drive error counts at low corruption rates, become threshold-dependent at moderate corruption, and contribute negligibly under severe corruption. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet-100 demonstrate that most performance differences observed in naive evaluation shrink or vanish at low-to-moderate corruption when operating points are matched. True ranking advantages only remain in specific low-prevalence settings and in high-recall regions under severe corruption. These findings highlight that adaptive cleaning methods must be benchmarked at matched operating points to ensure performance gains reflect genuine corruption discrimination.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出自适应数据清洗方法在评估时存在 removal-budget confounding 偏差：改变分组粒度会隐式移动决策边界并改变移除样本数，使精度或假阳性率等指标的优势仅来自更小的移除预算而非真正的污染判别能力。作者提出操作点感知评估框架，用 matched-budget 与 matched-recall 控制及 AUROC/AUPRC 阈值无关指标重新评估一个多线索自适应清洗器重设计；在 CIFAR-10 和 ImageNet-100 上，多数朴素评估下的性能差异在操作点匹配后缩小或消失，仅在特定低患病率设置和严重污染下的高召回区域保留真实排序优势。
Motivation: 现有的自适应数据清洗方法用数据驱动分区替代人工过滤阈值，但评估时未考虑移除预算变化；这种混淆使方法间比较不公平，看似提升实际源于删除更多样本，因而需要能消除该偏差的评估框架。
Method: 提出操作点感知评估框架，引入 matched-budget 与 matched-recall 控制，并结合阈值无关指标 AUROC 与 AUPRC；评估对象是一个多线索自适应清洗器重设计，包含重加权的学习难度线索、辅助欧氏距离线索以及更细的分组粒度，旨在隔离 clean-but-difficult 样本。
Result: 在 CIFAR-10 和 ImageNet-100 上，绝大多数朴素评估中的性能差异在操作点匹配后缩小或消失；真正的排序优势只在特定低患病率设置及严重污染下的高召回区域出现。假阳性分解还显示 clean-but-difficult 样本在低污染率下主要驱动错误计数、中污染时变得阈值依赖、严重污染下贡献可忽略。
Conclusion: 自适应清洗方法必须在匹配操作点下进行基准测试，才能确保性能收益反映真实的污染判别能力；该框架为这类方法的评估提供了控制混杂的新途径。

papers.title: Agentic AI: User Empowerment or Enclosure?
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI promises a more flexible form of digital agency: systems that can act on users' behalf, from filtering content to negotiating prices to selecting services. Whether it will empower users is an open question, and we argue that the answer depends on more than the technology. We conduct a comparative case analysis of four more mature domains where similar forms of agency arose: browser-based ad blockers, platform recommender systems, financial robo-advisors, and email spam governance. Across the cases, decisions about whose interests agents would serve were resolved through technical arrangements: API choices, protocol governance, industry standards, and default configurations. Beyond their technical form, these were political decisions. We identify this as depoliticization, a concept from political theory, here at work in technological systems. Its most consequential effect is that individual outcomes and collective contestation capacity can move in opposite directions: spam inbox quality improved substantially while the organized capacity to contest spam governance collapsed. Where intermediary institutions sustained adversarial challenge, user-aligned agency proved more durable; where proprietary infrastructure and closed standard-setting absorbed contestation, displacement compounded. We apply this to agentic AI, where governance arrangements consolidating around the Model Context Protocol and the Agentic AI Foundation are settling these configurations before the choices that define what agents can do move outside the reach of users and the public.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文以比较案例分析法考察了四个已成熟领域（浏览器广告拦截、平台推荐系统、金融智能投顾、邮件垃圾治理）中类似代理性（agency）的出现方式，论证关于代理人利益归属的决策是通过 API 选择、协议治理、行业标准和默认配置等技术安排被预先裁定的。作者借用政治理论中的去政治化（depoliticization）概念指出，这些安排本质上是政治决策；其最关键的后果是个人结果与集体抗争能力可以反向变动，例如垃圾邮件收件箱质量显著改善，而有组织的垃圾治理抗争能力却崩溃。作者将该分析推广到 agentic AI，认为围绕 Model Context Protocol 和 Agentic AI Foundation 的治理安排正在用户和公众失去选择权之前固化这些配置。
Motivation: Agentic AI 能否真正赋能用户（user empowerment）仍是开放问题，作者认为答案取决于超越技术本身的制度安排；既有讨论多聚焦技术能力，而忽略了代理人利益归属如何被政治性地预先决定。
Method: 采用四个成熟代理性领域的比较案例分析，识别跨案例中利益归属决策如何被技术安排（API 选择、协议治理、行业标准、默认配置）固化，并引入政治理论中的去政治化概念作为分析框架。
Result: 摘要报告的核心发现是个人结果与集体抗争能力可以反向变动：垃圾邮件治理中用户体验改善的同时，有组织的治理抗争能力崩溃；在存在中介机构维持对抗性挑战的领域，用户对齐的代理性更持久，而在专有基础设施和封闭标准制定吸收抗争的地方，替代（displacement）效应被放大。
Conclusion: 作者将结论应用于 agentic AI，警示围绕 Model Context Protocol 与 Agentic AI Foundation 形成的治理安排正在这些选择超出用户和公众可及范围之前固化，因此本文呼吁关注代理性系统治理中的政治维度，而非仅技术效率。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Toward Reliable Context Compression for Long-Horizon Agents: An Empirical Study of Execution Instability
papers.abstract_en: Recurrent context compression controls context growth in long-horizon agents, but its behavioral effects remain poorly understood. In this preliminary empirical study, we show that compression can weaken the influence of recent interactions, increasing blocked actions, repeated exploration, and instability across runs. Motivated by these observations, we introduce TRACE, a verifier-guided framework that evaluates individual compaction events through paired closed-loop continuations from the same environment state and uses summary preferences to optimize a natural-language compression prompt while keeping all models frozen. Initial results on AppWorld show improvements over existing compression baselines in task performance, multi-run reliability, and context--execution efficiency. These findings provide early evidence for boundary-local evaluation as a promising direction for reliable agent context compression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一项初步实证研究，考察长时程智能体 (long-horizon agents) 中循环上下文压缩 (recurrent context compression) 带来的行为影响。作者发现压缩会削弱近期交互的影响力，导致更多 blocked actions、重复探索以及跨运行的不稳定性。基于这些观察，他们提出 TRACE 框架：用验证器引导、通过同一环境状态下的成对闭环续接 (paired closed-loop continuations) 评估单个压缩事件，并利用摘要偏好 (summary preferences) 优化自然语言压缩提示，同时保持所有模型冻结。AppWorld 上的初步结果显示其在任务性能、多运行可靠性和上下文-执行效率方面优于现有压缩基线。
Motivation: 循环上下文压缩被用来控制长时程智能体的上下文增长，但其对智能体行为的影响尚未被充分理解。作者希望通过闭环执行层面的实证分析，揭示压缩带来的不稳定副作用，并探索更可靠的压缩评估与优化方式。
Method: 提出 TRACE 框架，采用验证器引导的方式，对每次压缩事件从同一环境状态生成成对闭环续接来评估其影响；再通过压缩摘要的偏好信号优化自然语言压缩提示，整个过程中所有模型保持冻结。
Result: AppWorld 上的初步结果显示，相比现有压缩基线，TRACE 在任务性能、多运行可靠性以及上下文-执行效率方面均有提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调这些发现为边界局部评估 (boundary-local evaluation) 作为可靠智能体上下文压缩的可行方向提供了早期证据，并明确该研究仍属初步阶段。

papers.title: Can MLLMs Decode the Creative Leap? Introducing C4 for Cross-Concept Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Creative capabilities of MLLMs matter in design, communication, education, and human--AI collaboration, yet remain difficult to evaluate because explicit targets and reward signals are scarce compared with accuracy-oriented tasks. Cross-concept understanding is a core cognitive capacity underlying receptive creativity. It enables a perceiver to recover intended meaning from non-obvious but meaningful conceptual relations. We operationalize item construction as cross-concept encoding and model inference as cross-concept decoding. We introduce C4, a cognition-inspired evaluation framework for Chengyu (Chinese idiom)-based Cross-Concept Creativity. Its encoding component maps target slots to imageable substitute concepts along bridge paths in a manually annotated and third-party-reviewed cross-concept network, enabling batch generation with explicit structure, difficulty indexed by bridge count and depth, and exact answers. Using this framework, we instantiate the C4 Evaluation Set (C4-Eval), comprising 184 synthetic items and 37 human-created cross-concept chengyu figures collected from online sources. We manually construct and review cross-concept relations, bridge paths, and reasoning processes for the collected figures. Each C4-Eval item is instantiated in five task settings, yielding 884 primary answer-recovery cases. Across ten evaluated MLLMs, the strongest closed models reach 50.7% and 48.0% primary accuracy, while open-source models remain substantially lower. Candidate constraints improve accuracy sharply, but bridge hints and explanation requests provide only modest gains. These results expose a substantial gap in how current MLLMs decode creatively encoded meaning through cross-concept relations. The code is in the supplementary material.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 C4，一个基于中文成语的跨概念创造力评估框架，用于评测多模态大语言模型（MLLM）从非显然概念关系中恢复意图含义的创造性解码能力。框架将项目构建视为跨概念编码、模型推理视为跨概念解码，并构建了含 184 个合成项和 37 个人工搜集项的 C4-Eval 评测集，每个项目覆盖五种任务设置共 884 个主答案恢复用例。在十个 MLLM 上的结果显示最强闭源模型主准确率约 50%，开源模型显著更低，提示当前 MLLM 在跨概念创造性解码上仍存在较大差距。
Motivation: MLLM 的创造力在设计、沟通、教育和人机协作中很重要，但显式目标和奖励信号稀缺，难以像准确率导向任务那样评估；跨概念理解是接受性创造力的核心认知能力，现有评测缺乏对此的结构化度量。
Method: 将项目构建抽象为跨概念编码、模型推理抽象为跨概念解码，构建手动标注并经第三方评审的跨概念网络，通过桥接路径将目标槽映射到可成像的替身概念，以桥接数量和深度作为难度指标；在此基础上生成 C4-Eval，并为每个项目实例化五种任务设置。
Result: 在十个 MLLM 上，最强闭源模型主准确率为 50.7% 和 48.0%，开源模型明显更低；候选约束能大幅提升准确率，而桥接提示和解释请求仅带来有限提升。
Conclusion: 摘要认为结果暴露了当前 MLLM 在通过跨概念关系解码创造性编码含义方面的显著差距，代码在补充材料中提供。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: InsertFuse: A Unified Framework for Multi-Category Reference-Guided Image Insertion
papers.abstract_en: We present InsertFuse, a unified framework for multi-category reference-guided image insertion. Its key idea is to decouple category-specific expertise learning from cross-category capability consolidation. InsertFuse first trains specialized experts for different insertion categories and then introduces Insertion On-Policy Distillation (IOPD) to consolidate their capabilities into a single student. By querying the matched expert at states visited by the student, IOPD preserves category-specific insertion behavior while mitigating the cross-category interference caused by direct joint training. To improve spatial control, we propose Token-Aligned Geometry Conditioning (TAGC), which maps mask-derived geometric cues to the visual token grid, and Region-Balanced Flow Matching, which separately normalizes prediction errors inside and outside the insertion region to prevent background-dominated and scale-dependent supervision. We further introduce Reference CFG to isolate and strengthen the guidance induced by the visual reference under fixed scene and geometry conditions, with IOPD transferring this enhanced supervision into the unified student. Extensive experiments on the public AnyInsertion benchmark and our multi-category test set demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on most metrics, showing strong reference fidelity and generation quality across diverse insertion categories.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 InsertFuse，一个面向多类别参考引导图像插入（reference-guided image insertion）的统一框架。其核心思路是将类别专长学习与跨类别能力整合解耦：先为不同插入类别分别训练专家模型，再用 Insertion On-Policy Distillation (IOPD) 把这些能力整合进单一学生模型。此外，作者提出 Token-Aligned Geometry Conditioning (TAGC)、Region-Balanced Flow Matching 和 Reference CFG，以增强空间控制与参考引导。在公开 AnyInsertion 基准和自建多类别测试集上，多数指标达到当前最优。
Motivation: 多类别参考引导图像插入中，直接联合训练不同类别会导致跨类别干扰，且背景主导和尺度相关的监督会使空间控制与参考保真不足。该文针对这一训练范式问题提出统一框架。
Method: 采用两阶段方案：先为各插入类别训练专家，再通过 IOPD 在学生模型访问的状态下查询匹配专家，把类别特定插入行为蒸馏进单一学生，缓解直接联合训练带来的干扰。空间控制方面引入 TAGC 将 mask 导出的几何线索映射到视觉 token 网格，并用 Region-Balanced Flow Matching 分别归一化插入区域内外的预测误差；Reference CFG 则在固定场景与几何条件下分离并增强视觉参考引导，并由 IOPD 传递给统一学生。
Result: 在公开 AnyInsertion 基准及作者自建的多类别测试集上，该方法在多数指标上达到 SOTA，展现出较强的参考保真度和生成质量。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，通过专家解耦、几何条件注入和区域平衡监督，统一学生模型能够在多类别插入任务中兼顾类别特定行为和跨类别泛化能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Attention: Signed Integrated Gradients Attribution in a BiomeGPT-Style Microbiome Transformer
papers.abstract_en: In a feature-tokenized transformer (arXiv:2106.11959) such as BiomeGPT (doi:10.64898/2026.01.05.697599), each input token is built by fusing a fixed identity with a sample-specific measurement: a fixed species and a variable abundance, T = S + A. To interpret downstream classification in such models, prior work inspects the attention weights of the special [CLS] token (arXiv:2106.11959, arXiv:1810.04805, BiomeGPT) to rank sample tokens by importance. These weights have two critical limitations: they are nonnegative, so they cannot separate disease-supporting from health-supporting evidence (arXiv:2201.12114), and they act after token fusion, obscuring how the input sources S and A each affect the output. To address this we use Integrated Gradients (arXiv:1703.01365), a signed, fusion-aware attribution method, and propose a source-derived baseline T' = S + A_0 for feature-tokenized models such as BiomeGPT, which preserves species identity as a fixed biological coordinate while isolating the effect of abundance variation. Applied to a disease-versus-health decision margin, it yields polarity that explicitly separates pathogenic from protective microbial signals. We show that this gradient-based approach uncovers species-abundance directional relationships and sensitivity diagnostics entirely obscured by unsigned [CLS] attention weights. We further recommend second-order Integrated Hessians (arXiv:2002.04138) to expose microbiome community interaction rules: how a perturbation in one member alters the model's sensitivity to another, and which other species drive ambiguous cases toward disease or health at a given abundance level. This provides a principled approach to explainability in BiomeGPT that generalizes to other smooth and differentiable feature-tokenized transformers. Code is available at https://github.com/nohren/token-source-attribution
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 BiomeGPT 这类特征化 token 的 Transformer（feature-tokenized transformer）提出用 Integrated Gradients 进行可解释性分析。作者指出 [CLS] 注意力权重为非负且作用于 token 融合之后，无法区分疾病支持与健康支持证据，也无法分离物种身份 S 与丰度 A 的各自贡献；为此提出源派生基线 T' = S + A_0，并在疾病对健康的决策边界上得到带极性的归因，从而区分致病与保护性微生物信号。文中还推荐使用二阶 Integrated Hessians 来揭示微生物群落中物种间的交互规则，并声称该方法可推广到其他平滑可微的特征化 token 模型。
Motivation: 现有解释工作在 feature-tokenized 模型（如 BiomeGPT）中依赖 [CLS] token 的注意力权重来对样本 token 排序，但该类权重是非负的，无法区分支持疾病与支持健康的证据；同时它们作用于 token 融合之后，掩盖了输入来源 S（物种身份）和 A（丰度）各自对输出的影响。
Method: 使用带符号且融合感知的 Integrated Gradients，并提出源派生基线 T' = S + A_0，在保留物种身份作为固定生物学坐标的同时隔离丰度变化的影响；将该方法应用于疾病与健康的决策边界，并进一步建议采用二阶 Integrated Hessians 来刻画一个物种的扰动如何改变模型对另一物种的敏感度。
Result: 摘要报告该方法能够揭示物种-丰度方向性关系以及灵敏度诊断，这些信息被无符号的 [CLS] 注意力权重完全掩盖；摘要未给出定量实验数字。
Conclusion: 该方法为 BiomeGPT 提供了一种原理性的可解释性途径，并能推广到其他平滑且可微的特征化 token Transformer；代码已开源。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Do AI Personas Grow? Analyzing and Benchmarking Personality Evolution in LLM Agents After Life Events
papers.abstract_en: Personality-conditioned LLM agents (PC-Agents) are increasingly used in emotional support, social simulation, and role-playing, motivating the development of lifelong agents that remain coherent over extended interactions. A key component of such coherence is personality evolution: agents should undergo plausible, psychology-grounded changes as they experience life events in different contexts. Although prior work shows that LLM personalities can shift under contextual perturbations, how these shifts vary across traits, events, personas, and models remains poorly understood. We study event-induced personality change after 11 major life events, using the Big Five traits as a psychometric anchor and interpreting the resulting trajectories against longitudinal evidence from human personality psychology. Across four diagnostic axes, PC-Agents exhibit measurable trait shifts at similar rates for event-trait pairs with and without documented human change directions. Even when shifts follow the expected direction, their magnitudes usually fall below human effect-size ranges. Gender and cultural-region prompts show little moderating effect, while persona-level dispersion is compressed three- to four-fold relative to human samples. To enable systematic comparison, we introduce BFI-Adapt, a reusable benchmark for scoring the directional fidelity of event-induced personality change, and use it to rank 14 models. A validation suite shows that the measured shifts exceed no-event retest noise, remain stable under independently paraphrased prompts, exhibit limited and model-dependent convergence with scenario-based behavioral choices, and persist across intervening unrelated dialogue. Together, these checks establish the measured trajectories as robust event-conditioned response patterns. Our results suggest that current PC-Agents simulate the mean of human personality dynamics, but not its shape.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 LLM 智能体在经历人生事件后的人格演化，以 Big Five 特质为心理测量锚点，考察 11 个重大生活事件引发的特质变化。作者提出可复用的 BFI-Adapt 基准来评分事件诱导人格变化的方向保真度，并用它排名 14 个模型。验证套件表明所测变化超过无事件重测噪声、在改写提示下稳定、与场景化行为选择收敛有限且依赖模型、并能跨无关对话持续。
Motivation: 人格条件化 LLM 智能体 (PC-Agents) 已用于情感支持、社会模拟和角色扮演，长期一致性依赖人格演化，但事件诱导的人格变化如何随特质、事件、角色和模型变化仍缺乏系统理解。
Method: 以 Big Five 特质为锚点，比较 11 个重大人生事件前后的人格轨迹，并对照人类纵向心理学证据；沿四个诊断轴分析。提出 BFI-Adapt 基准用于评分事件诱导人格变化的方向保真度，并配有一套验证程序检验重测噪声、提示改写稳定性、与行为选择的一致性及跨对话持久性。
Result: PC-Agents 在有人类变化方向和无人文变化方向的事件-特质对上表现出相近的变化率；即使方向正确，幅度通常低于人类效应量范围。性别和文化区域提示几乎没有调节作用，人格层面离散度相对人类样本压缩三到四倍；14 个模型的排名由 BFI-Adapt 给出，验证表明测量轨迹是稳健的事件条件化响应模式。
Conclusion: 结果表明当前 PC-Agents 能模拟人类人格动力学的均值，但无法模拟其分布形状，提示需要更好地刻画人格演化的个体差异。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: LyEvO: Lyapunov-Guided Evolutionary Optimization for Safe and Robust Sim-to-Real Policy Learning
papers.abstract_en: Training controllers that are safe and robust in simulation, and systematically assessing their readiness for real-world deployment, remain key challenges in sim-to-real transfer. To address this, we propose LyEvO, a physics-grounded framework that combines constrained Evolutionary Optimization and Statistical Model Checking (SMC)-based verification with Lyapunov-based stability analysis. Leveraging prior knowledge of the system dynamics, LyEvO uses Lyapunov analysis to compute an initial candidate stability region. An iterative loop then uses operational scenarios drawn from this region to jointly optimize and statistically verify a policy, and subsequently expands the region's boundaries based on the verification outcome. This integrated procedure provides a practical criterion for assessing deployment readiness. We evaluate LyEvO on Cartpole and 3D Quadrotor benchmarks through extensive simulations and targeted real-world experiments, demonstrating safe and robust sim-to-real transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LyEvO，一个基于物理的 sim-to-real 策略学习框架，结合约束进化优化 (constrained evolutionary optimization)、统计模型检验 (SMC) 验证与 Lyapunov 稳定性分析。LyEvO 先利用系统动力学先验知识通过 Lyapunov 分析计算候选稳定区域，再在迭代循环中从该区域采样运行场景，联合优化并统计验证策略，随后根据验证结果扩展区域边界。该方法在 Cartpole 和 3D Quadrotor 基准上通过大量仿真与针对性真实实验验证，展示了安全且鲁棒的 sim-to-real 迁移。
Motivation: sim-to-real 迁移中，如何训练安全且鲁棒的控制器，并系统评估其是否具备真实世界部署条件，仍是关键挑战。
Method: 提出 LyEvO 框架：利用系统动力学先验，通过 Lyapunov 分析计算初始候选稳定区域；迭代循环从该区域生成运行场景，联合进行策略优化和基于统计模型检验的验证，再根据验证结果扩展稳定区域边界。
Result: 在 Cartpole 和 3D Quadrotor 基准上开展大量仿真与针对性真实实验，摘要报告该方法实现了安全且鲁棒的 sim-to-real 迁移。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该集成流程为评估部署就绪性 (deployment readiness) 提供了实用判据；其基于物理的框架依赖系统动力学先验知识。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: StepJack: Benchmarking Computer-Use Agent Safety Against Multi-Step Indirect Prompt Injection
papers.abstract_en: Computer-use agents (CUAs) face a growing threat from indirect prompt injection, where adversarial instructions are planted in the environment such as web pages. In this paper, we introduce multi-step indirect prompt injection, a new attack class against CUAs in which the adversarial goal is decomposed into multiple innocuous-looking sub-steps and distributed across a chain of pages referenced along the agent's navigation path. We develop a pipeline to automatically decompose an adversarial goal under the constraint that the execution of the decomposed sub-steps must achieve the original goal while optimizing the innocuousness of each decomposed sub-step. With this pipeline, we build StepJack, a CUA safety benchmark with 480 test examples. On this benchmark, we evaluate six state-of-the-art CUAs and find that at a fixed decomposition depth, multi-step attacks raise attack success rate (ASR) on three of six CUAs, by up to 31.2 points (e.g., GPT-5.4-mini: 41.7% at single-step to 72.9% at three-step); averaged over the five CUAs that can reliably follow the reference chain (all but EvoCUA-32B), ASR rises from 31.3% at single-step to 36.9% at three-step. Dataset and code are available at https://github.com/BorealisAI/StepJack.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出针对计算机使用智能体 (computer-use agents, CUA) 的多步间接提示注入 (multi-step indirect prompt injection) 攻击类别：将对抗目标分解为多个看似无害的子步骤，并沿智能体导航路径分布到一系列页面中。作者构建了自动分解流水线，并基于此建立包含 480 个测试样本的 CUA 安全基准 StepJack。在六个 SOTA CUA 上的评估显示，固定分解深度下多步攻击使其中三个模型的攻击成功率 (ASR) 提升，最高提升 31.2 个百分点。
Motivation: CUA 面临来自环境中（如网页内）植入对抗指令的间接提示注入威胁，现有攻击通常为单步注入，容易被察觉或防御；作者希望探索一种更隐蔽的攻击形式，即把单一对抗目标拆解为多个看似正常的子步骤，以评估和推动 CUA 的安全性。
Method: 提出一个自动流水线，在保证拆分后的子步骤执行后能达成原始目标的前提下，将对抗目标分解为多个子步骤，并优化每个子步骤的无害性 (innocuousness)；分解结果沿智能体导航路径上引用的页面链分布，形成名为 StepJack 的 CUA 安全基准。
Result: 在 StepJack 上评估六个 SOTA CUA，固定分解深度下，多步攻击使六个模型中的三个 ASR 提升，最高提升 31.2 个百分点（如 GPT-5.4-mini 从单步的 41.7% 升至三步的 72.9%）；在能可靠跟随参考链的五个模型（除 EvoCUA-32B 外）上，平均 ASR 从单步的 31.3% 升至三步的 36.9%。
Conclusion: 作者认为多步间接提示注入能够提高对 CUA 的攻击成功率，并贡献了相应的数据集与代码（公开于 GitHub）。评估范围限于六个模型，其中 EvoCUA-32B 无法可靠跟随参考链，因而被排除在平均统计之外。

papers.title: WebGrader: Training LLMs for Web Development with Self-Evolving Programmatic Grader
papers.abstract_en: Large language models increasingly generate complete websites from natural-language descriptions, and reinforcement learning has become a central approach to closing their remaining functional gap. This training regime is bottlenecked by reward design. Hand-authored browser scripts are executable yet costly to write for open-ended requirements, while VLM and GUI-agent graders scale but may issue verdicts before observing the decisive state. We propose WebGrader, a self-evolving programmatic grader that autonomously derives the required interaction flows from each website request, represents each flow as an executable Flow Contract, and uses its execution outcome as an RL reward. WebGrader materializes the generated project in a live browser, grounds target actions against the source code and live DOM, and collects visual, DOM, response, and persistent-state evidence along the same browser trajectory. A residual-driven offline loop then discovers reusable verifier skills, screens them on disjoint validation pages, and freezes the promoted skill graph before policy training. By separating test planning, action grounding, evidence collection, and semantic judgment, WebGrader issues a Pass verdict only after observing the requested transition. On WebGen-Bench, WebGrader trains an 8B policy to a 52.01% functional success rate, outperforming a matched appearance-plus-script reward by 7.88 points and surpassing o4-mini and DeepSeek-v4-flash. On WG-core-250, the policy reaches a Full Score of 44.953 and surpasses Qwen3-Coder-480B.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 3 figures. Supplementary material is included in the main PDF
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WebGrader，一种自进化程序化评分器，用于训练 LLM 从自然语言描述生成完整网站。WebGrader 从每个网站请求自动推导所需交互流程，将其表示为可执行的 Flow Contract，并以执行结果作为强化学习奖励；在实时浏览器中实例化项目，基于源码和实时 DOM 对目标动作进行接地，并沿浏览器轨迹收集视觉、DOM、响应和持久状态证据。在 WebGen-Bench 上，训练 8B 策略达到 52.01% 的功能成功率，超过匹配的外观加脚本奖励 7.88 分，并超越 o4-mini 和 DeepSeek-v4-flash；在 WG-core-250 上 Full Score 达到 44.953，超过 Qwen3-Coder-480B。
Motivation: 强化学习成为弥合 LLM 网站生成功能差距的核心手段，但该训练模式受限于奖励设计：手写浏览器脚本可执行但对开放式需求编写成本高，而 VLM 和 GUI-agent 评分器虽然可扩展，却可能在观察到决定性状态之前就给出判定。
Method: WebGrader 将测试规划、动作接地、证据收集和语义判断分离，把每个交互流程表示为可执行的 Flow Contract，并用其执行结果作为 RL 奖励。它在实时浏览器中物化生成项目，针对源码和实时 DOM 接地目标动作，沿同一浏览器轨迹收集视觉、DOM、响应和持久状态证据；残差驱动的离线循环发现可复用的验证器技能，在不相交的验证页面上筛选，并在策略训练前冻结提升后的技能图。
Result: 在 WebGen-Bench 上，WebGrader 训练的 8B 策略达到 52.01% 功能成功率，比匹配的外观加脚本奖励高出 7.88 分，并超过 o4-mini 和 DeepSeek-v4-flash；在 WG-core-250 上策略达到 Full Score 44.953，超过 Qwen3-Coder-480B。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 WebGrader 只有在观察到请求的状态转换后才给出 Pass 判定，并通过分离测试规划、动作接地、证据收集和语义判断来保证判定可靠性。作者认为这种自进化程序化评分器能有效训练 LLM 完成网站生成任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CyberForge: Verified Vulnerability Injection at Repository Level for Cybersecurity Agent Training
papers.abstract_en: Despite recent advances, frontier large language model (LLM) agents remain limited in discovering and patching complex vulnerabilities in real-world software. Generally available agents can already aid attackers, who only need to find one exploitable weakness, while defenders must continuously identify and patch all vulnerabilities across fast-growing codebases. Stronger defensive agents would help close this gap, yet the scarcity of security training data with reproducible build and execution environments remains a bottleneck. We present CyberForge, a framework that synthesizes executable, repository-level security training data by injecting vulnerabilities into real C/C++ projects. It validates each instance dynamically: the injected build must pass the project's unit tests, and generated proof-of-vulnerability (PoV) must trigger on the injected build and not on the clean one. CyberForge is not limited by the availability of disclosed vulnerabilities, therefore it can scale in comparison to data augmentation techniques which rely on historic CVE data. The resulting corpus holds 1034 validated vulnerabilities across 80 projects and 63 weakness categories, with edit locality similar to real CVE patches under a real-versus-real noise floor. Fine-tuning on trajectories collected over this corpus improves SEC-bench patch repair by +3.3 to +14.7 points, in all six configurations of three model scales and two teachers, with the 31B student reaching its GPT-5.4-mini teacher, 72.7% against 74.0%. These gains generalize out of distribution to PatchEval, a corpus containing other programming languages, where every configuration also improves and the 31B student passes its teacher.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CyberForge 是一个在真实 C/C++ 项目中注入漏洞来合成可执行、仓库级安全训练数据的框架。每个实例都经过动态验证：注入后的构建必须通过项目单元测试，且生成的漏洞证明（PoV）只能在注入构建上触发而不能在干净构建上触发。最终语料包含 80 个项目、63 个弱点类别上的 1034 个已验证漏洞，编辑局部性与真实 CVE 补丁相近。在该语料上收集轨迹微调后，SEC-bench 补丁修复在三种模型规模和两种教师的六种配置中提升 +3.3 到 +14.7 点。
Motivation: 防御方需要持续发现并修补快速增长的代码库中的所有漏洞，但前沿 LLM agent 在发现和修补真实软件复杂漏洞方面仍有限，且安全训练数据稀缺、缺乏可复现的构建与执行环境是瓶颈。现有依赖历史 CVE 数据的数据增强方法受已披露漏洞可用性限制，难以扩展。
Method: CyberForge 通过向真实 C/C++ 项目注入漏洞来合成可执行、仓库级的安全训练数据，并对每个实例做动态验证：注入的构建需通过项目单元测试，生成的 PoV 必须在注入构建上触发且不能在干净构建上触发。由于不受已披露漏洞可用性限制，该方法相比依赖历史 CVE 数据的技术可以扩展。
Result: 语料包含 80 个项目中 1034 个已验证漏洞、63 个弱点类别，编辑局部性与真实 CVE 补丁相近。在 SEC-bench 上微调提升 +3.3 到 +14.7 点（六种配置），31B student 达到其教师 GPT-5.4-mini 的 72.7% 对比 74.0%；在包含其他编程语言的 PatchEval 上所有配置均提升，31B student 超过教师。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该方法能生成可扩展、可复现的仓库级安全训练数据，并提升多种模型规模与教师配置下的补丁修复能力，且改进能泛化到分布外的其他语言。该方法聚焦 C/C++ 项目，验证依赖单元测试与 PoV 触发条件。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fairis: Fairness-Aware Aggregation with Provable Influence Containment against Fairness Poisoning Attacks in Collaborative Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: Collaborative machine learning among financial institutions must be both group-fair and robust against deliberate adversarial manipulation. Existing fairness-aware aggregation methods remain formally vulnerable to fairness poisoning: a malicious client maximizing group disparity while preserving accuracy evades accuracy-based Byzantine defenses, and in our threat model FairFed's gap-based weighting can be gamed by an adversary who observes the global fairness score. We present Fairis, a server-side reweighting scheme in which each client's update receives the normalized weight $ω_k = \bar{w}_k / \sum_j \bar{w}_j$ built from the unnormalized score $\bar{w}_k = η- \mathcal{F}_k$, with $\mathcal{F}_k \in [0,1]$ the local Equal Opportunity Difference and $η> 1$ a security parameter. We prove three properties, Monotone Weight Reduction (MWR), Demographic Participation, and Non-Gamesmanship, extend MWR to colluding minority coalitions, and show that combining MWR with server-side norm clipping bounds the adversary's displacement of the global model by $ω_0 C$, strictly decreasing in its own reported disparity. Assuming honest score reporting, an assumption this paper does not discharge, Fairis is the only rule evaluated that guarantees every client strictly positive weight while provably reducing an adversary's weight monotonically in its bias; clipped FairFed can reach a lower weight but guarantees nothing and zeroes a client outright on Taiwan Credit. Against an adversary stealthy enough to evade accuracy-based defenses, within 0.04 accuracy of benign, Fairis cuts its weight by 41 to 54% below a size-blind control on Taiwan. On routine non-IID partitions no rule dominates, and a uniform-weighting ablation shows that containment tracks how far the adversary's score separates from the honest mean, providing none when the honest population is already unfair.
papers.comment: 37 pages, 6 figures. Extended version, adding a size-weighted variant, a clipping-based influence bound, and machine-checked proofs of the main results
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Fairis，一种服务器端重加权方案，用于防御协作机器学习中的公平性毒化攻击（fairness poisoning）。作者证明三个性质：单调权重减少（MWR）、民主参与和非博弈性，并将 MWR 扩展到共谋少数联盟；结合服务器端范数裁剪，可将对手对全局模型的位移限制为 ω0C。在台湾信贷数据集上，对能避开准确率防御且准确率与良性相差 0.04 以内的隐蔽对手，Fairis 将其权重削减 41-54%。
Motivation: 金融机构的协作机器学习既需群体公平性，又需抵御蓄意对抗操纵，而现有公平感知聚合方法在形式上易受公平性毒化攻击：恶意客户端可在保持准确率的同时最大化群体差异，从而绕过基于准确率的拜占庭防御；在本文威胁模型下，FairFed 基于差距的加权也可被观察全局公平分数的对手博弈。
Method: Fairis 是一种服务器端重加权方案，每个客户端更新的归一化权重为 ωk = w̄k / Σj w̄j，其中未归一化得分 w̄k = η - Fk，Fk∈[0,1] 为局部 Equal Opportunity Difference，η>1 为安全参数。作者证明 MWR、Demographic Participation 和 Non-Gamesmanship 三个性质，扩展 MWR 至共谋少数联盟，并展示将 MWR 与服务器端范数裁剪结合可将对手对全局模型的位移限制为 ω0C，且随其自身报告的差异严格递减。
Result: 在假设诚实报告分数（论文未消除该假设）的前提下，Fairis 是评估规则中唯一保证每个客户端严格正权重并随偏差单调减少对手权重的方案；clipped FairFed 可达到更低权重但无保证，并在台湾信贷数据上将客户端直接清零。对手在 0.04 准确率范围内隐蔽于良性时，Fairis 比不区分大小的对照组削减其权重 41-54%。在常规非 IID 划分上无规则占优；均匀权重消融表明遏制效果取决于对手分数与诚实均值的分离程度，当诚实群体本身已经不公平时不提供遏制。
Conclusion: Fairis 针对公平性毒化攻击提供可证明的影响遏制，但依赖诚实分数报告这一本文未消除的假设；论文同时补充了大小加权变体、基于裁剪的影响界以及对主要结果的机器检查证明。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Test-Time Adaptation with Online Personalized Energy-Based Cache for Fine-Grained Video Expression Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Facial expression recognition (FER) in videos is challenging because models must identify subtle, temporally evolving affective states that vary across individuals. Although vision-language models provide transferable visual-semantic representations, models trained on subject-independent data often degrade under subject-specific distribution shifts at inference time. Existing test-time adaptation (TTA) methods commonly update model parameters during inference, increasing computational cost and latency. Cache-based methods avoid parameter updates, but they usually require enough target samples to form reliable class prototypes, which is difficult early in adaptation and for rarely observed classes. We introduce Energy-Based Cache Personalization (EB-CaP), a subject-based online TTA method for video FER that generates class-specific prototypes personalized to each target video. EB-CaP uses a lightweight energy-based model to sample prototypes from the current unlabeled video and populate a personalized cache online, without accumulating large amounts of target data or storing diverse source prototypes. Its energy function relies only on pretrained CLIP: similarities between the target video embedding and class text embeddings guide prototype sampling. In parallel, positive and negative caches store reliable and uncertain target embeddings. An adaptive entropy gate controls cache updates according to the evolving confidence distribution, while a diversity gate limits redundant samples. Final predictions combine cache-derived scores with the current CLIP scores. Experiments on BioVid, StressID, and BAH show that EB-CaP outperforms state-of-the-art TTA methods while maintaining low computational and memory overhead. Code is available at https://github.com/MasoumehSharafi/EB-CaP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Energy-Based Cache Personalization (EB-CaP)，一种面向视频面部表情识别 (FER) 的基于主体的在线测试时适应 (test-time adaptation, TTA) 方法。EB-CaP 利用轻量级能量模型从未标记的目标视频中采样类别原型，在在线情况下填充个性化缓存，无需积累大量目标数据；其能量函数仅依赖预训练 CLIP 的目标视频嵌入与类别文本嵌入之间的相似度。实验在 BioVid、StressID 和 BAH 上表明，EB-CaP 在保持低计算与内存开销的同时，优于现有 TTA 方法。
Motivation: 视频 FER 模型在推理时面临主体特定的分布偏移 (subject-specific distribution shift)，而现有 TTA 方法通常需要更新模型参数，增加计算与延迟；缓存类方法又往往需要足够的真实目标样本以形成可靠的类别原型，这在适应早期和稀见类别上很困难。
Method: EB-CaP 为每个目标视频在线上生成个性化的类别原型，使用轻量级能量模型从当前未标记视频采样原型并填充个性化缓存；并行维护正负缓存分别存放可靠与不确定的目标嵌入，并采用自适应熵门 (adaptive entropy gate) 按置信分布控制缓存更新，同时用多样性门 (diversity gate) 限制冗余样本。最终预测由缓存得分与当前 CLIP 得分结合得到。
Result: 摘要报告在 BioVid、StressID 和 BAH 三个数据集上，EB-CaP 优于现有最先进的 TTA 方法，同时保持了较低的计算和内存开销。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 EB-CaP 提供了一种无参数更新的在线 TTA 方案，通过个性化原型缓存缓解视频 FER 中的分布偏移，并随论文公开代码。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ED-CSP: Crystal Structure Prediction from Electron Diffraction
papers.abstract_en: Recovering a periodic 3D crystal structure from sparse, unindexed electron diffraction (ED) observations is a challenging generative inverse problem. Existing ED-based learning methods mainly predict crystallographic labels, reconstruct structures from indexed reflections, or retrieve candidates from finite structure libraries. Here, we introduce ED-CSP, a machine learning framework that predicts crystal structures from chemical composition, atom count, and multiple detector-plane ED spot sets. ED-CSP combines a relational set encoder, permutation-invariant multi-view aggregation, and a periodic flow generator to jointly predict lattice parameters and fractional atomic coordinates. To train the model, we construct ED-CS, a dataset of 4.85 million simulated multi-view ED crystal structures, deduplicated across seven materials repositories and filtered to exclude CHILI-100K overlaps. On 2,075 held-out CHILI-100K materials, ED-CSP trained only on CHILI achieves a structural match rate of 57.49% MR@5, outperforming PXRDGen (52.92%), a state-of-the-art crystal structure prediction model conditioned on powder X-ray diffraction. Scaling training data further improves performance: initializing from a one-million-structure precursor raises MR@5 to 66.27%. On 1,024 compositions absent from the training retrieval library, the model still achieves 53.52% MR@5, demonstrating true generative capability beyond exact-formula retrieval. Replacing target ED observations with diffraction from non-isomorphic structures of identical composition decreases MR@5 by 22.09 percentage points, confirming that predictions depend on the input diffraction patterns rather than composition alone. ED-CSP and ED-CS establish a benchmark for generative crystal structure prediction from sparse ED observations and provide a foundation for future transfer to experimental data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ED-CSP，一个从化学组成、原子数和多探测器平面电子衍射 (electron diffraction, ED) 斑点集合中预测周期性 3D 晶体结构的机器学习框架。模型结合关系集合编码器、置换不变的多视角聚合与周期流生成器，联合预测晶格参数和分数坐标。作者构建了包含 485 万条模拟多视角 ED 晶体结构的 ED-CS 数据集，并在 CHILI-100K 留出材料上达到 57.49% 的 MR@5，超过以粉末 X 射线衍射为条件的 PXRDGen。
Motivation: 从稀疏、未索引的电子衍射观测中恢复周期 3D 晶体结构是一个困难的生成式逆问题；现有基于 ED 的学习方法大多只预测晶体学标签、从已索引反射重建结构，或在有限结构库中检索候选，缺乏直接从稀疏 ED 观测进行生成式结构预测的能力。
Method: ED-CSP 由关系集合编码器 (relational set encoder)、置换不变多视角聚合 (permutation-invariant multi-view aggregation) 和周期流生成器 (periodic flow generator) 组成，以化学组成、原子数和多个探测器平面的 ED 斑点集为输入，联合输出晶格参数与分数原子坐标；训练所用 ED-CS 数据集来自七个材料仓库去重并过滤掉与 CHILI-100K 重叠的样本。
Result: 在 2,075 个留出的 CHILI-100K 材料上，仅用 CHILI 训练的 ED-CSP 取得 57.49% MR@5，优于 PXRDGen 的 52.92%；用一百万结构预训练初始化后 MR@5 升至 66.27%。在训练检索库中不存在的 1,024 个组成上仍取得 53.52% MR@5。将目标 ED 替换为同组成非同构结构的衍射后 MR@5 下降 22.09 个百分点，表明预测依赖输入衍射图样而非仅组成。
Conclusion: 作者认为 ED-CSP 与 ED-CS 为从稀疏 ED 观测进行生成式晶体结构预测建立了基准，并为未来迁移到实验数据打下基础；工作重心在模拟数据上的生成能力验证与消融分析。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FedTransKD-IDS: Robust Federated Transfer Learning with Knowledge Distillation for Intrusion Detection in IoT
papers.abstract_en: In modern distributed network environments, particularly in Internet of Things infrastructures and 5G networks, stringent privacy preservation and scalability requirements have created significant challenges for intrusion detection systems. Although federated learning preserves privacy by preventing data centralization, its efficiency and stability is considerably degraded under severe statistical heterogeneity and resource constraints of edge nodes. To address these limitations, this study introduces the FedTransKD-IDS framework, which enhances both system stability and efficiency by integrating robust aggregation based on the geometric mean, federated transfer learning, and knowledge distillation. Within this framework, the collaboratively trained global teacher model transfers its feature extraction component to lightweight student models. Experimental evaluation on heterogeneous datasets demonstrates a peak detection performance, achieving an accuracy of 99. 18% and a recall of 99. 99%, thereby indicating the effectiveness of structured knowledge transfer in federated environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FedTransKD-IDS 框架，用于 IoT 和 5G 网络中的入侵检测。该框架结合基于几何均值的鲁棒聚合、联邦迁移学习和知识蒸馏，以缓解联邦学习在统计异质性和边缘节点资源受限下的效率与稳定性下降。实验在异构数据集上达到 99.18% 的准确率和 99.99% 的召回率。
Motivation: 现代分布式网络环境（尤其是 IoT 和 5G）对隐私保护和可扩展性要求严格，传统联邦学习在严重统计异质性和边缘节点资源约束下效率和稳定性显著下降。
Method: 提出 FedTransKD-IDS：采用几何均值（geometric mean）进行鲁棒聚合，结合联邦迁移学习（federated transfer learning）与知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation），将协作训练的全局教师模型的特征提取部分迁移给轻量级学生模型。
Result: 在异构数据集上的实验达到峰值检测性能，准确率 99.18%，召回率 99.99%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调结构化知识迁移在联邦环境中的有效性，所提框架能同时增强系统稳定性与效率。

papers.title: Game-Theoretic Inverse Reinforcement Learning for Modeling Competitive Human Driving: A Cut-in Prediction Study
papers.abstract_en: Capturing the strategic decision-making inherent in competitive human driving is critical for autonomous vehicle safety and traffic simulation. This study demonstrates that game-theoretic Inverse Reinforcement Learning (IRL) provides a robust framework for this challenge. We present a comprehensive analysis comparing data-driven IRL models against an established physics-based game-theoretic approach for predicting aggressive, safety-critical cut-in lane changes. Using the high-fidelity highD dataset, we systematically develop and evaluate a series of IRL models with increasing feature complexity. Our results reveal significant advantages: the best-performing IRL models achieve an overall prediction accuracy exceeding 75 percent while maintaining a Cut-In precision up to 51 percent and recall up to 49 percent. This represents a significant improvement over the established physics-based benchmark, which achieved only 4.4 percent precision in these high-stakes scenarios. The analysis reveals a clear trade-off: incorporating granular, instantaneous features yields higher precision, while adding temporal consistency features maximizes recall. These findings suggest that IRL-based models can effectively bridge the gap between microscopic driver intent and macroscopic safety outcomes, providing a more reliable foundation for modeling interactions in mixed-autonomy environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文论证了博弈论逆强化学习 (game-theoretic IRL) 能够为竞争性人类驾驶行为建模提供稳健框架，并聚焦于激进且安全关键的切入式变道 (cut-in) 预测。作者基于高保真 highD 数据集，系统构建并评估了一系列特征复杂度递增的数据驱动 IRL 模型，并与既有基于物理的博弈论方法对比。结果显示最佳 IRL 模型整体预测准确率超过 75%，Cut-In 精确率最高 51%、召回率最高 49%，而物理模型在该高风险场景下精确率仅 4.4%。
Motivation: 捕捉竞争性人类驾驶中的策略性决策对自动驾驶安全与交通仿真至关重要，而既有基于物理的博弈论方法在预测激进切入式变道时表现不足，需要更稳健的建模框架。
Method: 使用 highD 高保真数据集，系统开发并评估一系列特征复杂度递增的数据驱动逆强化学习 (IRL) 模型，并与一个成熟的基于物理的博弈论方法进行对比，以刻画驾驶意图与安全结果之间的关系。
Result: 最佳 IRL 模型整体预测准确率超过 75%，Cut-In 精确率最高 51%、召回率最高 49%；物理基准在该高风险场景下精确率仅 4.4%。分析还显示明显的权衡：引入细粒度瞬时特征提高精确率，而加入时间一致性特征则最大化召回率。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于 IRL 的模型能有效弥合微观驾驶员意图与宏观安全结果之间的鸿沟，为混合自主环境 (mixed-autonomy) 中的交互建模提供更可靠的基础。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SNI-GNN: SmartNIC-Assisted Full-Graph GNN Training with In-Network Embedding Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Full-graph GNN training delivers high accuracy but scales poorly on multi-server clusters due to heavy, irregular inter-node embedding exchanges. We present SNI-GNN, a SmartNIC-assisted full-graph training system that reduces communication while preserving accuracy by predicting remote embeddings in-network. SNI-GNN deploys a lightweight linear-trend predictor on SmartNICs to refine cached historical embeddings, coupled with an importance-based boundary-node sampling policy and an asynchronous DPU--GPU data pipeline with intermediate-result reuse. We provide error and convergence bounds showing that predictor bias remains controlled under bounded second-order dynamics and yields standard non-convex convergence with inexact gradients. Implemented on NVIDIA BlueField-3, SNI-GNN integrates with state-of-the-art full-graph systems, cuts communication by 21--45\%, achieves 1.3--3.6$\times$ end-to-end speedups over BNS-GCN and up to 1.29$\times$ over baseline SANCUS, with accuracy loss $\leq 0.01$, and scales efficiently to 16 GPUs on graphs with up to tens of millions of edges. These results indicate SmartNIC-based in-network prediction is a practical complement to partitioning and compression techniques for communication-efficient full-graph GNN training at scale.
papers.comment: Camera-ready version accepted at ICDE 2026. 14 pages, 18 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SNI-GNN，一个基于 SmartNIC 的全图 GNN 训练系统，通过在网卡内预测远端 embedding 来减少多机集群中不规则且繁重的节点嵌入交换，同时保持训练精度。系统在 NVIDIA BlueField-3 上实现，与现有全图训练系统集成，据称可削减 21–45% 的通信量，相对 BNS-GCN 取得 1.3–3.6 倍端到端加速，相对基线 SANCUS 最高 1.29 倍，精度损失不超过 0.01，并可在 16 块 GPU、数千万条边的图上有效扩展。作者还给出了预测器误差界与非凸收敛性分析。
Motivation: 全图 GNN 训练精度高，但在多服务器集群上因节点间 embedding 交换量大且模式不规则而扩展性差，现有分区和压缩手段仍有通信瓶颈。
Method: 在 SmartNIC 上部署轻量级线性趋势预测器来修正缓存的历史 embedding，并配合基于重要性 (importance) 的边界节点采样策略，以及带中间结果复用 (intermediate-result reuse) 的异步 DPU–GPU 数据流水线；同时给出在有界二阶动态下预测器偏差受控、非精确梯度下标准非凸收敛的理论保证。
Result: 实现于 NVIDIA BlueField-3，通信量降低 21–45%，端到端加速为 BNS-GCN 的 1.3–3.6 倍、基线 SANCUS 的 1.29 倍以内，精度损失 ≤0.01，并且可扩展到 16 块 GPU 和数千万条边的图。
Conclusion: 作者认为 SmartNIC 上的网内预测是面向大规模全图 GNN 训练时，对分区与压缩技术的一种实用补充，可在保持精度的同时显著降低通信开销。

papers.title: Fast and Accurate: An Adaptive VLA Inference Framework through Environment-aware Model Selection
papers.abstract_en: Embodied intelligence demands both long-horizon reasoning and real-time closed-loop responsiveness. Recent dual-system Vision-Language-Action (VLA) architectures combine fast reactive control with slow deliberative reasoning to balance inference speed and task success rate. However, existing dual-process VLAs tightly couple the fast module to intermediate representations of the slow module, necessitating end-to-end joint training and limiting modularity, extensibility and flexible system switching. In this paper, we propose Environment-aware Model Selection (EMS), an adaptive VLA inference framework that switches between two fully decoupled systems of different scales through environment-aware model selection. The large-scale deliberative system provides globally consistent trajectory planning to ensure task success, while a lightweight reactive system enables high-frequency closed-loop control. A reinforcement-learning-based switching policy dynamically selects which system to invoke based on real-time feedback, enabling sparse use of the slow system and thereby balancing pretrained knowledge utilisation with runtime efficiency. Our design offers three key advantages over prior hierarchical VLA frameworks: (1) a fully decoupled and modular dual-system architecture that supports plug-and-play model replacement; (2) an adaptive, environment-aware switching strategy; (3) high-frequency inference for responsive closed-loop control. We extensively evaluate EMS in both simulation and real-world environments. On the LIBERO benchmark, EMS achieves success rates comparable to the large-scale baseline while increasing the effective action frequency to 93.4 Hz. The framework further demonstrates strong extensibility in real-world dual-arm manipulation tasks, where it accelerates task completion while maintaining robust performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出环境感知模型选择 (Environment-aware Model Selection, EMS)，一个自适应的视觉-语言-动作 (Vision-Language-Action, VLA) 推理框架，在两个完全解耦的不同规模系统之间动态切换：大规模 deliberative 系统负责全局一致的轨迹规划以保证任务成功率，轻量 reactive 系统负责高频闭环控制。基于强化学习的切换策略根据实时反馈决定调用哪个系统，从而稀疏使用慢系统并平衡预训练知识利用与运行时效率。在 LIBERO 基准上，EMS 在成功率与大模型基线相当的同时将有效动作频率提升至 93.4 Hz，并在真实双机械臂操作任务中表现出较强的可扩展性。
Motivation: 现有双系统 (dual-system) VLA 架构把快速模块与慢速模块的中间表示紧密耦合，必须端到端联合训练，限制了模块化、可扩展性和灵活的系统切换能力。
Method: EMS 采用完全解耦且模块化的双系统架构，支持即插即用的模型替换；一个强化学习训练出的切换策略依据环境实时反馈，动态选择调用大规模 deliberative 系统或轻量 reactive 系统，实现慢系统的高频稀疏使用。
Result: 在 LIBERO 基准上，EMS 取得与大规模基线相当的任务成功率，同时将有效动作频率提升到 93.4 Hz；在真实世界双机械臂操作任务中，该框架在保持稳健性能的同时加速了任务完成。
Conclusion: 作者强调该设计相比此前分层 VLA 框架的三个优势：完全解耦的模块化双系统架构支持即插即用替换、环境自适应的切换策略、以及支持响应式闭环控制的高频推理。

papers.title: Atmospheric Light Pollution by Proposed Reflect Orbital Space Mirrors
papers.abstract_en: ReflectOrbital is planning to launch a $18\times18$\,m mirror in space at a $\sim$600\,km altitude to illuminate a $2.5$\,km radius circular patch on Earth. The pilot satellite, called EARENDIL-1, is a pathfinder for a constellation of $\sim$50,000 larger mirrors, each with $54\times54$\,m in diameter, with the explicit goal to provide space-borne illumination on Earth. We calculate the sky brightness caused by the Rayleigh scattering and aerosol scattering of the incoming beam from one such satellite and by the light reflected back by the illuminated patch, for various atmospheric properties and ground albedos under cloud-free conditions. We demonstrate that the light pollution caused by one of these satellites is very significant, altering the nighttime environment up to distances of $\sim$30\,kms. The results show that for an observer within the beam of a single 54\,m satellite, the mirror will appear as a $-16.7$\,mag point-like source, i.e.~about 4 magnitudes brighter than the full moon. The diffuse sky background will be similar to the dusk sky shortly after sunset; too bright to see even the brightest stars. From a distance of 14\,km, the glow from a single mirror will exceed the luminance of the full moon sky for majority of the sky. From a distance of 34\,km the sky will still appear brighter than the moon-lit sky in the direction of the beam. If 400 such mirrors illuminate the same patch simultaneously, the glow will be obvious from 80\,kms.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in ApJL. Visual renderings at https://starryprinceton.org/scattering_calculations_renderings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文量化评估 Reflect Orbital 计划部署的空间反射镜阵列对地球夜间天空造成的光污染。作者基于瑞利散射、气溶胶散射以及地面反射光的辐射传输计算，给出单个 54×54 m 镜面在不同大气条件和地面反照率下引起的天空亮度分布，结果显示即使在云况晴朗条件下，光污染影响范围也可达约 30 km，且在光束内观测者眼中镜面亮度远超满月。
Motivation: Reflect Orbital 计划发射由约 50,000 面 54×54 m 镜子组成的星座，为地球提供天基照明；在部署前需要定量评估这类人造天基光源对夜间环境和天文观测的潜在影响。
Method: 针对单颗卫星入射光束的瑞利散射与气溶胶散射、以及被照亮地面区域的反射光，建立天空亮度计算模型，并考虑不同大气属性与地面反照率，在无云条件下进行数值模拟。
Result: 摘要报告：单颗 54 m 镜面在其光束内表现为 -16.7 等点源，比满月亮约 4 个星等；漫射天空背景接近日落后不久的黄昏天空，亮到无法看见最亮恒星；距镜面 14 km 处，大部分天空的辉光超过满月天空亮度；34 km 处光束方向天空仍比月明天空亮；若 400 面镜子同时照亮同一区域，80 km 外辉光仍明显可见。
Conclusion: 作者认为单个此类反射镜造成的光污染非常显著，会改变最远约 30 km 范围内的夜间环境，因此这类天基照明计划对夜天光的影响需要在部署前予以重视。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mitigating Scoring Bias in LLM-as-a-Judge via Random Number Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are often used as evaluators of text quality, known as LLM-as-a-Judge, which can outperform conventional automatic evaluation metrics that rely on reference texts. However, LLM evaluators tend to generate particular scores regardless of the context of the evaluated text, which is known as scoring bias. This study proposes a novel method to mitigate this scoring bias. An LLM is instructed to randomly generate number tokens, and the latent numerical bias of the LLM is identified by measuring the deviation of the observed distribution of numbers from the uniform distribution. A definition of a downstream task, for which an LLM evaluator is used, is added to the prompts for random number generation to measure task-specific latent number bias. In the evaluation by an LLM, the token generation probabilities for a given input are rectified considering the LLM's latent number bias. Results of the experiment on four different tasks, evaluation of LLM alignment, evaluation of summarization, Semantic Textual Similarity, and Semantic Textual Relatedness, demonstrate that our proposed method outperforms the baselines, including an LLM without debiasing and previous calibration methods. In addition, it is confirmed that scoring bias varies across LLMs, tasks, and score ranges, indicating the importance of measuring latent number bias as the case may be.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 LLM-as-a-Judge 的评分偏置 (scoring bias) 问题提出一种去偏方法：让 LLM 随机生成数字 token，通过观察数字分布与均匀分布的偏差来识别其潜在数字偏置，并在后续评估中修正给定输入下的 token 生成概率。实验在四个任务（LLM 对齐评估、摘要评估、语义文本相似度 (STS)、语义文本相关性 (STR)）上报告该方法优于未去偏的 LLM 和先前校准方法。
Motivation: LLM 作为评估者虽能超越依赖参考文本的传统自动指标，但容易生成与评估内容无关的特定分数，即评分偏置；且偏置随模型、任务和分数区间变化，需要针对性地测量与校正。
Method: 提示 LLM 随机生成数字 token，并测量生成数字分布相对均匀分布的偏差以刻画潜在数字偏置；为获取任务特定的偏置，在随机数字生成的提示中加入下游评估任务的定义；最终在 LLM 评估时依据该潜在数字偏置修正输出 token 的生成概率。
Result: 在四个不同任务上，该去偏方法优于未去偏的 LLM 以及先前校准方法；同时实验确认评分偏置会随 LLM、任务和分数范围的不同而变化。
Conclusion: 作者强调评分偏置因模型、任务和分数区间而异，按具体情况测量潜在数字偏置对有效去偏十分重要。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对 LLM-as-a-Judge 的评分偏置 (scoring bias) 问题提出一种去偏方法：让 LLM 随机生成数字 token，通过观察数字分布与均匀分布的偏差来识别其潜在数字偏置，并在后续评估中修正给定输入下的 token 生成概率。实验在四个任务（LLM 对齐评估、摘要评估、语义文本相似度 (STS)、语义文本相关性 (STR)）上报告该方法优于未去偏的 LLM 和先前校准方法。
summary_sections.motivation: LLM 作为评估者虽能超越依赖参考文本的传统自动指标，但容易生成与评估内容无关的特定分数，即评分偏置；且偏置随模型、任务和分数区间变化，需要针对性地测量与校正。
summary_sections.method: 提示 LLM 随机生成数字 token，并测量生成数字分布相对均匀分布的偏差以刻画潜在数字偏置；为获取任务特定的偏置，在随机数字生成的提示中加入下游评估任务的定义；最终在 LLM 评估时依据该潜在数字偏置修正输出 token 的生成概率。

papers.title: TRACE: Ergodic Trajectory Optimization for Active Scene Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Existing active reconstruction systems with Gaussian-splatting maps select observations greedily, optimizing a single next-best-view (NBV) at each step and connecting the chosen views by short-horizon path planning. This greedy decoupling disregards the global structure of scene information, producing inefficient trajectories that waste sensing capacity in transit between selected views. In this work, we study active reconstruction as an ergodic coverage problem: the time-averaged spatial statistics of the sensor trajectory should match a target information distribution induced by the current map. Our approach derives this target distribution online from uncertainty and visibility, and calculates ergodic trajectories via a kernel-ergodic horizon planner with gradient flow and footprint depletion, closing the loop between mapping and trajectory optimization. We thoroughly evaluate TRACE on the Replica dataset against the Next-Best-View (NBV) baselines, improving PSNR by 1.5 dB. Code: https://github.com/spikelab-jhu/trace-active-reconstruction.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TRACE，一种将主动场景重建建模为遍历覆盖（ergodic coverage）问题的方法：传感器轨迹的时间平均空间统计应匹配当前地图诱导的目标信息分布。目标分布由不确定性和可见性在线推导，并通过带梯度流和足迹消耗的内核遍历水平规划器计算轨迹，从而闭环映射与轨迹优化。在 Replica 数据集上与 Next-Best-View (NBV) 基线相比，PSNR 提升 1.5 dB。
Motivation: 现有基于高斯溅射地图的主动重建系统贪婪地选择观测，每次只优化单个下一最佳视图，并通过短视路径规划连接所选视图；这种贪婪解耦忽略了场景信息的全局结构，导致轨迹低效，在视图之间浪费感知能力。
Method: 将主动重建视为遍历覆盖问题：在线从不确定性和可见性推导目标信息分布，并使用内核遍历水平规划器（kernel-ergodic horizon planner），结合梯度流与足迹消耗（footprint depletion）计算遍历轨迹，使映射与轨迹优化闭环。
Result: 在 Replica 数据集上与 Next-Best-View 基线相比，TRACE 将 PSNR 提高了 1.5 dB。
Conclusion: 作者认为，将主动重建建模为遍历覆盖问题并使时间平均轨迹统计匹配地图信息分布，可以克服贪婪解耦的低效性，显著改善重建质量。

papers.title: Rethinking and formalising the state across languages: a unified computational learning theory account
papers.abstract_en: The linguistic notion of state has traditionally been restricted to the construct (annexation) state of Afroasiatic languages and treated as a language-specific morphosyntactic phenomenon. This article argues instead that the state is a systemic, context-dependent morphosyntactic mechanism that selects grammatical templates across synthetic languages. Within the Template-Based Modular Cognitive framework, taking Riffian as its primary empirical basis, the proposed theory provides a unified explanation for diverse nominal marking patterns traditionally analysed independently and is formalised as a symbolic computational model in which the state is represented by a set-valued function over grammatical templates. A learning algorithm based on finite-set operations acquires and predicts state-dependent grammatical configurations. Beyond nominal morphology, the framework has broader implications for theories of nominal structure and lexical cognition, in particular offering a unified analysis of determiner-noun structure. These results suggest that the state constitutes one instance of a broader class of syntactically conditioned dependencies that also includes agreement and grammatical case.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在计算语言学视角下重新审视“状态”(state)这一语言学概念，主张它并非闪含语系(如构造态 annexation state)特有的形态句法现象，而是一种跨语言的、依赖语境的系统性机制，负责在综合语中选择语法模板。作者以里夫语(Riffian)为主要经验基础，在基于模板的模块化认知框架内提出统一解释，并将其形式化为一个符号计算模型：状态被表示为语法模板上的集值函数，并给出基于有限集运算的学习算法。
Motivation: 传统的语言学研究把“状态”限制在亚非语系(如构造态)中，视之为语言特异的形态句法现象，导致各种名词标记模式被分开分析，缺乏统一的理论解释。
Method: 提出“基于模板的模块化认知框架”(Template-Based Modular Cognitive framework)，把状态定义为语法模板上的集值函数，并用基于有限集操作的符号计算模型来获取和预测状态相关的语法配置。
Result: 摘要没有报告量化实验数据；宣称该框架能够统一解释多种名词标记模式，并对名词结构和词汇认知(尤其是限定词-名词结构)提供统一分析。
Conclusion: 作者认为状态是一类更广泛的句法条件依赖的实例，这类依赖还包括一致关系(agreement)和语法格(grammatical case)，表明该框架具有超出名词形态学的一般性意义。

papers.title: A Fortran General-Purpose Transpiler: Proof of Concept
papers.abstract_en: Fortran has been the cornerstone of high-performance computing for decades and remains unmatched in many domains. Yet the language faces an expertise gap: a new generation of scientists is barely familiar with it, while many experienced Fortran developers are only now transitioning to modern ecosystems such as JAX. This gap often results in "Fython" - Python code written with a Fortran mindset - that fails to leverage modern frameworks. We present FGPT, a transpiler framework designed to bridge this gap. It provides a systematic pipeline that transpiles Fortran into GPU-adapted Fortran, auto-differentiable Fortran via Tapenade, or NumPy and JAX scripts. Its architecture comprises three stages: (i) a frontend that parses Fortran and extracts target procedures along with all their dependencies; (ii) a middle-end that lowers the code into an intermediate representation, then into GPU-adapted or auto-differentiable Fortran, or a NumPy class; and (iii) a backend that transforms NumPy scripts into JAX modules optimized for GPU acceleration and automatic differentiation. Large language models fail when applied to the scale of community scientific codes-often spanning hundreds of thousands of lines-where consistent transformations, strict numerical fidelity, and validation against production tests are non-negotiable. FGPT addresses these challenges by preserving program semantics throughout the entire translation. We verified the framework on representative climate modeling kernels and demonstrated that it produces correct, differentiable Python implementations without requiring manual intervention. By combining rigorous compiler techniques with modern accelerator support, FGPT offers a scalable, trustworthy path for modernizing legacy Fortran code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FGPT，一个通用的 Fortran 转译器框架，将 Fortran 代码转译为 GPU 适配的 Fortran、经 Tapenade 自动微分的 Fortran，或 NumPy/JAX 脚本。框架采用三阶段架构：前端解析 Fortran 并提取目标过程及其依赖，中端将代码降级为中间表示并生成目标代码，后端将 NumPy 脚本转换为面向 GPU 加速与自动微分的 JAX 模块。作者在代表性气候模拟核上验证了无需人工干预即可生成正确、可微的 Python 实现。
Motivation: Fortran 在高性能计算领域仍占主导，但新一代科学家对其不熟悉，而资深开发者转向 JAX 等现代生态时常写出未充分利用框架能力的“Fython”代码。大规模社区科学代码通常有数十万行，需要一致的变换、严格的数值保真和生产测试验证，大语言模型难以胜任，因此需要保留语义的系统化转译方案。
Method: 提出 FGPT 转译器，采用三阶段流水线：前端解析 Fortran 并提取目标过程及其依赖；中端将代码降级到中间表示，再生成 GPU 适配或可自动微分的 Fortran，或 NumPy 类；后端将 NumPy 脚本转换为面向 GPU 加速与自动微分的 JAX 模块。整个翻译过程中保持程序语义。
Result: 摘要报告在代表性气候模拟核上验证了该框架，演示其能在无需人工干预的情况下产生正确、可微的 Python 实现。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过结合严谨的编译器技术与现代加速器支持，FGPT 为遗留 Fortran 代码的现代化提供了一条可扩展且可信的路径。
Relevance: 50

papers.title: MUGEN: A Unified Framework for Efficient Motion Understanding and Generation
papers.abstract_en: Grounding human motion in language, and language in motion, is a central step toward physical AI systems that can understand, generate, and communicate human behavior. Unified motion--language systems first coupled the two directions through a shared discrete motion codebook, but quantization limits generation quality. The strongest generators buy quality back at growing cost: stacked residual codebooks enlarge the representation; masked decoding stages, long autoregressive rollouts, and denoising chains of tens to hundreds of steps stretch inference; even the continuous-latent designs among them reach their latent only through an iterative diffusion head; and none of this decoding machinery serves understanding. We therefore propose MUGEN, a unified motion--language framework that pays neither cost: no codebook, one draw. A single adaptive-length autoencoder compresses any-length motion into a few continuous latent slots, the system's only motion representation: the language model generates them for text-to-motion and reads them back for motion understanding. Depth-routed hidden states let each slot read from the transformer depth it needs, and a calibrated head predicts a joint distribution over the full latent set, so a single draw carries the text-conditional, cross-slot variation a description permits. At a decoding cost of K language-model steps, one draw, and one decoder pass, MUGEN leads language-model baselines on FID on HumanML3D while raising retrieval precision above the real-motion reference under the standard evaluator, achieves the best CIDEr and BLEU@4 scores, and surpasses the discrete-token state of the art on every retrieval and alignment metric on SnapMoGen.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MUGEN，一个统一的运动-语言框架，目标是在避免离散量化或迭代解码开销的同时同时支持文本到运动生成与运动理解。其核心是一个自适应长度的自编码器，将任意长度运动压缩为少量连续潜变量槽 (continuous latent slots)，语言模型既生成这些槽也读取它们；深度路由隐状态 (depth-routed hidden states) 允许每个槽从所需的 Transformer 深度读取信息，校准头 (calibrated head) 则预测完整潜变量集上的联合分布，使单次采样即可携带文本条件下的跨槽变化。摘要报告在 HumanML3D 和 SnapMoGen 上的生成质量与检索/对齐指标均优于语言模型基线和离散 token 方法。
Motivation: 统一运动-语言系统通常依赖共享离散运动码本，但量化限制了生成质量；更强生成器需叠加残差码本、掩码解码、长自回归展开或数十上百步去噪链，成本高昂，且这些解码机制对理解任务无帮助。
Method: MUGEN 使用单个自适应长度自编码器，将任意长度运动压缩成少量连续潜变量槽，作为系统唯一的运动表示；语言模型为文本到运动生成这些槽，并为运动理解读取它们。深度路由隐状态允许每个槽从所需 Transformer 深度读取信息，校准头预测完整潜变量集的联合分布，使单次采样即可承载描述所允许的文本条件化跨槽变化，总解码成本为 K 步语言模型步、一次采样和一次解码器前向。
Result: 在解码成本仅为 K 步语言模型步、一次采样、一次解码器前向的情况下，MUGEN 在 HumanML3D 上以 FID 领先语言模型基线，并在标准评估器下将检索精度提升至超过真实运动参考；在 CIDEr 和 BLEU@4 上取得最佳分数，并在 SnapMoGen 上于所有检索和对齐指标上超越离散 token 最先进方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 MUGEN 通过单一连续表示以最小解码成本同时覆盖生成与理解，无需码本或迭代解码机制，在统一运动-语言建模上具备效率优势。

papers.title: DeepLoop: Depth Scaling for Looped Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Looped Transformers scale sequential computation by applying a compact stack of physical blocks for multiple rounds, increasing unrolled depth without increasing stored parameters. This reuse changes the residual-scaling problem: in an untied Transformer, each residual branch receives and applies its own parameter update, whereas in a looped Transformer one shared update aggregates gradients from repeated visits and is read back by those same visits in the next linearized forward pass. We formalize this tied-depth effect through a first-order perturbation bound controlled by a visit-alignment coefficient $κ_R$. The bound recovers the DeepNorm exponent when visits decorrelate, but in the conservative aligned regime it requires the exponent to increase from $1/4$ to $1/2$ as loop count grows at fixed physical depth. The resulting method, \textbf{DeepLoop}, keeps the Post-LN DeepNorm architecture and sets $α=(2N)^{1/2}$ and $β=(8N)^{-1/2}$ for unrolled depth $N$. On GPT-style looped language models at GPT-2 small and GPT-2 medium scale, DeepLoop is neutral when no physical block is revisited and improves validation loss and downstream accuracy once recurrent depth is activated. These results show that stable recurrent depth requires residual scaling rules that account for parameter visits, not only nominal layer count.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究循环 Transformer（Looped Transformers）在参数共享条件下残差缩放的稳定性问题。作者用受访问对齐系数 κ_R 控制的一阶扰动界刻画 tied-depth 效应，指出在保守对齐情形下，将物理深度固定而增加循环次数时，残差缩放指数需从 1/4 提高到 1/2。据此提出 DeepLoop 方法，保持 Post-LN DeepNorm 架构并取 α=(2N)^{1/2}、β=(8N)^{-1/2}；在 GPT-2 small 和 GPT-2 medium 规模的循环语言模型上，开启循环深度后验证损失与下游准确率均有改善。
Motivation: 在循环 Transformer 中，共享参数的多轮访问使梯度更新被多次聚合并在下一轮线性化前向传播中被重复读取，这不同于 untied Transformer 中每个残差分支各自更新参数；现有残差缩放规则只按名义层数设计，可能忽略参数被访问次数，导致深层循环训练不稳定。
Method: 形式化 tied-depth 效应：通过受访问对齐系数 κ_R 控制的一阶扰动界分析梯度共享对残差缩放的影响，在访问去相关时恢复 DeepNorm 指数，而在保守对齐情形下需将指数随循环次数从 1/4 提高到 1/2。DeepLoop 保留 Post-LN DeepNorm 架构，对展开深度 N 设置 α=(2N)^{1/2}、β=(8N)^{-1/2}。
Result: 在 GPT-2 small 和 GPT-2 medium 规模的循环语言模型上，当没有物理块被重访时 DeepLoop 保持中性；一旦激活循环深度，验证损失和下游准确率相比基线得到改善。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，稳定的循环深度需要能反映参数访问次数的残差缩放规则，而不仅仅是名义层数；DeepLoop 提供的缩放方案在实验规模上验证了这一观点。

papers.title: When Does Reward Teach State? A Hidden-Automaton Instrument and a Group-Language Warning Signal
papers.abstract_en: Does a reinforcement-learning agent that earns high reward actually learn its task's hidden state, or only a shortcut that correlates with reward? We build an instrument that makes this question directly measurable: the task is a hidden finite automaton that the agent partially controls. Because the automaton is known, the best achievable return is computable, and raw reward becomes a normalized score. The true state is also known at every step, so a linear probe can test whether the agent tracks a state it never observes. Measured separately, reward and state learning come apart: weak on-policy RL earns reward while the state probe stays at chance. Whether the agent escapes this shortcut depends on the optimizer, the training budget, and the task's structure. Structure gives an early warning: when the automaton is a permutation (group-language) automaton, a property readable from its transition table before any training, the agent will likely fail to learn the state. On a stratified set of 153 held-out automata the warning is right in 89 of the 103 cases where it fires; its absence, though, is no guarantee of safety. The instrument also tells apart two failures that reward alone cannot: a perception gap, where the linear probe finds no trace of a state the network could have represented, and a planning gap, where the state is decodable yet reward stays low. High reward alone is not evidence that the task's state was learned.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables (9-page main text). Ancillary file hidden-automata-rl-code.zip contains reproduction code and the complete per-run data behind every table and figure. v3: author name corrected, title revised, text rewritten for clarity, new robustness checks (nonlinear and off-policy probes) added; results and conclusions unchanged
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了一个使“智能体是否学到任务隐藏状态”可直接测量的实验装置：任务是部分受智能体控制的隐藏有限自动机，由于自动机已知，最优回报可计算、原始奖励可归一化，且每一步的真实状态已知，从而可用线性探针 (linear probe) 检测智能体是否跟踪了从未观测到的状态。作者发现奖励与状态学习可以分离：弱的 on-policy RL 能获得奖励，但状态探针仍停留在随机水平；此外，当自动机是置换型 (group-language) 自动机时，可在训练前从转移表读出预警信号。
Motivation: 高奖励并不能证明强化学习智能体学会了任务的真实隐藏状态，它可能只学到了与奖励相关的捷径；现有方法难以直接度量这一差距，作者希望构建一个使该问题可测量的工具。
Method: 将任务设计为已知的隐藏有限自动机，使其最优回报可计算、奖励可归一化；利用每一步已知的真实状态，用线性探针判断网络是否表示该状态。作者还提出一个基于自动机转移表的可读属性：置换（群语言）自动机会给出状态学习可能失败的早期预警。
Result: 在分层的 153 个留出自动机上，预警在触发的 103 个案例中有 89 个正确；但预警缺席并不保证安全。实验还区分了两种奖励无法区分的失败模式：感知缺口 (perception gap)，即线性探针找不到网络本可表示的状态痕迹；以及规划缺口 (planning gap)，即状态可解码但奖励仍然较低。
Conclusion: 高奖励本身不能作为任务状态已被学会的证据；自动机的结构特征可在训练前提供部分预警，但该预警并非充分的安全保证。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Physics-Inspired Classical Digital Twin of Cortical Dynamics: A Band-Stratified Metriplectic Port-Hamiltonian Neural Network Learned from Brain-Computer-Interface EEG
papers.abstract_en: We present a physics-inspired classical digital twin of brain-computer- interface (BCI) data: a graph neural network constrained to a band-stratified, metriplectic port-Hamiltonian form, with parameters learned from scalp EEG recorded during rest and motor imagery. The port-Hamiltonian structure is a modelling choice - it buys passivity, a certified steady-state power balance, and a clean separation of storage, routing and dissipation - not a claim about what the brain is. The state pairs each channel's instantaneous phase with its angular frequency, and stored energy decomposes over the five canonical frequency bands. A phase-locking prior measured from the same recordings gates the learned connectome, and a metriplectic formulation places the twin at a non- equilibrium steady state sustained by a metabolic port. Fitted to 'FitTrainN' phasor samples from the PhysioNet EEG Motor Movement/Imagery database under a leakage-free split, the twin reaches a held-out reconstruction error of 'FitTestMSE'. Scored free-running against invariants it did not author, the verdict is mixed: it reproduces near-critical avalanche branching ($σ\approx1$) but not the aperiodic $1/f$ slope or the long-range temporal correlations of the recordings. Skew-symmetry and non-negative dissipation hold by construction rather than by penalty, making the twin a structure-preserving substrate on which closed-loop neuromodulation can be designed and tested.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个受物理启发的经典数字孪生（digital twin）模型，用于脑-机接口（BCI）数据：将图神经网络约束为分带（band-stratified）的 metriplectic port-Hamiltonian 形式，并从静息态和运动想象的头皮 EEG 学习参数。状态将每个通道的瞬时相位与角频率配对，存储能量按五个规范频带分解；同一记录中测得的锁相先验（phase-locking prior）门控学习到的连接矩阵，metriplectic 公式使孪生模型处于由代谢端口维持的非平衡稳态。模型在 PhysioNet EEG Motor Movement/Imagery 数据库上以无泄漏划分训练，并在自由运行测试中复现了近临界雪崩分支（σ≈1），但未能复现非周期 1/f 斜率与长时程时间相关性。
Motivation: 作者希望为 BCI 皮层动力学提供一个受物理启发的数字孪生，以支持闭环神经调控（closed-loop neuromodulation）的设计与测试。port-Hamiltonian 结构作为一种建模选择，带来无源性（passivity）、可认证的稳态功率平衡以及存储、路由和耗散的清晰分离，而不是对大脑本质的断言。
Method: 方法是一个受约束为 band-stratified metriplectic port-Hamiltonian 形式的图神经网络。状态变量是每个通道的瞬时相位与角频率，存储能量按五个规范频带分解；用同一记录估计的锁相先验来门控学习到的连接矩阵，并通过 metriplectic 公式将系统置于由代谢端口维持的非平衡稳态。
Result: 摘要报告在 PhysioNet EEG Motor Movement/Imagery 数据库上以无泄漏划分拟合 'FitTrainN' 个相量样本，得到留出重构误差 'FitTestMSE'。自由运行测试的评判为喜忧参半：能复现近临界雪崩分支（σ≈1），但不能复现非周期 1/f 斜率或记录中的长时程时间相关性。
Conclusion: 作者强调斜对称（skew-symmetry）与非负耗散（non-negative dissipation）是通过构造保证而非惩罚项实现，因此该孪生模型是可用于设计和测试闭环神经调控的结构保持（structure-preserving）基底。同时指出 port-Hamiltonian 结构只是建模选择，并非对大脑真实机制的宣称。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Diffusion-MF: Approximate Structured Diffusion for Sequence Labelling
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Diffusion-MF, a discrete diffu- sion sequence labeller that places a linear-chain conditional random field (LCRF) inside the denoising loop. Unlike prior diffusion labellers, it performs structured inference at every step; parallel Mean-Field makes this efficient. Across multilingual POS, CoNLL-2003 NER, and joint Chinese Segmentation and POS, Diffusion-MF achieves the best primary result across all experimental settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Diffusion-MF，一种离散扩散序列标注器，将线性链条件随机场 (LCRF) 放入去噪循环中，并在每个步骤进行结构化推理，利用并行 Mean-Field 保持效率。在跨语言词性标注、CoNLL-2003 命名实体识别以及中文分词与词性联合任务上，该方法在所有实验设置中取得最佳主结果。
Motivation: 先前的扩散序列标注器没有在去噪过程中显式建模标签之间的结构化依赖，可能限制序列级推理质量。
Method: 在离散扩散去噪循环中嵌入线性链条件随机场 (LCRF)，使每一步都能进行结构化推理；为控制计算成本，使用并行 Mean-Field 近似推理。
Result: 在跨语言 POS、CoNLL-2003 NER 和中文分词与 POS 联合任务上，Diffusion-MF 在所有实验设置中均取得最佳主结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为在每一步引入结构化推理是提升扩散序列标注性能的有效途径，且并行 Mean-Field 使其在计算上可行。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Recognizing Co-Speech Gestures in-the-Wild
papers.abstract_en: While humans naturally gesture during speech, only a sparse subset of these co-speech gestures are visually depictive and semantically linked to specific spoken words. In this paper, we introduce a large-scale dataset -- Gesture Recognition in the Wild (GRW), comprising co-speech gestures corresponding to a diverse vocabulary of 155 words. GRW contains 140k manually annotated video clips where the word is spoken, with 17k instances of semantic co-speech gestures including their frame-level temporal boundaries. The video clips are collected 'in the wild' from public-facing discourse, including lectures, talk shows, and interviews, covering a diverse range of speakers and visual conditions. We also introduce video models to: (a) classify gestures as semantic or not; (b) recognize the word corresponding to a co-speech gesture; and (c) temporally localize the gesture. These models are trained and evaluated on the GRW dataset and compared against a range of strong baselines, establishing benchmark results for all three tasks. The dataset, annotations, and trained models are publicly available on the project website: https://www.robots.ox.ac.uk/~vgg/research/grw.
papers.journal_ref: European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出大规模数据集 GRW (Gesture Recognition in the Wild)，包含与 155 个单词对应的共语手势 (co-speech gestures)，共 140k 个手工标注的视频片段，其中 17k 为语义性共语手势并带有帧级时间边界。数据来自讲座、脱口秀和访谈等公开话语场景。作者还引入视频模型完成三个任务：判断手势是否具有语义、识别手势对应的单词、以及对手势进行时间定位，并在 GRW 上与多个强基线对比建立基准结果。
Motivation: 人类在说话时自然产生手势，但只有稀疏的一小部分共语手势在视觉上具有描绘性并与具体话语语义相关；现有研究缺乏针对这类语义手势的大规模野外数据集和基准。
Method: 构建 GRW 数据集，收集野外视频并手工标注 140k 个说出目标单词的片段，其中 17k 个语义手势带帧级时间边界；同时提出视频模型用于语义手势分类、手势对应单词识别和手势时间定位三个任务。
Result: 在 GRW 上对所提模型与多个强基线进行比较，为三个任务建立了基准结果；数据集、标注和训练模型已公开。
Conclusion: 该工作为野外共语语义手势识别提供了大规模资源与基准，但摘要未涉及手势生成或跨模态语义建模的局限。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出大规模数据集 GRW (Gesture Recognition in the Wild)，包含与 155 个单词对应的共语手势 (co-speech gestures)，共 140k 个手工标注的视频片段，其中 17k 为语义性共语手势并带有帧级时间边界。数据来自讲座、脱口秀和访谈等公开话语场景。作者还引入视频模型完成三个任务：判断手势是否具有语义、识别手势对应的单词、以及对手势进行时间定位，并在 GRW 上与多个强基线对比建立基准结果。
summary_sections.motivation: 人类在说话时自然产生手势，但只有稀疏的一小部分共语手势在视觉上具有描绘性并与具体话语语义相关；现有研究缺乏针对这类语义手势的大规模野外数据集和基准。
summary_sections.method: 构建 GRW 数据集，收集野外视频并手工标注 140k 个说出目标单词的片段，其中 17k 个语义手势带帧级时间边界；同时提出视频模型用于语义手势分类、手势对应单词识别和手势时间定位三个任务。
summary_sections.result: 在 GRW 上对所提模型与多个强基线进行比较，为三个任务建立了基准结果；数据集、标注和训练模型已公开。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作为野外共语语义手势识别提供了大规模资源与基准，但摘要未涉及手势生成或跨模态语义建模的局限。

papers.title: DATAREEL: Automated Data-Driven Video Story Generation with Animations
papers.abstract_en: Data videos combine animated visualizations with synchronized narration to communicate quantitative information and are widely used in journalism, education, and public communication. Automatically generating them requires deciding what story to tell, designing effective visualizations, and producing executable animations synchronized with narration. Despite rapid progress in vision-language models (VLMs), it remains unclear how well they can perform this task from a high-level communicative intent, largely because no standardized benchmark exists. We introduce DATAREEL, a benchmark for automated data-driven video story generation containing 328 real-world data reels. Given a data table, a communicative intent, a target duration, and a style reference image, a model must generate executable animation code with synchronized subtitles, which we render and evaluate. Evaluating eight proprietary and open-weight VLMs reveals a substantial capability gap: open-weight models exhibit execution failure rates of up to 39.8%, whereas proprietary models achieve stronger overall performance. Yet even the best-performing models frequently generate static charts, subtitle-animation desynchronization, unstable layouts, and poor adherence to the reference style. We further introduce a strong agentic baseline that decomposes generation into planning, coding, and verification, consistently outperforming direct prompting in both human and automatic evaluations. The task remains far from solved; we release DATAREEL at https://github.com/vis-nlp/DataReel to support future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DATAREEL，一个面向自动化数据驱动视频故事生成 (data video story generation) 的基准，包含 328 个真实世界数据短片。给定数据表、交际意图、目标时长和风格参考图，模型需生成带同步字幕的可执行动画代码并渲染评估。作者评测了 8 个专有和开源权重视觉语言模型 (VLM)，发现开源模型的执行失败率最高达 39.8%，且即便最佳模型也常生成静态图表、字幕与动画不同步、布局不稳定以及风格遵循不佳。文中还提出一个将生成拆分为规划、编码和验证的智能体基线，在人工和自动评估中均优于直接提示。
Motivation: 自动生成数据视频需要决定讲什么故事、设计有效可视化并生成与解说同步的可执行动画，但缺乏标准化基准，因此尚不清楚视觉语言模型 (VLM) 能否从高层交际意图完成该任务。
Method: 引入包含 328 个真实数据短片的基准 DATAREEL，要求模型根据数据表、交际意图、目标时长和风格参考图生成可执行动画代码与同步字幕；同时提出一个将流程分解为规划、编码和验证的智能体基线 (agentic baseline)。
Result: 对 8 个专有与开源 VLM 的评测显示，开源模型执行失败率最高达 39.8%，专有模型整体表现更强；即便最佳模型也频繁出现静态图表、字幕-动画不同步、不稳定布局和参考风格遵循不佳等问题。智能体基线在人工和自动评估中均稳定优于直接提示。
Conclusion: 作者认为该任务远未解决，并开源 DATAREEL (https://github.com/vis-nlp/DataReel) 以支持后续研究。
