papers.title: CASA: Classification Augmented with Safety Attention for Robust Multimodal Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large-language models (MLLMs) often experience degraded safety alignment when harmful queries exploit cross-modal interactions. Models aligned on text alone show a higher rate of successful attacks when extended to two or more modalities. We propose a simple conditional decoding strategy, CASA (Classification Augmented with Safety Attention) that uses internal representations of MLLMs to predict a binary safety token before response generation. The classification is guided by a safety attention mechanism that computes attention between a dedicated query prompt and the input to scale the classification logits, sharpening the model's ability to detect malicious queries. Our design ensures robust safety alignment without relying on any external classifier or auxiliary head, and without modality-specific safety fine-tuning. Unlike prior safety-decoding methods that attach an external classifier or moderation head, or rescale every generated token with a reward model, CASA makes a single, internal, attention-gated safety decision over the shared multimodal representation, which is precisely what lets safety learned from text-only training transfer to image and audio inputs. Compared against 4 baseline models across 7 attack types spanning text, image, and audio modalities, evaluated on benchmarks such as MM-SafetyBench, JailbreakV-28k, and adversarial audio tests, CASA lowers the average attack success rate by >90% relative when paired with a standard safety prompt (applied to all baselines for fair comparison), and by 54--61% using its internal safety mechanism alone. Our empirical evaluations also show that CASA~maintains strong utility on benign inputs, validated through both automated and human evaluations (via 13 trained annotators). Together, these results highlight CASA as a simple and generalizable framework to improve multimodal LLM safety.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CASA（Classification Augmented with Safety Attention），一种面向多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的安全对齐条件解码策略。CASA 利用模型内部表示在生成响应前预测一个二值安全 token，并通过安全注意力机制对分类 logits 进行缩放，以增强对恶意跨模态查询的检测。摘要报告该方法在文本、图像和音频多种攻击类型上显著降低攻击成功率，且不依赖外部分类器或模态特定的安全微调。
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型在安全对齐上存在退化问题：仅基于文本对齐的模型在扩展到两个或更多模态时，更容易被利用跨模态交互的有害查询攻击成功。现有安全解码方法多依赖外部分类器、审核头或奖励模型逐 token 重缩放，缺乏对共享多模态表示的统一内部安全决策。
Method: CASA 是一种简单的条件解码策略，使用 MLLM 的内部表示预测一个二值安全 token，并引入安全注意力机制，在专用查询 prompt 与输入之间计算注意力以缩放分类 logits。该设计在不使用外部分类器或辅助头、无需模态特定安全微调的情况下，对共享多模态表示做单一的注意力门控安全决策，从而使仅从文本训练学到的安全能力迁移到图像和音频输入。
Result: 在与 4 个基线模型、7 种跨文本/图像/音频攻击类型的对比中（基准包括 MM-SafetyBench、JailbreakV-28k 和对抗性音频测试），CASA 在搭配标准安全 prompt 时平均攻击成功率相对降低超过 90%，仅使用内部安全机制时降低 54–61%。自动化和 13 名训练标注者的人类评估均显示 CASA 在良性输入上保持较强效用。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 CASA 是一个简单且具有泛化能力的框架，可提升多模态 LLM 的安全性，其核心在于利用内部注意力门控的安全决策实现跨模态安全对齐迁移。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Probing Visual Concepts in Lightweight Vision-Language Models for Automated Driving
papers.abstract_en: The use of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in automated driving applications is becoming increasingly common, with the aim of leveraging their reasoning and generalisation capabilities to handle long-tail scenarios. However, these models often fail on simple visual questions that are highly relevant to automated driving, and the reasons behind these failures remain poorly understood. In this work, we examine the intermediate activations of VLMs and assess the extent to which specific visual concepts are linearly encoded, with the goal of identifying bottlenecks in the flow of visual information. Specifically, we create counterfactual image sets that differ only in a targeted visual concept and then train linear probes to distinguish between them using the activations of five state-of-the-art (SOTA) VLMs, including two training variants for one model. Our results show that concepts such as the presence of an object or agent in a scene are explicitly and linearly encoded, whereas other spatial visual concepts, such as the orientation of an object or agent, are only implicitly encoded by the spatial structure retained by the vision encoder, or are not linearly encoded at all. In parallel, we observe that in certain cases, even when a concept is linearly encoded in the model's activations, the model still fails to answer correctly. This leads us to identify two failure modes. The first is perceptual failure, where the visual information required to answer a question is not linearly encoded in the model's activations. The second is cognitive failure, where the visual information is present but the model fails to align it correctly with language semantics. Finally, we show that increasing the distance of the object in question quickly degrades the linear separability of the corresponding visual concept...
papers.journal_ref: Transactions on Machine Learning Research, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究轻量级视觉语言模型（VLM）在自动驾驶场景中回答简单视觉问题失败的原因，通过线性探针（linear probe）分析中间激活中视觉概念的线性编码程度。作者构造仅在目标视觉概念上有差异的反事实图像集，对五个SOTA VLM（含一个模型的两个训练变体）进行探测，发现物体/智能体存在性被显式线性编码，而方向等空间概念仅隐含编码或完全无法线性编码，并据此区分感知失败与认知失败两类模式。
Motivation: VLM在自动驾驶中常用以处理长尾场景，但经常在简单且高度相关的视觉问题上失败，失败原因尚不清楚；本文旨在定位视觉信息流中的瓶颈。
Method: 构建反事实图像集，使图像仅在某个目标视觉概念上不同，然后训练线性探针，利用五个SOTA VLM（其中包含一个模型的两种训练变体）的激活来区分这些图像，并评估概念是否被线性编码；同时结合模型回答正确性与编码结果分析失败模式。
Result: 摘要显示，场景中对象或智能体的存在性被显式且线性地编码，而对象/智能体的朝向等空间视觉概念仅通过视觉编码器保留的空间结构被隐含编码，或完全无法线性编码；即使概念可线性编码，模型仍可能答错。增加对象距离会快速降低对应视觉概念的线性可分性。
Conclusion: 作者将失败归因于两类模式：感知失败（所需视觉信息未在线性编码中体现）和认知失败（信息存在但未与语言语义正确对齐），并指出距离增大对线性可分性的退化是影响自动驾驶相关视觉问答的一个因素。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Counterfactual Simulation Training for Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness
papers.abstract_en: Inspecting Chain-of-Thought reasoning is among the most common means of understanding why an LLM produced its output. But well-known problems with CoT faithfulness severely limit what insights can be gained from this practice. In this paper, we introduce a training method called Counterfactual Simulation Training (CST), which aims to improve CoT faithfulness by rewarding CoTs that enable a simulator to accurately predict a model's outputs over counterfactual inputs. We apply CST in two settings: (1) CoT monitoring with cue-based counterfactuals, to detect when models rely on spurious features, reward hack, or are sycophantic, and (2) counterfactual simulation over generic model-based counterfactuals, to encourage models to produce more faithful, generalizable reasoning in the CoT. Experiments with models up to 235B parameters show that CST can substantially improve monitor accuracy on cue-based counterfactuals (by 35 accuracy points) as well as simulatability over generic counterfactuals (by 2 points). We further show that: (1) CST outperforms prompting baselines, (2) rewriting unfaithful CoTs with an LLM is 5x more efficient than RL alone, (3) faithfulness improvements do not generalize to dissuading cues (as opposed to persuading cues), and (4) larger models do not show more faithful CoT out of the box, but they do benefit more from CST. These results suggest that CST can improve CoT faithfulness in general, with promising applications for CoT monitoring. Code for experiments in this paper is available at https://github.com/peterbhase/counterfactual-simulation-training
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Counterfactual Simulation Training (CST) 训练方法，通过奖励那些能使模拟器在反事实输入上准确预测模型输出的思维链 (Chain-of-Thought)，来提升 CoT 的忠实度。该方法在 cue-based 和 generic 两类反事实设置中应用，实验表明在最多 235B 参数的模型上，监控准确率提升 35 个精度点，通用反事实上的可模拟性提升 2 个点。作者认为 CST 能普遍改善 CoT 忠实度，并对 CoT 监控有应用前景。
Motivation: CoT 推理是理解 LLM 输出的常用手段，但 CoT 不忠实 (unfaithful) 的已知问题严重限制了从中获得的洞察，因此需要训练方法来提升忠实度。
Method: 提出 CST 训练方法，其核心是让模型生成的反事实 CoT 能够使一个模拟器 (simulator) 在反事实输入上准确预测模型输出；该方法在两种设置中应用：基于 cue 的反事实用于 CoT 监控，基于模型生成的反事实用于鼓励更忠实、可泛化的推理。
Result: 实验显示，CST 将 cue-based 反事实的监控准确率提升 35 个精度点，将 generic 反事实的可模拟性提升 2 个点；CST 优于 prompting 基线；用 LLM 重写不忠实 CoT 比单独使用 RL 高效 5 倍；忠实度改进不能泛化到劝阻性 (dissuading) cue（相对于说服性 cue）；更大的模型并不会天然有更忠实的 CoT，但从 CST 中获益更多。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 CST 可以普遍提升 CoT 忠实度，并具有良好的 CoT 监控应用前景；实验代码已公开。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出 CST 训练方法，其核心是让模型生成的反事实 CoT 能够使一个模拟器 (simulator) 在反事实输入上准确预测模型输出；该方法在两种设置中应用：基于 cue 的反事实用于 CoT 监控，基于模型生成的反事实用于鼓励更忠实、可泛化的推理。
summary_sections.result: 实验显示，CST 将 cue-based 反事实的监控准确率提升 35 个精度点，将 generic 反事实的可模拟性提升 2 个点；CST 优于 prompting 基线；用 LLM 重写不忠实 CoT 比单独使用 RL 高效 5 倍；忠实度改进不能泛化到劝阻性 (dissuading) cue（相对于说服性 cue）；更大的模型并不会天然有更忠实的 CoT，但从 CST 中获益更多。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调 CST 可以普遍提升 CoT 忠实度，并具有良好的 CoT 监控应用前景；实验代码已公开。

papers.title: Parameter-free Dynamic Regret: Time-varying Movement Costs, Delayed Feedback, and Memory
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we study dynamic regret in unconstrained online convex optimization (OCO) with movement costs. Specifically, we generalize the standard setting by allowing the movement cost coefficients $λ_t$ to vary arbitrarily over time. Our main contribution is a novel algorithm that establishes the first comparator-adaptive dynamic regret bound for this setting, guaranteeing $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{(M^2+MP_T)(T+\sum_t λ_t)})$ regret, where $P_T$ is the path length of the comparator sequence over $T$ rounds and $M$ is the maximal comparator norm. Our result recovers the optimal adaptive rates for both static and dynamic regret in OCO as the special case where $λ_t=0$ for all rounds. To demonstrate the versatility of our results, we consider two applications: OCO with delayed feedback and OCO with time-varying memory. We show that both problems can be translated into time-varying movement costs, establishing a novel reduction specifically for the delayed feedback setting that is of independent interest. A crucial observation is that the first-order dependence on movement costs in our regret bound plays a key role in enabling optimal comparator-adaptive dynamic regret guarantees in both settings.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究带移动代价 (movement costs) 的无约束在线凸优化 (OCO) 中的动态遗憾，将标准设定推广为代价系数 λ_t 随时间任意变化。作者提出一种新算法，给出该设定下首个比较器自适应 (comparator-adaptive) 动态遗憾界，形如 O~(√((M^2+M P_T)(T+Σ_t λ_t)))，其中 P_T 是比较器序列的路径长度、M 是最大比较器范数。该结果在 λ_t=0 时恢复 OCO 中静态与动态遗憾的最优自适应率，并进一步将延迟反馈 (delayed feedback) 和时变记忆 (time-varying memory) 两类问题归约到该框架。
Motivation: 现有动态遗憾研究通常假设移动代价系数固定，而真实场景中代价可能随时间变化；现有方法也未能在该一般化设定下获得比较器自适应的最优遗憾保证。
Method: 作者提出一种参数无关 (parameter-free) 的算法，直接建立比较器自适应的动态遗憾界；关键技巧是把延迟反馈和时变记忆问题分别归约到时变移动代价设定，其中针对延迟反馈的归约被作者指出具有独立价值。
Result: 摘要报告遗憾界为 O~(√((M^2+M P_T)(T+Σ_t λ_t)))，并在 λ_t=0 的特例下恢复静态与动态遗憾的最优自适应率；作者强调遗憾界中关于移动代价的一阶依赖是实现两个应用设定下最优比较器自适应保证的关键。
Conclusion: 本文建立了时变移动代价下动态遗憾的比较器自适应上界，并通过归约展示了延迟反馈与时变记忆场景的可应用性；摘要未给出实验数据，结论以理论保证为主。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: "LLM Agent Performance" Is Not a Single Evaluation Target
papers.abstract_en: LLM agent benchmark scores are shaped not only by the model but also by the agent harness, environment, evaluator, and inference budget. Unified execution controls these non-model factors by evaluating candidate models under the same configuration, making observed differences more attributable to the models themselves. However, model comparison is only one use of agent benchmarks. Other evaluations compare complete agent systems or test whether a fixed model or system remains stable across predeclared changes in its operating conditions. These results can all be reported under the common label of "LLM agent performance." Our position is that "LLM agent performance" does not denote a single evaluation target. Model comparisons under a reference stack and comparisons of complete agent systems answer different questions, while robustness asks whether either conclusion persists across predeclared conditions. The claim supported by a score therefore depends on the declared candidate boundary and condition policy. We derive implications for leaderboards, result reporting, and benchmark versioning, showing how distinguishing these classes preserves fair comparison while accommodating system innovation and robustness analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文，主张“LLM agent performance”并不是单一的评测目标：智能体基准分数同时受模型、agent harness、环境、评估器和推理预算影响。作者提出区分模型对比、完整智能体系统对比和鲁棒性检验三类评估，并认为分数所支持的结论取决于声明的候选边界与条件策略。摘要还推导了该区分对排行榜、结果报告和基准版本管理的启示。
Motivation: 现有智能体基准得分经常把模型能力与非模型因素混在一起，且“LLM agent performance”被用于指代多种不同问题；这使公平比较和结论解释变得不清晰。
Method: 提出一个概念框架：通过统一执行控制（unified execution controls）固定非模型因素以比较模型；同时按候选边界（candidate boundary）与条件策略（condition policy）区分系统级对比和跨预声明条件的鲁棒性检验。
Result: 该文是立场论文，摘要未报告实验数据；其核心输出是推导区分三类评估目标对排行榜设计、结果报告和基准版本管理带来的影响，以兼顾公平比较、系统创新与鲁棒性分析。
Conclusion: 作者认为“LLM agent performance”不应被视为单一指标，按评估目标区分后才能保持公平比较并兼容系统创新和鲁棒性分析。

papers.title: Learning Ordinal Degradation Representations with Textual Priors for Diffusion-Based Blind Image Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Blind image super-resolution (Blind SR) has achieved remarkable perceptual quality via generative priors. However, lacking clear degradation representations such as varying severity and mixtures, these methods fail to accurately reflect the actual degradation process. This limitation severely compromises restoration fidelity and leads to content inconsistencies, especially in diffusion-based blind SR models that rely on simple textual descriptions for contextual guidance. To bridge the gap between high-level semantics and low-level degradation artifacts, we introduce Ordinal Degradation CLIP (OD-CLIP), leveraging textual priors to enhance the learning of continuous degradation-level representations. Unlike standard CLIP text encoders, which struggle to represent numerical intensity, OD-CLIP moves beyond coarse labels by modeling unknown degradations as a continuous spectrum representing quality. By learning an ordinal embedding from low-quality inputs, our design captures both degradation types and their relative severity, explicitly modeling the degradation hierarchy and enabling interpolation across unseen levels. In our experiments, the OD-CLIP representation demonstrates stronger ordinal ranking and perceptual distance modeling compared to baseline methods. When applied to blind SR, we show that conditioning on OD-CLIP maintains fidelity and preserves content structures over existing methods in both unknown and mixed-degradation settings on real-world benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Ordinal Degradation CLIP (OD-CLIP)，用文本先验 (textual priors) 为扩散式盲图像超分 (blind image super-resolution) 学习连续的退化级别表征。与标准 CLIP 文本编码器不同，OD-CLIP 将未知退化建模为表示质量的连续谱，通过序数嵌入 (ordinal embedding) 同时刻画退化类型及其相对严重程度，并支持跨未见级别的插值。实验表明该表征在序数排序和感知距离建模上优于基线；用于盲 SR 时，在未知与混合退化场景下比现有方法更好地保持保真度和内容结构。
Motivation: 现有盲 SR 方法缺少清晰的退化表征（如不同严重程度和混合退化），难以准确反映实际退化过程，导致恢复保真度受损；依赖简单文本描述的扩散式盲 SR 模型尤其容易出现内容不一致。
Method: 引入 OD-CLIP，利用文本先验增强连续退化级别表征的学习；将未知退化建模为表示质量的连续谱而非粗糙标签，从低质量输入学习序数嵌入，显式建模退化层级并支持在未见级别间插值。
Result: 摘要报告 OD-CLIP 表征在序数排序与感知距离建模上优于基线；将其用于盲 SR 后，在真实世界基准的未知退化和混合退化设置下，相比现有方法更好地保持保真度与内容结构。
Conclusion: 作者强调打通高层语义与低层退化伪影之间的鸿沟、以连续序数方式刻画退化层级，是提升扩散式盲 SR 恢复一致性的关键。

papers.title: Robust inference using density-powered Stein operators
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a density-power weighted variant of the Stein operator, called the $γ$-Stein operator, for robust inference with unnormalized probability models. The operator is motivated by the first variation of the $γ$-divergence under infinitesimal escort transport and weights the usual Stein field by a positive power of the model density. This weighting down-weights observations in low model-density regions, providing a principled robustness mechanism while retaining the normalizing-constant-free structure of score matching. We develop the resulting $γ$-score matching estimating equations and discuss their non-integrable, generalized-method-of-moments character. We further study two extensions: a $γ$-kernelized Stein discrepancy, interpreted as a robust diagnostic or contaminated-null goodness-of-fit procedure, and $γ$-Stein variational gradient descent for robust posterior approximation. Numerical examples on directional, mixture, and quartic-potential models illustrate the robustness--efficiency trade-off: positive $γ$ can stabilize inference under targeted contamination, whereas $γ=0$ remains preferable under clean well-specified models.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in Information Geometry. This version incorporates the revisions made during peer review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出密度幂加权的 Stein 算子（γ-Stein operator），用于非归一化概率模型的稳健推断。该算子基于 γ-散度在无穷小 escort transport 下的一阶变分，以模型密度的正幂加权通常的 Stein 场，从而降低低密度区域观测的影响，同时保留 score matching 不需归一化常数的结构。作者推导了相应的 γ-score matching 估计方程，并给出 γ-kernelized Stein discrepancy 与 γ-Stein variational gradient descent 两种扩展；数值实验在 directional、mixture 和 quartic-potential 模型上展示了稳健性与效率的权衡。
Motivation: 针对基于非归一化模型的 score matching 估计对离群点或模型误设敏感的问题，希望在不依赖归一化常数的前提下引入稳健性机制。
Method: 引入 γ-Stein 算子，通过模型密度的正幂对通常的 Stein field 加权，构造 γ-score matching 估计方程，并讨论其非可积的 generalized method of moments 特征；还提出 γ-kernelized Stein discrepancy 和 γ-Stein variational gradient descent 两种扩展。
Result: 数值结果显示，在 directional、mixture 和 quartic-potential 模型上，正的 γ 在针对性污染下能够稳定推断，而 γ=0 在干净且设定正确的模型下仍更优，体现稳健性—效率权衡。
Conclusion: 作者强调 γ 的选择存在权衡：正 γ 为污染数据下的推断提供稳健性，但在无污染且模型正确时，γ=0（标准 score matching）仍然可取。

papers.title: Free Denoising Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: We develop a free-probabilistic framework for denoising diffusion, in which the data is a self-adjoint operator and its law a spectral distribution. The forward process is the free Ornstein--Uhlenbeck diffusion, whose spectral marginals solve a nonlocal Fokker--Planck equation of complex Burgers type carried by the Hilbert transform. Organising the analysis around the $1$-convexity of the free energy along free Wasserstein geodesics, we recover, in the form required by the diffusion schedule, the free logarithmic Sobolev, Talagrand and HWI inequalities of Biane, Hiai--Petz--Ueda and Ledoux--Popescu, together with a dissipation identity and the convergence of a free Jordan--Kinderlehrer--Otto scheme. Specialising Dabrowski's time reversal of free diffusions, we obtain the reverse-time equation, whose drift involves Voiculescu's conjugate variable; the latter is square-integrable at every positive time, with an explicit bound along the schedule. A free Tweedie identity yields a consistent score-matching objective and a finite-dimensional algorithm. For operator-valued volatility, we compute the spectral velocity field, match it to a Hermitian matrix model, and show that the resulting diffusion admits neither a spectral Lamperti reduction nor a Wasserstein gradient-flow structure unless the coefficient is constant. We further give a threshold for the survival of a spectral gap along the flow, in terms of the second-order Cauchy kernel of the initial law, and report numerical experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于自由概率 (free probability) 的去噪扩散模型框架：数据被建模为自伴算子，其分布为谱测度，前向过程采用自由 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 扩散。摘要报告利用自由能量沿自由 Wasserstein 测地线的 1-凸性恢复多种自由不等式，推导反向时间方程与自由 Tweedie 恒等式，并给出有限维 score-matching 算法；对算子值波动率情形，则指出不存在谱 Lamperti 约化与 Wasserstein 梯度流结构，除非系数为常数。
Motivation: 填补去噪扩散模型在非交换/自由概率框架下缺乏严格理论分析的问题；现有扩散理论通常假设数据为有限维向量或交换随机变量，而本文处理自伴算子型数据及其谱分布。
Method: 以自伴算子和谱分布作为数据与分布对象，用自由 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 扩散作为前向过程；借助自由能量 1-凸性与自由 Wasserstein 几何，结合 Biane、Hiai-Petz-Ueda、Ledoux-Popescu 的自由 Sobolev/Talagrand/HWI 不等式，并特化 Dabrowski 的自由扩散时间反转来构造反向漂移与 score-matching 目标。
Result: 摘要报告得到非局部 Fokker-Planck 方程（复 Burgers 型），反向时间漂移由 Voiculescu 共轭变量给出且每正时间平方可积，并给出沿调度显式界；自由 Tweedie 恒等式产生一致 score-matching 目标。还给出谱间隙沿流动存活的阈值，以初始律的二阶 Cauchy 核表示，并有数值实验。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架为谱分布型扩散模型提供了统一的自由概率视角，同时指出算子值波动率情形一般既无谱 Lamperti 约化也无 Wasserstein 梯度流结构，只有常数系数才保持这些结构；这划定了方法的适用范围。

papers.title: Let's Unlearn Stereotypes Before Decision-Making: Assessing the Impact of Intrinsic Bias Mitigation on Downstream Fairness in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in high-stakes decision-making systems, where biased predictions can reinforce social and economic disparities. Although prior work has examined intrinsic representational bias and unfair downstream behavior separately, it remains unclear whether mitigating intrinsic bias leads to fairer downstream outcomes. We introduce Fairness-Aware Concept Unlearning (FACU), a model-level mitigation method that adapts concept unlearning to fairness-oriented representation balancing. Unlike suppression-based approaches, FACU explicitly regularizes probability differences between stereotypical and anti-stereotypical associations while preserving predictive performance and language modeling quality. We evaluate FACU across three open-source LLMs, multiple intrinsic bias benchmarks, and three socio-economic classification datasets using both frozen LLM embeddings and LoRA-fine-tuned classifiers. FACU produces statistically significant reductions in intrinsic gender bias that are associated with downstream fairness improvements across most evaluated settings, datasets, models, and fairness metrics, without significantly degrading predictive performance. Combining FACU with extrinsic mitigation methods, particularly counterfactual data augmentation, yields further fairness improvements. These findings suggest that fairness-aware intrinsic mitigation can support fairer LLM-based decision-making and that bias mitigation should be addressed across both model development and downstream deployment stages.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出公平感知概念遗忘 (FACU)，一种在模型层面将概念遗忘 (concept unlearning) 改造为面向公平的表示平衡的 LLM 偏见缓解方法。作者在三个开源 LLM、多个内在偏见基准和三个社会经济分类数据集上评估，发现内在性别偏见的统计显著下降与大多数评估设置中的下游公平性改善相关，且未显著损害预测性能。与外在缓解方法尤其是反事实数据增强结合时，公平性进一步提升。
Motivation: 以往研究分别考察了内在表征偏见和下游不公平行为，但内在偏见的缓解是否真的带来更公平的下游决策结果尚不明确。
Method: FACU 显式正则化刻板印象 (stereotypical) 与反刻板印象 (anti-stereotypical) 关联之间的概率差异，同时保留预测性能与语言建模质量，并使用冻结 LLM 嵌入和 LoRA 微调分类器进行下游评估。
Result: 摘要报告 FACU 在大多数设置、数据集、模型和公平性指标上产生了与下游公平性改善相关的统计显著内在性别偏见降低，且没有显著降低预测性能；与反事实数据增强等外在缓解方法结合可进一步改善公平性。
Conclusion: 公平感知的内在偏见缓解能够支持更公平的基于 LLM 的决策，偏见缓解应同时覆盖模型开发和下游部署阶段。

papers.title: Using Reinforcement Learning to Optimize the Global and Local Crossing Number
papers.abstract_en: Graph drawing concerns the algorithmic visualization of graphs. A good drawing of a graph is easy to read and facilitates solving tasks on the graph. Several properties have been identified to occur in good drawings of graphs. Such properties include a low number of crossings, large angles between edges, short edges, and depicting symmetries. Many of these properties are explicitly measurable metrics. This lets us model a graph-drawing problem as a game where a single player iteratively moves vertices of a straight-line graph drawing to reduce edge crossings. We investigate whether reinforcement learning can discover effective strategies for playing this game. Our reinforcement-learning agent observes the local geometric and structural context of a vertex and selects a movement direction with the goal of reducing either the global or the local crossing number, that is, either the total number of crossings or the maximum number of crossings per edge. We compare the resulting strategies to existing methods and established crossing-minimization heuristics on standard benchmark graphs. While our approach does not out-compete state-of-the-art methods for minimizing the global crossing number, it is competitive and often superior for minimizing the local crossing number.
papers.comment: Appears in the Proceedings of the 34th International Symposium on Graph Drawing and Network Visualization (GD 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究用强化学习（reinforcement learning）优化直线图绘制的交叉数问题。作者将图绘制建模为单智能体游戏，智能体观察顶点的局部几何与结构上下文，选择移动方向来减少全局交叉数（总交叉数）或局部交叉数（每条边最大交叉数）。在标准基准图上与现有交叉最小化启发式方法比较，结果表明该方法在最小化全局交叉数上不敌现有最优方法，但在最小化局部交叉数上具有竞争力且常常更优。
Motivation: 图绘制中低交叉数是评价绘制质量的重要指标，而现有的交叉最小化方法多为传统启发式；作者探索强化学习能否自动发现有效的交叉减少策略，特别是针对全局和局部交叉数两种目标。
Method: 将图绘制建模为单人游戏，强化学习智能体基于顶点的局部几何和结构上下文选择移动方向，目标是减少全局交叉数（总交叉数）或局部交叉数（每条边的最大交叉数），并在标准基准图上与已有方法及交叉最小化启发式进行比较。
Result: 在最小化全局交叉数方面，该方法未超越现有最优方法；但在最小化局部交叉数上，该方法表现具有竞争力且经常优于对比方法。
Conclusion: 摘要表明强化学习能够为局部交叉数最小化发现有效策略，但全局交叉数最小化仍需依赖更强的现有方法。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Social World Models
papers.abstract_en: Humans intuitively navigate social interactions by simulating unspoken dynamics and reasoning about others' perspectives, even with limited information. In contrast, AI systems struggle to structure and reason about implicit social contexts, as they lack explicit representations for unobserved dynamics such as intentions, beliefs, and evolving social states. In this paper, we introduce the concept of social world models (SWMs) to characterize the complex social dynamics. To operationalize SWMs, we introduce a novel structured social world representation formalism (S3AP), which captures the evolving states, actions, and mental states of agents, addressing the lack of explicit structure in traditional free-text-based inputs. Through comprehensive experiments across five social reasoning benchmarks, we show that S3AP significantly enhances LLM performance-achieving a +51% improvement on FANToM over OpenAI's o1. Our ablations further reveal that these gains are driven by the explicit modeling of hidden mental states, which proves more effective than a wide range of baseline methods. Finally, we introduce an algorithm for social world models using S3AP, which enables AI agents to build models of their interlocutors and predict their next actions and mental states. Empirically, S3AP-enabled social world models yield up to +18% improvement on the SOTOPIA multi-turn social interaction benchmark. Our findings highlight the promise of S3AP as a powerful, general-purpose representation for social world states, enabling the development of more socially-aware systems that better navigate social interactions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出社会世界模型（Social World Models, SWMs）的概念，并引入结构化表示 S3AP，用于显式捕捉社交互动中 agent 的演化状态、动作和心智状态（如意图、信念）。通过五个社交推理基准的实验，S3AP 显著提升 LLM 性能，在 FANToM 上比 OpenAI o1 提高 51%，并在 SOTOPIA 多轮社交交互基准上带来最多 18% 的提升。消融实验表明增益主要来自对隐藏心智状态的显式建模。
Motivation: AI 系统难以结构化地推理隐含社交语境，因为缺乏对未观测动态（如意图、信念和演化中的社会状态）的显式表示，而人类能凭有限信息模拟这些动态。
Method: 引入 S3AP（structured social world representation formalism），一种结构化社交世界表示形式，显式建模 agent 的演化状态、动作和心智状态；并基于 S3AP 提出构建社交世界模型的算法，使 AI 智能体能够建立对对话者的模型并预测其下一步动作和心智状态。
Result: 在五个社交推理基准上，S3AP 显著提升 LLM 性能：在 FANToM 上相对 OpenAI o1 提升 51%；消融显示收益由显式建模隐藏心智状态驱动，优于多种基线；在 SOTOPIA 多轮社交交互基准上提升最多 18%。
Conclusion: S3AP 有望成为一种通用的社交世界状态表示，推动更具社交感知能力的系统开发，使其更好地应对社交互动。摘要未提及该方法的适用范围或局限性。

papers.title: Inference-Time Scaling of Diffusion Language Models via Trajectory Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Discrete diffusion models have recently emerged as strong alternatives to autoregressive language models, matching their performance through large-scale training. However, inference-time control remains relatively underexplored. In this work, we study how to steer generation toward desired rewards without retraining the models. Prior methods typically resample or filter within a single denoising trajectory, optimizing rewards step-by-step without trajectory-level refinement. We introduce particle Gibbs sampling for diffusion language models (PG-DLM), an inference-time algorithm enabling trajectory-level refinement. PG-DLM constructs a Markov chain over full denoising trajectories and applies a conditional sequential Monte Carlo kernel to resample them. By doing so, PG-DLM introduces a new scaling axis, the number of refinement iterations, which is unavailable to prior methods. Increasing iterations remains effective even as gains from adding more parallel samples saturate. Furthermore, PG-DLM enables adaptive compute allocation by performing additional iterations only when needed, leading to further efficiency gains. We derive theoretical guarantees for convergence and variance bounds, and analyze trade-offs across different scaling axes. Empirically, PG-DLM outperforms prior methods across compute budgets on reward-guided generation tasks. On GSM8K, it achieves 90.07% accuracy with 2.9 particles on average and 94.47% accuracy with 24.8 particles on average.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PG-DLM，一种基于粒子吉布斯采样的推理时算法，对离散扩散语言模型的完整去噪轨迹进行轨迹级修正，无需重训模型即可引导生成朝向指定奖励。方法在完整去噪轨迹上构建马尔可夫链，并用条件序贯蒙特卡洛核重采样轨迹，引入此前方法不具备的“细化迭代次数”扩展轴。实验表明 PG-DLM 在奖励引导生成任务上优于此前方法，并在 GSM8K 上以平均 2.9 个粒子达到 90.07% 准确率，以平均 24.8 个粒子达到 94.47% 准确率。
Motivation: 离散扩散模型已成为自回归语言模型的强替代方案，但推理时控制仍研究不足；此前方法通常在单条去噪轨迹内重采样或过滤，逐步优化奖励，缺少轨迹级细化能力。
Method: 提出粒子吉布斯采样用于扩散语言模型（PG-DLM）：在完整去噪轨迹上构造马尔可夫链，并应用条件序贯蒙特卡洛（conditional sequential Monte Carlo）核重采样轨迹，从而支持通过增加细化迭代次数扩展计算，并允许只在需要时执行额外迭代以实现自适应计算分配；同时给出收敛性与方差界的理论保证。
Result: 在奖励引导生成任务上，PG-DLM 在多种计算预算下超过此前方法；当并行样本带来的收益趋于饱和时，增加细化迭代次数仍有效。GSM8K 上平均 2.9 个粒子时准确率为 90.07%，平均 24.8 个粒子时达到 94.47%。
Conclusion: 作者强调轨迹级细化迭代次数是此前方法不可用的新扩展轴，增加迭代可突破并行样本规模带来的收益上限，自适应计算分配可进一步提升效率；该方法面向不需要重训模型的离散扩散语言模型推理时控制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PURe: A Plug-and-Play Product-Unit Residual Module for Vision Networks
papers.abstract_en: Modern vision networks are dominated by additive local transformations, whereas explicit multiplicative local interactions remain underexplored. Product units offer a direct approach to modeling such interactions, but their use in deep architectures has been limited by optimization instability. In this work, we propose PURe, a product-unit Residual Module for deep vision networks. PURe is built around a 2D product unit with a real-valued log-domain formulation that makes multiplicative local aggregation practical within deep residual hierarchies. The resulting module serves as a drop-in replacement for native residual units. We instantiate PURe in residual CNNs for image classification and in 2D residual encoder--decoder networks for slice-based segmentation on volumetric CT data. Across Galaxy10 DECaLS, ImageNet, and CIFAR-10, PURe consistently improves residual CNNs and yields a more favorable accuracy--parameter trade-off, allowing moderately deep models to match or surpass substantially deeper ResNet baselines with much smaller parameter budgets. On the AMOS benchmark, PURe also improves slice-based CT segmentation under 3D case-level evaluation. These results show that explicit multiplicative local interaction is a practical and effective design primitive for deep residual vision networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PURe，一个基于2D乘积单元（product unit）的残差模块，采用实数对数域公式使乘法局部聚合在深度残差层级中可行，并可作为原生残差单元的即插即用替代。在Galaxy10 DECaLS、ImageNet、CIFAR-10图像分类和AMOS CT分割任务上，PURe一致提升残差CNN，并以更小的参数预算匹配或超越更深的ResNet基线。
Motivation: 现代视觉网络以加性局部变换为主，显式乘法局部交互尚未被充分探索；乘积单元可直接建模此类交互，但其在深度架构中的使用受优化不稳定性限制。
Method: 提出PURe模块，围绕2D乘积单元构造，采用实数对数域（real-valued log-domain）公式，使乘法局部聚合在深度残差层级中实用化，并作为原生残差单元的drop-in替代；作者在残差CNN分类网络和2D残差编码器-解码器分割网络上实例化该模块。

Conclusion: 结果表明，显式乘法局部交互是深度残差视觉网络中实用且有效的设计原语（design primitive）。

papers.title: Certified Interpolation Oversampling: Per-Instance Safety Guarantees for Imbalanced Learning
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic minority oversampling is typically designed and evaluated against a predictive objective, generating samples that improve downstream classification. This paper pursues a second objective by generating samples that carry a stated safety property, established for each instance by construction rather than assumed. We introduce Certified Interpolation Safe Oversampling (CISO), a three-phase interpolation framework built for this objective. A safety-guided distribution selects where synthesis occurs, a locality-and clearance-weighted distribution selects with whom each anchor interpolates, and a q-Gaussian placement density determines how far along the resulting segment each instance is placed. The framework provides three guarantees. Each synthetic instance seeded by a sufficiently safe anchor carries a certified distance from the majority class; a signed temperature parameter provably and monotonically shifts synthesis between boundary-seeking and interior-seeking regimes; and selection weights are strictly positive by construction, so no degenerate case arises. Certification is obtained alongside competitive predictive performance rather than in place of it. Under a protocol preregistered before evaluation, across 45 datasets, four classifiers, and eleven competing methods, CISO is statistically equivalent to SMOTE on precision-recall AUC, ranks second of eleven under gradient boosting, and completes every one of 11,460 fold-level evaluations without failure. A parameter sweep further reveals a continuous fidelity-safety trade-off that competing methods occupy only as isolated points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Certified Interpolation Safe Oversampling (CISO)，一个面向合成少数类过采样的三阶段插值框架，目标是在不牺牲预测性能的前提下，为每个合成样本按构造提供安全属性（与多数类的最小距离保证）。在预注册评估协议下，CISO 在 45 个数据集、4 个分类器、11 个对比方法中与 SMOTE 在 precision-recall AUC 上统计等价，在梯度提升下排名第二，并完成全部 11,460 次折级评估。
Motivation: 现有合成少数类过采样通常只按预测目标设计和评估，生成的样本不一定携带可声明的安全性质；本文针对这一缺口，追求第二个目标：按构造而非假设地为每个实例建立安全属性。
Method: CISO 采用三阶段插值框架：由安全引导的分布决定在何处合成，由局部性与间隔 (clearance) 加权分布决定每个锚点与谁插值，并由 q-Gaussian 放置密度决定沿插值线段放置多远，从而提供三类可证保证。
Result: 预注册评估显示，在 45 个数据集、4 个分类器、11 个对比方法下，CISO 在 precision-recall AUC 上与 SMOTE 统计等价；在梯度提升下排名第二（共 11 个方法），且 11,460 次折级评估全部成功完成。参数扫描还揭示了一个连续的 fidelity-safety 权衡，而对比方法只占据其中的孤立点。
Conclusion: 作者强调该框架在获得可认证安全性的同时仍保持有竞争力的预测性能，而非以牺牲性能为代价；其参数扫描表明安全性与保真度之间存在连续可调的空间。

papers.title: Convergence of Diffusion Models Under the Manifold Hypothesis in High-Dimensions
papers.abstract_en: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPM) are powerful state-of-the-art methods used to generate synthetic data from high-dimensional data distributions and are widely used for image, audio, and video generation as well as many more applications in science and beyond. The \textit{manifold hypothesis} states that high-dimensional data often lie on lower-dimensional manifolds within the ambient space, and is widely believed to hold in provided examples. While recent results have provided invaluable insight into how diffusion models adapt to the manifold hypothesis, they do not capture the great empirical success of these models, making this a very fruitful research direction. In this work, we study DDPMs under the manifold hypothesis and prove that they achieve rates independent of the ambient dimension in terms of score learning. In terms of sampling complexity, we obtain rates independent of the ambient dimension w.r.t.\ the Wasserstein distance. We do this by developing a new framework connecting diffusion models to the well-studied theory of extrema of Gaussian Processes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在流形假设（manifold hypothesis）下研究去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）的高维收敛性，证明其得分学习（score learning）速率与采样复杂度（Wasserstein 距离意义下）均可独立于环境维度（ambient dimension）。作者通过建立扩散模型与高斯过程极值理论之间的新联系来获得这些结果。
Motivation: 现有关于扩散模型如何适应流形假设的理论结果未能解释其在实际高维数据上的巨大经验成功，这一差距值得进一步研究。
Method: 提出一个新的理论框架，将扩散模型与已被充分研究的高斯过程极值（extrema of Gaussian Processes）理论联系起来，从而在流形假设下分析 DDPM 的收敛性质。
Result: 摘要报告：在得分学习方面获得与环境维度无关的收敛速率；在采样复杂度方面，关于 Wasserstein 距离同样获得与环境维度无关的速率。
Conclusion: 该工作主要提供理论保证，显示扩散模型在流形假设下可以摆脱高维环境维度的影响，但摘要未涉及实验验证或具体应用。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Boundary Density Likelihood for Direct Event-Time Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Event detection turns long recordings into a sparse set of ranked timestamps. Yet many sequence models are trained for samplewise segmentation and only convert predicted states into events after training. We ask whether training directly for the evaluated output improves detection. Boundary Density Likelihood (BDL) assigns one unit of target mass to each annotated event, preserves that mass through smoothing and temporal downsampling, and uses a Poisson objective to estimate expected event mass in each output bin; local peaks become ranked detections. In a prespecified five-fold nested sleep study, BDL-Hard raises pooled out-of-fold mAP from 0.586 to 0.705 over interval segmentation (+11.9 percentage points; 95% interval [10.8, 13.0]) and strict one-minute AP from 0.071 to 0.286 (4.0x; +21.5 points), improving on every outer fold. A separate held-out rerun reproduces the direction of the effect. A matched boundary-BCE detector reaches 0.702 mAP, showing that direct boundary supervision and event decoding account for most of the gain, with a smaller contribution from the Poisson objective. The same trend appears with an offline convolutional model; causal, Transformer, and patient-grouped seizure experiments leave broader generalization unresolved. Our results support training on event times when timestamps define the evaluated output.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出边界密度似然 (Boundary Density Likelihood, BDL)，用于直接以事件时间戳监督序列模型训练，使输出直接对应事件检测的评估指标，而不是先训练逐样本分割再事后转成事件。在预设五折嵌套睡眠研究中，BDL-Hard 将汇集的外部折 (out-of-fold) mAP 从 0.586 提高到 0.705，严格一分钟 AP 从 0.071 提高到 0.286。匹配的边界-BCE 检测器达到 0.702 mAP，表明大部分收益来自直接边界监督与事件解码，Poisson 目标贡献较小。
Motivation: 许多序列模型按逐样本分割训练，事后再把预测状态转换为事件，而事件检测的评估输出是排序后的时间戳集合。本文探究直接针对被评估输出（事件时间）进行训练是否能提升检测性能。
Method: BDL 为每个标注事件分配一个单位目标质量，并在平滑和时间下采样过程中保持该质量，再用 Poisson 目标估计每个输出 bin 中的期望事件质量；局部峰值成为排序检测结果。作者还构造了匹配的边界-BCE 检测器，以分离直接边界监督与 Poisson 目标各自的贡献。
Result: 在预设五折嵌套睡眠研究中，BDL-Hard 将 pooled out-of-fold mAP 从 0.586 提升至 0.705（+11.9 个百分点；95% 区间 [10.8, 13.0]），严格一分钟 AP 从 0.071 提升至 0.286（4.0 倍；+21.5 点），每个外折均改善，独立留出重跑复现了效应方向。匹配的边界-BCE 检测器达到 0.702 mAP，说明大部分增益来自直接边界监督与事件解码，Poisson 目标贡献较小；离线卷积模型呈现相同趋势，而因果、Transformer 和按患者分组的癫痫实验留下更广泛泛化问题未解决。
Conclusion: 当时间戳定义了评估输出时，研究结果支持直接按事件时间训练。但对于因果模型、Transformer 以及按患者分组的癫痫等场景，更广泛的泛化性仍未被充分验证。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: MiGHT-EHR: A Multi-task Graph Transformer for Heterogeneous Temporal Electronic Health Records
papers.abstract_en: Learning from Electronic Health Records (EHRs) has gained significant attention due to its potential to improve clinical prediction. However, effective learning remains challenging because EHRs encode heterogeneous, temporally ordered clinical interactions. In particular, EHRs contain: (i) heterogeneous clinical entities, including patients, visits, diagnoses, prescriptions, and procedures, together with their heterogeneous interactions, (ii) longitudinal patient trajectories across hospital visits and (iii) shared statistical dependencies across related clinical prediction tasks. Existing EHR learning methods capture only a subset of these properties. To bridge this gap, we propose Multi-task Graph transformer for Heterogeneous Temporal EHRs (MiGHT-EHR), which jointly models all three within a unified representation learning method. MiGHT-EHR constructs a heterogeneous graph from EHRs in which nodes represent clinical entities and edges connect statistically associated entities identified via normalized point-wise mutual information. Across MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV datasets, MiGHT-EHR outperforms state-of-the-art methods on average across four tasks: drug recommendation, prediction of length-of-stay, mortality, and readmission, with particularly strong improvements in mortality and readmission prediction. Furthermore, a post-hoc analysis of the learned representations reveals that patient neighborhoods are organized by clinical outcomes, salient medical concepts are recoverable as linear directions in the representation space, and task probabilities are well calibrated. Collectively, these findings demonstrate that MiGHT-EHR representations support diverse prediction tasks while preserving clinically interpretable structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MiGHT-EHR，一种面向异构时序电子健康记录（EHR）的多任务图 Transformer，将异构临床实体、跨就诊的纵向患者轨迹以及相关预测任务间的共享统计依赖统一到同一个表示学习方法中。摘要报告在 MIMIC-III 和 MIMIC-IV 上，药物推荐、住院时长、死亡率和再入院四个任务的平均表现超过现有方法，其中死亡率和再入院预测改进尤为突出。事后分析显示患者邻域按临床结局组织，医学概念可在表示空间中以线性方向恢复，且任务概率校准良好。
Motivation: EHR 包含异构临床实体及其交互、跨多次就诊的纵向轨迹，以及相关临床预测任务间的共享统计依赖，而现有 EHR 学习方法只覆盖其中部分性质，缺乏统一建模三者的方法。
Method: 从 EHR 构造异构图，节点为临床实体，边通过归一化点互信息（normalized point-wise mutual information）连接统计关联的实体；随后用多任务图 Transformer 联合学习统一表示，同时建模异构性、时间性和多任务共享依赖。
Result: 在 MIMIC-III 与 MIMIC-IV 上，MiGHT-EHR 在药物推荐、住院时长、死亡率和再入院四个任务的平均性能优于现有方法，死亡率和再入院预测提升尤其明显；事后分析表明学习到的表示具有临床可解释的组织结构。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 MiGHT-EHR 的表示既能支撑多种预测任务，又保留临床可解释的结构；摘要未提及明显的局限。

papers.title: Recovering Lesion Parameters from Aphasic Picture Naming Error Profiles in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Interpretability methods for large language models (LLMs) describe internal state but do not directly test whether that state is causally sufficient to produce the observed behavior. In earlier work, we lesioned LLMs to produce error profiles in picture naming, a central task for assessing aphasia, and found that specific lesions produced errors resembling those of individual stroke survivors. Here we ask the inverse question: given an error profile, can the lesion parameters that produced it be recovered, and what does this inverse problem reveal about transformer computation? Lesions in LLaVA-Vicuna 13B were parameterized by layer index, modification percentage, and noise sigma across 4,840 configurations, and error profiles were characterized by a seven-category clinical taxonomy (correct, semantic, unrelated, formal, mixed, neologism, no-response). We trained a multi-task neural network to map error profiles back to perturbation parameters. The problem admitted a partial solution: across 10 independently trained inverse models, modification percentage and noise sigma were recoverable, whereas layer index was recoverable only within a neighborhood. In counterfactual validation, a fresh model instance perturbed with the recovered parameters reproduced the target behavior in 81.4% of cases. This dissociation between low layer recovery and high counterfactual fidelity is consistent with functional redundancy across transformer layers, a property not captured by standard interpretability methods. As an out-of-distribution test, we applied the trained model to picture-naming error profiles from 278 stroke survivors; recovered parameters were syndrome-discriminative, most strongly for perturbation intensity, indicating generalization beyond the training distribution. Counterfactual validation provides a general framework for LLM interpretability claims beyond inverse mapping.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究从失语症图片命名错误剖面（error profiles）反推产生该剖面的大语言模型损伤参数，即逆映射问题。作者在 LLaVA-Vicuna 13B 上以层索引、修改比例与噪声 sigma 参数化 4840 种损伤配置，并用七类临床错误分类刻画输出；训练多任务神经网络将错误剖面映射回扰动参数。结果发现修改比例与噪声 sigma 可恢复，层索引仅能在邻域内恢复，且反事实验证中恢复参数可复现目标行为。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 可解释性方法只描述内部状态，不直接检验该状态是否因果充分到足以产生观察到的行为。此前工作通过损伤 LLM 产生类似个体卒中患者的图片命名错误，本文提出逆问题：给定错误剖面，能否恢复产生它的损伤参数，以及该逆问题能揭示 Transformer 计算的哪些性质。
Method: 将 LLaVA-Vicuna 13B 的损伤参数化为层索引、修改百分比和噪声 sigma，在 4840 种配置上获取七类临床错误剖面（correct、semantic、unrelated、formal、mixed、neologism、no-response）。训练一个多任务神经网络学习从错误剖面到扰动参数的映射，并用反事实验证检验恢复参数是否能在新模型实例上复现目标行为。
Result: 在 10 个独立训练的逆模型中，修改百分比和噪声 sigma 可以恢复，层索引只能在邻域内恢复。反事实验证中，用恢复参数扰动的新模型实例在 81.4% 的情况下复现目标行为。作为分布外测试，应用于 278 名卒中幸存者的图片命名错误剖面时，恢复参数具有综合征区分性，其中扰动强度区分性最强。
Conclusion: 低层索引可恢复性与高反事实保真度之间的分离，与 Transformer 各层间的功能冗余一致，这是标准可解释性方法未捕获的性质。作者提出反事实验证可作为 LLM 可解释性主张的一般性框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fixed and Adaptive Topological DeepONets: Functional Measurements on Hausdorff Locally Convex Spaces
papers.abstract_en: Deep Operator Networks (DeepONets; arXiv:1910.03193) typically encode an input function through point values on a fixed discretization. Building on the Topological DeepONet framework of Ismailov (arXiv:2603.11972), we replace point samples by continuous linear functionals drawn from the continuous dual of a Hausdorff locally convex space $({V},\{p_α\}_{α\in A})$, whose topology is generated by a point-separating family of seminorms rather than a single norm, and develop fixed and adaptive functional measurement systems. Measurements are combined with the coefficient-space Two-Step procedure of Lee and Shin (arXiv:2309.01020), while a training-only decoder and regularization stabilize the adaptive coordinates. We derive a discrete error decomposition separating measurement, output-basis, and neural-approximation errors, together with a Barron-rate refinement. The framework is evaluated on the antiderivative operator, a non-normable locally convex input space, heterogeneous Darcy flow, a controlled operator, and fixed-time and time-evolving Navier-Stokes vorticity operators. In the heterogeneous Darcy problem, the functional models retain nearly resolution-independent errors of 5.5-5.6% on unseen grids, while in the controlled problem adaptive measurements reduce the mean error below 1.2%. For the fixed-time Navier-Stokes problem, the Adaptive Topological DeepONet is the most accurate DeepONet-based model, attaining a mean relative $L^2$ error of 1.685% +/- 0.017% using 128 functional coordinates. A comparably sized Fourier neural operator (FNO; arXiv:2010.08895) achieves the lower error 0.832% +/- 0.172%, but requires the full 64x64 input field, twice the training time, and 10.7x greater peak GPU memory. The formulation provides compact, interpretable, and discretization-portable coordinates in the continuous dual $V'$, including for non-normable input spaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在 Topological DeepONet 框架基础上，用 Hausdorff 局部凸空间连续对偶中的连续线性泛函替换固定离散化上的点采样，提出固定与自适应泛函测量系统，并结合系数空间两步过程与仅训练解码器及正则化。作者给出将测量误差、输出基误差和神经逼近误差分离的离散误差分解以及 Barron 率细化，并在反导算子、非可赋范输入空间、异质 Darcy 流、受控算子及 Navier-Stokes 涡量算子等任务上验证。
Motivation: 标准 DeepONet 依赖固定离散化上的点值来编码输入函数，难以处理非可赋范局部凸空间，且坐标在分辨率变化时不够便携。目标是在连续对偶空间 V' 中构造更紧凑、可解释且离散化可移植的泛函坐标。
Method: 用来自 Hausdorff 局部凸空间 (V,{p_α}) 连续对偶的连续线性泛函替代点样本，发展固定与自适应两种测量系统；测量与 Lee-Shin 的系数空间 Two-Step 程序结合，并通过仅训练阶段使用的解码器和正则化稳定自适应坐标。理论部分推导了分离测量、输出基和神经逼近误差的离散误差分解，并给出 Barron 率层面的细化。
Result: 在异质 Darcy 问题上，泛函模型在未见网格上保持约 5.5-5.6% 的近分辨率无关误差；受控问题中自适应测量把平均误差降到 1.2% 以下。固定时间 Navier-Stokes 问题中，Adaptive Topological DeepONet 以 128 个泛函坐标取得 1.685%±0.017% 的平均相对 L2 误差，为 DeepONet 类模型中最低；同等规模的 FNO 误差更低（0.832%±0.172%），但需要完整 64x64 输入场、两倍训练时间和 10.7 倍峰值 GPU 内存。
Conclusion: 该公式为包括非可赋范空间在内的输入提供连续对偶 V' 中的紧凑、可解释、离散化可移植坐标，并在多个算子上展示与 FNO 等基线之间的精度-资源权衡。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Adversarial Causal Intervention Falsification
papers.abstract_en: Generative models can reproduce an observational distribution while encoding an incorrect causal structure. We study a sequential game in which a structural causal generator proposes observational and interventional distributions, while an adversarial experimentalist selects interventions intended to maximally falsify the generator. The discriminator is therefore not merely a real-versus-synthetic classifier: it is indexed by an intervention and tests whether the generator reproduces the corresponding post-intervention law. We introduce Adversarial Causal Intervention Falsification (ACIF), formulate oracle and implementable versions of the game, and distinguish three objects that are often conflated: observational fit, interventional equivalence over an admissible query class, and point identification of a structural causal model. For finite model and intervention classes, we prove: (i) an exact reduction of the adversarial objective to a worst-intervention integral probability metric; (ii) identification up to interventional equivalence, with point identification under a separating intervention family; (iii) existence of mixed-strategy equilibria; (iv) finite-sample uniform convergence and margin-based model-selection guarantees; and (v) a logarithmic elimination guarantee for a disagreement-driven sequential design under a balanced-separation condition. We also give a complete linear-Gaussian example in which two observationally indistinguishable causal directions are separated by a single well-chosen intervention. The framework clarifies what an adversarial causal discriminator can and cannot certify, and provides a principled bridge between causal generative modeling, active causal discovery, and experimental design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究一个序贯博弈：结构因果生成器提出观测分布和干预分布，对抗性实验者选择干预以最大程度证伪生成器。作者提出 Adversarial Causal Intervention Falsification (ACIF)，将判别器构造为被干预索引的检验器，并区分观测拟合、干预等价性与结构因果模型的点识别三个常被混淆的对象。对于有限模型和干预类，文章给出对抗目标到最坏干预积分概率度量 (integral probability metric) 的精确化归、混合策略均衡存在性、有限样本一致收敛与模型选择保证，以及一个线性高斯示例。
Motivation: 生成模型可以复现观测分布却编码错误的因果结构，而传统判别器只是真实与合成样本的分类器，无法检验干预分布，因此难以发现因果结构的错误。该问题对因果生成建模、主动因果发现与实验设计都至关重要。
Method: 提出 ACIF 博弈框架，使判别器由一个干预作为索引并检验生成器能否复现对应的后干预分布；同时给出 oracle 版本和可实现版本，并证明对抗目标可化简为最坏干预积分概率度量。
Result: 证明在有限模型和干预类下：（i）识别可达到干预等价性，且在分离干预族下可点识别；（ii）混合策略均衡存在；（iii）有有限样本一致收敛和基于间隔的模型选择保证；（iv）在平衡分离条件下，基于分歧的序贯设计有对数级消除保证。线性高斯例子显示单个精心选择的干预即可区分两个观测上不可区分的因果方向。
Conclusion: 该框架阐明了对抗性因果判别器能够证明和不能证明的内容，为因果生成建模、主动因果发现和实验设计之间提供了理论桥梁。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: NTDH: Complex Reasoning for Comprehensive Affective Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Comprehensive affective analysis is challenging for two reasons: it spans heterogeneous prediction tasks with continuous, ordinal, and multi-label outputs, and affective meaning is context-dependent, requiring conflicting cues to be reconciled rather than mapped directly to labels. Existing methods learn this mapping directly and do not model the reconciliation explicitly. We recast the task as a complex-reasoning problem, which yields one output interface across heterogeneous label spaces and a trajectory over which a verifiable reward can be optimised; to our knowledge, this is the first such treatment covering both sentiment and emotion. The obstacle is on the data side: affective reasoning traces must be synthesised, and generic synthesis is misaligned with the targets, tolerances, and phenomena of affect, and discards or leaks its failure cases. We propose NTDH, which addresses these four failures. Naturalisation sets the training answer to the gold label, so it is correct by construction. A Tolerance-aware gate checks each answer against the task's own scoring margin. Domain-aware strategies refine the reasoning using ideas from affective science. Directional Hints report only the type and direction of an error, without exposing the target. We train Qwen3-8B with SFT and then GRPO under the same tolerance used for verification (up to a more permissive construction gate on the multi-label subtask), and a component ablation quantifies the data-quality effect of each part. Using 16,302 training records, about 14x fewer than comparable instruction-tuned systems, the final policy improves over its SFT checkpoint on five of six official-test metrics and achieves the strongest EI-reg result among the compared systems, at a Pearson correlation of 0.862.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NTDH，将综合情感分析 (comprehensive affective analysis) 重新建模为复杂推理问题，以统一输出接口覆盖连续、序数、多标签等异构标签空间，并给出可验证奖励的推理轨迹。作者用 SFT 和 GRPO 训练 Qwen3-8B，仅用 16,302 条训练记录（约为同类指令微调系统的 1/14），在官方测试的六项指标中五项超过 SFT 检查点，并在 EI-reg 上取得 0.862 的 Pearson 相关，为对比系统中的最强结果。
Motivation: 综合情感分析既涉及连续/序数/多标签等异构预测任务，又因情感意义依赖上下文而需要调和冲突线索；现有方法直接学习从输入到标签的映射，没有显式建模这种调和过程。
Method: NTDH 包含四个组件：Naturalisation 将训练答案设为金标签从而保证正确性；Tolerance-aware gate 依据任务自身评分容差检查答案；Domain-aware strategies 引入情感科学思想细化推理；Directional Hints 只报告错误的类型和方向而不暴露目标。训练流程为 SFT 后接 GRPO，并使用与验证一致（多标签子任务用更宽松的构造门）的容差。
Result: 在 16,302 条训练记录下，最终策略在官方测试六项指标中的五项优于其 SFT 检查点，并取得 EI-reg 最强结果（Pearson 相关 0.862）；组件消融量化了各部分的 data-quality 效果。
Conclusion: 摘要称这是首次同时覆盖 sentiment 与 emotion 的此类复杂推理处理；主要障碍在数据端，即情感推理轨迹需合成，而通用合成与情感的目标、容差和现象错位，且会丢弃或泄漏失败案例，NTDH 针对这四类失败分别设计对策。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Multi Codec Discrete Diffusion Model for Text Guided Speech Inpainting and Editing
papers.abstract_en: Speech recordings often contain missing, corrupted, or incorrect regions that must be reconstructed or modified without re-synthesizing the entire utterance. Speech inpainting restores missing segments, whereas speech editing replaces spoken content according to an edited transcript. Both tasks require the generated speech to express the intended words while remaining consistent with the surrounding speaker identity, prosody, timing, and recording conditions. Discrete diffusion is particularly well suited to these tasks because it can iteratively refine masked tokens while jointly conditioning on both left and right acoustic context. We introduce SIEDD, a discrete diffusion framework for text-guided speech inpainting and editing over hierarchical codec tokens. Its core architecture, HiCoDD, follows the RVQ generation order by representing previously generated codebooks as clean, committed acoustic context and applying diffusion only to the current refinement codebook. This separation enables leakage-free joint training while matching sequential coarse-to-fine inference. The model further combines phoneme-level conditioning, span-localized classifier-free guidance, and duration prediction to support both fixed-duration inpainting and variable-duration text edits. On the RealEdit benchmark, SIEDD achieves the best overall speech-editing performance among the evaluated methods. It also outperforms the evaluated autoregressive baselines across all speech-inpainting settings, on both single and multiple gaps. These results demonstrate that explicitly modeling the codec hierarchy substantially improves context-preserving speech reconstruction and editing. See our full code at https://github.com/iftachShoham/SIEDD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SIEDD，一个用于文本引导语音修复（speech inpainting）与编辑（speech editing）的离散扩散框架，基于分层 codec tokens。其核心架构 HiCoDD 按 RVQ 生成顺序，将先前生成的 codebook 视为干净的已提交声学上下文，只对当前精化 codebook 施加扩散，从而支持无泄漏的联合训练，并与从粗到细的推理顺序匹配。模型还结合音素级条件、span 局部化无分类器引导和时长预测，兼顾固定时长修复与可变时长文本编辑。在 RealEdit 基准上，SIEDD 取得最佳整体语音编辑性能，并在所有语音修复设定（单缺口与多缺口）上优于所评估的自回归基线。
Motivation: 语音录音常包含缺失、损坏或错误区域，需要在不重新合成整个话语的前提下进行重建或修改；已有方法需要在保留说话人身份、韵律、时序和录音条件一致性的同时准确表达目标词。
Method: 提出 SIEDD 离散扩散框架，核心架构 HiCoDD 遵循 RVQ 生成顺序，将先前生成的 codebook 表示为干净、已承诺的声学上下文，仅对当前精化 codebook 做扩散，并组合音素级条件、span 局部化无分类器引导以及时长预测。
Result: 在 RealEdit 基准上，SIEDD 取得所评估方法中最佳的整体语音编辑性能，并在所有语音修复设定（包括单缺口和多缺口）上优于所评估的自回归基线。
Conclusion: 作者认为显式建模 codec 层级结构能显著改善上下文保持的语音重建与编辑。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Sharding Prevents LLM Oversight Failures and Adversarial Exploitation
papers.abstract_en: Giving an LLM judge more compute does not necessarily make it check more requirements. When one call must return many verdicts, some decisions become weakly grounded in the evidence, even when that call receives the same token or tool budget as a panel of separate calls. Across expert-graded research replications, legal work, and clinical-trial assessments, agreement with experts falls as the number of verdicts per call grows. We identify sharding as the intervention that mitigates this failure in model-based oversight. Sharding partitions the requirements into smaller groups, assigns each group to a separate call, and aggregates the verdicts. Against a single call with the panel's full budget, sharding improves agreement while holding the model, evidence, total budget, and per-decision budget fixed. Overall, we find that a sharded weaker judge can outperform a more capable holistic judge and match that judge even when the latter receives the panel's full budget. Additionally, we find that sharding exhibits robustness against adversaries. A best-of-N adversary can hold the underlying work fixed, vary only its presentation, and increase an overloaded judge's acceptance of genuinely unmet criteria severalfold. Wherever sharding reduces baseline error, it removes this adversarial advantage, keeping over-acceptance low even as the adversary's search widens. Sharding does not address attacks that persuade the judge separately on each criterion rather than exploiting overload. In that setting, we find that debate-style opposition on top of sharding withstands such adaptive re-optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 LLM 作为评判者（LLM judge）时，单次调用返回越多判定，其决策越缺乏证据支撑，与专家的一致性随每次调用的判定数量增加而下降。作者提出分片（sharding）干预：将需求划分为更小组，每组独立调用并聚合结果。摘要显示，在固定模型、证据、总预算和单决策预算的条件下，分片能提升与专家的一致性，且分片后的较弱评判者可超越更强大的整体评判者，并对利用过载的对抗性攻击表现出鲁棒性。
Motivation: 模型监督（model-based oversight）中，单纯增加 LLM 评判者的计算量并不必然让其检查更多需求；一次调用同时返回多个判定时，部分决策在证据上缺乏依据，导致与专家判断的一致性下降。
Method: 提出分片（sharding）方法，将需求划分成更小的组，每组分配给独立的调用，最后聚合各组判定；针对逐条说服的对抗性攻击，则在分片基础上叠加辩论式对立（debate-style opposition）。
Result: 与获得专家组全部预算的单一调用相比，分片在固定模型、证据、总预算和每决策预算的情况下提升与专家的一致性；分片的较弱评判者可超越更强的整体评判者。best-of-N 对抗方通过仅改变呈现方式可将过载评判者对未满足标准的接受率提高数倍，而分片在降低基线错误的同时消除了该对抗优势；对于逐条说服的适应式重优化攻击，分片叠加辩论式对立能够抵御。
Conclusion: 分片可缓解 LLM 监督中的判定失败与对抗性利用，但其局限在于无法应对逐个标准分别说服评判者的攻击，此时需要辩论式对立作为补充。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Risk-Aware Decision Policies for Agents Under Noisy Perception
papers.abstract_en: Perception in biological systems is inherently noisy, requiring organisms to make decisions under uncertainty where misclassification can be costly or fatal. We present an Artificial Life predator-prey model of foraging under noisy perception, and compare agent performance when using various policies that take into account their noisy predictions. Through controlled experiments under both symmetric and asymmetric perceptual noise, we show that blindly trusting perceptual labels leads to catastrophic failure as noise increases, while uncertainty-aware strategies significantly improve survival and reduce fatal errors. We further observe qualitative regime shifts in behaviour, with agents transitioning from exploratory to conservative strategies as uncertainty increases. Our model links risk-sensitive foraging, ecological information use, and Artificial Life by showing that explicit information gathering can improve robustness when perception is unreliable. These results highlight the importance of uncertainty-aware decision-making and provide an interpretable artificial life analogue to robust learning with noisy labels.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Submitted to the 2026 Conference on Artificial Life (ALIFE2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个在噪声感知下觅食的人工生命 (Artificial Life) 捕食者-猎物模型，并比较了多种利用噪声预测信息的决策策略。通过对称与非对称感知噪声下的受控实验，摘要表明盲目相信感知标签会在噪声增大时导致灾难性失败，而不确定性感知 (uncertainty-aware) 策略能显著提升存活率并减少致命错误。随着不确定性增加，智能体行为从探索型转向保守型，呈现定性的行为相变。
Motivation: 生物系统的感知本质上带有噪声，错分类可能代价高昂甚至致命，因此需要在不确定性下做出决策；现有策略若忽略预测的不确定性，在噪声增强时鲁棒性不足。
Method: 作者构建了噪声感知觅食的捕食者-猎物人工生命模型，并在对称和非对称感知噪声下进行受控实验，比较多种显式考虑噪声预测的策略。
Result: 摘要报告盲目信任感知标签在噪声增加时导致灾难性失败，而不确定性感知策略显著改善生存率并减少致命错误；同时观察到随不确定性增加，行为从探索型转变为保守型的定性相变。
Conclusion: 摘要把风险敏感觅食、生态信息利用与人工生命联系起来，指出显式信息收集能在感知不可靠时提升鲁棒性，并为噪声标签下的鲁棒学习提供一个可解释的人工生命类比。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Certified Feedforward Tracking for Unknown Nonlinear Systems via Invertible Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we address the certification of datadriven feedforward control for periodic tracking of unknown nonlinear systems under partial state measurements. To this end, we adopt an invertible neural network (INN) as a surrogate for the unknown system. This choice allows us to bypass solving a nonconvex inversion problem, eliminating the associated inversion errors and reducing tracking error certification to a surrogate modeling problem. We then apply conformal prediction to provide finite-sample probabilistic guarantees on the surrogate modeling error which, through the derived tracking error bound, yield marginal certificates on feedforward tracking error. Finally, we demonstrate the approach on a DC-motor-driven mechanical load with nonlinear friction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出在部分状态测量下，用可逆神经网络 (INN) 作为未知非线性系统的代理模型，对周期跟踪的数据驱动前馈控制进行认证。通过 INN 避免求解非凸反演问题，从而消除反演误差，并将跟踪误差认证转化为代理建模误差认证；利用 conformal prediction 提供有限样本概率保证，最终对前馈跟踪误差给出边际证书 (marginal certificates)。该方法在带非线性摩擦的直流电机驱动机械负载上进行了演示。
Motivation: 数据驱动前馈控制在未知非线性系统上缺乏可验证的跟踪误差保证，且部分状态测量使认证更困难；现有基于反演的方案需要求解非凸问题，会引入额外反演误差。
Method: 采用可逆神经网络 (INN) 作为未知系统的代理模型，绕开非凸反演问题；推导跟踪误差界与代理建模误差的联系，并应用 conformal prediction 对代理建模误差提供有限样本概率保证，从而得到前馈跟踪误差的边际证书。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，仅在带非线性摩擦的直流电机驱动机械负载上演示了该认证框架的有效性。
Conclusion: 该方法将跟踪误差认证简化为代理建模误差认证问题，可在部分测量和未知动力学条件下为前馈控制提供概率性跟踪误差保证。

summary_sections.method: 采用可逆神经网络 (INN) 作为未知系统的代理模型，绕开非凸反演问题；推导跟踪误差界与代理建模误差的联系，并应用 conformal prediction 对代理建模误差提供有限样本概率保证，从而得到前馈跟踪误差的边际证书。
summary_sections.result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，仅在带非线性摩擦的直流电机驱动机械负载上演示了该认证框架的有效性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法将跟踪误差认证简化为代理建模误差认证问题，可在部分测量和未知动力学条件下为前馈控制提供概率性跟踪误差保证。

papers.title: Latent Fact-Checking: Detecting Misinformation through Activation Engineering
papers.abstract_en: The proliferation of misinformation online has driven demand for scalable detection systems. While most existing approaches rely on surface-level linguistic features or external knowledge retrieval, we examine truthfulness as a geometric property of a language model's representation space. We introduce a misinformation detection framework grounded in activation engineering, which leverages the latent geometry of transformer models. Our approach elicits a misinformation direction in the residual stream by contrasting activations from paired truthful and false statements, following the difference-in-means principle of Contrastive Activation Addition (CAA). At inference time, the last-token activation of an unseen claim is projected onto this direction, and the projected representation is fed to an Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) for classification. The procedure requires no fine-tuning of the backbone model, no external evidence retrieval, and no task-specific supervision beyond the contrastive pairs used to estimate the direction. We evaluate the method across 11 models from the Gemma, Llama, and Qwen families, ranging from 270M to 12B parameters, on three fact-checking benchmarks: AVeriTeC, LIAR, and FACTors. The falsehood direction is recoverable across model scales and architectural families, and last-token projection matches or surpasses zero-shot and few-shot prompting baselines on LIAR and FACTors, with the largest gains observed for smaller models. Performance on AVeriTeC is more limited, which we attribute to its evidence-grounded labeling scheme. These findings provide evidence that truthfulness is a structured, linearly separable concept in the latent space of pretrained language models, and point toward interpretability-driven misinformation detection as a practical complement to retrieval-based pipelines. The code is available on https://github.com/Malta-Lab/LaFaCt.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于激活工程 (activation engineering) 的虚假信息检测框架，通过对比成对真实与虚假陈述的激活值，在残差流中估计一个“虚假方向”，推理时将未见声明的最后 token 激活投影到该方向并送入 MLP 分类。方法无需微调主干模型、无需外部证据检索，也无需任务特定监督。作者在 Gemma、Llama、Qwen 三个系列的 11 个模型（270M 到 12B 参数）以及 AVeriTeC、LIAR、FACTors 三个事实核查基准上评估，发现虚假方向在不同模型规模和架构间可复现，且最后 token 投影在 LIAR 和 FACTors 上达到或超过 zero-shot/few-shot 提示基线，小模型收益最大。
Motivation: 现有虚假信息检测大多依赖表层语言特征或外部知识检索，本文试图把真实性视为语言模型表示空间中的几何性质，从而绕过对检索和任务监督的依赖。
Method: 遵循对比激活添加 (Contrastive Activation Addition, CAA) 的均值差原则，用成对真实与虚假陈述的激活对比得到残差流中的虚假信息方向；推理时将未见声明的最后 token 激活投影到该方向，再交由多层感知机 (MLP) 分类，整个过程不微调主干模型。
Result: 在 11 个 Gemma、Llama、Qwen 系列模型（270M–12B 参数）上的三个基准评估中，最后 token 投影在 LIAR 和 FACTors 上匹配或超越 zero-shot 与 few-shot 提示基线，且对较小模型提升最大；在 AVeriTeC 上表现有限，作者归因于该基准基于证据的标注方案。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果支持“真实性在预训练语言模型的潜在空间中是一个结构化且线性可分的概念”，并指出面向可解释性的检测可以作为检索流水线的实用补充；代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: WorldMark: A Plug-and-Play World Knowledge Interface for Cross-Host Language Model Watermarking
papers.abstract_en: Watermarking traces the provenance of text produced by large language models by embedding statistically detectable signals during decoding. Existing schemes fall into logits-based, sampling-based, entropy-aware, and adaptive-strength families, yet all of them place watermark signals according to local token statistics. In the open-ended text-generation settings evaluated in this work, local statistics may provide insufficient guidance for placing robust watermark signals. We introduce WorldMark, a plug-and-play interface that uses World Knowledge Memory (WKM) to organize semantic and episodic knowledge in a memory graph, converts the retrieved knowledge into a token-level knowledge saliency score, and adjusts the strength of a host watermark through Asymmetric Knowledge Modulation (AKM). WorldMark requires no backbone retraining and introduces no additional detector-side model or parameter. On the primary C4 evaluation, the complete WorldMark interface improves clean and attacked detection across three adaptive-strength host variants while slightly reducing perplexity. Additional pilot experiments on C4 and OpenGen show that direct memory conditioning transfers across multiple watermark families but can be unstable without saliency-aware modulation. WorldMark requires no additional detector-side model or parameter and introduces negligible overhead under the primary protocol.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WorldMark，一个即插即用 (plug-and-play) 的跨宿主大语言模型水印接口。它通过世界知识记忆 (World Knowledge Memory, WKM) 将语义与情景知识组织为记忆图，将检索到的知识转为 token 级知识显著性分数，并用非对称知识调制 (Asymmetric Knowledge Modulation, AKM) 调整宿主水印的强度。该方法无需重新训练主干模型，也不引入额外的检测端模型或参数。
Motivation: 现有水印方案（logits-based、sampling-based、entropy-aware、adaptive-strength）都依据局部 token 统计放置水印信号；在本文评估的开放式文本生成场景中，局部统计可能不足以指导稳健水印信号的放置。
Method: WorldMark 使用 WKM 组织语义与情景知识为记忆图，将检索知识转换为 token 级知识显著性分数，再通过 AKM 调整宿主水印的嵌入强度，实现对多种宿主水印的即插即用增强。
Result: 在主 C4 评测上，完整 WorldMark 接口在三种 adaptive-strength 宿主变体上提升了干净与攻击场景下的检测性能，同时略降低困惑度 (perplexity)。C4 与 OpenGen 上的初步实验表明，直接记忆条件化可跨多个水印家族迁移，但缺少显著性感知调制时可能不稳定；主协议下额外开销可忽略。
Conclusion: WorldMark 不需要主干重训练、不需要额外的检测端模型或参数，可作为一个通用接口增强既有宿主水印，但其迁移稳定性依赖显著性感知的调制机制。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A proximal subgradient method for nonconvex stochastic optimization under the Kurdyka-Łojasiewicz condition
papers.abstract_en: This work introduces a proximal stochastic subgradient method for minimizing the sum of an expected cost, whose integrand is potentially nonsmooth and nonconvex, and a lower semicontinuous, prox-bounded function. We target a broad class of integrands obeying a nonsmooth, localized variant of the descent lemma in the decision variable, a structural assumption that simultaneously covers smooth losses with Lipschitz gradient and differences of such losses with convex functions. At each iteration the expected cost is replaced by a sample average that is progressively refined, and the proximal-subgradient stepsize is selected by an Armijo-type line search enforcing a sufficient-decrease property up to stochastic errors induced by the sample-based approximation. This framework accommodates substantially more general problem formulations than existing methods, in particular, it requires neither (weak) convexity of the regularizer nor a uniform bound on the variance of the stochastic oracle, and our analysis yields convergence guarantees that are new even in the smooth setting. Specifically, we establish almost sure convergence of the sequence of function values and stationarity of every accumulation point of the trajectories under the relaxed requirement that the sample-size sequence be merely nondecreasing and unbounded, with no prescribed growth rate. Leveraging the Kurdyka-Lojasiewicz (KL) property, we further upgrade this subsequential guarantee to convergence of the whole trajectory to a single stationary point. Finally, for exponential-type KL desingularizing functions and polynomially growing sample sizes, we derive explicit polynomial convergence rates, up to a logarithmic factor, for both the function values and the iterates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种近端随机次梯度方法 (proximal stochastic subgradient method)，用于最小化期望代价与下半连续、prox-bounded 函数之和，其中期望代价的被积函数允许非光滑且非凸。作者在满足非光滑局部化下降引理的一类被积函数框架下，证明在样本量序列仅要求非降且无界时函数值几乎必然收敛、所有聚点都是平稳点，并借助 Kurdyka-Łojasiewicz (KL) 条件升级为整条轨迹收敛。
Motivation: 现有非凸随机优化方法通常要求正则项满足（弱）凸性，或假设随机 oracle 的方差一致有界，这些限制排除了许多实际问题。本文旨在放宽这些假设，覆盖更一般的非光滑非凸目标，并给出即使在光滑情形下也属新颖的收敛保证。
Method: 每步用逐步细化的样本平均近似期望代价，并通过 Armijo 型线搜索 (Armijo-type line search) 选择近端次梯度步长，使充分下降性质在样本近似引入的随机误差下仍然成立。该方法不要求正则项的（弱）凸性，也不要求随机 oracle 的方差一致有界。
Result: 在样本量序列仅为非降且无界的松弛条件下，建立了函数值的几乎必然收敛与每个聚点的平稳性；利用 KL 性质将子序列收敛升级为整条轨迹到单一平稳点的收敛。对指数型 KL 解奇异函数和多项式增长的样本量，进一步导出函数值与迭代点关于多项式收敛速率（至多差一个对数因子）的显式结果。
Conclusion: 本文提出的框架比现有方法适用的问题形式更广泛，并在光滑设定下也给出新的收敛结论；主要代价是依赖 KL 条件来获得全程收敛与显式速率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning to Predict Middle-Layer Attention in MLLMs for Visual Token Prunin
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance across diverse vision-language tasks, but their efficiency is limited by the cost of processing numerous visual tokens. Visual token pruning can reduce this cost, but requires accurate token importance estimates. Recent studies have demonstrated that text-to-vision attention from middle language model layers can effectively guide visual token pruning, typically using attention from a predefined middle layer to select the visual tokens to retain. Two problems therefore remain. First, our analysis shows that the layer whose attention is most responsive to the question varies substantially across samples, making a fixed layer suboptimal. Second, obtaining attention from the appropriate middle layer requires processing numerous visual tokens through several language model layers, by which point considerable computation has already been spent. To address both problems, we propose Middle-layer Attention Prediction (MAP), which uses Question Contrastive Teacher Selection to identify a sample-specific teacher layer by contrasting attention under the original and reference questions, and distills attention from the selected layer into a lightweight predictor that estimates visual token importance from multi-modal input features. During inference, MAP combines the predicted importance scores with a diversity criterion to prune visual tokens before the first language model layer. Thus, MAP requires no attention maps for pruning and remains compatible with existing inference acceleration techniques. Across ten benchmarks on LLaVA-NeXT-7B, MAP retains 97.5% of the unpruned model performance with only 5.56% of the visual tokens, yielding a 3.09x end-to-end speedup.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 中视觉 token 过多导致的推理开销问题，提出 Middle-layer Attention Prediction (MAP) 方法。MAP 通过质疑对比教师选择 (Question Contrastive Teacher Selection) 为每个样本识别最合适的中间层，并将该层的注意力蒸馏到轻量级预测器中，从而在进入第一个语言模型层之前直接预测视觉 token 的重要性并剪枝。在 LLaVA-NeXT-7B 上，MAP 仅保留 5.56% 的视觉 token 即可维持未剪枝模型 97.5% 的性能，并获得 3.09x 端到端加速。
Motivation: 现有视觉 token 剪枝通常依赖预定义中间层的文本到视觉注意力，但作者分析发现最响应该问题的中间层随样本变化很大，固定层并非最优；同时，获取中间层注意力本身需要先处理大量视觉 token，计算开销已产生。
Method: MAP 包含两个关键组件：Question Contrastive Teacher Selection 通过对比原始问题与参考问题下的注意力差异来选择样本特定的教师层；随后将该层注意力蒸馏到轻量级预测器，使模型仅从多模态输入特征估计 token 重要性，并结合多样性准则在首个语言模型层之前完成剪枝。
Result: 在十个基准上基于 LLaVA-NeXT-7B 的评估中，MAP 保留 97.5% 的未剪枝模型性能，仅使用 5.56% 的视觉 token，实现 3.09x 端到端加速。
Conclusion: 摘要指出 MAP 在推理时无需任何注意力图即可剪枝，并且与现有推理加速技术兼容。

papers.title: ADIAS: Automated Design of Interactive Agentic Systems
papers.abstract_en: Automated agent design improves agent harnesses through iterative revision, evaluation, and feedback summarization. Existing methods are largely candidate-centric: cross-round experience is organized around candidate agents, which leaves the repair progress implicit. This causes inefficient repair targeting, slow consolidation of partial progress, and propagation of ineffective interventions across rounds. Therefore, we formulate issue-centric agent optimization, in which repair progress is carried forward as an explicit persistent issue state to guide optimization, rather than re-derived from candidate history in each round. We instantiate the formulation in ADIAS, a framework for automated full-code agent design with two mechanisms. A persistent issue state maintains stable issue identities, lifecycle status, supporting evidence, and intervention-outcome histories. Issue-guided optimization uses this state to jointly propose repair targets and revision directions for subsequent focused full-code modification. Across five interactive benchmarks, ADIAS outperforms the strongest baseline by 25.2% on average and achieves consistent gains across four backbone models. Controlled ablations further show that removing persistent issue state or replacing issue-centric revision with candidate-centric policies leads to performance drops of up to 40.7%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ADIAS，一个自动化全代码智能体设计（automated full-code agent design）框架，将优化重心从候选智能体转向显式的持久问题状态（persistent issue state）。该状态维护问题身份、生命周期状态、支持证据与干预-结果历史，并用于联合生成下一轮完整代码修改的修复目标与修正方向。在五个交互式基准上平均超过最强基线 25.2%，在四种骨干模型上均取得一致提升；消融显示移除问题状态或用候选中心策略替换会造成最高 40.7% 的性能下降。
Motivation: 现有自动化智能体设计是候选中心式的（candidate-centric），跨轮经验围绕候选智能体组织，修复进展是隐式的，导致修复目标不精准、部分进展整合慢、无效干预跨轮传播。作者因此将问题形式化为以问题为中心（issue-centric）的智能体优化，以显式状态承载修复进展。
Method: ADIAS 将修复进展作为显式持久问题状态向前传递，其中包含稳定的问题身份、生命周期状态、支持证据以及干预-结果历史；问题引导的优化（issue-guided optimization）利用该状态联合提议下一轮聚焦式全代码修改的修复目标和修订方向。
Result: 摘要报告 ADIAS 在五个交互式基准上平均超过最强基线 25.2%，并在四个骨干模型上取得一致增益；受控消融表明，移除持久问题状态或以候选中心策略替换问题中心修订会导致最多 40.7% 的性能下降。
Conclusion: 作者认为将修复进展显式建模为持久问题状态，比每轮从候选历史重新推导更高效，并改善了修复目标定位与修改方向的一致性。摘要未讨论明确的局限性。

papers.title: Separating Decision-Rule Misalignment from Readout-Coverage Limitations in Speech Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Speech language models are increasingly evaluated on paralinguistic tasks by the accuracy of prompted answers, but answer accuracy combines failures at different stages of the audio-to-answer computation. We introduce a generation-aligned diagnostic ladder that compares the emitted answer, the option logits, an affine readout of those logits, and a linear readout of the hidden state at the same answer token. Successive differences separate endpoint, decision-rule, and readout-coverage gaps. Across five systems and two emotion corpora, state decoding exceeds generation by 27.8 accuracy points on average, and both the decision-rule and readout-coverage gaps are positive in all ten conditions. A label-free logit correction improves generated accuracy in every condition, showing that part of the decision-rule gap is actionable. In rank-matched comparisons, emotion information outside the native readout generalizes to held-out speakers and survives controls for measured acoustic descriptors, but replacing the selected readout-external directions usually has little effect on emitted answers. These results distinguish information availability from behavioral use and localize performance losses across the decision rule and the state-to-answer readout.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对语音语言模型（speech language model）在副语言任务（paralinguistic task）中仅用提示答案准确率评估的问题，提出一种生成对齐的诊断阶梯（generation-aligned diagnostic ladder），依次比较发出答案、选项 logits、logits 的仿射读出以及同一答案 token 处隐藏状态的线性读出，以分离端点、决策规则和读出覆盖方面的失效。在五个系统和两个情绪语料库上，状态解码平均比生成高出 27.8 个准确率点，且决策规则和读出覆盖差距在所有十个条件下均为正。无标签 logit 校正可在每个条件下提升生成准确率，而排名匹配比较显示情绪信息可泛化到未见说话者，但替换读出外部方向对发出答案影响很小。
Motivation: 语音语言模型的副语言任务评估常把音频到答案计算中不同阶段的失败混在一起，导致仅看答案准确率无法定位性能瓶颈。需要区分决策规则错位（decision-rule misalignment）与读出覆盖限制（readout-coverage limitations）。
Method: 提出生成对齐的诊断阶梯，比较发出答案、选项 logits、logits 的仿射读出和同一答案 token 处隐藏状态的线性读出，用逐级差分分离端点、决策规则和读出覆盖差距；并采用无标签 logit 校正与排名匹配比较来检验信息可用性。
Result: 五个系统和两个情绪语料库上，状态解码平均比生成高出 27.8 个准确率点，决策规则和读出覆盖差距在所有十个条件下均为正；无标签 logit 校正使每个条件下的生成准确率都提升，情绪信息在排名匹配比较中可泛化到未见说话者并抵抗声学描述符控制，但替换读出外部方向通常几乎不影响发出答案。
Conclusion: 结果表明需要区分信息可用性与行为使用，并把性能损失定位到决策规则和状态到答案读出两个环节。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SubtleTalk: Generating Controllable Weakly-correlated Facial Dynamics for 3D Talking Heads via Residual Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Audio-driven 3D facial animation aims to synthesize realistic and temporally coherent motions from speech. Despite notable progress in lip synchronization, weakly correlated dynamics, including eyebrow movements, eye blinks, and head motion, which are essential to photorealistic facial animation, remain difficult to model faithfully and often appear static or unnaturally repetitive. We attribute this limitation to three factors: (a) insufficient conditioning for weakly correlated dynamics; (b) the limited ability of deterministic regression to capture diverse motion patterns; (c) data bottlenecks from unreliable upper-face pseudo-labels and limited dataset diversity. To address these issues, we propose SubtleTalk, a framework for generating natural and controllable weakly correlated facial dynamics via multi-condition modeling and residual flow matching. First, to compensate for the limited guidance of speech alone, we introduce interpretable controls, including prosody, regional intensity, and Valence-Arousal signals, to explicitly capture the timing, magnitude, and affective variation of weakly correlated dynamics. Second, to overcome the limited expressiveness of deterministic regression, we build residual flow matching based on a stable speech-driven motion prior, allowing the model to capture stochastic deviations beyond deterministic prediction. Third, to alleviate the data bottleneck, we construct SubtleTalk-Face, a large-scale 3D facial animation dataset comprising about 3,900 identities and 74 hours of data, built via a simple and scalable pseudo-labeling pipeline and featuring improved upper-face tracking and frame-level VA annotations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly improves the realism and diversity of weakly correlated facial dynamics while preserving accurate lip synchronization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SubtleTalk，一个面向三维说话头（3D talking head）的弱相关面部动态生成框架，基于多条件建模与残差流匹配（residual flow matching）。摘要称其引入韵律、区域强度和 Valence-Arousal 信号等可解释控制，并构建包含约 3900 个身份、74 小时数据的 SubtleTalk-Face 数据集，显著提升眉毛运动、眨眼、头部运动等动态的真实感与多样性，同时保持准确的唇形同步。
Motivation: 现有音频驱动 3D 面部动画在唇形同步上进展显著，但眉毛运动、眨眼、头部运动等弱相关动态难以忠实建模，常显得静态或重复。作者将这一局限归因于弱相关动态的条件信息不足、确定性回归的多样性表达能力有限，以及上脸伪标签不可靠与数据多样性不足。
Method: 提出 SubtleTalk 框架，包含三部分：引入韵律（prosody）、区域强度（regional intensity）与 Valence-Arousal 信号作为可解释控制，显式建模弱相关动态的时序、幅度与情感变化；在稳定的语音驱动运动先验之上构建残差流匹配，以捕捉确定性预测之外的随机偏差；构建大尺度 3D 面部动画数据集 SubtleTalk-Face（约 3900 个身份、74 小时数据），通过简单可扩展的伪标签流程改进上脸追踪并提供帧级 VA 标注。
Result: 大量实验表明该方法显著提升弱相关面部动态的真实感与多样性，同时保持准确的唇形同步；摘要未给出具体量化数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调多条件建模与残差流匹配结合大规模数据可以缓解弱相关动态的建模瓶颈，实现自然且可控的面部动画生成；摘要本身未讨论明确局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TransSLR: A Lightweight Transformer for Sign Language Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Automated Sign Language Recognition for under-represented languages remains a largely unsolved problem. Central African Sign Language (CASL) exemplifies this gap: the only available bench-mark, CASL-W60, has a best reported accuracy of 69.93%, and we show that the common heuristic of fine-tuning high-resource models fails to close it. This failure stems from two compounding factors: the limited scale of available CASL data and the significant lexical and visual domain gap between CASL and large-scale corpora such as WLASL, which renders pre-trained representations largely uninformative. To address this, we propose TransSLR, a lightweight Temporal Transformer Encoder trained from scratch on 64-frame normalized pose sequences, with average pooling and a classification head. By operating on geometric keypoint representations rather than raw RGB, TransSLR achieves signer-independent generalization without relying on visual appearance. On the CASL-W60 benchmark, TransSLR establishes a new state-of-the-art accuracy of 80.39%, surpassing the prior best by +10.46%. Beyond accuracy, our encoder-only design significantly reduces computational overhead, making deployment feasible in resource-constrained environments. We conduct extensive experiments on the CASL-W60 benchmark, comparing against RGB-based and multimodal baselines, and demonstrate that TransSLR achieves state-of-the-art performance.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted for oral presentation at Deep Learning Indaba 2026 which will be hosted on the IJCAI hosting platform. paper link: https://chairingtool.com/conferences/dli2026/main-track/submissions/356
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对中非手语（CASL）这类低资源手语识别问题，提出轻量级模型 TransSLR，一种从零训练的时序 Transformer 编码器，输入为 64 帧归一化姿态序列，配合平均池化与分类头。在 CASL-W60 基准上，TransSLR 达到 80.39% 的准确率，较此前最优的 69.93% 提升 10.46 个百分点，并显著降低计算开销。
Motivation: 自动手语识别在低资源语言上仍未解决，CASL 仅有 CASL-W60 基准且最佳准确率仅 69.93%。作者指出微调高资源模型的常见策略在此失效，原因是 CASL 数据规模有限，且 CASL 与 WLASL 等大规模语料之间存在显著的词汇和视觉域差距，预训练表征基本无效。
Method: 提出 TransSLR，一种基于几何关键点而非原始 RGB 的轻量级时序 Transformer 编码器，从零训练于 64 帧归一化姿态序列，后端使用平均池化和分类头，不依赖视觉外观以实现跨说话人（signer-independent）泛化。
Result: 在 CASL-W60 基准上达到 80.39% 的准确率，超越此前最优结果 10.46 个百分点；相比 RGB 和多模态基线，编码器-only 设计大幅降低计算开销，适合资源受限环境。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于姿态关键点的编码器-only 设计既能带来跨说话人的鲁棒性，也能降低部署成本；实验仅在 CASL-W60 基准上验证，展示了针对低资源手语识别的新最优水平。
